65\. From the ocean in the east, upto the ocean in the west, the huge Himalaya and Vindhyachala mountains and the land in between the two mountains is known as Madhyadesa. It is also known as Aryavarta.

## \|\| 1.7.66 \|\|

*aṭate yatra kṛṣṇā gaurmṛgo nityaṃ svabhāvataḥ \|*  
*sa jñeyo yājñiko deśo mlecchadeśastvataḥ paraḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. The country in which the black buck or the black cows roam about naturally, such a region is fit for the performance of the yajnas. Beyond this land, there exists the Mleccha country.

## \|\| 1.7.67 \|\|

*etānnityaṃ śubhāndeśānsaṃśrayeta dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*yasminkasmiṃśca nivasetpādajo2 vṛttikarśitaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. An excellent Brahmana should take refuge in the aforesaid lands. The Shudras who were born out of the feet, can patronize any country to earn their livelihood. There is no restriction for them.

## \|\| 1.7.68 \|\|

*prakīrtiteyaṃ dharmasya budhairyonirdvijottamāḥ \|*  
*sambhavaścāsya sarvasya samāsānna tu vistarāt \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. O excellent group of Brahmanas, the learned people have prescribed this method for achieving knowledge, which has already been spoken by me and the story for the birth of all has also been narrated in brief and not exhaustively.

## Chapter 8. Description of evil and noble character of the women

## \|\| 1.8.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kartavyaṃ yadgṛhasthena tadidānīṃ nibodhata \|*  
*gadato dvijaśārdūla vistarācchāstratastathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O lion among the Brahmanas, now the duties to be performed by the people living in a household and their performance in that capacity is being highlighted by me in an elaborate manner, which you please listen.

## \|\| 1.8.2 \|\|

*vaivāhike'gnau kurvīta gṛhyaṃ karma yathāvidhi \|*  
*śubhadeśāśrayaścaiva patnī vaivāhikī gṛhe \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. A householder should perform all the activities with the fire of the marriage. The married wife should enjoy the proper place in the household.

## \|\| 1.8.3 \|\|

*svāśrayeṇa vinā śakyaṃ na yasmādrakṣaṇādikam \|*  
*vittānāmiva dārāṇāmatastadvidhirucyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Without possessing a proper refuge or a house, the ladies cannot be protected as in the case of honour or the wealth. Therefore, I am speaking out the rules for the ladies.

## \|\| 1.8.4 \|\|

*hetavo hi trivargasya viparītāstu1 mānada \|*  
*arakṣaṇādbhavantyasmādamīṣāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ matam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O granter of the pride to the people, as the ladies contribute massively in achieving trivarga, similarly in case, they are not well looked after, they become instrumental in the destruction of trivarga. Therefore, they should be well looked after.

## \|\| 1.8.5 \|\|

*nisargātpuṃsyasantoṣādguṇadoṣavimarṣataḥ \|*  
*duṣṭānāṃ cāpi saṃsargādrakṣyā eva ca yoṣitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The women should be protected in the dwelling place, by native, natural dissatisfaction, by the feelings, merits and demerits, transposition, besides the contact with the evil people.

## \|\| 1.8.6 \|\|

*puruṣasthānaveśmāni trividhaṃ prāhurāśrayam \|*  
*vittānāṃ rakṣaṇādyarthamapūrvādhigamāya ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. For the women there are three places of refuge, viz. the man (husband), the place and the abodes. The protection of wealth and riches, achieving of the unachieved, are the three types of refuges.

## \|\| 1.8.7 \|\|

*kulīno nītimānprājñaḥ satyasandho dṛḍhavrataḥ \|*  
*vinīto dhārmikastyāgī2 vijñeyaḥ puruṣāśrayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A person of the auspicious family, well versed in policy, intelligent, truthful, having a firm mind, humble, religious-minded and the one devoid of greed, should be considered fit for the ashrama.

## \|\| 1.8.8 \|\|

*nagare kharvaṭe kheṭe grāme cāpi kramāgate \|*  
*yātrāvaśādvā nivaseddhārmikādyajanānvite \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. In the context of the travel, a place with enough of the religious minded people, a small town or a village, should be selected for living.

## \|\| 1.8.9 \|\|

*guruṇānumatastatra grāmaṇyādijanena vā \|*  
*prativeśmādyabādhena śuddhaṃ kuryānniveśanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In any one of the aforesaid appropriate place, with the permission of the preceptor or with the help of the prominent local people, a flawless dwelling place should be built without causing any inconvenience to neighbors.

## \|\| 1.8.10-11 \|\|

*dvāracatvaraśālānāṃ 1 sarvakārukaveśmanām \|*  
*dyūtasūnāsurāveśanaṭarājānujīvinām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pākhaṇḍadevavīthīnāṃ rājamārgakulasya ca \|*  
*dūrātsuguptaṃ kartavyā jīvikā vibhavocitā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. One should build his residence with an entrance gate away from the crossings, king’s house, houses of all types of artisans, houses of gamblers, the abodes of harlots, actors, the dwelling places of the royal servants, besides the cheats. One should build his house as per his means at a secured place to earn his livelihood.

## \|\| 1.8.12 \|\|

*sāpidhānaikaniṣkāśaṃ śuddhapṛṣṭaṃ samantataḥ \|*  
*sadvṛttāptajanākīrṇamaduṣṭaprātiveśikam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A house with terraces and a single gate, clearly visible from all the four sides should be built. It should be located at a place surrounded by the dwelling places of good natured and respected people. The neighbors should particularly not be of evil nature.

## \|\| 1.8.13-15 \|\|

*prāgudakpravaṇe deśe vāstuvidyāvidhānataḥ \|*  
*pravibhaktakriyākāñkṣaṃ sarvartukamanoharam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*arcāsnānodakāgāragoṣṭhāgāramahānasaiḥ \|*  
*yuktaṃ govājiśālābhiḥ sadāsībhṛtyakāśrayaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*bahirantaḥ purastrīkaṃ sarvopakaraṇairyutam \|*  
*vibhaktaśayanoddeśamāptavṛddhairadhiṣṭhitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. The house should be built over a place having a slope to the east or the north. It should be built according to vastu-shastra in such a way that it could be useful in all the seasons for all the purposes, with separate rooms like room for worship of gods, bath room, water storage, cow’s pen, kitchen, horse stable, servant quarters, the ladies inner apartment and separate rooms for the purpose of storage of various commodities. The bedroom for ladies should be located at a separate place, which should be well guarded close to the bed rooms of the elderly people.

## \|\| 1.8.16 \|\|

*arakṣaṇāddhi dārāṇāṃ varṇasaṅkarajādayaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭā hi bahavo doṣāstasmādrakṣyāḥ sadā striyaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Without the proper protection of the women, several blemishes like the mixed progeny etc. develop. Therefore, the women should always be well guarded.

## \|\| 1.8.17 \|\|

*na hyāsāṃ pramadaṃ dadyānna svātantryaṃ na viśvaset \|*  
*viśvastavacca ceṣṭeta nyāyyaṃ bhartsanamācaret \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. They should never be given the intoxicating drinks. Similarly, they should neither be made independent, nor one should have full faith in them. One should always behave as if having full faith in them, but occasionally they should be scolded as well.

## \|\| 1.8.18-19 \|\|

*nādhikāraṃ kvaciddadyādṛte pākādikarmaṇaḥ \|*  
*strīṇāṃ grāmīṇavattā hi bhogāyālaṃ suśāsitā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nityaṃ tatkarmayogena tāḥ kartavyā nirantarāḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ sarvadā vyāpteḥ syādavidyanirāśrayā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Leaving aside the task of the preparation of food, they should not be given any freedom. The women should remain in discipline and should be competent in the household jobs, which would be enough for them. They should not waste time sitting idle. In this way, the abode of a householder becomes free from ignorance and misfortune.

## \|\| 1.8.20-24 \|\|

*daurgatyamatirūpaṃ1 cāpyasatsaṅgaḥ svatantratā \|*  
*pānāśanakathāgoṣṭhīpriyatvākarmaśīlatā2 \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kuhakekṣaṇikāmuṇḍābhikṣukīsūtikādibhiḥ \|*  
*goprasaṅgaistathā3 sadbhirliṅgiyācakaśilpibhiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*saṃvāhodyānayātrāsūdyāneṣvāmantraṇādiṣu \|*  
*prasaṅgastīrthayātrārthaṃ dharmeṣu prakaṭeṣu ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*viprayogaḥ sadā bhartrā tajjñātikulaniḥsvatā \|*  
*amādhuryakadaryatve bhṛśaṃ puṃsāṃ ca vācyatā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*atikrauryamatikṣāntiratyantābhītipātanam \|*  
*strībhirjitatvamatyarthaṃ satyaṃ tāstāḥ sadoṣatāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. The poverty in a house, company of extremely beautiful evil people, freedom, drinking of wine, excellent food, excessive attraction of talking with others, sitting idle without work, special liking for enjoying the festivities, keeping company of female ascetics, quarrelsome women, dancer, mid-wife, ladies music, Sannyasi, beggar, artisan and people engaged in falsehood, excessive sex enjoyment, riding a vehicle, playing in on orchard, attending of invitations, going on pilgrimages, to wander on the pretext of religious work, separation from the husband, poverty in the family or the race, harsh treatment, cowardly listening to the denouncement of the husband, extreme cruelty, extreme peace, extreme danger, extreme fall, unable to get defeated soon, are the great blemishes for the ladies.

## \|\| 1.8.25 \|\|

*strīṇāṃ4 patyuradhīnatvātpumāneva hi nindyate \|*  
*bhartureva hi tajjāḍyaṃ yadbhṛtyānāmayogyatā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. A husband who acts at the command of a wife, always earns disgrace. This is also a proof of the incompetence of the husband, that his servants become lethargic.

## \|\| 1.8.26 \|\|

*tasmādyathoditāsvetā rakṣyāḥ śāsanatāḍanaiḥ \|*  
*tāḍanaiśca yathākālaṃ yathāvatsamupācaret \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Therefore, as has already been stated, the women should be protected by means of discipline and punishment. When the exigencies of the situation so desire, they should be respected as well.

## \|\| 1.8.27 \|\|

*parigṛhya bahūndārānupacāraiḥ samo bhavet \|*  
*yathākramocitaiḥ karma dānasatkāravāsanaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When a man marries more than one wives, then all should be treated equally. Taking into consideration their age and seniority, they should be respected and given costumes and other gifts.

## \|\| 1.8.28 \|\|

*prathamo'bhijano dharmo yogyatvaṃ ca suputratā \|*  
*pakṣe vittaṃ viśetstrīṇāṃ mānastatkāraṇaṃ tathā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The first and the foremost quality of a woman is her noble birth. Then comes her producing a son, besides her religious conduct. They should be given riches, keeping in view the time. Once should keep in mind their due respect and should always keep in view the cause.

## \|\| 1.8.29 \|\|

*tasmānmāno na kartavyo heyaścāpi na tatkṛtaḥ \|*  
*gurutve lāghave vāpi satāṃ kāryaṃ nibandhanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Therefore, she should neither be respected without any reasons, nor should be disgraced without any reason. The noble people should frame rules for showering grace or disgrace on women.

## \|\| 1.8.30 \|\|

*ākasmike prayuñjānaḥ prekṣāvānmānalāghave \|*  
*sa yatkiñcanakāritvāccāyamevaiti lāghavam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. To praise or denounce anyone without any reason, results in a person himself facing degradation or sudden rise.

## \|\| 1.8.31 \|\|

*yathā mānāpamānau hi prayujyetānimittataḥ \|*  
*tannimittā janatyāge prayatante tadāśritāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. As a person is praised or denounced without any reason, therefore the people taking refuge with him, keeping these facts in view, try to leave such a person.

## \|\| 1.8.32 \|\|

*etadeva hyapatyānāṃ1 jñeyaṃ mānanakāraṇam \|*  
*yatsvāpatyanimitteṣu2 pradhāne kulayogyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The grace of the children depends mainly on the family of their mother.

## \|\| 1.8.33 \|\|

*tatsaṃyogātsukhaṃ puṃsāṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ viyogataḥ \|*  
*tatprāptiḥ prati hātavyā svārthāyaiva priyāṇyapi \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. With the combination of the same, a person feels comfortable and separation causes grief. Therefore, for selfish purpose, its achieving should be discarded. Similarly, the things related to the same should also be discarded.

## \|\| 1.8.34 \|\|

*ataḥ svārthaikaniṣṭho'yaṃ lokaḥ sarvo'vasīyate \|*  
*tatprasiddhirbhavedastamānād bhrāntividhāyakaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Because of the selfish giver of women, the entire world has to face destruction. The destruction is known the world over.

## \|\| 1.8.35 \|\|

*tato dārādikā bhṛtyā niyantavyāstathā dvijāḥ \|*  
*yathehāmutra vā śreyaḥ prāpnuyāduttarottaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O group of Brahmanas, because of these reasons, the people should well control their servants and keep them well disciplined, to enable them to achieve welfare in the present as well the future world.

## \|\| 1.8.36 \|\|

*strīṇāṃ dharmārthakāmeṣu nātisandhānamācaret \|*  
*tāsāṃ teṣvabhisandhānādbhavedātmābhisaṃhitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. In the matters relating to the dharma, artha and kama, one should not be cheat the women. In case, someone behave with the women in a deceitful way, then he actually cheats his own soul.

## \|\| 1.8.37 \|\|

*jāyā tvardhaṃ śarīrasya nṛṇāṃ dharmādisādhane \|*  
*nātastāsu vyathāṃ kāñcitpratikūlaṃ samācaret \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Therefore, one should not behave in a deceitful way with the women, which could cause them mental pain.

## \|\| 1.8.38 \|\|

*yajñotsavādau nākasmātkāñcidāsāṃ viśeṣayet \|*  
*vastratāmbūladānādau pratipattau samo bhavet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. In case a person has more than one wives, then he should not extend special treatment to a particular wife, without any reason. One should behave similarly, in the matter of giving costumes, betel, etc. In other matters too, he should behave equally.

## \|\| 1.8.39 \|\|

*priyāpriyatvaṃ bhedo hi kāmatastu rahogataḥ \|*  
*upacāraiḥ punarvākyaistulyavṛttiḥ praśasyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Because of lust, in case a particular wife is more attached and the other is not so dear, then the person should behave with her similarly in seclusion. With the similar type of conduct, the similarity or parity is always praised.

## \|\| 1.8.40 \|\|

*ārtave tu punaḥ sarvā upagamyāḥ priyā iva \|*  
*pūrvābhijātadharmārthā putriṇī cottarottaram \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. One should unite with all the wives during the period equally. The senior most, belonging to high family, of noble character, religious minded and the one being the mother of a son, should be respected in a chronological order.

## \|\| 1.8.41 \|\|

*udaggacchedanenaiva vidhinā nityamārtave \|*  
*tulyavṛttiryathākālaṃ svaṃ svaṃ vāsamakhaṇḍayan \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. According to this procedure, one should unite with his wives during the periods. In due course of time, one should have the timely union with all the wives, without disturbing the rules.

## \|\| 1.8.42 \|\|

*nityaparyāyavāsānāmapādānamasūnviduḥ \|*  
*ṛtuduḥkhaṃ pramodaśca tathā pūrvaṃ samāgataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. By living in order is called Prana, The seasonal discomfort, comfort and the earlier unity and the union in perfect order during separated living is also called Prana.

## \|\| 1.8.43 \|\|

*anyayā saha yadduḥkhaṃ sadasadvā rahogatam \|*  
*utkaṇṭhitaṃ vā yatkiñcitsapatnīṣu na tadvaset \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Whatever experience a husband might have in seclusion with a particular wife or a wife about her husband, should not be revealed to the other wife.

## \|\| 1.8.44 \|\|

*yatkiñcidanyasambaddhamanyathā kathitaṃ mithaḥ \|*  
*tasya kuryādanirvedamātmanaiva vicintayet \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. In case a wife complains about another wife in seclusion, the husband should dispose of the matter then and there, removing the cause of the complain of the wife.

## \|\| 1.8.45 \|\|

*anyo'nyamatsarākhyānairna tā vācāpi bhartsayet \|*  
*guṇadoṣau ca vijñāya svayaṃ kuryānna niṣkalau \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. One should not carry to jealousy of one against the other, nor should it be spoken in the open. One should not reprimand the wife even orally. One should well understand the merits and demerits carefully and should make efforts to remove the same.

## \|\| 1.8.46 \|\|

*vastrālaṅkārabhojyādau tadapatyeṣvanukramāt \|*  
*mātṛdoṣānanādṛtya tulyadṛṣṭiḥ pitā bhavet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The children of all the wives should be equally treated in the distribution of costumes and ornaments, in the order of the mothers. Disregarding the shortcomings of the mother, the children should be treated equally.

## \|\| 1.8.47 \|\|

*anyasyānyagatairdoṣairdūṣaṇaṃ na hi nītimat \|*  
*yattu teṣāmapatyaṃ tu tattulyamubhayorapi \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The blemish of one should not attributed to the other, which would not proper. Same type of behaviour should extended to all.

## \|\| 1.8.48 \|\|

*prītiṃ dveṣamabhiprāyaṃ śaucāśaucagatāgamān \|*  
*bahirantaśca jānīyāddāsa gūḍhacaraiḥ sadā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The love of the women, their envy, intentions, auspiciousness, inauspiciousness, going inside or outside of the arrival and their other activities should be known through the slaves, servants or the spies.

## \|\| 1.8.49 \|\|

*ātmānamapi vijñāya cittavṛtteranīśvaram \|*  
*viśvaseta kathaṃ strīṣu sarvāvinayadhāmasu \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. When the mind of one’s own does not remain under control always, then how can one believe in the mind of a woman, who happens to be the form of discourtesy?

## \|\| 1.8.50 \|\|

*vṛddhadāsyaḥ kramāyātā dhātryaśca paricārikāḥ \|*  
*tanmātṛpitṛkādyāśca ṣaṇḍavṛddhāścarā matāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. One should keep a watch over the women through his spies, or the elderly people of the family, or the hereditary old slaves, co-wives, servants, their mothers and fathers besides others, in addition to the elderly eunuchs who are considered as spies.

## \|\| 1.8.51 \|\|

*vividhaistatkathākhyānaistulyaśīladayānvitaiḥ \|*  
*praviśyāntarabhiprāyaṃ vidyātkāle prayojitaiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. They should enter the inner apartments and narrating various stories etc., they should know their intentions or behaviour.

## \|\| 1.8.52 \|\|

*teṣu teṣu kathārtheṣu kathyamāneṣu lakṣayet \|*  
*mukhākārādibhirliṅgairabhiprāyaṃ manogatam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. At the time of the narration of the stories, the facial reaction on the prominent events should be watched, besides their bodily activities should be observed.

## \|\| 1.8.53 \|\|

*sītārundhatisambandhaistathā śākuntalādibhiḥ \|*  
*sadasaccaritākhyānairbhāvaṃ vidyātpravṛttitaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The mental conditions of the ladies should be observed by narrating the stories of Sita, Arundhati, Shakuntala and others.

## \|\| 1.8.54 \|\|

*tadduṣṭānāmaduṣṭeṣu sādhūnāmitareṣu ca \|*  
*prītiḥ kathāprabandheṣu syātsakhyaṃ puruṣeṣvitaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The men and the women who are referred to in these stories who are of evil or noble character, the ladies take special interest in them.

## \|\| 1.8.55 \|\|

*evamāgamaduṣṭābhyāmanumityā ca tattvataḥ \|*  
*strīṇāṃ viditvābhiprāyaṃ vartetāśu yathocitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thus on the basis of the provision of the Vedas, by learning about the true intentions of the ladies, suitable treatment should be extended to them.

## \|\| 1.8.56 \|\|

*strībhyo vipratipannābhyaḥ prāṇairapi viyojanam \|*  
*dṛṣṭaṃ hi ca yathā 1 rājñāmato rakṣetprayatnataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Because of the adverse conduct of the women, many of the rulers in the past had to face the end of their lives. Therefore, one should guard against such women, his own life quite carefully.

## \|\| 1.8.57 \|\|

*veṇyā gūḍhena śastreṇa hato rājā śubhadhvajaḥ \|*  
*mekhalāmaṇinā devyā sauvīraśca narādhipaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The king Shubhadhvaja had been killed with the weapons concealed in the locks of hair. The ruler of Sauvira was killed with the gem concealed by his queen in waistband.

## \|\| 1.8.58 \|\|

*bhrātrā devīprayuktena bhadraseno nipātitaḥ \|*  
*tathā putreṇa kārūṣo ghātito darpaṇāsinā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. With the inspiration of his own queen, the king Bhadrasena had been killed by his own brother. Similarly, the lord of the Karusha country, at the inspiration of his own wife was killed by his own son — the remover of the pain.

## \|\| 1.8.59 \|\|

*dvau kāśirājau vai vandyau cānandāpurayoṣitā \|*  
*viṣaṃ prayujya pañcatvamānītau pūjitātmakau \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Two kings of Kashi were quite popular with their subjects, were poisoned and killed by the ladies of the dream.

## \|\| 1.8.60 \|\|

*evamādi mahābhāgā rājāno brāhmaṇāśca ha \|*  
*strībhiryatra nipātyante tatrānyeṣviha kā kathā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. When the women had been instrumental in killing such powerful and highly glorious kings, then what to speak of the ordinary people.

## \|\| 1.8.61 \|\|

*tasmānnityāpramattena jāyā rakṣyāśca nityaśaḥ \|*  
*yathāvadupacaryāśca guṇadoṣānurūpataḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Keeping all these facts in view, a person should always remain alert and well protect himself and should deal with the women based on their merits and demerits.

## \|\| 1.8.62-63 \|\|

*vaiṣamyādupacārāṇāṃ vikāraiścānimittajaiḥ \|*  
*viśeṣeṇa sapatnīkairakasmāccāpi vedanaiḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*asambhāge ca vāgdaṇḍapāruṣyādaprasaṅgataḥ \|*  
*pradveṣo bhartari strīṇāṃ prakopaścāpi jāyate \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. A woman becomes envious of her husband because of ill treatments, impurity of mind, particularly emanating from the ill treatment of the co-wife, or punishment without any crime, decline in the desired sexual enjoyment, excess of punishment or to indulge in always speaking of the harsh words. Because of these reason, a woman becomes more and more envious of the husband.

## \|\| 1.8.64 \|\|

*tataścāyāti vārdhakyamudvoḍhuścāpi śatrutām \|*  
*tasmānna tānprayuñjīta doṣāndāravināśakān \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. This causes sexuality and enmity, therefore a person should not extend the aforesaid type of ill treatment towards the woman, which destroys them.

## \|\| 1.8.65 \|\|

*na caitāḥ svakulācāramadharmaṃ vāpi cāñjasā \|*  
*na guṇāṃścāpyupekṣante prakṛtyā kimu pīḍitāḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. When the women even after remaining sufficiently delightful, do not care much for the family tradition, evil ways and the nobility, then what would they do getting tortured?

## \|\| 1.8.66 \|\|

*satītve prāyaśaḥ strīṇāṃ pradṛṣṭaṃ kāraṇatrayam \|*  
*parapuṃsāmasamprītiḥ priye prītiḥ svarakṣaṇe \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Usually three reasons have been observed in their burning themselves with their dead husbands, viz. inability to have physical relationship with the other person, extraordinary love for the husband and self protection.

## \|\| 1.8.67 \|\|

*tasmātsurakṣitā nityamupacārairyathocitaiḥ \|*  
*subhṛtā1 nityakarmāṇaḥ kartavyā yoṣitaḥ sadā \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Therefore, the women should be protected extending the appropriate honour. They should always be lodged securely in the inner apartment and kept active always.

## \|\| 1.8.68 \|\|

*uttamāṃ sāmadānābhyāṃ madhyamābhyāṃ tu madhyamām \|*  
*paścimābhyāmubhāmyāṃ ca adhamāṃ samprasādhayet \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. A woman with an excellent temperament should be kept delightful with sweet words or presents. Similarly, the middle types of women should be pleased by gifts and occasionally by punishment. The women of the degraded temperament should be kept under control by punishment or dissension.

## \|\| 1.8.69 \|\|

*bhedadaṇḍau prayujyāpi prāgapatyādyapekṣayā \|*  
*tacchiṣṭānāṃ tadā paścātsāmadānaprasādhane \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. On the woman of degraded character, punishment and dissension should be tried first and then for the protection of the children, the policy of presenting gifts should be tried.

## \|\| 1.8.70 \|\|

*yāstu vidhvastacāritrā bhartuścāhitakārikāḥ \|*  
*tyājyā evaṃ striyaḥ sadbhiḥ2 kālakūṭaviṣopamāḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Such of the wicked women, who possess evil character and always think evil about their husbands, the noble people should think them like the terrific poison and should be discarded.

## \|\| 1.8.71 \|\|

*iṣṭāḥ 3 kulodgatāḥ sādhvyo vinītā bhartṛvatsalāḥ \|*  
*sarvadā sādhanīyāstāḥ sampradāyottarottaraiḥ 4 \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The woman, who is quite docile, is born in high race, chaste, humble, always favourite of the husband, should be given all the respect, pleasing her.

## \|\| 1.8.72 \|\|

*evameva yathoddiṣṭaṃ strīvṛttaṃ yo'nutiṣṭhati \|*  
*prāpnotyeva sa sampūrṇaṃ trivargaṃ 5 lokasambhavam \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. A person who behaves with his wife according to the above rules, he surely enjoys the trivarga and all the desired pleasures in the world.

## Chapter 9. Duties of the women

## \|\| 1.9.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ strīṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ vṛttiruktā samāsataḥ \|*  
*sāmprataṃ ca manuṣyeṣu strīṇāṃ samupadiśyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — I have briefly spoken about the behaviour of the men towards the women. I am now speaking about the behaviour of the women towards the men, which you please listen.

## \|\| 1.9.2 \|\|

*samyagārādhanātpuṃsāṃ ratirvṛttiśca yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*putrāḥ svargādyadṛṣṭaṃ ca tasmādiṣṭo hi tadvidhiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. When the woman adores the husband with devotion, only then she can achieve the pleasure and comfort of sex, the son, the heaven and several other inaccessible commodities. Therefore, it is her duty to well behave with her husband.

## \|\| 1.9.3 \|\|

*kartavyaṃ nāma yatkiñcitsarvaṃ 1 vidhimapekṣate \|*  
*vyaktimāyāti vaiphalyaṃ tadevārabdhamanyathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. All the duties in the world are based on the means and the methods. A task which is initiated without the means or the methods, the failure in such cases, becomes too apparent.

## \|\| 1.9.4 \|\|

*vidhyapekṣīṇi sarvāṇi kāryāṇyaviphalānyapi \|*  
*hetubhūtāstrivargasya mahārambhā viśeṣataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In case the tasks are initiated in a proper manner, then success is certain. In case such tasks are started with alertness, that result in a person’s achieving trivarga or dharma, artha and kama.

## \|\| 1.9.5 \|\|

*sarvasādhyāvidhijñānamāgamaikanibandhanam \|*  
*sādhyaṃ dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ ca dvayaṃ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Only the scriptures serve as the guide for the tasks which are to be performed and those which are prohibited. The visible and invisible tasks are attainable.

## \|\| 1.9.6 \|\|

*śāstrādhikāro na strīṇāṃ na granthānāṃ ca dhāraṇe \|*  
*tasmādihānye manyante tacchāsanamanarthakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. But the access to the women of the scriptures as well as the Vedas has been forbidden. They also cannot read them. Therefore, it is of no use to advise them on the subject.

## \|\| 1.9.7 \|\|

*āgamaikakriyāyoge strīṇāmadhyadhikāritā \|*  
*mṛte bhartari sādhvī syādityādau smṛtibhāṣitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. It is only the performing of the yajnas that the ladies are required to participate therein. After the death of the husband, the ladies are required to observe noble conduct. The Smritis also support the views on the subject.

## \|\| 1.9.8 \|\|

*tasmātkāryamakāryaṃ vā vijñāya prabhurāgamāt \|*  
*guṇadoṣeṣu tāḥ samyakchāsti rājā prajā iva \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The husband should do duties which are required to be performed as per the provision of the Vedas and also those which are prohibited as per the provision of the Vedas, and should extend the same type of behaviour towards the women, as a king extends towards the subjects.

## \|\| 1.9.9 \|\|

*satyeva pramadāḥ kāścidviśeṣādhigatāgamāḥ \|*  
*yattu śāstrādhikāritvaṃ vacanaṃ syānnirarthakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The knowledge of the Vedas as a subject is possessed by a few women only. The talk of the right to the access of the Vedas for such women is of no use.

## \|\| 1.9.10 \|\|

*kecidvedavido viprāḥ kṛtyairveṣakriyāparāḥ \|*  
*tathāpi 4 jātimātreṇa ta evātrādhikāriṇaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. There are certain Brahmanas, who clad themselves according to the provisions of the Vedas and also conduct themselves accordingly. But their access towards the Vedas is their caste only.

## \|\| 1.9.11 \|\|

*kriyante vedaśāstrajñaiḥ prayogāḥ śāstralaukikāḥ \|*  
*sthitameṣāmadūre'pi śāstrameva nibandhanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The Brahmanas getting well-versed in the Vedas and Shastras, conduct themselves both ways according to the Vedas as well as the Shastras in the worldly activities. Because of their closeness to the Shastras, they are considered to be the authority on the subject.

## \|\| 1.9.12 \|\|

*vyādhadhīvaragopālaprabhṛtīnāṃ ca dṛśyate \|*  
*viṣṭyaṃ gārakasauryādidinānāṃ parivarjanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The hunters, the fishermen, the milkmen and people of other castes, do not perform certain activities on Bhadra (second, seventh and twelfth day of the lunar months) besides on Tuesdays and Sundays.

## \|\| 1.9.13 \|\|

*gamyāgamyādikāryeyaṃ niyatācārasaṃsthitiḥ \|*  
*lokānāṃ śāstravākyānāṃ prāṇāḥ sveṣṭanibandhanāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. For the performing of proper or improper activities even, they remain conscious. They do not have to consult anyone on the subject.

## \|\| 1.9.14 \|\|

*tasmāccaturṇāṃ varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*mukhyagauṇādibhedānāṃ jñeyā śāstrādhikāritā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The interpretation of the words of Shastras as well as the worldly conduct depends on one’s own interpretation. Therefore, the right for access to the scriptures of the people living in the different stages of life, would be foremost as well as otherwise.

## \|\| 1.9.15 \|\|

*paurvāparyaṃ tu vijñātumaśakyaṃ lokaśāstrayoḥ \|*  
*tacchāstrameva mantavyaṃ yathā karmaśarīravat \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Like the body and the activity, it would be difficult to ascertain as to which one of the emerged earlier and which emerged later. Therefore, the Shastras should be considered to be the foundation of all.

## \|\| 1.9.16 \|\|

*āgame ca purāṇe ca dvidhaiva nāstikagraham \|*  
*mārgaṃ mahadbhirācīrṇaṃ prapadyetāvikalpadhīḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Knowledge about atheism can be traced in the Vedas as well as the Puranas in two ways. Therefore, the path prescribed by the people of nobility should be accepted without any doubt.

## \|\| 1.9.17 \|\|

*mūlaṃ gṛhasthadharmāṇāṃ yasmānnāryaḥ pativratāḥ \|*  
*tasmādāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi bharturārādhane vidhim \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The ladies are the foundation for the purities of the activities of the household. Therefore, the way they should adore their husbands, I am going to highlight the same.

## Chapter 10. Conduct of the women

## \|\| 1.10.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ārādhyānāṃ hi sarveṣāmayamārādhane vidhiḥ \|*  
*citta1 jñānānuvṛttiśca hitaiṣitvaṃ ca sarvadā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — This is the only method of worshipping the venerable ones, which is going to be highlighted by me. The adorer should initially know about the state of mind of the venerable one. Thereafter, he should conduct himself accordingly.

## \|\| 1.10.2-3 \|\|

*kanyā punarbhūrveśyā ca trividhā eva yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*priyā madhyāpriyā caiva yogyā madhyetarā tathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*samā śreṣṭhā ca nīcā ca bhūyopi trividhāḥ punaḥ \|*  
*pūrvavatparayorvṛttiriṣṭānuktyā 1 priyāpriye \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. The women are of three types, viz., a girl or a maid, a virgin widow who is remarried and the whore. All the three of them are known as beloved, middle beloved or the degraded beloved. Again the women are of three types, viz. equal, the best as well as the degraded one. Leaving asided the beloved and otherwise, the remaining two types of women have to perform the same duties as those performed by the earlier ones. In other words, the later women do not love a person like the initial women and are more sinful than the initial women. But in other activities like giving birth to the sons or performing of the other household activities, both of them are equated with the first one.

## \|\| 1.10.4 \|\|

*adhamāpriyayoratra patipatnyādikā matā \|*  
*niṣiddhānāṃ tu bhakṣyādi taddhi yatnādvidhīyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The degraded and unlovable couples have relations of a husband and wife, the same is found in the forbidden couples, like the forbidden food. O group of Brahmanas, we shall speak about the result of the same.

## \|\| 1.10.5 \|\|

*ekadvitvabahutvādyā2 ye bhedāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ \|*  
*jyeṣṭhādivṛtte vakṣyāmastānaśeṣāndvijottamāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In the context of the activities of the Jyeshtha, I shall now speak out. It is said that the women are of various types, which are based on their individual conduct basically.

## \|\| 1.10.6 \|\|

*vṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ strīṇāṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ tathā \|*  
*bharturanyajane bāhyaṃ tasyāḥ śārīramāntaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Leaving aside the inward or outward husband, all the activities relating to one’s own body are known as interior.

## \|\| 1.10.7 \|\|

*jñātītaravibhāgena tadbāhyaṃ dvividhaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*pūjyaṃ tulyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ ca tatpratyekaṃ punastridhā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The outward conduct is also of two types, one relating to one’s own kiths and kins and the others besides the unrelated people. The latter are also of three types, viz. respectable, similar and of lower ranks. Out of the aforesaid two divisions, each one has three divisions.

## \|\| 1.10.8 \|\|

*rahorataṃ prakāśaṃ ca śārīramapi tattridhā \|*  
*bhartuścittānukūlyena prayoktavyaṃ yathocitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Similarly, according to the conduct of the body, there are three parts, viz. the wife should conduct herself according to the image of her husband.

## \|\| 1.10.9-10 \|\|

*mātā pitā svasā bhrātā pitṛvyācāryamātulāḥ \|*  
*sabhāryā 3 bhaginī bhartā bhartṛmātṛpitṛṣvasā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dhātrī vṛddhāṅganādiśca yastatrāstā samo janaḥ \|*  
*prathamoḍhā sapatnī ca strīṇāṃ mānyatamo gaṇaḥ 4 \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The parents, elder sisters, uncle, maternal uncle, Acharya, sisters of uncles, the master and husband, besides the mother, the husband and their sisters, co-wives, the old ladies of the family are all equally adorable. The wife who is married first is also respectable.

## \|\| 1.10.11 \|\|

*eṣāmeva tvapatyādibhaginībhrātarastathā \|*  
*kaniṣṭhā bharturityādibhāryāścāptasamo mataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The sons and daughters of all these, the younger brothers and sisters, who touch the feet of the husband, have to be extended due respect.

## \|\| 1.10.12 \|\|

*hīno'nyaḥ śāsanīyastu tatra tāvanna vidyate \|*  
*yogyatā sutasaubhāgyairna yāvatsyātpratiṣṭhitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. For a bride in her husband’s house, no younger person is under control, till such time she gets a son, or achieves other fortunes.

## \|\| 1.10.13 \|\|

*yatrāpi guru bhartṝṇāmānukūlyena sarvadā \|*  
*vṛttiḥ praśasyate strīṇāṃ pūjācārāvirodhinī5 \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A bride should conduct herself according to the wishes of her preceptors. Besides serving the preceptors as well as her husband, performing of the vratas are considered to be quite praiseworthy for a bride in a family.

## \|\| 1.10.14 \|\|

*devaraiḥ patimitraiśca parihāsakriyocitaiḥ \|*  
*viviktadeśāvasthānaṃ varjayediti narma ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The bride should not cut jokes in seclusion with the younger brothers of the husband as well as the friends of her husband.

## \|\| 1.10.15 \|\|

*prāyaśo hi kulastrīṇāṃ śīlavidhvaṃsahetavaḥ \|*  
*duṣṭayogo raho nityaṃ svātantryamatinarmatā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. These activities cause the downfall of the modesty of the bride at times. Similar is the case with the association with evil people, freedom to remain in seclusion and excess of joking and laughing.

## \|\| 1.10.16 \|\|

*duṣṭasaṅge tvarā strīṇāṃ yuvabhirnarma nocitam \|*  
*nirbheṣatā svatantrāṇāṃ sāphalyaṃ rahasi yajet \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The association with the evil people and quickness in the same, besides joking with the youthful boys is totally improper for the women. The evil activities of the self-willed women quickly prosper in seclusion.

## \|\| 1.10.17 \|\|

*puṃso duṣṭeṅgitākārānduṣṭabhāvaprayojitān \|*  
*bhrātṛvatpitṛvaccaitānpaśyatī parivarjayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The dirty indications of other men are ill — intentioned. A woman should therefore, visualising such activities from the view of his brother or father, should ignore them totally.

## \|\| 1.10.18-22 \|\|

*puṃso' nyāgrahamālāpasmitaviprekṣitāni ca \|*  
*karāntareṇa 1 dravyāṇāṃ nibandhaṃ grahaṇārpaṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*dvārapradeśāvasthānaṃ rājamārgāvalokanam \|*  
*prekṣodyānādiśīlatvaṃ niruṣyāddeśamālayam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bahūnāṃ darśane sthānaṃ dṛṣṭivākkāyacāpalam \|*  
*ṣṭhīvanatvaṃ sasītkāramuccairhasitajalpitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sāṅgatyaṃ liṅgiduṣṭastrībhighṛṇīkṣaṇikādibhiḥ \|*  
*mantramaṇḍaladīkṣāyāṃ saktiḥ saṃvasaneṣu ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ityevamādidurvṛttaṃ prāyoduṣṭajanocitam \|*  
*varjayetparirakṣantī kulatritayavācyatām \|\| 22 \|\|*

18-22. The giving and taking of things with other people, conversation, cutting of jokes, sending of money to people in far off places, standing at the main door where one is visible to many, unstability or the wavering of the eyes, body postures besides spitting, laughing aloud, indulging in loose talk or to keep company of a recluse, evil woman, female beggar, quarrelsome women, etc., initiation with mantras, and to get attracted towards the village fairs are the activities conducive for the people of the evil minds. The chaste bride should discard these activities for the safeguard of her own honour as well as the honour of the three races related to her.

## Chapter 11. Household dharma of the ladies

## \|\| 1.11.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yā patiṃ daivataṃ paśyenmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ \|*  
*taccharīrārdhajāteva sarvadā hitamācaret \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — A chaste wife, always with action, thought and behaviour, should adore her husband like a god and for his welfare, she should make all the efforts as if she was born of half of his body.

## \|\| 1.11.2 \|\|

*tatpriyāṃ priyavatpaśyettaddveṣyā dveṣyavatsadā \|*  
*adharmānarthayuktebhyo'yuktā cāsya nivartate \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. She should love the things liked by her husband and should dislike the things not liked by her husband. She should do her best to save her husband from the evil ways.

## \|\| 1.11.3 \|\|

*priyaṃ kimasya kiṃ pathyaṃ sāmyaṃ cāsya kathaṃ bhavet \|*  
*jñātvaivaṃ sarvabhṛtyeṣu na pramādyeta vai dvijāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O group of Brahmanas, a chaste woman should always think as to what would be liked by her husband? Keeping all these in view, she should not behave irresponsibly with the slaves and the slave girls.

## \|\| 1.11.4 \|\|

*devatāpitṛkāryeṣu bhartuḥ snānāśanādiṣu \|*  
*satkāre'bhyāgatānāṃ ca yathaucityaṃ na hāpayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In performing of the rites for the gods and the manes, the wife should do her best to welcome the guests and conduct herself appropriately, besides making arrangement for the bath of her husband.

## \|\| 1.11.5 \|\|

*veśmātmā ca śarīraṃ hi gṛhiṇīnāṃ dvidhā kṛtam \|*  
*saṃskartavyaṃ prayatnena prathamaṃ paścimādapi \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The bodies of the householders’ wives have been divided into two parts, i.e. the body as well as the soul. Out of these two, the house should be kept more neat and clean than one’s own soul.

## \|\| 1.11.6 \|\|

*kṛtvā veśma susaṃmṛṣṭaṃ trikālavihitārcanam \|*  
*vṛttakarmopabhogānāṃ saṃskartavyaṃ yathocitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. During the morning, noon and evening, the house should be dusted and cleaned and then it should be adored. Besides this, in all her domestic activities as well as the commodities, the cleanliness must be maintained, making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.11.7 \|\|

*prātarmadhyāparāhṇeṣu bahirmadhyāntareṣu ca \|*  
*gṛhasammārjanaṃ kṛtvā niṣkārānna niśi kṣipet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In the house as well as outside it, besides the middle of it, every place should be broomed in the morning, noon and evening and the rubbish should be thrown out. But the rubbish should not be thrown out in the open during the night.

## \|\| 1.11.8 \|\|

*gomahiṣyādiśālānāṃ tatpurīṣādimātrakam \|*  
*vyapaneyaṃ tu yatnena sammārjanyā prasādhanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The cowpen as well as the buffalo-pen should be kept neat and clean removing their urine and the dung.

## \|\| 1.11.9 \|\|

*dāsakarmakarādīnāṃ bāhyābhyantaracāriṇām \|*  
*poṣaṇādividhiṃ vidyādanuṣṭhānaṃ ca karmasu \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The housewife should make adequate arrangement for the food and beverages of the domestic slaves and the slave girls, besides other servants. She should keep a watch over all the household activities.

## \|\| 1.11.10 \|\|

*śākamūlaphalādīnāṃ vallīnāmauṣadhasya ca \|*  
*saṅgrahaḥ sarvabījānāṃ yathākālaṃ yathābalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The vegetables, roots, fruits, creepers and aushadhis besides all types of seeds should be regularly kept in store of the house, occasionally according to one’s means.

## \|\| 1.11.11 \|\|

*tāmrakāṃsyāyasādīnāṃ kāṣṭhaveṇumayasya 1 ca \|*  
*mṛnmayānāṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ vividhānāṃ ca saṅgraham \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The vases for the domestic use which are made of copper, bell metal, iron, wood and bamboo besides the earthen wares, which are useful for the household, should be stored appropriately.

## \|\| 1.11.12 \|\|

*kuṇḍakādijaladroṇyā kalaśodañcatālukāḥ \|*  
*śākapātrāṇyanekāni snehānāṃ gorasasya ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Huge troughs for the storage of water, pitchers, mugs and the vases required for the storage of the vegetables, should also be stored. The vases for the storage of the oil as well as the milk of the cows, should also be collected carefully.

## \|\| 1.11.13-15 \|\|

*musalaṃ kuṇḍanīyaṃ tu yantrakaṃ2 cūrṇacālanī \|*  
*dohanyo netrakaṃ manthā maṇḍanyaḥ śṛṅkhalāni ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*saṃdaṃśaḥ kuṇḍikā śūlāḥ paṭṭapippalako dṛṣat \|*  
*ḍāvikā hastako darvī bhrāṣṭasphuṭalakāni ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tulāprasthādimānāni mārjanyaḥ piṭakāni ca \|*  
*sarvametatprakurvīta prayatnena ca sarvadā \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. The mortar, pestle, winnowing baskets, sieve, milk pail, grinding stone, grinding hand — mill, churning stick, chain, pincer, shallow earthen pot, spear, a bowl, spoon with a large handle, fork, a ladle, pan, handloom, scale or balance, sera (weight), half of sera, axe, besides the brooms should be kept in the house, which are quite useful for the running of a household.

## \|\| 1.11.16-19 \|\|

*hiṃgvādikamatho jājī pipalyo māricāni ca \|*  
*rājikā dhānyakaṃ śuṇṭhī tricaturjātakāni ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*lavaṇaṃ kṣāravargāśca sauvīrakaparūṣakau \|*  
*dvidalāmalakaṃ ciṃcā sarvāśca snehajātayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śuṣkakāṣṭhāni vallūramariṣṭā piṣṭamāṣayoḥ \|*  
*vikārāḥ payasaścāpi vividhāḥ kandajātayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nityanaimittikānāṃ hi kāryāṇāmupayogataḥ \|*  
*sarvamityādi saṃgrāhyaṃ yathāvadvibhavocitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. Besides the articles like the asafetida (hinga), cumin seeds, solution, coriander, mustard, dry ginger of three types, salt, other types of alkalines or salt, vinegar, pulses, myrobalan, tamarind, all types of oils, dry wood, black green powder, dry meat, soap nut, besides the milk and all other things which are used for the milk preparations, all types of sugar-candy and all other commodities useful for the household, should be collected in advance. According to one’s own financial position, all these things, after careful consideration, should be collected and stored in the house.

## \|\| 1.11.20-21 \|\|

*yatkāryāṇāṃ samutpattāvupāhartuṃ na dṛśyate \|*  
*tatprāgeva yathāyogaṃ saṅgṛhṇīyātprayatnataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dhānyānāṃ ghṛṣṭapiṣṭānāṃ kṣuṇṇopahatayorapi \|*  
*bhṛśaṃ śuṣkārdrasiddhānāṃ kṣayavṛddhī nirūpayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Besides the above, the stuff which cannot be procured rapidly after the start of a function, they should also be collected in advance. Thereafter, the extent to which the commodities or cereals, which are rubbed, powdered or cooked, unripe or totally dried up cereals which get increased or decreased during the storage, I am going to highlight the same.

## Chapter 12. Duties of the women

## \|\| 1.12.1 \|\|

*kārayedvastradhānyādi svāptavṛddhairadhiṣṭhitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — The wheat and inferior type of rice after pounding half of it remains the red and half of it is found as husk. One fifth of kangu and kroda is turned into varata.

## \|\| 1.12.2 \|\|

*pañcāśadbhāgikīṃ hāniṃ sūtre kurvīta lakṣaṇāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Similarly, a fifth part of paddy is also reduced. Priyangu type of rice is reduced by one fifth part of it, while a third of the high quality Sail rice gets reduced by a third or one eighth part of its weight. One third of the weight of the grams is reduced. This is what the people say.

## \|\| 1.12.3 \|\|

*pānīyayavagodhūmaṃ2 piṣṭadhānyacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*tulyamevāvagantavyaṃ mudgā māṣāstilā yavāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The thorny water fruit, millet, wheat and the grounded four types of cereals give equal types of results. The green grams, black grams and sesamum seeds, produce husks equal in weight.

## \|\| 1.12.4 \|\|

*pañcabhāgādikā ghṛṣṭā godhūmāḥ saktavastathā \|*  
*kulmāṣāḥ piṣṭamāṃsaṃ ca samyagardhādikaṃ bhavet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. When the wheat and barley are grinded, one fifth of them is reduced as the husk. In horse bean (Kulmasha), Pishtamamsa (a grain) after careful grinding, more then half of it is wasted.

## \|\| 1.12.5-6 \|\|

*siddhaṃ tadeva dviguṇaṃ punnāko yāvakastathā \|*  
*kaṅgukodravayorannaṃ caṇakodārakasya ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dviguṇaṃ 4 cīnakānāṃ ca vrīhīṇāṃ ca caturguṇam \|*  
*śāleḥ pañcaguṇaṃ vidyātpurāṇe tvatiricyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. But it multiplies to double of it when cooked. The same process is repeated in nutmeg and barely powder. When the cereal of kangu and kroda (both are different types of rice) when cooked with grams and udaraka type of cereals, it gets increased to double in weight. When the brihi rice is cooked it increases four times its weight, while that of shali rice expands to five times of its original weight.

## \|\| 1.12.7 \|\|

*kriyāpākaviśeṣāstu vṛddhirevopadiśyate \|*  
*nimittasya varānnasya tadvṛddhirdviguṇā bhavet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Those who are well-versed in cooking claim for the expansion of the said rice much more than the one already mentioned. Such people increase the weight of the pure and high quality cereals to double than its original weight.

## \|\| 1.12.8 \|\|

*tasmādbhūyo virūḍhasya caturbhāgo vivardhate \|*  
*lājā dhānāḥ kalāyāśca bhṛṣṭāddviguṇavṛddhayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Even more than that such cereals get increased which sprout and they get increased at one fourth of their actual weight. The parched rice, paddy and small pea, increase double their weight when fried.

## \|\| 1.12.9 \|\|

*bhraṣṭavyānāmato'nyeṣāṃ pañcabhāgo'dhiko mataḥ \|*  
*cāpakānāṃ ca piṣṭānāṃ pādahīnāḥ kalāyajāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Besides these, the types of cereals which could be fried, when actually fried increase their weight by one fifth of the actual weight. The cereals like peas and pulses, get reduced by one fourth of their original weight on grinding.

## \|\| 1.12.10 \|\|

*mudgamāṣamasūrāṇāmardhapādāvarobhavet \|*  
*klinnaśuṣkavarānnānāṃ hānirvṛddhirviśiṣyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. One eighth of the original weight of green gram, black gram, lentel pulse is reduced with this normal rule, the weight of wet, dry and excellent cereals gets increased or decreased.

## \|\| 1.12.11 \|\|

*tayārdhena tu śodhyānāmāḍhakyā mudgamāṣayoḥ \|*  
*masūrāṇāṃ ca jānīyātkṣayaṃ pañcamabhāgakam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Even otherwise, water parts in the green gram, black gram and lentel are left out or which cannot be taken out, one fifth of their weight gets reduced.

## \|\| 1.12.12 \|\|

*ṣaḍbhāgenātasītailaṃ siddhārthakakapitthayoḥ \|*  
*tathā nimbakadambādau 1 vidyātpañcamabhāgakam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. One sixth of the linseed is turned as the oil for the same, while the seeds of mustard or ripe seeds, wood apple, margos, and kadamba plant yield oil equivalent to one fifth of their weight

## \|\| 1.12.13 \|\|

*tileṅgudīmadhūkānāṃ 2 naktamālakusumbhayoḥ \|*  
*jānīyātpādakaṃ tailaṃ khalamanyatpracakṣate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The seeds of sesamum, wild staff tree, Madhuka (Bassia latifolia) and Karanja tree, (Geledupa Arborea) yield the oil equivalent to one fourth of oil. The position of the solid drags of oil seeds after the oil has been extracted from them, has been brought out elsewhere in this work.

## \|\| 1.12.14 \|\|

*kṣetrakālakriyādibhyaḥ kṣayādervyabhicārataḥ \|*  
*pratyakṣīkṛtya tānsamyaganumityāvadhārayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Some shortcomings could be found in relation to the fields, time, method of extracting the oil as has been mentioned above and there could be some derivations, which should be corrected with the inspection at the spot.

## \|\| 1.12.15 \|\|

*kṣīradoṣe gavāṃ 3 prasthaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ \|*  
*pādādhikamajāvīnāmutpādaṃ tadvido viduḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A sera of ghi can be extracted out of the cow’s milk. But depending on the quality of the milk, nothing definitely can be claimed in this respect. A little more ghi equivalent to a fourth of it can be extracted out of the milk of a buffalo, the sheep or a goat. This is what is claimed by the people, who are well-versed in the subject.

## \|\| 1.12.16 \|\|

*subhūmitṛṇakālebhyo vṛddhirvā kṣīrasarpiṣām \|*  
*atasteṣāṃ vidhātavyo hyarthādeva 4 viniścayaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When the animals graze over excellent type of grass in the good land, the quantity of ghi is increased in the milk. Therefore, the adequate quality and quantity of ghi that could be extracted from the milk should be decided taking all these factors into consideration.

## \|\| 1.12.17 \|\|

*pratyakṣīkṛtya yatnena pakṣamāsāntare tathā \|*  
*payorvṛttairgavādīnāṃ kuryātsambhavanirṇayam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. After well feeding the cows and buffalos etc. for a fortnight or a month, the quantity of milk and ghi could be decided.

## \|\| 1.12.18 \|\|

*kārpāsa kṛmikośaumaurṇaka kṣaumādikartanam \|*  
*kuṇipaṅgvandhayoṣābhirvidhavābhiśca kārayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The clothes of cotton, silk or jute and the collection of worms out of these clothes should be entrusted to the dumb, lame, deaf and widow women.

## \|\| 1.12.19 \|\|

*bālavṛddhāndhakārpaṇye yatkartavyamavaśyataḥ \|*  
*viniyogaṃ nayetsarvaṃ priyopagrahapūrvakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The appropriate work should be taken from boys, old people, blind, destitutes, giving them their desired things, besides food etc.

## \|\| 1.12.20 \|\|

*karmaṇāmantarāleṣu proṣite cāpi bhartari \|*  
*svayaṃ vai tadanuṣṭheyaṃ nityānāṃ cāvirodhataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In the absence of the husband’s going away on some business, or when he is taking rest, the wife should herself take up his work, without any obstruction or opposition.

## \|\| 1.12.21 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ sthūlasūkṣmatvaṃ bahutvaṃ ca vyayāvyayau \|*  
*matvā viśeṣaṃ kurvīta cetanapratipattiṣu \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The Shudra servants should be paid on the basis of their fatness of the body, thin physique and their number. One should achieve competency in the spending of money and the collection of money from their services.

## \|\| 1.12.22 \|\|

*śūdrāṇāṃ kṣayavṛddhyādi mantavyaṃ vetanāni ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The rules prescribed by the elders of the house, who are well-experienced for the distributing cereals and wages to the workers, should be followed. Similarly, one should gain experience for the increase and decrease of the laborers, besides the increase or otherwise of their wages through the well-experienced elderly people.

## \|\| 1.12.23 \|\|

*kṣaumakārpāsayorvidyātsūtraṃ pañcamabhāgakam \|*  
*deśakālādibhāgāttu pratyakṣādeva nirṇayaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In the cotton and linseed, the cotton is extracted equivalent to one fifth of their weight. But a decision in this rule should be taken on the basis of time and the place.

## \|\| 1.12.24 \|\|

*avaghātena tūlasya kṣayo viṃśatibhāgakaḥ \|*  
*channāṃ vyāptāṃ tu vātena tadvadūrṇāṃ pracakṣate \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. After the carding of the cotton, one twentieth of its quantity is lost. The good quality wool of the sheep when carded at a place which is safe from the wind, even then the reduction becomes the same.

## \|\| 1.12.25 \|\|

*vṛddhistu maṇḍasamparkāddaśakādaśikā bhavet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. While making the cloth, fiftieth part of the cotton is reduced. When the starch is added at the time of the weaving of the cloth, its tenth of eleventh part, stands increased.

## \|\| 1.12.26 \|\|

*ślakṣṇamadhyamasūtrāṇāmardhādhikasamaṃ bhavet \|*  
*sthūlānāṃ tu punarmūlyātpādonaṃ bālacetanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The extra fine and soft or the cotton of medium type, half or a little more of it gets reduced. In the coarse cotton, the reduction comes to one-fourth of it.

## \|\| 1.12.27 \|\|

*karmaṇo bhūribhedatvāddeśakālaprabhedataḥ \|*  
*tadvidbhya eva boddhavyo bālacetananiścayaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. But all these activities depend on the time, place besides the efficiency of the weavers. Because of the several parts of the job involved, and the time and the place, the expertise of the efficient or otherwise type of workers can be achieved from the experienced people who are experts in the respective fields.

## \|\| 1.12.28 \|\|

*sthūlaṃ dinatrayaṃ deyaṃ madhyamaṃ ca trirātrikam \|*  
*sūkṣmamāpakṣato mṛṣṭaṃ 4 māsāttatparikarmakam \|*  
*yadatra kṣatravṛddhyādi tadutsargātpradarśitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The cloth of coarse cotton should be given in three days, while that of medium type should be given in three nights. The highly fine cloth should be given in a fortnight. Whatever shortage or excess occurs in the same has already been described.

## \|\| 1.12.29-35 \|\|

*kālakartrādibhedena vyabhicāro'pi dṛśyate \|*  
*śayyāsanānyanekāni kambalāścaturāśrikāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kambukāścāvakoṣāśca madhyā raktāśca bhūriśaḥ \|*  
*gurubālādivṛddhānāmabhyāgatajanasya ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

*bhogāyānugato bharttā kuryādvividhamātrakam \|*  
*yadasya śvaśurādīnāṃ kalpitaṃ śayanādikam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*bhartuścaiva viśeṣaṇa tadanyena na kārayet \|*  
*vastraṃ mālyamalaṅkāraṃ vidhṛtaṃ devarādibhiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*na dhārayenna caiteṣāmākramecchayanāni vā \|*  
*piṇyākanakakuṭṭāśca 3 kālarūkṣāṇi yāni ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*heyaṃ paryuṣitādyannaṃ gobhaktenopayojayet \|*  
*kulānāṃ bahudhenūnāṃ godhyakṣavrajajīvinām \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kilāṭagavikādīnāṃ bhaktārthamupayojanam \|*  
*dadhnaḥ samāharetsarpirduhedvatsānna pīḍayet \|\| 35 \|\|*

29-35. Because of the difference in the time and the performer, there could be some exceptions as well in this rule. In other words, there could be deviation in the prescribed rules. The bed — sheet or the several types of mats, the blankets over which at least four people can be seated, are usually of medium type besides, usually being of red colour. A bride should perform all the aforesaid jobs with her husband, for the convenience of the preceptors, children, elderly people and guests. The beds which are earmarked for the elderly people, besides her own husband, should not be allowed to be made by the servants. The cloths used by the younger brother of the husband, the garland, the flowers and ornaments should not be used by a bride. Similarly, she should not put her feet over their beds. The pieces of solid drags of oil seeds, coarse meal, pieces of cereals, dry food or the base food should be given to the cows for eating. These could be used by the huge bulls, who move with the herd of cows. The butter milk should also be used by the cows. The ghi should be extracted from the curd. The cows should be timely milked, but the calves should not be tortured during the milking of the cows.

## \|\| 1.12.36 \|\|

*varṣāśaradvasanteṣu dvau kālāvanyadā sakṛt \|*  
*takraṃ vāpyupayuñjīta śvavarāhādipoṣaṇe \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The cows should be milked twice a day during the rainy, winter and the spring seasons. During the other seasons, the butter milk or the extracted milk could be used for dogs, pigs and other domestic animals.

## \|\| 1.12.37-38 \|\|

*piṇyākakledanārthaṃ vā vikreyaṃ vā tadarhayet \|*  
*vṛttiṃ dhānyahiraṇyena gopādīnāṃ prakalpayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*te hi kṣīravratā lobhādupahanyustadanvayān \|*  
*dohakālaṃ gavāṃ dogdhānītivarteta vai dvijāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Or otherwise it should be used for soaking the oil cakes or it could be sold out. The milkmen who sell milk, when not compensated well, torture the calves out of greed. Therefore, one should keep a strict watch over them. The cows should be milked at the appropriate time and there should be no delay in so doing.

## \|\| 1.12.39 \|\|

*prasarodakayorgopā manthakasya ca manthakāḥ \|*  
*māsamekaṃ yathā stanyaṃ māsamekaṃ stanadvayam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The cow protectors also indulge in adding water to the milk and then they chum the curd. When the cow delivers a calf, the calf should be allowed to drink milk from all the four nipples of the cow for a month.

## \|\| 1.12.40 \|\|

*satataṃ pāyayedūrdhvaṃ stanamekaṃ stanadvayam \|*  
*tilapiṣṭābhiḥ piṇḍābhistṛṇena lavaṇena ca \|*  
*vāriṇā ca yathākālaṃ puṣṇīyāditi vatsakān \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thereafter, it should be allowed to suck milk of one nipple at least. The balls of the powder of sesamum, the straw and water should be served to the calves.

## \|\| 1.12.41 \|\|

*jaradgurgarbhiṇī dhenurvatsā vatsatarī tathā \|*  
*pañcānāṃ samabhāgena ghāsaṃ yūthe prakalpayet \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. The old cow, the pregnant cow, the milking cow, the he and she calves besides the just born calves, should be given the grass of adequate quantity.

## \|\| 1.12.42 \|\|

*eko gopālakastasya trayāṇāmatha vā dvayam \|*  
*pañcānāṃ vatsakaścaikaḥ pravarāstu pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. One or two cowherds should be allowed to look after the cows, which may include five calves as well. The bigger of these should remain separate.

## \|\| 1.12.43 \|\|

*gocarasyānayanārthaṃ vyālānāṃ trāsanāya 1 ca \|*  
*ghaṇṭā karṇeṣu badhnīyuḥ śobhārakṣārthameva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. In order to scare the insects or reptiles from the path starting from the posture land to the house, besides the protection of the animals, a bell should be tied to their necks, which would also add to their beauty.

## \|\| 1.12.44 \|\|

*paśavye vyālanirmukte deśe bhūritṛṇodake \|*  
*abhūtaduṣṭe vāraṇye sadā kurvīta gokulam \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. A place which is free from the serpents and other wild creatures, rich in tender grass, free from thieves, should be selected for the grazing of the cows, which should be good for their sitting and grazing.

## \|\| 1.12.45 \|\|

*saguptamaṭavīvāsaṃ nityaṃ kuryādajāvikam \|*  
*ūrṇāṃ varṣe dvirādadyāccaitrāśvayujamāsayoḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. The pasture land for the sheep and goats should be fixed in a secure forest. The wool from the sheep should be extracted twice in a year during the months of Ashvina and Chaitra.

## \|\| 1.12.46 \|\|

*yūthe mṛṣā daśaitāsāṃ catvāraḥ pañca vā gavām \|*  
*aśvoṣṭramahiṣāṇāṃ ca yathā syuḥ sukhasevitāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. In the herd of goats, one he-goat should be provided after ten she-goats. Similarly, in the herd of cows, one bull should be there after four or five cows. In the herd of horses, camels and buffaloes, more number of males are considered to be quite comfortable. The bulls should also be well-fed.

## \|\| 1.12.47 \|\|

*vidyātkṛṣīvalādīnā yogaṃ kṛṣikakarmasu \|*  
*bhaktavetanalābhaṃ ca karmakālānurūpataḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. In the task of farming or irrigation, the work of the laborers should be well supervised. According to the task entrusted to each one of the labourer, they should be provided timely food and the wages should also be paid to them in due time.

## \|\| 1.12.48-49 \|\|

*kṣetrakedāravāṭeṣu bhṛtyānāṃ karma kurvatām \|*  
*khaleṣu ca vijānīyātkriyāyogaṃ pratikṣaṇam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*yogyatātiśayaṃ matvā karmayogeṣu kasyacit \|*  
*grāsācchadaśirobhyaṅgairviśeṣaṃ tasya kārayet \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. During the harvest season, tight vigil should be kept over the work force or the laborers, every moment. In case the laborers are expected to perform extra labour, then they should be provided more facilities for food and oil, costumes etc.

## \|\| 1.12.50 \|\|

*padmaśākādivāpānāṃ kandabījādijanmanām \|*  
*saṅgrahaḥ sarvabījānāṃ kāle vāpaḥ subhūmiṣu \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The seeds for lotus, vegetables, roots etc. besides other seeds required in the household should be timely collected and should be sown in the fertile fields at an appropriate time.

## \|\| 1.12.51 \|\|

*jātānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ samyagrakṣitānāṃ ca saṃgrahaḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ ca saṃgṛhītānāṃ yathāvannivapakriyā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. At the harvest season, the crop should be protected well and the yield of the crop should be collected and stored in a proper manner. The arrangements should also be made for the sowing of the collected seeds.

## \|\| 1.12.52 \|\|

*gṛhamūlaṃ striyaścaiva dhānyamūlo gṛhāśramaḥ \|*  
*tasmāddhānyeṣu bhakteṣu na kuryānmuktahastatām \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The women are said to be the root of the household, while the cereals are said to be the base of the household. Therefore, the food should not be freely given in charity.

## \|\| 1.12.53-54 \|\|

*dhānyaṃ tu sañcitaṃ nityaṃ mito bhaktaparivyayaḥ \|*  
*na cānte muktahastatvaṃ gṛhiṇīnāṃ praśasyate \|\| 53 \|\|*

*alpamityeva nāvajñāṃ caredanneṣu vai dvijāḥ \|*  
*madhuvalmīkayorvṛddhiṃ kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvāṃjanasya ca \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. O group of Brahmanas, even the smallest part of food should not be neglected. For the increase of the food articles, one should keep in mind the example of the bees or the ants which collect their food making all the efforts. For the shortage of food, the example of collyrium should be kept in view. This in other words mean that the bees collected huge quantity of honey starting from small quantity or the ants heap up the dust of earth by collecting it from beneath the earth, similarly a woman also can heap up food or riches by collecting them in small quantities. On the other hand, when the collyrium is applied in small quantity in the eye it gets vanished after some time, similarly even the small quantity of food when given to undesirable person, gets vanished.

## \|\| 1.12.55 \|\|

*ye kecidiha nirdiṣṭā vyāpārāḥ puruṣocitāḥ \|*  
*dāmpatyoraikyamāsthāya taddhidānaprasaṅgataḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. In this context, there are certain jobs, which are suited for the men, and their directions have been made taking into account the inseparable nature of the household. I have mentioned about the charity by women.

## \|\| 1.12.56 \|\|

*santyeva puruṣā loke strīpradhānāḥ sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*teṣu tāsāṃ prayoktṛtvādadoṣa iti gṛhyatām \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. One comes across many people in the world in which the women enjoy more importance. Actually, it is a woman who inspires a man. Therefore, there is no blemish in her conduct. This should be kept in mind.

## \|\| 1.12.57 \|\|

*evaṃ yogyatayā yuktā saubhāgyenodyamena ca \|*  
*samyagārādhya bhartāraṃ tatrainaṃ vaśamānayet \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thus the women should enchant their men making use of their fortunes, efforts and adoring their husbands.

## Chapter 13. Duties of the women

## \|\| 1.13.1 \|\|

*durbhagāmanapatyāṃ vā bhartrā cātitiraskṛtām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — The women should rise up earlier than the men and should engage themselves in their activities. They should take their food and go to bed after the servants have done so.

## \|\| 1.13.2 \|\|

*bhartrā virahitā strī ca śvaśurābhyāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*dehalīṃ nātivarteta pratīkāre 1 mahatyapi \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Even after the arising of some very serious problem, a woman should not cross her doorsill in the absence of her parents-in-law and the husband.

## \|\| 1.13.3 \|\|

*bhartṛcittānukūlatvaṃ yāsāṃ śīlamavicyutam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. She should get up from the bed earlier than her husband, but should not go out without his knowledge.

## \|\| 1.13.4 \|\|

*tadvāsabhavanasyaiva śanairāhūya kārmikān \|*  
*svavyāpāreṣu tānsarvāṃstatratatra niyojayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Inspite of there being the early or the late hour of the night or whether it is dread of night or the day time, she should call for the workers in her own room, she should put them over their respective duties.

## \|\| 1.13.5 \|\|

*vibuddhasya tato bharturnirvartyāvaśyakaṃ vidhim \|*  
*gṛhakāryāṇi sarvāṇi vidadhītāpramādataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After the waking up of her husband, freeing herself from the daily routine, she should carefully attend to all other household jobs.

## \|\| 1.13.6 \|\|

*muktvāvāsakanepathyaṃ karmayogyaṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*tatkālocitakartavyamanutiṣṭhedyathākramam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. While attending to the household duties, a woman should remove the clothes and ornaments worn by her during the night. Then clad in appropriate clothes, she should complete all the household jobs. The kitchen should be properly smeared.

## \|\| 1.13.7 \|\|

*mahānasaṃ susammṛṣṭaṃ cullyādivihitārcanam \|*  
*sarvopakaraṇopetamasambādhamanāvilam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The earth should be properly adored and all the necessary requirements should be placed in the kitchen, well arranged. It should always be kept neat and clean.

## \|\| 1.13.8 \|\|

*na cātiguhyaṃ prakaṭaṃ pravibhaktakriyāśrayam \|*  
*bharturāptajanākīrṇaṃ gūḍhaṃ kakṣādivarjitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The kitchen should neither be in a secluded place nor in a crowded place. There should be separate arrangement for the preparation of the several types of food. The kitchen should be located at a place which is free from cabins, away from the dwelling places of the friends of the husband.

## \|\| 1.13.9-10 \|\|

*tatra pākādibhāṇḍāni bahirantaśca kārayet \|*  
*niṇiktamalapaṅkāni śuktivalkādicūrṇakaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*niśi kurvīta dhūmārciḥ śodhitāni divātapaḥ \|*  
*dadhipātrāṇi kurvīta sadaivāntaritāni ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The vases of the kitchen should be kept neat and clean from inside as well as outside. They should be free from mud and stale food. The vase of the earth should be dried in the sun during the day and with smoke during the night. They should be kept away from the other utensils.

## \|\| 1.13.11 \|\|

*sādhukāritadugdheṣu śodhiteṣu divātape \|*  
*īṣadgṛhyoktapātreṣu svacchaṃ yena bhaveddadhi \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The vases which are dried up from the day’s sunshine, in them the milk should be kept carefully. A little quantity of curd should be placed in the vase of milk to make the curd, so as to keep it clean.

## \|\| 1.13.12 \|\|

*snehagorasapākādi kṛtvā supratyayekṣitam \|*  
*kuryātsvayamadhiṣṭhāya bhartuḥ pākavidhikriyām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Taking good care of the oil and after boiling the milk, the lady should prepare the food for her husband and herself.

## \|\| 1.13.13 \|\|

*kiṃ priyaṃ ca kimāgneyaṃ ṣaḍrasābhyantareṣu ca \|*  
*kiṃ pathyaṃ kimapathyaṃ ca svāsthyaṃ2 vāsya kathaṃ bhavet \|*  
*iti yatnādvijānīyādanuṣṭheyaṃ ca tattathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. At that point of time, it should be kept in mind as to which one of the juice would help the husband in digesting the food or the stuff which is liked by him. What should be eaten by him and what not (from the health point of view). Such things should be well taken care of and one should act accordingly.

## \|\| 1.13.14 \|\|

*nityānurāgaṃ satkāramāhāraṃ suparīkṣitam \|*  
*mahānasādau kurvīta janamāptaṃ kramāgatam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The food in the kitchen should be served with humility and should be served to the guests with respect.

## \|\| 1.13.15 \|\|

*śatru dāyādasambandhaṃ kruddhabhītāvamānitam \|*  
*avācyopagṛhītaṃ vā naivamādīni yojayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The enemy partners who are angry or fearful, who had been insulted or abused earlier, such people should not be put on duty in the kitchen.

## \|\| 1.13.16 \|\|

*punaḥ punaḥ pratiṣṭhāpya guptaṃ svayamadhiṣṭhitam \|*  
*bharturāhārapānādi vidadhyādapramādataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A woman should serve the tasteful food prepared by her with her own hands in a proper manner.

## \|\| 1.13.17-18 \|\|

*pākaṃ nirvartya mātrāṇāṃ kṛtvā svedapramārjanam \|*  
*gandhatāmbūlamālyādi kiñcidādāya mātrayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yathaucityāditatkāle bharturvinayasambhramaiḥ \|*  
*tatkālānugatātyarthamāhāramupapādayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. After getting free from food, she should wipe out sweating from her body. Then should bring the fragrant betel with tobacco of little quantity and then place it over the hand of the husband and guests carefully. The food should be arranged according to the season.

## \|\| 1.13.19 \|\|

*svabhāvāmayakālānāṃ vaiparītyena sarvadā \|*  
*sarvamāhārapānādi prayojyaṃ tadvido jaguḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Observing the adversity of the nature, time and liking (of the concerned person), the arrangement for betel and food should be made. This is what has been stated by the knowledgeable people.

## \|\| 1.13.20 \|\|

*hīnatulyādhikatvena bhartā paśyati yaṃ yathā \|*  
*taṃ tathaivādhikaṃ paśyennyāyataḥ pratipattiṣu \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Whatever is liked or disliked by the husband in the household, the wife should behave with such people accordingly.

## \|\| 1.13.21 \|\|

*sāpatnakānyapatyāni paśyetsvebhyo viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*bhaginīvatsapatnīśca tadvadhūnnijabandhuvat \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The children of the co-wives should be treated more lovingly. The other co-wives should be treated like one’s real sister. Their brother should be treated like one’s own brother.

## \|\| 1.13.22 \|\|

*grāsācchādaśirobhyaṅgasnānamaṇḍanakādikam \|*  
*sapatnīnāmakṛtvā tu ātmano'pi na kārayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. In case the food, costumes, applying of oil over the head or decoration of the body after taking the bath are not done for the co-wife, she should also not perform similarly for herself.

## \|\| 1.13.23 \|\|

*vyādhitānāṃ cikitsārthamauṣadhādikamādarāt \|*  
*vidadhyādātmanastāsāṃ sarvāśritajanasya ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. When the people dependent on her as well those related to her fall ill, she should arrange for the medicines for all of them with respect.

## \|\| 1.13.24 \|\|

*tacchoke śucamādadyāttattuṣṭau mudamāvahet \|*  
*bhṛtyabandhusapatnīnāṃ tulyaduḥkhasukhā bhavet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. When they are in grief, she should express her own grief for them. When they feel satisfied, she herself should also feel satisfied. The pleasure or pain of the kins and servants or co-wives should be taken as if one’s own.

## \|\| 1.13.25 \|\|

*lagdhāvakāśā svapyācya niśi suptotthitā kramāt \|*  
*anyatra vyayakartāraṃ patiṃ rahasi bodhayet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus getting free from the daily activities, a house wife should sleep at night and get up early in the morning. A tactful wife should advice the husband carefully in reclusion, who wastes riches in useless ways.

## \|\| 1.13.26 \|\|

*yadavadyaṃ sapatnīnāṃ svayamasmai na tadvadet \|*  
*dauḥśīlyādi tu sāpāyaṃ gūḍhamasmai nivedayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The discussion about the misconduct of the co-wives which would not be proper to be discussed in the open, should not be mentioned by her in person. In case their misconduct had reached the extreme heights, she should speak about them to her husband with the methods to get them removed.

## \|\| 1.13.27 \|\|

*aduṣṭāṃ samyamāśvāsya tenaitāmanukūlayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The co-wife who is unfortunate, barren and discarded by the husband, but is quite innocent, should be reassured well. She should move in such a way that she gains favour of her husband.

## \|\| 1.13.28 \|\|

*tathā vāgdaṇḍapāruṣyairjanaṃ bhartrā vipīḍitam \|*  
*kuryādvidheyamāśvāsya na ceddoṣāya tadbhavet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Similarly, the servants against whom harsh words have been used by the husband, or those who had been punished, should also be comforted appropriately quite often, but it should be kept in mind that by so doing, the mind of the husband does not get antagonized, otherwise there is a possibility of facing a grave misfortune, by such an action.

## \|\| 1.13.29 \|\|

*matvātmanonapatyatvaṃ kālaṃ cāpi gataṃ bahum \|*  
*santānādikamuddiśya kāryamātmanivedanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In case a woman is unable to produce a child after long time of the married life, then she should herself talk to the husband about the production of children.

## \|\| 1.13.30 \|\|

*yaccānyadapi jānīyātkiñcidasya cikīrṣitam \|*  
*tatkilājānatīvāsya siddhameva pradarśayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. In case the wife is aware of the secret mental ailment of her husband, then she should remove it in such a way that the husband is unable to even realise that she had contributed to the removal of her secret ailment.

## \|\| 1.13.31 \|\|

*vaivāhikaṃ vidhiṃ bhartuḥ sarvaṃ kṛtvā sasambhramam \|*  
*pariṇītā ca tāṃ paśyennityaṃ bhaginikāmiva \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A woman should expeditiously complete the arrangement for the marriage of her husband and then treat his second wedded wife as her real sister.

## \|\| 1.13.32 \|\|

*pūjāṃ sambandhivargasya maṅgalaṃ maṅgalāni ca \|*  
*kuryādabhinavoḍhāyāḥ suprahaṣṭena cetasā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. She should complete all the marriage ceremony of the bride herself, performing all the welfare ceremonies including the preparation of the mandapa.

## \|\| 1.13.33 \|\|

*mātṛvacchikṣayedenāṃ gṛhakṛtyeṣvamatsarā \|*  
*pradeśikavidhiṃ vāsyā vidadhyādyatnataḥ svayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. She should set like the mother for his cowife, in the performance of the domestic works, shedding away the jealousy. She should accordingly render the good advice. She should also perform the task of the first meeting of the co-wife with her husband.

## \|\| 1.13.34 \|\|

*evaṃ bharturabhiprāya sarvamityādikārayet \|*  
*sukhārthaṃ vāpi santyajya strīṇāṃ bhartādhidevatā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Thus realising fully well the intentions of the husband, she should act accordingly. A wife should always make all the efforts to build the life of the husband comfortable, because for the wives, the husband is adorable like the god.

## \|\| 1.13.35 \|\|

*bhartādhidevatā nāryā varṇā brāhmadevatāḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇā hyagnidevāstu prajā rājanyadevatāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. It is said that for the women, their husbands are the gods for them, while fire is the god for the Brahmanas and the king is the god for the people or the subjects.

## \|\| 1.13.36 \|\|

*tāsāṃ trivargasaṃsiddhau pradiṣṭaṃ kāraṇadvayam \|*  
*bharturyadanukūlatvaṃ yacca śīlamaviplutam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. There are two ways for the achieving of the trivarga for the women. The first one is their docile behaviour towards their husbands, and the second is their chaste conduct.

## \|\| 1.13.37 \|\|

*na tathā yauvanaṃ loke nāpi rūpaṃ na bhūṣaṇam \|*  
*yathā priyānukūlatvaṃ siddhaṃ śaśvadanauṣadham \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. For the women, neither their beauty nor their youthfulness or ornaments bestow comfort on them, as compared to their achieving favour of their husband. The favourable relations with her husband are the only cause or medicine for her eternal welfare.

## \|\| 1.13.38 \|\|

*vayorūpādihāriṇyo dṛśyante durbhagāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*vallabhā mandarūpāśca bahvyo galitayauvanāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The beauty, the youthfulness and the excellent charm possessed by the women, face misfortunes. To the contrary, the women possessing lesser beauty still get extreme favour of their husbands and enjoy all the comforts.

## \|\| 1.13.39 \|\|

*tasmātpriyatvaṃ lokānāṃ nidānaṃ 1 yogyatāparam \|*  
*tāṃ vinānye guṇā vandhyāḥ sarve'narthakṛto'pi vā \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Therefore, it is competence of a woman in the world to gain favour of the husband. In other words, in case a woman has no competence to win the favour of her husband, all her other good qualities are of no use. Her all other virtues become misfortunes.

## \|\| 1.13.40 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena vidadhyādātmayogyatām \|*  
*paracittajñatā cāsyā mūlaṃ sarvakriyāsviha \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Therefore, making all the efforts, the women should develop competence in them. They should also develop an instinct to know the minds of others. This is the basis for one’s gaining success over others.

## \|\| 1.13.41 \|\|

*bahirāgacchato jñātvā kālaṃ saṃmṛjya bhūmikām \|*  
*sajjīkṛtāsanā tiṣṭhettasyājñāṃ pratitatparā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Finding the arrival of her husband from outside, she should clean the ground, and make the bed beautiful and then wait for the husband. On his arrival, his command should be obeyed at once.

## \|\| 1.13.42 \|\|

*svayaṃ prakṣālayetpādāvutthāpya paricārikām \|*  
*tālavṛntādikaiḥ kuryācchamasvedāpanodanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Removing the slave girl, the wife should herself wash the feet of the husband. Thereafter, his fatigue and sweating should be removed with the moving of the fan of a palm tree.

## \|\| 1.13.43 \|\|

*āhārasnānapānādau saspṛhaṃ yatra lakṣayet \|*  
*tadiṃgitajñā tattvena siddhamasmai nivedayet \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Whatever things are especially required by the husband in taking his bath or food, should be produced by the wife. Reading the mind of her husband, she should indicate everything by indications.

## \|\| 1.13.44 \|\|

*sapantīpatibandhūnāṃ bhartṛcittānukūlyataḥ \|*  
*pratipattiṃ prayuñjīta svabandhūnāṃ na vai tathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. According to the liking of the husband, a wife should extend quite a cordial treatment to the co-wife and her relatives, better than her own relatives.

## \|\| 1.13.45 \|\|

*teṣu cātmani ca jñātvā bhartṛcittaṃ prasādayet \|*  
*pratipattiṃ tathāpyeṣāṃ nādriyeta svabandhuṣu \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Whomsoever is more liked or loved by the husband, she should also like the same person. But before thus conducting herself, a wife should make sure of her husband’s liking for her. The kins of the co-wife and the husband, should not speak about the pleasant treatment extended to them by their own kiths and kins to others.

## \|\| 1.13.46 \|\|

*api bharturabhipretaṃ nārī tatkulavāsinī \|*  
*satkārairnijabandhūnāṃ tena nopaiti vācyatām \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The wife living in the family of her husband, well understand the intentions of the husband, and when welcomes the relatives appropriately, she does not earn any blemish or denouncement.

## \|\| 1.13.47 \|\|

*pūjya eva hi sambandhaḥ sarvāvasthāsu yoṣitām \|*  
*kastato'pyupakārāṃśaṃ lipseta kulajaḥ pumān \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The relationship of a woman has been considered to be adorable in all the situations. Who would be the person in her parental home, who would expect favours from her?

## \|\| 1.13.48 \|\|

*sampūjya svasutāṃ tasmai vidhivatpratipādyate \|*  
*tato'syā lipsate nāma kimakāryamataḥ param \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The people give away their daughter appropriately to the son-in-law and in case they expect some benefit from the same girl, what would be more deplorable action than that?

## \|\| 1.13.49 \|\|

*kanyāṃ pradāya yairvṛttirātmanaḥ parikalpyate \|*  
*dāsabhaṇḍanaṭādīnāṃ mārgo'yaṃ na mahātmanām \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. To whom one gives away a daughter in marriage and expect one’s own livelihood from the same source, would amount to the performance of a slave, acrobats or other degraded people and not of the people with high ideals.

## \|\| 1.13.50 \|\|

*tasmātstrībāṃdhavā nityaṃ prītimātraikasādhinīm \|*  
*pratipattiṃ samādadyuḥ sambandhibhyaḥ prasaṃginīm \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Therefore, the relatives of the bride should increase love and affection towards their son — in-law and should ensure about the gradual increase of the same.

## \|\| 1.13.51 \|\|

*tasyā bhartari rakṣeta prītiṃ loke ca vācyatām \|*  
*ātmano'satpravādaṃ ca ceṣṭeransādhuvṛttayaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The relatives of such good natured woman, by their noble conduct and for the protection of the bride, will also save the bride from the denouncement and the blemishes that could be earned by them.

## \|\| 1.13.52 \|\|

*evaṃ vijñāya sadvṛttaṃ strī varteta tathā sadā \|*  
*yena tatparivargasya bhavedbhartuśca sammatā \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Therefore, the bride should know all about the noble deeds to be performed by her, which should be practiced by her and by so doing, she would earn the honour and prestige from her relatives, besides the husband and other relatives.

## \|\| 1.13.53 \|\|

*priyāpi sādhuvṛttāpi vikhyātābhijanāpi ca \|*  
*janāpavādātsamprāpa sītānarthaṃ sudāruṇam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Because even Sita, who was born in high race and was the most beloved of her husband, who always engaged herself in noble deeds, had to face the denouncement from the people (for absolutely no fault on her part).

## \|\| 1.13.54 \|\|

*sarvasyāmiṣabhūtatvādguṇadoṣānabhijñataḥ \|*  
*prāyeṇāvinayaucityātstrīṇāṃ vṛttaṃ hi duṣkaram \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The duties of the women are quite hard because of their being extra beautiful and attractive being unaware of the virtues and vices, lack of benevolence and humility and become difficult to be performed.

## \|\| 1.13.55 \|\|

*agṛhyatvānmanovṛtteḥ prāyaḥ kapaṭadarśanāt \|*  
*niraṅkuśatvāllokasya nirvācyā viralāḥ striyaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*
