55\. In the absence of well understanding the mental feelings of others and deceitful behaviour in all the activities, because of being carefree of the people, one can find only a few women who could escape blemishes.

## \|\| 1.13.56 \|\|

*daivayogādayogatvādvyavahārānabhijñataḥ \|*  
*vācyatāpattayo dṛṣṭāḥ strīṇāṃ śuddhe'pi cetasi \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Because of the move of destiny, or due to the absence of their own competence and good performance, there would be small number of women who could escape themselves from denouncement or blemish inspite of them being of auspicious conduct.

## \|\| 1.13.57 \|\|

*tāsāṃ daivapratīkāro nopabhogādṛte bhavet \|*  
*cāritraṃ lokavṛttaṃ ca etayorvidurauṣadham \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Their misfortune cannot be countered without enjoyment. The good conduct and outward performance with people are the two means, which could be termed as the medicine to get the blemish removed.

## \|\| 1.13.58-59 \|\|

*hiṃdolakādikrīḍāyāṃ prasaktāṃ taruṇīṃ niśi \|*  
*ramamāṇāṃ viṭaiḥ sārdhaṃ vidhavāṃ svairacāriṇīm \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vṛddhādibhāryāṃ 1 sajjāyāṃ yānageyādisaṃginīm \|*  
*kaḥ śraddadhyātsatītyevaṃ sādhvīmapi hi yoṣitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. While enjoying a-swing and sports during the night, a woman displays more attractiveness or she enjoys company of the jesters. Otherwise when a young lady is the wife of an old man, or otherwise a good natured woman takes more interest in music or vehicles, then who would be a person to think such a woman with reverence inspite of her being of noble character?

## \|\| 1.13.60 \|\|

*yau cāsāmiṅgitākārau sandigdhārthaprasādhakau \|*  
*tayostattvaparijñānaṃ viṣayo yogināṃ2 yadi \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The behaviour of such woman points to the doubtful character. Their true behaviour could be judged by the yogis who are well — versed in the tattvas, in case such yogis became inclined to know about them.

## \|\| 1.13.61 \|\|

*tasmādyathoktamācāramanutiṣṭhetsusaṃyatā \|*  
*mithyālagnopyasadvādaḥ kampayatyeva tatkulam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Therefore, as has been stated above, a noble bride of high family should peacefully observe the good conduct. The false blemish earned by the chaste woman totally shakes the entire family.

## \|\| 1.13.62 \|\|

*trikulyā vācyatā rakṣyā pratiṣṭhāpyatha santatiḥ \|*  
*bhartustrivargasiddhiśca sādhyaṃ tatkulayoṣitām \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. A chaste wife has to protect the honour of the three families. She has to protect her own honour, besides that of her children. Not only that, she should participate in achieving of trivarga for her husband as well. This should be the main object of her life.

## \|\| 1.13.63 \|\|

*pātayantyeva dauḥśīlyādātmānaṃ sakulatrayam \|*  
*uddharanti tadaivaitāḥ striyaścāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Because of her noble conduct, she can redeem the three races out of the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.13.64 \|\|

*tāsāṃ ratnasuvarṇādi bhāra eva na maṇḍanam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The ladies who move according to the mental approach of their husbands, and who do not fall from chastity, for them the ornaments of gold and gems are mere burden, because they remain decorated with the noble virtues.

## \|\| 1.13.65 \|\|

*lokajñāne parā koṭiḥ patyau bhaktiśca śāśvatī \|*  
*śuddhānvayānāṃ nārīṇāṃ vidyādetatkulavratam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The women of high and auspicious families have a great quality that they are quite efficient in dealing with others and are fully devoted to their husbands.

## \|\| 1.13.66 \|\|

*tasmāllokaśca bhartā ca samyagārādhito yayā \|*  
*dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca saivāpnoti niratyayā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Taking all these facts into consideration, one arrives at a conclusion that the noble bride who sufficiently adores her husband, she cannot face any misfortune in her life. She also earns dharma, artha and kama in the world.

## Chapter 14. Prohibition of self-decoration in the absence of the husband

## \|\| 1.14.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*preṣite maṇḍanaṃ strīṇāṃ patyau maṅgalamātrakam \|*  
*niṣpādanaṃ ca yatnena tadārabdhasya karmaṇaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O group of Rishis, when the husband is abroad, the chaste house wife should only wear the symbols which are indicative of her being married and should continue to perform the activities which were started earlier.

## \|\| 1.14.2 \|\|

*śayyāmupārjanamarthānāṃ vyayānāṃ parihāpaṇam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. During that period, she should place her bed close to those of the elders of the house. She should make all the efforts to earn wealth from all the possible sources, reducing the spending at the same time.

## \|\| 1.14.3 \|\|

*vratopavāsatātparyaṃ tadvārtāparimārgaṇam \|*  
*daivajñekṣaṇikapraśno devānāmupayācanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. She should be particularly interested in fasting and the performing of the vratas. She should try to have news about the welfare of her husband. She should pray to the gods consulting the religious people.

## \|\| 1.14.4 \|\|

*nityaṃ tasyāgamāśaṃsā kṣemārthaṃ devapūjanam \|*  
*na cātyujjvalaveṣatvaṃ na sadā tailadhāraṇam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. She should expect the return of her husband continuously and should move all the sources to know about his welfare. She should consult the astrologers and the priests about his welfare. A woman whose husband has gone abroad should not wear quite attractive dresses, nor should she apply oil on her body always.

## \|\| 1.14.5 \|\|

*jñātiveśma na gantavyaṃ sakāmagamanena 1 ca \|*  
*gurūṇāmājñayā yāvadbharturāptajanaiḥ saha \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The period during which her husband remains abroad and does not return from there, she should not visit the houses of her neighbors or other relatives. For some urgent work, she should do so with the seniors or elders of her husband.

## \|\| 1.14.6 \|\|

*tatrāpi na ciraṃ tiṣṭhetsnānādīnvāpi nācaret \|*  
*yāvadarthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tataḥ śīghraṃ samācaret \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. After going there, she should not remain there till late hours, she should not take bath or food there. She should return to her abode expeditiously.

## \|\| 1.14.7-8 \|\|

*āgate prakṛtisthaiva kṛtvā tātkālikaṃ vidhim \|*  
*muktapravāsane pathye snāte bhuktavati priye \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ samalaṅkṛtya saviśeṣaṃ mudānvitā \|*  
*devapūjopahārādīndadyātprāgupapāditān \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. After the returning of the husband from abroad, she should welcome him with great reverence, quite lovingly. She should help her husband to change the dress. After the husband properly takes his bath and finishes his food, she should delightfully decorate her husband beautifully with ornaments. Thereafter, she should offer presents to the family deities.

## \|\| 1.14.9 \|\|

*kaniṣṭhāmātṛvajjyeṣṭhāṃ tadapatyāni cātmavat \|*  
*paśyettatparivargaṃ tu nityaṃ svaparivargavat \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The junior house-wife should respect the senior house-wife (or co-wife) like the mother and her children should be treated like her own. Her family members besides the servants and those of her own should be treated alike.

## \|\| 1.14.10 \|\|

*tatpuronāsane tiṣṭhetpatiṃ nāmaṃtrayeta ca \|*  
*tadabhiprāyataḥ kuryātpravṛttiṃ sarvakarmasu \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. She should not be seated in her presence over a seat nor should she call for her husband. To the contrary, she should engage herself in all activities, well understanding her mind. She should conduct herself quite thoughtfully.

## \|\| 1.14.11 \|\|

*na saṃsṛjeta taddviṣṭaiḥ sakhyaṃ kurvīta tatpriyaiḥ \|*  
*janamāptatamaṃ tasya sadābhartuśca mānayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The people with whom she might be annoyed, she should have no contact with them. She should be friendly with her near and dear ones.

## \|\| 1.14.12 \|\|

*paitṛkātsamupānītaṃ vasusaugaṃdhikādikam \|*  
*tasmai nivedyātmatayā tadā tadupayojayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. She should always respect the elders of her husband. Whatever eatables or the things of make-up are received from her parents house, she should present the same first of all with the sense of intimacy to her and should make use of them subsequently.

## \|\| 1.14.13 \|\|

*sopi tatprītaye kiṃcidādadyādalpamūlyakam \|*  
*saṃgopya mātṛvatstheyaṃ tattathaivopayojayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The elder co-wife also must ensure too well present the love of her younger co-wife and she accepting a little part of what is presented to her, return the rest to her younger co-wife. She should present the articles so presented to her carefully and should use of them appropriately.

## \|\| 1.14.14 \|\|

*tatprītyarthaṃ gṛhītaṃ yadvailakṣyādinivṛttaye \|*  
*saviśeṣaṃ prasaṃgena tasyaitatpratipādayet 1 \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. In order to remove the discomfiture of the younger co-wife, the elder one, at some suitable occasion, should return the articles presented to her by the younger one adding something more to them.

## \|\| 1.14.15 \|\|

*strīṇāṃ yadetatsāpatnyaṃ paraṃ mātsaryakāraṇam \|*  
*tasmāttatparihartavyaṃ paramodāracaryayā2 \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The mutual conduct among the co-wives gets sour because jealousy etc., could be softened or eased with such types of generous behaviour.

## \|\| 1.14.16 \|\|

*tathā kalpitanepathyā bhartuḥ paryāyavāsare \|*  
*hriyamādayamāneva3 patiṃ gacchedvisarjitā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When her turn arrives, the younger cowife, decorating herself with different types of make-ups, taking leave of the elder co-wife, should bashfully approach the husband.

## \|\| 1.14.17 \|\|

*gatvā rahasi bhartāraṃ tatkālocitasaṃbhramaiḥ \|*  
*tadbhāvānugataistaistaiḥ saviśeṣamupācaret \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thus reaching with the husband at a solitary’ place and pleasing her husband with merriment, she should please her husband fully.

## \|\| 1.14.18 \|\|

*pratibudhya tataḥ kāle saviśeṣaṃ trapānvitā \|*  
*jyeṣṭhāya vasatiṃ gacchedviśeṣeṇa tathā punaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Then getting up from the bed in the early morning, she should go to the senior co-wife bashfully and then return to her abode from there itself.

## \|\| 1.14.19 \|\|

*aprātikūlyaṃ jyeṣṭhāyā hitamanyatra yoṣitaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śanaistvavacchidya patiṃ svavaśamānayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus when no opposition is caused to the senior co-wife in the outward activities, the junior one is always benefitted, otherwise in seclusion she should slowly conduct herself according to the desire of her husband and win over his heart.

## \|\| 1.14.20 \|\|

*bahiṣpākādiyogena catuḥṣaṣṭyā rahogatam \|*  
*jyeṣṭhāmatiśayāneva bhartāramuparañjayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. By arranging the best of food outside while in the harem displaying all the sixty four arts, the junior bride transgressing the elder co-wife, should please her husband and gain his favour.

## \|\| 1.14.21 \|\|

*prāgalbhyaṃ rahasi strīṇāṃ lajjādhikyaṃ tato'nyadā \|*  
*cittajñānānuvṛttiśca patyau saṃsevanaṃ param \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In seclusion, one should behave with the husband quite stubbornly. At other places, the modesty displayed in excess, happens to be her only ornament. According to the temperament of the husband, the wife should always get devoted. This is the only dharma of the house wife.

## \|\| 1.14.22 \|\|

*evamārādhya bhartāraṃ gṛhamākramya ca kramāt \|*  
*gauravaṃ pratipattiṃ vā jyeṣṭhādiṣu na hāpayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thus getting devoted to the husband and achieving success in the same, the house wife should not behave in a manner, by which the elders and superiors do not lose this grace in anyway.

## \|\| 1.14.23 \|\|

*gṛhavyāpāradāneṣu patiṃ guḍhaṃ tadhā vadet \|*  
*adhikuryādanicchantī jyeṣṭhaivenāṃ yathā balāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In the domestic activities, or in the giving away of the charioteers, a wife should secretly talk to the husband. Thus without expressing the outward desire, one should make the husband favourable towards herself as had been done by the elder co-wife.

## \|\| 1.14.24 \|\|

*sāpi vijñāya bhartāraṃ kaniṣṭhākṛṣṭamānasam \|*  
*viśrāmaṃ prārthayedenāmadhikuryātsutāmiva \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The senior house wife when detects that the husband is more inclined towards the junior co-wife, then she should behave with her junior co-wife like her own daughter and should regularly request her to take rest.

## \|\| 1.14.25 \|\|

*matvā bharturabhipretaṃ rakṣantī nijagauravam \|*  
*kṛtaṃ bhartranukūlaṃ syāttadiṣṭāyānumodayet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Well realising the mental feelings of the husband and for the protection of one’s glory and traditions, all the tasks should be accomplished. All the tasks should be carried out as per the desire of the husband, besides supporting his wishes.

## \|\| 1.14.26 \|\|

*sthānino yadabhipretaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ kiṃ kriyate'nyathā \|*  
*kliśyate tatra mūḍhātmā paratantro vṛthā janaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Therefore, in all the situations, whatever is desired by the husband, she should perform the tasks with her own hands, because the servants cannot do so as per the full satisfaction of the master. The people who do not act accordingly, such fools remaining slaves of others, suffer pain unnecessarily.

## \|\| 1.14.27 \|\|

*tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ \|*  
*hitaṃ svāmyanukūlatvaṃ nārīṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Therefore, in all the situations, a house wife should engage herself in the tasks which are beneficial and useful for her husband. The ladies should particularly emphasize on these things.

## \|\| 1.14.28 \|\|

*sāpi jyeṣṭhāpatiṃ caiva gṛhatantraṃ ca sarvadā \|*  
*samāvarjya 1 guṇairdhīrā prāgavasthāṃ na vismaret \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the special situation when the husband is entangled in the love of the junior co-wife, then the senior bride, with the use of her excellent virtues, well understanding the mind and the inclinations of her husband, should do her best to attract her husband’s mind, without forgetting the earlier (favourable) conditions.

## \|\| 1.14.29 \|\|

*na saubhāgyamadaṃ kuryānna cauddhatyādivikriyām \|*  
*nitarāmānatiṃ gacchetsadānāryabhayādiva \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. At that point of time, forgetting the pride of her fortune, she should not display any anxiety or unstability. She should behave as if she is tired of the workload and live with peace displaying humility.

## \|\| 1.14.30 \|\|

*yathā yogyatayā patyau saubhāgyamabhivardhate \|*  
*spardhayecya kulastrīṇāṃ praśrayopādhikaṃ tathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The brides should enter into competition to gain favour of the husband and enhance their respective fortunes. They should make use of such virtues.

## \|\| 1.14.31-32 \|\|

*evamārādhya bhartāraṃ tatkāryeṣvapramādinī \|*  
*pūjyānāṃ pūjane nityaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇeṣu ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*guṇānāmarjane nityaṃ śīlavatparirakṣaṇe \|*  
*pretya ceha ca nirdvandvaṃ sukhamāpnotyanuttamam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Thus becoming alert by the service rendered to the husband, one should adore and serve the elders, take care of the servants and gain merits. Such house wives always feel comfortable in the present as well as the future worlds.

## Chapter 15. Duties of the women

## \|\| 1.15.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*durbhagā ca punarnityamupavāsāditatparā \|*  
*bāhyeṣu patikṛtyeṣu syādviśeṣābhiyoginī \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — The women who are not loved by their husbands, should always resort to fasting and should co-operate in the outside activities of their husbands.

## \|\| 1.15.2 \|\|

*na praśaṃsāṃ sapatnīṣu niṃdāṃ cāpi tathātmani \|*  
*asūyāṃ bharturīrṣyāṃ vā praṇayaṃ vāpi darśayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. She should never praise herself among the other co-wives. To the contrary, she should denounce herself and when the situation so arises, she should display jealousy, malice and even love for her husband.

## \|\| 1.15.3 \|\|

*madvidhā yā hi bahvetattaccāttyaṃtikamaśnute \|*  
*yadasyā yuṣmato yāyādbhāryāśabdābhidheyatām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. She should think that for the types of unfortunate woman as she is, whatever is being received by her is enough — “I feel contented with the fact that I could get an opportunity to be a wife of such a great person.”

## \|\| 1.15.4 \|\|

*na ca nirbhūṣaṇā tiṣṭhenna cāpyuddhatabhūṣaṇā \|*  
*nānyadā gaṃdhamālyādi grāhyaṃ patyupacārataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. She should well clean her belly and other private parts of the body. These parts should be free from sweating, besides being perfectly neat and clean. Similarly, the teeth, the nose and the dust accumulated over the feet and odour should be removed.

## \|\| 1.15.5 \|\|

*tannyūnaṃ sarvaśo grāhyaṃ vallabhāyā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhamālyaṃ tu tāvatkālamalakṣitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. For the pleasure of the husband, she should do whatever is considered appropriate by her. In case normal efforts do not succeed, then she should emphasize on the cleaning of her private parts.

## \|\| 1.15.6 \|\|

*sambādhānāṃ pradeśānāṃ nityaṃ svedādimārjanam \|*  
*dantanāsādipaṅkānāṃ vigandhasya ca śodhanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. She should follow other co-wives in all the activities, particularly the bride who is the most favourite of the husband. She should always serve her. During such situations, she should behave like a cane.

## \|\| 1.15.7 \|\|

*nimittaṃ bharturetāsāṃ yatkiṃcidabhilakṣayet \|*  
*nānena vā tayoryatnaṃ vidadhyādaṅgamārjane \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. She should neither remain without ornaments, nor should she wear excessive, jewellery. She should not make use of the fragrance or the flower garlands without proper occasions. She should do so only for the pleasure of the husband.

## \|\| 1.15.8 \|\|

*sarvāsāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ sarvatrānugatā bhavet \|*  
*vaitasīṃ vṛttimāsthāya vallabhāyā viśeṣataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Even when she does so, she should wear only thin jewellery. The wife who is extremely loved by her husband, should wear the ornaments and fragrance in such a way that they do not become prominent.

## \|\| 1.15.9 \|\|

*anyasyā yadanuṣṭheyaṃ yanna sīdetsamarpitam \|*  
*bhartuścāviditaṃ yatnāttatkuryādavirodhi cet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. She should herself take up the work which is required to be done by the favourite wife and she should be contented with whatever she receives, She should secretly do the work which does not go against the husband, making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.15.10 \|\|

*kośavastrānnatāmbūlagandhāpānauṣadhādikam \|*  
*tatsarvamaniyuktānāṃ doṣavatvādvirudhyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The treasure, costumes, cereals, betels, fragrant materials, beverages, besides the aushadhis become the cause of conflict, when they are usurped without having been properly given by the elders. Therefore, she should not accept anyone of such articles without the permission of the co-wife.

## \|\| 1.15.11 \|\|

*yattu muktamanuṣṭheyaṃ gahasammārjanādikam \|*  
*strīṇāmanadhikāre'pi prāyastadvidhirucyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The neglected wife should perform all such jobs like the dusting and cleaning of the house which are usually done by the servants.

## \|\| 1.15.12 \|\|

*abhyaṅgodvartanaṃ snānaṃ bhojanaṃ maṇḍanāni ca \|*  
*kuryādbharturapatyānāṃ dhātrīkarmāṇi sādaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. She should apply paste over the bodies of her husband and other co-wives, besides treating their children like her own children, should attend to the cooking of food, decorations and the jobs which are done by the mid-wives should be attended to by her with respect

## \|\| 1.15.13 \|\|

*ātmavattānyapatyāni sādhayatyanuyogataḥ \|*  
*svenāpyamīṣāṃ vittena vidadhyānmaṇḍanādikam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The children of her co-wives should be looked after by her like her own children and she should provide them the ornaments spending money from her own source.

## \|\| 1.15.14 \|\|

*bhogaḥ svayamapatyairvā strīvittasya patirvidhā \|*  
*pūrve vayasyabhinandya paścime copayojanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Usually the riches available with the women are made use of by their husbands, they themselves or their children. They should save the money in their young age to be spent or utilised in the old age.

## \|\| 1.15.15 \|\|

*ubhayogastu vā mā vā karmajaḥ pṛthageva saḥ \|*  
*sadvṛtte tvadhikāṃ khyātiṃ kurvīta kriyayā punaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Irrespective of its being useful or not, it depends on the activities, and it has no relation with the savings as well. Therefore, the wealth should be saved in early age. Thus, the neglected wife, behaving in such a manner, should earn great glory.

## \|\| 1.15.16 \|\|

*na kāpi durbhagā nāma subhagā nāma jātitaḥ \|*  
*vyavahārādbhavatyeṣa nirdeśo ripumitravat \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. No woman becomes fortunate or unfortunate, she, behaving like a friend or a foe, becomes fortunate or unfortunate.

## \|\| 1.15.17 \|\|

*bhartṛcittāparijñānādananuṣṭhānato'pi vā \|*  
*vṛttairlokaviruddhaiśca yānti durbhagatāṃ striyaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Usually, the women who are unable to well understand the minds of their husbands or due to not moving in a favourable manner or indulging in unsocial activities, fall from the favour of their husbands, and become neglected.

## \|\| 1.15.18 \|\|

*prānukūlyānmanovṛttaiḥ paro'pi priyatāṃ vrajet \|*  
*prātikūlyānnijopyāśu priyaḥ pradveṣatāmiyāt \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. By moving according to the minds of others, the aliens even can be won over, and by moving against the wishes of others, even the own kins become the opponents.

## \|\| 1.15.19 \|\|

*tasmātsarvāsvavasthāsu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ \|*  
*priyaṃ samācarennityaṃ taccitānuvidhāyinī \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Therefore, a house wife, in all the activities and in all the situations, by action, thought or behaviour, should perform the noble deeds. She should always move in a way which finds favour with her husband.

## \|\| 1.15.20 \|\|

*yāmanyāṃ kāmayettāsāṃ taṃ tayā saṃprayojayet \|*  
*kupitāṃ ca priyāṃ kāñcidyatnādasmai prasādayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The co-wife who enjoys the best of the favour of her husband, she should do her best to be favourable to her instead of being destructive, In case the favourite wife of the husband gets annoyed, then all efforts should be made to please her.

## \|\| 1.15.21 \|\|

*tatpādaparicaryāyāṃ gotrasaṃvāhane 1 tathā \|*  
*pīḍane śirasaścaiva paraṃ kauśalamabhyaset \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. She should gain excellence in pressing of the feet, rubbing oil over the limbs of the body and application of the oil in the head.

## \|\| 1.15.22 \|\|

*pīḍanaṃ mṛdu madhyaṃ ca gātrāvasthāviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*mukhagātrādibhirliṅgaiḥ prayojyaṃ tatsukhāvaham \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. According to the condition of the body, there are three ways of rubbing the limbs of the body, viz., soft, medium and strong. One should make use of anyone of these methods while applying oil on the face or other limbs of the body.

## \|\| 1.15.23 \|\|

*bāhūrukaṭipṛṣṭheṣu skaṃdhe śirasi pādayoḥ \|*  
*gāḍhamardanamicchanti prāyonyatrāpi madhyamam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Dense rubbing would be required over aims, chest, waist, back, shoulder, head and both the feet. This is what is stated by the people. On other parts of the body, the medium type of rubbing would be needed.

## \|\| 1.15.24 \|\|

*nirmāṃseṣu pradeśeṣu nābhimūleṣu marmasu \|*  
*hṛdgaṇḍakakapolādāvicchanti mṛdumardanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. When the limbs have no flesh in the navel, over the heart and the cheeks, the rubbing should be soft, as desired by the people.

## \|\| 1.15.25 \|\|

*gāḍhaṃ jāgradavasthāyāmardhasuptasya madhyamam \|*  
*kiñcitsaparighātaṃ ca mṛdusuptasya neti vā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The rubbing while being awake should be dense or hard; when a person is half asleep, the rubbing should be of medium type and when sleeping deeply, the rubbing should be soft or the rubbing should stop after some time.

## \|\| 1.15.26 \|\|

*viruddhaṃ sarvagātreṣu2 lomavastu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*utkaṇḍūyatyu soddharṣaṃ snehākteṣu ca marda nam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Over all the limbs and especially the limbs with hair growth, excessive rubbing should not be resorted to because excessive rubbing on these spots creates adversity. Whichever part of the body has itching sensation, it should be rubbed with oil.

## \|\| 1.15.27 \|\|

*sparśādromāñcajananaṃ sanakhacchuritaṃ śanaiḥ \|*  
*pulakollekhanopetaṃ śiraḥkaṃḍūśca pārśvayoḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The limb by touching which one feels sensation, one should softly massage these, slowly touching with nail. By doing so, there would be sensation at that spot. Rubbing should be done on both the sides of head slowly.

## \|\| 1.15.28 \|\|

*teṣu teṣu ca gātreṣu tatprayojyaṃ tathātathā \|*  
*nidrāgamāya tatkāle rāgasaṃdhukṣaṇāya ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. At that point of time, it is desirable that sensation should be aroused in those limbs. In order to attract sleep, those limbs should be slowly massaged.

## \|\| 1.15.29 \|\|

*tiṣṭhataścopaviṣṭasya 1 jāgrataḥ svapato'pi vā \|*  
*saṃvāhanaṃ praśaṃsaṃti yadatyarthaṃ sukhāvaham \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The people have praised immensely of the massage undertaken while standing, seated, sleeping or when awake, because such an action makes one comfortable.

## \|\| 1.15.30 \|\|

*naiṣpandyaṃ pulakodbhedo gātrāṇāmakṣimīlanam \|*  
*tatpradeśārpaṇaṃ kiñcidbodhedvikṛtidarśanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. When the husband feels quite comfortable by massaging a particular limb, his hair stand at end, feels drowsy, that spot should be rubbed repeatedly, by the clever woman.

## \|\| 1.15.31 \|\|

*ūrū mūlādideśe ca tatpāṇipratipīḍanam \|*  
*lakṣayennipuṇā2 yatra tatraivādhikamācaret \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. In case the husband indicates by putting the root of the thighs, then the clever bride should indulge in excessive rubbing there.

## \|\| 1.15.32 \|\|

*evameva yathoddiṣṭaṃ strīvṛttaṃ yānutiṣṭhati \|*  
*patimārādhya sampūrṇa trivargaṃ sādhigacchati3 \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. As has been stated above, a woman who follow these rules carefully, she adoring the husband completely and carefully, ultimately achieves trivarga (dharma, art ha and kama).

## Chapter 16. Description of Pratipada Kalpa

## \|\| 1.16.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā strīlakṣaṇamaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sadvṛttaṃ ca tathā strīṇāṃ jagāma sa nijālayam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O group of Rishis, thus after speaking out the symptoms of the woman and their duties variously, lord Brahma returned to his abode.

## \|\| 1.16.2 \|\|

*ṛṣayaśca tathā jagmuḥ svāni dhiṣṇyānyaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*strīlakṣaṇaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ śrutvā kṛtsnaṃ mahīpate \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O king, listening to the auspicious and inauspicious symbols besides their duties, the Rishis also returned to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 1.16.3 \|\|

*itthaṃ lakṣaṇasampannāṃ bhāryāṃ prāpya mahīpate \|*  
*kartavyaṃ yadgṛhasthena tadidānīṃ nibodha me \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O king, after getting the virtuous wife, the duties to be performed by a householder should be listened from me.

## \|\| 1.16.4 \|\|

*baivāhikāgnau kurvīta gṛhyaṃ karma yathāvidhi \|*  
*pañcayajñavidhānaṃ tu paktiṃ kuryātsadā gṛhī \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Completing all the formalities in the fire of marriage, according to the provisions of the Grihya Sutras, all the rites should be observed. The householder should perform the five Mahayajnas daily as prescribed.

## \|\| 1.16.5 \|\|

*pañca sūnā gṛhasthasya tena svargaṃ na gacchati \|*  
*kaṇḍanī peṣaṇī cullī udakumbhīḥ pramārjanī \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. A householder always attracts five types of violence as a result of which he cannot achieve stay in the heaven. These violence deeds include — (i) Kandani (or killing of the insects while thrashing paddy), (ii) Peshani (killing of insects while grinding the com), (iii) Chulli (killing of insects while plastering the hearth), (iv) Udakumbhi (killing of insects while filling the pitchers with water) and (v) Pramarjani (killing of insects while brooming).

## \|\| 1.16.6 \|\|

*āsāṃ krameṇa sarvāsāṃ viśuddhyarthaṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*pañcoddiṣṭā mahāyajñāḥ pratyahaṃ gṛhamedhinām \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In order to purify oneself from all these sins, the people with wisdom have prescribed the five Mahayajnas, which should be daily performed by a householder.

## \|\| 1.16.7 \|\|

*adhyāpanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ pitṛyajñaśca tarpaṇam \|*  
*homo daivo balirbhaumastathānyo'tithipūjanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Teaching of vidya to the pupils is said to be the form of Brahman. To offer oblation to the manes is known as Pitri-yajna. Performing of homa is known as Daiva yajna. Making of offering (bali) is known as Bhuta-yajna and serving the guests is the Atithi-yajna.

## \|\| 1.16.8 \|\|

*pañcaitānyo mahāyajñānna hāpayati śaktitaḥ \|*  
*sa gṛhe'pi vasannityaṃ sūnodorṣairna lipyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A householder, who does not miss these yajnas and performs them daily, he inspite of being a householder, does not get involved in five types of violent deeds as stated above.

## \|\| 1.16.9 \|\|

*devatātithibhṛtyānāṃ pitṝṇāmātmanaśca yaḥ \|*  
*na nirvapati pañcānāmucchvasanna ca jīvati \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. To the contrary, a person who does not perform the five yajnas in favour of gods, guests, servants and the manes, which bestow welfare, he is to be treated as dead while living.

## \|\| 1.16.10 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*yasya nāsti gṛhe tvagniḥ sa mṛto nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*na sa pūjayituṃ śakto devādīnbrāhmaṇottamaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Shatanika said — O excellent Brahmanas, in a household, the fire of marriage cannot be preserved. It gets extinguished, there is no doubt about it. Because inspite of being a highly placed Brahmana, sometimes he is unable to adore the lord.

## \|\| 1.16.11 \|\|

*niragnikasya viprasya kathaṃ devādayo dvija \|*  
*prītāḥ syuḥ śāntaye tasya paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. But I feel quite anxious in my mind that the Brahmana, who is not in a position to adore that fire, how do the gods get pleased for bestowing welfare on him?

## \|\| 1.16.12 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi rājendra śrūyatāṃ paramaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*anagnayastu ye viprāsteṣāṃ śreyo'bhidhīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O master of the earth, O son of the Kuru race, by fasting on some particular tit his, the gods and others get especially pleased.

## \|\| 1.16.13 \|\|

*vratopavāsaniyamairnānādānaistathā 1 nṛpa \|*  
*devādayo bhavantyeva prītāsteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Shatanika said — O lord, you enlighten me on those special tithis and the method of fasting therein. How the fast is to be observed and how has it to be completed, the relevant methods as prescribed in the Grihya Sutra.

## \|\| 1.16.14 \|\|

*viśeṣādupavāsena tithau kila mahīpate \|*  
*prītā devādayasteṣāṃ bhavanti kurunandana \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O excellent Brahmana, you kindly speak out the way in which by your grace, I could be able to free myself from the collection of sins and get redeemed from the ocean of the universe and the entire world could be benefited from the same.

## \|\| 1.16.15 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*bhagavaṃstvaṃ tithīnbrūhi tithīnāṃ ca vidhiṃ hi me \|*  
*prāśanaṃ gṛhyadharmāṃśca upavāsavidhīnapi \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Sumantu said — You have put a very good question. Listen to my important words. I am speaking about the Brahmanas, who are without the worship of fire and the way they achieve welfare. I am going to speak to you on the subject

## \|\| 1.16.16 \|\|

*iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe śatārddhasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ brāhme parvaṇi pratipatkalpavarṇanaṃ \|*  
*nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O king, the gods get pleased where such types of Brahmanas are gifted with various types of presents after performing of the vratas, fasts etc., there is not the slightest doubt in it.

## \|\| 1.16.17 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu kaurava karmāṇi tithiguhyāśritāni tu \|*  
*śrutāni ghnanti pāpāni upoṣitaphalāni ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Sumantu said — O son of the race of Kuru, I now speak out the details of the auspicious tithis in which the fastings should be carried out You please listen about the auspicious tithis name, by which the collection of the sins vanish.

## \|\| 1.16.18-21 \|\|

*pratipadi kṣīraprāśanaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ lavaṇavarjanam \|*  
*tṛtīyāyāṃ tilānnaṃ prāśnīyāccaturthyāṃ kṣīrāśanaśca pañcamyām \|*  
*phalāśanaḥ sadā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śākāśanaḥ saptamyāṃ bilvāhāroṣṭamyāṃ tu \|\| 18 \|\|*

*piṣṭāśano navamyāmanagnipākāhāro daśamyāmekādaśyāṃ ghṛtāhāro dvādaśyāṃ pāyasāhāraḥ \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ gomūtrāhāraścaturdaśyāṃ yavānnāhāraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kuśodakaprāśanaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ haviṣyāhāro'māvāsyāyām \|*  
*eṣa prāśanavidhistithīnāmeva cānena vidhinā pakṣamekaṃ yo vartayati \|\| 20 \|\|*

*so'śvamedhaphalaṃ daśaguṇaphalamavāpnoti \|*  
*svarge manvantarāṇi yāvatprativasati \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. On the first day of the moon (Pratipada) one should consume milk daily. On the second day of the moon (Dvitiya), one should consume the saltless diet. On the third day of the moon (Tritiya), one should consume food with sesamum. On the fourth day (Chaturthi) of the moon, only milk has to be consumed. On the fifth day (Panchami) of the moon, one should consume the fruits alone; on the sixth day of the moon (Shasthi), one should live on vegetables alone. On the seventh day of the moon (Saptami), one should consume the wood apple fruit. On the eighth day of the moon (Ashtami), one should consume the powder of horse-bean. On the ninth day of the moon (Navami), one should consume the fruits as his food. On the tenth and eleventh days of the moon (Dashami and Ekadashi), one should take food cooked in ghi. On the twelfth day of the moon (Dvadashi), one should consume milk only. On the thirteenth day of the moon (Trayodashi), one should consume the cow’s urine alone. On the fourteenth day of the moon (Chaturdashi), one should eat barley alone. On the full moon day (Paurnamasi), one should consume the water mixed with Kusha grass. On the moonless day (Amavasya), one should consume the Havishyanna or the left-over of the homa’s food. These are the types of foods prescribed to be taken on each one of the moon days or fortnights. One who performs the vratas as per the aforesaid method, he earns the merit of performing the Ashvamedha sacrifice besides living in the heaven for several Manvantaras.

## \|\| 1.16.22 \|\|

*upagīyamānopsarogandharvairmāsatrayacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*sośvamedharājasūyānāṃ śataguṇamavāpnoti \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. One who performs these vratas continuously for three or four months, getting honoured by the groups of Apsaras and Gandharvas by musical feats, he achieves a hundred times more reward than the Ashvamedha and Rajasuya yajnas.

## \|\| 1.16.23 \|\|

*svarge upagīyamānopsarogandharvaiścaturyugānāṃ daśaśatīryāvatprativasati \|*  
*tathāṣṭamāsapāraṇe rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sahasraguṇaphalamavāpnoti \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Similarly, one who performs the vratas for eight months, getting praised by the Apsaras and Gandharvas, lives in the heaven for a thousand Chaturyugas besides earning merit thousand times more than the performing of the Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.16.24 \|\|

*svarge caturdaśa manvatarāṇi yāvatprativasati \|*  
*upagīyamānopsarogandharvairya evaṃ niyamamāsthāya varṣamekaṃ vartayati \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Similarly, one who performs the aforesaid vrata for full one year, he getting praised by the Apsaras and Gandharvas lives in the heaven for fourteen Manvantaras.

## \|\| 1.16.25 \|\|

*sa saviturloke kālaṃ manvantaraṃ prativasati \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He also lives in the Suryaloka for a Kala Manvantara.

## \|\| 1.16.26 \|\|

*ya evaṃ niyamānrājannāśvayujanavamyāṃ māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ vaiśākhatṛtīyāyāṃ kārtikapaurṇamāsyāṃ tithivratāni gṛdṛṇāti brahmacārī gṛhastho vanastho nārī naro vā śūdraḥ prayatamānasaḥ dīrghāyuṣyaṃ savituḥ sālokyaṃ vrajati \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O king, a person who performs these vratas on the ninth moon day of Ashvina, seventh moon day of Magha, the third moon day of Vaishakha and the full moon day of Karttika, irrespective of his being a Brahmachari or a householder, a man or a woman or a Shudra, controlling his or her sense organs, enjoys a long life and achieves the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.16.27-28 \|\|

*yaiścāpi purā rājannanena vidhinā etāsu tithiṣvanyajanmāntare upavāsavidhiḥ kṛtaḥ dānāni dattāni vividhaprakārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvijaneṣu vā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*trirātropavāsināṃ tīrthayātrātapogurumātāpitṛśuśrūśāniratānāṃ teṣāṃ svargādibhogavāsanādihāgatānāṃ phalaniṣpatticihnāni manuṣyaloke pratyakṣata eva dṛśyante \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. O king, not only this, such of the people who have observed these vratas in their earlier births giving away various types of charities to the Brahmanas and the ascetics, besides those who have fasted for three nights in pilgrimage, or those who engage themselves in the service of the preceptors and the parents, and desirous of enjoying the heavenly pleasures, their enjoying of all the merits is found accomplished clearly in this world.

## \|\| 1.16.29 \|\|

*hastyaśvayānayugyadhanaratnakanakahiraṇyakaṭakakeyūragraiveyakakaṭisūtrakarṇālaṅkāramukuṭavaravastravaranārīvaravilepanasurūpaguṇadīrghāyuṣo vigatādhivyādhayo dānopavāsaratānāṃ phalānyetāni nṛtyagītavāditramaṅgalapāṭhakaśabdairihādyāpi puṇyakṛto bodhyamānā dṛśyanta iti \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Such people possess elephants, horses, vehicles, chariots, riches, gems, gold bracelets, necklaces, waistbands, Brahmasutra, earrings, crowns, beautiful garments, charming wives, beautiful sandalpaste, charming beauty, virtues, long life, body without ailments, who perform the aforesaid types of vratas. They also enjoy dance and music and are waken up with the welfare recitations, after their sleep.

## \|\| 1.16.30-31 \|\|

*tathākṛtopavāsā api hi dṛśyante \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tathā adattadānā akṛtapuṇyāśca pratyakṣata eva dṛśyante \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. To the contrary those who do not perform these auspicious vratas, and also do not give away the charioteer, such sinful people can be clearly found in the world.

## \|\| 1.16.32 \|\|

*tadyathā kāṇakuṣṭhibadhirajaḍamūkavyaṅgā rogadāridryopasargavyādhihatāyuṣaśca dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi mānavāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. They are like those blind of one eye, deaf, inactive, dumb, handicap, ailing, lean and thin besides being with short life. Such people are found on earth even today.

## \|\| 1.16.33 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*dvijendra tithayaḥ proktāḥ samāsena tvayā budha \|*  
*vistareṇaiva me bhūyaḥ prabrūhi dvijasattama \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Shatanika said — O best of Brahmanas, you have briefly narrated the glory of the tit his. O excellent Brahmanas, you kindly explain comprehensively about them.

## \|\| 1.16.34 \|\|

*rahasyaṃ yattithīnāṃ tu devānāṃ ca viceṣṭitam \|*  
*yānīṣṭāni ca devānāṃ bhojyāni niyamāstathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The secrets of the aforesaid tithis and the related activities of the gods, their special or favourite eatables with the related rules, may please be narrated to enable me to purify myself. O Brahmana, you tell me the way by which I could be able to achieve the reward without any obstruction.

## \|\| 1.16.35 \|\|

*tāni me vada dharmajña yena pūto bhavenvaham \|*  
*nirdvandvo hi yathā vipra labhe yāgaphalāni tu \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Sumantu said — I am now going to speak out about the mysterious things, about those tithis, there consumable materials and the special merits for consuming them, the rules for performing them, all those details, particularly for the use of the ladies, are being spoken by me. You please listen. They are so secret, that their secrecy has not so far been disclosed by me even to my closest and favourite people.

## \|\| 1.16.36-37 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*rahasyaṃ yattithīnāṃ ca bhojanaṃ phalameva tu \|*  
*yāvacca yena niyamo viśeṣātstrījanasya ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*etatte sarvamākhyāmo rahasyaṃ tannibodha me \|*  
*yanmayā noktapūrvaṃ hi kasyacitsupriyasya hi \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. O long armed Narada, a particular tithi which is attributed to a particular god and the related rules to be observed for the adoration of a particular god, are going to be narrated by me. You please listen. I am briefly narrating in the context of the details of these tit his relating to the period earlier than the creation of the universe.

## \|\| 1.16.38-39 \|\|

*tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi yasya devasya yā tithiḥ \|*  
*devatānāṃ rahasyāni vratāni niyamāstathā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tāñchṛṇuṣva mahābāho gadato mama nārada \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ pūrvaṃ vadiṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa tithiṃ prati \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Prior to the creation of the universe, the entire globe was filled with darkness. It had no specific symbol nor were there any means to know about it, After reaching such a world, lord Brahma created it out of his own body.

## \|\| 1.16.40 \|\|

*tamobhūtamidaṃ tvāsīdalabhyamavitarkitam \|*  
*jagadbrahmā samāgatyāsṛjadātmānamātmanā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Out of the centre of the vast egg type world, lord Brahma — the soul of all the bhutas, himself emerged out of it. Initially lord Vibhu, known as Narayana, became desirous of creating the universe, and created a vast egg out of himself.

## \|\| 1.16.41 \|\|

*saṃbhūtātmaiva ātmāsāvaṇḍamadhyādviniḥsṛtaḥ \|*  
*ātmanaivātmano hyaṇḍaṃ sṛṣṭvā sa vibhurāditaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Out of its two parts, he built the sky as well as the earth. Out of the same, lord Brahma created the ten directions, the gods and the demons. All of them were created by Brahma on the first date also known as Pratipada.

## \|\| 1.16.42-43 \|\|

*brahmā nārāyaṇākhyo'sau sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*tābhyāṃ soṇḍakapālābhyāṃ divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirmame \|\| 42 \|\|*

*diśaścaivopadiśaścaiva devādīndānavāṃstathā \|*  
*tithiṃ pūrvāmimāṃ rājaṃścakārātha vibhuḥ svayam \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Because of the above fact, this tithi has been said to be the best of all the tit his. Since the people then demonstrated it, therefore it was known as Pratipada.

## \|\| 1.16.44 \|\|

*tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmādbrahmaṇā samudāhṛtā \|*  
*pratipāditā pare pūrve pratipattena tūcyate \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. After this initiation the moon days were called as tit his. The method of performing the fast relating to it is being explained by me, you better listen to it.

## \|\| 1.16.45 \|\|

*asmātpadāttu tithayo yasmāttvanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*asyānte kathayiṣyāmi upavāsavidhiṃ param \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Those who are well-versed in the constitution, should first start observing fast on the seventh moon day of the month of Karttika and Yugadi tithis of the month of Vaishakha.

## \|\| 1.16.46 \|\|

*kārttikyāṃ māghasaptamyāṃ vaiśākhasya yugādiṣu \|*  
*niyamopavāsaṃ prathamaṃ grāhayeta vidhānavit 1 \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O master of the people, during these fifteen moon days or tithis, a person who devotionally follows the rules, I am narrating the relative moves of the destiny,

## \|\| 1.16.47 \|\|

*yāṃ tithiṃ niyamaṃ kartuṃ bhaktyā samanugacchati \|*  
*tasyāṃ tithau vidhānaṃ yattannibodha janādhipa \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O king, when a person intends to start the vrata on the day of Pratipada, then he, after the fourteenth day of the moon, should perform a samkalpa for the same.

## \|\| 1.16.48 \|\|

*yadā tu pratipadyāṃ vai gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*caturdaśyāṃ kṛtāhāraḥ saṃkalpaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Thereafter, on the moonless day of Amavasya, without taking food the performer of the vrata should take bath thrice a day. He should then recite the Gayatri mantra with a pure mind throughout the day.

## \|\| 1.16.49 \|\|

*amāvāsyāṃ na bhuñjīta trikālaṃ snānamācaret \|*  
*pavitro hi japennityaṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Then in the early morning, next to the day of Pratipada, an excellent Brahmana should be adored offering fragrant flowers and pray — “let the glorious lord Brahma be pleased with me.” With this feeling in his mind, he should give away milk in charity.

## \|\| 1.16.50 \|\|

*arcayitvā prabhāte tu gandhamālyairdvijottamān \|*  
*śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāttu brahmā me prīyatāṃ prabhuḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. O monarch! With this method, after the conclusion of the vrata, the performer should take food with milk. O king, the same process should be observed during all the tit his.

## \|\| 1.16.51 \|\|

*tato bhuñjīta gokṣīramanena vidhinā nṛpa \|*  
*eṣa eva vidhirdṛṣṭaḥ sarvāsu tithiṣu nṛpa \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. With the lapse of one year in this way, the vrata is concluded. O master of people, you listen to the merit, one earns by performing the vrata.

## \|\| 1.16.52 \|\|

*saṃvatsaragate kāle vratametatsamāpyate \|*  
*vratāṃte yatphalaṃ tasya tannibodha narādhipa \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The performer of the vrata gets relieved of all the sins and his soul gets purified. In future, he gets a divine birth with divine virtues. Getting pleased on him, lord Brahma bestows on him an illumining divine plane, which cannot be stopped by anyone anywhere. He gets always surrounded by the Apsaras and Kinnaras.

## \|\| 1.16.53 \|\|

*vimuktapāpaḥ śuddhātmā divyadehasya dehinaḥ \|*  
*brahmā dadāti saṃtuṣṭo vimānamatitejasam \|*  
*avyāhatagatiṃ divyaṃ kinnarāpsarasairyutam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. In the auspicious loka, he enjoys all the comforts like the gods for long, making the best use of them. He achieves all the prosperity and enjoys all the comforts for long. He is born in the family of Brahmanas during the next ten births.

## \|\| 1.16.54 \|\|

*ramitvā suciraṃ tatra daivataiḥ saha devavat \|*  
*iha cāgatya vipratvaṃ daśa janmānyasau labhet \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. With the influence of the same merit, he attains knowledge of all the Vedas and the post Vedic literature, besides all the lores. He becomes immensely illustrious and donor in the Satyayuga age.

## \|\| 1.16.55 \|\|

*vedavedāṃgavidyaśca dīrghāyuścaiva suprabhaḥ \|*  
*bhogī dhanapatirdātā jāyate'sau kṛte yuge \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. O Rajendra, Vishvamitra in order to gain the position of a Brahmana and in order to cause pain to the gods of the heaven, performed enormous tapas but he could not achieve the position of a Brahmana. To the contrary, he had to face a number of obstructions besides the painful situations.

## \|\| 1.16.56 \|\|

*viśvāmitrastu rājendra brāhmaṇatvajigīṣayā \|*  
*tapaścacāra vipulaṃ santāpāya divaukasām \|*  
*brāhmaṇatvaṃ na lebhe'sau lebhe vighnānanekaśaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Then he, taking the tithi of Pratipada to be the favourite of Brahma, regularly performing various types of charities and other noble deeds, should resort to fasting.

## \|\| 1.16.57 \|\|

*tatastu niyamātteṣāṃ tithīnāṃ pravarā tithiḥ \|*  
*upoṣitā bahuvidhā jñātvā brahmapriyāṃ tithim \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. As a result of this, the lord Brahma for the extremely intelligent Vishvamitra, bestowed him the boon to achieve the Brahmanhood by the same body.

## \|\| 1.16.58 \|\|

*tato dadau brahmā viśvāmitrāya dhīmate \|*  
*ihaiva tena dehena brāhmaṇatvaṃ sudurlabham \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. The tithi of Pratipada is the best of all the tithis and bestows excellent merits. By regularly adoring it, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and even Shudras achieve the position of Brahmanhood.

## \|\| 1.16.59 \|\|

*tithīnāṃ pravarā hyeṣā tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyo vaiśyaśūdrau vā brāhmaṇatvamavāpnuyuḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. O king, thus the tithi of Pratipada, is extremely favourite of lord Brahma, born of a lotus, and fulfills all the desires. I have never revealed the glory of the same to anyone in the world so far. But I have revealed the rules and the mystery thereof.

## \|\| 1.16.60 \|\|

*evaṃ tithiriyaṃ rājankāmadā kañjajapriyā \|*  
*sarahasyā mayā proktā yā noktā yasya kasyacit \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. In this world, the extremely auspicious Pratipada tithi was adored by the Haihaya, Talajanga, Turushka, Yavanas and Shakas, who were desirous of achieving the Brahmanhood.

## \|\| 1.16.61 \|\|

*haihayaistālajaṅghaiśca turuṣkairyavanaiḥ śakaiḥ \|*  
*upoṣitā ihātraiva brāhmaṇatvamabhīpsubhiḥ 1 \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. This tithi bestows high merit and welfare besides being the remover of the sins. O king, by listening or maintaining the relative vratas, or by following the same, a person achieves the aforesaid merit.

## \|\| 1.16.62 \|\|

*ityeṣā paramā puṇyā śivā pāpaharā tathā \|*  
*paṭhitopāsitā rājañchraddhayā ca śrutā 1 tathā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. A person who merely listens to its glory alone, he achieves success, prosperity, glory, welfare and finally the heaven.

## Chapter 17. Adoration of Brahma in relation to Pratipada kalpa

## \|\| 1.17.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*brūhi me vista rādbrahmanpratipatkṛtyamādarāt \|*  
*brahmapūjāvidhānaṃ ca pūjane yacca vai phalam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O Brahman! Now you please enlighten me about the performance on the day of Pratipada and the method of the adoration of Brahma on that day. You also please tell me the reward one achieves by adoring Brahma on that particular day.

## \|\| 1.17.2-4 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanā rājankathayāmyeṣa śāṃtidam \|*  
*pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame \|\| 2 \|\|*

*svayaṃbhūrabhavaddevaḥ surajyeṣṭhaścaturmukhaḥ \|*  
*sasarja lokāndevāṃśca bhūtāni vividhāni ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kāyena manasā vācā jaṃgamasthāvarāṇi ca \|*  
*pitā yaḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sumantu said — O king, you listen to me with a concentrated mind, I am narrating the sacred story to you. In the ancient times when the entire mobile and immobile world was consigned in the deep oceanic waters, at that point of time the four-faced Brahma emerged on the scene. It is he, who created several types of creatures including the lokas and the bhutas. By his action, thought and behavior, he again created immobile and mobile creatures once again. This is the reason that he is called father of the gods and the grandfather of all the bhutas.

## \|\| 1.17.5 \|\|

*tasmādeṣa sadā pūjyo yato lokaguruḥ paraḥ \|*  
*sṛjatyeṣa jagatkṛtsnaṃ pāti saṃharate tathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. This is the reason for his being considered as adorable by all, because he is the foremost and quite great in the world. He creates the entire universe, preserves it and ultimately destroys the same.

## \|\| 1.17.6 \|\|

*rudro'sya manaso jāto viṣṇurjāto'sya vakṣasaḥ \|*  
*mukhebhyaścaturo vedā vedāṃgāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Rudra emerged out of his mind and Vishnu emerged out of his chest. The Vedas and the entire post Vedic literature emerged out of his mouths.

## \|\| 1.17.7 \|\|

*devāpsarasagaṃdharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*pūjayaṃti sadā vīra viriṃciṃ suranāyakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O valorous one, the lord who is also called Virinchi, is worshipped by the Apsaras, Gandharvas, Yakshas, serpents as well the Rakshasas.

## \|\| 1.17.8 \|\|

*sarvo brahmamayo lokaḥ sarvaṃ brahmaṇi saṃsthitam \|*  
*tasmātsamarcayedbrahmanya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. All the people are the forms of Brahman and are lodged in Brahman. Therefore, the one who is desirous of his welfare, he should adore Brahma.

## \|\| 1.17.9 \|\|

*yo na pūjayate bhaktyā surajyeṣṭhaṃ sureśvaram \|*  
*na sa nākasya rājyasya na ca mokṣasya bhājanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Such of the people who do not worship Brahma — the favorite of the gods, they do not get entitled to the achieving of the heaven.

## \|\| 1.17.10 \|\|

*yastu pūjayate bhaktyā viriṃciṃ bhuvaneśvaram \|*  
*sa nākarājyamokṣeṣu kṣipraṃ bhavati bhājanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A person who worships lord Brahma with devotion, he achieves the heaven and moksha without delay.

## \|\| 1.17.11 \|\|

*tasmātsaumyamanā bhūtvā yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā \|*  
*arcayitvā sadā devamāpannopi naro nṛpa \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O monarch! Therefore, a person irrespective of his facing any misfortune, should worship lord Brahma with devotion, who is the god of gods.

## \|\| 1.17.12 \|\|

*varaṃ dehaparityāgo varaṃ narakasambhavaḥ \|*  
*na tvevāpūjya bhuṃjaṃti devaṃ vai padmasaṃbhavam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Such of the people who take their food without worshipping lord Brahma, for them it would be better to fall in the hell, instead of moving alive on earth.

## \|\| 1.17.13 \|\|

*sadā pūjayate yastu vīra bhaktyā pitāmaham \|*  
*manuṣyacarmaṇā naddhaḥ sa vedhā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. O valorous one, a person who with utmost devotion worships Brahma — the grandsire, he undoubtedly becomes Brahman in human form.

## \|\| 1.17.14 \|\|

*na hi vedho'rcanātkiṃcitpuṇyamabhyadhikaṃ bhavet \|*  
*iti vijñāya yatnena pūjanī yaḥ sadā vidhiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. There is no merit greater than the worship of Brahma. Thus understanding, a person should worship Brahma making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.17.15 \|\|

*yo brahmāṇaṃ dveṣṭi mohātsarvadevanamaskṛtam \|*  
*naro narakagāmī syāttasya saṃbhāṣaṇādapi \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. A person who out of confusion in his mind becomes envious of Brahma who is adored by gods even, he surely falls in the hell. Not only that, by talking to such a person, one is sure to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.17.16 \|\|

*brahmaṇorcāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvayatnairvidhānataḥ \|*  
*yatpuṇyaṃ phalamāpnoti tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Consecrating the image of Brahma, it should be worshipped with all the yantras in an appropriate manner, and by so doing, the merit which is achieved by such a person, you listen the same from me.

## \|\| 1.17.17 \|\|

*sarvayajñatapodānatīrthavedeṣu yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ labhedvedhaḥ pratiṣṭhayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person who receives the merits with the performing of yajnas, tapas, charities, going on pilgrimage, study of the Vedas, will gets a hundred times more of that merit by worshipping the image of Brahma, after consecrating it.

## \|\| 1.17.18 \|\|

*kañjajaṃ sthāpayedyastu kṛtvā śālāṃ manoramām \|*  
*sarvāṃgamodita puṇyaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ labhet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. A person who builds a beautiful temple and consecrates the image of Brahma in the same, he achieves crore times more the merits as prescribed in the scriptures.

## \|\| 1.17.19 \|\|

*mātṛjānpitṛjāṃścaiva yāṃ caivodvahate striyam \|*  
*kulaikaviṃśamuttārya brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The immensely meritorious person, his maternal and paternal races, besides the family in which he marries, get redeemed upto twenty one generations. Besides that, he himself is worshipped in Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.20 \|\|

*bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānpralaye samupasthite \|*  
*jñānayogaṃ samāsādya sa tatraiva vimucyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. He, experiencing all the pleasures there, at the time of the dissolution of the world, achieves success in Jnanayoga and gets redeemed there itself.

## \|\| 1.17.21 \|\|

*atha vā rājyamākāṃkṣejjāyate saṃbhavāṃtare \|*  
*saptadvīpasamudrāyāḥ kṣiteradhipatirbhavet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. In case he is desirous of getting a kingship, then he in future births, becomes an emperor of all the seven continents and seven oceans of the entire world. He becomes the sole lord of the universe.

## \|\| 1.17.22 \|\|

*trisaṃdhyaṃ yo japedbrahma kṛtvāṣṭadala paṃkajam \|*  
*paurṇamāsyāṃ pratipadi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A person who makes the eight-petalled lotus during the purnima and pratipada dates, and performs japam in favour of Brahma thrice a day, you listen to the merits earned by him.

## \|\| 1.17.23 \|\|

*anenaiva sa dehena brahmā saṃtiṣṭhate kṣitau \|*  
*pāpahā sarvamartyānāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. What more could be said about him? It should be understood that lord Brahma alone moves on earth through his body. The touch and audience with him, relieves a person of all his sins.

## \|\| 1.17.24 \|\|

*uddhṛtya divi saṃsthāpya kulānāmekaviṃśatim \|*  
*taiḥ kulaiḥ sahito nityaṃ modate gogato nṛpa \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The auspicious and meritorious person gets established in the heaven, redeeming his twenty one generations. For the people of his own race, he always feels blissful on earth.

## \|\| 1.17.25 \|\|

*apyekavāraṃ yo bhaktyā pūjayetpadma saṃbhavam \|*  
*padmasthaṃ mūrtimaṃtaṃ vā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. A person, who even once adores Brahma seated over the lotus seat with devotion, he ultimately achieves Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.26 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayātkṣitiṃ prāpya bhavetkṣitipatirmahān \|*  
*vedavedāṃgatattvajño brāhmaṇaścāpi jāyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Where the merits get exhausted, he returns on the earth to become a great ruler there. He acquires the knowledge of all the Vedas and the parts thereof, and is reborn in the excellent race of a Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.17.27 \|\|

*na tattapobhiratyugrairna ca sarvairmahāmakhaiḥ \|*  
*gacchedbrahmapuraṃ divyaṃ mukttvā bhaktiparātmakān \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Except for the worship of Brahma with devotion, one cannot achieve Brahmaloka, even with the performing of tapas or yajnas.

## \|\| 1.17.28 \|\|

*mṛddārveṣṭakaśailairvā yaḥ kuryādbrahmaṇo gṛham \|*  
*triḥsaptakulasaṃyukto brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A person who builds the temple of Brahma with clay, wood, bricks or stone, he is redeemed in Brahmaloka with his twenty one generations.

## \|\| 1.17.29 \|\|

*mṛnmayātkoṭiguṇitaṃ phalaṃ dārviṣṭakāmaye \|*  
*iṣṭakādviguṇa puṇyaṃ kṛte śailamaye gṛhe \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The brick temple and the temple made of wood are crores of times better than the temple made of mud. The stone temple earns double the merit as compared to the brick temple.

## \|\| 1.17.30 \|\|

*krīḍamānopi yaḥ kuryācchālāṃ vai brahmaṇo nṛpa \|*  
*brahmaloke sa labhate vimānaṃ sarvakāmikam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O monarch! A person who builds the temple of Brahma playfully, he also becomes adorable and achieves the plane which fulfills all the desires.

## \|\| 1.17.31 \|\|

*puṣpamālāparikṣiptaṃ kiṃkiṇījālabhūṣitam \|*  
*dolāvikṣepasaṃpannaṃ ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. His plane is quite beautiful and surrounded with the garlands of fragrant flowers on all the sides, besides swings with the small bells, a big bell as well as the flywhisks.

## \|\| 1.17.32 \|\|

*muktādāmavitānena śobhitaṃ sūryasuprabham \|*  
*apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ sarvakāmasukhapradam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The strings of beads are hung all round it and it looks graceful like the sunshine. The groups of Apsaras surround it from all the sides. They fulfil all the desires and provide all the comforts.

## \|\| 1.17.33 \|\|

*tatroṣitvā mahābhogī krīḍamānaḥ sadā suraiḥ \|*  
*punarāgatya lokesminrājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. After dwelling in the Brahmaloka, a person, sporting with the gods, becomes a religious minded king after his return on earth.

## \|\| 1.17.34 \|\|

*paśyanpariharañjantūnmṛdupūrvaṃ mahīpate \|*  
*śanaiḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kurvaṃścāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ vrajet \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O great master, observing the creatures in the abode of Brahma, when a person sprinkles the water slowly and pleasantly, he earns the merit of performing the Chandrayana vrata.

## \|\| 1.17.35 \|\|

*vastrapūtena toyena yaḥ kuryādupalepanam \|*  
*paśyanpariharañjatūṃścāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Using the water filtered with a cloth, a person when observing the creature, smears (his body), he earns the merit of performing a Chandrayana vrata.

## \|\| 1.17.36 \|\|

*nairaṃtaryeṇa yaḥ kuryātpakṣaṃ saṃmārjanārcanam \|*  
*yugakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A person who performs marjana and devotion in the abode, he is adored in Brahmaloka for a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 1.17.37 \|\|

*tasyāṃte sa caturvedaḥ surūpaḥ priyadarśanaḥ \|*  
*āḍhyaḥ sarvaguṇopeto rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. After the lapse of that period, he becomes a king, well-versed in all the Vedas, besides being highly learned, beautiful, pleasant looking, enjoying enough of riches, virtuous, and religious-minded.

## \|\| 1.17.38 \|\|

*kapaṭenāpi yaḥ kuryādbrahmaśālāṃ sumānada \|*  
*saṃmārjanādi vai karma so'pi prāpnoti tatphalam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. O person with noble mind, a person who deceitfully builds the temple of Brahma, he also achieves the aforesaid merit.

## \|\| 1.17.39 \|\|

*tāvaddhamaṃti saṃsāre duḥkhaśokabhayaplutāḥ \|*  
*na bhavaṃti suraśreṣṭhe yāvadraktā mahīpate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O lord of earth, the people get involved in various types of miseries, grief and danger, till such time they do not develop their devotion for Brahma.

## \|\| 1.17.40 \|\|

*samāsaktaṃ yathā cittaṃ jantorviṣayagocare \|*  
*yadyevaṃ brahmaṇi nyastaṃ ko na mucyeta bandhanāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. As the mind of the people gets attracted towards the outward pleasures, in case they get attracted similarly towards Brahma, then who is there, who would not be freed or redeemed from the worldly bondages?

## \|\| 1.17.41 \|\|

*khaṇḍasphuṭitasaṃskāraṃ śālāyāṃ yaḥ karoti vai \|*  
*arāmāvasathādyeṣu labhate mauktikaṃ phalam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. A person who repairs the damaged temple of Brahma or completes it in every respect, or adds additional space or a resting place or orchard to it, he earns the merit of achieving moksha.

## \|\| 1.17.42-44 \|\|

*nāsti brahmasamo devo nāsti brahmasamo guruḥ \|*  
*nāsti brahmasamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti vedhaḥsamaṃ tapaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pratipadyādisarveṣu divaseṣūtsaveṣu ca \|*  
*parvakāleṣu puṇye paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śaṃkhabheryādinirghoṣairmahadbhigeṃyasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*kuryānnīrājanaṃ deve surajyeṣṭhe caturmukhe \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. There is no god or tapas or a preceptor comparable with Brahma. During all the tithis including Pratipada and others, on the days of all the festivities, or on some auspicious occasions, or on the foil moon day, playing on the religious musical instruments like conch, trumpets etc., and organizing the sweet musical feats, lights should be offered to Brahma — the four faced one.

## \|\| 1.17.45 \|\|

*yāvatparvāṇi vidhinā kuryā nnīrājanaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*tāvadyugasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. A person when offers light to Brahma, in as many functions, he is worshipped for as many thousands of years in Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.46 \|\|

*snānakāle trisaṃdhyaṃ tu yaḥ kuryānnṛtyavādanam \|*  
*gītaṃ vā mukhavādyaṃ vā tasya puṇya phalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A person who organizes programme for dance and music thrice a day in the temple of Brahma, besides singing or plays on mouth organs, you listen to the resultant reward he achieves.

## \|\| 1.17.47 \|\|

*yāvantyahāni kurute geyanṛtyādivādanam \|*  
*tāvadyugasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. For the number of days on which he arranges for dance, music and songs, he gets adored in the Brahmaloka for thousands of yugas.

## \|\| 1.17.48 \|\|

*kapilāpañcagavyena kuśavāriyutena ca \|*  
*snāpayenmaṃtrapūtena brāhmaṃ snānaṃ hi tatsmṛtam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Using Panchagavya of the white cow and the water mixed with kusha grass when a bath is taken, it is called Brahma bath.

## \|\| 1.17.49 \|\|

*kapilāpaṃcagavyena dadhikṣīraghṛtena ca \|*  
*snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ jñeyamitareṣāṃ narādhipa \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A hundred times more meritorious is the bath taken mixed with panchagavya of the white cow, curd, milk and ghi.

## \|\| 1.17.50 \|\|

*devāgnikāryamuddiśya kapilāmāharetsadā \|*  
*brahmakṣatraviśaścaiva na śūdrastu kadācana \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. A Brahmana, a Kshatriya and a Vaishya should always, for the purpose of fire ceremonies, use the milk etc. of the Kapila or white cow, of course, a Shudra should not make use of the same stuff of Kapila cow.

## \|\| 1.17.51 \|\|

*kāpilaṃ yaḥ pibecchūdro devakāryārthanirmitam \|*  
*sa pacyeta mahāghore suciraṃ narakārṇave \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. A Shudra who consumes the milk of Kapila cow, which is prescribed for the use of the religious purposes, he falls in the ocean of the terrific hell and remains there for a long time.

## \|\| 1.17.52 \|\|

*varṣakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam \|*  
*surajyeṣṭhaghṛtābhyaṃgāddahetsarvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The sins which are committed by a person in a thousand crores of years, they disappear instantaneously by applying ghi over the image of Brahma, without any doubt.

## \|\| 1.17.53 \|\|

*kalpakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam \|*  
*pitāmahaghṛtasnānaṃ dahatyagniriveṃdhanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Not only this, the sins which were committed in the thousand crores of kalpas, are also washed out with the bathing of the image of Brahma with ghi, in the same way as the fire bums the fuel.

## \|\| 1.17.54 \|\|

*ghṛtasnānaṃ pratipadi sakṛtkṛtvā tu kāṃjajam \|*  
*kulaikaviṃśamuttārya viṣṇuloke mahī yate \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. When the lotus born Brahma is even once bathed in ghi, a person redeems his twenty one generations and is adored in Vishnuloka.

## \|\| 1.17.55 \|\|

*ayutaṃ yo gavāṃ dadyādbhaktyā vai vedapārage \|*  
*vastrahemādiyuktānāṃ kṣīrasnānena yatphalam \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. By donating ten thousand cows decorated with cloths and ornaments with devotion to the Brahmanas who are well-versed in the Vedas, the extent of merit earned by him is the same which is earned by him after bathing lord Brahma with milk.

## \|\| 1.17.56 \|\|

*sakṛdājyena payasā snapayettu yaḥ \|*  
*gāṃgeyena sa yānena yāti brahmasalokatām \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. A person who bathes only once the image of Brahma with milk and ghi, he achieves Brahmaloka by Gangeya plane.

## \|\| 1.17.57 \|\|

*snāpya dadhnā sakṛdvīra kañjajaṃ viṣṇumāpnuyāt \|*  
*madhunā snapayitvā tu vīraloke mahīyate \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. O valorous one, when the lotus Brahma is only once bathed with curd by a person, he achieves Vishnu. In case, the said image is washed using the honey, he is adored in the Viraloka with decoration.

## \|\| 1.17.58 \|\|

*snānamikṣuraseneha yo viriṃceḥ samācaret \|*  
*sa yāti lokaṃ savitastu tejasā bhāsayannabhaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. A person who offers the bath to the image with sugarcane juice, he with his shining luster, illumining the sky, achieves the abode of Surya.

## \|\| 1.17.59 \|\|

*śuddhodakena yo bhaktyā snāpayetpadmasaṃbhavam \|*  
*utsṛjya pāpakalilaṃ sa yātyeva salokatām \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Similarly, when a person washes the image of Brahma with the pure and clean water with devotion, he getting relieved of the mud of sins, surely attains Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.60 \|\|

*vastrapūtena toyena snapayedyaḥ sakṛdvibhum \|*  
*sa sarvakālaṃ tṛptātmā lokavaśyatvamā pnuyāt \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. One who bathes the majestic lord Brahma with the water filtered with cloth, he always achieves satisfaction and attains the competence to overpower the world.

## \|\| 1.17.61 \|\|

*sarvauṣadhībhiryo bhaktyā snapayetpadmasaṃbhavam \|*  
*kāṃcanena vimānena brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. A person who washes the lotus born Brahma with the water mixed with aushadhis, he is worshipped in the Brahmaloka reaching there in the golden plane.

## \|\| 1.17.62 \|\|

*gandhacandanatoyena snāpayedyoṃbujodbhavam \|*  
*rudralokamavāpnoti tejasā hemasannibhaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. One who applies the fragrant material mixed with the sandalpaste over the image of Brahma with devotion, he, getting the grace of gold over his body, achieves Rudraloka.

## \|\| 1.17.63-64 \|\|

*pāṭalotpalapadmāni karavīrāṇi sarvadā \|*  
*snānakāle prayojyāni sthirāṇi surabhīṇi ca \|\| 63 \|\|*

*eṣāmekatamaṃ snānaṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā tu vedhasi \|*  
*vidhūya pāpakalilaṃ vidhiloke mahīyate \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. At the time of bathing the image of Brahma, the flowers of lotus, oleander and fragrant flowers should always be used. Keeping various articles before the image of Brahma, when a person bathes the image with anyone of them, then he getting relieved of all the sins, is respected in Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.65 \|\|

*karpūrāgarutoyena snapayedyastu kañjajam \|*  
*sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. A person who washes the image of Brahma with water mixed with camphor or aguru, he getting relieved of all the sins, becomes the spotless soul and is adored in the Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.66 \|\|

*gāyatrīśatajaptena vimalenāṃbhasā vibhum \|*  
*snapayitvā sakṛdbhaktyā brahmalokamavā pnuyāt \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. In case lord Brahma’s image is washed with the water sanctified with repeating of Gayatri mantra a hundred times, he achieves Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.17.67 \|\|

*vibhuṃ śītāṃbunā snāpya dhāroṣṇapayasā tataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ paścād ghṛtasnānaṃ kṛtvā pāpairvimucyate \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The image of lord Brahma should be washed first with the cool water, then with the warm milk, and then with the ghi and a person who does so, is relieved of all his sins.

## \|\| 1.17.68 \|\|

*etatsnānatrayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā tu bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. By extending all the three baths stated above, the image of Brahma should then be worshipped with devotion and by so doing, the performer achieves the merit of a thousand horse sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.17.69 \|\|

*mṛtkuṃbhaistāmrajaiḥ kuṃbhaiḥ snānaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*raupye lakṣottaraṃ proktaṃ haimaiḥ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. By bathing the images of Brahma with the water of earthen pitchers or the pitchers of copper, one achieves a hundred times more merit. With the use of the pitcher made of silver, one achieves the merit which is a lakh times greater than the earlier one. In case the pitchers of gold are used for the image, the merit of the same is enhanced a crore of times.

## \|\| 1.17.70 \|\|

*brahmaṇo darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanātsparśanaṃ param \|*  
*sparśanādarcanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ghṛtasnātamataḥ param \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Even otherwise, the very sight of the image of Brahma is immensely meritorious. But the touch of the image is more meritorious than the mere look from a distance.

## \|\| 1.17.71 \|\|

*vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ ghṛtasnānena dehinām \|*  
*kṣiṇute padmajo yasmāttasmātsnānaṃ samācaret \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The mental as well as the sins of the speech are removed by the lotus born Brahma, with his bath in ghi. Therefore, the glory of his bathing is fairly sung.

## \|\| 1.17.72-73 \|\|

*snapayitvārcayedbhaktyā yathā tacchṛṇu bhārata \|*  
*śucivastradharaḥ snātaḥ kṛtanyāsaśca bhārata \|\| 72 \|\|*

*caturhastaṃ likhetpadmaṃ caturbhāgavibhāgitam \|*  
*madhye tasya likheccakraṃ dalairdvādaśabhiścitam \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. O ruler of the race of Bharata, after bathing the image appropriately, Brahma should be adored appropriately. The way it is done, I am going to reveal it before you. You please listen. O the ruler born in the race of Bharata, first of all a person should himself take a bath and put on auspicious clothes. He should then perform the nyasa. Then he should make a lotus of four hands in size, which should remain divided on four parts. In the centre of that lotus, he should form a cakra with twelve petals.

## \|\| 1.17.74 \|\|

*sarojāni tato nyasya akṣarāṇi samantataḥ \|*  
*akṣaraṃ vihitaṃ cānyatpatrabhāge prakīrtitam \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. All round it, he should draw the following letters in the same. The letters which are to be shown there are as follows.

## \|\| 1.17.75 \|\|

*nānāvarṇakasaṃyogāllikheccaivānupūrvaśaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇotkaṭaṃ tu madhyaṃ syātpītaraktaṃ tathā param \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. They should be shown in a sequence appropriately, using different types of colours; out of those colours which are quite black, they should be used in the centre. The yellow and the red colour should be used in the middle and thereafter.

## \|\| 1.17.76 \|\|

*sitaṃ śuddhaṃ tu karttavyaṃ madhyabhāge tu vartulam \|*  
*prabhākuṇḍalakairbāhyairveṣṭayeccakranāyakam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The centre of it should be circular and has to be decorated with the white colour. Outwardly, it should be surrounded by the circular ring.

## \|\| 1.17.77 \|\|

*evamālikhya yatnena mūlamantraṃ tato nyaset \|*  
*mūrdhnaḥ pādatalaṃ yāvatpraṇavaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Thus making all the efforts, the illustration of the cakra should be drawn, and nyasa should be performed with the basic mantra of the limbs from head to the feet.

## \|\| 1.17.78 \|\|

*nādarūpaṃ nyasettāvadyāvacchabdasya śūnyatā \|*  
*tatkāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni sakāraṃ mukhamaṇḍale \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Thereafter, he should perform nyasa till the words get exhausted. Nyasa uttering Tat should be performed over the forehead. The Nyasa for Sakara should be made over the face.

## \|\| 1.17.79 \|\|

*vikāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu tukāraṃ sarvasaṃdhiṣu \|*  
*vakāraṃ hṛdi madhye tu rekāraṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. In the region of throat, nyasa of Vikara is performed. At all the points of joints, nyasa of Tukara should be performed. The nyasa of Vikara is performed at the heart. On both the back sides, nyasa of Rakara should be performed.

## \|\| 1.17.80 \|\|

*ṇakāraṃ dakṣiṇe kukṣau yakāraṃ vāmasaṃjñake \|*  
*bhakāraṃ kaṭinābhisthaṃ rgokāraṃ jānuparvasu \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. On the right side of the belly, nyasa of Nakara is performed. Similarly, on the left side of the belly, nyasa of Yakara should be done. On both the sides of the waist as well as the navel, nyasa of Bhakara should be done. At the joints of both the ankles, nyasa of Gokara should be performed.

## \|\| 1.17.81 \|\|

*dekāraṃ jaṃghayornyasya vakāraṃ pādapadmayoḥ \|*  
*syakāramaṃguṣṭhayornyasya dhīkāraṃ corasi nyaset \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. Similarly, in both the thighs, nyasa of Dakara should be done. At both the big toes, the nyasa of Syakara should be done. At the chest, nyasa of Dhikara should be done.

## \|\| 1.17.82 \|\|

*makāraṃ jānudeśe tu hikāraṃ guhyamāśritam \|*  
*dhikāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yokāraṃ cauṣṭhayo rnyaset \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. Over the knees, the nyasa of Makara should be done. In the secret parts, the nyasa of Hikara should be done. Similarly, nyasa of Dhikara should be done at heart. The nyasa of Yokara should be done at both the lips.

## \|\| 1.17.83 \|\|

*nakāraṃ nāsikāgre tu prakāraṃ netramāśritam \|*  
*cokāraṃ tu bhuvormadhye dakāraṃ prāṇamāśritam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. At the tip of the nose, the nyasa of Nakara should be done. In the eyes, nyasa of Prakara should be done. At the centre of the brows, nyasa of Chakara should be done. Then doing breathing, the spot nyasa should be performed.

## \|\| 1.17.84 \|\|

*yākāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni takāraṃ keśamāśritam \|*  
*nyāsaṃ kṛtvātmano dehe deve kuryāttathā nṛpa \|*  
*sarvopacārasaṃpannaṃ kṛtvā samyaṅ nirīkṣayet \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Again at the head, nyasa of Yakara should be done and in the hair, Takara nyasa should be done. O king, thus performing nyasa in the body, nyasa should also be performed in the body of the lord as well. Then decorating well all the limbs of the image, one should observe it carefully.

## \|\| 1.17.85 \|\|

*kuṃkumāgurukarpūra candanena vimiśritam \|*  
*gandhatoyamupaskṛtya gāyatryā praṇavena ca \|*  
*prokṣayetsarvadravyāṇi paścādarcanamācaret \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Reciting the Gayatri mantra and sprinkling the fragrant water in which aguru, camphor and sandal paste are present, the puja should be performed.

## \|\| 1.17.86-87 \|\|

*cakragranthiṣu sarvāsu praṇavaṃ viniveśayet \|*  
*bhūyaḥ plutaṃ samuccārya praṇavaṃ sarvatomukham \|\| 86 \|\|*

*vinyasetpadmamadhye tu pīṭhaniṣpattihetave \|*  
*āsane pṛthivī jñeyā sarvasattvadharā matā \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. The nyasa of Pranava should be done at all the joints of the cakra. Then a protracted sound recitation of Pranava should be done in all directions, and in the centre of the lotus, for the success of pitha, nyasa should be performed. The earth should be considered as taken to be a seat, who is believed to house all the living beings.

## \|\| 1.17.88 \|\|

*hrasvoṃkāre matā sā tu dīrghoṃkāre tu devarāṭ \|*  
*plutastu vyāpayedbhāvaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāmṛtātmakam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The earth is believed to be dwarfish in Omkara. In the vast Omkara, the power of Indra has been admitted. The short Omkara is bestower of moksha and pervades in the nectar like feelings.

## \|\| 1.17.89 \|\|

*yatnastho na nivarteta yogī prāṇaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣareṇa pareṇa tu \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The yogis who exercise control of the deep breath, should not get retired making all the efforts. Thereafter, uttering the supreme letter, he should invoke the deity.

## \|\| 1.17.90 \|\|

*āvāhya tejorūpaṃ tu nyasenmantravarāṃstataḥ \|*  
*tato vibhāvayeddevaṃ padmasthaṃ caturānanam \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Then after invoking the illustrious lord, he should perform nyasa with the excellent mantras. Then he should concentrate his mind over the four-faced Brahma seated over the lotus petals.

## \|\| 1.17.91 \|\|

*sraṣṭāraṃ sarvajagatāṃ viṣṇurudravidhānagam \|*  
*saṃbhāvya gandhapuṣpādi saṃbhārānkramātsarvānprakalpayet \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Brahma is creator of the entire mobile and immobile world, besides being the one who can surpass the provisions of Vishnu and Rudra. Thus after consecrating the lord with devotion, he should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.17.92 \|\|

*gandhapushpadisam bharanrkamat sarvanprakalpayet \|*  
*gāyatrīmuccaranmantraṃ sarvakarmāṇi kārayet \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. Then Brahma should be worshipped after collecting all the materials for puja. At that point of time, all the rites should be performed with the reciting of the mantras.

## \|\| 1.17.93-95 \|\|

*puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ tathā dīpaṃ naivedyaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*khaṃḍalaḍḍukaśrīveṣṭakāsārāśokavartikāḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*svastikollopikādugdhatilāveṣṭatilāḍhikāḥ \|*  
*phalāni caiva pakvāni lagnakhaṇḍaguḍāni ca \|\| 94 \|\|*

*anyāṃśca vividhāndadyātpūpāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*evamādīni sarvāṇi dāpayecachaktito nṛpa \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. The materials for worship include the flowers, incense, lamp, pleasant eatables, Shrikhanda, sweet balls, Shri Veshtakasara, Ashoka vartika, Svastikollopika, milk, sesamum, sweets, ripe fruits, sugar, sugarcane balls and the stuff made thereof. Besides these things, various types of other fruits should also be given away in charity, including several types of sweet cakes. O king, one should give away in charity all the things according to his means.

## \|\| 1.17.96 \|\|

*mūlamantreṇa devasya tato dehaṃ vibhāvayet \|*  
*pūjayeccāpi vidhinā yena taṃ te bravīmyaham \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Thereafter, reciting the basic mantras one should concentrate his attention over the image of the lord. The method of worship at that particular time is being told by me.

## \|\| 1.17.97 \|\|

*prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dehasaṃśodhanāya vai \|*  
*āvāhayettatonantaṃ dhārayantaṃ vacaḥ sadā \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. A person should perform pranayama thrice for the purification of his body. Then he should think of Brahma — the creator of the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.17.98 \|\|

*dhyātvānantaṃ tato rudraṃ padmakiṃjalkamadhyagam \|*  
*dhyāyedviṣṇuṃ tato devaṃ nyasetpadmodarodbhavam \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. After devoting one’s mind to Ananta, he should concentrate on Rudra lodged in the pericarp of the lotus. Thereafter, one should adore lord Vishnu as well. Thereafter, adoring lord Vishnu, one should perform nyasa for Brahma.

## \|\| 1.17.99 \|\|

*evaṃ tridevatārūḍhaṃ padmamadhyeṃbujodbhavam \|*  
*pūjayenmūlamantreṇa padmodarabhavaṃ nṛpa \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Thus Brahma should be adored seated in the centre of the lotus flanked by Vishnu and Rudra, reciting the basic mantra.

## \|\| 1.17.100 \|\|

*ṛgvedaṃ tu yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca pūjayet \|*  
*jñānavairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. O king, thereafter, one should worship Jnana, Vairagya, Aishvarya and Dharma, one should also adore the Rigveda, Yajurveda and Samaveda.

## \|\| 1.17.101-102 \|\|

*īśānādikramādrājanvidiśāsu samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca \|\| 101 \|\|*

*jyotiṣaṃ ca mahābāho upavedāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni yathāyogyaṃ yathākramam \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. Starting from the north-east direction, one should worship education, kalpa, grammar, nirukta, metres, astrology, and the other semi-Vedas, besides the Itihasa, Puranas etc. in due order.

## \|\| 1.17.103 \|\|

*śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ devasya purataḥ sadā \|*  
*kalpādayastataścānye diśāsu vidiśāsu ca \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Out of the above education, kalpa and Vyakarana should be placed before all the three gods, while kalpas and other items should be placed in the other directions.

## \|\| 1.17.104 \|\|

*mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ praṇavena samanvitāḥ \|*  
*pūrvādikramayogena pūjayedvidhinā nṛpa \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. O king, together with Pranava, all the Mahavyahritis (Bhu, Bhuva, Svaha) should be placed starting from the east, and should be adored.

## \|\| 1.17.105 \|\|
