*śaktayo brahmaṇastvetā lokarūpā vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena maṃtrarūpāḥ sthitāḥ svayam \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. These Mahavyahritis are the well-organized forces of the world. They should be worshipped making all the efforts. They are the real forces of Brahma appearing in the form of mantras.

## \|\| 1.17.106 \|\|

*arakāṃtarasaṃsthāṃśca ṣaṭ samudrānsamarcayet \|*  
*nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva rāśayaśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūjyāḥ sarve yathānyāyaṃ surāgreṣu vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. The six oceans lodged within the spokes of the wheel should also be adored. In the front part of the gods, the planets, constellations and signs of zodiac, should also be worshipped appropriately.

## \|\| 1.17.107 \|\|

*nāgāśca garuḍaścaiva pūjanīyastathāgrataḥ \|*  
*devatā ṛṣayaścaiva sahitāḥ kulaparvatāḥ \|*  
*tattejonilayāḥ sarve pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. The serpents and Garuda should also be worshipped in front of them. All the gods, Rishis and the mountains are the forms of the illustrious god. Therefore, they should all be worshipped making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.17.108 \|\|

*ācamya vidhivatpūrvaṃ maṃtrapūtena vāriṇā \|*  
*hṛdayādīnnyasedaṃgānhṛdayādiṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

108\. Performing the sipping with the water purified with mantra, nyasa of all the limbs like the heart etc. should be performed.

## \|\| 1.17.109 \|\|

*śikhā netraṃ tathā carma astraṃ ca bharatarṣabha \|*  
*maheṃdrādidiśaścaitāḥ pūjayedvidhivannṛpa \|\| 109 \|\|*

109\. Thereafter, the nyasa should be performed in respect of the eyes, head, skin and the weapons, and then adore the east and other directions.

## \|\| 1.17.110 \|\|

*hṛdayaṃ purataḥ pūjyaṃ śiro devasya pṛṣṭhataḥ \|*  
*pūrvaṃ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

110\. The region of the heart of the image of Brahma should be worshipped initially and then the head from the back.

## \|\| 1.17.111 \|\|

*visarjayeddarśayitvā mudrāṃ tu bharatarṣabha \|*  
*aṃkuśaṃ naraśārdūla hyāhvāne kaṃjamādiśet \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. O best of the race of Bharata, O lion among the humans! By invoking Brahma, a goad and a lotus have also been included.

## \|\| 1.17.112 \|\|

*yastvevaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ pratipannityameva ca \|*  
*upoṣya paṃcadaśyāṃ tu sa yāti paramaṃ padam \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. A person who on a full moon day observing the fast, always worships the lord on the day of Pratipada, be surely attains the supreme position.

## \|\| 1.17.113 \|\|

*sumaṃtu ruvāca \|*  
*āpo hiṣṭheti maṃtro'yaṃ hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*ṛtaṃ satyaṃ śikhā proktā udutyaṃ netramādiśet \|\| 113 \|\|*

113\. Sumantu said — The mantra “Apo hishtheti....” is meant for nyasa of the heart. “Ritam Satyam…” meant for the tuft. “Udutyam...” mantra is meant for the eyes.

## \|\| 1.17.114 \|\|

*citraṃ devānāṃ mastamiti sarvalokeṣu viśrutam \|*  
*varmaṇā te cchādayāmi kavacaṃ samudāhṛtam \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. “Chitram devanam...” is the mantra meant for the forehead, which is famous in all the lokas. Then, “Varmana tecchadayami…” is said to be the mantra kavacha.

## \|\| 1.17.115 \|\|

*bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti tathā śirase parikīrtitam \|*  
*gāyatrīmūlataṃtrastu sādhakaḥ sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. The mantra known as “Bhur bhuvah svah...” is meant for the head. The mantra bestows success in all the matters.

## \|\| 1.17.116 \|\|

*gāyatryā pūjayeddevamoṃkāreṇābhimaṃtritam \|*  
*praṇavenāparānsarvānṛgvedādīnprapūjayet \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. The Gayatri mantra inclusive of Omkara is used for the worship of the gods. The Rigveda and others, should be adored by Pranava alone.

## \|\| 1.17.117 \|\|

*āhvāne pūjane vīra visarge brahmaṇastathā \|*  
*gāyatrī paramo maṃtro vedamātā vibhāvinī \|\| 117 \|\|*

117\. O valorous one, in the invocation, worship and sending off, the extremely beneficial Gayatri has been considered to be extremely auspicious and the foremost, besides being the bestower of the merits.

## \|\| 1.17.118 \|\|

*gāyatryakṣaratattvaistu pūjayedyastu devatām \|*  
*sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ yaddurā sadam \|\| 118 \|\|*

118\. A person who adores the gods reciting the Gayatri mantra, achieves the excellent place which is extremely difficult to achieve.

## Chapter 18. The end of Pratipada Kalpa

## \|\| 1.18.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*paurṇamāsyupavāsaṃ tu kṛtvā bhaktyā narādhipa \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu viriñciṃ pūjayennaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O great monarch, a person who perform fasting as per the above method on the full moon day, and adores Brahma on the day of Pratipada, he certainly achieves the Brahmapada.

## \|\| 1.18.2 \|\|

*pratipadyāṃ mahābāho sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|*  
*ṛgbhirviśeṣato 1 devī viriñcervāstudevatāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The goddess of Viranchi should be worshipped with the reciting of the Vedic Richas, since she has been described to be the household deity.

## \|\| 1.18.3 \|\|

*kārttike māsi devasya rathayātrā prakīrtitā \|*  
*yāṃ kṛtvā mānavo bhaktyā yāti brahmasalokatām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. During the month of Karttika, the chariot festival of the Deva has been praised. A person who performs the same, he achieves the Salokya devotion of the lord.

## \|\| 1.18.4-5 \|\|

*kārtike māsi rājendra paurṇamāsyāṃ caturmukham \|*  
*mārgeṇa carmaṇā sārdhaṃ sāvitryā ca parantapa \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhrāmayennagaraṃ sarvaṃ nānāvādyaiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*sthāpayed bhrāmayitvā tu salokaṃ nagaraṃ nṛpa \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. O Rajendra, on the full moon day of the month of Karttika, a person should consecrate Brahma with Savitri over the deer skin. Then placing it over the chariot, bath of them should be carried in a procession with the dancing and music and taken out through the city. The image should then be made to be consecrated at a particular place.

## \|\| 1.18.6 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayityāgre śāṃḍileyaṃ prapūjya ca \|*  
*āropayedrathe devaṃ puṇyavāditranisvanaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A Brahmana of Shandilya gotra should be appropriately worshipped and then he should be well served with the food. After worshipping the images, they should again be placed over the chariot and should remain awake during the night.

## \|\| 1.18.7-9 \|\|

*rathāgre śāṃḍilīputraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṃgalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*devamāropayitvā tu rathe kuryātprajāgaram \|*  
*nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakairbrahmaghoṣaiśca puṣkalaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*rathopari ṭippaṇī \|*  
*kṛtvā prajāgaraṃ hyevaṃ prabhāte brāhmaṇaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā bhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. During the night, the reciting of the Vedas should continue with musical feats. In the morning, the Brahmana should again be adored and then satisfied offering him food, clothes and ornaments as per the means of the devotee.

## \|\| 1.18.10 \|\|

*pūjayitvā janaṃ2 vīra vajreṇa vidhivannṛpa \|*  
*bījena ca mahābāho payasā pāyasena ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O king! Thereafter, the Brahmana should be presented with the offering of the clothes. He should then be presented with milk and milk products.

## \|\| 1.18.11 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca cchāṃdena vidhinā nṛpa \|*  
*kṛtvā puṇyāhaśabdaṃ ca rathaṃ ca bhrāmayetpure \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O king! Then the Brahmanas should be made to recite the Vedas as per the prescribed procedure and the chariot should again be made to move.

## \|\| 1.18.12 \|\|

*caturvedavidairviprairbhrāmayedbrahmaṇo ratham \|*  
*bahvṛcātharvaṇoccāraiśchandogādhvaryubhistathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The chariot should be made to move with the Brahmanas who are well-versed in all the four Vedas. They should include Bahvricha, Atharvana, Chandogya and Adhvaryu. They should all be there.

## \|\| 1.18.13 \|\|

*bhrāmayeddevadevasya surajyeṣṭhasya taṃ ratham \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ puraṃ sarvaṃ mārgeṇa susamena tu \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The chariot should be taken round the entire city with the highly placed Brahmanas, moving through the plain and beautiful roads, around the city.

## \|\| 1.18.14 \|\|

*na voḍhavyo ratho vīra śūdreṇa śubhamicchatā \|*  
*nāruheta rathaṃ prājño muktvaikaṃ bhojakaṃ nṛpa \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O valorous one, the people desirous of welfare, should not have the chariot driven by the Shudras. O ruler, besides the entertained Brahmanas, no one also should be made to be seated in the chariot.

## \|\| 1.18.15 \|\|

*brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe pārśve sāvitrīṃ sthāpayennṛpa \|*  
*bhojako vāmapārśve tu purataḥ kañjajaṃ nyaset \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O king, Savitri should be lodged to the right of Brahma. The Bhojaka Brahmana should be lodged to the left. Brahma should be lodged in the forefront.

## \|\| 1.18.16 \|\|

*evaṃ tūryaninādaistu śaṃkhaśabdaiśca puṣkalaiḥ \|*  
*bhrāmayitvā rathaṃ rājanpuraṃ sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*svasthāne sthāpayedbhūyaḥ kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The trumpet and other beautiful musical instruments should be played upon besides the playing of conches. The circumbulation should be completed, after which images should be established at their original place.

## \|\| 1.18.17 \|\|

*ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ bhaktyā yaścāpi paśyati \|*  
*rathaṃ cākarṣate yastu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person who performs such a ratha yatra, or witnesses it with devotion, he surely achieves the position of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.18.18 \|\|

*kārtike māsyamāvāsyāṃ yastu dīpapradīpanam \|*  
*śālāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kuryātsa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. On the moonless day of the month of Karttika if a person lights a lamp in the temple of Brahma, he achieves the Brahmapada.

## \|\| 1.18.19 \|\|

*pratipadi brāhmaṇāṃścāpi guḍamiśraiḥ pradīpakaiḥ \|*  
*vāsobhirahataiścāpi sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Similarly, on the Pratipada of the month of Karttika when a person gives in charity the lamp with food comprising of the sugarcane cakes, besides the new clothes to a Brahmana, he also attains the Brahmapada.

## \|\| 1.18.20 \|\|

*gaṃdhaipuṣpairnavairvastrairātmānaṃ 1 pūjayecca yaḥ \|*  
*tasyāṃ pratipadāyāṃ tu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On the same tithi of Pratipada, a person who uses for himself the fragrant flowers and the new clothes, he also achieves the place of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.18.21 \|\|

*mahāpuṇyā tithiriyaṃ balirājyapravartinī \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ supriyā nityaṃ bāleyā parikīrtitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The tithi of Pratipada is quite auspicious and meritorious and is the bestower of the kingdom to the Daitya king Bali. It is the favourite tithi of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.18.22 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānpūjayitvāsyāmātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A person who on this particular tithi adores a Brahmana and himself, he achieves the illustrious lord Vishnu’s place.

## \|\| 1.18.23-24 \|\|

*caitre māsi mahābāho puṇyā pratipadā parā \|*  
*tasyāṃ yaḥ śvapacaṃ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ kuryānnarottama \|\| 23 \|\|*

*na tasya duritaṃ kiñcinnādhayo vyādhayo nṛpa \|*  
*bhavanti kuruśārdūla tasmātsnānaṃ pravartayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. O valorous king, the Pratipada tithi of the month of Chaitra is also quite meritorious. On that particular day, if a person, after coming in contact with a Chandala simply takes a bath, he gets freed from all the sins and attracts no ailment. O lion of the Kuru race, one should therefore must take his bath on the said date.

## \|\| 1.18.25-26 \|\|

*divyaṃ nīrājanaṃ taddhi sarvarogavināśanam \|*  
*gomahiṣyādi yatkiṃcittatsarvaṃ bhūṣayennṛpa \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tailaśastrādibhirvastrastoraṇādhastato nayet \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā bhojyaṃ kuryātkurukulodvaha \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. He attains divinity and is relieved of all the ailments. O king, on the aforesaid auspicious tithi, cows or the buffaloes should be well decorated with oil and ornaments and should be made to pass through an arched gateway. O ruler born in the race of Kuru, at that point of time, food should be properly served to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.18.27-28 \|\|

*tisro hyetāḥ parāḥ proktāstithayaḥ kurunandana \|*  
*kārttikeśvayuje māsi caitre māse ca bhārata \|\| 27 \|\|*

*snānaṃ dānaṃ śataguṇaṃ kārttike yā tithirnṛpa \|*  
*balirājyāptisukhadā pāṃśulāśubhanāśinī \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. O son of the race of Kuru, the aforesaid three tithis of Ashvina, Karttika as well as the month of Chaitra, are considered to be the best of all, but O Bharata, out of these the tithi of Karttika bestows hundred times more merit than others. This auspicious day of the month of Karttika is the one which bestows the kingdom back to the king Bali. It removes inauspiciousness.

## Chapter 19. The story of Sharyati and description of Pushpa Dvitiya

## \|\| 1.19.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*dvitīyāyāṃ tu rājendra aśvinau somapītinau \|*  
*cyavanena kṛtau yajñe miṣato maghavasya1 ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O Rajendra, it was on the Dvitiya tithi that cheating Devaraja Indra, both the Ashvinikumaras had consumed the Soma juice in the sacrifice of Chyavana.

## \|\| 1.19.2-3 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*kathamindrasya miṣataḥ kṛtau tau somapītinau \|*  
*cyavanena hi devānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadvadasva me \|\| 2 \|\|*

*aho mahattapastasya cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*yadindrasya balādeva devatvaṃ prāpitāvubhau \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Shatanika said — O Brahmana, how did the Ashvinikumaras, in the yajna of Chyavana, consumed Soma cheating Indra? The Maharishi Chyavana possessed the enormous strength of his tapas, who inspite of so powerful Indra, made Ashvinikumaras to consume Soma resulting them in their achieving of the godhood.

## \|\| 1.19.4 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*purātanayuge sandhau paścime'tha narādhipa \|*  
*cyavano yogamāsthāya gaṃgākūle'vasacciram \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Sumantu said — O great ruler, at the flag end of the ancient yuga, Chyavana was engaged in the practicing of the yoga and stayed at the bank of Ganga for a long time.

## \|\| 1.19.5 \|\|

*tatra śaryātirāyātaḥ snātumantaḥ1 puraiḥ saha \|*  
*snātvābhyarcya2 pitṝndevāngamanāyopacakrame \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The king Sharyati, together with his queens, once arrived there to have a bath in the sacred water of the Gangs. After taking his bath, the king adored the gods and the manes. Thereafter, he got ready for returning to his abode.

## \|\| 1.19.6-7 \|\|

*tatra mūḍhaṃ janapadamapaśyatpathi ceṣṭanam \|*  
*viṇmūtrotsargasaṃruddhaṃ jyotirākṣiptaniṣkriyam \|*  
*bhramantaṃ tatratatraiva samīkṣya sa balaṃ nṛpaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*uvāca3 durmanā rājā amātyānsvānpurogamān \|*  
*cyavanasyāśramo'yaṃ hi nāparāddhaṃ tu kenacit \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. At the same time, he found a habitation there and discovered that his entire army was in an unconscious state. All of them were only a little conscious. All of them were lying motionless. All of them had become inactive with a flame of fire. The upset army has armlets wandering here and there. Finding his army in such a precarious condition, the king spoke to his chief ministers with a heavy heart about the auspicious hermitage of the sage Chyavana. “Has anyone committed some sins at this place?”

## \|\| 1.19.8 \|\|

*na covāca yadā kaścittasya rājñastu pṛcchataḥ \|*  
*tadā sutā sukanyāsya provāca pitaraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. When so questioned by the king, no one was able to give an answer, then Sukanya — his own daughter, said to her father.

## \|\| 1.19.9 \|\|

*mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tu yattāta sakhibhiḥ saha kautukam \|*  
*tatte vacmi nibodha tvaṃ śṛṇu tāta mahādbhutam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O father, I have witnessed a wonder, which I am going to narrate to you. Indeed it is a wonderful scene.

## \|\| 1.19.10 \|\|

*śiñjitārāvabahulāḥ kāñcīnūpuramekhalāḥ \|*  
*gāyantyo vilapantyaśca kīḍantyaścātra kānane \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. I have seen many damsels adorned with various ornaments, like waistbands, anklets, issuing sweet sounds. They were indulging in excessive talks, while engaged in the various types of sports.

## \|\| 1.19.11 \|\|

*kokiladhvanimaśrauṣaṃ vyaktāvyaktākṣaraṃ kṛśam \|*  
*sukanye hyehihyehīti valmīkādvacamudgiran \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. I have heard the sweet voice of the cuckoo. At the same time, I heard a voice from a round of crest, saying — “O Sukanya, come here, come here.” Thus a partly clear and partly unclear sound was heard by me.

## \|\| 1.19.12 \|\|

*tatra gatvādbhutaṃ tāta paśyāmaḥ kila pāvakau \|*  
*dīpāvivācalaśikhau bhūyaḥ kanyā uvāca ha \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O father, going through the round of white crest, I found two flames, burning like lamps. They were burning without wavering, static and resembled a two lamps.

## \|\| 1.19.13 \|\|

*mayā ca kautukāttāta kimetadityabuddhitaḥ \|*  
*sūditau darbhasūcyagraistattejaḥ samupāramat \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Looking at them, in my anxiety as to what they were and out of my foolishness, I rubbed them with the tip of the grass. As a result of this, the flames got extinguished.

## \|\| 1.19.14 \|\|

*tacchrutvā nṛpatistrastastūrṇaṃ tadvanamāgamat \|*  
*yatrāste bhārgavaḥ kaṣṭaṃ valmīkāntargato muniḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Hearing the words of Sukanya, the king felt frightened. He at once went to that place and found the sage Chyavana of Bhargava race, who was seated in a painful situation.

## \|\| 1.19.15 \|\|

*gatvā sa tatra provāca praṇipatya dvijottamam \|*  
*aparāddhaṃ mayā 1 deva tatkṣamasva namo'stu te \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Reaching there, the king offered his salutation to the sage Chyavana and prayed to him — “O Deva, I have committed a grace sin. You kindly forgive me. I offer my salutation to you.”

## \|\| 1.19.16 \|\|

*sa taṃ provāca nṛpatiṃ mayā jñātaṃ narādhipa \|*  
*sukanyāṃ me prayacchasva niveśārthī2 hyahaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*anukramansukanyāṃ tu dattvā rājansukhī bhava \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Chyavana then said to the king Sharyati — “O king, I am aware of your sin. You give me Sukanya — your daughter, to me because now I intend to stay at home. In order to free yourself of the sin, in case you give away your daughter Sukanya to me then you will feel comfortable.”

## \|\| 1.19.17 \|\|

*ityuktaḥ pradadau rājā sukanyāmavicārayan \|*  
*tataḥ svapuramāgamya avasatsuciraṃ sukhī \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. At these words of the sage Chyavana, the king Sharyati gave away his daughter Sukanya to Chyavana, without any thought. Thereafter, he returned to his place and ruled the country for long, with comfort.

## \|\| 1.19.18 \|\|

*sukanyāpi patiṃ labdhvā suprītārādhayattadā \|*  
*rājyaśriyaṃ parityajya valkalājinadhāriṇī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Sukanya on the other hand, by getting Chyavana as her husband, adored him delightfully. She discarded the royal costumes and ornaments and clad herself in the bark garments or the dear skin.

## \|\| 1.19.19 \|\|

*gate bahutithe kāle vasante samupasthite \|*  
*tapodyotitasarvāṅgīṃ rūpodāryaguṇānvitām \|*  
*snātāṃ svabhāryāṃ cyavana uvāca madhurākṣaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. In this way, a long time passed and the pleasant spring season arrived. At that astonishing time, because of the performing of the tapas by Sukanya, the beauty of her limbs had increased. She looked graceful because of her broad mindedness, excellent beauty and virtues. Getting free from the monthly bath, she went to her husband who spoke to her in sweet voice.

## \|\| 1.19.20 \|\|

*ehyehi bhadre bhadraṃ te śayanīyaṃ samāśraya \|*  
*apatyaṃ janayasyādya kuladvayavivardhanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. “O fortunate one, come here and sleep with me over the bed, You will meet with welfare. You produce from me the progeny, to increase the grace of both the races.”

## \|\| 1.19.21 \|\|

*evamuktā tu sā kanyā prāñjaliḥ patimabravīt \|*  
*3 nārhasyadya sukalyāṇa saṅgamaṃ sthaṇḍile'same \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. At the insistence of Chyavana, she spoke to him with folded hands — “O lord of welfare, it would not be proper for us to unite here over the high round.

## \|\| 1.19.22 \|\|

*mama priyaṃ kuruṣvādya tato māmāhvayasva ca \|*  
*pitṛgehe yathātiṣṭhaṃ śayanīye susaṃskṛte \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. First of all you fulfil my desire and then call me. You make for me the beautiful bed, the type of which was used by me in my parental home.

## \|\| 1.19.23-24 \|\|

*bahugairikavarṇādyaiḥ śvetapītāruṇākule \|*  
*vastrālaṅkāragandhādyaistathā tvamapi tatkuru \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ vayasopetaṃ rūpavantaṃ suvarcasam \|*  
*vastrālaṅkāragandhāḍhyaṃ paśyeyaṃ yena sādaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. My bed in my parental home was decorated with different colours like white, green, red and yellow. It was also decorated with various silk garments and ornaments. You get a bed of chat type made for me. Let me find you in the comparable youthful age, possessing the beauty, decorated with ornaments and the fragrant materials, quite gracefully.”

## \|\| 1.19.25 \|\|

*sukanyāyā vacaḥ śrutvā cyavanaḥ prāha durmanāḥ \|*  
*na me'sti vittaṃ kalyāṇi pituste'sti yathā vane \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. On heating the words of Sukanya, Chyavana spoke with a hurt mind— “O virtuous one, I have no riches in this forest, as is possessed by your father.

## \|\| 1.19.26 \|\|

*sa kathaṃ bhūṣayāmyadya surūpaśca kathaṃ vada \|*  
*provāca sā patiṃ bhūyaḥ prahasantī kṛtāñjaliḥ \|*  
*vittaṃ dadāvailavilo rūpaṃ vairocano'dadat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Then how could the same materials be procured in the forest? And how could I decorate the bed with those materials besides myself? Not only this, how could I become beautiful. You tell me a way out.” At these words of the husband, Sukanya again spoke to Chyavana, with folded hands — “O adorable one, Elabila in earlier times had given in charity the glory of his charity, while Bali — the son of Virochana, had given his beauty in charity.”

## \|\| 1.19.27 \|\|

*cyavanaḥ prāha bhāryāṃ tāṃ na kariṣye tapovyayam \|*  
*evamuktvā tapaścograṃ tatāpa suciraṃ tadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. At this, Chyavana said to his wife Sukanya — “O auspicious one, your words are true. But I shall not be able to spend my tapas for this purpose” At these words of her husband, Sukanya also performed tapas for a long time.

## \|\| 1.19.28 \|\|

*atha tatrāgatau vīrāvaśvinau kālaparyayāt \|*  
*dṛṣṭavantau sukanyāṃ tau dīptyā vai devatāmiva \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. After the lapse of a long period, (having been pleased with her severe tapas), both the valorous Ashvinikumaras reached there and found the Sukanya with divine beauty.

## \|\| 1.19.29 \|\|

*upagamyocatustāṃ tau kā tvaṃ sundari rūpiṇī \|*  
*kimarthamiha ekā tvaṃ tiṣṭhase kastavāśrayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Reaching closer to her, they asked her — “O beautiful one, who are you? What for are you staying here alone? Who is your support?”

## \|\| 1.19.30 \|\|

*sā tāvuvāca tanvaṅgī śaryātiduhitā hyaham \|*  
*bhartā ca cyavano mahyaṃ kau ca vāṃ me tathocyatām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. In reply to the question of Ashvinikumaras, Sukanya said — “O Prince! I am the daughter of royal seer Sharyati, My husband Chyavana is adorable for me. Who are both of you. You kindly tell me.”

## \|\| 1.19.31 \|\|

*ūcatuścāśvinau devāvāvāṃ viddhi nṛpātmaje \|*  
*kiṃ kariṣyasi tena tvaṃ jīrṇena ca kṛśena ca \|*  
*āvayorvṛṇu bhartāramekameva yamicchasi \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. When so questioned by Sukanya, the Ashvinikumaras said — “O princess, you take us to be Ashvinikumaras. What shall you do with a weak, ugly and old husband? You accept either one of us as your husband.”

## \|\| 1.19.32 \|\|

*sā tvabravīcca mā maivaṃ vaktumarhau divaukasau \|*  
*bhartāramanuraktāṅgī yathā svāhā vibhāvasoḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Hearing the words of Ashvinikumaras, Sukanya said — “Both of you being the gods, should not speak like this. I am devoted at the feet of my husband in the same way as Svaha is devoted to the god of fire.”

## \|\| 1.19.33 \|\|

*aśvināvūcatuḥ \|*  
*āyātu ca viśatvadya cyavano vaiṣṇavījalam \|*  
*tato nau madhyagaṃ hyekaṃ vṛṇīṣvānyaṃ yamicchati \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The Ashvinikumaras said — “First of all it should be done that Chyavana should come here and have a dip in the sacred water of Ganga. Then you should select anyone of us as your husband.”

## \|\| 1.19.34 \|\|

*tāvabrūtāṃ sukanyāṃ tu gatvā pṛccha svakaṃ patim \|*  
*taṃ ca pṛṣṭvā punaścātrāgaccha nau sannidhau punaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Both of them again said to her — “You first go and ask your husband about it and inform whatever he tells you.

## \|\| 1.19.35 \|\|

*āvāmatraiva tiṣṭhāvo yāvadāgamanaṃ tava \|*  
*sā gatvā prāha bhartāramaśvināvevasūcatuḥ 1 \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Till your return, we shall wait for you here.” Hearing the words of Ashvinikumaras, Sukanya went to her husband and reported the matter to him.

## \|\| 1.19.36 \|\|

*rūpavantaṃ ca bhartāraṃ kariṣyāvo yamicchasi \|*  
*atha madhyagataṃ hyekaṃ bhartṛtvena variṣyasi \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. They say that they would turn my husband extremely beautiful and I shall have to select anyone of three as my husband.

## \|\| 1.19.37 \|\|

*evamastviti tāṃ prāha bhāryāṃ cyavanastvaran \|*  
*sā taṃ gṛhya jagāmāśu yatra tau bhiṣajāvubhau \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Listening to the words of Sukanya, Chyavana at once said to her — “This is perfectly well. Do as they want you to do.” When Chyavana expressed his willingness, Sukanya together with her husband, went to that place where Ashvinikumaras were waiting for her.

## \|\| 1.19.38 \|\|

*sā tāvuvāca cyavano yathoktaṃ bhavatorvacaḥ \|*  
*kurutaṃ hyaśvinau kṣipraṃ sukanyā cepsitaṃ2 vṛṇot \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. On reaching that place, the sage Chyavana said to Ashvinikumaras — “O physicians of the gods, as you have spoken to Sukanya, you at once fulfil your words. Then Sukanya would select anyone of us as her husband.”

## \|\| 1.19.39 \|\|

*tau taṃ saṅgṛhya gaṅgāyāṃ praviṣṭau muninā saha \|*  
*muhūrtāttu samuttiṣṭhanrūpataśca śriyā vṛtāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. At these words of Chyavana, both the Ashvinikumaras together with Chyavana, entered the water of Ganga. Soon thereafter, they emerged out of the water.

## \|\| 1.19.40 \|\|

*śobhante sma mahābāhau kamudbhidya tapoyutāḥ \|*  
*kalpādau kalaśe yadvatkañjākṣa vyoma vedhasaḥ \|*  
*udakādutthitāstasmātsarve te samarūpakāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. After this, all the three of them looked as spotless and graceful as at the time of the start of a kalpa the sky reflects in the kamandalu of Brahmana. When they emerged out of water, all of them had similar bodies.

## \|\| 1.19.41 \|\|

*sukanyā tu tato dṛṣṭvā bharttāraṃ devarūpiṇam \|*  
*harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā na ca taṃ veda bhārata \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O king born in the race of Bharata, finding her husband having been turned in a divine form, Sukanya became happy no doubt, but she could not recognize him.

## \|\| 1.19.42 \|\|

*samakāyāḥ samavayaḥ samarūpāḥ samaśriyaḥ \|*  
*vastrālaṅkārasadṛśāndṛṣṭvā cintāṃ gatā ciram \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. It was because all the three of them had similar bodies and were of similar age and lustre. Not only this, their costumes and ornaments were also alike. Thus finding them in this condition, Sukanya got worried and anxious for a while.

## \|\| 1.19.43 \|\|

*sā cintayitvā suciraṃ vaidyadevāvuvāca ha \|*  
*bībhatso'pi mayā bhartā parityakto na karhicit \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. After thinking over the matter for a long time, when she could find no other alternative, she said — “O physicians of the gods, you are well aware that I had never discarded my terrific and ailing husband even for a moment.

## \|\| 1.19.44 \|\|

*bhavadbhirātmasaṃdṛśaṃ kathaṃ1 tyaktvā vṛṇe param \|*  
*tasmāttameva bhartāraṃ prayacchadhvaṃ divaukasaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Then how can I leave him, when he has been turned as beautiful as you are? Therefore, both of you should give back my husband to me.”

## \|\| 1.19.45 \|\|

*tayā sabahumānaṃ tau prāñjalyā prārthitau tadā \|*  
*devacihnāni svānyeva dhārayantau supūjitau \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. When Sukanya so prayed to Ashvinikumaras with folded hands, both the physicians of the gods took to their own divine forms.

## \|\| 1.19.46 \|\|

*sukanyā nipuṇaṃ tau tu sunirīkṣya ca vihvalā \|*  
*na rajo na nimeṣo vai na spṛśete dharāṃ pade \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Sukanya, who was in doubt about her real husband, carefully looked at all the three of them and found that both the divine physicians’ bodies had no dust on them, nor their eyelids were falling. Their feet were also not touching the earth.

## \|\| 1.19.47 \|\|

*ayaṃ ca sarajā mlāno bhūmimāśritya tiṣṭhati \|*  
*nimeṣaṃ caiva tasyaivaṃ jñātvā vai cyavano vṛtaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Her husband was seated there covered with dust and his eyelids were also twinkling. Then after fully recognizing her husband, she selected Chyavana.

## \|\| 1.19.48 \|\|

*cyavane vṛte sukanyayā puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha \|*  
*devadundubhayaścaiva prāvādyanta anekaśaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. At the time of selection of Chyavana by Sukanya, there was a rain of flowers from the sky and the gods played the musical instruments.

## \|\| 1.19.49 \|\|

*tatastu cyavanastuṣṭo divyarūpadharastadā \|*  
*uvāca tau tu suprīta aśvinau kiṃ karomi vām \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thereafter, Chyavana, having been completely satisfied, spoke to both the divine physicians — “O Ashvinikumaras, I am extremely pleased with you. Tell me what should I do for you now?

## \|\| 1.19.50-52 \|\|

*bhāryā dattā kṛtaṃ rūpaṃ devānāmapi durlabham \|*  
*upakāraṃ variṣṭhaṃ yo na karotyupakāriṇaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*ekaviṃśatsa gacchecca narakāṇi krameṇa vai \|*  
*tasmādahaṃ variṣṭhaṃ vai kariṣye'hamamānuṣam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*upakāraṃ bhavadbhyāṃ tu prītaḥ kuryāṃ suniścitam \|*  
*yajñabhāgaphalaṃ dadyāṃ yaddeveṣvapi durlabham \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Because of you I have got back my virtuous wife, besides this divine beauty. A person who does not do good to a person who has done good to him, he in due course of time falls in the hell with twenty one generations. Therefore, getting pleased with the favour done by you, I would also like to render some enormous service to you, which would be beyond the reach of an ordinary person. This is my firm opinion. Because of this benefit which has been extended by you, I shall make you entitled to receive a share in the yajna, which is difficult even for the gods to achieve.”

## \|\| 1.19.53 \|\|

*evamuktvā tu deveśau visasarja mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*ājagāmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sahabhāryo mudānvitaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus bestowing a boon on them, the great sage Chyavana gave away farewell to both the divine physicians and he himself getting delighted, returned to his auspicious abode.

## \|\| 1.19.54 \|\|

*atha śuśrāva śaryātiścyavanaṃ devarūpiṇam \|*  
*jagāma ca mahātejā draṣṭuṃ munivaraṃ vaśī \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. After the lapse of sometime, the king Sharyati who had controlled all his sense organs, came to know about Chyavana’s receiving the divine body and he then reached the hermitage of the sage Chyavana.

## \|\| 1.19.55 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇipatyādau pratipūjya yathārhataḥ \|*  
*sukanyāṃ tu tato dṛṣṭvā praṇipatyābhinandya ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Initially finding that Chyavana had attained the divine form, the king offered his salutation to him and honoured him with due adoration. Then he honoured his daughter Sukanya touching her feet.

## \|\| 1.19.56 \|\|

*sasvaje mūrdhni āghrāya tatotsaṅgaṃ 1 samānayat \|*  
*sā tasyāḥ sasvaje premṇā ānandāśrupariplutā \|*  
*saṃsthāpya tāṃ mudā yukto nṛpatiḥ saha bhāryayā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. At that point of time, the king Sharyati embraced Sukanya with utmost affection, smelling her head, lifting her up in his lap. Similarly, the mother of Sukanya, with her eyes filled with tears, lifted her in her lap affectionately. After sometime, the king overwhelmed with affection, made Sukanya sit by his side.

## \|\| 1.19.57 \|\|

*bhūyo'bravītsusaṃtuṣṭaṃ cyavanastaṃ narādhipam \|*  
*saṃbhāraṃ kuru yajñārthaṃ yājayiṣye narādhipa \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Thereafter, the completely satisfied sage Chyavana said to the king — “O lord of people, you better start a yajna. I shall make you perform Yajna.”

## \|\| 1.19.58 \|\|

*evamuktaḥ sa nṛpatiḥ praṇipatya mahāmunim \|*  
*jagāma svapuraṃ hṛṣṭo yajñārthaṃ yatnamācarat \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Listening to the words of Chyavana, the king Sharyati paid his tribute with folded hands, delightfully. Thereafter, he returned to the kingdom. Reaching his capital city, the king started action for the performing of the yajna.

## \|\| 1.19.59 \|\|

*sapreṣyānpreṣayankṣipraṃ yajñārthe dravyamāharat \|*  
*maṃtripurohitācāryānānayāmāsa satvaram \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He sent the servants in all the directions, for collecting the required materials. Enough of money required for the yajna was earmarked from the royal treasure. Thereafter, the ministers, priests, Acharyas and others were summoned in the court of the king.

## \|\| 1.19.60 \|\|

*samānīteṣu sarveṣu teṣu dravyeṣu bhārata \|*  
*ājagāma viśuddhātmā cyavanaḥ saha bhāryayā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. O king born in the race of Bharata, after collection of all the materials for the performing of the yajna, Chyavana — the auspicious soul, together with his wife arrived in the city of Sharyati.

## \|\| 1.19.61 \|\|

*sampūjitaśca śuśrāva mahāntaṃ tyāgamaujasam \|*  
*anyaiśca bahubhiḥ sārddhamatryaṅgirasabhārgavaiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. At that point of time, the great sages like Atri, Angiras and Bhargava were also there. The king Sharyati welcomed them all gracefully. The sage Chyavana heard the talk about renunciation, devotion and greatness of the king Sharyati. The great yajna was started thereafter.

## \|\| 1.19.62 \|\|

*pravartite mahāyajñe yajamāne nṛpottame \|*  
*ṛtviktvakarmanirate hūyamāne hutāśane \|*  
*āhūtāḥ svāgatāḥ sarve bhāgārthaṃ tridivālayāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Then Sharyati — the best of the rulers, occupied the seat of a yajamana in the yajna. The other Brahmanas were engaged in their respective duties. The offerings were dropped in the fire. All the gods from the heaven reached there in order to receive their respective share in the yajna.

## \|\| 1.19.63 \|\|

*yajñabhāge pravṛtte tu śāstroktena vidhānataḥ \|*  
*āgatāvaśvinau tatra āhūto cyavanena tu \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Offering their shares in an appropriate manner, Chyavana — the great sage, also earmarked the shares of Ashvinikumaras who also arrived there duly invited.

## \|\| 1.19.64 \|\|

*āhvāne kriyamāṇe tu aśvibhyāṃ tu tadā nṛpa \|*  
*provācendro'tha cyavanaṃ naitau bhāgānvitau kuru \|*  
*devānāṃ bhiṣajāvetau na bhāgārhau na daivatau \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. When Indra found that Chyavana had also invited Ashvinikumaras in the yajna, he said to Chyavana — “Don’t allow both of them to take part in the yajna, because they happen to be the physicians of the gods. They are not the gods. Therefore, they are not allowed to participate in the yajna.”

## \|\| 1.19.65 \|\|

*cyavanastviṃdramāhedaṃ devau hyetāvubhāvapi \|*  
*mamopakāriṇāvetau dadmi bhāgaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. On hearing the words of Indra, Chyavana said — ‘O lord of gods, both of them are also the gods. They have immensely benefitted us. I shall surely give them the share in the yajna.”

## \|\| 1.19.66 \|\|

*tato hyuvāca sakrodhaḥ sa śakraścyavanaṃ ruṣā \|*  
*viprarṣe prahariṣyāmi yadi bhāgaṃ prayacchasi \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Hearing the firm talk of Chyavana, Indra spoke in anger— “O Chyavana, O Brahmarishi, in case you give them the share, then you take it for granted that it shall surely attack you by other means.”

## \|\| 1.19.67 \|\|

*evamuktastu viprarṣirna covācāpi kiñcana \|*  
*bhāgau dadau ca so'śvibhyāṃ sruvamudyamya mantrataḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Even after hearing the words (of threat) from Indra, Chyavana kept quiet He kept totally silent. He continued the recitation of the mantras and took up his sacrificial ladle, and gave the share to both Ashvinikumaras.

## \|\| 1.19.68 \|\|

*atha udyamya bhiduraṃ moktukāmo divaspatiḥ \|*  
*stambhitaścyavanenātha savajraḥ sa narādhipa \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Finding Chyavana bestowing the part of yajna to Ashvinikumaras, Indra tried to attack over the sage with his vajra. But O king, the moment when Indra thought of it, Chyavana made him and his vajra inactive in a moment.

## \|\| 1.19.69 \|\|

*sa stambhayitvātvindraṃ tu bhāgaṃ dattvāśvinorvaśī \|*  
*samāpayāmāsa tadā yajñakarma yathārthavat \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Thus the great sage Chyavana, who had controlled all his senses, made Indra inactive. Thereafter, he gave the share of yajna appropriately to Ashvinikumaras. And then the sage Chyavana, who was well-versed in all the formalities of the yajna, completed the same in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 1.19.70 \|\|

*kañjajo'thājagāmāśu āha ca cyavanaṃ tadā \|*  
*uttaṃbhyatāmayaṃ lekho bhāgaścāstvaśvinoriha \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. At the same time, somehow lord Brahma also arrived there expeditiously and he said to Chyavana — “O excellent sage, now you free Indra from the bondage. Both the Ashvinikumaras will have their share in the yajnas”

## \|\| 1.19.71 \|\|

*tathendrastamuvācedaṃ cyavanaṃ prītamānasaḥ \|*  
*jānāmi śaktiṃ tapasaścyavaneha tavottamām \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Thereafter, Devaraja Indra, also getting immensely pleased with the sage Chyavana, spoke to him — “O Chyavana, I am well aware of the prowess of your tapas.

## \|\| 1.19.72 \|\|

*khyāpanārthaṃ hi tapasastava etatkṛtaṃ mayā \|*  
*adyaprabhṛti bhāgo'stu devatvaṃ cāśvinostathā \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Whatever had been done by me was only to enhance the glory of your tapas. From today onwards, I accept their achieving the godhood.

## \|\| 1.19.73 \|\|

*yastvimāṃ tapasaḥ khyātiṃ tvadīyāṃ vai paṭhiṣyati \|*  
*śṛṇuyādvāpi śuddhātmā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Whosoever will read or listen to the auspicious glory of your tapas, you listen to the related reward.

## \|\| 1.19.74 \|\|

*virocanasado gatvā gatvā puṣpasadastathā \|*  
*kāle'tha vāmadevasya muñjakeśasadastathā \|*  
*yauvanayuktaḥ sa krīḍāstiṣṭhatīti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Such a person (who does so), reaching the assembly of the sun, moon or pushpa and also in the assemblies of Vamadeva and Munjakesha, gaining youthfulness, live their sporting at the same time. There is no doubt about it.”

## \|\| 1.19.75 \|\|

*evamuktvā jagāmāśu devaḥ svabhavanaṃ vaśī \|*  
*cyavano'pi sabhāryo vai śayārtiścāśramaṃ gataḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Thus speaking to Chyavana, Devaraja Indra retired to his own abode. Then Chyavana, who had exercised control over all his sense organs, together with his wife, returned to his hermitage, while the Sharyati also retired to his kingdom.

## \|\| 1.19.76 \|\|

*athāpaśyadvimānābhaṃ bhavanaṃ devanirmitam \|*  
*śayyāsanavarairjuṣṭaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhimat \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. After his return, Chyavana glanced at his hermitage, which looked graceful like the beautiful divine hermitage. The extremely beautiful seats and beds had been arranged therein at appropriate places. There were enough of materials which could fulfil the desires.

## \|\| 1.19.77 \|\|

*1 udyānavāpibhirjuṣṭaṃ devendreṇa samāhṛtam \|*  
*2 gokhaṇḍasannibhaṃ reje gṛhaṃ tadbhuvi durlabham \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. With the inspiration of Indra, several orchards and step wells were placed there. Thus, the auspicious hermitage of the sage Chyavana appeared graceful like the inaccessible heavenly region of Surya.

## \|\| 1.19.78 \|\|

*subhūṣaṇāni divyāni ratnavanti mahānti ca \|*  
*arajānsi ca vastrāṇi divyaprāvaraṇāni ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. The divine ornaments studded with gems, added grace to the hermitage of the sage. The spotless costumes, the divine shining floors and the canopies had astonishing type of grace in the hermitage.

## \|\| 1.19.79 \|\|

*tatsarvamakhilaṃ saha patnyā mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*mudaṃ paramikāṃ lebhe śakraṃ ca praśaśaṃsa ha \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. The sage Chyavana, observing the resplendence of his ashrama with his wife, started enjoying pleasure of an ocean, praising Indra at the same time.

## \|\| 1.19.80 \|\|

*evamiṣṭā tithiriyaṃ dvitīyā aśvinornṛpa \|*  
*devatvaṃ yajñabhāgaṃ ca samprāptāviha bhārata \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. O king, this is the reason that the second day of the moon is considered to be quite favourite of Ashvinikumaras. O Bharata, on this very tithi, Ashvinikumaras joined the family of the gods.

## \|\| 1.19.81-82 \|\|

*upoṣyā vidhinā yena taṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa \|*  
*rūpaṃ surūpaṃ yo vāñcheddvitīyāyāṃ narādhipa \|\| 81 \|\|*

*kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvitīyāyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*puṣpāhāro varṣamekaṃ bhavetsa niyatātmavān \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. O king, I am now narrating the method of fasting in this tithi. You please listen. O king, the people desirous of achieving the beautiful appearance, should start fasting from the second moon day of the bright fortnight of the month of Karttika and continue fasting till that particular day, for one year continuously, controlling all his senses and consume fruits only during the fast.

## \|\| 1.19.83 \|\|

*kālaprāptāni yāni syurhaviṣyaṃ kusumāni tu \|*  
*bhuñjīyāttāni dattvā tu brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipa \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. O king, by accepting the above rule, one should accept whatever the flowers or fruits are made available and these should be turned into havi, which should be given to Brahmanas as charity, and himself consuming the same.

## \|\| 1.19.84 \|\|

*sauvarṇaraupyapuṣpāṇi atha vā jalajāni 1 ca \|*  
*vratānte tasya santuṣṭau devau tribhuvane'śvinau \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. O king, similarly, the golden, silver or the lotus flowers which grow in water can also be used in this vrata. At the conclusion of this vrata, Ashvinikumaras who live above the three worlds, get pleased.

## \|\| 1.19.85 \|\|

*dadatuḥ kāmagaṃ divyaṃ vimānamatitejasam \|*  
*suciraṃ divi nārībhirloke'sau ramate'śvinoḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Both the Ashvinikumaras bestow an excellent divine plane to the devotee, which moves as per one’s desire. Because of the grace of Ashvinikumaras, such a person lives in the heaven with the divine damsels.

## \|\| 1.19.86 \|\|

*iha cāgatya kalpānte jāto vipraḥ puraskṛtaḥ \|*  
*vedavedāṃgaviduṣaḥ saptajanmāntarāṇyasau \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. After the lapse of a the same person returns on earth, and is reborn as a Brahmana, well-versed in the Vedas and is well rewarded in all his activities. In this way, he gets born in the family of Brahmanas for seven births.

## \|\| 1.19.87 \|\|

*jāto jāto bhavedvidvānbrāhmaṇo'sau kṛte yuge \|*  
*dātā yajñapatirvāgmī ādhivyādhivivarjitaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Thus having been born in the Brahmana family in Satyayuga, he becomes a donor, performer of yajna, an orator, free from ailments, and remains alive for long with his sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 1.19.88 \|\|

*putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ saha pantyā'vasacciram \|*  
*madhyadeśe sunagare 2 dharmiṣṭho rājyabhāgbhavet \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. He is born in the Madhyadesa in a beautiful city as a religious person in an affluent family and gets entitled to the position of a ruler.

## \|\| 1.19.89 \|\|

*ityeṣā kathitā tubhyaṃ dvitīyā puṣpasaṃjñitā \|*  
*phalasaṃjñā tathānyā syātsute vai muñjakeśini \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Thus I have narrated to you the story of Pushpa dvitiya. Now I shall narrate the story of Phala-dvitiya, which concludes by the grace of Munjakesha.

## \|\| 1.19.90 \|\|

*suṣṭhu puṇyā pāpaharā viṣṭaraśravasaḥ priyā \|*  
*aśūnyaśayanā loke prakhyātā kurunandana \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. It is the bestower of all the merits and welfare. It is also known as an Ashunya-Shayana Dvitiya.

## \|\| 1.19.91 \|\|

*tāmupoṣya naro rājañchraddhābhaktipuraskṛtaḥ \|*  
*ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ śriyaṃ vātha bhāryayā saha modate \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. O king, this is an extremely meritorious Dvitiya. One who celebrates it with devotion and faith, he achieves all the prosperity and success, beloved wife and feels blissful.

## Chapter 20. Importance of Ashunya Shayana Dvitiya

## \|\| 1.20.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*brūhi me dvijaśārdūla dvitīyāṃ phalasaṃjñitām \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro yoṣidviyogaṃ neha gacchati \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O lion among the Brahmanas! Now you narrate the glory of Phala-Dvitiya, the performer of which never faces separation in this world.

## \|\| 1.20.2 \|\|

*patnyā naro muniśreṣṭha bhāryā ca patinā 1 saha \|*  
*tāmahaṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhavā strī na jāyate \|*  
*upoṣitena yenārya patnyā ca sahito naraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O best of the sages, you tell me the total glory of that vrata with the performing of which a man is never separated from his wife, nor the wife gets separated from her husband. Besides a woman who performs that vrata has never to face widowhood and the man who performs that vrata never gets separated from his wife.

## \|\| 1.20.3 \|\|

*tanme brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha śreyo'rthaṃ narayoṣitām \|*  
*yena me kautukaṃ brahmañchrutvāpūrvaṃ prasarpati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O excellent Brahmana, you kindly speak out the glory of that vrata for the welfare of the women on earth. I feel quite anxious to listen about the same.

## \|\| 1.20.4 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*aśūnyaśayanāṃ nāma dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu bhārata \|*  
*yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ strī prayāti narādhipa \|*  
*patnīviyuktaśca naro na kadācitprajāyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Sumantu said — O Bharata, you listen to the glory of Ashunya Sayana Dvitiya. O monarch, it is a vrata which when performed by a woman, she can never face widowhood and a man never becomes a widower.

## \|\| 1.20.5 \|\|

*śete jagatpatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā sārdhaṃ yadā nṛpa \|*  
*aśūnyaśayanā nāma tadā grāhyā hi sā tithiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O king, when lord Vishnu sleeps with Lakshmi, this vrata of Ashunya Sayana Dvitiya should be performed only at that particular time.

## \|\| 1.20.6 \|\|

*kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi bhārata \|*  
*idamuccārayetsnātaḥ praṇamya jagataḥ patim \|*  
*śrīvatsadhāriṇaṃ devaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O Bharata, on the second day of the black fortnight of the month of Shravana, the performer, after taking his bath in the morning, should adore with reverence to lord Vishnu, having a Shrivatsa mark over the chest. He should then worship him with Lakshmi, with devotion.

## \|\| 1.20.7 \|\|

*śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkānta śrīvatsa śrīpate'vyaya \|*  
*gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He should pray at that point of time thus — “O possessor of Shrivatsa mark, O Shrikanta, O eternal lord, let my household which is the bestower of trivarga viz., dharma, artha and kama, never face destruction.

## \|\| 1.20.8 \|\|

*gāvaśca mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu me janāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. My cows should not be destroyed, let the members of my family not face destruction.

## \|\| 1.20.9 \|\|

*jāmayo mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ \|*  
*lakṣmyā viyujye'haṃ deva na kadācidyathā bhavān \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Let my sisters and housewives not face destruction, there should be no obstruction in the relations between the husband and wife. As you never get separated from Lakshmi, similarly, I also should never be separated from my Lakshmi. This is what is desired by me.

## \|\| 1.20.10 \|\|

*tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me viyujyatām \|*  
*lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O Deva, similarly, the relations between me and my wife should never be disturbed or broken. O bestower of boons, as your bed is never devoid of Lakshmi, similarly my bed also should not be remain without my Lakshmi.

## \|\| 1.20.11-12 \|\|

*śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā tu madhusūdana \|*  
*evaṃ pramādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyāstathā hareḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*phalāni dadyācchāyāyāmabhīṣṭāni jagatpatim \|*  
*naktaṃ 1 praṇamyāyatane havirbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. O killer of the demon Madhu, you shower your grace on me.” The performer should worship Vishnu and Lakshmi accordingly. Then he should give away fruit in the shade in order to please the lord of the universe. During the night, offering his salutations in a temple, he should consume havi, controlling all his sense organs.

## \|\| 1.20.13 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāya dvitīye'hni śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. On the next day, he should offer dakshina to Brahmanas according to his means.

## \|\| 1.20.14 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*kāni tāni abhīṣṭāni keśavasya phalāni tu \|*  
*yojyāni śayane vipra devadevasya kathyatām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Shatanika said — O Brahmana, which are the favourite fruits of lord Keshava, which should be given in charity over his bed?

## \|\| 1.20.15 \|\|

*kiṃ ca dānaṃ dvitīye'hni dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu \|*  
*bhaktairnarairdvijaśreṣṭha devadevasya śaktitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. On the next day which type of clarity should be given as per one’s means to the Brahmanas? O best of the Brahmanas, you kindly answer correctly both the questions.

## \|\| 1.20.16-17 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*yāni tatra mahābāho kāle santi phalāni tu \|*  
*madhurāṇi sutīvrāṇi na cāpi kaṭukāni tu \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dātavyāni nṛpaśreṣṭha svaśaktyā śayane nṛpa \|*  
*madhurāṇi pradattāni naro vallabhatāṃ yajet \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Sumantu said — O long armed one, O best of rulers, whatever fruits of the season are there which are neither too sweet, nor too sour, nor quite hard or bitter, should be placed by a person as per his means, over the bed of the lord. By offering the sweet fruit, the performer becomes the favourite of the lord.

## \|\| 1.20.18 \|\|

*yoṣicca kuruśārdūla bharturvallabhatāmiyāt \|*  
*tasmātkaṭukatīvrāṇi strīliṅgāni vivarjayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O best of the race of Kuru, similarly, a lady who offers the sweet fruits to the lord, she becomes favourite of her husband. Therefore, a woman should not give in charity the sour or bitter fruits.

## \|\| 1.20.19 \|\|

*kharjūramātuliṅgāni śvetena śirasā saha \|*  
*phalāni śayane rājanyajñabhāgaharasya tu \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O lion of the Kuru race, particularly, the dates (of palm tree), myrobalam and the coconut should be particularly placed over the bed of the lord.

## \|\| 1.20.20 \|\|

*deyāni kuruśārdūla svaśaktyā muñjakeśine \|*  
*etānyeva tu viprasya gāṅgeyasahitāni tu \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O king, these fruits should be given away in charity according to one’s means to Munjakesha. The same fruits should be given to a Brahmana the next day, with water of Ganga according to one’s means with devotion.

## \|\| 1.20.21 \|\|

*dvitīye'hni pradeyāni bhaktyā śaktyā ca bhārata \|*  
*vāsodānaṃ tathā dhānyaphaladānasamanvitam \|*  
*gāṅgeyasya viśeṣeṇa dhānyadānaṃ pracakṣate \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. At that point of time, together with costumes, food and fruits etc., the aforesaid fruits should also be given. The giving of gold in charity is of special importance. Even the donating of paddy is also said to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 1.20.22 \|\|

*evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaṅnaro māsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*tato janmatrayaṃ vīra gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A person who follows all the above rules for four months, his household never is broken in three births.

## \|\| 1.20.23 \|\|

*aśūnyaśayanaścāsau dharmakāmārthasādhanaḥ \|*  
*bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The Ashunya Shayana Vrata is the source of mainly the achieving of dharma, artha and kama. There is never any decrease in riches to a person who performs the same. This is sure.

## \|\| 1.20.24 \|\|

*1 nārī ca rājandharmajñā vratametadyathāvidhi \|*  
*yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A woman who performs this vrata appropriately, such a virtuous woman never turns as a critical for her family or otherwise she never causes any worry for the family.

## \|\| 1.20.25 \|\|

*vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama \|*  
*nāpnoti janma triyatametaccīrtvā2 mahāvratam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O excellent one, such a virtuous woman, has never to face widowhood, misfortune and neglect from the husband, because of the performing of the vrata, she does not have to face any ugly situation in three future births.

## \|\| 1.20.26-27 \|\|

*adattvā kaṭukānīha phalāni kurunandana \|*  
*kharjūramātuliṅgāni bṛhatphalaśirāṃsi ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*dattvā dvijebhyo rājendra madhurāṇi parāṇi ca \|*  
*tasmātsvaśaktyā yattena deyāni madhurāṇi ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. O son of the race of Kuru, instead of giving the bitter fruits in charity, when a person gives away in the vrata grapes, coconut and myrobalan to the Brahmanas, or other sweet fruits, he surely gets the suitable reward. Therefore, the performer, making all the efforts, should give away only the sweet fruits.

## \|\| 1.20.28 \|\|

*ityeṣā kathitā kṛṣṇadvitīyā tithiruttamā \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro rājannṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ tathā vrajet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O king, a person who reveals about the excellent reward that is achieved with the performing of the vrata of Krishna dvitiya, has already been spoken by me. He also achieves the best of success and prosperity.

## \|\| 1.20.29-30 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*bhavatā kathiteyaṃ vai dvitīyā tithiruttamā \|*  
*aśvibhyāṃ dvijaśārdūla kathamasyāṃ janārdanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sampūjyaḥ phalasaṃjñāyāṃ kathitaḥ padmayā saha \|*  
*tadatra kautukaṃ mahyaṃ sumahajjāyate dvija \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Shatanika said — O lion among the Brahmanas, the story of the excellent Dvitiya which has been narrated by me in the story of Ashvinikumaras, besides the way lord Vishnu is to be adored with Lakshmi, besides the rewards after adoring them (have already been described). In this vrata of Pushpa Dvitiya, how is lord Janardana to be worshipped? O Brahmana, listening to the same, our mind has become too anxious.

## \|\| 1.20.31 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*evametanna sandeho tathā vadasi bhārata \|*  
*aśvinorvai tithiriyaṃ kiṃ tu vākyaṃ nibodha me \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Sumantu said — O king born in the race of Bharata, whatever has been spoken by you is true. Both these tithis are meant for the adoration of Ashvinikumaras. But you listen to my words again quite clearly.

## \|\| 1.20.32 \|\|

*aśūnyaśayanā dattā 1 viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|*  
*aśvibhyāṃ kuru śārdūla prītaye muñjakeśinaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Out of all the three, Ashunya Shayana is meant for the immensely illustrious lord Vishnu, which was bestowed by Ashvinikumaras for the pleasure of lord Munjakesha.

## \|\| 1.20.33 \|\|

*tāveva kuruśārdūla pūjyete'tra mahīpate \|*  
*nāsatyau bhagavānviṣṇurdattaśca śrīrvibhāvyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Both Ashvinikumaras are worshipped during these days when lord Vishnu and Lakshmi are also adored.

## Chapter 21. The glory of the Tritiya Tithi

## \|\| 1.21.1-3 \|\|

*lavaṇaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ devyai śaktyā nivedayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sopavāsā tṛtīyāṃ tu lavaṇaṃ parivarjayet \|*  
*sā gṛhṇāti ca vai bhaktyā vratamāmaraṇāntikam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*gaurī sannihitā nityaṃ bhūmau prastaraśāyinī \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sumantu said — O king, the extremely chaste woman who is devoted to her husband, remains always in service of her husband throughout the day and night, possessing all the noble virtues. She being extremely beautiful, possessing all the noble ideals, has been said to be a chaste woman. She should observe a fast on the day of Tritiya but should not consume the salt. A devoted woman who performs this vrata till her death, the goddess Gauri, getting pleased with her, bestows on her the enormous beauty as well the fortunes. Besides that, the goddess Parvati also bestows excessive charm which could attract her in the eyes of men, besides the power to attract the men towards herself with ease.

## \|\| 1.21.4 \|\|

*puṃso manoramā nārī bharttā nāryā manoramaḥ \|*  
*gaurīvratena bhavati rājaṃllavaṇavarjanāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O monarch, a charming woman in the eyes of man and a man who looks charming in the eyes of woman, can be achieved by the performing of the Gaur! vrata, discarding the salt.

## \|\| 1.21.5 \|\|

*idaṃ vrataṃ prati vibho dharmarājasya śṛṇvataḥ \|*  
*umayā ca purā proktaṃ yadvākyaṃ tannibodha me \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O excellent one, I shall repeat before you whatever had been spoken by Parvati to Dharmaraja, about this vrata. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.21.6 \|\|

*vidhavā tu yadā rājandevyā vrataparāyaṇā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Parvati had said — “I had introduced this vrata on earth for the increase of the fortunes of the people on earth. The ladies shall perform this vrata on earth, observing all the rules. With the glory of the performing of the vrata, the ladies shall feel blissful with the husbands who are totally favourable to them as had Parvati done with her husband Shiva.

## \|\| 1.21.7 \|\|

*yā ca kanyā na bhartāraṃ vindate śobhanā satī \|*  
*sā tvidaṃ vratamuddiśya bhavedakṣārabhojanā \|*  
*maccittā manmanāḥ kuryānmadbhaktā matparigrahā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A young maiden who is unable to find a good husband, she, while performing this vrata, discarding the saltish food, keeping her mind devoted in me at that time, should have all the expectations from me.

## \|\| 1.21.8-10 \|\|

*gaurīṃ saṃsthāpya sauvarṇīṃ gandhālaṅkārabhūṣitām \|*  
*vastrālaṅkārasaṃvītāṃ puṣpamaṇḍalamaṇḍitām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kaṭukhaṇḍaṃ jīrakaṃ ca patraśākaṃ ca bhārata \|\| 9 \|\|*

*guḍaghṛṣṭāṃstathāpūpānkhaḍaveṣṭāṃstathā nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇe vratasampanne pradadyātsubahuśrute \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. She should then consecrate the image of Sauvarna Gauri or the image of Parvati in gold. The image should then be decorated with fragrant materials in an appropriate manner. The beautiful costumes, ornaments, flowers and garlands should be offered to the image. Thereafter, the offering of salt, sugarcane cakes, ghi and sesamum should be offered to the goddess. Thereafter, black pepper, cominseed, betel and sweet cakes should be given to such a reputed Brahmana who had entered the household after performing Brahmacharya.

## \|\| 1.21.11 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe sadā deyā yathā śaktyā hiraṇmayī \|*  
*dhanahīne tu bhaktyā2 ca madhuvṛkṣamayī nṛpa \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. On the third day of the bright fortnight, one should give away a gold image in charity according to his means. O king, when in poverty, an image made of Madhuvriksha (Bassia latifolia) should be given in charity.

## \|\| 1.21.12 \|\|

*arcyā nityaṃ saṃnidhānāttatra gaurī na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*akṣāralavaṇaṃ rātrau bhuṃkte caiva suvāgyatā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The image of the goddess should be worshipped from close quarters, because the goddess Gauri dwells in the same. The lady who is performing the vrata, should exercise good control over her speech. She should consume the food without salt in the night.

## \|\| 1.21.13-14 \|\|

*evaṃ niyamayuktasya4 devyā yatsamudāhṛtam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tacchṛṇuṣva mahābāho kathyamānaṃ mahāphalam \|*  
*bhartāraṃ tu labhetkanyā yaṃ vācchati mano'nugam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. She should sleep on the ground or a stone slab, where the closeness of Gauri is anticipated. A woman who performs this vrata observing all the rules and by so doing, she earns a great reward, which the goddess has herself revealed. O valorous one, I am going to speak out the same. When a maiden performs this vrata, she gets desirous of a husband of her liking and she gets the same.

## \|\| 1.21.15 \|\|

*suciraṃ saha vai bhartrā krīḍayitvā5 ihaiva sā \|*  
*santatiṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya saha tenaiva gacchati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Her husband moves according to her wish. She enjoys all the pleasures on the earth with her husband for long and then well establishing her progeny, moves on to the other world with her husband.

## \|\| 1.21.16 \|\|

*helilokaṃ candralokaṃ lokaṃ citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ \|*  
*gatvā yāti sado rājanvāmadevasya bhārata \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O king born in the race of Bharata, a woman who performs this vrata, she achieves place in the Suryaloka, Chandraloka, the abode of the seven Rishis and lord Vamadeva’s court, with her husband.

## \|\| 1.21.17-18 \|\|

*bharttāraṃ niyatā nityaṃ sadārcanaparāyaṇā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*iha cotsṛjya dehaṃ svaṃ dṛṣṭvā haripure priyam \|*  
*ākṣipya yamadūtebhyaḥ saha bhartrā rameddivi \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. O king, a widowed woman who getting devoted at the feet of her husband, performs the aforesaid vrata of the goddess, she after discarding her body in this world, goes to the place of lord Hari, where she meets with her husband. Then neglecting the messengers of Yama, she enjoys comforts in the heaven with; her husband.

## \|\| 1.21.19 \|\|

*varṣakoṭiṃ daśaguṇāṃ ramitvā sā ihāgatā \|*  
*bhartrā sahaiva pūrvoktaṃ labhate phalamīpsitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. She enjoys the company of her husband for ten crores of years and she is then reborn in this world and enjoys all the pleasures with her husband.

## \|\| 1.21.20 \|\|

*indrāṇyāpi vratamidaṃ putrārthinyā narādhipa \|*  
*labdhaḥ putro vratasyānte jayanto nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O king, Indrani, when desirous of having a son, had performed this vrata appropriately and by the glory of the same vrata, she had a son named Jayanta.

## \|\| 1.21.21 \|\|

*arundhatyā tathā cīrṇaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ prati kāmataḥ \|*  
*dṛśyate divi cādyāpi vaśiṣṭhasya samīpataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Similarly, Arundhati got desirous of having Vasishtha as her husband, as a result of which, she even today lives with Vasistha in the heaven.

## \|\| 1.21.22 \|\|

*rohiṇyā lavaṇatyāgātsapannīgaṇamardanam \|*  
*labdhaṃ devyāḥ prasādena saubhāgyamacalaṃ divi \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Discarding the salt, Rohini had performed the above vrata and by the grace of the goddess, she was in a position to shatter the pride of her co-wives. Her prosperity and happiness are found intact in the heaven even today.

## \|\| 1.21.23 \|\|

*ityeṣā tithirityeva tṛtīyā lokapūjitā \|*  
*sadā viśeṣataḥ puṇyā vaiśākhe māsi yā bhavet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus the Tritiya tithi is even otherwise quite popular in the world, but out of these, the Tritiya tithi of the month of Vaishakha is particularly meritorious.

## \|\| 1.21.24 \|\|

*puṇyā bhādrapade māsi māghepyevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*māghe bhādrapade cāpi strīṇāṃ dhanyā1 pracakṣate \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Similarly, the same tithi of the month of Bhadrapada is also quite auspicious and meritorious. The Tritiya tithi of the month of Margashirsha is also auspicious. There is no doubt about it. The Tritiya tithi of the months of Margashirsha and Bhadrapada are especially meritorious for the females.

## \|\| 1.21.25 \|\|

*sādhāraṇī tu vaiśākhe sarvalokasya bhārata \|*  
*māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ guḍasya lavaṇasya ca \|*  
*dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ rājanstrīṇāṃ2 ca puruṣasya ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O king born in the race of Bharata, the Tritiya tithi of the month of Vaishakha is meant for the ordinary people. O king, on the tritiya of the month of Magha, if the sugarcane cakes and the salt are given by both the man and woman, it becomes more beneficial for them.

## \|\| 1.21.26 \|\|

*guḍena tuṣyate datto lavaṇena tu viśvabhūḥ \|*  
*guḍapūpāstu dātavyā māsi bhādrapade tathā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. By giving away the sugarcane cakes and salt in charity on the aforesaid tithi the universal soul is particularly delighted. During the month of Bhadrapada, the fried cakes with sugarcane cakes are given in charity.

## \|\| 1.21.27 \|\|

*tṛtīyāyāṃ tu māghasya vāmadevasya prītaye \|*  
*vāridānaṃ praśastaṃ syānmodakānāṃ ca bhārata \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O Bharata, on the Tritiya day of the month of Magha, Vamadeva is pleased. For the fulfilling of one’s all desires, the giving away of the water and sweet balls is considered to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 1.21.28 \|\|

*vaiśākhe māsi rājendra tṛtīyā candanasya ca \|*  
*vāriṇā tuṣyate vedhā modakairbhīma eva hi \|*  
*dānāttu candanasyeha kañjajo nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O king, on the Tritiya of the month of Vaishakha, Brahma gets pleased with the offering of sandal paste, large size sweet balls, and with the giving away of the charities on the Tritiya of the month of Vaishakha. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.21.29 \|\|

*yātveṣā kuruśārdūla vaiśākhe māsi vai tithiḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyā sā'kṣayā loke gīrvāṇairabhinanditā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O lion of the Kuru race, the meritorious Tritiya tithi of the month of Vaishakha is known in the world as Akshaya Tritiya by the gods.

## \|\| 1.21.30 \|\|

*āgateyaṃ mahābāho bhūri candraṃ vasuvratā \|*  
*kaladhautaṃ tathānnaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yadyaddattaṃ tvakṣayaṃ syātteneyamakṣayā smṛtā \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O valorous one, this auspicious Akshaya Tritiya emerged on the earth for bestowing enormous riches and cereals. During this tithi, gold, food, particularly the ghi or any other thing that is given, become indestructible. This is the reason that the name Akshaya has been given to it.

## \|\| 1.21.31-32 \|\|

*yatkiñciddīyate dānaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu \|*  
*tatsarvamakṣayaṃ syādvai teneyamakṣayā smṛtā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*yo'syāṃ dadāti karakanvāribījasamanvitān \|*  
*sa yāti puruṣo vīra lokaṃ vai hemamālinaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Whatever charities are given on this day, irrespective of its being big or small, it becomes indestructible. Because of this, it is known by the name of Akshaya. One who gives away water, lotus or lotus seeds, and kamandalu, he surely attains the heaven.

## \|\| 1.21.33 \|\|

*ityeṣā kathitā vīra tṛtīyā tithiruttamā \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro rājannṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ śriyaṃ bhajet \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O king, one who fasts on the meritorious Akshaya Tritiya, he achieves all the success, prosperity and Lakshmi.

## Chapter 22. Glory of the vrata of Chaturthi tithi

## \|\| 1.22.1-2 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*caturthyāṃ tu sadā rājannirāhāravratānvitaḥ \|*  
*dattvā tilānnaṃ viprasya svayaṃ bhuṃkte tilaudanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*matimāndhṛtimānvāgmī bhāgyavānkāmakāravān \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — A person who performs the vrata without taking food on the Chaturthi tithi, gives away the sesamum seeds in charity and himself also takes the boiled rice mixed with sesamum seeds as his food, and continues the process for a couple of years without any obstruction, the god Vinayaka gets pleased on him and bestows success to him in all his desired tasks.

## \|\| 1.22.3-4 \|\|

*yāti bhāgyanivāsaṃ hi krīḍate vibhavaiḥ saha \|*  
*iha cāgatya puṇyānte divyo divyavapuryaśāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*asādhyānyapi sādhyeha kṣaṇādeva mahāntyapi \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. With the performing of this vrata and its glory, he earns fortunes, enjoying all the pleasures and prosperity. Then with the decline of his merits, the auspicious soul again attains the human body, becomes glorious, intelligent, patient, orator, fortunate one, who performs his duties independently. Then he is reborn. He accomplishes the difficult tasks in his life quite easily in no time.

## \|\| 1.22.5 \|\|

*hantyaśvarathasampannaṃ ṣalīputrasahāyavān \|*  
*rājā bhavati dīrghāyuḥ saptajanmānyasau nṛpa \|*  
*etaddadāti santuṣṭo vighnahantā4 vināyakaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. He becomes a ruler, possessing the elephants, horses, chariots, besides noble wife and sons enjoying all the worldly comforts. He is born as a ruler for seven births, with long life. Lord Vinayaka — the destroyer of obstructions, because of his performing vrata on the Chaturthi tithi, gets pleased with him and bestows the aforesaid reward.

## \|\| 1.22.6 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*vighnaḥ kasya kṛtastena yena vighnavināyakaḥ \|*  
*etadvadasva vighneśa vighnakāraṇamadya me \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Shatanika said — O excellent sage, to whom had Vinayaka caused obstructions, earning him the title of the remover of the obstructions. You kindly tell me today the cause of his being the remover of obstructions.

## \|\| 1.22.7 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*kaumāre lakṣaṇe puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ ca sukṛte kṛte \|*  
*vighnaṃ cakāra vighneśo gāṅgeyasya vināyakaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Sumantu said — O King, in the earlier times, Karttika — the son of Ganga, was revealing the virtues of the men and women. Vighnesha Vinayaka caused destruction in his task.

## \|\| 1.22.8-9 \|\|

*taṃ tu vighnaṃ viditvāsau kārttikeyo ruṣānvitaḥ \|*  
*utkṛṣya dantaṃ tasyāsyāddhantuṃ taṃ ca samudyataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nivāryāpṛcchaddeveśo roṣaḥ kāryaḥ kutastvayā \|*  
*taṃ cācakhyau sa pitre vai kṛtaṃ pūruṣalakṣaṇam \|*  
*tatra vighnakṛte mahyaṃ yoṣitā na ca lakṣaṇam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. When Karttikeya came to know that Vighnesha had caused obstruction in his activity, he was enraged. Then he, removing a tusk from his face, got ready to kill Vighnesha. At that point of time, lord Shiva stopped Karttikeya and asked him — “why had he been enraged so much?” Karttikeya replied — “O adorable one, I had resolved to note down the good or bad qualities of men and women, and out of those I had completed the description of good and bad qualities of men, but those of the women was still incomplete, when Vinayaka created obstructions.”

## \|\| 1.22.10 \|\|

*athovāca mahādevaḥ prahasantsvasutaṃ kila \|*  
*mama kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ putra paśyase tvaṃ vadasva me \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Listening to the words of Karttikeya, lord Shiva smiled and said — “O son, you look at the symptoms of my body and what would be the effect of the same? You tell me the same.”

## \|\| 1.22.11 \|\|

*sa covāca kare tubhyaṃ kapālaṃ dvijalakṣitam \|*  
*avicāreṇa saṃsthāpyaṃ kapālī tena cocyate \|*  
*sa tallakṣaṇamādāya samudre prākṣipadruṣā \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Karttikeya said — “O adorable one, the head of a Brahmana would stick to your hand, due to some carelessness. Because of the same, you would be known in the world as a Kapali.” Listening to the words of Karttikeya, lord Shiva in anger, threw away the “Book on symptoms” in the ocean.

## \|\| 1.22.12 \|\|

*atha devasamāje vai pravṛtte brahmarudrayoḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ jyāyānahaṃ jyāyānvivādo'bhūttayordvayoḥ \|*  
*tava saṃbhūtyabhijño'sti māṃ tu veda na kaścana \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Many days after this incident, once a controversy developed in the assembly of gods between Brahma and lord Shiva as to who was more adorable. At that pint of time, both of them claimed their superiority over one another. Shiva then told Brahma — “I am aware of your birth.”

## \|\| 1.22.13 \|\|

*evaṃ śive'ti bruvati brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ \|*  
*muktāṭṭahāsaṃ provāca tvāmahaṃ veditā bhava \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Listening to the words of Shiva, the fifth head of Brahma laughed aloud and uttered — “I am also well aware of you.”

## \|\| 1.22.14 \|\|

*evaṃ bruvantu rudreṇa brāhmaṃ hayaśiro mahat \|*  
*nakhāgreṇa nikṛttaṃ ca tasyaiva ca kare sthitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The moment Brahma spoke these words, Rudra, with the nail of his hand at once, removed the same head of Brahma which had uttered those words. Thus the head was separated from the body. After having been separated from the body, the head was stuck to the hand of lord Shiva.

## \|\| 1.22.15 \|\|

*karasthenaiva tenāsāvāgacchadyatra vai hariḥ \|*  
*tapastepe tadā merau tatrāsau bhagavānvaśī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. With Brahma’s head having been stuck up to the hand, lord Shiva reached the place of Hari. At that point of time, lord Vishnu who had controlled all his senses, was engaged in performing the tapas.

## \|\| 1.22.16-17 \|\|

*kṛtte hayaśire tasminsthānāttasmāttu brahmaṇaḥ \|*  
*roṣādviniḥsṛtastvanyaḥ puruṣaḥ śvetakuṇḍalī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kavacī saśiraskaśca saśaraḥ saśarāsanaḥ \|*  
*anirdeśyavapuḥ sragvī kiṃ karomi sa cābravīt \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. On the other hand, when the fifth head of Brahma was thus cut off, a human body emerged out of the same place where there was the fifth head. The human figure that emerged out the severed head of Brahma, was wearing white earrings, kavacha and the turban. He also held the bow and arrow in his hands. His vast body was unparalleled and undefinable. A rosary of beads was falling over his chest. Soon after his appearing, the enraged person spoke to Brahma — “O lord, give me a command.”

## \|\| 1.22.18 \|\|

*athovāca ruṣā brahmā hanyatāṃ sa sudurmatiḥ \|*  
*sa tu mārgeṇa rudrasya āgacchadroṣato drutam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The enraged Brahma said — “You better kill the sinful Shankara. At these words of Brahma, the man with white kundalas at once rushed towards the direction to which lord Shiva had gone.

## \|\| 1.22.19 \|\|

*rudro'pi viṣṇutejobhiḥ praviṣṭaḥ sa tvadhiṣṭhitaḥ \|*  
*sa praviśya tadāpaśyattapantaṃ cottamaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*haro nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ vaikuṇṭhamaparājitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On the other hand, lord Rudra, reaching the abode of Vishnu, was also influenced of Vishnu, where he performed severe tapas, and witnessed lord Vaikuntha.

## \|\| 1.22.20 \|\|

*haraṃ dṛṣṭvātha samprāptaṃ kāryaṃ cāsya vicintya ca \|*  
*uvāca śūlinaṃ devo bhindhi śūlena me bhujam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Lord Vishnu, finding lord Shiva present in his abode and well realizing the cause of his arrival, said to the carrier of the trident, lord Shiva — “You injure my arm with your trident.”

## \|\| 1.22.21 \|\|

*sa bibheda mahātejā bhujaṃ śūlena taṃ haraḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. At this, Shiva injured the arm of lord Vishnu with his trident.

## \|\| 1.22.22 \|\|

*śūlabhedādasṛkcordhvaṃ jagāmāvṛtya rodasī \|*  
*vinivṛtya tataḥ paścātkapāle nipapāta ha \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Soon after the arm of Vishnu was injured, a stream of blood flew out of it. It after going round the universe, again fell onto the skull of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.22.23-25 \|\|

*asṛkkapāle patitaṃ pradeśinyā vyavarddhayat \|*  
*yadā hi vinivṛttiḥ syāddevasya rudhiraṃ prati \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tadā tu vyasṛjattoyaṃ sa kṛtvā vāruṇīṃ tanum \|*  
*toye pravṛtte'sṛgbhūte kapāle yatra tacchiraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kapāle tu pradeśinyā rudro'sau rudhire'sṛjat \|*  
*āmuktakavacaṃ raktaṃ raktakuṇḍalinaṃ naram \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Thus the entire blood filled the skull of Brahma. Lord Shiva then stirred the blood in the skull with his index finger. When the stirring of the blood with the index finger was stopped, then the lord made his body like the one of Aruna and then created water. Thereafter, the skull of Brahma was made red by Rudra like the blood. Then Rudra stirring the blood in the skull of Brahma, created a red human figure wearing the red earrings.

## \|\| 1.22.26 \|\|

*athovāca bhavaṃ devaṃ kiṃ karomīti mānada \|*  
*asāvapi sasarjātha śvetakuṇḍalinaṃ naram \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Then the person with red complexion asked lord Rudra — “What is the task to be accomplished by me?” As has been stated earlier, a human with white earrings was created from the body of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.22.27 \|\|

*tāvubhau samayudhyetāṃ dhanuṣpravaradhāriṇau \|*  
*yathā rājanbalīyāṃsau kujaketū yugātyaye \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O king, both of them who were the great archers, who were born out of anger, were engaged in fight with each other as Mangala (Mars) and Ketu — the planets, had fought at the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 1.22.28 \|\|

*tayostu yudhyatorevaṃ saṃvartaścādhiko gataḥ \|*  
*na cādṛśyata vijaya ekasyāpi tadā tayoḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Both the Purushas kept on fighting for more than a kalpa, but no signs of victory with either of them could be visible.

## \|\| 1.22.29 \|\|

*athāntarikṣe tau dṛṣṭvā vāguvācāśarīriṇī \|*  
*avatāro'tha bhavitā yuvayorhi mayā saha \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Then observing both of them, a divine voice was heard that both of them would incarnate with me.

## \|\| 1.22.30 \|\|

*bhārāpanodaḥ karttavyaḥ pṛthivyarthe suraiḥ saha \|*  
*tadāścaryo hi bhavitā devakāryārthasiddhaye \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. I shall incarnate on earth, for the removal of her burden with other gods. At that point of time, for the success of the gods, an astonishing event happened.

## \|\| 1.22.31 \|\|

*bhūlokabhāvaṃ nirdhūya bhūyo gantā surālayam \|*  
*evamuktvā tu vaikuṇṭho dadāvekaṃ ravestadā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thereafter, with the completion of the task on earth, I shall go back to the heaven. Thus lord Vaikuntha, expressing his ideas through the divine voice, gave one of the Purusha to Ravi — the Sun.

## \|\| 1.22.32 \|\|

*śvetakuṇḍalinaṃ dṛptaṃ1 taṃ jagrāha ravirmudā \|*  
*indrasyāpi tataḥ paścādraktakuṇḍalinaṃ dadau \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Ravi on his part, feeling proud, accepted one of those Purushas with the white kundalas. Thereafter, the Purusha with red earrings was given over to Indra.

## \|\| 1.22.33 \|\|

*jagrāha ca mudā yukta indraḥ svaṃ ca puraṃ yayau \|*  
*gatau ravīndrau pragṛhya puruṣau krodhasambhavau \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Accepting the Purusha, Indra returned to his abode with delight. Thus, both the Purushas born of the rage of Brahma and Shiva, returned to their respective abodes.

## \|\| 1.22.34 \|\|

*athovāca tadā rudraṃ devaḥ kamalasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*gaccha tvamapi kāpāle kapālavratacaryayā \|*  
*avatāro vratasyāsya martyaloke bhaviṣyati \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. After this incident, Brahma seated over the seat of lotus, said to Rudra — “You also visit the Kapala tirtha in order to remove the skull out of your hands, which would be done on earth.”

## \|\| 1.22.35 \|\|

*ye ca vrataṃ tvadīyaṃ vai dhārayiṣyanti mānavāḥ \|*  
*na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiñcidbhaviteha paratra ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A person, who would perform this vrata for you, nothing would be beyond his reach in this, nor the future world.

## \|\| 1.22.36 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃlapya bahuśaḥ sumukhaṃ pratinandya ca \|*  
*āhūya ca samudraṃ sa pratyuvācāvicārayan \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thus talking several such things, praising from his mouth, he invoked the ocean and on his arrival, he said to him thoughtlessly.

## \|\| 1.22.37 \|\|

*kuruṣvābharaṇaṃ2 strīṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yadvilakṣaṇam \|*  
*kārttikeyena yatproktaṃ tadvadasvāvicārayan \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O ocean, you compose the astonishing types of symptoms of the women, which could be the cause of their grace. Karttikeya has described some symptoms of men as well as the women. You narrate before me, without thinking (deeply) about them.

## \|\| 1.22.38 \|\|

*sa cāha mama nāmnedaṃ bhavetpuruṣalakṣaṇam \|*  
*devena tatpratijñātamevametadbhaviṣyati \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The ocean said — “O lord, the symptoms for the women so expressed by me, would be known to the world in my name.” The request of the ocean was accepted by lord Brahma.

## \|\| 1.22.39 \|\|

*kārttikeyena yatproktaṃ tadvadasvāvicārayan \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. You repeat to me whatever Karttikeya had spoken to you (without any change).

## \|\| 1.22.40 \|\|

*prayacchāsya viṣāṇaṃ vai niṣkṛṣṭaṃ yattvayā'dhunā \|*  
*avaśyameva tadbhūtaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tu kasyacit \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. At these words of the ocean, Brahma said to Karttikeya — “You give me also the tusk of Vinayaka which you had uprooted. A person gets the same, whatever is destined to be received by him.” By the move of destiny, the same thing happens whatever is destined to happen.

## \|\| 1.22.41 \|\|

*ṛte vināyakaṃ tadvai daivayogānna kāmataḥ \|*  
*gṛhāṇa etatsāmudraṃ yattvayā parikīrtitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Because of the move after destiny, none else is aware of the truth about the subject, except Vinayaka. The service of palmistry should be accepted by you, about which you have already mentioned.

## \|\| 1.22.42 \|\|

*strīpuṃsorlakṣaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāmudramiti viśrutama \|*  
*imaṃ ca saviṣāṇaṃ vai kuru devavināyakama \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. The excellent symptoms of the men and women are enshrined in the service of palmistry. You connect it with the tusk of Vinayaka.

## \|\| 1.22.43 \|\|

*athovāca ca deveśaṃ bāhuleyaḥ samatsaram \|*  
*viṣāṇaṃ dadmi cāsyāhaṃ tava vākyānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Hearing these words, Karttikeya spoke with arrogance — “I had given back the tusk at your command. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.22.44 \|\|

*yadā tvayaṃ viṣāṇaṃ ca muktvā tu vicariṣyati \|*  
*tadā viṣāṇamuktaḥ sanbhasma aitaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. But when he shall wander here and there leaving this tusk, it would reduce him to ashes at the same time.”

## \|\| 1.22.45 \|\|

*evamastviti taṃ coktvā viṣāṇaṃ tatkare dadau \|*  
*vināyakasya deveśaḥ kārtikeyamate sthitaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thus speaking, Karttikeya handed over the tusk to Vinayaka. With this performance of Karttikeya, lord Shiva became agreeable.

## \|\| 1.22.46 \|\|

*saviṣāṇakaro'dyāpi dṛśyate pratimā nṛpa \|*  
*bhīmasūnormahābāhorvighnaṃ karttuṃ mahātmanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O king, even today, for the sake of creating obstructions in the tasks, the image of Vinayaka is found holding a tusk in his hand.

## \|\| 1.22.47 \|\|

*etadrahasyaṃ devānāṃ mayā te samudāhṛtam \|*  
*yatra devo na vai veda devānāṃ bhuvi durlabham \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. This secret talk of the gods has been revealed by me to you, which is not known to all the gods. It is of course, rarely found.
