*sārathyaṃ rudra kuryādvai śreyo'rthamātmanaḥ sadā \|*  
*nāruheta rathe'śraddho yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. O Rudra, in this way, one should accept the position of a charioteer for his own welfare. Similarly, a person, having no faith but is desirous of his own welfare, should never be allowed to mount the chariot.

## \|\| 1.55.84 \|\|

*rathamārohatastasya kṣayaṃ gacchati santatiḥ \|*  
*sa ratho devadevasya voḍhavyo brāhmaṇaiḥ sadā \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Because in case a person having no faith in the Sungod mounts over the Sun chariot, his progeny gets destroyed. The chariot of the Sungod should be driven by the Brahmanas alone.

## \|\| 1.55.85-86 \|\|

*kṣatriyaiścāpi vaiśyaiśca na tu śūdraiḥ kadācana \|*  
*ye tvanyadevatābhaktā ye ca madyapravartakāḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*naitaiḥ śūdraiśca voḍhavya itaraistu sadohyate \|*  
*upavāsavratopetairvoḍhavyaḥ pārvatīpriya \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. The Kshatriyas and the Vaishyas too can drive them, but the Shudras or the enemies cannot do so. Similarly, the devotees of the other gods except the drunkards and the Shudras, can also drive the chariot, while performing the vrata.

## \|\| 1.55.87-94 \|\|

*svasthānāccalito rudra pūrvadvāraṃ vrajeta3 vai \|*  
*dinamekaṃ vasettatra pūjyamāno nṛpeṇa vai \|\| 87 \|\|*

*nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakaiḥ purāṇaśravaṇena ca \|*  
*nānāvidhairbrahmaghoṣairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*sthitvā tu tatrāṣṭamyantaṃ navamyāṃ calate punaḥ \|*  
*vrajeta dakṣiṇaṃ dvāraṃ nagarasya trilocana \|\| 89 \|\|*

*tatrāpi dinamekaṃ tu tiṣṭhantendhakasūdana \|*  
*sthite'tra taiḥ pūjyamāno yathā rājñā tathā nṛpaiḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*tasmādapi caledbhadra dvāraṃ paścāttatottaram \|*  
*tatrāpi pūjyaḥ śūdraistu vidhivatpriyadarśana \|\| 91 \|\|*

*tasmācca calate rudra vrajenmadhyaṃ purasya tu \|*  
*tatrasthaṃ pūjayanti sma brāhmaṇāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*śaṃkhavāditranirghoṣaistathā prekṣaṇakairvaraiḥ \|*  
*brahmaghoṣaiśca vividhaiḥ samantāddīpakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 93 \|\|*

*nānāvidhairvittadānairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*dīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaistripurāntaka \|\| 94 \|\|*

87-94. Starting from the original place, the chariot should move to the eastern gate and halt there for a day. Then getting worshipped from the king, several of the Brahmanas should recite the Vedas and should start on the ninth moon day again and reach the southern gate. The chariot should halt there for a day when the chariot should be worshipped by the ministers in the same way as the king had done earlier, and then reach the northern gate. O Rudra, he should be worshipped by the Shudras and then reach the middle of the village. There the chariot should be worshipped by the Brahmanas with utmost devotion, with the playing of cymbals and other musical instruments, offering precious articles. Thereafter, producing the tumultuous sound and decorating it with lighted lamps, the Sungod should be worshipped. The Brahmanas should be pleased with various types of gifts, besides the blind and shelterless people.

## \|\| 1.55.95-98 \|\|

*puramadhyāttu calitastiṣṭhetprāpya svamaṃdiram \|*  
*itthaṃ prāpya sthito devaḥ purato maṃdirasya tu \|\| 95 \|\|*

*tatra sthitaḥ pūjanīyo bhavetpaureṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*pūjyamānastvahorātraṃ rathārūḍhastu tiṣṭhati \|\| 96 \|\|*

*apare dine vrajetsthānaṃ taccirantanamādarāt \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ trilocana \|\| 97 \|\|*

*sadaivaṃ bhrāmayeddevaṃ graheśaṃ duritāpaham \|*  
*parivārayutaṃ rudra sānugaṃ parameśvaram \|\| 98 \|\|*

95-98. The chariot should then be made to return from that place to the place of the original temple. All the people of the village should worship the chariot in front of the temple and the image should be kept in the same chariot for the night. On the next day when the thirteenth moon day is over, and on the start of the fourteenth moon day, the image should be again placed in its original temple with the reciting of the mantras. O three eyed lord, thus the Sungod with his family should be taken round, since he is the lord of all the planets besides being the remover of all the obstructions.

## Chapter 56. The Ratha-yatra of the Sungod

## \|\| 1.56.1 \|\|

*śrīrudra uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ pracālayedbrahman rathasthaṃ tamanāśanam \|*  
*anugāśca kathaṃ cāsya ke ca te anugā kramāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Rudra said — Placing the image of the Sungod In the chariot, how should the chariot be driven? By whom should it be followed? How should one follow the chariot?

## \|\| 1.56.2 \|\|

*bhūyobhūyaḥ suraśreṣṭha vistarānmama śreyase \|*  
*1 vada sarvaṃ jagannātha paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O best of the gods, O lord of the universe, you kindly enlighten me on the subject, since I am quite anxious to learn about the same.

## \|\| 1.56.3 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śanairnayedrathaṃ rudra vartmanā su samena tu \|*  
*yathā paryaṭanaṃ tu syādviṣame pathi gacchataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Brahma said — O Rudra, the chariot which is driven quite slowly on the road, it should be driven similarly.

## \|\| 1.56.4-6 \|\|

*pratīhārarathaṃ pūrvaṃ nayenmārgaviśuddhaye \|*  
*tasmādanantaraṃ rudra daṇḍanāyakamādarāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

*piṅgalaṃ ca tatastasya pṛṣṭhagaṃ cādarānnayet \|*  
*rakṣako dvārako yasmādrathārūḍhau tu pṛṣṭhataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*rathārūḍhastathā diṇḍī devasya purataḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tasmādapi tathā rudra lekhako bhāskarapriyaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. In order to beautify the path, the gatekeepers should first drive the chariot. Thereafter, the staff holders, the chief commander as well as Pingala — the carrier of the flag, should move on. Then should follow the chariot of the guards. Thereafter, the chariot of Dindi should move ahead of the chariot of the Sungod. The chariot of the favourite writer of the Sungod should move on.

## \|\| 1.56.7-12 \|\|

*śanaiḥśanairnayedrudra rathaṃ devasya yatnataḥ \|*  
*yugākṣacakrabhaṅgo vā yathā na syāttrilocana \|\| 7 \|\|*

*īṣābhaṅge dvijabhayaṃ bhagne'kṣe kṣatriyakṣayaḥ \|*  
*tulābhaṅge tu vaiśyānāṃ śayyāśūdrakṣayo bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yugabhaṅge tvanāvṛṣṭiḥ pīṭhabhaṅge prajābhayam \|*  
*paracakrāgamaṃ 1 vidyāccakrabhaṅge rathasya tu \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dhvajasya patane cāpi nṛpabhaṅgaṃ vinirdiśet \|*  
*2 vyaṅgitapratimāyāṃ tu rājño maraṇamādiśet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*chatrabhaṅgādbhayaṃ rudra yuvarājño vinirdiśet \|*  
*utpanneṣvevamādyeṣu utpāteṣvaśubheṣu ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*balikarma punaḥ kuryācchāṃtihomaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*brāhmaṇānvācayedbhūyo dadyāddānāni caiva hi \|\| 12 \|\|*

7-12. O lord with three eyes, the chariot of the Sun should then follow all of them slowly in such a way that no harm is caused to the yoke, the axle and the wheel, because the wooden shaft of the centre of the yoke if broken, it would amount to the danger to the Brahmanas. In case the axis is broken the Kshatriyas would be in danger, and when the axle is broken the Vaishyas shall be in danger. In case of the breaking of the wheel, the state is overpowered by someone else. When the flag falls, the ruler gets destroyed. When the image is broken the king dies and with the fall of chatra the crown gets himself in danger. With the causing of such type of disturbances, the offerings should be poured in the fire altar besides the reciting of the welfare mantras. Thereafter, after listening to the discourse of the Brahmana, he should be pleased with the offering of dakshina.

## \|\| 1.56.13-14 \|\|

*pūrvottare ca digbhāge rathasyāgniṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*samidbhistu ghṛtāktābhirhomayejjātavedasam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*svāhākārānvadansamyagdaivatebhyastvanukramāt \|*  
*grahebhyaśca prajābhyaśca nāmānyuddiśya homayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Thereafter, consecrating the fire in the north-east direction, one should perform homa, pouring the fire sticks soaked in ghi in the names of planets, people and gods, ending with Svaha.

## \|\| 1.56.15 \|\|

*prathamaṃ cāgnaye svāhā svāhā somāya caiva hi \|*  
*svāhā prajāpataye ca deyā āhutayaḥ kramāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Initially, uttering the names of the Agni, Soma and Prajapati ending with the word Svaha, the offering should be made.

## \|\| 1.56.16-18 \|\|

*svastyastviha ca viprebhyaḥ svasti rājñe tathaiva ca \|*  
*gobhyaḥ svasti prajābhyaśca jagataḥ śāntirastu vai \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śaṃ no'stu dvipade nityaṃ śāntirastu catuṣpade \|*  
*śaṃ prajābhyastathaivāstu śaṃ sadātmani cāstu vai \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhūḥ śāntirastu deveśa bhuvaḥ śāntistathaiva ca \|*  
*svaścaivāstu tathā śāntiḥ sarvatrāstu tathā raveḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Thereafter, he should quite humbly pray — “Let the Sungod bestow comfort and peace over the Brahmanas, the rulers, the cows, the people, the entire universe, humans, animals and birds, besides protection to them. Let the Sungod also bestow peace and comfort to the earth, sky and the heaven.”

## \|\| 1.56.19 \|\|

*tvaṃ deva jagataḥ sraṣṭā poṣṭā caiva tvameva hi \|*  
*prajāpāla graheśāna śāntiṃ kuru divaspate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus speaking, he should pray — “O god, you happen to be the creator of the universe, besides being the preserver. O lord of the people, O Maheshana! Kindly bestow grace on me.

## \|\| 1.56.20 \|\|

*idamanyacca vakṣyāmi śāntyā paramakāraṇam \|*  
*yātrākāraṇabhūtasya puruṣasya svajanmanaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. When one is surrounded by misfortunes at the time of the adversities of the planets, the great cause for the same shall be detailed by me separately.

## \|\| 1.56.21-26 \|\|

*duḥsthāngrahāṃśca vijñāya grahaśāntiṃ samācaret \|*  
*prādeśamātrāḥ karttavyāḥ samidho'tha pramāṇataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*arkamayyo raveḥ kāryā pālāśyaḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*khādiryaścaiva bhaumāya āpāmārgyo'bjasūnave \|\| 22 \|\|*

*āśvatthyaścātha jīvāya audumbaryaḥ sitāya ca \|*  
*asitāya śamīmayyo dūrvā kāryastu rāhave \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ketave tu kuśāḥ kāryāḥ dakṣiṇāścāpyataḥ śṛṇu \|*  
*sūryāya śobhanāṃ dhenuṃ śaṃkhaṃ dadyādathendave \|\| 24 \|\|*

*raktamanaḍvāhaṃ bhaumāya kāñcanaṃ somasūnave \|*  
*jīvāya vāsasī deye śukrāyāśvaṃ sitaṃ hara \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śanaiścarāya gāṃ nīlāṃ rāhave bhāṇḍapāyasam \|*  
*chāgaṃ tu ketave dadyācchṛṇveṣāṃ bhojanānyapi \|\| 26 \|\|*

21-26. But when briefly viewing the situation, the planets are in adverse position, something has to be done to appraise them. The homa sticks should be offered for the purpose in the sacred Are, which should be as long as one’s little finger. To appease the Sun the sticks of the swallow wort, sticks of palasha wood for the moon, sticks of Catechu wood for Mars, wood of snake gourd for Mercury, sticks of Pippala wood for Jupiter, wood of wild fig tree for Venus, Sami wood for Saturn, durva for Rahu while Kusha for Ketu should be used as the burning sticks. Besides these, dakshina should also be offered to the Brahmanas as follows. A beautiful cow should be given to please the Sungod, a conch for the moon, red colour bull for Mars, gold for Mercury, two yellow robes for Brihaspati (Jupiter), a white horse for Venus, blue cow for Saturn, payasam in a gold vase and a small male goat for Ketu, in charity. They should also be served with food as is being detailed by me.

## \|\| 1.56.27-29 \|\|

*guḍaudanaṃ tu sūryāya somāya ghṛtapāyasam \|*  
*haviṣyamannaṃ bhaumāya kṣīrānnaṃ somasūnave \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dadhyodanaṃ tu jīvāya śukrāyātha ghṛtāśanam \|*  
*tilapiṣṭāṃśca māṣāśca sūryaputrāya dāpayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

*rāhave dāpayenmāṃsaṃ ketave citramodanam \|*  
*sauvīramāranālaṃ ca svinnabījaṃ ca kāñjikam \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. For Surya, guda with cooked rice should be given; payasam should be given with ghee for the moon; havishya food for Mars; milk with food to Mercury; boiled rice and curd for Jupiter; the best food fried in ghi for Venus; the powder of sesamum powder and black gram for Saturn; meat for Rahu and various types of boiled rice for Ketu. In addition to this, a stick of thorn apple and thorny bush fruit should be offered.

## \|\| 1.56.30 \|\|

*yathā bāṇaprahārāṇāṃ vāraṇaṃ kavacaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*tathā daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. As the kavacha protects a warrior from the attack of arrows, making them infructuous, similarly, in order to protect a person from a natural calamity, the aforesaid performance serves as a protection.

## \|\| 1.56.31 \|\|

*ahiṃsakasya dāntasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca \|*  
*nityaṃ ca niyamasthasya sadā sānugrahā grahāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Thus making use of the riches earned by auspicious, religious and non-violent means, one should always follow the rules of discipline and the persons who do so, the planets always remain favourable to them.

## \|\| 1.56.32 \|\|

*grahāḥ pūjyāḥ sadā rudra icchatā vipulaṃ yaśaḥ \|*  
*śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samācaret \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Therefore, the person enjoying great glory, should always worship the planets. Similarly, the person desirous of peace, should always perform the griha-yajna.

## \|\| 1.56.33-35 \|\|

*vṛṣṭyāyuḥpuṣṭikāmo vā tathaivābhicaranpunaḥ \|*  
*yānapatyā bhavennārī duṣprajāścāpi yā bhavet \|\| 33 \|\|*

*bālā yasyāḥ pramriyante yā ca kanyāprajā bhavet \|*  
*rājyabhraṣṭo nṛpo yastu dīrgharogī ca yo bhavet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*grahayajñaḥ smṛtasteṣāṃ mānavānāṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*tasmādasau sadā kāryaḥ śreyo'rthaṃ jānatā hara \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Similarly, for the fall of ram, long life, development of the limbs of the body and for getting sons or the women who produce daughters alone, or the king fallen from the kingship or for the core of a person with prolonged ailment, the performance of graha-yajna has been prescribed by the learned people. O Rudra, therefore, for a person desirous of welfare, the graha-yajna should be performed.

## \|\| 1.56.36-39 \|\|

*dattapuṣpaḥ krūradṛkca puṣpajo dhiṣaṇastathā \|*  
*sitāsitau tathā rudra uparāgaḥ śikhī tathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ete grahā mahābāho vidvadbhiḥ pūjitāḥ sadā \|*  
*tāmrakātsphāṭikādraktacandanātsvarṇakādapi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rājatādāyasātsīsādgrahāḥ kāryāḥ2 prayatnataḥ \|*  
*svarṇe vātha paṭe lekhyā yathāśāstraṃ maheśvara \|\| 38 \|\|*

*yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca \|*  
*gaṃdhāśca balayaścaiva dhūpo deyaśca guggulaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. O valorous one, the harsh planets like Mercury, the Sun and Mars, the Moon, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu should be adored by the wise people. The figures of the planets made in silver, copper, crystal, red sandal, gold, iron and glass should be made or the figures of the planets should be drawn in a gold vase or cloth. The clothes and flowers should be offered to them according to their colours, besides the fragrance, offerings and guggulu.

## \|\| 1.56.40-42 \|\|

*kartavyā mantra3 vaṃtaśca caravaḥ pratidaivatam \|*  
*ākṛṣṇena imaṃ devā agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakut \|\| 40 \|\|*

*udbudhyasva yathāsaṃkhyamṛca etāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*bṛhaspate atiyadaryastathaivānnātparisrutaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śaṃ no devī tathā kāṃḍātketuṃ kṛṇvannimāḥ kramāt \|*  
*pūrvoktāḥ samidhastvatra yathāśāstraṃ prahomayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. For the yellow deity cam should be offered reciting the mantra. The homa should be performed reciting the mantras: Akrishnena, imam deva, Agnirmurdha..... etc. Reciting these reds, the offering of small sticks should be made in the fire.

## \|\| 1.56.43 \|\|

*ekaikasyāṣṭaśatakamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā \|*  
*hotavyā madhusarpibhyāṃ dadhnā caiva samanvitāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Thus in order to please each individual planet, twenty eight or a hundred and eight offerings should be made with curd, ghi and honey, mixing them up.

## \|\| 1.56.44 \|\|

*pūrvoktabhojanaṃ yaddhi brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet \|*  
*śaktito vā yathālābhaṃ dakṣiṇā tu1 vidhānataḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The Brahmanas should be properly fed, offering the food as detailed earlier. They should be well satisfied. Thereafter, an adequate dakshina should also be given to them.

## \|\| 1.56.45 \|\|

*yaśca yasya yadā duḥsthaḥ sa taṃ yatnena pūjayet \|*  
*mayaiṣā hi varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjayiṣyatha \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Therefore, which ever planet is required to be adored by a person, he should worship the same making all the efforts. Since I have already pronounced a boon on them that they would be adored in the world, therefore, all of you should worship them.

## \|\| 1.56.46 \|\|

*grahādhīnā nareṃdrāṇāmucchrayāḥ patanāni ca \|*  
*bhāvābhāvau ca jagatastasmātpūjyatamā grahāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The rise and fall of the rulers, while the preservation and destruction of the universe come under the purview of the planets. Therefore, the planets have been described as extremely adorable.

## \|\| 1.56.47 \|\|

*grahā gāvo narendrāśca guravo brāhmaṇāstathā \|*  
*pūjitaḥ pūjayantyete nirdahantyapamānitāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Similarly, the cows, the rulers and the Brahmanas when worshipped, they glorify the worshippers. In case of their humiliation, they destroy the entire race.

## \|\| 1.56.48 \|\|

*yathā samutthitaṃ yantraṃ yantreṇaiva prahanyate \|*  
*tathā samutthitāṃ pīḍāṃ grahaśāntyā 3 praśāmayet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. As a yantra meant for destruction is destroyed by another yantra, similarly the pain caused by any planet is subsided by appeasing the planet.

## \|\| 1.56.49 \|\|

*yajvanāṃ satyavākyānāṃ tathā nityopavāsinām \|*  
*japahomaparāṇāṃ ca sarvaṃ duṣṭaṃ praśāmyati \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Those who perform the worship of the plants, performing the yajnas as well or those who are truthful and also perform vratas and fasting besides the japam, get all their miseries removed

## \|\| 1.56.50 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛtvā prajāśāntiṃ kṛtvā ca svastivācanam \|*  
*punaḥ sajjaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā kuryātprakamaṇaṃ hara \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Thus for the welfare of the people, perform the yajnas for peace, besides reciting the welfare mantras and other welfare activities should be performed.

## \|\| 1.56.51-52 \|\|

*mārgaṃ śeṣaṃ nayitvā tu nayeddevālayaṃ ravim \|*  
*pūjayitvā tataḥ 4 pūrvā yāḥ proktā rathadevatāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*yathā pūjyā grahāḥ sarve utpāteṣu trilocana \|*  
*rathadevāstathā5 pūjyā yāḥ sthitā rathamāśritāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Then cutting short of the rest of the movement of the chariot, after concluding the same, the worship of all the deities should done. O three eyed lord, during the time of disturbance, the method of worshipping the planets, similarly all the deities associated with the chariot, should also be worshipped.

## Chapter 57. Description of Ratha-yatra

## \|\| 1.57.1-23 \|\|

*kṛtvā tvārārtikaṃ yatnāddīpatoyayavākṣataiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puruhūtāya bhakṣyāṇi sānugāya nivedayet \|*  
*havirannamagnaye syādagrānnaṃ viṣṇave tathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*rākṣasebhyaḥ samaireyaṃ dadyānmāṃsaudanaṃ hara \|*  
*saṃskṛtaṃ piśitānnaṃ ca revatāya nivedayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tilānnaṃ pitṛrājāya dadyāttripurasūdana \|*  
*āśvinābhyāmapūpāṃstu vasubhyo māṃsamodanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pitṛbhyaḥ pāyasaṃ dadyādghṛtāktaṃ madhunā saha \|*  
*kātyāyanyai yavāgūṃ ca śriyai dadyāttathā dadhi \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sarasvatyai trimadhuraṃ varuṇāyekṣurasaudanam \|*  
*1 khāḍavānnaṃ dhanapatāvevaṃ mitre trilocana \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sasnehena tu takreṇa marudbhyastarpaṇaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*māṃsānnabhaktasūpāṃśca mātṛbhyo vai nivedayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ullepikāśca bhūtebhyo jalaṃ sūryāya vai hara \|*  
*dadyādgaṇādhipataye modakāṃstripurāntaka \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śaṣkulyastu nairṛtāya deyāḥ syurgaṇanāyaka \|*  
*sarvabhakṣyāṇi viśvebhyo dātavyāni samantataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kṣīraudanamṛṣibhyastu kṣīraṃ nāgebhya eva hi \|*  
*sūryarathāya baliṃ dadyātkuryādvai sārvabhautikam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*udvartanaṃ surā māṃsaṃ tadvāhebhyaśca bhārata \|*  
*ājyaṃ ca brahmaṇe dadyāttryambakāya tilāṃstathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*svāhātanaye vai lājā dātavyāstripurāntaka \|*  
*bhāskarāya sadā dadyātkovidāraṃ trilocana \|\| 12 \|\|*

*rājavṛkṣaṃ tathendrāya haviṣyaṃ pāvakāya ca \|*  
*cakriṇe saptadhānyaṃ ca garuḍe matsyamodanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yakṣebhyo vividhānnāni niryāsaṃ revate tyajet \|*  
*vaikaṃkatasrajo rudra yamāya parikīrtitāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*deyaṃ syātkarṇikāraṃ tu aśvibhyāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja \|*  
*śriyai padmāni deyāni caṃḍikāya sucaṃdanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*navanītaṃ sarasvatyai vinatāyai tathāmiṣam \|*  
*puṣpāṇyapsarasāṃ rudra mālatyāḥ parikīrttitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*varuṇāyāgnimanthaṃ tu phalaṃ mūlaṃ nirṛtaye \|*  
*bilvaṃ dadyātkuberāya kapitthaṃ marutāṃ tathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*gaṃdharvebhyastvāragvadhaṃ dadyāttripurasūdana \|*  
*vāsavebhyastu karpūraṃ dadyāddāru gaṇādhipe \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍamūlāni bhūtebhyaśca bibhītakam \|*  
*gobhyo yavānpradadyādvai mātṛbhyaścākṣatānhara \|\| 19 \|\|*

*guggulaṃ vighnapataye viśvebhyo deyamodanam \|*  
*ṛṣibhyo brahmavṛkṣaṃ tu nāgebhyo viṣamuttamam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*madhusarpistathoktāni gairikasya trilocana \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nyagrodhaṃ tasya vāhebhyo bhaktyā rudra nivedayet \|*  
*sāyaṃ prātastu madhyāhne sadaikāgramanā hara \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sarveṣāṃ śaktito bhaktyā 2 daheddhūpaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*mantrato devaśārdūla yo yasyeha prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

1-23. Brahma said — O three eyed lord, for Brahma the porridge made in milk should be given. For Karttikeya fruits should be offered; then honey for Vivasvan besides wine and meat; food for Indra and his attendants; havishyanna for Agni; food for Vishnu; meat and wine for the Rakshasas; pure food for Revata; food with sesamum seeds for the manes; fried cakes for Ashvinikumaras; meat and boiled rice for Vasus; payasam mixed with and honey for the manes; pudding for Katyayani; curd for Shri Lakshmi; ghi for Sarasvati; rice cooked in sugarcane juice for Varuna; food prepared with sugar for Kubera; sweet butter milk for Maruts; beverages beside meat and cooked rice for Matrikas; ullepika for the goblins; water for the Sun; sweet balls for Ganesha; fried cakes for Nairritis; all the eatables for Vishvavasu; milk and cooked rice for the Rishis; milk for serpents; several types of offerings for the bhutas of the chariot; paste for those who draw the chariot besides the wine and meat. Again clarified butter should be offered to Brahma; sesamum for Rudra; pudding for the sons of Svaha; Bambania variegate (kechnara) for Bhaskara; royal tree for Indra; havishya for the fire god; seven cereals for Vishnu, fish and rice for Garuda; several types of food articles for Yakshas; gum for Revata; garland of flowers of thorny shrubs, garland of Karnikara flowers for Ashvinikumaras; lotus for Lakshmi; the best sandal paste for Chandika, butter for Sarasvati, sporting object for Vinata; jasmine flowers for Apsaras; flowers for Varuna; fruit and roots for Nairriti; wood apple for Kubera; wood apple for Maruts; scattered flowers for Gandharvas; camphor for Vasus; Devadaru for Ganesha; carrot for manes; barley for cows; unbroken rice for the Matrikas; guggulu incense for Vighneshvara; boiled rice for Vishvedevas; Palasha tree for the Rishis; sharp venom or dust of lotus flowers for the Nagas; the honey, ghi or gold etc. for Bhaskara; for the driver of the chariot all the things should be given, besides the fruits of the banyan tree should be given. Thus during the morning, noon and evening, the aforesaid articles should be given with devotion, reciting the mantras. Besides, the fragrant incense should also be offered.

## \|\| 1.57.24 \|\|

*śāntyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastu tilāndadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*vaiśvānare vā juhuyād ghṛtena sahitānhara \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. For the attaining of peace, the Brahmanas, mixing ghi in the sesamum seeds, should perform homa.

## \|\| 1.57.25 \|\|

*devānāmamṛtaṃ hyete pitṝṇāṃ hi svadhāmṛtam \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sadā hyetānvidurbudhāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. This is because all these articles are favourites, of the gods, which are nectar like. Similarly, for pitris, Svadha is best suited. The providing of shelter to Brahmanas is equated with the nectar. This has been ordained by the learned people.

## \|\| 1.57.26 \|\|

*kasyapasyāṅgajā hyete pavitrāśca tathā hara \|*  
*snāne dāne tathā home tarpaṇehyaśane parāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Since the gods were born of the body of Kashyapa, they are considered to be very auspicious. Therefore, they should be well respected in the activities like bathing, charities, homa, oblation, food etc.

## \|\| 1.57.27 \|\|

*itthaṃ devāngrahāṃścaiva pūjayitvā prayatnataḥ \|*  
*avatārya rathāccainaṃ maṇḍale sthāpayetpunaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Thus worshipping the gods and others, the image of the Sungod should be removed from the chariot and re-established in its original place.

## \|\| 1.57.28 \|\|

*kārpāsabījalavaṇatuṣairdurdṛṣṭiśāntaye \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Subsequently, for the removal of the misfortune, Arati should be performed offering cotton seeds, salt, husk, barley, unbroken rice and lamp.

## \|\| 1.57.29 \|\|

*vedīmāropayetpaścātpatnībhyāṃ saha suvrata \|*  
*tatrasthaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ dināni daśa suvrata \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thereafter, the Sungod should be consecrated over the pedestals with his two wives, one should continue the worship of the image for ten days continuously.

## \|\| 1.57.30 \|\|

*daśāhiketi vikhyātā yā pūjā bhūtale hara \|*  
*tayā sampūyeddevaṃ caturthe'hni tathā hara \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O Hara, the Dashahi puja which is well known on earth, should also be performed in the same way on the fourth day as well.

## \|\| 1.57.31 \|\|

*caturthe'hani kartavyaṃ yatnāddhi snapanaṃ raveḥ \|*  
*abhyaṅgabhojanādyaistu pūjāsatkāramaṇḍalaiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Therefore, on the fourth day, one should wash the image, applying paste over it. The food should then be offered. Thereafter, with the performing of puja, the deity should be pleased.

## \|\| 1.57.32 \|\|

*anena vidhinā pūjya daśāhāni divākaram \|*  
*tato nayetparaṃ sthānaṃ yattatpūrvamathālayam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus worshipping the Sungod for ten days, the image should again be restored in its original place.

## Chapter 58. Description of Ratha-yatra

## \|\| 1.58.1-2 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu kuryādvā kārayeta vā \|*  
*yātrāṃ bhagavato bhaktyā bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sa parārdhaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|*  
*kule na jāyate tasya daridro vyādhito'pi vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Brahma said — In this way, a person who himself performs the ratha-yatra of the Sungod. or makes others to do so, he is adored in the solar region for long and no one remains poor in his race, nor does anyone attract ailments.

## \|\| 1.58.3 \|\|

*abhyaṅgāya ghṛtaṃ yastu bhāskarāya prayacchati \|*  
*kṛte tu varṇatilake sa gacchetsurabhī 1 puram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Similarly, a person who gives in charity ghi for application of over the Surya image or colour for the same purpose, he reaches the abode of the sacred cow Surabhi.

## \|\| 1.58.4-5 \|\|

*tīrthodakaṃ tu yo bhaktyā gaṃgāyāśca tathodakam \|*  
*snānārthamānayedyastu bhāskarasya trilocana \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhaktyā varṇatrayaṃ dadyādbhāskarasya trilocana \|*  
*samāpyehākhilānkāmānprāpnuyādvaruṇālayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. O three eyed lord, a person who for the bathing of the image of Surya, donates the Gang# water or the water collected from other sacred place, besides colour for the purpose of tilakam, with devotion, he, getting all his desires fulfilled in the world, ultimately reaches Varunaloka.

## \|\| 1.58.6 \|\|

*raktavarṇaṃ tu yo dadyāddhaviṣyānnaṃ guḍaudanam \|*  
*sa gaccheddīptimānrudra sūryalokaṃ puraṃ varam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. One who gives red colour together with sugarcane cakes and mixed rice as havishyanna, such an illustrious person reaches through the abode of the Sungod, after his death.

## \|\| 1.58.7 \|\|

*gacchetpuravare rudra yatra devaḥ prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*snāpayedyastu vā bhaktyā bhāskaraṃ pūjayettathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Similarly, a person who bathes the Sungod with devotion, besides worshipping the same, he surely achieves the place of Prajapati.

## \|\| 1.58.8 \|\|

*sa gaccheddīptimānrudra sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*2 rathamāropayedyastu rathamārgaṃ pramārjati \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The one who establishes the chariot or cleans the path of the chariot, he, undoubtedly, getting illustrious, reaches the abode of the sun.

## \|\| 1.58.9 \|\|

*sa yāti vātasālokyaṃ vātatulyaparākramaḥ \|*  
*rathasya gacchato yastu mārge kuryātsumaṇḍalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A person who creates a beautiful mandapa over the path of the Surya’s chariot, he becoming powerful like the windgod, lives in the abode of Vayu.

## \|\| 1.58.11 \|\|

*sa lokaṃ prāpnuyātpuṇyaṃ yaḥ kuryānmārgamādarāt \|*  
*puṣpaprakaraśobhāḍhyaṃ 3 śubhatoraṇamaṇḍitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A person who decorates the path of the Sun’s chariot or makes a beautiful gateway over it with flower decorations, he achieves the auspicious loka.

## \|\| 1.58.12 \|\|

*śaṃkhatūryaninādāḍhyaṃ tathā4 prekṣaṇakānvitam \|*  
*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo vibhāvasuḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A person who creates the sound of musical instruments on the way, he achieves the best of the place in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.58.13 \|\|

*devena sahito yastu nṛtyangāyaṃstathārcayan \|*  
*kuryānmahotsavaṃ bhaktyā sa yāti paramaṃ padam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A person who remains awake in the festivities of the Sungod, he attains long life in the world.

## \|\| 1.58.14 \|\|

*prajāgaraṃ yastu kuryāddeve rathagate ravau \|*  
*sa sukhī puṇyavānnityaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. One who arranges dancing and singing over the path of the chariot movement, besides organizing other festivities, he achieves the supreme position and achieving all the comforts, enjoys long life.

## \|\| 1.58.15 \|\|

*bhaktadāsādikaṃ 1 sarvaṃ yo dadāti ravernaraḥ \|*  
*samprāpyehākhilānkāmānsūryalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. One who presents the slaves for the purpose, all his desires are fulfilled and he ultimately reaches the abode of Surya.

## \|\| 1.58.16 \|\|

*rathārūḍhasya sūryasya bhramato darśanaṃ hara \|*  
*durlabhaṃ devaśārdūla viśeṣātpurato vrajan \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O lion among the deities, the sight of the Sungod moving in a chariot is difficult to get.

## \|\| 1.58.17 \|\|

*uttarābhimukhaṃ yāntaṃ tathā vai dakṣiṇāmukham \|*  
*dhanyaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhaktavatsalam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Therefore, facing north or the south, when one gets an audience of the Sungod — the favourite of devotees, they are indeed graceful.

## \|\| 1.58.18-19 \|\|

*atha saṃvatsare prāpye bhānoryātrādine yadi \|*  
*rathaprakamaṇaṃ tatra na kathañcitkṛtaṃ bhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tato vai dvādaśe varṣe kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|*  
*indradhvajasya cāpyevaṃ yadi notthāpanaṃ kṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. In case one fails to arrange the yatra of the Sungod at the start of the year, then the person desirous of welfare, must organize the ratha — yatra in the twelfth year. Similarly, if the flag of Indra is not raised, still the similar procedure has been prescribed for the same.

## \|\| 1.58.20-22 \|\|

*tato vai dvādaśe varṣe kartavyaṃ nāntarā punaḥ \|*  
*yātrāyāścāpi ye bhaṅgaṃ kurvanti vṛṣabhadhvaja \|\| 20 \|\|*

*mandehā nāma te jñeyā rākṣasā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ye kurvanti tathā yātrāṃ narā dharmadhvajasya tu \|\| 21 \|\|*

*indrādidevāste jñeyā gatāśca paramaṃ padam \|*  
*punaryātrāvidhiṃ cemaṃ samāsātkathayāmi te \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. O bull-bannered lord, the yatra must be performed in the twelfth year, it should then be arranged every year regularly, because the person who misses the yatra, should be treated as Mandeha Rakshasa. Those who perform the ratha-yatra of the Sungod, they equate with the gods like Indra and achieve the highest position. Therefore, I am briefly repeating the method of the yatra.

## \|\| 1.58.23-24 \|\|

*yaṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*vartamāne tu vai māghe rathe 2 devagaṇāśrite \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sa tasminneva manasā sthāpanīyo rathopari \|*  
*dyaurmahī ca dvimūrtisthe yathāpūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhite \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Listening to which all the people would be relieved of all the sins. During the month of Margashirsha, after lodging all the deities in the chariot, two images of the sky and the earth should also be mentally consecrated in the chariot

## \|\| 1.58.25 \|\|

*tathaiva rājñī dyaurjñeyā nikṣubhā pṛthivī smṛtā \|*  
*etābhyāmapi devībhyāṃ yathaiva savitustathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. This is because, the Devi represents the sky and Nikshubha has been equated with the earth.

## \|\| 1.58.26 \|\|

*diṇḍinaḥ piṃgalādīnāṃ pṛthuḥ kāryo rathakramaḥ \|*  
*manasā cintayedanyāṃ yathāsthāneṣu devatām \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. All other deities like Dindi and Pingala should also be mentally arranged, which is quite essential.

## \|\| 1.58.27 \|\|

*dikpālāṃllokapālāṃśca kalpayetmanasaiva tu \|*  
*devo vedamayaścāyaṃ sarvadevamayastathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Similarly, the Dikpalas and Lokapalas should also be mentally lodged there. The Sungod represents the Vedas besides all the deities.

## \|\| 1.58.28-30 \|\|

*maṃḍalamṛṅmayaṃ caiva chandāṃsyāsyaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*gāyatrī caiva triṣṭupca jagatyanuṣṭubeva ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

*paṃktiśca bṛhatī caiva uṣṇigeva ca saptamī \|*  
*tato devamayātvācca cchandasāṃ caiva kalpanāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tato vedamayātvācca taraṇirlokapūjitaḥ \|*  
*1 rathaprakamaṇātsūryo voḍhavyo brahmavādibhiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Their mandala has the form of richas. Therefore, Gayatri, Trishtupa, Jagati, Anushtupa, Pankti, Brihati and Ushnika are the seven prominent chandas (metres). Since the Sungod represents all the deities as well as the Vedas, in the background of the chandas, he is adorable by all. Therefore, for the driving of his chariot, all the spokespersons of Brahman should follow all the rules. They should be quite learned, well-versed in the Vedas and Vedangas, and should be engaged for the purpose.

## \|\| 1.58.31 \|\|

*upavāsaparairyuktairvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ \|*  
*rathaṃ tu nāruhecchūdro bhāskarasya trilocana \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. O three eyed one, a Shudra should not be seated over the chariot of the Sun.

## \|\| 1.58.32 \|\|

*āruhya taraṇeryānaṃ vrajecchūdro hyadhogatim \|*  
*yathoktakaraṇādrudra sadā śāntirbhavennṛṇām \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Because in case he is seated over the same, then he would face miserable condition. O Rudra, the person should follow the method spoken out by me and if he does so, he shall always achieve peace.

## \|\| 1.58.33-34 \|\|

*nāyakaścāpi sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ tu2 divākaraḥ \|*  
*vinyasettu rathānāṃ tu devatāyataneṣu ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tato dhūpopahāraistu pūjayetprathamaṃ ravim \|*  
*digdevānucarāṃścaiva pūjayetpūjyate śriyā \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Since Divakara happens to be the leader of all the deities, therefore, he with all the gods, should be seated first. Then the Sungod should be worshipped first offering presents and gifts besides incense. Thereafter, all other deities should be worshipped. A person who does so, he getting all the riches, is honoured by the people.

## \|\| 1.58.35 \|\|

*apūjya prathamaṃ sūryamaparānyastu pūjayet \|*  
*3 tattadbhūtakṛtaṃ pādyaṃ na pragṛhṇanti devatāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A person who neglecting the Sungod adores the other deities initially, the offerings so made by him are not accepted by the deities.

## \|\| 1.58.36 \|\|

*yātrākāle tu samprāpte 4 saviturdīkṣitāṃ tanum \|*  
*ye drakṣyaṃti narā bhaktyā te bhaviṣyantyakalmaṣāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. In this way, one who has a view of the image of the Sungod, he is freed of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.58.37 \|\|

*paurṇamāsyāmamāyāṃ ca darśanaṃ puṇyadaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*saptamyāṃ ca tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dine tasya ravestathā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Similarly, an audience of the image of the Sungod on full moon day, a moonless day, or the seventh or sixth moon days of a month, is said to be quite meritorious.

## \|\| 1.58.38 \|\|

*āṣāḍhī kārttikī māghī tithyaḥ puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*mahābhāgyaṃ tithe puṇyaṃ yathā śāstreṣu gīyate \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The moon days of the months of Ashadha, Margashirsha and Karttika are quite auspicious, because their sanctity has been testified in the scriptures.

## \|\| 1.58.39 \|\|

*kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa mahākārtikyudāhṛtā \|*  
*evaṃ kālasamāyogādyātrākālo viśiṣyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The adoration of the Sun in the month of Karttika is of special importance and because the puja of the Sungod in the month of Karttika has been termed Mahakarttiki. Thus, the yatra period has been prescribed according to the time, which has special importance.

## \|\| 1.58.40-41 \|\|

*darśanaṃ ca mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ bhavet \|*  
*upavāsaparo yastu tasminkāle yatavrataḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*pūjayettu1 raviṃ bhaktyā sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim \|*  
*devo'yaṃ yajñapuruṣo lokānugrahakāṃkṣayā \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. To have an audience with the Sungod during that particular time is of special importance. A person who during that period performing vrata, keeps fast and worships the Sun with devotion, he attains the highest position. Therefore, in order to bestow special grace over the people, Surya has been described to be a yajna Purusha.

## \|\| 1.58.42-43 \|\|

*pratimāvasthito bhūtvā pūjāṃ gṛhṇātyanugrahāt \|*  
*snānāddānājjapāddhomātsaṃyogāddevakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*kūrcānāṃ vapanāccaiva dīkṣitaḥ puruṣo bhavet \|*  
*kacānāṃ vāpanaṃ kāryaṃ sūryabhaktaiḥ sadā naraiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. The Sungod, getting surrounded with his lustre, showing his grace on you, accepts your offerings. By offering Surya water for bath, charities, japam, homa etc., and with the showing of the beard, the people get initiated. Therefore, the devotee of the Sungod should always get his head shaved.

## \|\| 1.58.44 \|\|

*sūryakratau śucistvevaṃ dīkṣitaḥ puruṣo bhavet \|*  
*caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ bhaktyā sūryasya nityadā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. In the yajna for the Sungod, the people of all the four varnas get initiated and purified.

## \|\| 1.58.45 \|\|

*evaṃ ye'tra kariṣyanti te narā nityadīkṣitāḥ \|*  
*cīrṇavratā mahātmānaste yāsyanti parāṃ gatim \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thus, those who always keep on performing the yajna, they always getting initiated, would achieve the supreme position.

## \|\| 1.58.46 \|\|

*ityeṣā kathitā rudra rathayātrā divaspateḥ \|*  
*yāṃ śrutvā vācayitvā sarvarogairvimucyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O Rudra, I have thus spoken about the yatra of the Sungod, hearing or narrating which, all the people are relieved of their ailments.

## \|\| 1.58.47-48 \|\|

*kṛtvā ca vidhivadbhaktyā yāti sūryasado naraḥ \|*  
*rathāhvā kathitā rudra samāsātsaptamī śubhā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*bhūyo'pi śrūyatāṃ rudra saptamī gadato mama \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. By completing the yatra appropriately, one achieves the heaven. O Rudra, I have apprised you of the importance of Rat ha — Saptami in brief, still, I am defining the seventh moon day, which you please listen.

## Chapter 59. Ratha-yatra of the Sungod

## \|\| 1.59.1-3 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*māghe māsi tathā deva site pakṣe jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito bhūtvā gandhapuṣpopahārataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā dinakaraṃ rātrau tasyāgrataḥ svapet \|*  
*vibuddhastvatha saptamyāṃ bhaktyā bhānuṃ samarcayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścādvittaśāṭhyaṃ1 vivarjayet \|*  
*khaṇḍaveṣṭairmodakaiśca tathekṣuguḍapūpakaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Brahma said — On the sixth bright moon day of the month of Magha, controlling one’s senses, while fasting, offering fragrance and flowers, and performing the worship of the Sungod, one should sleep before the image. Then waking upon the seventh moon day in the morning, one should worship the Sungod with devotion. One should serve the Brahmanas without showing any type of miserliness, feed them well.

## \|\| 1.59.4 \|\|

*atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe saptamyāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*devadevasya vai yātrāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā hara \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O Hara, then at the close of the year on the seventh moon day, one should perform the Ratha-yatra of the Sungod as has been related by me earlier.

## \|\| 1.59.5 \|\|

*kṛṣṇapakṣe tu yaḥ kṛtvā rathamārohitaṃ ravim \|*  
*paśyedbhaktyā jagannāthaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. A person who can get an audience with the Sungod seated over the chariot in the dark fortnight he achieves the highest position.

## \|\| 1.59.6-7 \|\|

*tṛtīyāyāmaikabhaktaṃ caturthyāṃ naktamucyate \|*  
*pañcamyāmayācitaṃ syātṣaṣṭhyāṃ caivamupoṣaṇam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāddṛṣṭvā devaṃ rathe sthitam \|*  
*pūjayitvā ca vidhinā śaktyā bhaktyā trilocana \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Similarly, on the third moon day, one should take food once and should fast on the night of fourth moon day. On the fifth moon day, he should consume the food which is not begged from anyone and observe a fast on the sixth moon day. On the seventh moon day, he should have a sight of the Sungod seated in the chariot, with devotion. Then he should break his fast as per his means, after worshipping the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.59.8 \|\|

*sauvarṇaṃ tu rathaṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātropari sthitam \|*  
*rathamadhye nyasedvyoma pūjitaṃ maṇibhirhara \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The chariot should be made of gold and the image should be placed in a copper vase. Then the centre of the chariot should be decorated with gems.

## \|\| 1.59.9-12 \|\|

*padmarāgaṃ nyasenmadhye mauktikaṃ pūrvato nyaset \|*  
*iṃdranīlamatho yāmyāṃ vāruṇyāṃ marakataṃ hara \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pravālamuttare rudra savajraṃ vinyased budhaḥ \|*  
*śvetaṃ pītāsitaṃ cāpi raktaṃ cāndhakasūdana \|\| 10 \|\|*

*etāni tāta vastrāṇi dikṣu sarvāsu vinyaset \|*  
*patākākārasaṃsthānaṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*puṣpairdāmairalaṃkṛtya rathaṃ rudra samantataḥ \|*  
*yathānyāyaṃ pūjayitvā bhāskarāya nivedayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. Ruby should be placed in the middle of the chariot, a bead in the east, sapphire in the south, emerald in the west and coral should be placed in the north, decorating the chariot. It should further be decorated with the pieces of cloth of white, yellow, black and red cloths, on all the sides. Besides the flags, bell, flowers and the garlands should be used for decoration. Thereafter, the same should be offered to the Sungod appropriately.

## \|\| 1.59.13-14 \|\|

*bhojayitvātha vā viprānācāryāya nivedayet \|*  
*yo'dhīte saptamīkalpaṃ sopākhyānaṃ ca bhārata \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ācāryaḥ sa dvijo jñeyo varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ \|*  
*saurāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu śaivānāṃ pārvatīpriya \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Again serving food to the Brahmanas, the chariot should be given in charity to the Acharya. O Bharata, O beloved of Parvati, a person who with this episode recites the Saptami kalpa, he becomes Acharya of all the four varnas, besides the Vaishnavas and Shaivas.

## \|\| 1.59.15 \|\|

*alābhe tu suvarṇasya rathaṃ rājatamādiśet \|*  
*tadalābhe tāmramayaṃ rathaṃ vyoma ca kārayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In case the gold could not be procured for the making of the chariot, then the silver can be used for the purpose, and in the absence of silver, copper could be used.

## \|\| 1.59.16-18 \|\|

*abhāve cāpi tāmrasya rathaḥ piṣṭamayaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*sahiraṇyo 1 mahādeva tāmrabhājanamāśritaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*2 kauśeyayugmasahitaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*pūrvoktāya mahādeva vācakāya mahātmane \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ gubhagandhādhivāsitam \|*  
*svaśaktyā tu virūpākṣa vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. In case the copper is also not available, then the chariot can be made of the wheat flour. O Mahadeva, thus placing the golden chariot in the copper vase, it should be offered to the Brahmanas, who recites the scriptures with two silk pieces of cloth. He should also be given as per one’s means the five gems as well as the scents and the complete worship.

## \|\| 1.59.19 \|\|

*eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā rathāhvā saptamī hara \|*  
*kathitā te mayā rudra mahatīyaṃ prakīrtitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O Rudra, this puja which removes the sins has been narrated to you by me, which is also called Ratha-saptami.

## \|\| 1.59.20 \|\|

*snānaṃ dānamatho homaḥ pūjā grahapaterhara \|*  
*śatasāhasraṃ bhavedasyāṃ kṛtaṃ bhūdharavidyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. During the saptami, the bathing, charities given, homos performed and adoration are thousand times more beneficial. Therefore, the seventh moon day of the month of Magha has been considered to be thousand times more beneficial.

## \|\| 1.59.21 \|\|

*evameṣā puṇyatamā māghe proktā tu saptamī \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro bhaktyā sūryasyānucaro bhavet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Therefore, the seventh moon day of the month of Magha has been said to be extremely auspicious, because a person performing vrata on this particular saptami becomes an attendant of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.59.22 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo yāti devatvaṃ kṣatriyo vipratāṃ vrajet \|*  
*vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ yāti śūdro vaiśyatvameti ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. With the influence of this auspicious day, the Brahmana becomes a deity, Kshatriya becomes a Brahmana, Vaishya becomes a Kshatriya and a Shudra becomes a Vaishya.

## \|\| 1.59.23 \|\|

*vidyāvinayasampannaṃ bharttāraṃ 3 kanyakā labhet \|*  
*aputrā strī sutaṃ vindetsaumāgyaṃ ca gaṇādhipa \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A girl gets a husband who is bestowed with humility and learnings, the woman gets a son, besides the fortunes.

## \|\| 1.59.24 \|\|

*vidhavā cāpyupoṣyemāṃ saptamīṃ tripurāntaka \|*  
*nānyajanmasu vaidhavyaṃ prāpnuyātpārvatīpriya \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O killer of Tripura and beloved of Parvati, even the women should also perform this vrata because by so doing, they do not have to face widowhood.

## \|\| 1.59.25 \|\|

*bahuputrā bahudhanā patyurvallabhatāṃ vrajet \|*  
*yāvadvai sapta janmāni striyastu puruṣāstathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. On the other hand, they achieve many sons, enormous wealth and remain favourite of their husbands. Similarly, by perfuming this vrata, a man attains all the benefits.

## \|\| 1.59.26 \|\|

*evaṃvidhā saptamī te kathitā vṛṣabhadhvaja \|*  
*yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate brahmahatyayā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O bull-bannered lord, thus I have revealed the auspiciousness of the saptami-vrata performing which a person is relieved even of the sin of Brahmahatya.

## Chapter 60. Ratha-yatra of Suryadeva

## \|\| 1.60.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ityuktvā sa jagāmāśu surajyeṣṭhaṃ trilocanam \|*  
*rathayātrā mahābāho sūryasyetyamitaujasaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O long armed one, after narrating the importance of the Ratha-yatra of the Sungod to Rudra, Brahma rapidly left the place.

## \|\| 1.60.2-3 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*yamārādhya jagannāthaṃ mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭyarthaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu annamāpuścaturvidham \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tasya devasya māhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ ca bahuśo mayā \|*  
*devarṣisiddhamanujaiḥ stutasya hi dinedine \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Shatanika said — By worshipping the lord of the universe, my ancestors, pleasing the Brahmanas, achieved four types of cereals. The same lord of the universe is adored daily by the gods, Siddhas and humans, I have heard the glory of the same lord many times.

## \|\| 1.60.4-5 \|\|

*kaḥ stotumīśastamajaṃ1 yasyaitatsacarācaram \|*  
*avyayasyāprameyasya vibudhyetodayājjagat \|\| 4 \|\|*

*karābhyāṃ yasya deveśau kaviṣṇū lokapūjitau \|*  
*utpannau dvijaśārdūla lalāṭāttripurāntakaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Therefore, who can praise him because he is unborn, the entire mobile and immobile world belongs to him. He is beyond destruction and beyond imagination. With his rising, the whole world is awakened and because of him alone, the world renowned Brahma and Vishnu have emerged out of his forehead.

## \|\| 1.60.6-8 \|\|

*tasya devasya kaiḥ śakyā vaktuṃ sarvā vibhūtayaḥ \|*  
*so'hamicchāmi devasya tasya sarvātmanā dvija \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śrotumārādhanaṃ yena nistareyaṃ bhavārṇavam \|*  
*kenopāyena mantrairvā rahasyaiḥ paricaryayā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dānairvṛtopavāsairvā homairjāpyairathāpi vā \|*  
*ārādhitaḥ samastānāṃ kleśānāṃ hānido bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Therefore, who could be competent to describe the glory of the said lord? O Brahmana, again his adoration in the morning, enables a person to cross the ocean of the universe. I am desirous to hear about that glory. You also tell me about his secrets, the way one should serve him, give charities in his name and perform fastings or homas in his favour besides the homas to achieve liberation.

## \|\| 1.60.9-11 \|\|

*saikā vidyā hi vidyānāṃ yayā tuṣyati sarvakṛt \|*  
*śrutānāmapi tatpuṇyaṃ yatra bhānoḥ prakīrtanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ tadyena haṃsaḥ prasīdati \|*  
*ekaḥ śreṣṭhatamo maṃtrastadekaṃ paramaṃ vratam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*upoṣitaṃ ca tacchreṣṭhaṃ yena bhānuḥ prasīdati \|*  
*sā caikā rasanā dhanyā mārtaṇḍaṃ stauti yā sadā \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. This is the best of all the lores as has been claimed in the scriptures, by which the lord gets pleased. The singing of the glory of the Sungod has also been praised in the Vedas, besides being auspicious. Similarly, out of all the secrets, only that secret is the best, the same is the best of all the vratas and the same fasting is the best by which the Sungod is pleased. Graceful is the tongue of a person which recites the glory of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.60.12-16 \|\|

*tadekaṃ nirmalaṃ cittaṃ 1 yadgataṃ satataṃ ravau \|*  
*ślāghyānāmapi tau ślāghyāviha loke paratra ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yo sadā dvijaśārdūla bhānoḥ pūjākarau karau \|*  
*tadekaṃ kevalaṃ dhanyaṃ śarīraṃ sarvajantuṣu \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yadeva pulakodbhāsi bhānornāmānukīrtane \|*  
*sā jihvā kaṇṭhatālūkamatha vā pratijihvikā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*atha vā sāparo rogo yā na vakti raverguṇam \|*  
*navadvārāṇi santyasminpure puruṣasattama \|\| 15 \|\|*

*prākāraistvāvṛte viṣvagvṛthā tāni vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*dattvāvadhānaṃ yacchabde vinaiva ravisaṃstutim \|\| 16 \|\|*

12-16. The same thinking is spotless by which the Sungod is always meditated upon. Similarly, the hands of the people are praised in this as well as the future world, with which the Sungod is always worshipped and the name of the Sungod is recited in such a way that it creates thrill in the body. Among all the creatures, only the same body is graceful among them. Therefore, the tongue with palate and throat which sings the glory of the Sungod is indeed the true tongue, but the one which does not recite the glory of the Sungod it cannot be called a tongue but an ailment. O best of the humans, the body which is surrounded by a boundary wall has nine doors, therefore, when the name of the Sungod is recited without the concentration of mind, it proves to be of no use.

## \|\| 1.60.17 \|\|

*śreyasāṃ na hi. samprāptau puruṣāṇāṃ viceṣṭitam \|*  
*janmanyaviphalā sevā kṛtā yāśritya bhāskaram \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In case the people do not make efforts to worship the Sungod, then those efforts shall not be fruitful. That is the only successful service in one’s life.

## \|\| 1.60.18-19 \|\|

*durgasaṃsārakāṃtāramapāramabhidhāvatām \|*  
*eko bhānunamaskāraḥ saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*ratnānāmākaro meruḥ sarvāścaryamayaṃ nabhaḥ \|*  
*tīrthānāmāśrayo gaṃgā devānāmāśrayo raviḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Therefore, the people who wander in the forest of the universe, in case they offer salutation to the Sungod even once, it could ease them successfully to move beyond the ocean of the universe. The Meru mountain is the everlasting storehouse, while the sky possesses astonishing type of surprises. Ganga is the refuge of all the holy places, while the Sungod is the refuge of all these.

## \|\| 1.60.20 \|\|

*evamādiguṇo bhogo bhānoramitatejasaḥ \|*  
*śruto me bahuśaḥ siddhairgīyamānaistathāmaraiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The Sungod with the enormous merits is eulogized by all the gods always. This has been heard by me several times.

## \|\| 1.60.21-22 \|\|

*so'hamicchāmi taṃ devaṃ saptalokaparāyaṇam \|*  
*divākaramaśeṣasya jagato hṛdyavasthitam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ārādhayitumīśeśaṃ bhāskaraṃ cāmitaujasam \|*  
*mārtaṇḍaṃ bhuvanādhāraṃ smṛtamātrāghadāriṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. He is the refuge for all the seven worlds and dwells in the hearts of the people of all the worlds. He is the support of the worlds, and with his mere thinking, all the sins are washed out. He is the lord of all the gods. Therefore, I would like to worship him.

## Chapter 61. The glory of Sungod

## \|\| 1.61.1-2 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*tamekamakṣaraṃ dhāma paraṃ sadasatormahat \|*  
*bhedābhedasvarūpasthaṃ praṇipatya raviṃ nṛpa \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pravakṣyāmi yathāpūrvaṃ viriñcena mahātmanā \|*  
*ṛṣīṇāṃ kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ taṃ nibodha narādhipa \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — O king, I offer my salutation to the eternal Sungod who is the highest place to be achieved by all, who is unparallel and beyond differentiation, besides being unique, beyond sat and asat. I am speaking about him, which was revealed to me by Brahma. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.61.3 \|\|

*ārādhanāya saviturmahātmā padmasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*yogaṃ brahmaparaṃ prāha maharṣīṇāṃ yathā prabhuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Brahma had revealed the Brahma — pradhana yoga, which is to concentrate himself from the outside world and enables him to achieve the Kaivalya-pada.

## \|\| 1.61.4-6 \|\|

*samastavṛttisaṃrodhātkaivalyapratipādakam \|*  
*tadā jagatpatirbrahmā praṇipatya maharṣibhiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sarvaiḥ kilokto bhagavānātmayoniḥ prajāhitam \|*  
*yoyaṃ yogo bhagavatā prokto vṛttinirodhajaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*prāptuṃ śakyaḥ sa tvanekairjanmabhirjagataḥ pate \|*  
*viṣayā durjayā nṝṇāmindriyākarṣiṇaḥ prabho \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. At that point of time, the Rishis after offering salutation to Brahma, said — “O lord of the universe, you have revealed the yoga for the concentration of mind and for the benefit of all the people, which forces the people to get attracted. Therefore, the people cannot become victorious over it.

## \|\| 1.61.7 \|\|

*vṛttayaścetasaścāpi cañcalasyāpi durdharā \|*  
*rāgādayaḥ kathaṃ jetuṃ śakyā varṣaśatairapi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O Brahman, on the one hand, the mind is quite unstable and at the same time, it is quite difficult to control it Because of this, we cannot exercise control over the same in the hundreds of years.

## \|\| 1.61.8-10 \|\|

*na yogayogyaṃ bhavati mana ebhiranirjitaiḥ \|*  
*alpāyuṣaśca puruṣā brahmankṛtayugepyamī \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kimu prāpte kalau yuge \|*  
*bhagavaṃstvāmupāsīnānprasanno vaktumarhasi \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anāyāsena yenaiva uttarema bhavārṇavam \|*  
*duḥkhāmbumagnāḥ puruṣāḥ prāpya brahmanmahāplavam \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Thus without overcoming the same, which always remains invoked in one way or the other, how could it be made suitable for the performing of the yogic practices? On the other hand, the people are short lived. When such is the case with the Treta yuga, then what to speak of the age of Kaliyuga? All of us have reached before you, therefore, you getting pleased! Tell us as to how the people who are always drowning in the ocean of the universe, could cross the same?”

## \|\| 1.61.11-12 \|\|

*uttarema bhavāmbhodhiṃ tathā tvamanuciṃtaya \|*  
*evamuktastadā brahmākriyāyogaṃ mahātmanām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*teṣāmṛṣīṇāmācaṣṭa narāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā \|*  
*ārādhayata viśveśaṃ divākaramatandritāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. When so questioned by the people, Brahma said to them — “This is the kriya yoga which can be beneficial for the people. Therefore, the worship of the Sungod with the human body should be performed quite carefully.

## \|\| 1.61.13-14 \|\|

*bāhyālambanasāpekṣāstamajaṃ jagataḥ patim \|*  
*ijyāpūjānamaskāraśuśrūṣābhiraharniśam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vratopavāsairvividhairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ \|*  
*taistaiścābhimataiḥ kāmairye ca cetasi tuṣṭidāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. In this way, the Sungod should be worshipped, performing the yajna or salutations, service, vratas and fasting, throughout the day and night making all the efforts, besides feeding the Brahmanas and by similar deeds, performing which the mind feels delighted.

## \|\| 1.61.15-19 \|\|

*aparicchedyamāhātmyamārādhayata bhāskaram \|*  
*tanniṣṭhāstadgatadhiyastatkarmāṇastadāśrayāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*taddṛṣṭayastanmanasaḥ sarvasmintsa1 iti sthitāḥ \|*  
*samastānyatha karmāṇi tatra sarvātmanātmani \|\| 16 \|\|*

*saṃnyasadhvaṃ sa vaḥ karttā samastāvaraṇakṣayam \|*  
*etattadakṣaraṃ brahma pradhānapuruṣāvubhau \|\| 17 \|\|*

*2 yato yasminyathā cobhau sarvayyāpinyavasthitau \|*  
*paraḥ parāṇāṃ paramaḥ saikaḥ sumanasāṃ paraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yasmādbhinnamidaṃ sarvaṃ 3 yaccedaṃ yacca neṅgati \|*  
*mokṣakāraṇamavyaktamacintyamaparigraham \|*  
*samārādhya jagannāthaṃ kriyāyogena mucyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. It is because by practicing this, the Sungod gets pleased. Therefore, devoting one’s mind in him and depending on him, turning one’s mind toward him, one should perform all the deeds in his favour. It is because he remains present in all the beings and all the deeds get enshrined in him. He happens to be your creator and also destroys all your blemishes. He is undestructible Brahman and Pradhana Purusha. Both the positions are enshrined in the Sungod. He is the best of all and beyond the gods. He is the one. Getting reported from him, the entire universe now can make any effort and the mind which is the cause of moksha is unthinkable and beyond the reach of a person. Therefore, the Sungod who is the lord of the universe, should be adored by means of kriya-yoga and by so doing a person gets successful.”

## \|\| 1.61.20-21 \|\|

*iti te brahmaṇaḥ śrutvā rahasyamṛṣisattamāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*narāṇāmupakārāya yogaśāstrāṇi cakrire \|*  
*kriyāyogaparāṇīha muktikārīṇyanekaśaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Thereafter, the excellent Rishis, listening to the secret ways of the worship, for the benefit of the people, composed several of the scriptures dealing with kriya-yoga, which bestow redemption from the world.

## \|\| 1.61.22 \|\|

*ārādhyate jagannāthastadanuṣṭhānatatparaiḥ \|*  
*paramātmā sa mārtaṇḍaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. With the practicing of the same kriya — yoga, people adore the Sungod, who is the supreme soul, known as Martanda — the lord of all and pervading all the places.

## \|\| 1.61.23-24 \|\|

*yānyuktāni purā tena brahmaṇā kurunandana \|*  
*tāni te kuruśārdūla sarvapāpaharāṇyaham \|\| 23 \|\|*

*vakṣyāmi śrūyatāmadya rahasyamidamuttamam \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ viṣayākrāṃtacetasām \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. O son of the Kuru race, whatever was spoken by Brahma earlier, removes all the sins. But I am going to speech out something more. There is another secret subject for those drowning in oceanic water of the universe. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.61.25-27 \|\|

*haṃsapotaṃ vinā nānyatkiṃcidasti parāyaṇam \|*  
*uttiṣṭhaṃściṃtaya raviṃ vrajaṃściṃtaya gopatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

*bhuñjaṃściṃtaya mārtaṃḍaṃ svapāṃściṃtaya bhāskaram \|*  
*evamekāgracittastvaṃ saṃśritaḥ satataṃ ravim \|\| 26 \|\|*

*janmamṛtyumahāgrāhaṃ saṃsārāmbhastariṣyasi \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. For the rescue of the persons overpowered with the worldly passions, in which the birth and death are like the huge crocodiles, only the secret worship of lord Martanda is the way out to cross this oceanic world of sorrow and sufferings.

## \|\| 1.61.28 \|\|

*graheśamīśaṃ varadaṃ purāṇaṃ jagadvidhātāramajaṃ ca nityam \|*  
*samāśritā ye ravimīśitāraṃ teṣāṃ bhavo nāsti vimuktibhājām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Therefore, the Sungod, who is the lord of the plants, bestower of boons, having no birth and those who take refuge in the Sungod, they surely get redeemed. They will not have to be reborn.

## Chapter 62. Conversation between the Sungod and Dindi

## \|\| 1.62.1 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*haṃta diṇḍe prasanno'smi bhaktyā stotreṇa te'nagha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — Now I shall relate the conversation between the Sungod and Dindi, which is quite secretive and can remove all the sins.

## \|\| 1.62.2 \|\|

*brahmahatyābhibhūtastu parā diṃḍirmahātapāḥ \|*  
*ārādhanāya devasya stotraṃ cakre mahātmanaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. In earlier times, Dindi — the great ascetic, once attracted the sin of the killing of a Brahmana. In order to get rid of the misery, he worshipped lord Surya, and composed a stotra.

## \|\| 1.62.3 \|\|

*śrutvā tasyārthataḥ stotraṃ tutoṣa bhagavānraviḥ \|*  
*uvāca devadevastaṃ diṇḍinaṃ gaṇanāyakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Listening to it with its meaning, lord Suryadeva was pleased and he said to Dindi — the leader of the ganas.

## \|\| 1.62.4 \|\|

*sarvabhūteṣu māṃ paśyanmamavasthitamīśvaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Aditya said — O Dindi, I am extremely pleased with the poem composed and recited by you. O learned one, you better speak what you desire from me.

## \|\| 1.62.5 \|\|

*diṇḍiruvāca \|*  
*eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yatprāpto'si mamāntikam \|*  
*tvaddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ svapneṣvapi ca durlabham \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Dindi said — You have arrived before me, which is an act of great kindness on me. This in itself is a boon which is quite praiseworthy. An audience with you is beyond the reach of the sinful people even in dream.

## \|\| 1.62.6 \|\|

*yathaiṣā brahmahatyā me āgatā lokagarhitā \|*  
*bhavāñjānāti sarveśo hadisthaḥ sarvadehinām \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. But the deplorable Brahmahatya which I know not, how I got it? It could be known by the lord who resides in the heart of all the living beings.

## \|\| 1.62.7 \|\|

*tvatprasādānmameśāna3 nāśamāśu prayātu vai \|*  
*tathā ca duritaṃ sarvaṃ yaccānyallokagarhitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Therefore, O Ishana! By your grace should at once be destroyed, together with all the other deplorable sins.

## \|\| 1.62.8 \|\|

*yadyadicchāmyahaṃ tattatsarvamastu divaspate \|*  
*etenaivānumānena prasanno bhagavanniti \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O lord of the day, whatever things are desired by me, should be received by me. O lord! I am realizing that you are pleased with me.

## \|\| 1.62.9 \|\|

*jñātaṃ mayā hi mārtaṇḍe nāprasanne vibhūtayaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ sarvasukhāhlādamadhyastho'pi hi bhānumān \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. I also know very well that when the Sungod is not pleased, one cannot achieve all the riches and the fortunes, because the Sungod happens to be the centre of all the comforts and pleasures.

## \|\| 1.62.10 \|\|

*tvaṃ māmagādhe saṃsāre magnamuddhartumarhasi \|*  
*sukhāni tāni caivānte teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ na tatsukham \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. You kindly redeem me out of the immensely deep ocean of the universe, to enable me to enjoy all the pleasures and not otherwise. Because the pleasure which ultimately ends in pain, it cannot be treated as the pleasure.

## \|\| 1.62.11 \|\|

*yadā tu duḥkhamāgāmi kiṃ4 vā kasyaiva bhakṣaṇāt \|*  
*tatprasādaṃ kuru vibho jagatāṃ tvaṃ jagatpate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O magnanimous one, O lord of the universe, you destroy the things by consuming which one is bound to face misery.

## \|\| 1.62.12-14 \|\|

*jñānadānena yenaivamuttareyaṃ bhavārṇavam \|*  
*ityuktastena mārtaṇḍaḥ kathayāmāsa yogavit \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yogaṃ nirbījamatyantaṃ duḥkhasaṃyogabheṣajam \|*  
*śrutvā yogaṃ tu taṃ diṇḍirnirbījaṃ niṣkalaṃ babhau \|\| 13 \|\|*

*praṇipatya mahātejā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|*  
*devadeva tvayā yogo yaḥ prokto dhvāntanāśana \|*  
*naiṣa prāpyo mayā nānyairmānavairajitendriyaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Therefore, you tell us the way by following which, myself and all other people are able to cross the ocean of the universe. At these words of Dindi, Surya, who was well — versed in the yogic practices, discoursed on the practice of Nirbija yoga which removes the horrible sins. He then offered his salutation to the Sungod and then spoke — “O god of gods, the yoga, which has been discoursed by you, has not been met with by me or any person having uncontrolled sense organs.

## \|\| 1.62.15 \|\|

*viṣayā durjayāḥ puṃbhirindriyākarṣiṇaḥ sadā \|*  
*indriyāṇāṃ jayo yuktaḥ kaḥ śaktānāṃ kariṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The lust for pleasure is beyond control, because who could control the so powerful sense organs.

## \|\| 1.62.16-17 \|\|

*ahaṃmametivikhyātirdurjayaṃ cañcalaṃ manaḥ \|*  
*rāgādayastathā tyaktuṃ śakyā janmāntarairyadi2 \|\| 16 \|\|*

*so'hamicchāmi deveśa tvatprasādādanirjitaiḥ \|*  
*rāgādibhiramartyatvaṃ prāpuḥ prakṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. With the feelings of “This is mine”, and “I am there”, the mind always remains entangled. Therefore, it is quite difficult to overcome such feelings. O lord of gods, in case the control of mind and discarding of attachments or passions could be possible in many births, it would be desired by me. Because it is by your grace that a person involved in the passions and other attachments, gets free from the same and achieves the eternal position, becoming divine.

## \|\| 1.62.18 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*yadyevaṃ muktikāmastvaṃ gaṇanātha śṛṇuṣva tam \|*  
*kriyāyogaṃ samastānāṃ kleśānāṃ hānikārakam3 \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Aditya said — In case you are so desirous of liberation, which is achievable through kriya yoga, removing the misery, then you listen to me.

## \|\| 1.62.19 \|\|

*manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru \|*  
*māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Listening to it, you should develop your devotion in me. All my devotees should perform yajna, puja and salutation. Thus devoting your mind in me, in case you do so and remain absorbed in me, then you will surely achieve me.

## \|\| 1.62.20 \|\|

*madbhāvanā madyajanā madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*mama pūjākarāścaiva mayi yānti layaṃ narāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Because, by devoting your mind in me, becoming truthful, such people surely achieve

## \|\| 1.62.21 \|\|

*karttāsi kena caiva tvamevaṃ doṣānprahāsyasi5 \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thus by visualizing that the lord pervades everywhere as a divinity and realizing the fact as to who the actual performer is, all your blemishes would disappear.

## \|\| 1.62.22 \|\|

*jaṅgamājaṅgame jñāte mayyāsakte samantataḥ \|*  
*rāgalobhādināśena bhavitrī kṛtakṛtyatā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. All the mobile and immobile beings are attracted towards me. When this knowledge is dawned in a person and with the removal of the attachment, a person achieves success.

## \|\| 1.62.23 \|\|

*bhaktyātipraṇayasyāpi cañcalatvānmano yadi \|*  
*mayyāveśaṃ dadhad bhūyaḥ kuru madrūpiṇīṃ tanum \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In case the mind is more passionate and unstable, gets beyond control, then one should absorb himself in me with devotion and should imagine my form in his own body.

## \|\| 1.62.24 \|\|

*suvarṇarajatādyaistvaṃ śailamṛddārulekhanam \|*  
*pūjopahārairvividhaiḥ sampūjaya trilocanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. One should make the image of gold, silver, stone or wood and should offer presents of different types and should adore the three eyed lord.

## \|\| 1.62.25 \|\|

*tasyāśritaṃ samāviśya sarvabhāvena sarvadā \|*  
*pūjitā saiva te bhaktyā dhyātā caivopakāriṇī \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Taking refuge in the same, dedicate all your feelings in the same. Concentrating the mind, one should meditate with devotion. By so doing, on achieves the desired success.

## \|\| 1.62.26-28 \|\|

*gacchaṃstiṣṭhansvapanbhuñjastāmevāgre ca pṛṣṭhataḥ \|*  
*uparyadhastathā pārśve cintayaṃstanmayaśca vai \|\| 26 \|\|*

*snānaistīrthodakairhadyaiḥ 1 puṣpairgandhānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*vāsobhirbhūṣaṇairbhakṣyairgītavādyairmanoramaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yacca yacca taveṣṭaṃ vai kiñcidbhojyādikaṃ tava \|*  
*bhaktinamro gaṇaśreṣṭha prīṇayasva kṛtiṃ2 mama \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. Thus while seated, sleeping, eating food, utile moving up and down, forward or backwards, one should always think of the lord. The image should be bathed with sacred water of the holy places, offering fragrant flowers and paste. The beautiful costumes and the eatables should be offered, besides singing and dancing, and pleasing the deity. Whatever other things are liked by you, should be offered to the deity with devotion before the image, pleasing it.

## \|\| 1.62.29 \|\|

*rāgeṇākṛṣyate tāta gandharvābhimukhaṃ yadi \|*  
*mayi buddhiṃ samāveśya gāyethā yāḥ kathā mama \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O excellent one, in case at the same time, some Gandharva reaching there is attracted with the music, then concentrating your mind in me, recite my stories.

## \|\| 1.62.30-31 \|\|

*kathayā ramate ceto yadi tadbhavato mama \|*  
*śrotavyāḥ prītiyogena matsvarūpodayāḥ kathāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*evaṃ samarpitamanāścetaso ye'tha āśrayāḥ \|*  
*heyāstānnikhilāndiṇḍe parityajya sukhī bhava \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. In case you enjoy the recitation, then you should listen to my loveable stories. O Dindi, thus by concentrating your mind with devotion, you will become blissful, getting relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.62.32 \|\|

*akṣīṇarāgadveṣo'pi matpriyaḥ paramaḥ param \|*  
*padamāpnoṣi mā bhaiṣīrmayyarpitamanā bhava \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Even without the vanishing of the attraction and jealousy, you would be my favourable and achieve the best position. Therefore, don’t be afraid and concentrate your mind in me.

## \|\| 1.62.33 \|\|

*mayi saṃnyasya sarvaṃ tvamātmānaṃ yatnavānbhava \|*  
*madarthaṃ kuru karmāṇi mā ca dharmavyatikramam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. In case you leave all for my sake, you should be alert and perform yourself for my sake alone. By so doing, there would be overlapping of dharma.

## \|\| 1.62.34 \|\|

*evaṃ vyapohya hatyāstvaṃ brahmaṇa mokṣyase bhavāt \|*  
*etenaivopadeśena vyākhyātamakhilaṃ tava \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. By so doing, you would not only be free from Brahmahatya, but also from the world as well. This much is the discourse delivered by me for you.

## \|\| 1.62.35 \|\|

*kriyāyogaṃ samāsthāya madarpitamanā bhava \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Therefore, you getting yourself involved in the kriyayoga, concentrate your mind in me.

## \|\| 1.62.36 \|\|

*diṇḍiruvāca \|*  
*maddhitāya jagannātha kriyāyogāmṛtaṃ mama \|*  
*vistareṇa samākhyāhi prasannastvaṃ hi duḥkhahā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Dindi said — O lord of the universe, for my benefit, in case the nectar like performance of kriya yoga is related by you exhaustively, then I shall be grateful. It is because you always remain blissful, besides being the remover of miseries.

## \|\| 1.62.37 \|\|

*tvāmṛte na hi tadvaktuṃ samartho'nyo1 jagadguro \|*  
*guhyametatpavitraṃ ca tadācakṣva prasīda me \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O preceptor of the world and lord of the universe, there is none except you, who would be able to explain the same, which is quite a secret and an armpit inns subject. Therefore, getting pleased with me, you kindly speak on the subject.

## \|\| 1.62.38-39 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*ākhyāsyate tadakhilaṃ nirvikalpaṃ gaṇādhipa \|*  
*ityuktvāntardadhe devaḥ sarvalokapradīpakaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sa ca diṇḍirmahātejā jagāmāśu nabhogatim \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Aditya said — “O leader of the ganas, I shall surely reveal all the secrets of the kriya-yoga to you.” Thus speaking, the Sungod who brings light over the entire universe, was set. The immensely Dindi too also flew up in the sky.

## Chapter 63. Glory of the Sungod

## \|\| 1.63.1-2 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā devaṃ surajyeṣṭhaṃ caturmukham \|*  
*uvāca sa mahātejā diṇḍirlokeśamādarāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*devadevena bhavatādiṣṭo'smi ca mahātmanā \|*  
*kriyāyogāmṛtaṃ2 sarvamākhyāsyati bhavānkila \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — The immensely illustrious Dindi, offering his salutation to the four-faced Brahms and lowering his head, said to him — “O god of gods, the lord Surya has ordained that the kriya-yoga should be defined by you.”

## \|\| 1.63.3 \|\|

*sa tvāṃ pṛcchāmyahaṃ brahmankriyāyogaṃ nirantaram \|*  
*santoṣayitumīśehaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Therefore, I desire that the definition of kriya-yoga should be done by you in an appropriate manner in order me to achieve solace.

## \|\| 1.63.4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*ehyehi matsakāśaṃ ca matsamīpe gaṇādhipa \|*  
*brahmahatyā praṇaṣṭā te darśanādeva tasya tu \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Brahma said — O foremost of the ganas, come here and be seated by my side, because with the very look of the lord, the sin of Brahmahatya would vanish.

## \|\| 1.63.5 \|\|

*anugrāhyo'si bhūteśa bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ \|*  
*ārādhanāya bhūteśa yadīśe pravaṇaṃ manaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O lord of the bhutas, in case your mind is desirous of worshipping the Sungod, then you are best suited for his grace.

## \|\| 1.63.6 \|\|

*yadi devapatiṃ bhānumārādhayitumicchasi \|*  
*bhagavantamanādyantaṃ bhava dīkṣāguṇānvitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In case you are desirous of worshipping Brahma, who is without beginning or the end, then you will have to be initiated.

## \|\| 1.63.7 \|\|

*na hyadīkṣānvitairbhānurjñātu stotuṃ ca tattvataḥ \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ vā śakyate mūḍhaiḥ praveṣṭuṃ kuta eva hi \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Because for the fools to achieve the devotion of Surya and his prayer is totally impossible; what to speak of getting his devotion?

## \|\| 1.63.8 \|\|

*janmabhirbahubhiḥ pūtā narāstadgatacetasaḥ \|*  
*bhavanti bhagavansaurāstadā dīkṣāguṇānvitāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. By meditating upon the Sungod for many years, one gets purified and achieves initiation for the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.63.9 \|\|

*anekajanmasaṃsāracite pāpasamuccaye \|*  
*nākṣīṇe jāyate puṃsāṃ mārtaṇḍābhimukhī matiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Because till such time all the sins which have been accumulated for many births do not get destroyed, a person cannot develop desire to worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.63.10 \|\|

*pradveṣaṃ yāti mārtaṇḍe dvijānvedāṃśca nindati \|*  
*yo narastaṃ vijānīyātpāpabījasamudbhavam 1 \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Similarly, he is taken to have been born out of the amsha of the Asuras. Such people are envious of the Sungod and denounce the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.63.11 \|\|

*pākhaṇḍeṣu ratiḥ puṃsāṃ hetuvādānukūlatā \|*  
*jāyate viṣṇumāyāmbhaḥ patitānāṃ durātmanām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The wicked people’s love is extended more and more in deceitful ways, because situations are quite conducive to them.

## \|\| 1.63.12 \|\|

*yadā pāpakṣayaḥ puṃsāṃ tadā vedadvijādiṣu \|*  
*ravau ca devadeveśe śraddhāṃ bhavati niścalā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. When the sins are wiped out, at that very moment, their fiery devotion towards the Vedas, the Brahmanas and the Sungod is ignited.

## \|\| 1.63.13 \|\|

*yadā svalpāvaśeṣastu narāṇāṃ pāpasañcayaḥ \|*  
*tadā dīkṣāguṇānsarve bhajante nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus, with the destruction of the sins, the people develop the desire of initiation.

## \|\| 1.63.14 \|\|

*bhramatāmatra saṃsāre narāṇāṃ pāpadurgame \|*  
*hastāvalambadopyeko bhaktiprīto divākaraḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Because all the sins in this world are meant for the people who wander in the same. It is the Sungod who provide protection to them holding their hands. He gets pleased with devotion.

## \|\| 1.63.15 \|\|

*sarvabhāgavato bhūtvā sarvapāpaharaṃ ravim \|*  
*ārādhayeha taṃ bhaktyā prītimeṣyati bhāskaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Therefore, making all the efforts and by all means, one should turn himself to be a Bhagavata and should inculcate in himself a desire to worship the Sungod. He will surely be pleased.

## \|\| 1.63.16 \|\|

*diṇḍiruvāca \|*  
*kiṃ lakṣaṇā narā dīkṣāmarhanti padmasambhava \|*  
*yacca dīkṣānvitaiḥ kāryaṃ tanme kathaya padmaja \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Dindi said — O Padma Sambhava (born of lotus), in which way should a person receive initiation? What is his duty after getting initiated? What type of people are best suited for initiation? You kindly enlighten us on these points.

## \|\| 1.63.17 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*karmaṇā manasā vācā prāṇināṃ yo na hiṃsakaḥ \|*  
*bhāvabhaktaśca mārtaṇḍe tasya dīkṣā guṇānvitā \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Brahma said — A person, who by his action thought or behaviour, does not indulge in terrorism, he alone could be the real devotee of the Sungod. Initiation of such a person is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 1.63.18 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāṃścaiva devāṃśca nityameva namasyati \|*  
*na ca drogdhā1 paraṃ vāde sa mārtaṇḍaṃ samarcati \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. One who offers salutation always to the Brahmanas and the gods, and does not indulge in controversies about them, he alone is entitled to the worship of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.63.19 \|\|

*sarvāndevān raviṃ vetti sarvalokāṃśca bhāskaram \|*  
*tebhyaśca nānyamātmānaṃ sa naraḥ sauratāṃ vrajet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A person who believes the Sun to be all pervading and representing all the gods, and for whom there is none else besides the Sungod, he alone could be the devotee of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.63.20-21 \|\|

*devaṃ manuṣyamanyaṃ vā paśupakṣipipīlikān \|*  
*tarupāṣāṇakāṣṭhāni bhūmyaṃbho gaganaṃ diśaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ cāpi deveśādvyatiriktaṃ divākarāt \|*  
*yo na jānāti yatiṣu sa vai dīkṣāguṇānbhajet \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Similarly, a person who does not consider the gods, humans, birds, animals, ants, trees, stones, wood, earth, water, the sky, directions, besides, he himself, separate from the Sungod, he alone is the best of the yatis and is initiated in the best possible way.

## \|\| 1.63.22 \|\|

*bhāvaṃ na kurute yastu sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam \|*  
*karmaṇā manasā vācā sa tu dīkṣāṃ samarhati \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Because who is not envious mentally by wisdom or by feelings, he alone is best suited for initiation.

## \|\| 1.63.23 \|\|

*sutapteneha tapasā yathairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ \|*  
*tāṃ gatiṃ na narā yānti yāṃ gatāḥ sūryamāśritāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Therefore, even after performing the hard tapas, by performing of the yajnas and distributing enormous dakshinas, people do not achieve the merit, as compared to the one achieved by the devotees of Surya.

## \|\| 1.63.24 \|\|

*yena sarvātmanā bhānau bhaktyā bhāvo niveśitaḥ \|*  
*gaṇeśvara kṛtārthatvācchlāghyaḥ sauraḥ sa mānavaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O Ganeshvara, in this way, one who has diverted all his attention towards the Sungod, he, getting successful, is considered to be the best devotee of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.63.25 \|\|

*api naḥ sa kule dhanyo jāyate kulapāvanaḥ \|*  
*bhagavānbhaktibhāvena yena bhānurupāsitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Accordingly, having been born in my family, one who adores the Sungod with devotion, he becomes graceful and purifies his entire race.

## \|\| 1.63.26 \|\|

*yaḥ kārayatidevārcāṃ hṛdayālambanaṃ raveḥ \|*  
*sa naro bhānusālokyamāpnoti dhutakalmaṣaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Similarly, one who devotes his mind towards the worship of Shiva, he getting relieved of all the sins, ultimately achieves the place of Surya.

## \|\| 1.63.27 \|\|

*yastu devālayaṃ bhānorbhaktyā kārayati dhruvam \|*  
*sa sapta puruṣāṃllokaṃ bhānornayati mānavaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The one who builds a beautiful temple for the Sungod, the people for his seven generations live in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.63.28 \|\|

*yāvantyābdāni devārcā ravestiṣṭhati mandire \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Similarly, the number of years upto which the Sungod is adored in a temple, for thousand times more number of years, he is lodged respectfully in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.63.29 \|\|

*devārcā lakṣaṇopetā tadgṛhe santato vidhiḥ \|*  
*niṣkāmaṃ ca mano yasya sa yātyakṣarasāmyatām \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Therefore, in case the Sungod is regularly worshipped in a house with a detached mind, one achieves the Sarupya salvation.

## \|\| 1.63.30-31 \|\|

*puṣpāṇi ca sugandhīni manojñāni ca yaḥ pumān \|*  
*prayacchati sahasrāṃśoḥ sadā prayatamānasaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dhūpāṃśca tāṃstānvividhāngandhāḍhyaṃ cānulepanam \|*  
*naraḥ so'nudinaṃ yajñaṃ karotyārādhanaṃ raveḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. One who offers the fragrant and beautiful flowers to the Sungod, besides incense and other fragrant material, besides the sandal paste, it amounts to the daily performing of a yajna.

## \|\| 1.63.32-33 \|\|

*yajñeśo bhagavānpūṣā sadā kratubhirijyate \|*  
*bahūpakaraṇā yajñā nānāsambhāravistarāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*na te diṇḍinnavāpyante manuṣyairalpasañcayaiḥ \|*  
*bhaktyā tu puruṣaiḥ pūjā kṛtā dūrvāṅkurairapi \|*  
*bhānordadāti hi phalaṃ sarvayajñaiḥ sudurlabham \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. In this way, the people should adore lord Surya, who is the lord of yajnas and the similar yajnas should be performed in his favour, adoring him at the same time. O Dindi, though the poor and the ugly people cannot perform the yajnas, but a poor person, by offering the durva grass alone, with devotion, the Sungod bestows on them the merit for the performing of the best of yajnas.

## \|\| 1.63.34-35 \|\|

*yāni puṣpāṇi hṛdyāni dhūpagandhānulepanam \|*  
*dayitaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ yacca prītaye caiva vāsasī \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yāni cābhyavahāryāṇi bhakṣāाṇi ca phalāni vai \|*  
*prayaccha tāni mārtaṇḍe bhavethāścaiva tanmanāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*
