70\. Similarly, by donating the book of Samba Purana or Surya Purana, one achieves the merit of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.93.71 \|\|

*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yāti sūryasalokatām \|*  
*sūryaloke ciraṃ sthitvā brahmalokaṃ vrajetpunaḥ \|*  
*sthitvā kalpaśataṃ tatra rājā bhavati bhūtale \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. Then the said person, getting all his desires fulfilled, attains the Salokya devotion of the Sungod. Thus, remaining in the solar region for long, he again returns to Brahmaloka. Thus enjoying all the comforts there for a hundred kalpas, he returns to the earth as a king.

## \|\| 1.93.72 \|\|

*bhānorāyatane yastu prapāṃ kuryādgaṇādhipa \|*  
*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ divyaṃ saumanasaṃ naraḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. O lord of the ganas, a person who creates a chamber for the free supply of water to the devotees in the Sun temple, he achieves the divine place of the gods.

## \|\| 1.93.73 \|\|

*śītakāle ghanaṃ dadyānnarāṇāṃ śītanāśanam \|*  
*bhānorāyatane deva aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Similarly, a person, who during the winter season, distributes warm clothing’s in Sun temple, he achieves the merit of performing Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.93.74 \|\|

*itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ puṇyaṃ pustakavācanam \|*  
*aśvamedhasahasraṃ yo nityaṃ kartuṃ pravartate \|*  
*na tatphalamavāpnoti yadāpnotyasya karmaṇaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. A person who daily reads the Pauranika texts, he earns merits much more than the performing of a thousand Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.93.75 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryaṃ pustakavācanam \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ bhānorāyatane śubham \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. Therefore, one should always make efforts to recite or read Itihasa or Puranas in the Sun temple.

## \|\| 1.93.76 \|\|

*nānyatpuṣṭikaraṃ bhānostathā tuṣṭikaraṃ param \|*  
*puṇyākhyānakathā yāstu yathā tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Because there is nothing else to please the Sungod more than the reciting of the stories of his glory.

## Chapter 94. Description of the auspicious glory

## \|\| 1.94.1 \|\|

*dattvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ tasmai vācakāyāmitaujase \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O best of the ganas, there is a popularly known story of in the form of a dialogue between Brahma and Kumara Kartikeya, which is quite auspicious, destroyer of the sins and bestower of the welfare.

## \|\| 1.94.2-3 \|\|

*sraṣṭāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ sukhāsīnaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā devaṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kumāro devaśārdūla idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|*  
*gato'hamadya bhagavandraṣṭuṃ devaṃ divākaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. O lion among the gods, once Brahma — the creator of all the lokas, was seated comfortably. Arriving before him, Kumara Kartikeya offered his salutation to the lord with respect and said to him — “O lord, I had an audience with the Sungod today.

## \|\| 1.94.4 \|\|

*kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ devaḥ sa mayā pūjito raviḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā bhaktyā parayā śraddhayā vibho \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. With utmost devotion, I offered my salutation to him with great reverence. Then, I worshipped him, after circumambulating him.

## \|\| 1.94.5 \|\|

*anujñātastatastena sukhāsīno hyahaṃ sthitaḥ \|*  
*āsīnena mayā tatra dṛṣṭamāścaryamadbhutam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Then, with his permission, I got myself seated with comfort. When I was thus seated before him, I observed a wonderful surprise.

## \|\| 1.94.6-7 \|\|

*kāñcanena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā \|*  
*maṇimuktāvicitreṇa vaidūryavaravedinā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sasambhramaṃ samutthāya āsanādeva sattama \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Suddenly, a person mounted over a plane of gold which was decorated with small dinging bells like a net, arrived there. The plane had a beautiful throne studded with gems, rubies, and the precious beads. On the arrival of that person, the Sungod himself went to welcome him.

## \|\| 1.94.8 \|\|

*gṛhītvā1 dakṣiṇe pāṇau purataḥ prāpya taṃ naram \|*  
*śirasyāghrāya deveśa pūjayāmāsa vai raviḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The Sungod held the right hand of that person and smelt his head. The Sungod then worshipped him.

## \|\| 1.94.9-10 \|\|

*upaviṣṭaṃ tu taṃ bhānuridaṃ vacanamabravīt \|*  
*susvāgataṃ bhadra sukhakṛtā prītāstvayā vayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*samīpe mama tiṣṭha tvaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|*  
*punaryāsyasi tatsthānaṃ yatra brahmā svayaṃ sthitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. When that person was seated comfortably, the Sungod addressed him — “O adorable one, you are welcome here. You have made me comfortable. Therefore, we people are quite happy. You better remain here with me till the time of dissolution and thereafter you can go back to Brahma.”

## \|\| 1.94.11 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare cānyo vimānavaramāsthitaḥ \|*  
*āgataḥ puruṣo devo yatra tiṣṭhati bhāskaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In the meantime, another person also arrived there boarding a plane, at the place of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.94.12 \|\|

*sa cāpyevaṃ naro deva pūjito bhānunā tadā \|*  
*sāmapūrvaṃ tathoktastu praśrayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The new comer was again worshipped by the Sungod similarly, welcoming him. The said person also got himself seated with comfort.

## \|\| 1.94.13 \|\|

*tatra me kautukaṃ jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ kṛtāṃ tayoḥ \|*  
*bhānunā devaśārdūla pṛṣṭo bhānurmayā tataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. O lion among the gods, finding both of them so honoured by the Sungod, out of I curiosity, I asked Brahma.

## \|\| 1.94.14 \|\|

*kimanena kṛtaṃ deva yo'yaṃ pūrvamihāgataḥ \|*  
*narastatra sakāśaṃ vai yasya tuṣṭo bhavādṛśām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. “O Deva, what type of the noble deed had been performed by the person who arrived first, which had delighted you?

## \|\| 1.94.15 \|\|

*yadasya bhavatā pūjā kṛtā hi svayameva tu \|*  
*atra me kautukaṃ jātaṃ vismayaśca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Besides that you have yourself performed puja for him. I got surprised by witnessing the same.

## \|\| 1.94.16-17 \|\|

*tathaivāsya kṛtā pūjā dvitīyasya narasya ca \|*  
*sarvathā puṇyakarmāṇāvimau naravarottamau \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaistu pūjyate bhagavānsadā \|*  
*yastvamābhyāṃ paraṃ pūjāṃ kṛtavāndevasattama \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The other person was also worshipped by you personally. Therefore, both the persons are the souls of highest nobility, because you yourself are adored by Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, where as you yourself have adored them both.

## \|\| 1.94.18 \|\|

*kathyatāṃ mama deveśa kimetau karma cakratuḥ \|*  
*yasyedṛkparamaṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ divyamavāpatuḥ \|*  
*śrutvā tadvacanaṃ deva idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Therefore, O lord, you tell me, what type of noble deeds have been done by both of them to earn such a type of treatment from you and by which they have achieved the divine planes?” On bearing these words, the Sungod said.

## \|\| 1.94.19-20 \|\|

*sūrya uvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhavatā karmaṇo nirṇayaṃ param \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yadanena kṛtaṃ karma nareṇa munisattama \|*  
*yo'sau sūryamihāyātastacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Sungod said — O best of the sages, you have raised an excellent question about the performing of their deeds. O person of great wisdom, I am going to narrate the conduct of the persons who achieve my vicinity or closeness. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.94.21 \|\|

*yeyaṃ madaṃśasambhūtaiḥ pārthivaiḥ pālitā sadā \|*  
*ayodhyā nāma nagarī prakhyātā pṛthivītale \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. There is a popular city named Ayodhya on the earth, which has been well looked after by the rulers born of my race.

## \|\| 1.94.22-23 \|\|

*tatrāsau vaiśyajātīyo dhanapāla iti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*tasyāḥ puryāṃ dvijaśreṣṭha divyamāyatanaṃ vyadhāt1 \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tasminnāyatane divye hyāmnāyārthaṃ tathāśritaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ viśiṣṭānāṃ pūjayityā kadambakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. In that city, a merchant named Dhanpala lived there, who happened to be the gem of his race. O excellent Brahmana, he had built a beautiful temple for me. He had entrusted the duty of performing the daily puja etc. to a group of Brahmanas who were well-versed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.94.24-25 \|\|

*itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vācakaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūjayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ munaśreṣṭhaṃ mahāmunim \|\| 24 \|\|*

*pustakaṃ cāpi sampūjya gandhapuṣpopahārataḥ \|*  
*tasya viprakadambasya vyāsasya ca yathāgrataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Out of those Brahmanas, those who were specialized in the books of Itihasa and Puranas and the great sages and good orators, they were invited by them and said to them.

## \|\| 1.94.26-29 \|\|

*prakalpyokto dvijo'nena pāṭhako2 vācakottamaḥ \|*  
*eṣa tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sahasrakiraṇo raviḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*cāturvarṇyamidaṃ vāpi śrotukāmaṃ kadambakam \|*  
*tiṣṭha ceha dvijaśreṣṭha kuru pustakavācanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yena me varado bhānuḥ3 sapta janmāni vai bhavet \|*  
*yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ vipra pragṛhya vṛttimuttamām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*svarṇaniṣkaśataṃ vipra tato dāsye tathāparam \|*  
*pūrṇe varṣe dvijaśreṣṭha śreyo'rthamahamātmanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. The lords Surya with thousand rays is present here. O best of the Brahmanas, the people of all the varnas as well as groups of Brahmanas would be here to listen to the narration of the holy scriptures. Therefore, you start the recitation of this holy book in such a way that the grace of the Sungod continue to be received by me and my seven future generations, I am offering a hundred gold coins to you for serving of full one year. Therefore, you kindly accept the gold offerings. For my own welfare, I shall continue to give you more riches quite often.

## \|\| 1.94.30 \|\|

*evaṃ pravartite tasminpuṇye pustakavācane \|*  
*ṣaṇmāsāgatamātre tu kāle suravarottama \|*  
*tathaivāntarataścāyaṃ kāladharmamupeyivān \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O best of the gods, thus making arrangement for the regular recitation from the holy book, a period of six months was passed, when he met with the end of his life.

## \|\| 1.94.31 \|\|

*mayā cāsya vimānaṃ tu preṣitaṃ kurvato vratam \|*  
*ityeṣā karmaṇastuṣṭiḥ puṇyākhyānakajārcitā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. I had sent the plane to bring the holy person here. He happens to be the same person and this is the cause of my getting pleased with him and the recitation of the scriptures arranged by him.

## \|\| 1.94.32 \|\|

*gandhapuṣpopahāraistu na tathā jāyate mama \|*  
*prītirdevavara śreṣṭha purāṇaśravaṇe yathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. O best of the gods, the pleasure I derive with the listening of the Puranas, I do not earn so much from fragrant flower garlands.

## \|\| 1.94.33-34 \|\|

*gosuvarṇahiraṇyānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ cāpi kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*grāmāṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca dānaṃ prītikaraṃ mama \|\| 33 \|\|*

*na tathā syātsuraśreṣṭha yathā prītikaraṃ guha \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ śravaṇaṃ surasainyapa \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. O best of the gods, O Guha, the cows, gold, gems, costumes and villages (when donated in my name) do not delight me so much as with the recitations of Itihasa and Puranas.

## \|\| 1.94.35 \|\|

*śrāddhaṃ kurvanti ye mahyaṃ bhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ \|*  
*na karoti tathā prītiryathā pustakavācanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A person, who for my sake, donates or performs Shraddha with various articles, I do not feel delighted with those things so much, as I achieve with reciting of the scriptures.

## \|\| 1.94.36 \|\|

*karṇaśrāddhe yathā prītirmama syātsurasattama \|*  
*na tathā jāyate prītirbhojyaśrāddhe tathaiva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. O excellent Deva, the pleasure I receive with the reciting of the scriptures (is even more than the) Karna-Shraddha or the Shraddha performed with the offering of food etc.

## \|\| 1.94.37 \|\|

*atha kiṃ bahunoktena nānyatprītikaraṃ mama \|*  
*puṇyākhyānādṛte deva guhyametatprakītitam \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O Deva, what more should I speak? Except the auspicious stories, nothing is dearer to me. This is the secret, which has been revealed by me.

## \|\| 1.94.38 \|\|

*yaścāyamaparo vipra ihāyato narottamaḥ \|*  
*ayamāsīddivajaśreṣṭhastasminneva purottame \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. O Brahmana, the other gem of a person who has arrived here, he had been a Brahmana of the excellent city.

## \|\| 1.94.39-40 \|\|

*ekadā tu gataścāyaṃ dharmaśravaṇamuttamam \|*  
*śrotuṃ bhaktyā ddvijaśreṣṭha śraddhayā parayā vṛtaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*śrutvā tatra tato bhaktyā puṇyākhyānamanuttamam \|*  
*kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tasya vācakasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*eṣa vipro'maraśreṣṭha dattavānsvarṇamāṣakam \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Once he went to a temple to listen to the recitation with utmost faith and devotion. Listening to the discourse, he went round the orator and then offered him a masha (ancient unit) of gold.

## \|\| 1.94.41 \|\|

*ānandamagamadvipraḥ prāptavānkāñcanaṃ yathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Thereafter, he offering dakshina to the orator, getting delighted like a pauper and getting old, returned to his abode.

## \|\| 1.94.42 \|\|

*etaddhi saphalaṃ cāsya na cānyatkṛtavānayam \|*  
*yadanena kṛtā pūjā vācakasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ hi karmaṇastasya yanmayā pūjitaḥ svayam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. This is the only noble deed performed by him during his life. Nothing else has been done by him except adoring the orator and because of the same deed, I welcomed him personally.

## \|\| 1.94.43 \|\|

*vācakaṃ pūjayedyastu śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tenāhaṃ pūjitaḥ syāṃ vai ko viṣṇuḥ śaṅkarastathā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Therefore, the people with faith, when adore the orator of the scriptures, Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu get pleased with him like me.

## \|\| 1.94.44 \|\|

*vācakaṃ bhojayedyastu bhaktyā bhojyeranuttamaiḥ \|*  
*tenāhaṃ pūjitaḥ syāṃ vai daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. A person who serves excellent food to the orator of the scriptures, he should think that he had meditated on me for fifteen years.

## \|\| 1.94.45 \|\|

*na yamo na yamī cāpi na mando na manustathā \|*  
*tapatī na tathānviṣṭā yatheṣṭo vācako mama \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Because Yama, Yami, Saturn, Manu and Tapati — my children, are not so much loved by me as the orator of the scriptures.

## \|\| 1.94.46 \|\|

*vācake satkṛte deva bhojite surasainyapa \|*  
*tṛptirbhavati me deva saṃvatsaraśatadvayam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. O Deva, I remain happy over a person for two hundred years, who serves food to the orator of the scriptures.

## \|\| 1.94.47 \|\|

*na kevalaṃ mama prītirvācake bhojite bhavet \|*  
*kṛtsnaśo devatānāṃ ca indrādīnāṃ tathā bhavet \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. By serving food to the orator of the scriptures, not only myself, but all the gods like Indra and others are also pleased like me.

## \|\| 1.94.48 \|\|

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sa ceṣṭho vācako mama \|*  
*prīte tasmindevatāḥ syuḥ sarvāḥ prītā na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The reciter, like me, is also dear to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, because when they are pleased, all the gods are pleased. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.94.49 \|\|

*ityetatkathitaṃ sarvamābhyāṃ karma mahābala \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. O valorous one, thus I have revealed before you, the deeds performed by the two people.

## \|\| 1.94.50-51 \|\|

*na cānyaccakratuḥ karma kimanyacchrotumicchasi \|*  
*etaddṛṣṭvāhamāścaryaṃ tavābhyāśamihāgataḥ \|*  
*kimatra tathyaṃ deveśa kathyatāṃ kautukaṃ mama \|\| 50 \|\|*

*śrutvā kumāravacanaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Both of them had not performed any other good deed. What more do you want to listen?” O lord of the Devas! Thereafter, witnessing the wonder, I have arrived before you. You subside my anxiety. What is the underlying truth in it, on hearing the word of Kumaras?

## \|\| 1.94.52 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*hanta bhoḥ sādhu puṇyo'si nāsti tulyastvayāparaḥ \|*  
*yaddṛṣṭau bhavatā tau hi supuṇyau puṇyakāriṇau \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Brahma said — You are a chaste and a noble soul. No one else has the virtues and qualities comparable with you, because you had an audience with the two persons, who had performed the noble deeds.

## \|\| 1.94.53-54 \|\|

*yaduktaṃ bhānunā vatsa tattathā nānyathā bhavet \|*  
*yadāsīnme mukhaṃ putra prathamaṃ lokapūjitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tasmādetāni sarvāṇi nirgatāni samantataḥ \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. O son, whatever has been spoken by the Sungod, there is nothing false in the same. O son. the Itihasa and Puranas emerged out of my first face.

## \|\| 1.94.55 \|\|

*yathaitāni mameṣṭāni purāṇāni mahāmate \|*  
*na tathā vai caturvedī na cāṅgini mahāmate \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. O intelligent one, the type of attachment I have with (Puranas etc.), I do not have it with the Vedas etc.

## \|\| 1.94.56 \|\|

*śṛṇvantyetāni ye bhaktyā nityaṃ śraddhāsamanvitāḥ \|*  
*dattvā tu vācake vṛttiṃ te gacchanti paraṃ padam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Such of the people who, making offerings, recite or listen to the Pauranika stories daily, they achieve the best position.

## \|\| 1.94.57 \|\|

*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ spaṣṭīkaraṇamuttamam \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni mayā sṛṣṭāni suvrata \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. O person with good holy rites, I composed Itihasa and Puranas to reveal the forms of dharma, artha, kama and moksha.

## \|\| 1.94.58 \|\|

*catvāro ya ime vedā gūḍhārthāḥ satataṃ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*atastvetāni sṛṣṭāni bodhāyaiṣāṃ mahāmate \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. O immensely intelligent one, the meaning of the four Vedas is quite deep. Therefore, for the proper interpretation of the Vedas, the Puranas were composed.

## \|\| 1.94.59 \|\|

*yastu kārayate nityaṃ dharmaśravaṇamuttamam \|*  
*ādityādbhāskaraṃ prāpya yāti tatparamaṃ padam \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Therefore, a person who listens to these religious texts or makes others to hear them, he attaining the light from the Sun, gains the highest position.

## \|\| 1.94.60 \|\|

*dattvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ tatra ādityasya puraṃ vrajet \|*  
*kimāścaryaṃ suraśreṣṭha dānapātraṃ hi tatparam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. The reciter or orator also achieves the place of the Sungod. O best of Devas! There is no cause of surprise in it, because no other charity has been stated to be better than this.

## \|\| 1.94.61 \|\|

*yathā devavaro lekho yathā hetiḥ paraṃ paviḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā śreṣṭho vācako nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. As Indra is the best of gods and vajra is the best of weapons, similarly, the reciter of scriptures is considered to be the best among the Brahman as.

## \|\| 1.94.62 \|\|

*hetiryathā tejasāṃ tu sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā \|*  
*tathā sarvadvijebhyastu vācakaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Because of its being illustrious vajra is considered to be the foremost of the weapons, the ocean is the foremost of the reservoirs and among the Brahmanas, the reciter is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 1.94.63 \|\|

*vācakaṃ pūjayedyastu naro bhaktipuraḥ saram \|*  
*pūjitaṃ sakalaṃ tena jagatyānnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Therefore, a person who worships the reciter with devotion, he adores the entire world, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.94.64 \|\|

*satyamuktaṃ na sandeho bhānunā matkulodvaha \|*  
*vācakena samaṃ pātraṃ na jātvanyadbhavetkvacit \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. O best of my race, whatever had been spoken by the Sungod is the total truth and there is no excellent person better than the reciter.”

## \|\| 1.94.65-66 \|\|

*tacchrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ kumāro vākyamabravīt \|\| 65 \|\|*

*aho hi dhanyatā tasya puṇyaśravaṇakāriṇaḥ \|*  
*dānaṃ ca dadato'tyarthaṃ puṇyatā vācakāya vai \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. Listening to the words of Brahma, Kumara also said — “Hundred times thanks to a person who listens to the recitations, who gives charities to the reciter and earns the relative merit”

## \|\| 1.94.67 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*itthaṃ diṇḍe sadā yastu devadevasya mandire \|*  
*kuryāttu dharmaśravaṇaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Brahma said: O Brahmana, thus a person, who listens to the story of dharma in the temple of the Sungod, he achieves the highest position.

## Chapter 95. Glory of the worship of Surya

## \|\| 1.95.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tribhiḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā yo namaskurute ravim \|*  
*bhūmau gatena śirasā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said: A person who circumambulating the image of Surya, offers salutation to him touching the ground, he achieves the highest position.

## \|\| 1.95.2 \|\|

*sopānatko devagṛhamārohedyastu mānavaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tāmisraṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. A person who enters the temple with his shoes cm, he falls in the hell named Tamisraka.

## \|\| 1.95.3 \|\|

*śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi samutsṛjati yastu vai \|*  
*devasyāyatane bhānoḥ sa gacchennarakaṃ kramāt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A person who spits in the Sun temple, or passes urine or stools, he falls into all the bells.

## \|\| 1.95.4 \|\|

*ghṛtaṃ madhu payastoyaṃ tathekṣurasamuttamam \|*  
*snapanārthaṃ tu devasya ye dadatīha mānavāḥ \|*  
*sarvakāmānavāpyeha te yānti helimaṇḍalam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A person who offers ghi, honey, milk and juice of sugarcane to the Sungod, he achieves the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.95.5 \|\|

*snāpyamānaṃ raviṃ bhaktyā ye paśyanti vṛṣadhvaja \|*  
*te'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya layaṃ yānti vṛṣadhvaje \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O bull-bannered lord, a person who has a look at the Sun while bathing, he earns the merit of the performing of Ashvamedha sacrifice, and also achieves the Sayujya moksha of Shiva.

## \|\| 1.95.6 \|\|

*snapanaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti bhānorbhaktisamanvitāḥ \|*  
*labhante tatphalaṃ bhīma rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. A person who bathes the image of the Sun with devotion, he earns the merit of performing Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.95.7-10 \|\|

*yathā na laṅghayetkaścitsnapanaṃ bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*tathā kāryaṃ prayatnena laṅghitaṃ hyasukhāvaham \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tāmisraṃ narakaṃ yāti laṅghayecca sa rauravān \|*  
*tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryaṃ snapanamāditaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ghṛtena snāpayeddevaṃ kañjamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*madhunā priyamāyāti toyenāpi ghṛtaukasam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ikṣurasena saṃsnāpya payasā kañjaśadhvajam \|*  
*evamebhiḥ snāpayedvai ravimīhitamāpnuyāt \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. No one should cross the water with which the Sungod is bathed. This aspect should be particularly kept in mind and act accordingly, because a person who does so, he is sure to tail into Raurava and Tamisra hells. Therefore, making all the efforts, the image of the Sungod should be bathed in a secluded place, so that no one is able to cross the same. The person who bathes him, achieves the riches. Similarly, by bathing the image of the Sungod with honey, he becomes favourite of the Sungod. A person who bathes the Sun image with water he achieves the heaven, the one who washes the image with juice of sugarcane, he achieves Vishnuloka. The person who washes the images with all the things combined, he achieves the desired success.

## Chapter 96. Description of Jaya Saptami

## \|\| 1.96.1 \|\|

*diṇḍiruvāca \|*  
*yaccaitāḥ sapta saptamyo bhavatā kathitā mama \|*  
*tāsāṃ yā prathamā deva kathitā sā savistarā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Dindi said — O Deva, of all the Saptamis about which you have provided the description earlier, only the first one has been explained in detail.

## \|\| 1.96.2 \|\|

*yāstvanyā devaśārdūla tāḥ sarvāḥ kathayasva me \|*  
*yenopoṣya tatastāstu vraje'haṃ helisadma vai \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O lion among the Devas, you kindly tell me the glory of the rest of the Saptamis, observing which, the devotees may be able to achieve the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.96.3 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ pañcatārakam \|*  
*yadā syātsā tadā jñeyā jayā nāmeti saptamī \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Brahma said — When the bright seventh moon day falls in Hasta constellation, it is called Jaya Saptami.

## \|\| 1.96.4 \|\|

*tasyāṃ dattāṃ1 hutaṃ jāpastarpaṇaṃ devapūjanam \|*  
*sarvaṃ śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ pūjā cāpi divākare \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Because the charities, homos, japam, oblations, worship of the gods, and the Sun worship performed during a particular Saptami, multiply hundred times in merit.

## \|\| 1.96.5 \|\|

*bhāskarasya priyā hyeṣā saptamī pāpanāśinī \|*  
*dhanyā yaśasyā putryā ca kāmadā kañjajāvahā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Because of its being favourite of the Sungod, it fulfills the desires besides removing the sins.

## \|\| 1.96.6 \|\|

*vidhinānena kartavyā tithiryā mama vidyate \|*  
*taṃ śṛṇuṣva vidhiṃ matto yena kṛtvārthamaśnumate \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Therefore, the process in which the vratas etc. should be performed during this particular Saptami, is going to be revealed by me.

## \|\| 1.96.7 \|\|

*haṃse haṃsamākye śukleyaṃ saptamī purā \|*  
*samupoṣya ca kartavyā vidhinānena śaṅkara \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O Shankara, in earlier times, when once at the time of Sungod’s riding the horse, this Saptami had become bright Therefore, by fasting, in the same process it should be celebrated

## \|\| 1.96.8 \|\|

*pāraṇā tṛtīyā'he syātkathitaṃ govṛṣāvaham \|*  
*prathamaṃ caturo māsānpāraṇaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. During the performing of vrata of this Saptami, the fast has to be broken on the third day. Thus by completing the process of four months, the fast should be broken.

## \|\| 1.96.9-11 \|\|

*kathitānyatra puṣpāṇi karavīrasya suvrata \|*  
*candanaṃ ca tathā raktaṃ dhūpārthaṃ guggulaṃ param \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kāsāraṃ tu supakvaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhāskarāya vai \|*  
*anena vidhinā pūjya mārtaṇḍaṃ vibudhādhipam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pūjayedbrāhmaṇānbhīma bhakṣyabhojyairyathāvidhi \|*  
*kāsāraṃ bhojayedviprānpāraṇe'sminvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*svayameva tathāśnīyātprayato maunamāśritaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. O lord of excellent holy rites! In the worship, the oleander flowers, red sandal paste, incense, guggulu, cyperus tuberosus fruits and other eatables should be offered to the image of the Sungod. O Bhima, after completing the worship of the sun image in an appropriate manner, the excellent food should be offered to the Brahmanas. Thereafter, the fast should be broken and the devotee should take his food maintaining silence.

## \|\| 1.96.12 \|\|

*pañcamyāmekabhaktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ pravartate \|*  
*kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Though the related process has been thus described that a devotee should take food once on the day of Panchami (fifth moon day), should fast on the night of sixth moon day, fasting completely on the seventh moon day and breaking the fast on the eighth moon day.

## \|\| 1.96.13 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhyā sametā kartavyā nāṣṭamyeyaṃ kadācana \|*  
*yasyopavāsanāyaiva ṣaṣṭhyāmāhurupoṣitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The combination of the sixth moon day is considered to be more appropriate than the eighth moon day. It is because the sixth moon day has been said to be more appropriate for the fasting.

## \|\| 1.96.14 \|\|

*yathaikādaśyāṃ kurvanti upavāsaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*upavāsanāya dvādaśyāṃ tatheyaṃ parikīrtitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. As in the Ekadashi vrata, when complete Ekadashi is not there on a particular day, the learned people have prescribed the combination of Dvadashi (or the twelfth moon day) with the Ekadashi for the purpose of fasting. Similarly, in the fast during Saptami, when it is not found full on a particular day, the combination with Shashthi has been prescribed for the same.

## \|\| 1.96.15 \|\|

*siddhārthakaiḥ snānamantraḥ prāśanaṃ gomayasya tu \|*  
*bhānurme prīyatāmatra dantakāṣṭhaṃ tathārkajam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. One should bathe applying the paste of mustard oil, use tooth stick of swallow wort, and tasting of cow-dung. One should conduct himself in such a way that the Sungod is pleased.

## \|\| 1.96.16 \|\|

*ityeṣa kathitastāta prathame pāraṇe vidhiḥ \|*  
*dvitīyaṃ śrūyatāṃ bhīma pāraṇaṃ gadato mama \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O excellent one, the first break of the fast has been thus prescribed. O Bhima, I am now speaking out the method of the second break of fast. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.96.17 \|\|

*mālatīkusumānīha śrīkhaṇḍaṃ candanaṃ tathā \|*  
*naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ bhānordhūpaṃ vijayamādiśet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In this process, the use of jasmine flowers, the sandal of Malaya mountain, eatables, payasam and incense vijaya are required to be offered to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.96.18 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayedvāpi tathāśnīyātsvayaṃ vibho \|*  
*ravirme prīyatāmatra nāma devasya kīrtayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O excellent one, after serving food to the Brahmanas and also consuming the same himself, he should recite — “Let the Sungod be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 1.96.19 \|\|

*prāśayetpañcagavyaṃ tu khadiraṃ dantadhāvane \|*  
*dvitīye pāraṇe vīra vidhirukto mayādhunā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O valorous one, in this process, the tooth stick of catechu and panchagavya at breakfast should be used. In this way, I have explained the second breaking of the fast as well.

## \|\| 1.96.20-21 \|\|

*tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ cāpi kathyamānaṃ nibodha me \|*  
*agastikusumairatra bhāskaraṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*samālambhanamatroktaṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kusumaṃ tathā \|*  
*sihlako dhūpa uddiṣṭo bhānoḥ prītikaraḥ paraḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Now I am speaking about the fast breaking method for the third time. You please listen. In this process, the use of Agastya flowers have been prescribed by the people with wisdom. The use of Shrikhanda, sandal paste and the flowers required, have already been stated. Besides Sihlaka incense which is the favourite of the Sungod, should also be offered.

## \|\| 1.96.22 \|\|

*śālyodanaṃ tu naivedyaṃ rasāloparisaṃyutam \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dātavyaṃ bhakṣayeta tathātmanā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The mango fruit rice of Sati paddy and the eatables should be presented to the Brahmanas. The devotee should take his food thereafter.

## \|\| 1.96.23 \|\|

*kuśodakaprāśanaṃ tu badaryā dantadhāvanam \|*  
*vikartanaḥ prīyatāṃ me nāma devasya kīrtayet \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The water of kusha should be sipped and the tooth stick of jujube tree should be used. Thereafter, singing for the Sungod should be resorted to with a prayer that let the Sungod be pleased with me.

## \|\| 1.96.24-26 \|\|

*varṣāsu devadevasya pūjā kāryā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*gandhapuṣpopahāraistu nānāprekṣaṇakaistathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*godānairbhūmidānairvā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*itthaṃ sampūjya deveśaṃ devasya purataḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kārayetparamaṃ puṇyaṃ dhanyaṃ pustakavācanam \|*  
*vastrairgandhaistathā dhūpairvācakaṃ pūjayettataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Similarly, in the rainy season, the Sungod should be worshipped appropriately, in which the fragrance, flower garlands and several others presentable things should be given. After this performance, land and food should also be given to the Brahmanas who are well — versed in the scriptures reading.

## \|\| 1.96.27-28 \|\|

*devasya purataḥ sthitvā tato mantramudīrayet \|*  
*devadeva jagannātha sarvarogārtināśana \|*  
*graheśa lokanayana vikartana tamo'paha \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kṛteyaṃ devadeveśa jayā nāmeti saptamī \|*  
*mayā tava prasādena dhanyā pāpaharā śivā \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Thereafter, presenting himself before the Sungod, the recitation of the secret texts should be performed. Then the Brahmana should be worshipped with costumes, fragrance and incense and then pray — “O lord of gods, O lord of the universe, O destroyer of all the disease, O lord of the planets, O Tantra of the world, O destroyer of darkness, by your grace! I have organised the performing of this Jaya-Saptami, which is remover of the sins, and is the bestower of welfare.

## \|\| 1.96.29 \|\|

*anena vidhinā vīra yaḥ kuryātsaptamīmimām \|*  
*tasya snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavecchataguṇaṃ vibho \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Such of the people who perform vrata for this Saptami, the activities like bathing etc., multiply a hundred times in merit.

## \|\| 1.96.30-31 \|\|

*kṛtvemāṃ saptamīṃ vīra puruṣaḥ prāpnuyādyaśaḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca putramāryabalaṃ śriyam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*prāpyeha devaśārdūla sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*tasmādetya punarbhūmau rājarājo bhavedbudhaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. By concluding the vrata of this Saptami in an appropriate manner, a person is blessed with glory, riches, corals, gold and sons, besides becoming a king.

## \|\| 1.96.32 \|\|

*ityeṣā kathitā vīra jayā nāmeti saptamī \|*  
*kṛtā smṛtā śrutā sā tu helilokapradāyinī \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus, I have narrated to you the glory of Jaya Saptami, by performing which or by listening to which, one achieves the place of the Sun.

## Chapter 97. Glory of Jayanti

## \|\| 1.97.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*māghasya śuklapakṣe tu saptamī yā trilocana \|*  
*jayantī nāma sā proktā puṇyā pāpaharā śivā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O three eyed lord, the bright seventh moon day of the month of Magha, which is quite auspicious and removes the sins, is said to be the form of benevolence and is known as Jayanti.

## \|\| 1.97.2 \|\|

*sopoṣyā yena vidhinā śṛṇu taṃ pārvatīpriya \|*  
*pāraṇāni tu catvāri kathitānyatra paṇḍitaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O beloved of Parvati, the manner in which its fast is observed, is being revealed by me. You please listen. Four breaking of the fasts have been prescribed by the people of wisdom for this Saptami.

## \|\| 1.97.3 \|\|

*pañcamyāmekabhaktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*upavāsastu saptamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. According to the said procedure, on the fifth moon day, one should have a single meal. On the sixth moon day, one should fast during the evening time, while on the seventh moon day one should observe the complete fast. The fast should be broken on the eighth day.

## \|\| 1.97.4-5 \|\|

*māghe ca phālgune māsi tathā caitre ca suvrata \|*  
*bakapuṣpāṇi ramyāṇi kuṅkumaṃ ca vilepanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ modakāṃścātra dhūpa ājyamudāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*prāśanaṃ pañcagavyaṃ tu pavitrīkaraṇaṃ param \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. O lord of good holy rites! Thus, in the month of Magha, Phalguna and Chaitra, jasmine flowers, saffron paste and sweet balls should be offered as eatables. The incense of ghee should be offered. The purified Panchagavya should be tasted for breaking the fast.

## \|\| 1.97.6 \|\|

*modakairbhojayedviprānyathāśaktyā gaṇādhipa \|*  
*śālyodanaṃ ca bhūteśa dadyācchaktyā dvijeṣu vai \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O lord of the Ganas, O lord of the Bhutas, thereafter, he should serve rice with sweet balls to the Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.97.7 \|\|

*itthaṃ sampūjayedyastu bhāskaraṃ lokapūjitam \|*  
*sarvasminpāraṇe vīra so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O valorous one, a person who worships the Sungod who is adorable by the world, he achieves the merit of Ashvamedha sacrifice in each one of the fast break.

## \|\| 1.97.8-9 \|\|

*dvitīye pāraṇe pūjya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*vaiśākhāṣāḍhajyeṣṭheṣu śrāvaṇe māsi suvrata \|*  
*pūjārthamatha bhānorvai śatapatrāṇi suvrata \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śvetaṃ ca candanaṃ bhīma dhūpo guggulurucyate \|*  
*naivedyaṃ guḍapūpāstu prāśanaṃ gomayasya tu \|*  
*bhojane cāpi viprāṇāṃ guḍapūpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. In the second breaking of the fast, one gets reward comparable with the Rajasuya sacrifice. O respectable man of the holy rites, similarly, in the month of Vaishakha, Jyestha, Ashadha and Shravana, the flowers like lotus flowers, white sandal paste, guggulu, incense, naivedya (eatables) including sugarcane cakes, fried cakes, should be offered to the Sungod. The breaking of the fast has been prescribed with the tasting of cow’s products. Similarly, the Brahmanas should be served food to their satisfaction including the fried cakes.

## \|\| 1.97.10 \|\|

*dvitīyamidamākhyātaṃ pāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phaladaṃ bhāskarapriyam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thus, the second fast breaking is the remover of the sins and the provider of the merits of performing the Rajasuya and Ashvamedha yajnas, bestowed by the Sungod, which has been spoken by me.

## \|\| 1.97.11-13 \|\|

*tṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu devasya pūjārthe bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*māsi bhādrapade vīra tathā cāśvayuje vibho \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kārttike cāpi māse tu raktacandanamādiśet \|*  
*mālatīkusumānīha dhūpo vijaya ucyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūpāstu bhojanaṃ ca dvijanmanām \|*  
*kuśodakaprāśanaṃ tu kāyaśuddhikaraṃ param \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Now you listen to the third fast breaking relating to the Sun worship, which I am going to speak out. O excellent one, in the months of Bhadrapada, Ashvina and Karttika, offering of the Malati flowers soaked in the paste of the red sandal, besides the incense vijaya and the eatables of fried cakes and ghi, should be offered. These should be served to the Brahmanas as the food items. For the purification of the performer’s body, the water of kusha grass should be sipped. This is necessary.

## \|\| 1.97.14 \|\|

*tṛtīyamapi cākhyātaṃ pāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phaladaṃ bhāskarapriyam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Thus, I have spoken to you about the third breaking of the fast, which is the remover of the sins and bestower of the merits of performing of the Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.97.15 \|\|

*caturthamapi te vacmi pāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phaladaṃ bhāskarapriyam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Similarly, the fourth parana (breaking of fast) is also remover of sins, besides the bestower of the merits of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.97.16-18 \|\|

*tadadya devaśārdūla pāraṇaṃ śreyase śṛṇu \|*  
*māsi mārgaśire vīra pauṣe māsi tathā śiva \|\| 16 \|\|*

*māghe ca devaśārdūla śṛṇu puṇyānyaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*karavīrāṇi raktāni tathā raktaṃ ca candanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*amṛtākhyastathā dhūpo naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ param \|*  
*ārjanīyaṃ tathā takraṃ prāśanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. O lion among the gods! Therefore, for the self benefit, you listen to it quite carefully. O valorous Shiva, I am speaking all the flowers used in the months of Margashirsha, Pausha and Magha, which you please listen. In this type of performance, the oleander flowers, red sandal paste, Amrita incense, eatables and payasam should be used breaking the fast.

## \|\| 1.97.19 \|\|

*agaruṃ candanaṃ mustaṃ sihlakaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*samabhāgaistu kartavyamidaṃ cāmṛtamucyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. With these things, the Sungod is immensely pleased. One should collect equal quantity of ginger, black pepper and long pepper. By mixing them together they are named as Amrita incense.

## \|\| 1.97.20-22 \|\|

*nāmāni kathitānyatra bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*citrabhānustathā bhānurādityo bhāskarastathā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prīyatāmiti sarvasminpāraṇe vidhimādiśet \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu kuryātpūjāṃ vibhāvasoḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ tithau devadeva sa yāti paramaṃ padam \|*  
*kṛtvaivaṃ saptamīṃ bhīma sarvakāmānavāpnute \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Thereafter, one should recite the name of the Sungod, known as Chitrabhanu, Bhanu, Aditya and Bhaskara, praying at the same time — “Let him remain always pleased with me.” With this prayer, the fast breaking should be done. O lord of gods! Thus, on this particular moon day, one who worships the Sungod, he achieves the highest position. O Bhima, by thus performing the Saptami vrata, all the desires get fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.97.23 \|\|

*putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam \|*  
*sarogo mucyate rogaiḥ śubhamāpnoti puṣkalam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In this way, a person desirous of a son, riches, cure from disease and other benefits, gets all to his satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.97.24 \|\|

*pūrṇe saṃvatsare bhīma kāryā pūjā divākare \|*  
*gandhapuṣpopahāraistu brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakaiḥ pūjayā vācakasya tu \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O Bhima, accordingly, by the etui of the year, and while adoring the Sungod with flower garlands, one should serve the excellent food to the Brahmanas. The reciter of the scriptures should also be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.97.25 \|\|

*itthaṃ sampūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścābhipūjya ca \|*  
*vācakaṃ ca dvijaṃ pūjya idaṃ vākyamudīrayet \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Thus, worshipping the Sungod besides the Brahmanas and the reciter with all humility, one should offer the prayer.

## \|\| 1.97.26 \|\|

*dharmakāryeṣu me deva arthakāryeṣu nityaśaḥ \|*  
*kāmakāryeṣu sarveṣu jayo bhavatu sarvadā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O Deva, by your grace, I should continue to achieve success in the activities of dharma, artha and kama.

## \|\| 1.97.27-28 \|\|

*tato visarjayedviprānvācakaṃ tu dvijottamam \|*  
*itthaṃ kuryādidaṃ yastu sa jayaṃ prāpnuyātphalam \|*  
*sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 27 \|\|*

*vimānavaramāruḍhaḥ kañjajodbhavamuttamam \|*  
*tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā patagopamaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. O best of the Brahmanas, at the time of conclusion, the Brahmanas as well as the reciter Brahmanas should be sent off gracefully. A person, who thus performs the process of Saptami appropriately, he achieves the abode of Surya, seated over the resplendent plane, endowed with Lakshmi.

## Chapter 98. Glory of Aparajita

## \|\| 1.98.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*māsi bhādrapade śuklā saptamī yā gaṇādhipa \|*  
*aparājiteti vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O leader of the ganas, the bright seventh moon day of the month of Bhadrapada removes the grave sins and is known by the name of Aparajita.

## \|\| 1.98.2 \|\|

*caturthyāmekabhaktaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ naktamādiśet \|*  
*upavāsaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saptamyāṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. In the process of the performing for the same, a person should take food once on the fifth moon day, while tasting during the night on the sixth moon day and the fast should be broken on the seventh moon day or the Saptami. This is the prescribed method for this vrata.

## \|\| 1.98.3-4 \|\|

*pāraṇānyatra catvāri kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*puṣpāṇi karavīrasya tathā raktaṃ ca candanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dhūpakriyā guggulena naivedyaṃ guḍapūpakāḥ \|*  
*bhādrapadādimāseṣu vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The people with wisdom have prescribed four parana (fast breaking) for this vrata. Then the eatables like sugarcane balls, fried sweet cakes, besides the flowers of oleander plant, red sandal paste and guggulu incense, have to be offered.

## \|\| 1.98.5-7 \|\|

*śvetāni bhīmapuṣpāṇi tathā śvetaṃ ca candanam \|*  
*dhūpamājyamihākhyātaṃ naivadyaṃ pāyasaṃ raveḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*tato'gastyasya puṣpāṇi kuṅkumaṃ ca vilepanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dhūpārthaṃ sihlakaṃ proktamatha vā ravivarṇakam \|*  
*śālyodanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sarasaṃ phālgunādiṣu \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. O Bhima in this way, the white flowers, white sandal paste, ghi, incense and payasam as eatable should be offered to the Sungod during the months of Margashirsha and others, which is called the second parana or fast breaking. Similarly, the Agastya flowers, saffron paste, the red incense, boiled rice and other sweet eatables, should be offered for the Sungod in the months of Phalguna etc., as the part of the worship of the Sun. This is known as the third parana (fast breaking) of the entire process.

## \|\| 1.98.8-10 \|\|

*raktotpalāni bhūteśa sāguruṃ candanaṃ tathā \|*  
*ananto dhūpa uddiṣṭo naivedyaṃ khaṇḍapūpakāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śrīkhaṇḍaṃ granthisahitamaguruḥ sihlakaṃ tathā \|*  
*mustā tathendraṃ bhūteśa śarkarā gṛhyate tryaham \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ityeṣa dhūpo'nantastu kathito devasattama \|*  
*jyeṣṭhādimāseṣu tathā vidhirukto manīṣibhiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. O lord of the goblins, in the fourth parana (fast breaking) red lotus flowers, agaru, sandal paste, Ananta incense and fried cakes of sugar, should be offered in the month of Jyeshtha and others. The incense should be prepared of Shrikhanda, agaru, motha weed and sugar winch is called Ananta incense, and is processed in three days.

## \|\| 1.98.11-12 \|\|

*śṛṇu nāmāni devasya prāśanāni ca suvrata \|*  
*sudhāṃśuraryamā caiva savitā tripurāntakaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pāraṇeṣveva sarveṣu prīyatāmiti kīrtayet \|*  
*gomūtraṃ pañcagavyaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ coṣṇaṃ payo dadhi \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. O lord of good holy rites, now I am speaking out the names of the Sungod as well as the related eatables required for the worship. His names are — Sudhamshu, Aryama, Savitri and Tripurantaka. One should offer bumble prayer — “Let the Sungod always remain pleased with me.” Such a type of prayer should be made in each one of the parana. The cow’s urine, hot milk, curd, ghi and sugar should all be mixed together. The mixture is called Panchagavya, which has to be used during the performing of the vrata.

## \|\| 1.98.13 \|\|

*yastvetāṃ saptamo kuryādanena vidhinā naraḥ \|*  
*aparājito bhavetso'sau sadā śatrubhirāhave \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A person who performs the Saptami vrata, he always remains invincible from the enemies in the battlefield.

## \|\| 1.98.14 \|\|

*jitvā śatruṃ labhetāpi trivargaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*trivargamatha samprāpya svarbhānoḥ puramaśnute \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Again after his conquering of the enemies, he gets surely successful in the achieving of trivarga or triple success of dharma, artha and kama. Thereafter, he achieves the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.98.15 \|\|

*tataḥ pūrṇeṣu māseṣu pūjayecchaktitaḥ khagam \|*  
*gandhapuṣpopahāraistu purāṇaśravaṇena ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Performing these vratas in an appropriate manner, one should worship the Sungod according to his means, offering fragrance and flowers, besides listening to the Puranas. The process should be thus completed.

## \|\| 1.98.16-18 \|\|

*aśvadānena ca vibhorbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*vācakaṃ pūjayitvā ca bhāskarasya priyaṃ sadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bhāskarāya dhvajāndadyānnānāratnavibhūṣitān \|*  
*ya itthaṃ kurute vīra saptamīṃ yatnataḥ sadā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sa parājitya vai śatruṃ yāti haṃsasalokatām \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. O excellent one, again one should donate the horse, serve food to the Brahmanas and adore the reciter of the Puranas, offering them various types of gems, flags, for the Sungod. O valorous one! A person, who remains anxious for the appropriate performing of the Saptami vrata, he besides being victorious over his enemies in the battle, attains the moksha of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.98.19 \|\|

*śuklāśvodbhavayānena āpagena patākinā \|*  
*āpagādhipasaṃkāśa āpagānucaro bhavet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Such a person, boarding the vehicle driven by the white horses, with white flags, becomes the attendant of Varuna with bright resplendence.

## Chapter 99. Glory of Aparajita

## \|\| 1.99.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ \|*  
*mahājayā tadā sā vai saptamī bhāskarapriyā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — When the Samkranti of the Sungod falls on the bright seventh moon day, it becomes the favourite of the Sungod and is known as Mahajaya Saptami.

## \|\| 1.99.2 \|\|

*snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam \|*  
*sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasya vaco yathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Therefore, according to the words of the Sungod, the activities like bathing, charities, japam, homa, besides the worship of pitris and the gods performed during this period, result in the crore times multiplication of the related merits.

## \|\| 1.99.3 \|\|

*yastasyāṃ mānavo bhaktyā ghṛtena snāpayedravim \|*  
*so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya svargalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A person, who on this particular moon day, bathes the image of the Sun with clarified butter, he attains the merit of the Ashvamedha sacrifice besides the heaven.

## \|\| 1.99.4 \|\|

*payasā snāpayedyastu bhāskaraṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ \|*  
*vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo yāti sūryasalokatām \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A person who bathes the Sungod with milk, he getting relieved of all the sins, ultimately achieves the Salokya moksha of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.99.5-7 \|\|

*kārpūreṇa vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinī \|*  
*tejasā harisaṃkāśaḥ kāntyā sūryasamastathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sthitvā tatra ciraṃ kālaṃ rājā bhavati cāñjasā \|*  
*mahājayaiṣā kathitā saptamī tripurāntaka \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yāmupoṣya naro bhaktyā bhavate sūryalokagaḥ \|*  
*tato yāti paraṃ brahma yatra gatvā na śocati \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Boarding the plane made of camphor and decorated with small bells fixed in a net and possessing the resplendence of ruby, he lives there for long. Returning from there, he becomes an illustrious king. O killer of Tripura, this Mahajaya Saptami when celebrated appropriately, the concerned person, achieving a place in the abode of the Sungod, also achieves Brahmaloka where one is relieved of all the worries.

## Chapter 100. Nanda Saptami described

## \|\| 1.100.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yā tu mārgaśire māsi śuklapakṣe tu saptamī \|*  
*nandā sā kathitā vīra sarvānandakarī śubhā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O valorous one, the bright seventh moon day of the month of Margashirsha is blissful besides being the bestower of welfare. Therefore, it is known as Nanda Saptami.

## \|\| 1.100.2 \|\|

*pañcamyāmekabhaktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu kīrtayanti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The process of the performing of the vrata includes taking food once a day on the fifth moon day, then fasting at night on the sixth moon day and observing complete fast on the seventh moon day. This has been prescribed by the people with wisdom.

## \|\| 1.100.3-5 \|\|

*pāraṇānyatra vai trīṇi śaṃsantīha manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*mālatīkusumānīha sugandhaṃ candanaṃ tathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*karpūrāgarusammiśraṃ dhūpaṃ cātra vinirdiśet \|*  
*dadhyodanaṃ sakhaṇḍaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhāskarapriyam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tameva dadyādviprebhyo'śnīyācca tadanu svayam \|*  
*dhūpārthaṃ bhāskarasyaiṣa prathame pāraṇe vidhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. The learned people have prescribed thee paranas of this vrata. For the performing of this vrata, the offering of jasmine flowers, fragrant sandal paste, camphor and incense mixed with agaru should be offered to the Sungod. Thereafter, the curd, sugar and boiled rice are immensely liked by the Sungod. These should be offered to the Brahmanas with respect, satisfying them at the same time. This u the process of the first param of the Sungod’s vrata.

## \|\| 1.100.6-7 \|\|

*palāśapuṣpāṇi vibho dhūpo yaḥ śakya eva ca \|*  
*karpūraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhamaguruḥ sihlakaṃ tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sagranthi vṛṣaṇaṃ bhīma kuṃkumaṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā \|*  
*harītakī tathā bhīma eṣa pakṣaka ucyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. O excellent one, in the second parana, the flowers of palasha tree should be collected besides yahshakya incense, camphor, sandal paste, a herb, guggulu, olibanum tree steaks, granthiparni (a kind of grass), musk-deer, yellow myrobalan, and mixing together the incense should be prepared and offered to the image.

## \|\| 1.100.8-10 \|\|

*dhūpaḥ prabodha ādiṣṭo naivedyaṃ khaṇḍamaṇḍakāḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇāgaruḥ sitaṃ kañjaṃ bālakaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*caṃdanaṃ tagaro mustā prabodhaśarkarānvitā \|*  
*bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścāpi khaṇḍakhādyairgaṇādhipa \|*  
*nimbapatraṃ tu samprāśya tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pāraṇasya dvitīyasya vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Thereafter, the eatables should be prepared and offered to the Sungod besides the incense known as Prabodha which comprises of black agaru, sitamkanja, musk-deer, sandal paste and weed grass. It should be presented with reverence. O leader of the ganas, the eatables with sweet dishes should be served to the Brahmanas. The performer should take his food keeping silence. The breaking of the fast has been prescribed with fruits of the nima tree. The method of second parana has thus been concluded.

## \|\| 1.100.11-12 \|\|

*nīlotpalāni śubhrāṇi dhūpaṃ gauggulamāharet \|*  
*naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ deyaṃ1 prītaye bhāskarasya tu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vilepanaṃ candanaṃ tu prāśane vidhirucyate \|*  
*tṛtīyasyāpi te vīra kathito vidhiruttamaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The spotless blue lotus, incense of guggulu, naivedya of pay as am, sandal paste for paste, are the articles which are favorites of the Sungod and must be offered to him. O valorous one, thus the third parana of this process has been spoken.

## \|\| 1.100.13 \|\|

*śṛṇu nāmāni devasya pāvanāni nṛṇāṃ sadā \|*  
*viṣṇurbhagastathā dhātā prīyatāmudgirecca vai \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Now I am speaking out such names of the Sungod, which are quite auspicious for the human beings. You please listen. Initially, the names should be recited that Vishnu and Vidhata should always remain pleased with me. Reciting the names in this way, the prayer should be made.

## \|\| 1.100.14 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryātprayatamānasaḥ \|*  
*sakāmāniha samprāpya nandate śāśvatī samāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A person who performs this Saptami vrata appropriately, he enjoys blissful life for many years, getting all his desires fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.100.15-16 \|\|

*tataḥ sūryasado gatyā nandate nandavardhana \|*  
*eṣā tu nandajananī tavākhyātā bhayā śiva \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yāmupoṣya tato bhuktvā nandate haṃsamāpya vai \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Thereafter, reaching the abode of the Sungod, he enjoys all the pleasures. This Saptami therefore, bestows all the comforts delighting the Sungod and has been described to you exhaustively.

## Chapter 101. Description of Bhadra kalpa

## \|\| 1.101.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ saviturbhavet \|*  
*yadā prathamatā caiva tadā vai bhadratāṃ vrajet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — The sixth moon day of the bright fortnight when falls during Hasta constellation, it is known as Bhadra and it bestows welfare, besides being the foremost.

## \|\| 1.101.2 \|\|

*snapanaṃ tatra devasya ghṛtena kathitaṃ budhaiḥ \|*  
*kṣīreṇa ca tathā vīra punarikṣurasena ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O valorous one, the learned people have described about bathing the Sungod, while performing the religious celebrations. There is a provision for the bathing of the Surya image with milk or the juice of the sugarcane.

## \|\| 1.101.3-6 \|\|

*snāpayitvā tu deveśaṃ candanena vilepayet \|*  
*dagdhvā tu guggulaṃ tasya dadyādbhadraṃ tathāgrataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*godhūmacūrṇaṃ nivapanvimalaṃ śaśisannibham \|*  
*savajraṃ saguḍaṃ caiva raktapuṣpopaśobhitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yadasya śṛṅgamīśānaṃ tatra vai mauktikaṃ nyaset \|*  
*yadāgneyaṃ tatra māṇikyaṃ nyasedvā lohitaṃ maṇim \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nairṛtye makaraṃ dadyādvāyavye padmarāgiṇam \|*  
*gāṅgeyamantatastasya svaśaktyā vinyasedbudhaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Bathing the Sungod again, the sandal paste should be offered to him. The guggulu incense should then be offered to the image. Thereafter, a figure of the wheat flour having the white complexion resembling the sandal paste, should be made. The figure then should be decorated with vajra flowers and other flowers. Then the image should be decorated with four horns. Beads should be studded in the horn to the north-east, gems in the southeast horn, makara in the south-west and ruby in the north-west. All other limbs should also be decorated with gold.

## \|\| 1.101.7-9 \|\|

*caturthyāmekabhaktaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ naktamādiśet \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāmayācitaṃ proktaṃ upavāso hyataḥ paraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthānbaiḍālavratikāntyajān \|*  
*saptamyāṃ pālayetprājño divā svāpaṃ vivarjayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryādvai bhadrasaptamīm \|*  
*tasmai bhadrāṇi sarvāṇi yacchanti ṛbhavaḥ sadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. One should take food once on the fourth moon day, and should observe night fast on the fifth moon day. On the sixth moon day, one should consume food received without demand. The fasting in this case is performed on the seventh moon day. The people with wisdom should discard cheating, wickedness, fraudulent ways and should not sleep during the day. Thus a person, who performs the vrata as prescribed above, he is always bestowed with welfare by the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.101.10 \|\|

*bhadraṃ dadāti yastvasyāṃ bhadrastasya suto bhavet \|*  
*bhadramāsādya bhūteśa sadā bhadreṇa tiṣṭhati \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A person who making a Bhadra image of the Sungod, offers it (in a temple), he is bestowed with a virtuous son. Thus, he achieving virtues, becomes the image of virtue himself.

## \|\| 1.101.11 \|\|

*diṇḍiruvāca \|*  
*ko'yaṃ bhadra iti proktaḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ prabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*dattvā ca kiṃ phalaṃ vidyādvidhinā kena dīyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Dindi said — What type of Bhadra is there who has been mentioned by you? What type of ornaments should be used to decorate the image? You please tell me.

## \|\| 1.101.12 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*vyoma bhadramiti proktaṃ devacihnamanūpamam \|*  
*yaddhṛtveha naraḥ sūryaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Brahma said — He is called Vyoma Bhadra because of his possessing the beautiful symptoms of divinity. Meditating upon the same Sun, a person is relieved of all his sins.

## \|\| 1.101.13-16 \|\|

*śālipiṇḍamayaṃ kāryaṃ catuṣkoṇamanūpamam \|*  
*gavyena sarpiṣā yuktaṃ khaṇḍaśarkarayānvitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*cāturjātakapūrṇaṃ tu drākṣābhiśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*nālikeraphalaiścaiva sugandhaṃ ca gaṇādhipa \|\| 14 \|\|*

*madhyendranīlaṃ bhadrasya nyasetprājñaḥ svaśaktitaḥ \|*  
*puṣparāgaṃ marakataṃ padmarāgaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

*anaupamyaṃ ca māṇikyaṃ kramātkoṇeṣu vinyaset \|*  
*vācakāyātha vā dadyādatha vā bhojake svayam \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. The beautiful figure of Bhadra should be prepared with the powder of rice, with four corners. The ghi of cow, white sugar, pulses, sugar, cardamom, nagakeshara, dry grapes and the coconut fruits should be shown hanging over the four comers of the figure. In the middle of the image, the gems like sapphire, topaz, emerald, ruby and other gems should be studded besides the horns, as per one’s means. Thereafter, they should be given to the Brahmanas or the reciter of the holy book.

## \|\| 1.101.17 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu kṛtvā bhadraṃ prayacchati \|*  
*sa hi bhadrāṇi samprāpya gacchedgopatimandiram \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person who after so creating a Bhadra, presents it to the Brahmanas, he enjoying all the welfare, achieves the place of Surya.

## \|\| 1.101.18-20 \|\|

*brahmalokaṃ tato gacchedyānārūḍho na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tejasā gojasaṃkāśaḥ kāṃtyā gojasamastathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*prabhayā gopatestulya ūrjasā goparasya ca \|*  
*tasmādetya punarbhūmau gopatiḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*prasādādgopatervīra sarvajñādhipapūjitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ityeṣā kathitā bhīma bhadrā nāmeti saptamī \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro bhīma brahmalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Thereafter, gaining the lustre of the sun, resplendence and the strength, he proceeds on to the Brahmaloka seated over a comfortable vehicle. In due course of time, returning to the earth by the grace of the Sungod, he becomes a king respected by other rulers. O Bhima, thus I have described the Bhadra Saptami by celebrating which a person reaches Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.101.21 \|\|

*śṛṇvanti ye paṭhantīha kurvanti ca gaṇādhipa \|*  
*te sarve bhadramāsādya yānti tadbrahma śāśvatam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O leader of the ganas, by listening, reciting of this vrata, besides performing of the related holy rites with devotion, the people receiving Bhadra, also achieve eternal Brahman.

## \|\| 1.101.22 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ityuktavānpurā brahmā diṇḍine saptamīvratam \|*  
*mayāpyuktaṃ tava vibho yathājñātaṃ yathāśrutam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Sumantu said — Thus the process of the performing of the Saptami vrata was narrated by Brahma to Dindi. O excellent one, whatever the knowledge had been possessed by me, by listening to the same, the same has been repeated to you.

## \|\| 1.101.23 \|\|

*gṛhītvā saptamīkalpaṃ mānavo yastu bhūtale \|*  
*tyajetkāmādbhayādvāpi sa jñeyaḥ patito'budhaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Such of the people on earth, who discard the Saptami vrata out of fear or other engagements, they have been termed as ignorant and the fallen people.

## \|\| 1.101.24 \|\|

*tasmāddhāraya tadvīra na tyājyaṃ saptamīvratam \|*  
*tyajamāno bhavedvīra ārūḍhapatito naraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O valorous one! Therefore, people should always perform vrata for this Saptami. By just ignoring it, a person is treated as the fallen one.

## \|\| 1.101.25 \|\|

*śrāvayedyastu bhaktyā ca saptamīkalpamāditaḥ \|*  
*so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya tato yāti paraṃ padam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The people who would recite the Saptami kalpa from beginning to the end, they would surely earn the merit of performing the Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## Chapter 102. Worship of constellations

## \|\| 1.102.1-2 \|\|

*uttarāyāmahirbudhnyaṃ parāṃ śāntimavāpnuyāt \|*  
*revatyāṃ pūjitaḥ pūṣā dadāti satataṃ śubham \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarvāśca tithayo hyasya priyāḥ sūryasya bhārata \|*  
*tasmādasyāṃ nareṇeha pūjanīyo divākaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — O Bharata, all the tithis (moon days) are favourite of the Sungod. But the Saptami tithi or the seventh moon day is the most favourite one. A person may have several wives, but one out of them is the dearest of all, similarly, a person should worship the Sungod who is the dearest among all gods.

## \|\| 1.102.3 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*tithīnāmadhipaḥ sūryaḥ sarvāsāṃ kathito yadi \|*  
*saptamyāmeva yāgo'sya kimarthaṃ kriyate budhaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Shatanika said — In case the Sungod is the leader of all the tithis or moon days, then why the people of learnings emphasize the worship of Sun on the Saptami day alone.

## \|\| 1.102.4-5 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*idamarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭaḥ surajyeṣṭho divi sthitaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇunā kuruśārdūla tenoktaṃ haraye yathā \|*  
*tathā te sarvamākhyāsye śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vibho \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sukhāsīnaṃ surajyeṣṭhaṃ purā devaṃ pitāmaham \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā deva kṛṣṇo vacanamabravīt \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Sumantu said — O lion of the Kuru race, this particular question was once asked by Vishnu from Brahma. O excellent one, whatever at that time was spoken by Brahma to Vishnu, the same is going to be repeated by me. You listen to me attentively. Once in earlier times, lord Krishna offered his salutation to Brahma, lowering his head who was comfortably seated on his place.

## \|\| 1.102.6 \|\|

*yadyeṣa bhānumāndevastithīnāmadhipaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*kimarthaṃ pūjyate brahmansaptamyāṃ brūhi me vibho \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He said — “O Brahman, though the Sungod happens to be the leader of all the tithis (moon days), then why is he adored during the seventh moon day alone? You kindly enlighten me on this point clearly.

## \|\| 1.102.7 \|\|

*evamuktaḥ surajyeṣṭho viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*prahasya bhagavāndeva idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. When Vishnu, possessing all the prominent virtues thus asked from Brahma, Brahma smiled and said.

## \|\| 1.102.8 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*devebhyastithayo dattā bhāskareṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*muktvaikāṃ saptamīṃ sarvāṃ samyagārādhanena vai \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Brahma said — At the prayer of the gods, getting pleased, the Sungod had given over all the tithis to you except the Saptami tithi.

## \|\| 1.102.9 \|\|

*yasyaiva yaddinaṃ dattaṃ sa tasyaivādhipaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*svadine pūjitastasmātsvamantrairvarado bhavet. \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Therefore, whichever tithi was given over to a particular god, he became the leader of the same. Thereafter, each one of the gods, getting worshipped on that allotted particular tithi, started showering blessings to their devotees.

## \|\| 1.102.10 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*arkeṇa kataratkasmai dinaṃ dattaṃ mahātmanā \|*  
*svadine pūjite'sminvai svamantrairjāyate dhruvam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Vishnu said — Which one of the tithi or moon day was allotted to which particular god during getting worshipped with the reciting of the mantras, he bestows the boons.

## \|\| 1.102.11-15 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*agnaye pratipaddattā dvitīyā brahmaṇe tathā \|*  
*tṛtīyā yakṣarājāya gaṇeśāya caturthyapi \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pañcamī nāgarājāya kārtikeyāya ṣaṣṭhyapi \|*  
*saptamī sthāpitātmārthaṃ dattā rudrāya cāṣṭamī \|\| 12 \|\|*

*durgāyai navamī dattā yamāya daśamī svayam \|*  
*viśvebhyaścātha devebhyo dattā caikādaśī sadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dvādaśī viṣṇave dattā madanāya trayodaśī \|*  
*caturdaśī śaṅkarāya dattā somāya pūrṇimā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pitṝṇāṃ bhānunā dattā puṇyā pañcadaśī sadā \|*  
*tithyaḥ pañcadaśaitāstu somasya parikīrtitāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

11-15. Brahma said — Pratipada or the first moon day was allotted to Agni. Dvitiya or the second moon day was allotted to Brahma; Tritiya or the third moon day was allotted to Kubera — the lord of Yakshas. Chaturthi or the fourth moon day was allotted to Ganapati or Ganesha, Panchami or the fifth moon day was allotted to Nagaraja; Shasthi or the sixth moon day was allotted to Karttikeya, while the Sungod kept Saptami or the seventh moon day, for himself. Ashtami or the eighth moon day was allotted to Rudra, Navami or ninth moon day was allotted to Durga; Dashami or the tenth moon day was allotted to Yama; Ekadashi or the eleventh moon day was allotted to Vishvedeva; Dvadashi or the twelfth moon day was allotted to Vishnu. Trayodashi or the thirteenth moon day was allotted to Kamadeva, while for lord Shiva Chaturdashi or the fourteenth moon day was allotted. Purnima or the full moon day was allotted for performing the Somavrata. This auspicious moonless night was earmarked for the pitris. All the fifteen tithis are in the forms of the digits of the moon.

## \|\| 1.102.16 \|\|

*pīyate kṛṣṇapakṣe tu surairebhiryathoditaiḥ \|*  
*śuklapakṣe prapūryante ṣoḍaśyā kalayā saha \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Therefore, the gods consume the same during the dark fortnight. Then, in the sixteenth kala, they get completed during the bright fortnight.

## \|\| 1.102.17 \|\|

*akṣayā sā sadaikaikā tatra sākṣātsthito raviḥ \|*  
*kṣayavṛddhikaro hyevaṃ tenāsau tatpatiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The sixteenth ray or digit of the moon never vanishes and remains intact, because the Sungod himself is resided in it. In this way, the Sungod is the cause of the increase or decrease of the moon. Because of this, the Sungod is conceived to be the father of the moon.

## \|\| 1.102.18-19 \|\|

*dadāti gatimakṣīṇā dhyānamātrasthito 1 raviḥ \|*  
*anyepīṣṭānyathākāmānprayacchanti sukhena vai \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tathā sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi kṛṣṇa saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu \|*  
*agnimiṣṭvā ca hutvā ca pratipadyamṛtaṃ ghṛtam \|*  
*haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyādamitaṃ dhanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. O Krishna, as with the mere appearance of the Sungod in the sky, how the Sungod bestows the excellent position besides fulfills all the desires of the people, I am going to speak out. You please listen. On the day of Pratipada or the first moon day by pouring the oblation of ghi in the fire and after completion of the worship of the Sungod, one achieves enormous riches and the cereals.

## \|\| 1.102.20 \|\|

*brahmāṇaṃ ca dvitīyāyāṃ sampūjya brahmacāriṇam \|*  
*bhojayitvā ca vidyānāṃ sarvāsāṃ pārago bhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. On the second moon day, adoring Brahma and by serving food to a Brahmachari, the person achieves excellence in all the lores.

## \|\| 1.102.21 \|\|

*tṛtīyāyāṃ ca vitteśaṃ vittāḍhyo jāyate dhruvam \|*  
*krayādivyavahoraṣu lābho bahuguṇo bhavet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. By adoring Kubera on the third moon day, one surely achieves enormous wealth, besides various other gains.

## \|\| 1.102.22 \|\|

*gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kuryāccaturthyāṃ sarvakarmasu \|*  
*avighnaṃ vidviṣāṃ vighnaṃ kuryāccāsya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. By worshipping Ganesha on the fourth moon day, all the tasks get established without any obstruction and the enemies get destroyed.

## \|\| 1.102.23 \|\|

*nāgāniṣṭvā ca pañcamyāṃ na viṣairabhibhūyate \|*  
*striyaṃ ca labhate putrānparāṃ ca śriyamāpnuyāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. By adoring the Nagas on the fifth moon day, one is relieved of the danger of poison. A person also gets an excellent wife, son as well as the wealth.

## \|\| 1.102.24 \|\|

*sampūjya kārtikeyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāyate \|*  
*medhāvī rūpasampanno dīrghāyuḥ kīrtivardhanaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. By worshipping Karttikeya on the sixth moon day, a person achieves excellent intelligence, beauty, long life and enormous glory.

## \|\| 1.102.25-26 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ pūjya rakṣeśaṃ citrabhānuṃ divākaram \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ pūjito devo govṛṣābharaṇo haraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*jñānaṃ dadāti vipulaṃ kāntiṃ ca vipulāṃ tathā \|*  
*mṛtyuhā jñānadaścaiva pāśahā ca prapūjitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. By adoring Chitrabhanu form of Surya on the seventh moon day, one should worship the bull-bannered Shiva on the eighth moon day and by so doing, he achieves enormous knowledge, beauty, besides freedom from birth and death.

## \|\| 1.102.27 \|\|

*durgāṃ sampūjya durgāṇi navamyāṃ taratīcchayā \|*  
*saṅgrāme vyavahāre ca sadā vijayamaśnute \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. By worshipping the goddess Durga on the ninth moon day, crossing various types of miserable forts of the universe, he becomes victorious always in the battlefield.

## \|\| 1.102.28 \|\|

*daśamyāṃ yamamātiṣṭhetsarvavyādhiharo dhruvam \|*  
*narakādatha mṛtyośca samuddharati mānavam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. By worshipping Yama on the tenth moon day, a person is relieved of all the ailments, suffering of the hell, besides the death.

## \|\| 1.102.29 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ yathoddiṣṭā viśvedevāḥ prapūjitāḥ \|*  
*prajāṃ paśuṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ prayacchanti mahīṃ tathā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. By worshipping Vishvedeva on the eleventh moon day, a person achieves progeny, animals, riches, cereals, and the earth or land.

## \|\| 1.102.30 \|\|

*dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumiṣṭveha sarvadā vijayī bhavet \|*  
*pūjyaśca sarvalokānāṃ yathā gopatigokaraḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. As the Sungod possessing the rays is adorable in all the world, similarly, Vishnu is also worshipped in the world. Therefore, by worshipping him on the twelfth moon day, one always faces victory.

## \|\| 1.102.31 \|\|

*kāmadevaṃ trayodaśyāṃ surūpo jāyate dhruvam \|*  
*iṣṭāṃ rūpavatīṃ bhāryāṃ labhetkāmāṃśca puṣkalān \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. By worshipping the god of love on the thirteenth moon day, a person achieves excellent beauty and all his desires as also of his wife are fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.102.32 \|\|

*dṛṣṭveśvaraṃ caturdaśyāṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*bahuputro bahudhanastathā syānnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. By adoring Shiva on the fourteenth moon light, a person achieves all the riches, sons and enormous wealth.

## \|\| 1.102.33 \|\|

*paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yaḥ somaṃ pūjayedbhaktimānnaraḥ \|*  
*svādhipatyaṃ bhavettasya sampūrṇaṃ na ca hīyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Similarly, by worshipping the moon on the full moon day, the devoted person achieves excellent superiority or leadership from which he is never fallen.

## \|\| 1.102.34 \|\|

*pitaraḥ svadine diṇḍe dṛṣṭāḥ kurvanti sarvadā \|*  
*prajāvṛddhiṃ dhanaṃ rakṣāṃ cāyuṣyaṃ balameva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O Dindi, on the moonless day, when the pitris are adored, they getting pleased increase progeny, riches, safety, long life and strength always.

## \|\| 1.102.35 \|\|

*upavāsaṃ vināpyete bhavantyuktaphalapradāḥ \|*  
*pūjayā japahomaiśca toṣitā bhaktitaḥ sadā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Even when the worship is performed without fasting, all the gods bestow the appropriate reward. Therefore, one should please them by performing worship with devotion.

## \|\| 1.102.36-37 \|\|

*mūlamantraiśca saṃjñābhiraṃśamantraiśca kīrtitāḥ \|*  
*pūrvavatpadmamadhyasthāḥ karttavyāśca tithīśvarāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpopahāraiśca yathā śaktyā vidhīyate \|*  
*pūjā bāhyena vidhinā kṛtāpi ca phalapradā \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. In case, while observing the usual fast, establishing the related god over the lotus seat and offering fragrance, flowers etc., then surely the grace of the respective god as stated above is achieved. Similarly, by worshipping outwardly, one achieves the best award.

## \|\| 1.102.38 \|\|

*ājyadhārāsamidbhiśca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ \|*  
*yathoktaphalado homo japaḥ śāntena cetasā \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The eatables prepared with the flow of ghi, sacrificial sticks, curd and milk besides the honey when used in performing homa with a peaceful mind besides performing of japam, all the above boons are achieved.

## \|\| 1.102.39-42 \|\|

*mūlamantrāśca saṃjñābhiraṅgamantrāśca kīrtitāḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā yajñāndaśa dvau ca phalānyetāni bhaktitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yathoktāni tathoktāni labhetehādhikānyapi \|*  
*iha yasmādyathānyasminyo vasedyaḥ sukhī sadā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ lokeṣu mantrajño yāvatteṣāṃ tithiḥ sthitā \|*  
*dahettasmāttathāriṣṭaṃ tadrūpo jāyate naraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*surūpo dharmasampanno kṣapitārirmahīpatiḥ \|*  
*strī vā napuṃsako vāpi jāyate puruṣottamaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

39-42. In this process, the use of basic mantras and the names which are to be recited, have also been defined. A person who performs twelve yajnas with devotion and the related rewards achieved their from, have already been spelt out. With the performing of the due holy rites, one gets better rewarded. The moon day on which the respective god is worshipped in the abode of the relevant god, a person lives there with comfort till the time of dissolution. All misfortunes of the intervening period, vanish on his return to earth. He becomes a ruler, who overpower all his enemies. By performing these holy rites, a person irrespective of his being a man, a woman or a eunuch, he is turned as the best person.

## \|\| 1.102.43 \|\|

*ityetāḥ kathitāḥ kṛṣṇa tithayo yā mayā tava \|*  
*nakṣatradevatāḥ sarvā nakṣatreṣu vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O Krishna! Thus, I have spoken about the glory of all the moon days. Similarly, all the leaders of the constellations are lodged in their respective constellations.

## \|\| 1.102.44-45 \|\|

*iṣṭānkāmānprayacchanti yāstā vakṣye mahīdhara \|*  
*candramā yatra nakṣatre mahāvṛddhyā sthitaḥ sadā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*uktastu devatāyajñastadā sā phaladā bhavet \|*  
*devatāśca pravakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathākramam \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. The way, the leaders of the constellations bestow the desired wishes to the devoted persons, I am going to reveal the same, which you please listen from me with attention. The constellation in which the moon with all its four parts resides, in the same constellation, the method of the adoration of its leader has been prescribed. Therefore, I am speaking out the leaders of the constellations.

## \|\| 1.102.46 \|\|

*nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi yajñāścaiva pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*aśvinyāmaśvināviṣṭvā dīrghāyurjāyate naraḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Like the different constellations, the related yajnas have also been described differently. In the Ashvini constellation with the worship of Ashvinikumaras, a person attains long life.

## \|\| 1.102.47-48 \|\|

*vyādhibhirmucyate kṣipramatyarthaṃ vyādhipīḍitaḥ \|*  
*bharaṇyāṃ yama uddiṣṭaḥ kusumairasitaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*tathā gandhādibhiḥ śubhrairapamṛtyorvimocayet \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. At the time of the serious ailment, (by adoring) Ashvinikumaras, a person is at once relieved of his ailments. When Yama is worshipped in the Bharani constellation with beautiful black flowers and excellent fragrances, a person is saved from the untimely death.

## \|\| 1.102.49 \|\|

*analaḥ kṛttikāyāṃ tu iha sampūjitaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*raktamālyādibhirdadyātphalaṃ homena ca dhruvam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In the Krittika constellation when the puja and homa are performed offering the red flowers in homa, one achieves the excellent reward.

## \|\| 1.102.50 \|\|

*pūjyaḥ prajāpatiḥ prīta iṣṭo dadyātpaśūṃstathā \|*  
*rohiṇyāṃ devaśārdūla pūjanādiha gopate \|*  
*mṛgaśīrṣe sadā somo jñānamārogyameva ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. O lion among the gods, in the Rohini constellation if Brahma is worshipped and he getting pleased, bestows animals. In the Mrigashira constellation, the moon is always worshipped and the person achieves knowledge besides good health.

## \|\| 1.102.51 \|\|

*ārdrāyāṃ tu śivaṃ pūjya paścāddvija yamāpnuyāt \|*  
*padmādibhiḥ sa divyaiśca pūjitaḥ śaṃ prayacchati \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. In the Ardra constellation if Shiva is worshipped, then the person who does so becomes victorious. In case the flowers are offered to the said lord, one achieves all the welfare.

## \|\| 1.102.52 \|\|

*tathā punarvasvaditiḥ sadā sampūjyate divi \|*  
*gurūṇāṃ tarpitā caiva māteva parirakṣati \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. In the Punarvasu constellation, when Aditi is adored like the sky, she protects a person like the mother.

## \|\| 1.102.53-54 \|\|

*puṣye bṛhaspatirbuddhiṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śubhām \|*  
*gītairgandhādibhirnāgā āśleṣāyāṃ prapūjitāḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tarpitāśca yathānyāyaṃ bhakṣyādyairmadhuraiḥ sitaiḥ \|*  
*rakṣāmiṣādibhistaistaiḥ prītiṃ kurvanti mānada \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. In the Pushya constellation, when Brihaspati — the preceptor of the gods is adored, he surely bestows the beneficial wisdom. In the Ashlesha constellation if the Nagas are worshipped with sweet music and sweet eatables, they getting pleased, daily protect the person who does so, from the poison.

## \|\| 1.102.55 \|\|

*maghāsu pitaraḥ sarve havyaiḥ kavyaiśca pūjitāḥ \|*  
*prayacchanti dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ bhṛtyānputrānpaśūṃstathā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. In the Magha constellation when pitris are pleased offering havya and kavya, they bestow wealth, sons and servants, besides the animals.

## \|\| 1.102.56-57 \|\|

*phālgunyāmatha vai pūṣā iṣṭaḥ puṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*pūrvāyāṃ vijayaṃ dadyāduttarāyāṃ bhagaṃ tathā \|\| 56 \|\|*

*bhartāramīpsitaṃ dadyātkanyāyai puruṣāya tām \|*  
*iha janmani yujyeta rūpadraviṇasampadā \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. When Pusha is worshipped in the Purva Phalguni constellation, one achieves victory. When Bhava is adored in the Uttara Phalguni constellation, the girl achieves the husband of her liking, while the man gets a suitable girl. He also achieves the riches with grace.

## \|\| 1.102.58 \|\|

*pūjitaḥ savitā haste viśvatejonidhiḥ sadā \|*  
*gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sarvaṃ dadāti vipulaṃ dhanam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. In the Hasta constellation when the illustrious Savita is worshipped with fragrance and flowers, one achieves enormous wealth.

## \|\| 1.102.59 \|\|

*rājyaṃ tu tvaṣṭā citrāyāṃ niḥsapatnaṃ prayacchati \|*  
*iṣṭaḥ santarpitaḥ prītaḥ svātyāṃ vāyurbalaṃ param \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. When Tvashta is worshipped in the Chitra constellation, one undoubtedly becomes victorious over his enemy and becomes a king with no enemies around. When the wind god is pleased after adoration in Svati constellation, one achieves great merits.

## \|\| 1.102.60 \|\|

*iṃdrāgnī ca viśākhāyāṃ jātaraktai prapūjya ca \|*  
*dhanadhānyāni labdhveha tejasvī nivasetsadā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Getting filled with devotion in the Vishakha constellation, the concerned person, by adoring Indra and Agni, gains enough of wealth and cereals. He always remains illustrious.

## \|\| 1.102.61 \|\|

*raktairmitramanūrādhāsvevaṃ sampūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*śriyo bhajanti sarveṣāṃ ciraṃ jīvanti sarvadā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. In the Anuradha constellation when a person worships with devotion Mitra, then he attains wealth and long life.

## \|\| 1.102.62 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūrvavacchakramiṣṭvā puṣṭimavāpnuyāt \|*  
*guṇairjyeṣṭhaśca1 sarveṣāṃ karmaṇā ca dhanena ca \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. When a person worships Indra as stated earlier, he bestows all the progress. The devotee then excels in riches, virtues and activities.

## \|\| 1.102.63 \|\|

*mūle devapitṝntsarvānbhaktyā2 sampūjya pūrvavat \|*  
*pūrvavatphalamāpnoti svargasthāne dhruvo bhavet \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. A person by adoring his pitris in the Mula constellation as already stated, achieves high merit and finally attains the eternal heaven.

## \|\| 1.102.64 \|\|

*pūrvāṣāḍhe hyapaḥ pūjya hutvā tatraiva pūrvavat \|*  
*santāpānmucyate kṣipraṃ śārīrānmānasāttathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. By performing the worship of water during the Purvashadha constellation, a person is at once relieved of bodily and mental ailments.

## \|\| 1.102.65 \|\|

*āṣāḍhāsu tathā viśvānuttarāṣāḍhayogataḥ \|*  
*viśveśaṃ pūjya puṣpādyaiḥ3 sarvamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. In the Uttarashadha constellation, when Vishvedeva is worshipped with flowers, one has his desires fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.102.66 \|\|

*śravaṇe tu sitairviṣṇuṃ pītairnīlaiśca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*sampūjya śriyamāpnoti paraṃ vijayameva ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. A person who worships Vishnu in the Shravana constellation offering white» yellow and blue flowers» one overpowers Lakshmi or wealth.

## \|\| 1.102.67 \|\|

*dhaniṣṭhāsu vasūniṣṭvā na bhayaṃ bhajate kvacit \|*  
*mahato'pi bhayāttvetairgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. In the Dhanishtha constellation if Vasus are worshipped offering excellent fragrance and flowers, he is relieved of the great japam as well.

## \|\| 1.102.68 \|\|
