*indraṃ śatabhiṣāyāṃ ca vyādhibhirmucyate dhruvam \|*  
*āturaḥ puṣṭimāpnoti svāsthyamaiśvaryameva ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. In the Shatabhisha constellation when Indra is worshipped by a person, he is relieved of all the ailments. Thereafter, he achieves progress, improvement in health and enormous riches.

## \|\| 1.102.69 \|\|

*ajaṃ bhādrapadāyāṃ tu śuddhasphaṭikasannibham \|*  
*sampūjya bhaktimāpnoti paraṃ vijayameva ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. In the Purva Bhadrapada constellation, by worshipping Aja having the colour of crystal, one achieves devotion as well as victory.

## \|\| 1.102.70 \|\|

*sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sthitiṃ caiva dhṛtiṃ vijayameva ca \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. During the Uttara Bhadrapada constellation, by worshipping Ahirbudhnya, one achieves excellent peace. By worshipping Pusha in Revati constellation with white flowers, one achieves welfare, stability, patience and victory.

## \|\| 1.102.71 \|\|

*tavaivaite samākhyātā yajñāḥ saṃkṣepato mayā \|*  
*nakṣatradevatānāṃ ca sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai \|*  
*bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa bhavanti phaladāḥ sadā \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. For your sake as well as for the sake of the gods of different constellations, I have recited these yajnas in brief. When the gods are adored by the people according to their means, the gods always shower their rewards.

## \|\| 1.102.72 \|\|

*gantumicchedanantyaṃ vā kriyāṃ prārabdhameva ca \|*  
*nakṣatradevatāyajñaṃ kṛtvā tatsarvamācaret \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Therefore, at the start of a long journey or at the start of some new work, the Devayajna of the respective leader of the constellation should always be performed.

## \|\| 1.102.73 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛte hi tatsarvaṃ yātrāphalamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*kriyāphalaṃ ca sampūrṇamityuktaṃ bhānunā svayam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. Because by adoring them, according to the words of the Sungod, one gets reward for all the works so done.

## \|\| 1.102.74-75 \|\|

*yajñātsa vijayaṃ kuryātkriyāṃ kuryādyathepsitām \|*  
*kālacakre'tha vā sūryaṃ rāśicakre kalātmanā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*viśvatejonidhiṃ dhyātvā sarvaṃ kuryādyathepsitam \|*  
*vibhūtireṣā coddiṣṭā kriyābhiḥ sādhyate dhruvam \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. With the performing of the yajna, one achieves victory besides the success in the desired work. In this way, in the present Kalachakra and Rashichakra, the Sungod always remains permanent, who happens to be the treasure of the lustre of the world. By adoring him, one should have his desires fulfilled. The purpose for which the vrata or other holy rite was started, it is surely achieved. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.102.76 \|\|

*uddiṣṭābhiḥ prayatnena muktiyogena sādhyate \|*  
*bhānorārādhanādvāpi prāpyate muktireva hi \|*  
*tasmādārādhaya raviṃ bhaktyā tvaṃ madhusūdana \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. By performing the aforesaid activities and with the worship of the Sungod, one is relieved of the cycle of birth and death. Therefore, O Madhusudana, you worship the Sungod with devotion.

## \|\| 1.102.77-78 \|\|

*ijyāpūjānamaskāraśuśrūṣābhiraharniśam \|*  
*vratopavāsairvividhairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*yaḥ kārayati devārcāṃ hadayālambanaṃ raveḥ \|*  
*sa naro bhānusālokyamupaiti gatakalmaṣaḥ1 \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. In this way, by performing yajnas, puja, salutations, serving others or the lord, fasting for the day or the night, besides serving several eatables to the Brahmanas or the one who worships the Sungod, he, becoming sinless, achieves the Salokya moksha of the Sungod.

## Chapter 103. Glory of the Sun worship

## \|\| 1.103.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yaśca devālayaṃ bhaktyā bhānoḥ kārayate sthiram \|*  
*sa sapta puruṣāṃllokānbhānornayati mānavaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — A person, who builds a strong and solid temple for the Sungod, the people of seven generation of that person attain the place of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.2 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa uvāca \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Those who worship the Sungod in that temple for a number of years, the builder of the temple (with those who worship therein) live in the abode of the Sungod equivalent to the period, multiplied by a thousand years for which he had carried out adoration there.

## \|\| 1.103.3 \|\|

*devārcā lakṣaṇopetā yadgṛhe santato vidhiḥ \|*  
*niṣkāmaṃ vā mano yasya sa yāti ravisāmyatām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Therefore, the house in which the worship of the Sungod is performed continuously with devotion, the person gains equality with the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.4-6 \|\|

*puṣpāṇyatisugandhīni manojñāni ca yaḥ pumān \|*  
*prayacchati hi deveśaṃ tadbhāvagatamānasaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dhūpāṃśca vividhāṃstāṃstāngandhāḍhyaṃ cānulepanam \|*  
*dīpabalyupahārāśca yaccābhīṣṭamathātmanaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*naraḥ so'nudinaṃ yajñātprāpnotyārādhanādrave \|*  
*yajñeśo bhagavānbhānurmakhairapi ca toṣyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. A person, who overwhelmed with the love of the Sungod, offers fragrant flowers, besides various types of incenses, the fragrant pastes, gifts for sacrifice and other favourite things to the Sungod, he meets with success always. Everyone tries to please lord Bhaskara, as the leader of the yajnas.

## \|\| 1.103.7-8 \|\|

*bahūpakaraṇā yajñā nānāsambhāravistarāḥ \|*  
*prāpyante3 tairdhanayutairmanuṣyairlokasañcayaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*bhaktyā tu puruṣaiḥ pūjā kṛtā dūrvāṃkurairapi \|*  
*raverdadāti hi phalaṃ sarvayajñaiḥ sudurlabham \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Though there are many means of performing the yajnas, but their performance is quite expensive. Such yajnas can be performed by the wealthy people alone. Because of this, they achieve enormous reward. But in case, a poor person adores the Sungod by offering the durva grass, he achieves the merits comparable with great yajnas besides several other inaccessible merits.

## \|\| 1.103.9-10 \|\|

*yāni puṣpāṇi bhakṣyāṇi dhūpagandhānulepanam \|*  
*dayitaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ yacca raktake caiva vāsasī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yāni cābhyupahārāṇi bhakṣyāṇi ca phalāni ca \|*  
*prayaccha tāni deveśa bhavethāścaiva tanmanāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Therefore, O lord of the Devas! Offering all the flowers, eatables, incense, fragrant pastes, beautiful ornaments, two costumes of red colour, all the gifts and fruits should be offered to the Sungod and the performer should always concentrate his mind in meditating Surya, making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.103.11-12 \|\|

*ādyaṃ taṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ yathāśaktyā prasādaya \|*  
*ārādhya sthāpitaṃ devaṃ tasminneva narālaye \|\| 11 \|\|*

*puṣpaistīrthodakairgandhairmadhunā sarpiṣā tathā \|*  
*kṣīreṇa snāpayeddevaṃ citrabhānuṃ divākaram1 \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Initially, the yajna Purushas should be worshipped by the performer as per his own means. It is further stated that the same Brahmana should be established in the same house and should be bathed like the Sungod, offering him auspicious water of the sacred places, offering fragrance, honey, ghi and milk as the form Chitrabhanu Surya. He should be bathed as such.

## \|\| 1.103.13 \|\|

*dadhikṣīrahradānyāti syargalokānmadhucyutān \|*  
*prayāsyati yaduśreṣṭha nirvṛtiṃ vāpi śāśvatīm \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. After completing this holy rite, the devotee attains the heaven comparable to the person who has the tanks filled with curd, milk and honey. O best of the race of Yadus, in this way, he is redeemed for all times to come.

## \|\| 1.103.14 \|\|

*stotrairgītaistathā vādyairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*manasaścaikatāyogādārādhaya vibhāvasum \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Therefore, the Brahmanas should be pleased with the reciting of the stotras, playing on musical instrument besides singing and offering prayers.

## \|\| 1.103.15 \|\|

*ārādhya taṃ videhānāṃ puruṣāḥ saptasaptatiḥ \|*  
*haihayānāṃ ca pañcāśadamṛtatvaṃ samāgatāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Because with the worship of the Sungod, the seventy seven generations of Janaka and fifty generations of the Haihaya rulers were redeemed.

## \|\| 1.103.16 \|\|

*sa tvamebhiḥ prakāraistamupavāsaistu bhāskaram \|*  
*santoṣaya hi tuṣṭo'sau bhānurbhavati śāntidaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. You should also please the Sungod by fasting etc. The Sungod, when pleased, bestows tranquility and moksha.

## \|\| 1.103.17-18 \|\|

*upavāsaiścitrabhānuḥ kathaṃ tuṣṭaḥ prajāyate \|*  
*paricaryā kathaṃ kāryā yā kāryā copavāsinā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yadyatkāryaṃ yadā caiva bhānorārādhanaṃ naraiḥ \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ vistarādbrahmanyathāvadvaktumarhasi \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Shri Krishna said — How is the Sungod pleased by fasting? How should the Sungod be served by fasting? O Brahmana, the particular form of Surya who is required to be worshipped at a particular time, you kindly speak out the same exhaustively.

## \|\| 1.103.19 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*smṛtaḥ sampūjito dhūpapuṣpādyaiḥ sa sadā raviḥ \|*  
*bhogināmupakārāya kiṃ punaścopavāsinām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Brahma said — The Sungod grants the desires of even the worldly people, when they worship him offering only incense, flowers etc., but a person who worships the Sungod observing the fast, then what to speak of him.

## \|\| 1.103.20 \|\|

*upāvṛttastu pāpebhyo yastu vāsoguṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Discarding all the sinful acts, one who is freed from attraction and envy, and leads the virtuous life, it amounts to fasting.

## \|\| 1.103.21-22 \|\|

*ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ vā trirātramatha vā hare \|*  
*upavāsī raviṃ yastu bhaktyā dhyāyati mānavaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tannāmayājī tatkarmaratastadgatamānasaḥ \|*  
*niṣkāmaḥ pūjayitvā taṃ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O Hara! In this way, by observing fast on one, two or three nights, a person when recites his name with devotion, without expecting any reward, he surely achieve Brahman.

## \|\| 1.103.23 \|\|

*yaśca kāmamabhidhyāya bhāskarārpitamānasaḥ \|*  
*upoṣati tamāpnoti prasanne tu vṛṣadhvaje \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. By totally concentrating one’s mind on the Sungod, a person who meditates upon him with devotion, all his desires are granted by the bull-bannered Surya.

## \|\| 1.103.24 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhistathā vibho \|*  
*saṃsāragartapaṅkasthaiḥ sugatiḥ prāpyate katham \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Shri Krishna said — O excellent, how do the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, Shudras and women, who are caught in worldly pit with mud, achieve the excellent positions?

## \|\| 1.103.25-26 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*athārādhya jagannāthaṃ bhāskaraṃ timirāpaham \|*  
*nirvyalīkena cittena prayāsyati ca sadgatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

*viṣayāgrāhavaiṣamyaṃ na cittaṃ bhāskarārpaṇam \|*  
*sa kathaṃ pāpa kartā vai naro yāsyati sadgatim \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Sumantu said — By worshipping lord Bhaskara — the remover of darkness, with a peaceful mind, he bestows then the excellent positions, but the sinful people who are unable to detract their minds from the worldly pleasures and turn themselves away from the worship of Surya, then how could they be able to achieve the highest position?

## \|\| 1.103.27-30 \|\|

*yadi saṃsāraduḥkhārtaḥ sugatiṃ gantumicchasi \|*  
*tadārādhaya sarveśaṃ1 graheśaṃ lokapūjitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ sugandhairhadyaiśca dhūpaiḥ sāgurucandanaiḥ \|*  
*vāsovibhūṣaṇairbhakṣyairupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*yadi saṃsāranirvedādabhivācchasi sadgatim \|*  
*tadārādhaya kāleśaṃ yacceṣṭaṃ tava cetasā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*puṣpāṇi yadi tena syuḥ śastaṃ pādapapallavaiḥ \|*  
*dūrvāṃkurairapi kṛṣṇa tadabhāve'rcayedravim \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. Therefore, if you, getting fed up with the misery of the world, in case be desirous of the excellent stage, then you should worship the Sungod, who is the lord of the planets besides being his own lord, offering flowers, fragrant excellent incense, agaru, sandal paste, costumes and ornaments, besides the eatables, and observing the fast. In case you are desirous of achieving an excellent position, you should worship the Sungod offering the things which are his favorites. O Krishna, in case the flowers could not be procured at the time of the performing of the puja, then the tender shoots of the trees or alternately the tender durva grass can be offered.

## \|\| 1.103.31 \|\|

*puṣpapatrāmbubhirdhūpairyathāvibhavamātsanaḥ \|*  
*pūjitastuṣṭimatulāṃ bhaktyā yātyekacetasām \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Because by offering the flowers, leaves and water with consecrated and devoted mind while worshipping the Sungod, he bestows unparallel satisfaction.

## \|\| 1.103.32 \|\|

*yaḥ sadāyatane bhānoḥ kuryātsammārjanaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sa pāṃsudehasaṃyogātsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A person who brooms the temple of the Sungod, he is relieved of all the sins with the mere touch of the particles of the dust with his body.

## \|\| 1.103.33 \|\|

*yāvatyaḥ pāṃsukaṇikā mārjyante bhāskarālaye \|*  
*dināni divi divyāni tāvanti modate naraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The particles of dust which are cleaned by a devotee in a temple, he enjoys blissful life in the heaven for an equivalent number of divine days, enjoying a blissful life.

## \|\| 1.103.34 \|\|

*sabāhyābhyantaraṃ veśma mārjate bhāskarasya yaḥ \|*  
*sa bāhyābhyantarastasya kāyo niṣkalmaṣo bhavet \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. A person, who cleans the inner as well as the outer part of the Sun temple, the inner and outer parts of the said person get purified.

## \|\| 1.103.35 \|\|

*yaścānulepanaṃ kuryādbhānorāyatane naraḥ \|*  
*sa helilokamāsādya modate gogate harau \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A person who attends to the work of colour washing of the Sun temple, he finally achieves the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.36 \|\|

*mṛdā vā mṛdvikārairvā varṇakairgomayena vā \|*  
*anulepanakṛdbhaktyā naro gopatimāpnuyāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. One who plasters the temple with mud or with ochre colour or the cowdung, he surely achieves the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.37 \|\|

*udakābhyukṣaṇaṃ bhānoryaḥ karoti tathākṣaye \|*  
*sa gacchati naraḥ kṛṣṇa yatrāste gopatiḥ sadā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O Krishna, similarly a person, who washes the idol of Sungod at the time of water scarcity, he achieves the auspicious place of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.38 \|\|

*puṣpaprakaramatyarthaṃ sugandhaṃ bhāskarālaye \|*  
*anulipte naro dadyātpūṣottaragṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. A person, who after plastering the temple of the Sungod, offers beautiful flowers to the Sungod, he achieves the Pusha or the northern abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.39 \|\|

*vimānavaramabhyeti sarvaratnamayaṃ divi \|*  
*samprāpnoti naro dattvā dīpakaṃ bhāskarālaye \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. A person, who bums a lamp in the Sun temple, he achieves the heaven, reaching their in a gem studded beautiful plane.

## \|\| 1.103.40 \|\|

*yastu samvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ tilapātraprado naraḥ \|*  
*dhvajaṃ ca bhāskare dadyātsamamatra phalaṃ labhet1 \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. A person who offers sesamum vase and a flag for the Sungod for the whole year, he achieves the equivalent merit.

## \|\| 1.103.41 \|\|

*vidhunotyativātena dāturajñānataḥ kṛtam \|*  
*pāpaṃ dāturgṛhe bhānurdivārātrau na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. When the flag flutters with the flowing of the wind, the person who had presented the flag, all his daily sins committed by him in ignorance, are washed out. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.103.42 \|\|

*gītavādyādirbhirdevaṃ ya upāste vibhāvasum \|*  
*gandharvanṛtyairvādyaiśca vimānastho niṣevyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. A person who worships the Sungod with songs and music, he is made to sit on a decorated plane, while Gandharvas and Apsaras dance before him, serving him at the same time.

## \|\| 1.103.43 \|\|

*jātismaratvaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca tatastu paramāṃ gatim \|*  
*prāpnoti helerāyatane puṇyākhyānakathākaraḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. A person who recites the stories from scriptures in a Sun temple, he, getting reborn in a high caste, preserve the past memory with considerable progress and finally achieves the best position.

## \|\| 1.103.44 \|\|

*tasmātkuryātprayatnena pūjayedvāpi vācakam \|*  
*nānyatprītikaraṃ bhānoḥ puṇyākhyānādṛte kvacit \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Therefore, the reciter of the stories should be worshipped making all the efforts, because no other alternative has been suggested besides the reciting or listening to the religious stories in the temple.

## \|\| 1.103.45 \|\|

*eko'pi heleḥ sukṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ \|*  
*daśāśvamedhī punareti janma helipraṇāmī na punarbhavāya \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. A person who offers his salutation to the Sungod properly, he earns the merit equivalent to the performing of ten Ashvamedha sacrifices. Besides the performance of the ten Ashvamedha sacrifices, he has to be reborn on earth, but a person who offers salutation to the Sungod once with devotion, he is never reborn on earth.

## \|\| 1.103.46 \|\|

*evaṃ1 deveśvaro bhaktyā yena bhānurupāsitaḥ \|*  
*sa prāpnoti gatiṃ ślāghyāṃ yāmicchati ca cetasā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Therefore, a person, who adores the Sungod with devotion, he attains the position mentally desired by him.

## \|\| 1.103.47 \|\|

*tamārādhya mayā prāptaṃ brahmatvaṃ lokapūjitam \|*  
*saureryathepsitaṃ prāptaṃ tvayā tasmātpurānagha \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O sinless one, as you had achieved success by adoring the Sungod, similarly, by so doing, I had attained the position of Brahma.

## \|\| 1.103.48 \|\|

*brahmahatyābhibhūtastu gośrutābharaṇo haraḥ \|*  
*tamārādhya raviṃ bhaktyā mukto'sau brahmahatyayā \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Even lord Shiva, having attracted Brahmahatya, worshipped the Sungod and was relieved of his sin.

## \|\| 1.103.49 \|\|

*devatvaṃ manujaiḥ kaiścidgandharvatvaṃ tathā paraiḥ \|*  
*vidyādharatvamaparairevāptaṃ hi divākarāt \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In this way, by adoring the Sungod, people have achieved godhood, the position of a Gandharva or Vidyadharas.

## \|\| 1.103.50 \|\|

*lekhaḥ kratuśateneśamārādhyainaṃ divākaram \|*  
*indratvamagamattasmānnānyaḥ pūjyo divākarāt \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Even Indra had attained the position of the lord of gods with the adoring of the Sungod. Therefore, there is no more adorable than the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.51 \|\|

*devebhyo'pyatipūjyastu svagururbrahmacāriṇā \|*  
*tasmātsa yajñapuruṣo vivasvānpūjya eva hi \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. As a Brahmachari adores his preceptor, similarly, the Sungod too is adorable by the gods. Therefore, Surya is the yajna Purusha who is always adorable. It should be clearly understood.

## \|\| 1.103.52 \|\|

*striyāśca bhartāramṛte pūjyo'tyantaṃ vibhāvasuḥ \|*  
*bharturgṛhasthasya sataḥ pūjyo gopatiraṃśumān \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. For the widows after the death of their husbands, the Sungod is most adorable. Even when the husband is alive, a woman must worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.103.53 \|\|

*vaiśyānāmapi cārādhyastapobhistamanāśanaḥ \|*  
*dhyeyaḥ parivrājakānāṃ sadā devo vibhāvasuḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The Sungod, being the destroyer of the darkness, is also adorable by the Vaishyas. He is also adorable by the Sanyasis (recluse).

## \|\| 1.103.54 \|\|

*evaṃ sarvāśramāṇāṃ hi citrabhānuḥ parāyaṇam \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ caiva varṇānāṃ tamārādhyāpnuyādgatim \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thus the Sungod is the abode of all and is adorable for all the classes of the human beings. Therefore, by worshipping the adorable god, one should achieve the best position.

## Chapter 104. Description of Trivarga Saptami

## \|\| 1.104.1 \|\|

*śṛṇuṣva saṃyataḥ kāmyānupavāsāṃstathāparān \|*  
*tāṃstānāśritya yānkāmānkurutepsitamānasaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Exercising all the restrain during the fasting, by which a person gets the desired reward, I am going to speak about the same.

## \|\| 1.104.2-5 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu phālgunasyeha mānavaḥ \|*  
*japanhelīti devasya nāma bhaktyā punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*devārcane cāṣṭaśataṃ kṛtvaitacca japecchuciḥ \|*  
*snātaḥ prasthānakāle tu utthāne skhalite kṣute \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pākhaṇḍānpatitāṃścaiva tathaivānyāyaśālinaḥ \|*  
*nālapeta tathā bhānumarcayecchraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*idaṃ codāharedbhānau manaḥ saṃdhāya tatparaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*haṃsahaṃsa kṛpālustvamagatīnāṃ gatirbhava \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ trātā bhava divākara \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. On the bright seventh moon day of the month of Phalguna, a person should purify himself by taking a bath and then recite the holy japam of the Sungod, repeatedly. During the adoration of the deity, the japam has to be performed eight hundred times. At the time of journey, after taking the bath or at the time of waking up from sleep, at the time of sneezing, the aforesaid name of the Sungod should be uttered which is essential. At the time of the worship of the Sungod, a devotee should not talk to a wicked person and those who indulge in injustice. On the other hand, one should remain devoted to the Sungod, saying — “O Sun, you are merciful and the move of immovable. Therefore, O Divakara! You protect the people, who are drowning in the ocean of the world.”

## \|\| 1.104.6-7 \|\|

*evaṃ prasādyopavāsaṃ kṛtvā niyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*pūrvāhṇa eva ca sakṛtprāśyāccācamanīyakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*snātvārcayitvā haṃseti punarnāma prakīrtayet \|*  
*vajradhārātrayaṃ caiva kṣipettrirdevapādayoḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. By pleasing the Sungod in this way and observing the fast carefully, a person should sip the water once in the noon. After taking the bath, Hamsa — the name of the Sungod should be repeated again and again. Thereafter, the vajra flowers should be offered at the feet of the Surya image.

## \|\| 1.104.8 \|\|

*caitravaiśākhayoścaiva tadvajjyeṣṭhe tu pūjayan \|*  
*martyaloke gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kṛṣṇa prāpnoti vai naraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Like this method of worship in the months of Chaitra and Vaishakha, the same process should be repeated in the month of Jyeshtha, as has been prescribed in the scriptures. O Krishna! By so doing, a person achieves the best position in this world and not otherwise. It has been ordained.

## \|\| 1.104.9 \|\|

*utkrāṃtastu vrajetkṛṣṇa divyaṃ haṃsālayaṃ śubham \|*  
*vṛṣadhvajaprasādādvai saṃkrandanaśriyā vṛtaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O Krishna! The same person, after his death, by the grace of the bull-bannered lord, achieves the divine Hamsa of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.104.10-11 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe caiva māsi bhādrapade tathā \|*  
*tathaivāśvayuje caiva anena vidhinā naraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*upoṣya sampūjya tathā mārtaṇḍeti ca kīrtayet \|*  
*gomūtraprāśanotpūto dhanī dhanapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Similarly, a person, during the months of Ashadha, Shravana, Bhadrapada and Ashvina, should worship the lord Martanda, sipping the cow’s urine. Because of the worship of the eternal Martanda and observing the fast, and getting purified, a person achieves the place of Kubera.

## \|\| 1.104.12 \|\|

*ārādhitasya jagatāmīśvarasyāvyayātmanaḥ \|*  
*utkrāṃtikāle smaraṇaṃ bhāskarasya tathāpnuyāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thereafter, the Sungod, who is the lord of the universe, having been worshipped by a person, he recalls Bhaskara at the time of his death as well.

## \|\| 1.104.13-14 \|\|

*kṣīrasya prāśanaṃ kṛṣṇa vidhiṃ caiva yathoditam \|*  
*kārttikādi yathānyāyaṃ kuryānmāsacatuṣṭayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tenaiva vidhinā kṛṣṇa bhāskareti ca kīrtayet \|*  
*sa yāti bhānusālokyaṃ bhāskaraṃ smarati kṣaye \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. O Krishna! During the four months including the month of Karttika, by observing the same process, the puja has to be performed appropriately and the fast has to be broken with the tasting of the milk. Thereafter, the Sankirtana should be performed. The Sungod should then be remembered. When it is so done, the devotee after his death, achieves the Salokya redemption of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.104.15 \|\|

*pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo dadyāddānaṃ yathepsitam \|*  
*cāturmāsye tu sampūrṇe kṛtvā pustakavācanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Similarly, on the seventh moon day of each of the four months, giving the appropriate charities to the Brahmanas one should listen to the reciting of the holy books.

## \|\| 1.104.16 \|\|

*kathāṃ tu bhāskarasyeha saṅgītakamathāpi vā \|*  
*dharmaśravaṇamabhīṣṭaṃ sadā dharmadhvajasya tu \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The concluding ceremony should be performed with or without music, because the Sungod is fond of listening to dharma.

## \|\| 1.104.17 \|\|

*vācakaṃ pūjayitvā tu tasmātkāryaṃ vipaścitā \|*  
*śrāddhamanyena pakvena vācakena dvijena tu \|*  
*divyena ca yathāyuktamabhīṣṭaṃ bhāskarasya hi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. After worshiping the Brahmanas and reciter, and at the conclusion of the puja, the payasam and other eatables should also be served to the Brahmanas and reciter. Besides the Shraddha should also be performed. This is because the Surya Shraddha performed by divine Brahmanas, is considered to be most desirable.

## \|\| 1.104.18 \|\|

*evameva gatiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ devānāmanukīrtanāt \|*  
*prāpnuyāttrividhāṃ kṛṣṇa trilokākhyāṃ naraḥ sadā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O Krishna! By performing kirtana of the gods, one achieves three types of the excellent position.

## \|\| 1.104.19 \|\|

*kathitaṃ pāraṇaṃ yatte prathamaṃ godharādhanam \|*  
*ādhipatyaṃ tathā bhogāṃstataḥ prāpnoti mānuṣaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Accordingly, the way in which a person achieves the pleasures and the superiority among the people in the first parana has been revealed by me.

## \|\| 1.104.20 \|\|

*dvitīyena tathā bhogāngopateḥ prāpnuyānnaraḥ \|*  
*sūryalokaṃ tṛtīyena pāraṇena tathāpnuyāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Similarly, with the second parana, a person enjoys pleasures with Sungod and after the third parana, one achieves the abode of Surya.

## \|\| 1.104.21 \|\|

*evametatsamākhyātaṃ gatiprāpakamuttamam \|*  
*vidhānaṃ devāśārdūla yaduktaṃ saptamīvrate \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O lion among the Devas! Thus, I have spoken to you about the excellent method for the performing of vrata during Saptami, by which one achieves the highest position.

## \|\| 1.104.22 \|\|

*yaḥ śvetāṃ saptamīṃ kuryātsugatiṃ śraddhayā naraḥ \|*  
*tathā bhaktyā ca vai nārī prāpnoti trividhāṃ gatim \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A man or a woman, who with devotion, concludes the Shveta Saptami vrata appropriately, he or she achieves the highest position, as well as wife achieves the three fold position.

## \|\| 1.104.23-24 \|\|

*eṣā dhanyā pāpaharā tithirnityamupāsitā \|*  
*ārādhanāya yasteṣāṃ yadā bhānordharādhara \|\| 23 \|\|*

*paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi sarvapāpabhayāpahā \|*  
*tathā dhanyā ca puṇyā ca trivargādīṣṭadā sadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Therefore, this particular moon day is quite praiseworthy, remover of sins and is fit to be adored forever. O lord of the earth, a person, who in these moon days of the Sungod, adores the Sungod or performs adoration or performs vratas or listens to the recitations, all his sins are destroyed. Because of its being quite auspicious, one also achieves success in dharma, artha and kama as well.

## Chapter 105. Highlighting of Kamada Saptami

## \|\| 1.105.1-4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*phālgunāmalapakṣasya saptamyāṃ kṣmādharāvyaya \|*  
*upoṣito naro nārī samabhyarcya tamo'paham \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sūryanāma japanbhaktyā mitabhoktā jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*uttiṣṭhanprasvapaṃścaiva sūryamevābhikīrtayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tato'nyadivase prāpte tvaṣṭamyāṃ prayato ravim \|*  
*snātvā devaṃ samabhyarcya dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ravimuddiśya vai cāgnau ghṛtahomakṛtakriyaḥ \|*  
*praṇipatya jagannāthamiti vāṇīmudīrayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Brahma said — O compassionate and eternal lord, on the bright seventh moon day of the month of Phalguna, a man or a woman, observing fast, should worship the Sungod with devotion, besides uttering his name. He should take light food. Thereafter, at the time when he is awake or is going to sleep, he should keep on uttering the name of the Sungod. Thus, taking bath on the eighth moon day, he should adore the Sungod attentively. The Brahmanas should be given the dakshina. Thereafter, ghi should be poured into the fire. Then offering salutation to the lord of the universe, recite the name of Jagannatha.

## \|\| 1.105.5 \|\|

*yamārādhya purā devī sāvitrī kāmanāya vai \|*  
*sa me dadātu deveśaḥ sarvānkāmānvibhāvasuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thereafter, he should utter that by adoring whom the goddess Savitri had all her desires fulfilled, let the same leader of the world also grant all my desires, being compassionate on me.

## \|\| 1.105.6 \|\|

*samabhyarcya iti prāptānkṛtsnānkāmānyathepsitān \|*  
*sa dadātyakhilānkāmānprasanno me divaspatiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Let the Sungod getting well pleased with my adoration, bestow success in all my desires.

## \|\| 1.105.7 \|\|

*bhraṣṭarājyaśca devendro yamabhyarcya divaspatiḥ \|*  
*kāmānsamprāptavānrājyaṃ sa me kāmaṃ prayacchatu \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. As Indra, having fallen from the heaven, regained all his fortunes and desires besides the kingdom of the heaven, similarly, let me get all my desires fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.105.8 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya pūjāṃ ca niṣpādyeha vivasvataḥ \|*  
*bhuñjīta prayataḥ samyagghaviṣyaṃ patagadhvaja \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O lord with the bird banner, by adoring Vivasvan, the devotee should consume the food of the sacrifice, controlling all his senses.

## \|\| 1.105.9 \|\|

*phālgune caitravaiśākhajyeṣṭhe yasya samāpanam \|*  
*caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsairebhirniṣpāditaṃ bhavet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Similarly, in the months of Phalguna, Chaitra, Vaishakha and Jyestha, on the conclusion of the vratas, the four paranas have been described.

## \|\| 1.105.10-11 \|\|

*karavīraiścaturo māsānbhaktyā sampūjayedravim \|*  
*kṛṣṇāguruṃ daheddhūpaṃ prāśyaṃ gośṛṅgajaṃ jalam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ khaṇḍaveṣṭāṃstu dadyādviprebhya eva ca \|*  
*tataśca śrūyatāmanyā hyāṣāḍhādiṣu yā kriyā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. In all the four months, the Sungod should be worshipped offering the oleander flowers and incense of agaru. Then, the water purified with the horns of the cows should be sipped. Thereafter, the fried sweets mixed with sugar, should be offered to Brahmanas. Now I am speaking about the process to be followed in the months of Asadha and others which you please listen.

## \|\| 1.105.12-14 \|\|

*jātīpuṣpāṇi śastāni dhūpo gauggula ucyate \|*  
*kūpodakaṃ samaśnīyānnaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ matam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*svayaṃ tadeva cāśnīyāccheṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret \|*  
*kārttikādiṣu māseṣu gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mahāṅgo dhūpa uddiṣṭaḥ pūjā raktotpalaistathā \|*  
*kāsāraṃ cātra naivedyaṃ nivedyaṃ bhāskarāya vai \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. The use of the jasmine flowers, incense of guggulu and the well water should be consumed. During the vrata, the payasam should be offered to others and the devotee should also consume the same. Similarly, in the Karttika and other months, the cow’s urine should be used for sipping in the breaking of the fast. The Mahanga incense and red lotus flowers should be used while worshipping Bhaskara. Thereafter, kamsara as Naivedya should be offered as eatables.

## \|\| 1.105.15-16 \|\|

*pratimāsaṃ ca viprāya dātavyā dakṣiṇā tathā \|*  
*karpūraṃ candanaṃ mustāmagaruṃ tagaraṃ tathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*ūṣaṇaṃ śarkarā kṛṣṇa sugandhaṃ sihlakaṃ tathā \|*  
*mahāṅgo'yaṃ smṛto dhūpaḥ priyo devasya sarvadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. During the monthly worship, dakshina to a Brahmana must be given. O Krishna! The incense made of the mixture of agaru, dried ginger, black pepper, long pepper, other fragrant material is known as Mahanga incense and is the favourite of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.105.17 \|\|

*prīṇanaṃ ceṣṭayā bhānoḥ pāraṇepāraṇe gate \|*  
*yathāśakti yathāyogaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thus is each and every parana, it is desirable that the Sungod should be pleased making all the efforts. Appropriate amount of wealth should be spent in this process. The miserliness in the process should not be displayed, because for such an auspicious purpose, miserliness is totally unwanted.

## \|\| 1.105.18-19 \|\|

*sadbhāvenaiva saptāśvaḥ pūjitaḥ prīyate yataḥ \|*  
*pāraṇānte yathāśaktyā pūjitaḥ snāpito raviḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*prīṇitaścepsitānkāmāndadyādavyāhataṃ hare \|*  
*eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā saptamī sarvakāmadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. But with the enormous goodwill in the heart, the Sungod, with the chariot of seven horses, gets pleased. Therefore, at the end of each one of the parana, one should take bath with stuffs, as per one’s means, and with the performing of the puja, the Sungod, getting pleased, bestows the reward of all the desires. Therefore, O Hara! This particular Saptami is quite auspicious and removes the sins, besides it is instrumental in the fulfilling of all the desires.

## \|\| 1.105.20 \|\|

*yathābhilaṣitānkāmāṃllabhate garuḍadhvaja \|*  
*upoṣyaitāṃ tribhuvanaṃ prāptamindreṇa vai purā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Garuda-bannered lord, in earlier times, performing this vrata, Indra had achieved the kingdom of all the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.105.21-22 \|\|

*putraṃ prāpacca sāvitrī putrāṃstu aditistathā \|*  
*yadavaḥ kāmanāṃ prāptā dhaumyo vedamavāptavān \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tvayāptā bhārgavī kṛṣṇa śaṅkaraḥ śuddhimāptavān \|*  
*pitāmahatvaṃ prāpto'haṃ tatprasādājjanārdana \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Similarly, with the use of the same process, Savitri got a son, Aditi got many sons, the people of Yadu race had all their desires fulfilled. The sage Dhaumya got the Vedas, you became the lord of the earth, lord Shiva got self purification. With the grace of the same, I too, achieved the position of the Grandsire or Brahma.

## \|\| 1.105.23 \|\|

*anyaiścādhigatāḥ kāmāstamārādhya na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdrairyoṣidbhireva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Similarly, many of the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, Shudras as well as their women, achieved the desired things by the grace of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.105.24-26 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyettaṃtaṃ prāpnotyupoṣaṇāt \|*  
*janaḥ prāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ bhānorārādhanādyataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*aputraḥ putramāpnoti rogataścāpi modate \|*  
*rogābhibhūta ārogyaṃ kanyā vindati satpatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

*samāgatya pravasita upoṣyaitadavāpnuyāt \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti gogataścāpi modate \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. When a person performs vrata on the day of Saptami with any particular desire in his mind, his wish is surely fulfilled. Thus, with the worship of the Sungod, a sonless or barren woman achieves a son, besides achieving the Sungod himself, feeling blissful. The ailing person is relieved of all his ailments, a girl gets an excellent husband, a person having gone abroad, reaches his home and all his desires are fulfilled. Ultimately, enjoying all the pleasures, he stays in the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.105.27-28 \|\|

*nāputro nādhano vāpi na vāniṣṭo na nirghṛṇaḥ \|*  
*upoṣyaitadvrataṃ martyaḥ strījano vāpi jāyate \|\| 27 \|\|*

*gohelilokamāsādya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|*  
*gaurikaṃ yānamārūḍhastejasā ravisannibhaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Therefore, with the performing of this vrata, no person remains without a son or poor, suffering or hatred. On the other hand, seated over the plane made of silver and glittering like the Sungod, he reaches the abode of the Sungod and enjoys all types of comforts there.

## \|\| 1.105.29 \|\|

*punaretya mahīṃ kṛṣṇa ghanāghanasamo nṛpaḥ \|*  
*kṣmātale syānna saṃdehaḥ prasādādgopaternaraḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O Krishna! The same person, after his rebirth on earth, with the grace of the Sungod, becomes a popular monarch.

## Chapter 106. Method of the vrata, remover of the sins

## \|\| 1.106.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*punaścaitanmahābhāga śrūyatāṃ gadato mama \|*  
*proktaṃ khagena devānāṃ tithimāhātmyamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O excellent one, I am going to repeat the glory of the excellent moon day, which is the favourite of the gods. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.106.2-3 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*vijayātijayā caiva jayantī ca mahātithiḥ \|*  
*tvattaḥ śrutā suratheṣṭha brūhi me pāpanāśinīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tathottarāyaṇaṃ brūhi śastaṃ yadbhāskarārcane \|*  
*yatra sampūjito bhānurbhavetsarvāghanāśanaḥ \|*  
*tanme kathaya yatnena bhaktyā pṛṣṭo'kṣayaṃ phalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Vishnu said — O foremost of the Devas, the glory of the great moon days known as Vijaya, Atijaya and Jayanti has been heard by me from you. Now you describe me the importance of the seven moon days which remove the sins and the glory of Uttarayana which is considered to be quite important for the worship of the Sungod and getting pleased, the lord removes all the guilts and crimes. I am aware of the fact that when a question in this topic is raised with devotion, the person earns enormous merit.

## \|\| 1.106.4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadarkṣaṃ tu raverbhavet \|*  
*tadā syātsā mahāpuṇyā saptamī pāpanāśinī \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Brahma said — When the Hasta constellation falls on the bright seventh moon day of a fortnight, the said auspicious moon day is believed to be the remover of the grave sins.

## \|\| 1.106.5 \|\|

*tasyāṃ sampūjya deveśaṃ citrabhānuṃ jagadgurum \|*  
*saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. By adoring the world preceptor and leader of the Devas known as Surya, the sins committed in the last three births are removed. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.106.6 \|\|

*yaścopavāsaṃ kurute tasyāṃ niyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpavimuktātmā sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. One who restraining himself, resorts to fasting on that particular day, he getting relieved of all the sins, finally achieves the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.106.7-9 \|\|

*dānaṃ yaddīyate kiñcittamuddiśya divākaram \|*  
*homo vā kriyate tatra tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*eka ṛgvedaḥ purato japtaḥ śraddhāpareṇa tu \|*  
*ṛgvedasya samastasya yacchate satphalaṃ dhruvam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sāmavedaphalaṃ sāma yajurvedaphalaṃ yajuḥ \|*  
*atharvā atharvāṃgiraso nikhilaṃ yacchate raviḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The charities given on that particular day, besides the homas performed, yield the everlasting reward for the same. As by reciting even a single hymn from the Rigveda, one achieves the merit of reciting the entire Rigveda, similarly, with the reciting of a single hymn of the Yajurveda, Samaveda and Atharvaveda, the Sungod bestows the merit of reciting of all the related Vedas.

## \|\| 1.106.10 \|\|

*tārakā iva rājante dyotamānā divāniśam \|*  
*samabhyarcya ca saptamyāṃ devadevaṃ divākaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. By worshipping well the Sun, who is the god of gods, during the seventh moon night, the devotee, illumining like the stars, remains resplendent throughout the day and night.

## \|\| 1.106.11 \|\|

*yatra pāpamaśeṣaṃ vai nāśayatyatra bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*kartavyā saptamī kṛṣṇa tenoktā pāpanāśinī \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Bhaskara — the Sungod also removes all his sins. O Krishna! Because of this reason, this particular moon day has been termed as the remover of the sins. Therefore, the religious rites prescribed for the purpose, must be performed.

## \|\| 1.106.12-14 \|\|

*asyāṃ samabhyarcya raviṃ yāti saurapuraṃ naraḥ \|*  
*vimānavaramāruhya karpūrodbhavamuttamam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tejasā kavisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā sūryasannibhaḥ \|*  
*kāntyātreyasamaḥ kṛṣṇa śaurye harisamaḥ sadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*modate tatra suciraṃ vṛndārakagaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*punaretya bhuvaṃ kṛṣṇa bhavedvai kṣmādhipādhipaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. By adoring the Sungod during this particular moon day, a person has to board the plane made of camphor. O Krishna! He has the lustre of fulcra, shine of the Sun, the light of the moon and the strength of lord Hari. He then roams about like the gods for long and feeling blissful on his return on earth, he becomes the king of kings.

## Chapter 107. Bhanupadadvaya vrata described

## \|\| 1.107.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tathānyadapi dharmajña śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|*  
*padadvayaṃ jagaddhāturdevadevasya gopateḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O well-versed in Dharma, Surya is the lord of the universe, has two feet known as Uttarayana as well as Dakshinayana, which are being described by me.

## \|\| 1.107.2-3 \|\|

*yadekapādapīṭhaṃ hi tatra nyastaṃ padadvayam \|*  
*svayamaṃśumatā kṛṣṇa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vāmanasya padaṃ kṛṣṇa jñeyaṃ vai uttarāyaṇam \|*  
*devādyaiḥ sakalairvandyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. O Krishna! For the benefit of the universe, Sungod established both his feet at the Sumeru mountain. The left foot is known as Uttarayana, while the right foot is known as Dakshinayana.

## \|\| 1.107.4 \|\|

*ahaṃ tvaṃ ca sadā kṛṣṇa dakṣiṇaṃ pādamarcataḥ \|*  
*śraddhānvitau bhāskarasya harīśau vāmamarcataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O Krishna! Both myself and yourself adore the right foot of the Sungod. And India and other gods, adore the left foot of the Sungod with devotion.

## \|\| 1.107.5 \|\|

*tasminyaḥ pratyahaṃ samyagdevadevasya mānavaḥ \|*  
*karotyārādhanaṃ tasya tuṣṭaḥ syādbhānumāntsadā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Because of this, the Sungod who is the god of all gods, always remains cheerful.

## \|\| 1.107.6 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*kathamārādhanaṃ tasya devadevasya gopateḥ \|*  
*kriyate devaśārdūla tatsamākhyātumarhasi \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Vishnu said — How is the Sungod — the lord of gods, adored? You kindly speak out the procedure for the same.

## \|\| 1.107.7 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*uttare tvayane kṛṣṇa snāto niyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*ghṛtakṣīrādibhirdevaṃ snāpayettimirāpaham \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Brahma said — O Krishna! When the sun is in Uttarayana, one should remain disciplined, take his bath and then he should bath the image of the Sungod with milk and ghi, since he is the remover of darkness.

## \|\| 1.107.8 \|\|

*cāruvastropahāraiśca puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*samabhyarcya tataḥ samyagbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Thereafter, one should present beautiful presents of clothes, the flowers, incense and paste to the Sungod. Then he should make offerings to the Brahmanas, pleasing them.

## \|\| 1.107.9-11 \|\|

*padadvayaṃ vrataṃ yasya gṛhṇīyādbhānutatparaḥ \|*  
*vandetsnātaścitrabhānuṃ tataśca garuḍadhvaja \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhuktvānnaṃ citrabhānuṃ tu citrabhānuṃ vrajaṃstathā \|*  
*svapanvibudhyanpraṇamanhomaṃ kurvaṃstathārcayan \|\| 10 \|\|*

*citrabhānoranudinaṃ kariṣye nāmakīrtanam \|*  
*yāvadadya dinātprāptaṃ kramaśo dakṣiṇāyanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. O Garuda-bannered one, it has been prescribed to perform vrata for both the feet of the Sungod, in which it is resolved to worship the Sungod in Chitrabhanu form after taking a bath and applying sandal paste over the body. Then, kirtana of Chitrabhanu is resorted to after finishing the bath, after taking food, while sleeping or awaken or offering salutation for worship.

## \|\| 1.107.12-13 \|\|

*calite huṃkṛte caiva vedārambhe'pi vā sadā \|*  
*tāvadvakṣye citrabhānuṃ yāvadevottarāyaṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yāvajjīvaṃ ca yatkiñcijjānatojñānato'pi vā \|*  
*kariṣye'haṃ tathā caiva kīrtayiṣyāmi taṃ prabhum \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. At the time of his making a resolve, the following should be added to the same — while walking, roaring, at the start of the reciting of the Vedas, he shall recite the name of Chitrabhanu till the completion of the period of Uttarayana. Thereafter, he should repeat this resolve daily, that till he remains alive, whatever shall be performed by him knowingly or unknowingly, he shall be uttering the same name.

## \|\| 1.107.14 \|\|

*yadānṛtaṃ kiñcidvakṣye tadā vakṣyāmi tadvacaḥ \|*  
*ajñānādatha vā jñānātkīrtayiṣyāmi taṃ prabhum \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Even while indulging in falsehood, he shall be uttering the same name.

## \|\| 1.107.15-16 \|\|

*ṣaṇmāsamekamanasā citrabhānumayaṃ param \|*  
*taṃ smaranmaraṇe yāti yāṃ gatiṃ sāstu me gatiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*ṣaṇmāsābhyantare mṛtyuryadi tasminbhavenmama \|*  
*tanmayā bhāskarasyeha svayamātmā niveditaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. In this way, concentrating his mind for half an year on Chitrabhanu, one achieves the excellent position even after his death. He should desire for the same position. He should further desire, that in case, he meets with the end of his life within six months, even then there should be no harm, because he had dictated everything to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.107.17 \|\|

*paramātmamayaṃ brahma citrabhānumayaṃ param \|*  
*yamaṃ te saṃsmariṣyāmi sa me bhānuḥ parā gatiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. He should pray that — “Chitrabhanu is the form of the supreme Brahman, he shall continue to recite his name, because he happens to be his ultimate god.”

## \|\| 1.107.18 \|\|

*yadi prātastathā sāyaṃ madhyāhne vā japāmyaham \|*  
*ṣaṇmāsābhyantare nyāsaḥ kṛto vratamayo mayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. He should resolve that he should continue to utter his name during the morning, noon and the evening. In this way, I have arranged the duty of my performing the vrata within six months.

## \|\| 1.107.19 \|\|

*tathā kuru jagannātha svargalokaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*citrabhāno yathā śaktyā bhavānbhavati me gatiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O lord of the universe, you reside in the heaven. O Chitrabhanu, I shall worship you as per my means since you are my final god.

## \|\| 1.107.20 \|\|

*evamuccārya ṣaṇmāsaṃ citrabhānumayaṃ vratam \|*  
*tāvanniṣpādayedyāvatsampūrṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. With this resolve, the six months vrata of Chitrabhanu should be started in beginning of Dakshinayana.

## \|\| 1.107.21 \|\|

*tataśca prīṇanaṃ kuryādyathāśaktyā vibhāvasoḥ \|*  
*bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndivyānbhaumāṃścāpi sadakṣiṇān \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Thereafter, pleasing the Sungod as per one’s means, the divine and the worldly Brahmanas should be served the food beside the dakshina.

## \|\| 1.107.22 \|\|

*puṇyākhyānakathāṃ kuryānmārtaṃḍasya tathāgrataḥ \|*  
*pūjayedvācakaṃ bhaktyā yathāśaktyā1 ca lekhakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Besides the above, the reciter of the scriptures and the writer of the scriptures should also be worshipped as per one’s means, before the image of the Sungod and should listen to the auspicious stories.

## \|\| 1.107.23 \|\|

*evaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛṣṇa yo dhārayati mānavaḥ \|*  
*ihaiva devaśārdūla mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O lion among the gods, O Krishna! When a person thus performs in the world, he is relieved of all the grave sins committed on earth.

## \|\| 1.107.24 \|\|

*ṣaṇmāsābhyantare cāsya maraṇaṃ yadi jāyate \|*  
*prāpnotyanaśanasyoktaṃ yatphalaṃ tadasaṃśayam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. In case a person meets with his death within six months, still he shall achieve all the rewards for his fasting. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.107.25 \|\|

*padadvayaṃ ca devasya samyaktvena sadārcitam \|*  
*bhavatyetajjagau bhānuḥ purā candrāya pṛcchate \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He would also achieve the fruits of performing vratas with both the feet, appropriately. This was revealed by the Sungod himself, on a question from the moon.

## Chapter 108. Sarvarthavapti Saptami

## \|\| 1.108.1-4 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya sarvāptiṃ saptamīṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*yāmupoṣya samāpnoti sarvānkāmāṃstathā parān \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pākhaṇḍādibhirālāpaṃ na kuryādbhānutatparaḥ \|*  
*pūjayetpraṇato devamekāgramanasā śubham \|\| 2 \|\|*

*māghādyaiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sāṃkrāntikaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*mārtaṇḍaḥ prathamaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ kaḥ prakīrtitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tṛtīyaṃ citrabhānuśca vibhāvasurataḥ param \|*  
*bhageti pañcamaṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ haṃsaḥ sa ucyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Brahma said — During the bright seventh moon day of the month of Magha, when a person observes fast, all his desires get fulfilled. The day is therefore known as Sarvapti or the one when everything is achieved. I am going to explain the same, you please listen. One should observe fast on that particular day. He should not talk to the cheats. With a concentrated mind, be should worship he Sungod with all humility in an appropriate manner. The paranas for six months, which are prescribed for the months of Magha and others, starting from the first day of the month, should be followed performing the worship at the same time. Separate forms of the Sungod, like Martanda, Arka, Chitrabhanu, Vibhavasu, Bhaga and Hamsa should be recited and all of them should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.108.5 \|\|

*pūrṇeṣu ṣaṭsu māseṣu pañcagavyamudāhṛtam \|*  
*snāne ca prāśane caiva praśastaṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After the expiry of six months, one should take bath with panchagavya, sipping the same at the same time. This process has been termed as the best and the destroyer of the sins.

## \|\| 1.108.6-7 \|\|

*praṇāmaṃ devadevasya kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhi \|*  
*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchraddadhānaśca śaktitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pāraṇānte ca devasya prīṇanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*kurvīta bhaktyā vidhivadravibhaktyā tu gṛhyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thus offering salutation to the Sungod and properly worshipping him, it removes all the sins. Thereafter, one should give away charities to the Brahmanas as per his means, together with dakshina. At the conclusion of the vrata, it is necessary to please the Sungod, offering valuables to him. By so doing, the Sungod continues to shower his grace on the devotee.

## \|\| 1.108.8-9 \|\|

*naktabhojī tathā viṣṇo tailakṣāravivarjitaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇa jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau saptamyāmatha vā dine \|\| 8 \|\|*

*etāmuṣityā dharmajño haṃsaprīṇanatatparaḥ \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. O Vishnu! During the fasting at night, the salt and oil should be discarded. On the day of Saptami, one should remain awake during the day. When it is so done, all the desires of the performer are fulfilled and he is relieved of the grave sins as well.

## \|\| 1.108.10 \|\|

*yataḥ sarvamavāpnoti yadyadicchati cetasā \|*  
*ato lokeṣu vikhyātā sarvārthāvāptisaptamī \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Therefore, whatever articles are desired by a person, he achieves success in getting them. The Saptami tithi is believed to be the fulfiller of all the desires and it has been so called.

## \|\| 1.108.11 \|\|

*kṛtābhilaṣitā hyeṣā prārabdhā dharmatatparaiḥ \|*  
*pūrayatyakhilānkāmānsaṃśrutā ca dinedine \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. In case, the religious minded people observe the same, or even if they express desire to celebrate the same, or if they simply listen to the performing of the same, even then, this Saptami fulfills all his desires.

## \|\| 1.108.12 \|\|

*tamārādhayasva raviṃ tathātha garuḍadhvaja \|*  
*yathārādhitavānbhānuṃ bhagaṇādhipatiḥ purā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. O Garuda-bannered lord, as the moon had performed the process earlier, you should also follow the same.

## Chapter 109. Description of Martanda Saptami

## \|\| 1.109.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*mārtaṇḍasaptamīṃ kṛṣṇa yathānyāṃ1 vacci te'nagha \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vīra gadato me śubhapradām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O sinless Krishna! The Martanda Saptami, which bestows welfare, is being described by me, and with the performing of which the desired wish is granted. You listen to me with an attentive mind.

## \|\| 1.109.2-4 \|\|

*yasyāḥ samyaganuṣṭhānātprāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam \|*  
*pauṣe māse site pakṣe saptamyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*samyaksampūjya mārtaṇḍaṃ mārtaṇḍa iti vai japet \|*  
*pūjayetkutapaṃ bhaktyā śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dhūpapuṣpopaharādyairupavāsaiḥ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*mārtaṇḍeti japannāma punastadgatamānasaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. On the bright seventh moon day of the month of Pausha, a person, while fasting, should adore the Sungod, besides reciting the name of Martanda, the process of which has been described like this. One should observe fast with great devotion offering incense, flowers to the Sungod while worshipping him. Thereafter, he should meditate upon the Sungod uttering the name of Martanda.

## \|\| 1.109.5 \|\|

*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā khagadhvaja \|*  
*svapanvibodhanskhalito mārtaṇḍeti ca kīrtayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O Garuda-bannered one! According to one’s means, he should recite the name of Martanda, while sleeping, awaking or in trans position.

## \|\| 1.109.6-8 \|\|

*pāṣaṇḍādivikarmasthairālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet \|*  
*gomūtraṃ gopayo vāpi dadhi kṣīramathāpi vā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*godehataḥ samudbhūtaṃ prāśnīyādātmaśuddhaye \|*  
*dvitīye'hni punaḥ snātastathaivābhyarcanaṃ raveḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tenaiva nāmnā sambhūya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*tato bhuñjīta godohasambhūtena samanvitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. On that particular day, one should have no contact with the cheats or the deceitful people. For self purification, he should consume cow urine, milk, curd or any other thing emerging out of the body of the cow. On the next day, he should again take a bath, should again worship the Sungod as before. Then reciting the name of the Sungod, he should offer dakshina to the Brahmanas and consume the payasam.

## \|\| 1.109.9-10 \|\|

*evamevākhilānmāsānupoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*dadyādgavādikaṃ viprānpratimāsaṃ svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dhāritā cetpunarvarṣe yathāśaktyā gavādikam \|*  
*dattvā paraṃ raverbhūyaḥ śṛṇu yatphalamaśnute \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Thus performing all the monthly vratas appropriately and with purity, one should give away cows and dakshina to Brahmanas for the sake of the Sungod. The merits one earns by so doing are being spoken by me, which you should listen.

## \|\| 1.109.11-12 \|\|

*svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ ca pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*pratimāsaṃ dvijātibhyo yaddattvā phalamaśnute \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tatprāpnotyakhilaṃ samyagvratametadupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*taṃ ca lokamavāpnoti mārtaṇḍo yatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Similarly, on the fifth moon day, the cows with their horns decorated with gold, should be given. On the sixth moon day, when a person gives away a bull in charity on every month, a person achieves the desired reward. The aforesaid entire merit can be achieved by performing this anushthana. He also achieves the place where Martanda resides himself.

## \|\| 1.109.13-14 \|\|

*śāṇḍeleyasamaḥ kṛṣṇa tejasā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mārtaṇḍasaptamīmetāmupoṣyaite gaṇā divi \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vidyotamānā dṛśyante lokairadyāpi bhūdhara \|*  
*tasmāttvamādideveśaṃ graheśaṃ bhāskaraṃ ravim \|*  
*anayārcaya govinda gopatiṃ golasannibham \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. O Krishna! The said person attains the glory resembling the fire. O lord of the earth, with the performing of the Martanda Saptami, the shining stars exist in the sky. O Govinda! Yon also, therefore, celebrating tins particular Saptami, should worship the circular Sungod, who is the lord of the Sun rays.

## Chapter 110. Vrata of Anantara Saptami

## \|\| 1.110.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ māsi bhādrapade'cyuta \|*  
*praṇamya śirasādityaṃ pūjayetsaptavāhanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said O infallible one, during the bright seventh moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, a devotee, lowering his head, should worship the Sungod, who moves seated in a chariot driven by seven horses.

## \|\| 1.110.2 \|\|

*puṣpadhūpādibhirvīra kutapānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*pāṣaṇḍādibhirālāpamakurvanniyatātmavān \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O valorous one, offering the incense and flowers, one should please the Sungod. The performer should not talk to the deceitful people, himself observing self control.

## \|\| 1.110.3-5 \|\|

*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭhanvrajanprasthitaśca kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ādityanāmasmaraṇaṃ kurvannuccāraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*anenaiva vidhānena māsāndvādaśa vai kramāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

*upoṣya pāraṇe pūrṇe samabhyarcya jagadgurum \|*  
*puṇyena śrāvaṇeneha prīṇayanpuṣṭimaśnute \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. He should then offer dakshina to the Brahmanas. The devotee should take food, keeping himself silent He should utter the name of Aditya while sleeping, awake, while walking or in semi conscious condition, by completing the process of performing of the twelve vratas. At the time of the completion of the vratas, he should worship the Sungod who is the preceptor of the universe and please with the reciting of the auspicious stories of the lord.

## \|\| 1.110.6 \|\|

*anantaṃ śrāvaṇeneha yataḥ phalamudāhṛtam \|*  
*tenādityaṃ samabhyarcya tadeva labhate phalam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The great merit which one achieves with the listening of the story of lord Ananta, the same merit is achieved by a person, with the appropriate worship of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.110.7-8 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kuryādādityārādhanaṃ śuciḥ \|*  
*prāpyeha vipulaṃ bhogaṃ dharmamarthaṃ tathāvyayam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*amutra lokamāyāti divye khe gītasaṃyute \|*  
*nārī vā svargamabhyetya hyanantaṃ phalamaśnute \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Thus a person, who observing purity, worships the Sungod, he achieves Suryaloka after enjoying all the pleasures on earth, besides comforts, enjoyment, imperishable riches and with the dancing and music on earth. The woman who also worships the Sungod like this, she also achieves heaven and the merits beyond measure.

## Chapter 111. Description of Abhyanga Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 1.111.1-2 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*śrāvaṇe māsi devāgryaṃ saptamyāṃ saptavāhanam \|*  
*śuklapakṣe samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śuciḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pākhaṇḍādibhirālāpamakurvanniyatātmavān \|*  
*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā naktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Brahma said — On the Shukla Saptami of Shravana, one should adore Sungod with the offering of flowers and incense. He should be very alert in avoiding the company of wicked people and after completing the anushthana, he should first give away dakshina to the Brahmana and then consume his food, maintaining due silence.

## \|\| 1.111.3-4 \|\|

*abhyaṅgaṃ devadevasya varṣe varṣe niyojayet \|*  
*saptamyāmannamevāgryaṃ śubhaṃ śuklaṃ navaṃ tathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vibhaveṣu tathānyeṣu vāditrāṇyeva vai viduḥ \|*  
*tathā devasya māse'sminnabhyaṅgaḥ parigīyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. In this way, every year, a devotee should offer abhyanga (oil etc.) for the Sungod. On each Saptami y according to one’s capacity, a person should offer all the favourite things of the Sungod along with musical instruments. Thus, it has been ordained to provide Abhyanga for Surya during this month,

## \|\| 1.111.5-6 \|\|

*yastu cārādhayedbhaktyā bhāskarasya naro'cyuta \|*  
*abhyaṅgaṃ vidhivacchaktyā kṛtvā brāhmaṇabhojanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śaṅkhatūryaninādaiśca brahmaghoṣaiśca puṣkalaiḥ \|*  
*sa divyaṃ yānamārūḍho lokamāyāti helinaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. O Achyuta! A person who devotedly offers food to the Brahmanas and Abhyanga for Sungod after adoring him, he hears the divine sound of Shankha and Brahmaghosha and boarding the divine plane, goes to Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.111.7 \|\|

*anenaiva vidhānena māsāndvādaśa vai kramāt \|*  
*upoṣya pāraṇe pūrṇe dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Thus, performing vratas of all the twelve months, a person should complete the parana and give away suitable dakshina to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.111.8 \|\|

*vrataṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kuryādādityārādhanaṃ śuciḥ \|*  
*sa gacchetparamaṃ lokaṃ divyaṃ vai vanamālinaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A person who performs the worship of Sungod in this manner with all purity, he achieves the divine place of Vanamali.

## Chapter 112. Method of Tritiyapada-vrata described

## \|\| 1.112.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*evaṃ kṛṣṇa sadā bhānurnarairbhaktyā yathāvidhi \|*  
*phalaṃ dadātyasulabhaṃ salilenāpi pūjitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — O Krishna! In case, a person with utmost devotion worships the Sungod, simply with water alone, then he is sure to get the inaccessible merits.

## \|\| 1.112.2 \|\|

*na bhānurjīvadānena na puṣpairna phalaistathā \|*  
*ārādhyate suyuddhena hṛdayenaiva kevalam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. It is because the worship of the Sungod cannot be done with any type of violence, flowers or fruits, but to the contrary, the Sungod is worshipped with the purity of heart.

## \|\| 1.112.3 \|\|

*rāgādapetaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāgduṣṭā nānṛtādibhiḥ \|*  
*hiṃsāvirahitaṃ karma bhāskarārādhanatrayam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The heart of a devotee should be free from any type of attraction and malice. It should be pure, free from falsehood and free from harming others. These activities are said to be praiseworthy for the worship of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.112.4 \|\|

*rāgādidūṣite citte nāspandī timirāpahaḥ \|*  
*badhnāti taṃ naraṃ haṃsaḥ kadācitkardamāmbhasi \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Because the meditation performed with a blemished mind, can never please the Sungod. Can a swan like soul by creating confusion in the muddy water, live in the heart of human being, because the swan can never live in the muddy water.

## \|\| 1.112.5 \|\|

*tamaso nāśanāyālaṃ cendorlekhā hyanāratam \|*  
*hiṃsādidūṣitaṃ karma keśavārādhane kutaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. As the moon rays can shine only after the thick sheets of clouds are removed, removing the darkness, then how could the evil ways be useful in the worship of the Sungod?

## \|\| 1.112.6-8 \|\|

*janaścittāprasādādvai na cāpa timirāpaham \|*  
*tasmātsatyasvabhāvena satyavākyena cācyuta \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ahiṃsakena cādityo nisagadeva toṣitaḥ \|*  
*sarvasvamapi devāya yo dadyātkuṭilāśayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sa naivārādhayedevaṃ devadevaṃ divākaram \|*  
*rāgādapetaṃ hadayaṃ kuru tvaṃ bhāskarārpaṇam \|*  
*tataḥ prāpayasi duṣprāpyamayatnenaiva bhāskaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Similarly, how could a person with blemished heart achieve the Sungod, who is the remover of darkness? O infallible one, therefore with the true intentions, truthful speech, non-violent activities, when the Sungod is adored, he gets pleased, even when a wicked person offers all his belongings to the Sungod, but he cannot be successful in his approach. Therefore, you should worship the Sungod with a purified heart, because by so doing, you shall surely achieve the inaccessible things, without much effort.

## \|\| 1.112.9 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*deveśaḥ kathitaḥ samyalkāmyo'yaṃ bhāskaro mayi \|*  
*ārādhanavidhiṃ sarvaṃ bhūyaḥ pṛcchāmi taṃ vada \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Lord Vishnu said — You have explained to me the method of adoration of Surya (with purpose) still, I would like to get it repeated before me.

## \|\| 1.112.10 \|\|

*kule janma tathārogyaṃ dhanavṛddhiśca durlabhā \|*  
*tritayaṃ prāpyate yena tanme vada jagatpate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O lord of the universe, you tell me the way out for achieving birth in high race, getting free of ailments, gaining of inaccessible fortunes.

## \|\| 1.112.11 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*māse tu māghe sitasaptame'hni hastarkṣayoge jagataḥ prasūtim \|*  
*sampūjya bhānuṃ vidhinopavāsī sugandhadhūpānnavaropahāraiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Brahma said — On the bright seventh moon day of the month of Magha falling during Hasta constellation, one should observe fast and should worship the Sungod, offering fragrance, incense, besides eatables to him who happens to be cause of the entire universe.

## \|\| 1.112.12 \|\|

*gṛhī tu puṣpaiḥ pratipādya pūjāṃ dānādiyuktaṃ vratamabdamekam \|*  
*dadyācca dānaṃ munipuṅgaḥvebhyastatkathyamānaṃ vinibodha dhīra \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus, the householder should please the Sungod offering flowers and charities. For the full one year, he should perform vratas appropriately. This has been ordained by the excellent sages. O great warrior, I am speaking this with all confidence. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.112.13 \|\|

*vajraṃ tilānvrīhiyavānhiraṇyaṃ yavānnamambhaḥ karakāmupānaham \|*  
*chatropapannaṃ guḍapheṇitāḍhyaṃ dadyātkramādvastu anukrameṇa \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. With the performing of the vratas in the aforesaid manner, flowers, sesamum, paddy, barley, gold vase filled with water, shoes, umbrella and sugar cake should be offered to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.112.14 \|\|

*yadyeṣa1 varṣe vidhinoditena yasyāṃ tithau lokaguruṃ prapūjya \|*  
*aśmantanānyātmaviśuddhihetoḥ samprāśanānīha nibodha tāni \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. By this method, whenever the Sungod is worshipped during the year, one should purify his body accordingly. I am going to speak about the same.

## \|\| 1.112.15 \|\|

*gomūtramambhaśca rase nu śākaṃ dūrvā dadhivrīhitilānyavāṃśca \|*  
*sūryāṃśutaptaṃ jalamambujākṣa kṣīraṃ ca māsaiḥ kramaśaḥ prayujyaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O lotus eyed one, cow’s urine, water, ghi, vegetables, durva grass, curd, paddy, sesamum, barley, the water heated with the sun rays and payasam should be consumed during these months.

## \|\| 1.112.16 \|\|

*kule pradhāne dhanadhānyapūrṇe padmāvṛte hyastasamastaduḥkhe \|*  
*prāpnoti janmā'vikalendriyaśca bhavatyarogo matimānsukhī ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By establishing this, a person is born in a high race, the household of whom is filled with enormous riches, cereals and eatables. His sense organs always remain satisfied, he possesses enormous wisdom and always remain comfortable.

## \|\| 1.112.17 \|\|

*tasmāttvamapyetadamoghavīrya divākarārādhanamapramattaḥ \|*  
*kuru prabhāvaṃ bhagavantamīśamārādhya kāmānakhilānupehi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Therefore, remaining alert, you also, must worship the Sungod and have all your desires fulfilled.

## Chapter 113. Adoration in the Sun temple

## \|\| 1.113.1-5 \|\|

*saptalokamayo bhānustasya yaḥ kurute gṛham \|\| 1 \|\|*

*devārcāṃ kārayitvā tu yatpuṇyaṃ puruṣo'śnute \|*  
*pūjayitvā ca vidhivadanulipya ca yatphalam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kāni mālyāni śastāni kāni nārhati bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*ke dhūpā bhānudayitāḥ ke varjyāśca jagatpateḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*upacāraphalaṃ kiṃ syātkiṃ phalaṃ gītavādite \|*  
*ghṛtakṣīrādinā yattu snāpite bhāskare phalam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yathopalepanādau ca phalamabhyukṣitena tu \|*  
*divākaragṛhe tāta tadaśeṣaṃ vadasva me \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Vishnu said — O best of the gods, you speak out extensively whatever is going to be asked by me. What type of merit is earned with the construction of a Sun temple. Similarly, what is achieved by a person by worshipping the image of Surya? Besides, offering the paste to him. You also tell me as to which one the things are to be offered to the Sungod, known to be praiseworthy? Which are the incense suitable to be offered to the Sungod, which one is discarded? You tell me decisively. What type of merits are earned by offering fruits, ghi, milk, for the bathing of the image of Surya or by applying paste over his body? What merit is earned by consecrating the image of Surya? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 1.113.6 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sādhu vatsa yadetattvaṃ mārtaṇḍasyeha pṛcchasi \|*  
*śuśrūṣaṇe vidhiṃ puṇyaṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Brahma said — O son, this is an excellent question which has been asked by you relating to Martanda. It reveals the extent of your devotion for him. I am now speaking out the reply to the question asked by you. You listen to me with attention.

## \|\| 1.113.7-8 \|\|

*yastu devālayaṃ bhānordārvaṃ śailamathāpi vā \|*  
*kārayenmṛnmayaṃ cāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ahanyahani yajñena yajato yanmahatphalam \|*  
*prāpnoti tatphalaṃ bhānoryaḥ kārayati mandiram \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Such of the people who build the Sun temple with wood and clay, the merits so earned by them are being revealed by me, you listen. A person who constructs a temple for the Sungod earns the merit equivalent to the daily performing of yajna.

## \|\| 1.113.9 \|\|

*kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ kulaṃ śatam \|*  
*kārayedbhagavaddhāma sa nayedarkalokatām \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The person who constructs a Sun temple, his hundred past and an equal number of future generations achieve the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.113.10 \|\|

*saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu \|*  
*bhānorālayavinyāsaprārambhādeva naśyati \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Soon after the start of the construction of the Sun temple, the sins of his past seven births are washed out.

## \|\| 1.113.11 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāṃ samavāpnoti sa naraḥ sāptalaukikīm \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Because the Sun has his presence in the seven worlds, therefore, the person who builds his temple, he achieves the seven worlds.

## \|\| 1.113.12 \|\|

*praśastadeśabhūbhāge praśastaṃ bhavanaṃ raveḥ \|*  
*kārayedakṣayāṃllokānsa naraḥ pratipadyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In the land of the excellent country, when a temple of Surya is built by a person, he achieves the eternal lokas.

## \|\| 1.113.13 \|\|

*iṣṭakācayavinyāso yāvadvarṣāṇi tiṣṭhati \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tatkarturdivi saṃsthitiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. When a brick temple is built for him and the period for which the temple lasts, for the same period, the builder of the temple resides in the heaven.

## \|\| 1.113.14 \|\|

*pratimāṃ lakṣaṇavatīṃ yaḥ kārayati mānavaḥ \|*  
*divākarasya tallokamakṣayaṃ pratipadyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Similarly, a person who gets the image of the Sungod prepared as per the features prescribed in the scriptures, he achieves several of the indestructible lokas.

## \|\| 1.113.15 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi sa modate \|*  
*loke sumanasāṃ vīra pratyekaṃ madhusūdana \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O valorous one, O Madhusudana! The builder lives in each one of the lokas of the gods for more than sixty thousand years, enjoying all the comforts.

## \|\| 1.113.16 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāpya raverarcāṃ supraśaste niveśane \|*  
*puruṣaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'sti na doṣaphalamaśnute \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By consecrating the beautiful image of Surya and worshipping it, the devotee gets success and he therefore, never earns blemishes.

## \|\| 1.113.17 \|\|

*ye bhaviṣyanti ye'tītā ākalpaṃ puruṣāḥ kule \|*  
*tāṃstārayati saṃsthāpya devasya pratimāṃ raveḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The person who consecrates the image of the Sungod in a temple, he redeems his family extending upto a kalpa.

## \|\| 1.113.18 \|\|

*anuśiṣṭāḥ kila purā yamena yamakiṅkarāḥ \|*  
*pāśadaṇḍakarāḥ kṛṣṇa prajāsaṃyamanodyatāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O Krishna! In earlier times, Yama had advised his messengers accordingly, who were going to exercise their control over the people.

## \|\| 1.113.19 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*viharantu yathānyāyaṃ niyogo me'nupālyatām \|*  
*nājñābhaṅgaṃ kariṣyanti bhavatāṃ jantavaḥ kvacit \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Yama said — With a judicious mind, you should roam about here and there, obeying my command. No one would be able to disobey the command of the noble or the trustworthy people.

## \|\| 1.113.20 \|\|

*kevalaṃ ye jaganmūlaṃ vivasvantamupāśritāḥ \|*  
*bhavadbhiḥ parihartavyāsteṣāṃ naiveha saṃsthitiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. You should keep one thing in mind. Never go near the devotee of the Sungod who is the basic cause of the universe, because they can never reach here.

## \|\| 1.113.21 \|\|

*ye tu vaivasvatā loke taccittāstatparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti sadā bhānuṃ te ca tyājyā sudūrataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Therefore, the devotes of the Sungod, who getting observed in him, worship the Sun with devotion, you should leave them alone from a distance.

## \|\| 1.113.22 \|\|

*tiṣṭhaṃśca prasvapangacchannuttiṣṭhanskhalite kṣute \|*  
*saṅkīrtayati devaṃ yaḥ sa nastyājyaḥ sudūrataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Similarly, a person who while walking, sleeping or awake in semi-conscious condition or while sneezing, recites the name of the Sungod, should be left undisturbed from a distance.

## \|\| 1.113.23 \|\|

*nityanaimittikairdevaṃ ye yajanti tu bhāskaram \|*  
*na cālokyā bhavadbhiste yaddhyānaṃ haṃti vo gatim \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. One who worships the Sungod on some festive occasions, you should not have even a look at him, because with a mere glance at such a person, your strength would disappear.

## \|\| 1.113.24-26 \|\|

*ye puṣpadhūpavāso'bhirbhūṣaṇaiścāpi vallabhaiḥ \|*  
*arcayanti na te grāhyā matpituste parigrahāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*upalepanakartāraḥ kartāro mārjanasya ye \|*  
*arkālaye parityājyaṃ teṣāṃ tripuruṣaṃ kulam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ye vāyatanaṃ bhānoḥ kāritaṃ tatkulodbhavaḥ \|*  
*pumānna nāvalokyo vai bhavadbhirduṣṭacakṣuṣā \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Therefore, the people who worship the Sungod offering flowers, incense, costumes and beautiful ornaments, they have to be left undisturbed being the devotee of the Sungod. Similarly, a person who plasters, cleans with broom in a Sun temple, his generations should not be touched by you.

## \|\| 1.113.27 \|\|

*yenārcā bhagavadbhaktyā matpituḥ kāritā śubhā \|*  
*narāṇāṃ tatkulaṃ vīrāḥ sadā tyājyaṃ sudūrataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The one who himself worships or gets others to worship the Sungod, you should leave alone all the people of his race from a distance.

## \|\| 1.113.28 \|\|

*bhavatāṃ bhramatāṃ yatra bhānusaṃśrayamudrayā \|*  
*na cājñābhaṅgakṛtkaścidbhaviṣyati naraḥ kvacit \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. None else, except the devotee of the Sungod cannot disobey your command, while roaming about in the world.

## \|\| 1.113.29 \|\|

*ityuktāḥ kiṅkarāstena yamena sumahātmanā \|*  
*anāśritya vacaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satrājitamatho gatāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Thus at the command of Yama, his messengers, disregarding the command of Yama, arrived before Satrajit.

## \|\| 1.113.30 \|\|

*tasya te tejasā sarve bhānorbhaktasya suvrata \|*  
*mohitāḥ patitā bhūmau yathā ca vihagā nagāt \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O Suvrata, all of them were fainted with the lustre of the sun and fell down on the earth, like the birds falling from the sky.

## \|\| 1.113.31 \|\|

*etāṃ mahāphalāṃ yorcāṃ bhānoḥ kārayate naraḥ \|*  
*tavākhyānaṃ mahābāho gṛhaṃ kārayituśca yat \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A person who performs the meritorious puja of the sun or builds a temple for him, they would earn the relative merits with the listening of this story.

## \|\| 1.113.32 \|\|

*yajñā narāṇāṃ pāpaughanāśakāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ \|*  
*tathaiveṣṭo jagadbhānuḥ sarvayajñamayo raviḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. As the performing of a yajna removes the sins of a person and fulfills his desires, similarly, the Sungod, who is loveable for the universe and bestows the desired things, happens to be like the yajna.

## Chapter 114. Consecration of the Surya image

## \|\| 1.114.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sthāpitāṃ pratimāṃ bhānoḥ samyaksampūjya mānavaḥ \|*  
*yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — Consecrating the image of the Sungod, the purpose for which the person worships it, all his desires get fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.114.2 \|\|

*yaḥ snāpayati devasya ghṛtena pratimāṃ raveḥ \|*  
*prastheprasthe dvijāgryāṇāṃ sa dadāti gavāṃ śatam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. A person who bathes the image of the Sungod with ghi or by his giving away in charity a sera (930 grams), he earns the merit of donating a hundred cows. This should be well understood.

## \|\| 1.114.3 \|\|

*gavāṃ śatasya viprebhyo yadvattasya bhavetphalam \|*  
*ghṛtaprasthena tadbhānorbhavetsnātakayoginām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. By giving a hundred cows in charity to a Brahmana the merit one earns, the same merit is earned by him by bathing the image of Surya with a seer of clarified butter.

## \|\| 1.114.4 \|\|

*bhūridyumnena samprāptā saptadvīpā vasundharā \|*  
*ghaṭodakena mārtaṇḍapratimā snāpitā kila \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A person who bathes the image of Surya with a pitcher filled with water, earns enormous riches besides possessing land in the seven continents.

## \|\| 1.114.5 \|\|

*pratimāmasitāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛtena jagatīpateḥ \|*  
*snāpayitvā samastebhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ kṛṣṇa mucyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O Krishna! During the dark eighth moon day when the Sun image is bathed with clarified butter, he is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.114.6 \|\|

*saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā gavyena haviṣā raveḥ \|*  
*snapanaṃ tu bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The bathing of the Surya image with ghi on the seventh or sixth moon day is said to be praiseworthy and removes all the sins.

## \|\| 1.114.7 \|\|

*jñānato'jñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ \|*  
*tatkṣālayati sandhyāyāṃ ghṛtena snapanaṃ raveḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Because the sins which are committed by a person in ignorance, get destroyed if the image of the Sungod is washed with clarified butter in the evening.

## \|\| 1.114.8 \|\|

*sarvayajñamayo bhānurhavyānāṃ paramaṃ ghṛtam \|*  
*tayoraśeṣapāpānāṃ kṣālakaḥ saṅgamo bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. As the Sungod represents all the yajnas, similarly, he is the best of all the havyas. Therefore, the confluence of both of them becomes the remover of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.114.9 \|\|

*yeṣu kṣīravahā nadyo hradāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ \|*  
*modate teṣu lokeṣu kṣīrasnānakaro raveḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Therefore, the place where the rivers flow filled with milk always and where the tanks are filled with payasam in place of mud, a person reaches these types of lokas of the Sun, when he had bathed the Sungod with milk.

## \|\| 1.114.10 \|\|

*āhlādaṃ nirvṛtisthānamārogyaṃ cārurūpatām \|*  
*saptajanmānyavāpnoti kṣīravānaparo raveḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A person who bathes the image of the Sungod, gets filled with bliss, unattached, free from ailments and gains a beautiful body.

## \|\| 1.114.11-12 \|\|

*dadhyādīnāṃ vikārāṇāṃ kṣīrataḥ sambhavo yathā \|*  
*yathā ca vimalaṃ kṣīraṃ yathā nirvṛtikārakam \|*  
*tathā ca nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatyapi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*grahānukūlatāṃ puṣṭiṃ priyatyamakhile jane \|*  
*karoti bhagavānbhānuḥ kṣīrasnapanatoṣitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Though the curd or butter etc., are the product of the milk, but they are spotless at the same time. Therefore by washing the image with milk, one achieves the spotless jnana or knowledge. Because the Sungod, getting pleased with his wash with milk, makes other planets favourable and they provide energy and endear a person in this world.

## \|\| 1.114.13 \|\|

*sarvasya snigdhatāmeti dṛṣṭamātre prasīdati \|*  
*ghṛtakṣīreṇa deveśa snāpite timirāpahe \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. With the bathing of the image with the milk or ghi, it endears a person among the other people to such an extent, which delight the people at sight and he feel blissful.

## Chapter 115. Method of Sun Worship

## \|\| 1.115.1 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*praśaṃsanti mahātmānaḥ saṃvādaṃ bhāskarāśrayam \|*  
*gautamyā saha kauśalyā sumanāyāṃ surālaye \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Brahma said — I am going to reveal to you the discussion between Gautami and Kausalya in the heaven, which is immensely praised by the learned people.

## \|\| 1.115.2 \|\|

*svarge'tiśobhanāṃ dṛṣṭvā kauśalyāṃ patinā saha \|*  
*brāhmaṇī gautamī nāma paryapṛcchata vismitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Once in the heaven, Kausalya was present in the company of the lord of the universe. Observing the enormous beauty of Kausalya, the immensely surprised Gautami — the Brahmana lady, put her a question.

## \|\| 1.115.3 \|\|

*gautamyuvāca \|*  
*śataśaḥ santi kauśalye devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ \|*  
*devapatnyastathaivaitāḥ siddhāḥ siddhāṅganāstathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Gautami said — There are hundreds of gods living in the heaven who have their spouses, besides the spouses of the Siddhas.

## \|\| 1.115.4 \|\|

*na teṣāmīdṛśo gandho na kāntirna surūpatā \|*  
*na vāsasī śobhane ye yathā te patinā saha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. But O beautiful one, the lustre of your body while living with your husband, possessed by you, is not to be found with any other damsel of the heaven.

## \|\| 1.115.5 \|\|

*naivābharaṇajātāni teṣāṃ bhrājanti vai tathā \|*  
*yathā tava yathā patyurna ca svarganivāsinām \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Besides the way in which your ornaments and those of your husband look graceful, are not possessed by anyone else in the heaven.

## \|\| 1.115.6 \|\|

*susnātacailataścaiva yuvayoratiricyate \|*  
*lekhādyānāmapīśānāṃ kṣayātiśayavarjitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. By taking bath with your clothes on, and getting clad in these garments, the grace of both of you has become unparallel. You now actually look more beautiful than the prominent gods, who have their own blemishes, but both of you are unblemished.

## \|\| 1.115.7 \|\|

*tapaḥprabhāvo dānaṃ vā homo vā karmasaṃjñitaḥ \|*  
*yuvayoryatsamācakṣva tatsarvaṃ varavarṇini \|*  
*yena me vikrame buddhirmanujā yena saṅgatāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. O excellent lady, I am feeling surprised as to how could both of you achieve this beauty? Is it the result of you tapas? Or is it the reward of your charities or of any other noble deed? Whatever be the cause of your possessing such as enormous beauty, you please speak out to me, to enable me to do the same. I have firmly resolved to follow the same, other people would also be interested in following the same.

## \|\| 1.115.8 \|\|

*kauśalyovāca \|*  
*yajño yajñeśvaro bhānurāvābhyāṃ jātu toṣitaḥ \|*  
*svargaprāptiriyaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ phalamuttamam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Kaushalya said — Once both of us had pleased the Sungod, who also happens to be the lord of yajnas and by so doing, we had an opportunity of achieving the heaven.

## \|\| 1.115.9 \|\|

*surūpatā tataḥ prītiḥ paśyatāṃ cāruveṣitā \|*  
*yatpṛcchasi mahābhāge tadapyeṣāṃ vadāmi te \|\| 9 \|\|*
