41-42. O best of Yadus, thereafter, incense should be offered to Dindi, Hemanta, Maheshvara and Vyoma. In a sequence, he should offer salutation to Vishvedevas as well as Rudra, Mundapati, Aditya, Purusheshvara and Surya.

## \|\| 1.143.43 \|\|

*oṃ anekakāntaye natvā śeṣāya vāsukitakṣakakarkoṭakāya padmaśaṅkhakulikebhyo nāgarājebhyo namaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Again, salutation to the one, having lustre of different kinds. Then salutation to Shesha, Vasuki, Takshaka, Karkotaka, Padma, AamkЬa and Kulika — the king of serpents.

## \|\| 1.143.44-45 \|\|

*tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānmātṛkābhyo namonamaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*oṃ ugrahebhyo namaḥ\| oṃ daṇḍanāyakāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ tarartaṇḍāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ vināyakāya namaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Then salutation to the dwellers of Tala, Patala, Atala, Vitala, Rasatala, Daityas, Danavas and Pishachas. Thereafter, going round, salutation should be offered to the mothers, the planets, Dandanayakas, Martanda and Vinayaka.

## \|\| 1.143.46-48 \|\|

*evamuddiśya nāmāni dhūpaṃ dattvā varānana \|*  
*utkṣipto yatra vai dhūpo muktvā tatraiva taṃ punaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sūryaguptairabhiṣṭūya evaṃ vijñāya te tataḥ \|*  
*arcitastvaṃ yathā śaktyā mayā bhaktyā vibhāvaso \|*  
*aihikāmuṣmikīṃ nātha kāryasiddhiṃ vadasva me \|\| 47 \|\|*

*evaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ snātvā yo'rcayetpraṇato ravim \|*  
*vidhinā tu yathoktena so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 48 \|\|*

46-48. Thus uttering, the incense should be offered to all the people. Thereafter, the incense burner should be placed at the same place, from where it had been lifted. Then, he should offer prayer to the Sungod, saying — “O Vibhavasu, I have adored you according to my devotion and strength. Therefore, O lord you kindly bestow success to me for the worldly success as well as beyond it.” Thus taking bath thrice a day, one who worships the Sungod with all humility, he achieves the merit of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.143.49 \|\|

*yaścaivaṃ kurute nityaṃ yathoktaṃ dhūpavistaram \|*  
*sa putravānarogī ca mṛtaḥ saṃlīyate ravau \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A person, who offers the incense as per the above procedure, he enjoys the pleasure of good health, the sons, besides the worldly pleasures and the Sayujya moksha of Surya.

## \|\| 1.143.50 \|\|

*vidhinā tu yathoktena kriyamāṇāni yatnataḥ \|*  
*sarvakāryāṇi siddhyanti saphalāni bhavanti ca \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Thus, with the performing of the Sun worship according to the procedure laid down above, he achieves success in all his tasks.

## \|\| 1.143.51 \|\|

*puṣpaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadā na syātpatrāṇi samupāharet \|*  
*patraṃ na syāttato dhūpaṃ dhūpo na syāttato jalam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. In case, there be shortage of excellent flowers, then making all the efforts, incense should be burnt and in the absence of the same, the worship of the Sun can be carried with water alone.

## \|\| 1.143.52 \|\|

*sarvaṃ na syādyadā caiva praṇipātena pūjayet \|*  
*aśaktaḥ praṇipātasya manasā pūjayedravim \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. In the absence of everything, one should worship the Sungod with all humility. The weak persons, with all humility, should worship the Sungod mentally.

## \|\| 1.143.53 \|\|

*asambhave tu dravyāṇāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*dravyāṇāṃ sambhave caiva sarvamevopahārayet \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. This procedure has been prescribed when one has no money. But when a person has enough of riches, in that case, there is the provision for the worship of the Sungod offering all the presents.

## \|\| 1.143.54 \|\|

*mantraiḥ karmayuto yastu mitre dhūpaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*uccāraṇācca vai teṣāṃ dhūpaprīto bhavedraviḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. A performer when worships the Sungod, reciting mantras and also offers him the incense, the Sungod gets immensely pleased with him.

## \|\| 1.143.55 \|\|

*śiro nāsāmukhaṃ caiva bhṛśamāvṛtya yatnataḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbhāskaraṃ vīra śithilaṃ1 tu na kārayet \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The Sungod should be worshipped covering his head, nose as well as the face. A person should not be lethargic about it.

## \|\| 1.143.56 \|\|

*nalinena tu rājendra naro yāti divākaram \|*  
*tasmādyuktaṃ sadā kāryaṃ pūjyate ca divākaraḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O Rajendra! The small lotus flowers should always be offered to Sungod, because by so doing, a person achieves Sayujya moksha of the Sungod. Therefore, at the time of worship, they should always offer the small lotus flowers.

## \|\| 1.143.57-58 \|\|

*te'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya sūryalokaṃ vrajanti hi \|*  
*dhūpena pūjyamānaṃ tu narāḥ paśyanti yādava \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yānti te paramaṃ sthānaṃ yanna paśyanti sūrayaḥ \|*  
*kriyamāṇaṃ tathārkaṃ ca bhaktyā paśyanti ye narāḥ \|*  
*sarvānkāmāniha prāpya te yānti paramaṃ padam \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. Those who do so, they achieve the merit of performing the Ashvamedha sacrifice, which cannot even be witnessed by several of the learned people. Those who offer incense to the Sungod, they achieve the highest position, which cannot be visualised by anyone. Those who have an audience with the Sungod with devotion, all their worldly desires are fulfilled and they achieve the supreme position.

## Chapter 144. Origin of Bhojakas

## \|\| 1.144.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*athājagāma bhagavānvyāso dvāravatīṃ purīm \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — Thereafter, lord Vyasa arrived in tine city of Dvaravati, in order to have an audience with lord Narayana — the carrier of conch, disc and club.

## \|\| 1.144.2 \|\|

*tamāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsudevo viśāṃpate \|*  
*abhyutthāya mahātejāḥ pūjayāmāsa bhārata \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O Bharata! At the arrival of the Rishi, the highly illustrious Krishna got up to welcome him.

## \|\| 1.144.3-5 \|\|

*svayamevāsanaṃ dattvā pādyamarghyaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*papraccha prayato bhūtvā vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ya ete bhojakā viprā ānītā matsutena vai \|*  
*śākadvīpamito gatvā jñānino mokṣagāminaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tāndṛṣṭvā rūpato vipra praveśātkarmatastathā \|*  
*kautūhalaṃ samutpannaṃ harṣaśca paramo mama \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. He made him to sit over a seat himself and offered him padya, arghya and water etc. Thereafter, he asked Vyasa — the son of Satyavati — “My son Samba had brought the Shaka Brahmanas from Shakadvipa. I feel delighted and anxious observing their performance.

## \|\| 1.144.6-7 \|\|

*kathamete kṣaṇamapi tiṣṭhante pṛthivītale \|*  
*yeṣāṃ raviḥ sadā pūjyasteṣāṃ muktiḥ sadā vaset \|\| 6 \|\|*

*nāgatvā bhojakatvaṃ hi mokṣamāpnoti kaścana \|*  
*idaṃ me manaso brahmansadā sampratibhāti vai \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. How are they lodged an earth, because their family god is the Sun. They can achieve redemption forever. O Brahman, presently I have developed a feeling, that none can achieve moksha without embracing the dharma of Bhojakas.”

## \|\| 1.144.8 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*evameva yathāttha tvaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādhara \|*  
*dhanyā ete mahātmāno bhojakā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Vyasa said — O holder of Shankha, cakra and gada, whatever has been spoken by you is true, the Bhojakas are quite graceful. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.144.9 \|\|

*ye pūjayanti satataṃ bhānumantaṃ divākaram \|*  
*jñāninaḥ karmaniṣṭhāśca sadā mokṣagatiṃ gatāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Those who regularly worship the shining Sungod, they are the devoted workers and always remain free.

## \|\| 1.144.10-11 \|\|

*yajante satataṃ bhānuṃ balipuṣpaphalaistathā \|*  
*annenauṣadhibhiścaiva ājyahomaiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*homaṃ ca śāśvataṃ kṛtvā paraṃ homaṃ tataḥ śritāḥ \|*  
*parahomasya karaṇātpūtātmāno hyakalmaṣāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The Bhojakas always worship the Sungod, offering ball, flowers, fruits, cereals, herbs and ghi in homa. They perform homa daily by which they get purified and freed from their sins. For that purpose, they enter the rays of the Sungod. A digit of the Sungod, for the performing of the deeds, is lodged in the fire. They perform the homa daily because by so doing, they get purified and free from sins.

## \|\| 1.144.12 \|\|

*viśanti paramāṃ divyāṃ bhāskarīṃ taijasīṃ kalām \|*  
*karmaṇaḥ sādhane caikā tatra cāgnau pratiṣṭhitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Therefore, they enter the divine digit of the Sun. A part of the digit of the Sun is also lodged in the fire.

## \|\| 1.144.13 \|\|

*vāyumārgasthitā vyomni dvitīyāntaḥ prakāśikā \|*  
*tataḥ paraṃ tṛtīyā tu tatsmṛtaṃ sūryamaṇḍale \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Similarly, another illuminated digit is lodged in the sky in the route of the wind. The third digit is lodged in the solar disc itself.

## \|\| 1.144.14-15 \|\|

*maṇḍalaṃ tacca saviturdivyaṃ hyajaramavyayam \|*  
*tasyā'sau puruṣo madhye yo'sau sadasadātmakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kṣarākṣarastu vijñeyo mahāsūryastathaiva ca \|*  
*niṣkalaḥ sakalaścāpi dvau ca tasya prakalpitau \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The solar disc is divine and indestructible. In the centre of it, the imperishable, destructible as well as the indestructible form is visible. This is the great Sun disc. He is conceived to be of two parts, viz., visible and invisible.

## \|\| 1.144.16 \|\|

*akṣaraḥ sakalaścaiva sarvabhūtavyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*satattvaḥ sakalaḥ proktastattvahīnastu niṣkalaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. He is indestructible without digit and pervades in all the living beings. Because of his being with digit, he is visible and because of his being without digit, he is said to be invisible.

## \|\| 1.144.17-18 \|\|

*tṛṇagulmalatāvṛkṣavṛkasiṃhadvijādhipān \|*  
*surasiddhamanuṣyāṃśca sthalajāñjalajānharet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vyavasthitaḥ sa sarvatra sarveṣāmantarātmani \|*  
*yadā kalpātmakaścaiva dvitīyāṃ tanumāśritaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The strand, knot, creeper, jackal or crow, lions, Brahmanas, Devas, Siddhas, humans or the creatures, which are born in water or on earth, are usurped by him. Thus, he pervades in the bodies of all. When he patronizes his second digit, he is then known as the one possessing the digit.

## \|\| 1.144.19 \|\|

*niṣkalastu sadā jñeyaḥ saṃsthitastaijasīṃ kalām \|*  
*himaṃ gharmaṃ ca varṣaṃ ca trailokye kurute sadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. With his existence in his own digit, he is always known as without digit or complete. He moves evenly in cold, summer and the rainy seasons.

## \|\| 1.144.20 \|\|

*dvitīyā yā tanustasya akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ padam \|*  
*devayānaṃ tu panthānaṃ karmayogena saṃsthitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. His second digit is without destruction and is the form of Paramapada. The yogis achieves it moving by the divine way.

## \|\| 1.144.21 \|\|

*ādityasiddhāntaritāḥ sāṅkhyayogavidaśca ye \|*  
*te'bhigacchanti tatsthānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The followers of Aditya Siddhanta as well as the followers of the Samkhya philosophy, also achieve that place because it is said to be of the form of moksha.

## \|\| 1.144.22 \|\|

*nirdvandvo nirgamaścaiva tatra gatvā na śocati \|*  
*vedeṣu brahma vadanti dhyāyante tattvavedinaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Reaching there, the jivas are free from pleasures and pain besides hot and cold etc., because there is no fear of birth and death and worries. It has been described as Brahman in the Vedas. And the people well-versed in the tattvas describe it as dhyana.

## \|\| 1.144.23 \|\|

*akāraṃ tattvataścāpi dhyāyante puruṣottama \|*  
*tryakṣaraṃ ca tamoṃkāraṃ sārdhamātrātraye sthitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O Purushottama, Omkara is meditated upon with the knowledge of the tattvas. The word OM comprises of three letters and three and a half matras.

## \|\| 1.144.24 \|\|

*vadanti cārdhamātrasthaṃ makāraṃ vyañjanātmakam \|*  
*dhyāyanti ye makārīyaṃ jñānaṃ te hi sadātmakam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The consonant matra is said to have half a matra. One who meditates upon Makara, he actually meditates perpetuality.

## \|\| 1.144.25 \|\|

*makāro bhagavāndevo bhāskaraḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|*  
*makāradhyānayogācca magā hyete prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Because lord Bhaskara has been conceived to be the form of Makara. The people, who meditate on him, are known as Magas.

## \|\| 1.144.26 \|\|

*dhūpamālyairyutaścāpi upahāraistathaiva ca \|*  
*bhojayanti sahasrāṃśuṃ tena te bhojakāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Therefore, those who offer food to the Sungod with incense, flower garland and other presents, are known as Bhojakas.

## Chapter 145. Knowledge of Bhojakas

## \|\| 1.145.1 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*jñānopalabdhiṃ viprendra bhojakānāṃ mahāmune \|*  
*brūhi tattvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kautukaṃ paramaṃ mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vasudeva said — O best of Brahmanas, O great sage! How did Bhojakas attained divine knowledge? You kindly speak out the same in detail. O best of Brahmanas! I feel quite anxious to listen about the same.

## \|\| 1.145.2 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*imāṃ jñānopalabdhiṃ tu nibodha gadato mama \|*  
*asthisthūlaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam \|*  
*carmāvanaddhaṃ durgaṃdhipūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Vyasa said — I am now relating to you the attaining of the divine knowledge by the Bhojakas. You listen with attention. The body has thick bones and the tubular ducts in the body, the flesh and the skin, are all bound with the blood. It is filled with odour of refuse and urine.

## \|\| 1.145.3 \|\|

*jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam \|*  
*rajasvalamanityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsamimaṃ tyajet \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. It has the place for old age as well as grief. Therefore, it is the abode of disease, anxiety, filth, perishable and is the abode of a living being. Therefore, the body has to be discarded (one way or the other).

## \|\| 1.145.4-5 \|\|

*kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucailamasahāyatā \|*  
*samatā sarvabhūteṣu evaṃ muktasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tile tailaṃ gavi kṣīraṃ kāṣṭhe pāvakasantatiḥ \|*  
*upāyaṃ cintayedasya dhiyā dhīraḥ samāhitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. To make a vase out of the skull, to cat the fruits and flowers of the trees, to wear tattered clothes and not to demand help from anyone, are the symptoms of salvation. As the oil is lodged in the sesamum seeds, the milk in a cow and fire in the wood, but it remains invisible, similarly, in order to achieve the invisible supreme in the form of moksha, the people of nobility enter in Samadhi or meditation and always engage themselves making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.145.6-7 \|\|

*pramāthi ca prayatnena manaḥ saṃyamya cañcalam \|*  
*buddhīndriyāṇi saṃyamya śakunāniva pañjare \|\| 6 \|\|*

*indriyairniyatairdehī dhārābhiriva tṛpyate \|*  
*satatamamṛtasyaiva janārdana mahāmate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Initially, the instable mind should be put under control like a bird put in a cage. Similarly, the wisdom and the sense organs should be put well under control. O Janardana, O wise one! Thereafter, a person achieves success with the sense organs, which are put under control.

## \|\| 1.145.8-9 \|\|

*prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣāndhāraṇābhiśca1 kilbiṣam \|*  
*pratyāhāreṇa saṃsargāndhyānenānīśvarānguṇān \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhyāyamānasya dahyante cānte doṣā yathāgninā \|*  
*tathendriyakṛtā doṣā dahyante prāṇanigrahāt \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. All the blemishes are removed with the performing of pranayama, the sins by steadiness, obstructing the sense organs to move towards sins and by preventing oneself from leaning towards the worldly pleasures.

## \|\| 1.145.10 \|\|

*cittaṃ cittena saṃśodhya bhāvaṃ bhāvena śodhayet \|*  
*manastu manasā śodhyaṃ buddhiṃ buddhyā tu śodhayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The mind is purified with mind, the thoughts with thoughts and the wisdom with wisdom.

## \|\| 1.145.11 \|\|

*cittasyātiprasādena bhāti karma śubhāśubham \|*  
*śubhāśubhavinirmukto nirdvandvo niṣparigrahaḥ \|*  
*nirmamo nirahaṅkārastato yāti parāṃ gatim \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. With the complete purification of the mind, one become» conscious about the good and evil deed» Then, getting free from good or had deed», one becomes free from the pleasure or pain, discard the worldly things and becomes free from attraction, devoid of pride and then achieves the best stage.

## \|\| 1.145.12-14 \|\|

*parvāhṇe lohitaṃ rūpaṃ prathamamṛṅmamayaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*yajurmayaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu śvetaṃ mādhyāhnikaṃ smṛtam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sāyāhne sāmno rūpaṃ tu tatkṛtam \|*  
*prathamaṃ rājasaṃ deva dvitīyaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tṛtīyaṃ tāmasaṃ rūpaṃ traiguṇyaṃ tasya kalpitam \|*  
*trayāṇāṃ vyatirekeṇa caturthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. In the forenoon, the Sun is conceived of having the shining form of Rigveda; during noon it is believed to be white representing the Yajurveda and in the evening it is of black colour, representing the Samaveda. O Deva! The first one is Rajas, the second one is Sattvika and the third one is Tamas. Thus, the Sungod is said to be of three types. Another form separate from these three is the mandate form of Surya.

## \|\| 1.145.15 \|\|

*jyotiḥ prakāśakaṃ sūkṣmaṃ proktaṃ devanirañjanam \|*  
*caturthaṃ tu vedavidaḥ sūryasiddhāntavedinaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The Sun makes the flames to shine. He is subtle as well as without blemish. They said solar disc has been conceived by the learned people as the fourth form of Surya.

## \|\| 1.145.16 \|\|

*oṃkārapraṇavairyuktā dhyānanirbhūtakalmaṣāḥ \|*  
*sthitāḥ padmāsane vīrā nābhisaṃnyastapāṇayaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Combined with Pranava of the form of Omkara, by meditating in a sinless way in padmasana, one should place his hand at the navel.

## \|\| 1.145.17-19 \|\|

*suṣumnānāḍikāmārgaṃ kumbharecakapūrakaiḥ \|*  
*tribhiḥ saṃśodhya tānpañca maruto dehamadhyagān \|\| 17 \|\|*

*padāṅguṣṭhānvitaḥ svinnamūrdhvamutkṣepayetkramāt \|*  
*nābhideśe tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamagnimanāmayam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*somaṃ ca hadaye dṛṣṭvā mūrdhni vāgniśikhāṃ tataḥ \|*  
*vātaraśmibhirāsādya taṃ bhittvā maṇḍalaṃ param \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Thereafter, Kumbhaka, Rechaka and the Paraka exercises of Pranayama should be activated. Then purifying the Sushumna vein with Pranayama, he should raise up all the five winds upwards, making all the efforts. In the navel region, Agni is lodged, having no defeat. In the heart it is lodged as Soma, as Agnishikha in the head and one should have an audience with him. Thereafter, attracting the same with wind and rays, one should try to penetrate through the mandala.

## \|\| 1.145.20 \|\|

*tataḥ paraṃ tu yo gacchedyogasthaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam \|*  
*yatra gatvā na śocanti tatsauraṃ paramaṃ padam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Then, patronizing the yoga, one achieves the solar disc. Reaching there, he does not have to face any grief and he achieves the supreme solar position.

## \|\| 1.145.21-22 \|\|

*devārcanaṃ mahābāho kīrtitaḥ keśisūdana \|*  
*prathamaṃ hadayaṃ sthānaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāgnimāśritam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tṛtīyaṃ nābhisaṃsthaṃ ca caturthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O valorous one! Thus, I have spoken about the adoration of the Sungod. O destroyer of Keshi! For the adoration of the Sungod, the first spot is the heart, the second one is the fire, the third is the navel, while the fourth is the navel.

## \|\| 1.145.23 \|\|

*sthānaṃ paraṃ vai paramātmasaṃsthaṃ bhānoḥ sureśasya vadanti tajjñāḥ \|*  
*jñeyaḥ sa mokṣaśca nṛṇāṃ sa eva saṃsāravicchittikaraṃ padaṃ tataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The same supreme stage which is the abode of the supreme soul, is also known as the supreme position of lord Surya. It is the same stage which should be known by the people and which provides moksha. The same becomes the destroyer of the world for him.

## \|\| 1.145.24 \|\|

*idamamṛtasamaṃ parasya vedyaṃ kiraṇasahasramṛto hitaṃ janānām \|*  
*ṛṣicaritamavetya tattvasāraṃ vyapagatamohadhiyaḥ prayānti mokṣam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The same place is nectar like, which should be known by the others. He has a thousand rays and bestows benevolence on humans as well as his devotees. By patronizing the same, the Rishis achieve the moksha. Therefore, well understanding this tattva, with the removal of the delusion, a person achieves the moksha.

## \|\| 1.145.25 \|\|

*idaṃ magānāṃ caritaṃ mayā te prakhyāpitaṃ yānavareṇa yuktam \|*  
*jñātvātvimaṃ mokṣavido vadanti siddhāśca tatsthānamavāpnuvanti \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. I have narrated the story of the Magas. The people well-versed in knowledge call it moksha, which is achieved by mounting over the beautiful planes. The Siddhas also achieves the same position.

## \|\| 1.145.26 \|\|

*yanmayoktamidaṃ jñānaṃ deyaṃ śraddhāvatāṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*nāstikānāmabuddhīnāṃ na deyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. You should reveal the knowledge imported by me to the devoted people. The person desirous of riches should never import this knowledge to any other person who have no faith (in the Sungod).

## \|\| 1.145.27-28 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ityuktvā bhagavānvyāso bhojakajñānamuttamam \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ mahābāho jagāmāyatanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*khyāto yastriṣu lokeṣu gaṃgayā paritoṣitaḥ \|*  
*badaryā maṇḍito vīra naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Sumantu said — Thus, the sage Vyasa revealed the excellent knowledge about the Bhojakas to Narayana. Thereafter, he departed for the place well known as Badrikashrama.

## Chapter 146. Bhojakas described

## \|\| 1.146.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*ya ete bhojakāḥ proktā devadevasya pūjakāḥ \|*  
*nānyaṃ bhojyamathaiteṣāṃ brāhmaṇaiśca kadācana \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — Bhojakas — the devotees of the Sungod, about whom, you have enlightened us, should be invited by the Brahmanas for taking food and none else.

## \|\| 1.146.2 \|\|

*bhāskarasya priyā hyete pūjyatvaṃ ca tathā gatāḥ \|*  
*divyāścaite smṛtā viprā ādityāmbhaḥ samudbhavāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Because of their being favourite of the Sungod, they are respectable. These are the divine Brahmanas having been born out of the water of Aditya.

## \|\| 1.146.3 \|\|

*abhojyatvaṃ kathaṃ yātā bhojakāstadvadasva me \|*  
*kiṃ kurvāṇāstathā karma bhojyatāṃ yānti me vada \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Now, I intend to know as to when the Bhojakas become unfit for taking the food and by which means, the Bhojakas are fit to be served the food. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 1.146.4 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*imamarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo vāsudevo mahīpate \|*  
*kṛtavarmaṇā purā rājaṃstathā sāmbo mahābalaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Sumantu said — O lord of earth, in earlier times, the same question had also been asked by lord Vasudeva. Similar question was also put to Samba.

## \|\| 1.146.5-9 \|\|

*gatau sāmbapurīṃ vīra tathā nāradaparvatau \|*  
*bhuktavanto gṛhe sarve bhojakasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ādityakarmaṇo loke devānnakhyātimāgatāḥ \|*  
*tena te pūjitāḥ sarve bhaktyā bhojyairanekaśaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*āgatāste purīṃ vīra puṇyāṃ dvāravatīṃ vibhoḥ \|*  
*tāvṛṣī divamāruḍhau rājannāradaparvatau \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vāsudevaṃ mahātejā hārdikyo vākyamabravīt \|*  
*ya ete bhojakā vipra pūjakā bhāskarasya tu \|\| 8 \|\|*

*annameṣāṃ kathaṃ viprau bhuktavantau janārdana \|*  
*tāvṛṣī divyamākhyātau yau tau nāradaparvatau \|*  
*abhojyāḥ kila ete vai brāhmaṇānāṃ janārdana \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. Once Narada and Parvata both reached the city of Sambapuri, took food with the Bhojakas and other people. Because of their worshipping the Sungod, their food was known as the food of the gods. With the food served with utmost devotion, comprising of the several dishes, all the people were well fed. From there, the people reached Dvaravati. Both Narada and Parvata, staying in the sky, enquired of Vasudeva in sweet voice — “The Bhojaka Brahmanas worship the Sungod and therefore, how did the Brahmanas, Narada and Parvata, take food with the Bhojakas, inspite of their having been born in the races of Rishis?’ It is because, the food of Bhojakas should not to be taken by the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.146.10 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*na te bhojyā mahābāho bhojyā bhojāśca sarvadā \|*  
*abhivādyāṃ prayatnena yathādityo mahāmate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Vasudeva said — O valorous one, the Bhojakas alone are authorized for the religious rites and not the other Brahmanas. These people are fit to be honoured like the Sungod himself.

## \|\| 1.146.11-12 \|\|

*ācarantaśra tatkarma bhojyatvaṃ pravajanti te \|*  
*tacchrūyatāṃ yaduśreṣṭha yatkāryaṃ cāpi tairvibho \|*  
*yatamānairmahābāho tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vṛṣalī yasya vai bhāryā yaścāvyaṅgaṃ na dhārayet \|*  
*abhojyaḥ sa tu vijñeyo bhojako nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. They are known as Bhojyas because they perform all the rites relating to the Sungod. You listen carefully as to how they perform the related rites. A Shudra woman cannot be physically contacted, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.146.13-16 \|\|

*asnātaḥ pūjayedyastu tathābhyaṅgavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*ādityaṃ yaduśārdūla tathā ca vidhinā vibho \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sevako bhojako yastu śūdrānnaṃ yena bhujyate \|*  
*kṛṣiṃ ca kurute yastu devārcāmapi varjayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*jātakarmādayo yasya na saṃskārāḥ kṛtā vibho \|*  
*āruṇeyaiśca mantraiśca sāvitrīṃ na ca vai paṭhet \|*  
*tasya gehe dvijo bhuktvā kṛcchrapādena śudhyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*akṛtvā vidhivatpūjāṃ yastu bhuṅkte sa dharmahā \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. A person who without himself taking a bath performs the worship of Surya adequately wearing a girdle, one who gets the service of Bhojaka consumer of the food given by Shudras, a person who is engaged in farming (or a farmer), the one who has discarded the worship of gods or those for whom the essential religious rites have not been performed, one who recites Gayatri-mantra with the solar hymns, are the condemned persons. A person or a Brahmana who takes food with such persons, can be purified by observing the Kricchrapada fast. Without adoring the parents or pitris, Devas or the humans, worshiping the Sungod with proper means, the one who takes food is known as killer of dharma.

## \|\| 1.146.17 \|\|

*abhyaṅgena vihīno yaḥ śaṃkhahīnastathaiva ca \|*  
*śirasā dhārayetkeśānsa jñeyo bhojakādhamaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. One who is deprived of girdle or Shankha and the Bhojaka having grown hair over the head, is treated to be of the lowest grade.

## \|\| 1.146.18 \|\|

*devārcanaṃ tathā homaṃ snānaṃ tarpaṇameva ca \|*  
*dānaṃ brāhmaṇapūjāṃ ca kurvato bhojakasya tu \|*  
*abhyaṅgena vihīnasya sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The worship of gods, performing of homa, taking of bath, giving of charities and the worship of Sungod in case the girdle is not worn, all his efforts become infructuous.

## \|\| 1.146.19-22 \|\|

*sarvadevamayo hyeṣa sarvavedamayastathā \|*  
*abhyaṅgo yaduśārdūla pavitraḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhojakānāṃ yaduśreṣṭha tasya mūle sthito hariḥ \|*  
*madhye brahmā mahātejā agre gośrutibhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ṛgvedo yasya mūlastho madhye sāmāni kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*yajurvedastathā śreṣṭhaścātharvasahitaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*trayo'gnayastathā rājaṃstrayo lokāḥ sthitāḥ kramāt \|*  
*evameva pavitrastu abhyaṅgo bhojakasya tu \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. O lion of the Yadu race, since the girdle represents Surya as well all the gods, it is considered to be extremely auspicious-. O best of Yadu’s race! At the base of the girdle of the Bhojakas, Vishnu is lodged; Brahma in the middle, while Surya with kundalas in the ears in the form of rays, is lodged. The Rigveda is lodged at its root, Samaveda in the middle besides Yajurveda. Similarly, O king! All the three fires and all the three lokas are lodged in the same. Therefore, the girdle is considered to be quite auspicious for the Bhojakas.

## \|\| 1.146.23 \|\|

*yastvanena vihīnastu bhojako bhojakādhamaḥ \|*  
*abhojyaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ so'śucirnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A Bhojaka without the girdle is considered to be quite a degraded one. His food is not fit to be taken and should be treated to be impure. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.146.24-25 \|\|

*nirmālyamatha naivedyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ devahelinām \|*  
*ye prayacchanti śūdrāṇāṃ vikrīṇanti ca bhojakāḥ \|*  
*te'dhamā bhojakā jñeyā ye ca devasvahāriṇaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*na pūjayanti deveśaṃ devasvaṃ kṣapayanti ca \|*  
*na te deva priyāstāta vijñeyā bhojakādhamāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. The left overs of Surya, the food besides the kunkum, when given to the Shudras or when sold, they are considered to be the degraded ones, usurpers of the riches of gods. Those who do not worship the Sungod, they simply waste their time. They are not liked by the lord, and should be treated as the degraded Bhojakas.

## \|\| 1.146.26 \|\|

*yasminna bhukte naivedyaṃ bhojako'śnāti mānada \|*  
*tadannaṃ bhuṅjatastasya narakāya na śāntaye \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O praiseworthy one, in case a Bhojaka consumes the food without offering it to the Sungod, then he shall have no peace and shall Tall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.146.27 \|\|

*naivedyaṃ bhojayettasmādbhāskarasya naraḥ sadā \|*  
*prathamaṃ yaduśārdūla tacca dehaviśodhanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Therefore, first offering the food to the Sungod, then it should be taken by the devotee because by so doing, the body is purified.

## \|\| 1.146.28 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānāṃ puroḍāśo yathā kāyaviśodhanaḥ \|*  
*bhojakānāṃ tathā vīra naivedyaṃ kāyaśodhanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. As Purodasa has been prescribed to be taken by the Brahmanas for the purification of their hearts, similarly, the naivedya of Surya has been prescribed for purity of the Bhojakas.

## Chapter 147. The Bhojaka Brahmanas

## \|\| 1.147.1-2 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*atra pṛṣṭo yathā devo bhāskaro devapūjitaḥ \|*  
*aruṇena mahābāho ke priyā bhojakāstathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pūjāyāṃ tava ke yogyāḥ ke na yogyā bhavanti ca \|*  
*iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa bhagavānaruṇena divākaraḥ \|*  
*yaduvāca mahābāho tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Vasudeva said — O long armed one, Aruna asked the Sungod to tell him as to how the Bhojakas were his favourite, which one of them is suitable and which one of them is unsuitable for performing your worship? When so asked by Aruna, the reply given by the Sungod is being spoken by me. You listen to it attentively.

## \|\| 1.147.3-4 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca \|*  
*paradārānparadravyaṃ ye na hiṃsanti bhojakāḥ \|*  
*te priyā mama vai nityaṃ ye na niṃdanti daivatān \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣisevāṃ tu vedānāṃ nindanaṃ ca ye \|*  
*kurvanti bhojakā jñeyāḥ sarve te mama vairiṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Bhaskara said — The Bhojakas, who do not steal the wives and the riches of others or do not denounce the gods, are my favourites. The Bhojakas, who enter into business or trade and denounce the Vedas, are like my enemies.

## \|\| 1.147.5 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ bhāryāsaṅgrahaṇaṃ karṣaṇaṃ ye prakurvate \|*  
*nṛpasevāṃ khagaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ patitāstu te \|*  
*bhuñjate ye ca śūdrānnaṃ jñeyāste śatravo mama \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Those who have thousands of wives, who move in the sky or are engaged in farming, or the Bhojakas who serve the rulers, should be treated as the fallen ones. Those who consume the food of Shudras are like my enemies.

## \|\| 1.147.6 \|\|

*pūjā kṛtā tu yā taistu tathārghyaṃ ca khagottama \|*  
*pūjāṃ tāmatha cāpyarghyaṃ nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi khecara \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Whatever the food and other offerings are made by such Bhojakas, are not accepted by me.

## \|\| 1.147.7-8 \|\|

*ya ete kathitā vīra ye ca śaṅkhavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*nirmālyaṃ ye madīyaṃ tu naivedyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śūdrāya ye prayacchanti vikīrṇanti ca ye khaga \|*  
*yacchanti ye ca vaiśyāya bhojakā me na te priyāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. O valorous one, O best of the birds! Such people are without conches, give away my left over of kunkum to Shudras or sell the same to Vaishyas, such Bhojakas are not my favourites.

## \|\| 1.147.9-10 \|\|

*yajante ye ca sāvitrīṃ mahāśvetāṃ ca gopateḥ \|*  
*ye na jānanti me mudrāṃ kiṅkarāṇāṃ ca nāmataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ya ete1 kathitā vīra bhojakāste mayā khaga \|*  
*naite pūjayituṃ śaktā ye priyā mama bhojakāḥ \|*  
*tāñchṛṇuṣva khagaśreṣṭha bhūtvā caikāgramānasaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Those who worship Mahashveta of Surya, besides the one who does not make my mudra in the names of my attendants or is unaware of the same, such Bhojakas are not fit to worship me. O best of the birds! All such types of Bhojakas are unfit to perform puja for me. You now listen to my favourite Bhojakas, quite attentively.

## \|\| 1.147.11 \|\|

*devadvijamanuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi pūjakāḥ \|*  
*te priyā mama vai nityaṃ śaktāḥ pūjayituṃ ravim \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Such of the Bhojakas who adore the Devas, humans and Brahmanas, are always dear to me. They alone are fit enough to worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.147.12 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ muṇḍaṃ śiro nityaṃ ye cābhyaṅgasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*vādayanti ca ye śaṅkhaṃ divyāste bhojakā matāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Those whose heads are always shaven and are wearing the girdle, blow the conch, they are the good Bhojakas by my blessings.

## \|\| 1.147.13-15 \|\|

*trikālaṃ ye ca māṃ nityaṃ susnātāḥ krodhavarjitāḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti khagaśreṣṭha te priyā mama bhojakāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vāre madīye naktaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ye ca prakurvate \|*  
*saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu tathā saṅkramaṇe mama \|\| 14 \|\|*

*divyāste brāhmaṇā jñeyā bhojakā mama pūjakāḥ \|*  
*pūjayanti ca ye viprānmadbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*te priyāḥ satataṃ mahyaṃ bhojakā garuḍāgraja \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. O best of birds, the Bhojakas who take bath thrice a day, shedding away the anger who worship me on the first or the sixth moon day of the month, they are dear to me. Those who perform vrata at night and fast on the seventh moon day, such divine Bhojakas should be treated as quite closer to me, O Garuda bannered one, my devotees, having faith in me when adore the Brahmanas, they are always liked by me.

## \|\| 1.147.16 \|\|

*mayi bhaktiṃ na kurvanti brāhmaṇānpūjayanti no \|*  
*na te pūjyā na vandyāśca ye dviṣanti ca māṃ sadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Those of the Bhojakas who are not devoted to me or the Brahmanas, besides remain jealous with me always, they are unfit for performing puja and are not suitable enough to be offered salutation.

## \|\| 1.147.17-18 \|\|

*ye kurvanti mahāyajñānbhojakā garuḍāgraja \|*  
*pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ pūjārthaṃ santataṃ khaga \|\| 17 \|\|*

*priyāste satataṃ vīra bhojakānāṃ tathottamāḥ \|*  
*tasmātsarvaprayatnena pañcayajñānpravartayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. O elder brother of Garuda, such of the Bhojakas who arrange for enormous yajnas in favour of Pitris, Devas, as well as the humans, they are always my favourite. They are said to be the excellent Bhojakas. Therefore, from the start of all the five types of yajnas, one should make all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.147.19 \|\|

*ekabhaktena ye nityaṃ vartante kaśyapātmaja \|*  
*bhuñjate na ca ye rātrau bhojakāste priyā mama \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O son of Kashyapa, those Bhojakas who eat once in a day or those who do not eat during the night, are also dear to me.

## \|\| 1.147.20 \|\|

*mama vāre ca ye vīra tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca keśava \|*  
*na rātrau bhuñjate prājñā matpriyāste magāḥ khaga \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O valorous one, O Keshava, on my day or on the sixth moon day, the Maga who does not take food at night, is dear to me.

## \|\| 1.147.21 \|\|

*pratisaṃvatsaraṃ ye tu bhojakā garuḍāgraja \|*  
*na yacchanti piturmāturdivase tena me priyāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O elder brother of Garuda, the Bhojaka who during the days of the pitris, does not offer food to them, they are not liked by me.

## \|\| 1.147.22-25 \|\|

*itthaṃ bhūtā bhojakā yā māghamāse ca saptamī \|*  
*puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇi tathā raktaṃ ca candanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vācako brāhmaṇānāṃ tu naivedyaṃ modakāstathā \|*  
*ghṛtāhutyo guggulaśca kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ tathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*vādyānāṃ śaṅkhaśabdaśca nṛtyaṃ nāṭyaṃ mataṃ mama \|*  
*pañcavarṇā patākāstu śvetaṃ chatraṃ ca me priyam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*nānyavarṇaiḥ kṛtā pūjā tathā prīṇāti māṃ khaga \|*  
*yathā kṛtā bhojakena pūjā prīṇāti māṃ sadā \|*  
*nānyadevapratiṣṭhā tu kartavyā bhojakena tu \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. Such of the Bhojakas, who on the seventh moon day, offer oleander flowers, red sandal paste and listen recitations from the Brahmanas, and then offers eatables, sweet balls, offerings in ghi, incense of guggulu and payasam, sounds the musical instruments besides singing and dancing, fixes flags of five colours, they are dear to me since they also offer the white umbrella for me. I do not feel so happy with the puja performed by others dwellers of the sky as with the puja performed for me by the Bhojakas. Therefore, the Bhojakas should not meditate on other gods.

## \|\| 1.147.26 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*ityuktvā bhagavāndevaścāruṇāya purānagha \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ bhojakānāṃ tu tato merumathākramat \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Vasudeva said — O sinless one! The Sungod, while describing the characteristics of Bhojakas, reached the mountain.

## \|\| 1.147.27-28 \|\|

*evaṃ bhojyā bhojakāstu na cābhojyāḥ kadācana \|*  
*anuṣṭhānavihīnā ye na te bhojyāstu bhojakāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhaumāstu brāhmaṇā ye tu anuṣṭhānavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*te'pyabhojyā bhavantīha vikarmasthā viśeṣataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. Such types of Bhojakas should be considered fit for or suitable for the serving of food and they should never be deprived of the same. The food served without performing the religious rites should not be considered fit for consumption. A Brahmana living on earth, in case fails to perform the regular rites, he should not be considered suitable for the serving of the food. In case, he discarding his own religious rites, indulges in evil ways, then he should be discarded.

## \|\| 1.147.29 \|\|

*nāsti pūjyatamaṃ kiñcinmāṅgalyaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā \|*  
*caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ muktvā bhojakamuttamam \|*  
*pūjite bhojake vīra ādityaḥ pūjito bhavet \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. For all the four varnas or castes, no other auspicious deed is so purifying as compared to the serving of food to the Brahmanas. When a Bhojaka is served with food, the Sungod himself is considered to have been worshipped.

## \|\| 1.147.30-31 \|\|

*bhuñjate yasya vai gehe bhojakā yadunaṃdana \|*  
*tasya bhuṅkte svayaṃ bhānurbrahmā viṣṇustathā śivaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*yatheha sarvasattvānāṃ pradhānatve sthito raviḥ \|*  
*tatheha sarvabhūtānāṃ bhojakaḥ pūjya ucyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. O son of Yadu’s race, a house in which a Bhojaka is served with food, in that house Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva themselves arrive to take food. As the Sungod is the foremost of all other gods, similarly, Bhojakas are adorable by all.

## \|\| 1.147.32 \|\|

*tīrthānāṃ tu kurukṣetraṃ sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā \|*  
*tathā pūjyatamo jñeyaḥ pūjyānāṃ bhojako vibho \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. As Kurukshetra is the best of all the holy places and out of all the reservoirs the ocean is adorable, similarly, of the adorable people Bhojakas are most respectable.

## \|\| 1.147.33-34 \|\|

*viśeṣeṇa ca saurāṇāṃ bhojakaḥ pūjya ucyate \|*  
*bhartā pūjyo yayā strīṇāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ ca yathā guruḥ \|*  
*bhojakastu tathā pūjyaḥ saurāṇāṃ hṛdikātmaja \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yasya bhuṅkte bhojakastu gandhapuṣpādinārcitaḥ \|*  
*tasya bhuṅkte svayaṃ bhānuḥ pitaro devatāstathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Bhojakas are believed to be particularly the devotees of the Sungod. As the husbands are adorable for the wives and the preceptors for the disciples, similarly, Bhojakas are considered adorable by the devotees of the Sungod. A house in which a Bhojaka takes his food, getting worshipped with fragrant flowers, it amounts to the Sungod, Pitris and the gods having taken their food there.

## \|\| 1.147.35-38 \|\|

*evaṃ pūjyāstathā bhojyā bhojakā hṛdikātmaja \|*  
*ye saurā bhojakasyānnaṃ bhuñjate nirvikalpataḥ \|*  
*te sarve pāpanirmuktā yānti sūryasalokatām \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kathito yatra yo bhojyo yathā bhojyaḥ sa varjitaḥ \|*  
*atha kiṃ bahunoktena śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama \|\| 36 \|\|*

*nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā sarit \|*  
*aśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ nāsti putrasamaṃ sukham \|\| 37 \|\|*

*nāsti bhānusamo devo nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ \|*  
*yathaitāni samastāni uttamāni yadūttama \|*  
*tathottamo bhojakastu samprokto bhāskareṇa tu \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-38. O dear son, such types of Bhojakas are adorable and should be served with food and they delightfully take food with the people with solar faith. Getting relieved of all the sins, they proceed on to the place of Surya. Thus those who are to be served food and those who should be discarded in serving of the food, have been highlighted by me. What more could be spoken on the subject? You listen to me. The religious scriptures are beyond the Vedas, the rivers are equated with the mantras, and the noble deeds equate the merit of Ashvamedha sacrifice. The pleasure comparable with the getting of a son, a god comparable with the Sungod and the move beyond the mother cannot be found on the earth. O best of the race of Yadus, as has been spoken about all the best of things in the world, similarly, the Sungod has declared the Bhojakas as the best of all.

## Chapter 148. Description of Kala-cakra

## \|\| 1.148.1-2 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*adha sāmbo mahātejā dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ pituḥ kare \|*  
*jvālāmālākarālaṃ tu mahatā tejasānvitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*papraccha pitaraṃ sāmbo bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*kutastāta tvayā prāptaṃ cakramādityasannibham \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — Thereafter, the illustrious Samba, finding the resplendent disc in the hand of his father which was issuing scorching rays, with his mind having been filled with devotion and faith, said to him — “O excellent one, where from did you get this disc resembling the Sungod?

## \|\| 1.148.3 \|\|

*kimarthaṃ vahate deva divyamāyudhamuttamam \|*  
*etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ śrotukāmasya1 kautukāt \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Why do you carry this divine and excellent weapon with you? I am anxious to know about the same. You kindly enlighten me about the same.”

## \|\| 1.148.4-5 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*sādhusādhu2 mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭosmya'haṃ tvayā \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ putra cakrasya vidhinirṇayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu bhānumārādhya śraddhayā \|*  
*prāptaṃ cakraṃ mayā tasmādbhāskarāllokapūjitāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Vasudeva said — “O valorous one, you have put me an excellent question. O son, you attentively listen to the receiving of this cakra. I meditated on the Sungod for a hundred divine years after which this cakra was achieved by me from the Sun, who is adored by the universe.

## \|\| 1.148.6 \|\|

*nabhogaḥ pañcakārūḍhaḥ sthitaḥ sākṣāddivākaraḥ \|*  
*grahāḥ somādayo yasya saṃsthitā nābhimaṇḍale \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Lodged in the sky, when the cakra with five parts is visualised, it looks like Divakara himself. In its navel and the part in the intercourse of it, the planets are lodged including Soma and others.

## \|\| 1.148.7-8 \|\|

*ādityā dvādaśa samā areṣu kramaśastathā \|*  
*proktaṃ pathiṣu tattvāni pṛthivyādīni yāni vai \|\| 7 \|\|*

*etaistattvaiḥ parivyāptaṃ cakraṃ kālātmakaṃ param \|*  
*saṃkṣepātte mayākhyātaṃ dattaṃ cakramivāparam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Its twelve spokes represent the twelve Adityas, on its path the earth as well as the five tattvas are lodged. All the tattvas pervade in this cakra. These tattvas are the form of kala or the time. I have narrated about the cakra in brief (and by so doing), I have given you another cakra. You should take it like that.”

## \|\| 1.148.9 \|\|

*sāmba uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ kālamayaṃ deva cakraṃ kamalamucyate \|*  
*idaṃ tāvanmamācakṣva jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Samba said — O Deva, why is this lotus like cakra called as Kala-cakra. You please enlighten me on the issue. I would carefully like to understand this matter.

## \|\| 1.148.10 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*kamalaṃ hyṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ ṣaṭdalaṃ cākṣayāśritam \|*  
*puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ taddhi tatra sāṅgo raviḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Vasudeva said — The six seasons are lodged in the six petalled lotus. The flower is established in that form, which represents the Sungod in all respects.

## \|\| 1.148.11 \|\|

*yacca kālatrayaṃ loke tannābhitrayamucyate \|*  
*māsā arā mahābāho pakṣāśca pradhayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The three periods which are well known in the world, represent his three navels. The twelve months and the two fortnights of each month are said to be his daughters.

## \|\| 1.148.12-13 \|\|

*nemī caiva pare prokte ayane dakṣiṇottare \|*  
*pathinābhiṣu yoge ca yogākhyāstapanādibhiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva sadā cātra sthitāḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*etairvyāptamidaṃ cakraṃ sthūlasūkṣmaprabhedataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Both Uttarayana and Dakshinayana are the circumferences of the wheel. The planets and constellations are always lodged in the same. The same cakra present in them is subtle and gross forms.

## \|\| 1.148.14 \|\|

*atroddiṣṭeṣu kāleṣu ye noddiṣṭā mayā tava \|*  
*yugādikalpaparyantāste'pi cātra sthitāḥ kramāt \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Several types of periods included in it have not been spoken by me. All of them remain lodged in it from the start of the yuga to the end of the kalpa.

## \|\| 1.148.15 \|\|

*yatte kālātmakaṃ cakramidaṃ saṃkṣepato mayā \|*  
*kathitaṃ tadviniṣkrāntaṃ pradīptātsūryamaṇḍalāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. This is the cakra of kala which have been explained to you in brief, which emended out of the solar disc in flame.

## \|\| 1.148.16 \|\|

*asurāṇāṃ vadhāyedaṃ mayā labdhaṃ divākarāt \|*  
*ārādhya tapasā sūryaṃ purā kalpe jagadgurum \|*  
*ataḥ sampūjyayāmyenaṃ grahaistattvairvṛtaṃ sadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. I had got it from Divakara for the killing of the Rakshasas. In the first kalpa, I had performed the adoration of the Sungod who is the preceptor of the worlds, for the killing of the Rakshasas. I worship this cakra which is surrounded by the planets and the tattvas.

## \|\| 1.148.17 \|\|

*arkaṃ bhakto hi cakrasthaṃ yaḥ pūjayati bhaktimān \|*  
*tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ puṣpottarapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A devotee who worships the Sungod with cakra surrounded by the tattvas, then becoming illustrious like the Sungod, he achieves the city of Pushpottarapura.

## \|\| 1.148.18 \|\|

*tasmāttaṃ matkulānandaṃ mitraṃ sampūjayāmyaham \|*  
*grahaistattvairvṛtaṃ bhaktyā svamantraiḥ satataṃ vibhum \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Therefore, the Sungod, who is lodged in cakra, who has bestowed bliss for my race, who is surrounded by tattvas and planets, is being worshipped by me, reciting the mantras with devotion.

## \|\| 1.148.19-25 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ cakramālikhya ye yajanti divākaram \|*  
*raktacandanapūrṇena kuṃkumena sugaṃdhinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*piṣṭagandhādibhirvāpi raktavarṇakamiśrakaiḥ \|*  
*raktaiśca kamalaiḥ śuddhaiḥ karavīraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*anyairvā kusumairvanyaiḥ pratyagrairjantuvarjitaiḥ \|*  
*aparyuṣitaniśchidraiḥ śubhadhanyairdalairapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

*phalaiḥ pakvairoṣadhibhistathā dūrvāṅkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ \|*  
*dhūpaiśca vividhairgandhaistathā vastraiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca peyaiśca coṣyairlehyaiśca śaktitaḥ \|*  
*vitānaśobhāsikataiḥ palāśairupaśobhitaiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*chatracāmaraghaṇṭābhirbhūṣaṇairdarpaṇādibhiḥ \|*  
*nṛtyavāditragītaiśca vedaiḥ puṇyakathāsvanaiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sarvatra jayaghoṣaiśca sampūrṇe pūjayanti ye \|*  
*sampūrṇānvividhānkāmānnirvighnānprāpnuvanti te \|\| 25 \|\|*

19-25. During the seventh day of the moon, one should adore this cakra with red sandal paste and kunkum. Worshipping the cakra as well as the Sungod, and offering fragrant red flowers, red lotus flowers, fragrant oleander flowers, or the wild flowers, new shoots and petals, the ripe fruits, herbs, durva grass, kusha grass, several types of fragrant incenses, costumes, ornaments, eatables, beverages, besides tasteful, bitter, pungent, gives away in a white canopy decorated with branches and flowers of palasha tree, besides umbrella, flywhisks, bells, ornaments, mirrors, dancing and singing, reciting of the Vedic hymns, one who so adores the cakra, he has all his desires fulfilled without obstruction.

## \|\| 1.148.26 \|\|

*svacakraṃ cāpi nirvighnaṃ vṛddhimāyāti suvrata \|*  
*hanyate paracakraṃ ca yatredaṃ pūjyate sakṛt \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O Suvrata, besides the cakra also gets expanded. By adoring this cakra only once, a person can easily destroy other chakras.

## \|\| 1.148.27 \|\|

*saṅkrāntau grahaṇe cāpi likhitvā yo japedidam \|*  
*bhavanti niyatāḥ sāmba tasya sānugrahā grahāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O Samba! On the first day of the month, or during the time of eclipse, it should be adored in the form of a yantra, and when worshipped, all the planets become favourable for him.

## \|\| 1.148.28 \|\|

*sarvarogavihīnastu sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*ciraṃ jīvati dharmātmā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Getting relieved of all the ailments and the miseries, such a noble soul remains alive for a long time.

## \|\| 1.148.29-30 \|\|

*eṣa vai kathito vatsa cakrayogo mayā tava \|*  
*arkasya sarvayajñānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ siddhiprado bhṛśam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*puṇyo dharmastathā puṣṭyaḥ śatrughnaśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*śveto rakto'tha pītaśca kṛṣṇaścāpi vibhāgaśaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. O son, I have explained to you the details about this cakra. This is the best of all the yajnas of the Sungod and bestows all success, besides being auspicious, religious, bestows prosperity and particularly destroys the enemies. It comprises of red, yellow, white and black colours.

## Chapter 149. Initiation of Surya

## \|\| 1.149.1 \|\|

*sāmba uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ pramāṇaṃ likheccakraṃ tatra padmaṃ ca kiṃ bhavet \|*  
*nemipradhyāranābhīnāṃ vibhāgaḥ kriyate katham \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Samba said — What should be the size of the cakra? How would it be represented therein? What would be its circumference? What would be the size of its spokes and the navel? How could be division of the navel be made?

## \|\| 1.149.2-9 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ cakraṃ kṛtvā vṛttaṃ pramāṇataḥ \|*  
*aṣṭāṅgulā bhavennemiḥ seyaṃ vibhavataḥ sadā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nābhikṣetraṃ tathaiva syātpadmaṃ tattriguṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*arakṣetraṃ ca padmasya kaṇikākesarāṇi ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kesarasya ca pādena śeṣapatrāṇi kalpayet \|*  
*patrasandhiśca pādāṅgaṃ kramāttatrāpi bhidyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

*unnataṃ kamalaṃ tattu kuryānnābhyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ākīrṇāḥ saṃvibhaktāśca kartavyāḥ pradhayaḥ kramāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*aṅgulasthūlamūlaṃ syādarāgraṃ triguṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*bhūmiḥ pītā bahirjñeyā karṇikākesarāṇi ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sitaṃ nābhisthalaṃ tatra dvārāṇi parikalpayet \|*  
*hastamātraṃ bhavettasya tanmānaṃ dvārasannibham \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śeṣaṃ raktaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ saṃhatāḥ patrasandhayaḥ \|*  
*nābhinemyantare lekhāḥ sitāścāṅgulamānataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sitaraktasitābhiśca samantādupaśobhitam \|*  
*kapolaṃ dvārapadmaṃ ca dvārakoṇe prakalpayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

2-9. Vasudeva said — The circumference of the cakra would be of sixty four angulas and would be circular in shape. The nemi should of eight angulas. The place of the navel should be designed. The lotus is of three times of its size. Over the lotus petals, the region of spokes is to be made. Rest of the leaves should be made with saffron. The joints of the leaves and their parts should be separated. The lotus should then be raised with navel. The bondages should be arranged which should separately surround it from all the sides and remains lodged there. The solid part of the hollowed hands placed together is said to be the region of spokes, which is three times greater from the same. The saffron of the pericarp in its outspace is of yellow colour. The white lotus represents its navel and one should conceive a door there which when made should have a cubit’s height as well as the width. It looks like a door, rest of the joints should be made of red lotus. The line dividing the circumference and the navel should be of white colour and an angula in thickness. It should also be of white, red, black, lotus flowers, which beautify it from all the four sides. The lotus of the entrance should be lodged at the comer of the door.

## \|\| 1.149.10 \|\|

*caturdvāraṃ bhavedevamaindradvāraṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*aparāhṇe'tha pūrvāhṇe varuṇamāvāhayetsadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. There are four doors of similar type. A door for Indra should also be conceived. During the forenoon and afternoon, Varuna should always be invoked.

## \|\| 1.149.11-12 \|\|

*dvārāṇyetāni saṃvartya yathoktavidhinā yajet \|*  
*yathoktā devatāḥ sarvāḥ svamantraireva bhaktitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*cakramevaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ yajanārthaṃ mayā tava \|*  
*yajñenānena sambaddho dīkṣitaścārkamaṇḍale \|*  
*itthaṃ me bhānunā pūrvamidamuktaṃ varānana \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Thus conceiving the door, it should be worshipped appropriately. One should worship all the gods with devotion, who are lodged therein, reciting the mantras. I have thus explained the method for the worship of the cakra to be worshipped by you. With the processing of this yajna, your contact with the solar region has become permanent. You have been initiated (for the Sun worship) as well. This is how, I had been told by the Sungod earlier.

## \|\| 1.149.13 \|\|

*sāmba uvāca \|*  
*ke mantrāścakrayajñe'smindevatānāṃ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*yajñakramaśca kaḥ prokto rūpaṃ kiṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Samba said — What are the mantras to be recited in the yajna of cakra? What is the process of yajna and what are its different forms.

## \|\| 1.149.14-15 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*khaṣolkaṃ hadayādhyakṣaṃ pūrvokte kamale yajet \|*  
*karṇikāyāṃ daleṣvevamaṅgāni hṛdayādi ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*nāmamantrāścaturthyaṃtāsteṣāṃ pūrvoktakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*namaskāraśca sarvatra eṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Vasudeva said — The mantra related to the performing of the above process are — khasholka hridyadhyaksham and others. The petals are lodged in the lotus and pericarp, one should worship the heart and other limbs. Their names should be uttered in the fourth inflexional form according to the Sanskrit grammar. The same process is to be followed for the offering of salutation.

## \|\| 1.149.16-17 \|\|

*svāhāntā homakāle ca karmasvanyeṣu te punaḥ \|*  
*yathā karmāvasānāśca prayoktavyāḥ samāsataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*oṃ khaṣolkāya vidmahe divākarāya dhīmahi \|*  
*tannaḥ sūryaḥ pracodayāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Besides following the process, at the time of performing homa, one should also add the word svaha. In other rites, the word svaha should not be used. For the early completion of the rites, the names of all the deities should be combined together and the fourth grammatical form should be added at the end. The relevant mantra is — Om khasholkaya vidmahe divakaraya dhimahi tannah suryah pracodayat. This is the mantra.

## \|\| 1.149.18 \|\|

*sāvitrī ca mahābāho caturviṃśākṣarā matā \|*  
*sarvatattvamayī puṇyā brahmagotrārkavallabhā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O long armed one, Savitri (Gayatri) has twenty four letters, which represents all the tattvas, auspicious, belongs to Brahmagotra, besides being the beloved of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.149.19-20 \|\|

*evaṃ mantrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ sarvakarmasvataṃdritaiḥ \|*  
*anyathā viphalaṃ karma bhavediha paratra ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena mantrāñjñātvā vidhiṃ tathā \|*  
*yathāvatkarma tatkṛtvā sādhayedīpsitaṃ phalam \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Therefore, Gayatri should be invoked in all the religious rites, otherwise all the worldly and the activities relating to the other world, become useless. Therefore, making all the efforts and following the prescribed procedure, completing the appropriate rites, one should have his desire fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.149.21 \|\|

*sāmba uvāca \|*  
*ādityamaṇḍale dīkṣā kasya kāryā kathaṃ ca sā \|*  
*kadā kena kimarthaṃ ca kathayedaṃ mamākhilam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Samba said — Whose initiation should be made in the Surya-mandala? How should it be done? When should it be done? Who should do so? The purpose for which it should be done? You kindly enlighten me on all the aforesaid issues.

## \|\| 1.149.22 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ kulīnaṃ śūdrameva ca \|*  
*puruṣaṃ vā striyaṃ vāpi dīkṣayetsūryamaṇḍale \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Vasudeva said — In the Surya-mandala, the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras of high race can be initiated.

## \|\| 1.149.23 \|\|

*svayaṃ bhaktyopapannaśca praṇipatya guruṃ tathā \|*  
*gurustaṃ dīkṣayedvipraḥ kalpajñaḥ satyavākchuciḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The concerned person himself should go to the preceptor and offer salutation to him. The preceptor, who should be well-versed in kalpa, truthful and Auspicious, should bestow initiation to the said Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.149.24 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhyāmagniṃ samādhāya pūrvoktavidhinā kramāt \|*  
*sampūjyārkaṃ tathā vahnau hutvā vai haviṣā ravim \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The fire should be consecrated on the sixth moon day, the Sungod should be adored as per the procedures stated above. Thereafter, the ghi should be poured in the fire for the sake of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.149.25-27 \|\|

*śiṣyaṃ snātamathācāntaṃ khaṣolkākṛtivigraham \|*  
*svāṅgairālabhya cāṅgeṣu darbhavadbhistathākṣataiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ sampūjya cāṅgāni deyaḥ kāryo balistathā \|*  
*ādityo varuṇo'rko'gniḥ sādhito hṛdayena ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*bhaved ghṛtaguḍakṣīraistandulaiśca1 pramāṇataḥ \|*  
*tribhirañjalibhirhutvā devāyāgnau hutaṃ punaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. The disciple should be made to take his bath and perform sipping. Then, using the kusha grass, broken rice and the flowers, one should adore all the limbs and then the offerings should be made, mentally consecrating Aditya, Varuna and Surya in the form of fire. Then mixing ghi, sugarcane balls, payasam and rice, pour them in fire for the sake of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.149.28-29 \|\|

*dattvā śiṣṭāya muktvaivaṃ dattvānte dantadhāvanam \|*  
*kṣīraṃ vṛkṣodbhavaṃ tasmai dvādaśāṅgulasannibham \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dantaśliṣṭe'panīte ca tena prācyāṃ kṣipettataḥ \|*  
*dantadhāvanamāsyaṃ ca tadā tasyopari kṣipet \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. After thus performing, the rest should be released for the brushing of the teeth. The tooth brush stick should be of twelve angulas in length and should be made of a milky tree. After brushing the teeth, the tooth stick should be thrown towards the east. The tooth stick as well as the dirt from the mouth should be left at that very place.

## \|\| 1.149.30 \|\|

*maitrāvāruṇamīśānaṃ vakraṃ saumyasamāśritam \|*  
*praśastaṃ dantakāṣṭhasya mukhamanyatra ninditam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The face (cakra) of Maitravaruna, Ishana (north-east) and Saumya are the best. The face of the person who uses tooth stick is said to be praiseworthy and the faces which are otherwise, are not considered to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 1.149.31 \|\|

*yāṃ diśaṃ dantakāṣṭhasya mukhaṃ paśyati tatpatim \|*  
*arcayettena śāṃtiḥ syādityuktaṃ bhānunā svayam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The person using the tooth stick, to whichever side he casts his glance, the masters of that direction get adored. He achieves peace. This has been spoken by the Sungod himself.

## \|\| 1.149.32-34 \|\|

*punastadvacanaṃ śrutvā aṅgairālabhya ca kramāt \|*  
*sampūjya locane tatra sañciṃtya parijapya ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*kārayitvā ca saṅkalpaṃ tathā cendriyasaṃyamam \|*  
*sthāpayeta svayaṃ cāpi varaṃ śrutvā samāhitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ācamya kṛtarakṣastu kṛtadravyādhivāsanaḥ \|*  
*hadayena nametprātaḥ snātvā hutvā hutāśanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Thereafter, listening to the speech of the preceptor, he should touch his limbs. Then, worshipping the eyes and performing japam and samkalpa, controlling all his senses, he should go to sleep. Getting up early in the morning, he should do sipping of the mouth, taking care of his body, collect the material and take his bath. The homa should be performed. He should offer salutation concentrating on the heart.

## \|\| 1.149.35 \|\|

*svapnaṃ pṛcchedyathā dṛṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ saṃvādayecca tam \|*  
*hadayenāśubhe dṛṣṭe śatahomaṃ samācaret \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. When asked, he should repeat the auspicious dreams witnessed by him. In case of his witnessing an evil dream, he should perform homa with a hundred offerings.

## \|\| 1.149.36-41 \|\|

*svapne paśyati harmyāṇi devatānāṃ hutāśanam \|*  
*nadīyānāni ramyāṇi udyānopavanāni ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*patrapuṣpaphalāḍhyāni kamalāni ca rājatam \|*  
*sampaśyati yadi svapne brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rājānaṃ śauryasampannaṃ dhanāḍhyaṃ kṣatriyottamam \|*  
*śuśrūṣaṇaparaṃ śūdraṃ yadi tattvārthamādiśet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*praśastaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ caiva yathāsambhavato matam \|*  
*etaiḥ sparśanameteṣāṃ śreṣṭhamārohaṇaṃ tataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vāhanāni praśastāni prāsādaṃ nāvameva ca \|*  
*parvataṃ ca samāruhya vipulāṃ bhārgavīṃ bhajet \|\| 40 \|\|*

*pītvā surāṃ samudraṃ ca dadhyājyaṃ kṣīrameva ca \|*  
*somaṃ māṃsaṃ havirbhuktvā kāśyapīṃ labhate naraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

36-41. In case, one witnesses in dream house, fire, god, river boat, beautiful orchard having creepers, leaves, flowers, blossomed lotus flowers, or a learned person well-versed in the Vedas, a strong and valorous king who should be rich and of Kshatriya race or renders advice to the serving Shudras, beautiful speech, or touching such virtuous people or riding a vehicle, are considered to be praiseworthy. Similarly, witnessing a palace, a boat or climbing a mountain, drinking of wine, drinking of the ocean, curd, ghi, payasam, nectar, meat or the consuming of the havi when witnessed in the dream, one achieves the vast land.

## \|\| 1.149.42-43 \|\|

*labdhvā vastrāṇi ratnāni vividhābharaṇāni ca \|*  
*vāhanāni mahīṃ gāśca dhānyopakaraṇāni ca \|\| 42 \|\|*

*samṛddhimāpnuyātkiñcitsvapnānāṃ darśanaṃ śubham \|*  
*śubhakarmānugaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ śubhamucyate \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Besides with the witnessing of costumes, several types of gems and ornaments, several types of vehicles, the land, the cow and cereals, results in achieving of great prosperity. The witnessing of such dreams is quite auspicious. Then the dreams in which a person performs the noble deeds, are said to be the auspicious ones.

## \|\| 1.149.44-45 \|\|

*tasmādanyadaniṣṭaṃ syāttasmādyuktā pratikriyā \|*  
*kramādālikhya saptamyāṃ tatra sampūjya bhāskaram \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tarpayitvā dvijāñcchiṣṭānānamya pūrvavadgurum \|*  
*sṛṣṭikrameṇa bhṛtyarthaṃ muktyarthaṃ nānyathā bhavet \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. The dreams of the reverse type cause harm. Therefore, it is necessary to do something to negativate them. Thus, on the seventh moon day, the Sungod should be adored And the suitable Brahmanas should be fed with satisfaction. Then salutation should be offered to the preceptor. According to the sequence of the creation, he becomes unfit to perform the job of servant, nor could be fit for liberation.

## \|\| 1.149.46 \|\|

*divākaraṃ samālabhya puruṣo'tha yathākramam \|*  
*sarvagraheṣu tattveṣu yathāvattanniyojayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. For achieving the Sungod, a person should establish him among the planets and the tattvas.

## \|\| 1.149.47-50 \|\|

*viśuddheṣu viśuddhaṃ taṃ dhyātvā cādityavatkramāt \|*  
*niyojayetpṛthivyāśca tataḥ prabhṛti sarvaśaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ādityamaṇḍalaṃ śuddhaṃ sarvamuktaṃ niyojayet \|*  
*evaṃ tu manasā dhyātvā juhuyāccaiva taṃ śatam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*sarvairmantraiḥ kramādevaṃ dīkṣā proktā varāparā \|*  
*kṛtvaiva puṣpapātaṃ tu tasminnādityamaṇḍale \|\| 49 \|\|*

*baddhvāsyamañjalau puṣpaṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca mantritam \|*  
*kṣipedvai kulaśuddhyarthaṃ nāmārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. The Surya is most auspicious of all the auspicious beings and he should be established on earth. The Aditya-mandala has the auspicious form. So, it is to be established therein. Then with the mental devotion, a hundred offerings should be made. The method of initiating of Surya has been spoken by me. With the above type of the performing, one should drop everything over the Surya — mandala. Then closing his mouth with the hand cups (anjali) and holding the flowers therein, they should be sanctified with mantras and drop them uttering the names, for the purification of the race.

## \|\| 1.149.51 \|\|

*yatra tatpatitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya tatkulamādiśet \|*  
*nāma cādityasaṃyuktamityuktaṃ bhānunā svayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Wherever the auspicious material falls, he should direct the people of his race that their names are linked with the Sungod. This has been ordained by the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.149.52-54 \|\|

*sampūjya śrāvayettatra samayānarkabhāṣitān \|*  
*prātaḥ sāyaṃ madhyāhne raverabhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*upasthānaṃ sadā kuryādarcanaṃ ca sadā naraḥ \|*  
*adṛṣṭvārkaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ divā rātrau hutāśanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā bhoktavyamarkākhyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kadācana \|*  
*na ca padyā spṛśettadvannāsanaṃ parivarjayet \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. Worshipping him, according to the words of the Sungod, all should be informed that all should appear before the Sungod thrice a day in the morning, noon and evening, and worship him. Food should not be taken during the day without looking at the Sungod. He should not take food on Sundays. Similarly, the bed should also be discarded. So much so, that one should not touch it with the foot.

## \|\| 1.149.55-57 \|\|

*na laṅghyā pratimācchāyā na laṅghyāstithayaḥ kvacit \|*  
*nakṣatrāṇi grahā yogā māsā māsādhipāśca ye \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ayane ṛtavaḥ pakṣāstathaiva divasāni ca \|*  
*kālaḥ saṃvatsaraścāpi yaḥ kaścitkāla ucyate \|\| 56 \|\|*

*abhivandyaḥ sa sarvo'pi namasyaḥ pūjya eva ca \|*  
*tasmātkālādhipaḥ sūryaḥ svayaṃ kālaśca paṭhyate \|\| 57 \|\|*

55-57. The shade of the image should not be crossed. Similarly, the tithis should also not be crossed. This is prohibited. The constellations, planets, yogas, months, Ayanas, seasons, fortnights, day and time, year and the period are all adorable and salutation should be offered to them. Therefore, the Sungod, who is the lord of time, is adored in the same position.

## \|\| 1.149.58 \|\|

*jyotirgaṇasya sarvasya sthāvarāsthāvarasya ca \|*  
*cetanācetanasyāpi sarvātmā yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. All the stars, all the immovables and the movables, the conscious and the unconscious ones, have the Sungod as their soul.

## \|\| 1.149.59-61 \|\|

*stutyo vandyaḥ sadā pūjyastvayāyaṃ sarvathā nṛpa \|*  
*manasā karmaṇā vācā devanindāṃ parityajet \|\| 59 \|\|*

*preṣayitvā1 ca nirmālyaṃ tadaśvebhyo nivedayet \|*  
*prakṣālya hastau pādau ca namaskuryāddivākaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ityeṣā paramā dīkṣā tava saṃkṣepato mayā \|*  
*bhuktimuktikarī cāpi kathitā pravibhāgataḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. The Sungod is always praiseworthy, adorable, and is to be worshipped by you. Therefore, one should not denounce him mentally, by speech or by actions. His left overs should be given to the horses. Thereafter, washing the hands and the feet, one should offer salutation to the Sungod. I have narrated the details about the initiation of Surya which is quite useful and bestow liberation.

## Chapter 150. Aditya’s adoration

## \|\| 1.150.1 \|\|

*vāsudeva uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā pūjyo divākaraḥ \|*  
*sthaṇḍile yaduśārdūla nibodhaikāgramānasaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vasudeva said — O lion of the race of Yadus, how should the Sungod be worshipped on earth? I am going to speak out the same. You listen with attention.

## \|\| 1.150.2 \|\|

*maṇḍalairaṣṭabhiḥ kāryaṃ cakraṃ kālātmakaṃ śubham \|*  
*madhye padmākṛtaṃ cakramarairdvādaśabhiryutam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. An auspicious cakra of kalas should be made, with eight mandalas and a lotus in the centre. It should have twelve spokes and a shaft for the wheel. There should be spokes to link the shaft with the wheel.

## \|\| 1.150.3-5 \|\|

*tanmadhye kamalaṃ proktaṃ patrāṣṭakasamanvitam \|*  
*sarvātmā sakalo devaḥ khaṣolkaḥ kiraṇojjvalaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pūjanīyaḥ sadā madhye sahasrakiraṇāyudhaḥ \|*  
*praṇavena mahābāho caturbāhusamanvitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aruṇaṃ1 pūjayetprājñaḥ sadā devāgrajaṃ2 śubham \|*  
*dakṣiṇe pūjayeddevīṃ nikṣubhāṃ bhāskarasya tu \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. There should he eight petals in the middle of the wheel. In the centre of the same, the four armed Khasholka Surya, with thousand bright rays, who is the form of Omkara should be worshipped. The learned people should also worship Arupa, who is the foremost of all the learned people. To the right of the Sungod, the goddess Nikshubha should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.150.6 \|\|

*revataṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve uttare piṅgalaṃ sadā \|*  
*saṃjñāṃ ca yaduśārdūla śreyase satataṃ budhaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O lion of Yadus, in the south back side should be Raivata, and on the north backside should stands Pingala. The learned people should, for their own welfare, also worship the goddess Samjna.

## \|\| 1.150.7-8 \|\|

*āgneyyāṃ lekhakaṃ vīra nairṛtyāmaśvinau tathā \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ pūjayeddevaṃ manuṃ vaivasvataṃ vibhum \|\| 7 \|\|*

*aiśānyāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ yamunāṃ lokapāvanīm \|*  
*dvitīyāvaraṇe vīra pūrvataḥ pūjayedviyat \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. In the south-east side should stand the writer, on the Nairitya side should stand the Ashvinikumaras, in the north-west side should stand Vaivasvata Manu and in the north-east side the river Yamuna should be lodged, who purifies the world. In the second apartment, the worship should start from the east.

## \|\| 1.150.9-10 \|\|

*dakṣiṇe ca tato devīṃ paścime garuḍaṃ tathā \|*  
*uttare nāgarājānaṃ putramairāvataṃ śubham \|\| 9 \|\|*

*āgneyyāṃ pūjayeddheliṃ praheliṃ nairṛte tathā \|*  
*vāyavyāmurvaśīṃ devīmīśāne vinatāṃ tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The goddess should be in the south, Garuda should be in the west, the son of serpent Shesha should be in the north and Airavata in the south-east side should be the Sungod (heli). In the south-west side, there should be Praheli, in the north-west there should be Urvashi, while Vinata — the mother of Garuda, should be lodged on the north-east side.

## \|\| 1.150.11-12 \|\|

*tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūrve pūjayedgurumādarāt \|*  
*paścime tvarkaputraṃ tu uttare dhiṣaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*aiśāne śaśiputraṃ tu somamāgneyamaṇḍale \|*  
*pūjayeddakṣiṇe koṇe nairṛte rāhumādarāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. In the third apartment, the preceptor should be worshipped with reverence. In the western side, there should be the son of Surya, Brihaspati should be in the north, Buddha — the son of Moon, should be on the north-east. In the south-east, there should be Moon. Rahu should be lodged in the south-east and Ketu should be in the north-east. This has been prescribed by the people with wisdom.

## \|\| 1.150.13-20 \|\|

*vāyavye vikacaṃ vīra pūjayetsatataṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*caturthāvaraṇe devaṃ pūjayellekhamādarāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

*āgneye śāṇḍilīputraṃ dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇādhipam \|*  
*virūpākṣaṃ nairṛte devaṃ jaleśaṃ paścime tathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vāyuputraṃ ca vāyavyāṃ satataṃ pūjayennaraḥ \|*  
*īśāne devamīśānaṃ pūjayetsatataṃ budhaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*uttare yakṣarājānāṃ kuberaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*pañcame pūjayedvīra sadā svāvaraṇe dvijāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*pūrvataḥ paramāṃ devīṃ mahāśvetāṃ mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*śriyamṛddhiṃ vibhūtiṃ ca dhṛtiṃ caivonnatiṃ tathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pṛthivīṃ yaduśārdūla mahākīrtiṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*indraṃ viṣṇuṃ cāryamaṇaṃ bhagaṃ parjanyameva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vivasvantaṃ tathārkaṃ ca tvaṣṭāraṃ kiraṇojjvalam \|*  
*pūjayedvaruṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhe caivametāndivākarān \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śiro netre tathā varma astraṃ ca yadusattama \|*  
*aruṇaṃ sarathaṃ vīra saptame pūjayedbudhaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

13-20. In the fourth cabin should be lodged Vishvakarma — the divine architect. In the south-east side, Agni — the son of Shandilya should be lodged. In the southern side, Yama — the lord of Dakshini should be lodged. Virupaksha should be placed on the south-west, while Jalesha should be placed in the west. The son of the wind god should be placed in the north-west side, while Shiva should be placed in the north-east side. Kubera — the lord of Yakshas is worshipped by the learned people in the north. In the fifth chamber, the Brahmanas should worship the gods of their own liking. The learned ones should establish the goddess Mahashveta, Shri, Riddhi, Vibhuti, Dhriti, Unnati and Earth. O lion of Yadu’s race, Mahakirti, Indra, Vishnu, Aryama, Bhaga, Parjanya, Vivasvan, Surya with bright rays and Varuna should be worshipped. In the sixth chamber, other gods of the form of the Sungod should be worshipped. Thereafter, the devotee should adore the head, eye, kavacha, weapons, besides the people of learnings. In the seventh chamber, Aruna should be adored.

## \|\| 1.150.21-24 \|\|

*tathāśvānyaduśārdūla sadā cāvaraṇe budhaḥ \|*  
*yakṣarakṣāṃsi gandharvānmāsānpakṣānahāni tu \|\| 21 \|\|*

*saṃvatsaraṃ tathā putra hyetānsaṃpūjayetpurā \|*  
*ya evaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ bhāskaraṃ satataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati \|\| 22 \|\|*

*mūlamantrākṣarāṇīha cāṅgāni paricakṣate \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu pūjayetsatataṃ ravim \|\| 23 \|\|*

*nityamubhayasaptamyāṃ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam \|*  
*ityuktvā bhagavāndevo jagāmāśu gṛhaṃ raviḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. O lion of Yadus race, the learned people should also worship the horses in a chamber, besides the sons, Yakshas, Gandharvas, days, months and years should be worshipped first of all. A person who regularly worships the Sungod, he achieves the place reaching where he does not have to face any grief. The basic mantra is Om Khasholkaya namah. The rites of anganyasa should be performed with this mantra. A person, who following this process, worships the Sungod on both the seventh moon days in a month, he achieves the supreme position. Thus speaking, the Sungod atonce proceeded to his abode.

## Chapter 151. Description of Solar dharma

## \|\| 1.151.1-2 \|\|

*sūta uvāca \|*  
*atha rājā mahātejāḥ śatānīko dvijottamam \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā bhaktyā sumantuṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*aho devasya māhātmyaṃ bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ \|*  
*kīrtitaṃ bhavatā mahyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Suta said — Thereafter, the illustrious king Shatanika, lowering his own head, offered his salutation to Sumantu — the excellent Brahmana and said to him — “The Sungod with enormous resplendence has enormous glory, which is destroyer of all the sins, which has been revealed to me by you. This is the matter of great rejoicing.

## \|\| 1.151.3 \|\|

*tasmānnārkasamaṃ devaṃ loke paśyāmi suvrata \|*  
*na cāpyasya sthitā vipra gatirlokeṣu vidyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O Suvrata, therefore, I do not find any deity comparable with the Sungod. O Brahmana, his influence is not seen on the people.

## \|\| 1.151.4 \|\|

*pravartate jagadvipra sargakāle divākarāt \|*  
*sthitau pālayate cāpi kalpānte saṃharetpunaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. During the time of creation, the universe emerges out of the Sungod and is lodged in the same, who maintains the universe and finally destroys the same.

## \|\| 1.151.5-7 \|\|

*śrutvaivaṃ devamāhātmyaṃ bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ \|*  
*kīrtitaṃ bhavatā mahyamaśvamedhaśatādvaram \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kiṃ tu me saṃśayo brahmansumahānhṛdi vartate \|*  
*kenopāyena viprendra mucyate sambhavārṇavāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

*divākaraprasādādvai suprasannādvṛṣadhvajāt \|*  
*kathaṃ tuṣyetsadā devo dharmeṇa katareṇa tu \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Thus, the Sungod is with enormous resplendence, the glory of whom has been spoken out by you, and which has been listened by me without attention. This is said to be more meritorious than the merit of performing a hundred Ashvamedha sacrifices. By listening to it, I have developed a great doubt in any heart, as to how to save oneself from the cycle of the birth and death? In case, with the pleasure of the Sungod, the deliverance could be possible and in order to please whom the flag of dharma has been bestowed to the people, then with the performing of which one of the dharma is the Sungod pleased?

## \|\| 1.151.8-12 \|\|

*śrutā me bahavo dharmāḥ śrutismṛtyuditāstathā \|*  
*vaiṣṇavāḥ śaivadharmāśca tathā paurāṇikāḥ śrutāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śrotukāmo hyahaṃ vipra sauraṃ dharmamanaupamam \|*  
*bhagavansarvadhanyāste sauradharmaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*brūhi me devadevasya bhānordharmamanaupamam \|*  
*śṛṇvato nāsti me tṛptiramṛtasyaivameva ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*aśvamedhādayo yajñā bahusambhāravistarāḥ \|*  
*na śakyāste yataḥ kartumalpavittadvijātibhiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sukhopāyamato brūhi dharmakāmārthasādhakam \|*  
*hitāya sarvamartyānāṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. I have heard about several Vaishnava, Shaiva and Pauranic dharmas as defined in the Shrutis and Smritis. Now I am desirous of listening to the solar dharma. O lord, graceful are the people who are devoted to the solar dharma. Now you tell me about the gracious solar dharma. I shall feel satisfied by listening to the same. For the performing of the Ashvamedha sacrifice, enormous arrangements have to be made. Therefore, the Brahmanas of limited means cannot perform it. Therefore, with the intention of performing dharma, artha and kama, tell us some means by which goal could be achieved with ease. You kindly tell us the same, which should be beneficial for all and removes grave sins as well.

## \|\| 1.151.13 \|\|

*sauradharmaparaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*śrutvā tu vacanaṃ rājño vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā vyāsamidaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. To my mind, the solar dharma is the best, auspicious and remover of sins.” Thus listening to the words of the king, Sumantu — the disciple of Vyasa, offered his salutation to the sage Vyasa and said.

## \|\| 1.151.14-16 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi sukhopāyaṃ mahāphalam \|*  
*paramaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sarvadharmamanaupamam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*raviṇā kathitaṃ pūrvamaruṇasya viśāṃpate \|*  
*kṛṣṇasya brahmaṇo vīra śaṅkarasya na vidyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmayam \|*  
*sauradharmatamaḥ śrīmānhitāya jagatoditaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Sumantu said — You please listen. I am speaking about the dharma which could be followed with comfort, is best of all the dharmas, besides being incomparable and peerless. It was in earlier times told by Surya himself to Arana. The activity of the dharmas of Krishna, Brahma and Shiva, cannot be equated with the same. Because in order to redeem the people drowning in the ocean of the universe, the Saura dharma emerged on earth.

## \|\| 1.151.17 \|\|

*yairayaṃ śāntahṛdayaiḥ sūryabhaktairbhagārthibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃsevyate paro dharmaste saurā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person, who, with a peaceful mind, getting devoted to the Sungod, he is called the Saura or the devotee of the Sungod. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.151.18 \|\|

*ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityameva ca \|*  
*ye smaranti raviṃ bhaktyā sakṛdevāpi bhārata \|*  
*sarvapāpairvimucyante saptajanmakṛtairapi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O Bharata, a person, who once, twice or thrice a day with utmost devotion, adores the Sungod only, he is relieved of the sins of his past seven births.

## \|\| 1.151.19 \|\|

*stuvanti ye sadā bhānuṃ na te prakṛtimānuṣāḥ \|*  
*svargalokātparibhraṣṭāste jñeyā bhāskarā bhuvi \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A person who always adores the Sungod, he should not be treated as an ordinary person born on earth, but should be considered as a form of Bhaskara, having fallen from the heaven.

## \|\| 1.151.20 \|\|

*nānarkaḥ smarate'rkaṃ vai nānarko'rkaṃ samarcayet \|*  
*nānarkaḥ kīrtayedarkaṃ nānarko'rkamavāpnuyāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Without becoming close to the Sungod, his devotion, worship, kirtana (singing) should not be resorted to. Because in such conditions, he cannot achieve the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.151.21 \|\|

*sauradharmasya sāro'yaṃ sūryabhaktiḥ suniścalā \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāṅgā ca sā proktā raviṇeha divaukasām \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The gist of the dharma is that the devotion of Surya should be quite firm, with sixteen s parts. This has been revealed by Surya himself to the gods.

## \|\| 1.151.22-23 \|\|

*prātaḥ snānaṃ japo homastathā devārcanaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*dvijānāṃ pūjanaṃ bhaktyā pūjā gośvatthayostathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*itihāsapurāṇebhyo bhaktiśraddhāpuraskṛtam \|*  
*śravaṇaṃ rājaśārdūla vedābhyāsastathaiva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. After taking bath in the early morning, one should perform japam and homa. Thereafter, the worship of the Sungod should be done. Thereafter, the mango and the holy fig tree should be worshipped. Thereafter, the devotee should listen to the ancient lores, as well as the Puranas with devotion in a faithful manner. O lion king, similarly, the recitation of the Vedas has also been prescribed.

## \|\| 1.151.24 \|\|

*madbhaktyā janavātsalyaṃ pūjāyāṃ cānumodanam \|*  
*svayamabhyarcayedbhaktyā mamāgre vācakaṃ param \|\| 24 \|\|*
