24\. By worshipping me, a sense of mutual love exists with the support of puja, while the reciter should recite the scriptures before me. The reciter should be worshipped with devotion.

## \|\| 1.151.25 \|\|

*pustakasya sadā śreṣṭha mamātīva priyaṃ surāḥ \|*  
*matkathāśravaṇaṃ nityaṃ svaranetrāṅgavikriyā \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. While worshipping the excellent book, the gods should also be worshiped, because the gods are also quite dear to me. Listening to my divine stories, at times, one may suffer from ailments of voice, eyes and throat. In the context of compassion, the voice is to be choked, tears could appear in the eyes or such other emotions could appear.

## \|\| 1.151.26-27 \|\|

*mamānusmaraṇaṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā śraddhāpuraskṛtam \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāḍgā bhaktiriyaṃ yasminmlecche'pi vartate \|*  
*viprendraḥ sa muniḥ śrīmānsajātyaḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*na me pṛthakcaturvedā madbhaktaḥ śvapaco'pi yaḥ \|*  
*tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hyaham \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Therefore, daily recitation of my name with devotion and faith has been prescribed. There is said to be the devotion of the sixteen types. Even when a person of a degraded caste follows it, he becomes a Brahmana sage, respectable, foremost of the caste, besides being a learned person. The four Vedas are not separate from me. Therefore, even if my devotee is of the lowest caste or a Chandala, even then he should be allowed to learn the Vedas, because he should be acceptable like me besides being respectable.

## \|\| 1.151.28 \|\|

*patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati \|*  
*tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A person, who offers with devotion, leaves, flowers, fruits as well as water for them, I never get destroyed, nor do they get destroyed after getting me.

## \|\| 1.151.29 \|\|

*yo māṃ sarvagataṃ paśyetsarvaṃ ca mayi saṃsthitam \|*  
*tasyāhamāsthito nityaṃ sa ca nityaṃ mayi sthitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. One who considers me all pervading besides visualizes the entire universe in me, for him, my faith remains in him, while he is always lodged in me always.

## \|\| 1.151.30-32 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśārdhakakṣāyāḥ paraṃ cāṣṭabhirudbhavaiḥ \|*  
*rodhayitvā mahābāho tathā jñānatareṇa tu \|\| 30 \|\|*

*durgapālaṃ vijityāśu bhāskarārdhaṃ tu durjayam \|*  
*jitvā ca purarājānāṃ mahātejamanaupamam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*manasācalayā bhaktyā yo māṃ dhyāyati mānavaḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ tameva ciṃtāmi ātmavatsatataṃ naram \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. Obstructing all the nine doors of a fort, overcoming the guard of the fort, as the king of the city becomes victorious, similarly, with one’s knowledge, establishing one’s superiority with the high knowledge possessed by a person, with a firm mind establishes his superiority over Bhaskara and gets devoted to me with firm faith, I always think about him like my own son.

## Chapter 152. The Solar dharma

## \|\| 1.152.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*sūre ca durlabhā bhaktirdurlabhaṃ surapūjanam \|*  
*sūrāya durlabhaṃ dānaṃ sūrahomaśca durlabhaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — The devotion of the Sungod is difficult to be achieved. His worship is difficulty homa and japam too are difficult to be performed.

## \|\| 1.152.2-5 \|\|

*sudurlabhaṃ raverjñānaṃ tadabhyāso'pi durlabha \|*  
*sudurlabhataraṃ jñeyaṃ khaṣolkajñānamuttamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sudurlabhataraṃ jñānaṃ sadā vai bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*pradakṣiṇāṃ cakraturvai pādau bhaktyā'rkamandire \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tau karau ślāghyatāṃ prāptau yau pūjāṃ cakratū raveḥ \|*  
*saivaikā rasanā dhanyā stotraṃ yā kurute raveḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tanmanaḥ puṇyatāṃ prāptaṃ yaddhitvā viṣayaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*niścalā ca raverlīlā nirbhīkā krodhavarjitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. The divine knowledge is also difficult to achieve, besides making use of the same is beyond the reach of the people. As the knowledge of Khasholka is difficult to get, similar is the case with the knowledge of the Sungod. The feet with which a person goes round the temple of the Sungod and the hand with which one perform worship of the Sungod, are said to be praiseworthy. Graceful is the tongue using which a person recites the stotras of the Sungod. The mind which had discarded the worldly pleasure and anger, becoming fearless, has patronized the devotion of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.152.6-18 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*sūryārcanavidhiṃ kurvañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|*  
*tvatprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha kautūhalamatīva me \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yatpuṇyaṃ sthāpite sūrye kṛte sūryālaye ca yat \|*  
*sammārjane ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyamupalepane \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sthāne kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ tathā nīrājane kṛte \|*  
*nīlauṣadhipravāpena nṛtyamaṅgalavāditaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*arghyadānena yatpuṇyaṃ toyasnānena yadbhavet \|*  
*pañcāmṛtamayasnāne dadhisnāne ca yatphalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*cakrābhyaṅge ca yatproktaṃ vajrasnāne ca yatphalam \|*  
*madhusnāne payaḥsnāne snāna ikṣurasasya tu \|\| 10 \|\|*

*udvartanaṃ śucisthāne kuśapuṣpodakena tu \|*  
*suvarṇaratnatoyaiśca gandhacandanavāribhiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*karpūrāgurutoyena svacchato yena yatphalam \|*  
*vilepanaiśca gandhāḍhyairvilepanaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tālapatrapradāne tu pradāne cāmarasya tu \|*  
*raktapuṣpārcane yacca dāmabhiḥ pūjanena ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sumānāṃ maṇḍape yacca puṣpamālāvalambanāt \|*  
*pūjābhaktiviśeṣaiśca gṛhamālāvalambane \|\| 14 \|\|*

*puṣpadānaviśeṣeṇa dhūpadīpaiśca yatphalam \|*  
*vastrālaṅkāradāne tu puṇyaśravaṇakīrtane \|\| 15 \|\|*

*brahmaśravasya dāne tu avyaṅgasya ca gopate \|*  
*magānāṃ matprasādena abhivādanapūjane \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vyomapūjāphalaṃ yacca aruṇasya ca pūjanam \|*  
*tathānyadapi yatproktamajñānādbrāhmaṇottama \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tatsarvaṃ brūhi me brahmanbhaktānāmanukampayā \|\| 18 \|\|*

6-18. Shatannika said — O best of the Brahmanas, in case you are pleased with me, then you speak out to me the secret process of the Sun worship, which I intend to listen and for which I am anxious to know. The method of consecrating of the image of the Sungod, the method of building a temple for the Sungod, the dusting and cleaning of the Sun temple, plastering of the cowdung in it, the space for the consecrating of the Sungod, performing of the arati in the temple, besides plastering of the blue colour and planting of the herbs in the Sun temple, the dancing before the image of the Sungod, besides the playing of the auspicious musical instruments in the Sun temple, offering of arghya or bathing of the image of the Sun with water, one earns the merits. The extent of the merit achieved by a person for each one of the above performances, together with Panchamrita bath, bathing with curd, adoring of cakra, vajrasnana, bathing with honey, milk, sugarcane juice, sprinkling of water with kusha at an auspicious place, offering of the water of gems and diamonds, the fragrant water mixed with sandal paste, offering from of tala tree besides the flywhisk, one achieves merits which is equivalent to the merits one earns by doing all these activities. You kindly enlighten me on all the matter. You also tell me the merit one earns by offering the red flowers and worshipping the Sungod offering riches, hanging of the beautiful flowers garlands in the mandapa as well as the temple with devotion, offering of flowers, incense lamps, costumes, ornaments, besides listening of the holy scriptures. What is the merit earned by offering a girdle to the Sungod, besides honouring the Magas, adoring Vyoma and Varuna? O best of Brahmanas, something which I have been unable to speak out, including the same, you kindly speak out to me the merits of all the above activities in a Sun temple which could be achieved by a person. You kindly tell me.

## Chapter 153. The lustre of the Sun

## \|\| 1.153.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*sumatiśca raverbhaktaḥ pāṇḍaveya mahāmate \|*  
*ataste nikhilaṃ vacmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O Intelligent one, you possess an excellent wisdom. You are a devotee of the Sungod. Therefore, I shall explain to you all in detail whatever has been asked by you. You please listen attentively.

## \|\| 1.153.2 \|\|

*kalpādau sṛjato vīra brahmaṇo vividhāḥ prajāḥ \|*  
*ahaṃkāro mahānāsīnnāsti loke maduttamaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. At the start of kalpa, while creating several types of living beings, Brahma developed pride in his heart that there was nothing comparable to him in the world.

## \|\| 1.153.3 \|\|

*tathā pālayato vīra keśavasya dharāpate \|*  
*tathā saṃharato jajñe'haṅkārastryambakasya ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O lord of Earth! Similarly, Vishnu while maintaining the world and lord Shiva while destroying it, also developed pride.

## \|\| 1.153.4 \|\|

*ciṃtayantotha te devāḥ keśavaśca narādhipa \|*  
*mithaste spardhayā yuktāḥ parasparavirodhinaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Getting intoxicated with pride, all the three gods became envious of one another.

## \|\| 1.153.5 \|\|

*vivādastu mahānāsītkañjāmbunagaukasām \|*  
*parasparaṃ mahābāho manasāśritya kevalam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. All of them feeling pride in their hearts, Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva quarreled among themselves.

## \|\| 1.153.6-9 \|\|

*ahaṃ kartā vikartā'haṃ pālako'haṃ jagatprabhuḥ \|*  
*ityāha bhagavānbrahmā kṛṣṇabhīmau samarcitau \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tathaitya śaṃkaraḥ kruddhaḥ kaḥ śakto madṛte bhuvi \|*  
*saṃhartuṃ jagadetaddhi sraṣṭuṃ pālayituṃ tathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇo'pyevameva manāk krodhasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*na vā śakto jagatsraṣṭuṃ saṃhartuṃ rakṣituṃ tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*evaṃ teṣāṃ pravadatāṃ kruddhānāṃ ca parasparam \|*  
*samāviśattadā'jñānaṃ tamo mohātmakaṃ vibho \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. At the time of the controversy, Brahma claimed to be the creator, preserver as well as the destroyer of the world. Lord Shiva said in anger — “Who in the world, except myself be competent enough to destroy the world except myself?” Narayana also, at the same time, getting enraged declared — “There is cone on earth to create, maintain or destroy the world except myself.” When all the three of them were so quarrelling, the confusion of darkness entered their body, destroying their wisdom at the same time. Having been overpowered with delusion, they could not visualise one another, nor could they know anything.

## \|\| 1.153.10-12 \|\|

*tena krāntadhiyaḥ sarve na paśyanti parasparam \|*  
*atyarthaṃ mohamāpannā na jānantīha kiñcana \|\| 10 \|\|*

*apaśyanto mithaste tu niṣaṇṇāḥ kṣmātale vibho \|*  
*āramanti hi ye cānye te divākaramāsthitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tamasā mohitāḥ sarve nidrāvatkrāntacetasaḥ \|*  
*manāgjñānena cākrāntāḥ kiṃ kuryāmeti mohitāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. In the total darkness, being unable to see one another, they squatted on the ground and started thinking — “How the other people taking refuge in the Sungod, are living happy lives, while all of us having been overpowered with delusion, feel like the sleepy persons. Only a very little knowledge is left with us and what should be done with the same and what not?”

## \|\| 1.153.13-14 \|\|

*atha bhūtādhipo devo gośrutābharaṇojjvalaḥ \|*  
*candrārdhakṛtaśobhastu śītalāṃśuviśodhitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ārtimetya parāṃ vīra mohitastamasā vibho \|*  
*apaśyannabravīddevaṃ mādhavaṃ bhūdharaṃ harim \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. With such flow of thoughts, lord Shiva — the leader of the goblins, wearing the shining kundalas in the ears, with his head decorated with the crescent moon having bright rays, and having been overpowered with ignorance and feeling painful, could out find Shri Krishna, who holds the earth and started speaking thus.

## \|\| 1.153.15-17 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho kva gatastvaṃ mahāmate \|*  
*brahmā ca kva gato vīra nāhaṃ paśyāmi vāṃ kvacit \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mohena mahatāhaṃ vai tamasā ca vimohitaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva cāhamadhunā sthitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kṣmādharaṃ pṛthivīṃ vṛkṣān devagandharvadānavān \|*  
*vipulaṃ sāgaraṃ sindhūnnahi paśyāmi kiñcana \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. Mahadeva said — “O Intelligent one, O Krishna, where are you? Where have you gone? Where has Brahma gone? I am unable to find both of you. Alas! I have presently been overpowered be the great delusion? Where should I go? What should I do? Where am I at the moment? I am unable to witness the mountains, earth, trees, Gandharvas, Danavas, the vast ocean, besides the river Sindhu.

## \|\| 1.153.18 \|\|

*kenopāyena paśyeyaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam \|*  
*brūhi me devaśārdūla vrīḍā me'tīva jāyate \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O lion among the gods, you tell me, how could I be able to visualise the mobile and immobile world? O best of the Devas, I am feeling extremely shameful.”

## \|\| 1.153.19 \|\|

*śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā harirvacanamabravīt \|*  
*śokagadgadayā vācā tamasā mohito nṛpa \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Listening to the words of Shiva, Vishnu, who had already been confused because of ignorance, spoke in choked and painful voice.

## \|\| 1.153.20-21 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*bhīma bhīma na jāne'haṃ kva bhavānvartate'dhunā \|*  
*mamāpi mohitaṃ cetastamasātīva śaṅkara \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kva gacchāmi kva tiṣṭhāmi kathaṃ tatsvasthatāṃ vrajet \|*  
*tamasā pūritaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhi parameśvara \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Vishnu said — “O dreadful one, I am not aware of the place where you are presently lodged. O Shiva, my mind too has presently been overpowered with darkness. Where should I go, where should I live? How could my mind be cured of the darkness? O Parameshvara! The entire world has been covered with darkness.

## \|\| 1.153.22-24 \|\|

*yadyasau dṛśyate devaḥ surajyeṣṭho'mbujodbhavaḥ \|*  
*pṛcchāvastaṃ mahātmānaṃ yadi te rocate hara \|\| 22 \|\|*

*hitvā darpamahaṅkāraṃ samamāsthāya kevalam \|*  
*padmānanaṃ padmayoniṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ gadato vākyaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|*  
*śrutvovāca vibhurbrahmā gaṅgādharamahīdharau \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. O Shiva, in case you are with me, then both of us discarding arrogance, should respectfully ask the lotus-born Brahma having the eyes like the lotus leaves, about this?” Hearing the words of Vishnu, Brahma spoke to Vishnu and Shiva.

## \|\| 1.153.25 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho bhīma bhīma mahāmate \|*  
*kva bhavantau brūta kiṃ ca kiṃ yuvāmūcathurmithaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Brahma said — “O Krishna! O Shiva! O long armed one having enormous wisdom, where from are you speaking? What are you talking?

## \|\| 1.153.26 \|\|

*mamātīva manobuddhī tamasā vaśamāgate \|*  
*na śṛṇomi na paśyāmi nidrāmohavaśaṃ gataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. My mind and wisdom have been overpowered with darkness. I am unable to see or hear anything like a person in sleep.

## \|\| 1.153.27 \|\|

*aho bata jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam \|*  
*tamasā vyāṣṭataṃ devau na jāne kva gataṃ mahaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. It is a matter of great pain and surprise that the entire world has been covered together with Rakshasas and the humans with darkness. No one knows as to where lord Krishna and Mahadeva have disappeared.”

## \|\| 1.153.28-30 \|\|

*atha teṣāṃ pravadatāṃ brahmādīnāṃ divaukasām \|*  
*darpakrodhabhayārtānāṃ tamasākrāntacetasām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ darpāpahārāya prabodhārthaṃ ca gopateḥ \|*  
*tejorūpaṃ samudbhūtamaṣṭaśṛṅgamanaupamam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*alakṣyaṃ pāpatamasā mahadvyoma narādhipa \|*  
*jvālāmālāvṛtaṃ vīra bahurūpaṃ ca bhāsate \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Thereafter, getting upset with fear, anger ma pride, having hearts been covered with rind darkness, when Brahma and other gods so spoke for the removal of their pride and in order to bestow the knowledge of the Sungod, a resplendent figure with eight horns, beautiful m that sinful darkness, which had not been seen earlier and wearing the garland of flames appeared. It looked as if having many forms.

## \|\| 1.153.31 \|\|

*śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ gatamūrdhvaṃ bhramattathā \|*  
*gomadhyato mahārāja karṇikevāmbujasya tu \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Spreading himself in a hundred yojanas in cuddle of the earth and above in the sky, resembling the pericarp of the lotus flower, it moved in a circular way.

## \|\| 1.153.32-39 \|\|

*prakāśaṃ tejasā tasya jagatsarvamidaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*pureṣvantaryathā vīra ambujasyārcibhiḥ sadā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā parasparaṃ sarve huṅkārādivikāriṇaḥ \|*  
*tejasā mohitāstasya jagatsarvamidaṃ nṛpa \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tejasā mohitaṃ tasya mahadvyoma narādhipa \|*  
*tato vismayamāsīnaḥ dṛṣṭagopatayo nṛpa \|\| 34 \|\|*

*paśyamānā maho vyomni mitho vacanamabruvan \|*  
*aho tejaḥ samuddhūtamasmākaṃ śreyase nṛpa \|\| 35 \|\|*

*prakāśāya ca lokānāṃ sarve paśyāma kiṃ nvidam \|*  
*jñānāyordhvaṃ gato brahmā cādhastāttripurāntaka \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tiryagjagāma deveśaścakrāmbujagadādharaḥ \|*  
*alabdhvā tasya te sarve pramāṇaṃ gairikādhipāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*vismayotphullanayanā samāgamya parasparam \|*  
*sarve kañjādikā devā idaṃ vacanamabruvan \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ko'yaṃ kimātmakaścāyaṃ kimidaṃ tejasāṃ nidhiḥ \|*  
*aho'sya darśanātsarve sañjātā jñānino vayam \|\| 39 \|\|*

32-39. With his lustre, the entire globe was filled. Like the interior of the inner part of a city lighted suddenly with the lightning, it was illuminated. The people got confused with this light. Such of the people, who had possessed the pride, mutually looking at one another, found that the entire universe was resplendent with his lustre. Thereafter, the lustre of the sky was witnessed by the gods, who felt surprised and they started talking among themselves — "The lustre of light has appeared for our benefit. Then why should we not have a look at it." Thus speaking, Brahma stood at its upper part, Shiva at the bottom end and Vishnu ~ the carrier of conch, moved at its back. All the three gods were unable to find out the size or the length and breadth of it. They returned getting surprised. Their eyes blossomed like the lotus flowers, ultimately Brahma and other gods thus spoke — "What is it that we foil to understand. What is its form? It is lustreful. It is a matter of great surprise with the very sight of it, our knowledge has been regained.”

## \|\| 1.153.40-43 \|\|

*tasmātsarve praṇamyainaṃ stuvīmo'dbhutadarśanam \|*  
*kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve cāstuvaṃstridivaukasaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*stuvatāmapyathaiteṣāṃ sahasrakiraṇo raviḥ \|*  
*ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa kṛpayā parayā vṛtaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*jñātvā bhaktiṃ mahābāho brahmādīnāṃ mahopamām \|*  
*atha te vyomni deveśaṃ dadṛśuḥ parameśvaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

*khaṣolkalokanātheśaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalam \|*  
*kṛttikābhirasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ yadvā tatkārtikāsthitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

40-43. Therefore, it would be quite appropriate to offer prayer to it, while rendering salutations to the same.” Thus speaking, all the gods offered prayer to it with folded hands. When all the prayers were thus offered by the gods, the compassionate Sungod with a thousand rays, appeared before them. The Sungod was pleased with the devotion of the gods. Then, the gods visualised the Sungod in the sky, who was of the khasholka form — the one who was pleased with the devotion of Brahma and other gods. Then all of them had a look at Parameshvara in the sky. He was in the form of khasholka form, besides being Lokanatha, Isa, having bright thousand rays. He was pleased with the Krittikas and was lodged in Karttika.

## \|\| 1.153.44-47 \|\|

*durjayaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu tathaikena vivarjitam \|*  
*tathā hastavihīnaṃ ca saptarṣirahitaṃ tathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*varṣābdarahitaṃ devaṃ saptasvaravivarjitam \|*  
*sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva sadaikākārarūpiṇam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*taddṛṣṭvānekaśirasamanekacaraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*anekodarabāhvaṃsamanekābharaṇānvitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*anekānanamakṣībaṃ sahasrākṣamanaupamam \|*  
*anekavarṇarūpaṃ ca anekamukuṭojjvalam \|\| 47 \|\|*

44-47. He was invincible by the Krittikas, deprived of hands and the seven lifts, without ears and words, without cloud or sky, without seven tunes, possessing the kalas, always having one form, having many heads, feet, bellies, arms and the shoulders, decorated with several types of jewellery, having many resplendent faces, having a thousand eyes, beyond comparison, colours and forms, and having the heads adorned with several types of bright crowns.

## \|\| 1.153.48-49 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvaivaṃ devadevasya rūpaṃ bhānormahātmanaḥ \|*  
*vismayotphullanayanāstuṣṭavuste divākaram \|\| 48 \|\|*

*kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā brahmā stotuṃ pracakrame \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā bhānumidaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. The Sungod is the lord of all the gods. Witnessing his form, the eyes of the gods blossomed with surprise. Then, all of them offered prayers to the Sungod. Initially, Brahma offered prayer to the Sungod thus.

## \|\| 1.153.50-53 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*namaste devadeveśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala \|*  
*lokadīpa namaste'stu namaste koṇavallabha \|\| 50 \|\|*

*bhāskarāya namo nityaṃ khaṣolkāya namonamaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇave kālacakrāya somāyāmitatejase \|\| 51 \|\|*

*namaste pañcakālāya indrāya vasuretase \|*  
*khagāya lokanāthāya ekacakrarathāya ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

*jagaddhitāya devāya śivāyāmitatejase \|*  
*tamoghnāya surūpāya tejasāṃ nidhaye namaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. Brahma said — O god of gods, salutation to the one who is adorned with a thousand rays. Salutation to the lamp of the world. The trident is dear to you, salutation to you. Salutation always to Khasholka. You are Kalachakra — the form of Vishnu, the nectar and possess enormous lustre, salutation to you. You are present in the five periods, Indra, Vasuretas, the traveller of the sky, lord of lokas. You have a chariot with a single wheel. You benefit the world, you are Shiva, possesses enormous lustre, remover of darkness, full of beauty and the abode of lustre, salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.153.54-58 \|\|

*arthāya kāmarūpāya dharmāyāmitatejase \|*  
*mokṣāya mokṣarūpāya sūryāya ca namonamaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*krodhalobhavihīnāya lokānāṃ sthitihetave \|*  
*śubhāya śubharūpāya śubhadāya śubhātmane \|\| 55 \|\|*

*śāntāya śāntarūpāya śāntaye'smāsu vai namaḥ \|*  
*namaste brahmarūpāya brāhmaṇāya namonamaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*brahmadevāya brahmarūpāya brahmaṇe paramātmane \|*  
*brahmaṇe ca prasādaṃ vai kuru deva jagatpate \|\| 57 \|\|*

*evaṃ stutvā raviṃ brahmā śraddhayā parayā vibho \|*  
*tūṣṇīmāsīnmahābhāga prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā \|\| 58 \|\|*

54-58. You are the form of dharma, artha and kama. You are immensely illustrious, you are liberation as well as the form of liberation. Salutation to the Sungod. You are devoid of anger and the lust, cause of the stability of the world, bestower of welfare and peaceful. Salutation to Brahman, Brahmadeva, Brahmarupa. O Paramatman! Salutation to you. O lord of the universe, be graceful on Brahma. Thus having been filled with devotion, Brahma offered prayer to Surya and thereafter, with a delightful mind, kept silent.

## \|\| 1.153.59 \|\|

*brahmaṇo'nantaraṃ rudraḥ stotraṃ cakre vibhāvasoḥ \|*  
*tripurārirmahātejāḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. After Brahma, the illustrious Shiva — the enemy of Tripura offered his salutation, lowering his head, to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.153.60-69 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca \|*  
*jaya bhāva jayājeya jaya haṃsa divākara \|*  
*jaya śambho mahābāho khaga gocara bhūdhara \|\| 60 \|\|*

*jaya lokapradīpena jaya bhāno jagatpate \|*  
*jaya kāla jayānanta saṃvatsara śubhānana \|\| 61 \|\|*

*jaya devāditeḥ putra kaśyapānandavardhana \|*  
*tamoghna jaya sapteśa jaya saptāśvavāhana \|\| 62 \|\|*

*maheśa jaya kāntīśa jaya kāleśa śaṅkara \|*  
*arthakāmeśa dharmeśa jaya mokṣeśa śarmada \|\| 63 \|\|*

*jaya vedāṅgarūpāya graharūpāya vai namaḥ \|*  
*satyāya satyarūpāya surūpāya śubhāya ca \|\| 64 \|\|*

*krodhalobhavināśāya kāmanāśāya vai jaya \|*  
*kalmāṣapakṣirūpāya yatirūpāya śambhave \|\| 65 \|\|*

*viśvāya viśvarūpāya viśvakarmāya vai jaya \|*  
*jayoṅkāra vaṣaṭkāra svāhākāra svadhāmaya \|\| 66 \|\|*

*jayāśvamedharūpāya cāgnirūpāryamāya ca \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavapītāya mokṣadvārapradāya ca \|\| 67 \|\|*

*saṃsārārṇavamagnasya mama deva jagatpate \|*  
*hastāvalambano deva bhava tvaṃ gopate'dbhuta \|\| 68 \|\|*

*īśo'pyevamahīnāṅgaṃ stutvā bhānuṃ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*virarāma mahārāja praṇamya śirasā ravim \|\| 69 \|\|*

60-69. Mahadeva said — “O eternal one, victory to you. Victory to invincible one, salutation to Hamsa as well as Divakara. Salutation to Bhanu — the lord of the globe. Salutation to the form of time, salutation to the one who is beyond measure, the samvatsara, as well as the one having auspicious face. Salutation to the son of Aditi, the bliss of Kashyapa. Victory to you. Victory to the remover of darkness. Victory to the lord of seven horses, besides having a chariot driven by the seven steeds. Victory to the lord of planets. Victory to the lord of lustre. Victory to the lord of time, Shankara, Ishvara of dharma and artha, Salutation to the lord of rage, one who preserves the modesty of the people, the form of truth, having beautiful and auspicious form. Salutation to you. Victory to the destroyer of kama (lust), krodha (anger), and lobha (the greed). Salutation to the one resembling the bird Kalmasha, form of husband, Shambhu, the universe as well as the universal form, victory to you. Victory to Omkara, Vashatkara, Svahakara and Svadharupa. You are the form of Ashvamedha, Agni, Aryama and the one who drinks the water of the ocean of the universe. O lord of the universe, O Deva, I am struggling in the ocean of the universe, O lord of rays, save me. You provide support with you hand.” Thus Shiva, offering prayer to the Sungod and lowering his head in reverence to the Sungod, kept silent.

## \|\| 1.153.70 \|\|

*atha viṣṇurmahātejāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭo ravim \|*  
*uvāca rājaśārdūla bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. Thereafter, the lion of the rulers and immensely illustrious Vishnu spoke to the Sungod with utmost faith and devotion.

## \|\| 1.153.71-73 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*namāmi devadeveśaṃ bhūtabhāvanamavyayam \|*  
*divākaraṃ raviṃ bhānuṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhagam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*indraṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ haṃsamarkaṃ lokaguruṃ vibhum \|*  
*trinetraṃ tryakṣaraṃ tryaṅgaṃ trimūrtiṃ trigatiṃ śubham \|\| 72 \|\|*

*ṣaṇmukhāya namo nityaṃ trinetrāya namonamaḥ \|*  
*caturviṃśatipādāya namo dvādaśapāṇaye \|\| 73 \|\|*

71-73. Vishnu said — “O god of the gods, the producer of the living beings, you are indestructible, Divakara, Bhanu, Martanda, Bhaskara, Bhaga and Ravi, salutation to you. You are Indra, Vishnu, Hari, Hamsa, Arka (Surya), preceptor of the world, all pervading, having three eyes, having three letters (Om), having three limbs, Trimurti, having three castes and six faces, salutation to you. Salutation always to the lord with three eyes. You have twenty four feet, tattvas and twelve hands (mouths), salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.153.74-77 \|\|

*namaste bhūtapataye lokānāṃ pataye namaḥ \|*  
*devānāṃ pataye nityaṃ varṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ jagannātho rudrastvaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ somastvaṃ tathādityastvamoṃkāraka eva hi \|\| 75 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatirbudhastvaṃ hi tvaṃ śukrastvaṃ vibhāvasuḥ \|*  
*yamastvaṃ varuṇastvaṃ hi namaste kaśyapātmaja \|\| 76 \|\|*

*tvayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam \|*  
*tvatta eva samutpannaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam \|\| 77 \|\|*

74-77. Salutation to the lord of earth and lord of the lokas. You are the master of the gods as well the people of all the castes, salutation to you. You are Brahma, Jagannatha, Rudra, Prajapati, the Moon, the Sun and Omkara. You are Brihaspati, Budha, Shukra, Vibhavasu and Varuna. O son of Kashyapa, salutation to you. You have expounded the mobile and immobile world. The gods, asuras and humans were created by you.

## \|\| 1.153.78-80 \|\|

*brahmā cāhaṃ ca rudraśca samutpannā jagatpate \|*  
*kalpādau tu purā deva sthitaye jagato'nagha \|\| 78 \|\|*

*namaste vedarūpāya ahorūpāya vai namaḥ \|*  
*namaste jñānarūpāya yajñāya ca namonamaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*prasīdāsmāsu deveśa bhūteśa kiraṇojjvala \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ prasādaṃ kuru gopate \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. O lord of the universe! I myself, Brahma and Rudra have been born at the start of kalpa by your grace. O sinless one, for the maintenance of the world, all of us have been born. Salutation to you as the form of the Vedas. Salutation to you as the form of the day. Salutation to you again and again, being the form of knowledge and the Vedas. O Deva, lord of the bhutas, you are the combination of the rays and brightness, kindly be pleased with us. O lord of the Sun rays, you kindly shower your grace on us, since we are drowning in the ocean of the universe. Salutation to the form of Vedanta as well as the Yajna.”

## \|\| 1.153.81-87 \|\|

*vedāntāya namo nityaṃ namo yajñakalāya ca \|*  
*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*stutvaivaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā viṣṇurbharatasattama \|*  
*pradadhyau nṛpaśārdūla raviṃ tadgatamānasaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*evaṃ te naraśārdūla devā brahmādayo'nagha \|*  
*stuvanti taṃ mahātmānaṃ sahasrakiraṇaṃ ravim \|\| 82 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ stuvatāṃ teṣāṃ raviṃ bhaktyā mahātmanām \|*  
*atha tuṣṭo ravisteṣāṃ brahmadīnāṃ jagatpatiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*vijñāya bhaktiṃ paramāṃ śraddhāṃ ca paramāṃ vibhuḥ \|*  
*uvāca sa mahātejāḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā \|\| 84 \|\|*

*graheśo vyoma cārūḍhastejasā prajvalandiśaḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumīśānamāmantryaitānviśāṃpate \|\| 85 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tānpraṇatāntsarvāñchirobhiravaniṃ gatān \|*  
*tuṣṭo'smi te surajyeṣṭha caturmukha jagatpate \|*  
*varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te manasā tvaṃ yadicchasi \|\| 86 \|\|*

*kṛtvā tu vacanaṃ bhānorbrahmā lokagururnṛpa \|*  
*jagāma śirasā bhūmāvuvāca sa kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

81-87. O most excellent Bharata, thus Vishnu offered prayer to the Sungod and then meditated upon him with devotion. O lion among the humans, O sinless one, Brahma and other gods offered prayer to the Sungod having a thousand rays. As a result of which the Sungod was extremely pleased with them. Observing their utmost devotion and faith, the Sungod was pleased in the heart. Then the lord of planets, using his lustre in the sky, illuminated all the directions. Then summoning Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, who offered their salutation to the Sungod, bending their heads over the earth. Finding them so eulogising, the Sungod said — “O four-faced Brahma, the best of gods and lord of the world, I am extremely happy. Let you meet with welfare. You ask for a boon as per your desire.” At these words of the Sungod, Brahma — the preceptor of the world, lowering his head offered his salutation and said.

## \|\| 1.153.89-92 \|\|

*sahasrakiraṇairyanme bhavāndarśanamāgataḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

*apaśyataśca deveśa mūḍhamāsīnmano mama \|*  
*bhagavansamprasīda tvaṃ mamopari vibhāvaso \|\| 90 \|\|*

*prayaccha tvaṃ balaṃ bhaktimātmano mama gopate \|*  
*gatvā śirobhiravanimaṣṭāṅgaiḥ patitasya ca \|*  
*bhaktyā vijñaptimākarṇya prasādaṃ kuru gopate \|\| 91 \|\|*

*brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā pūṣā devo jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*tathetyāha mahārāja virāṭa praśrayānvitam \|\| 92 \|\|*

89-92. Brahma said — You have appeared before me with a thousand rays, therefore, I feel beholden to you. O lord of the gods, I have been purified. O dweller of the sky, you are graceful. Getting beholden, I have achieved the excellent position. In your absence, my mind had become motionless. Be pleased with me and O lord of rays, you bestow your strength and devotion on me. I prostrate before you laying down on earth, salutation to you. Listening to the words of Brahma which were filled with devotion, the Sungod said — “Be it so”, giving his approval.

## \|\| 1.153.93-95 \|\|

*brahmaṇe ca varaṃ dattvā rājandevo divākaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca tryambakaṃ devaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharam \|\| 93 \|\|*

*varaṃ varaya bhūteśa bhūbhṛjjādayitānagha \|*  
*yamicchasi mahādeva dade'haṃ tadaśeṣataḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*bhāskarasya vacaḥ śrutvā īśvarastripurāntaka \|*  
*gatvā tu śirasā bhūmau praṇamyovāca bhāskaram \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. O king, the Sungod bestowed the boon on Brahma and then said to Shiva with crescent moon over his head — “O lord of the bhutas, beloved of Parvati, O sinless one, you ask for your desired boon. O Mahadeva, I shall bestow on you whatever is desired by you.” Listening to the words of Bhaskara, Tripurantaka Shiva, placing his head over the earth, offered his salutation to the Sungod and then said.

## \|\| 1.153.96-102 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca \|*  
*puṇyo'haṃ puṇyakarmāhaṃ nāsti dhanyataro mama \|*  
*gato'haṃ paramāṃ siddhiṃ gataśca paramāṃ gatim \|\| 96 \|\|*

*nāprāpyamasti deveśa nāsādhyaṃ mama kiṃcana \|*  
*yasya me bhagavāndevaḥ prasādapravaṇaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*tvayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam \|*  
*tvatta eva samutpannaṃ layaṃ ca tvayi yāsyati \|\| 98 \|\|*

*yadi tuṣṭo mama vibho anugrāhyo'smi te yadi \|*  
*acalāṃ dehi me bhaktimātmanaścaraṇaṃ naya \|\| 99 \|\|*

*vyomakeśavacaḥ śrutvā pūṣā devo divākaraḥ \|*  
*tathetyāha haraṃ vīra tato harimuvāca \|\| 100 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇa mahābāho varaṃ varaya godhara \|*  
*parituṣṭo'smi te deva yamicchasi mahābala \|\| 101 \|\|*

*śrutvā tu bhāskaravacaḥ kīlālajanako hariḥ \|*  
*uvāca parayā bhaktyā natvā ca śirasā ravim \|\| 102 \|\|*

96-102. Mahadeva said — I am auspicious, perform auspicious deeds. There is none more graceful then myself. I have achieved the best of success today. O lord of gods! Now, there is nothing beyond my reach and nothing is incurable for me, because the Sungod is standing before me. The world of mobile and immobile beings has been expanded by you from your own self. The entire universe would be absorbed in you as well. You are pleased with me and wish to shower your grace on me. Then, bestow your devotion as well as the service at your feet/’ Listening to the words of Shiva, the Sungod gave his approval, saying — “Be it so.” Thereafter, he said to Vishnu — “O Narayana, O long armed one, O carrier of the earth, now you ask for a boon as per your desire. I am extremely pleased with you.” Listening to the words of Bhaskara, with utmost devotion Vishnu offered his salutation, lowered his head and said.

## \|\| 1.153.103 \|\|

*nārāyaṇa uvāca \|*  
*jaya deva jagannātha jaya deva guro rave \|*  
*prasīda mama deveśa bhaktiṃ yacchātmano rave \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Narayana said — “O Deva, O Jagannatha, victory to you, victory to Sungod — the preceptor. You are extremely pleased with me, O lord, therefore, you bestow your devotion on me.

## \|\| 1.153.104-110 \|\|

*yenāhaṃ sarvadevānāmuttamaḥ syāṃ jagatpate \|*  
*ajeyaśca tathā deva daityadānavarakṣasām \|\| 104 \|\|*

*tvadbhaktyā bṛṃhitabalastejasā mahatānvitaḥ \|*  
*tato mayā mahatkarma kartavyaṃ tava śāsanāt \|\| 105 \|\|*

*prajānāṃ pālanaṃ deva devānāṃ ca grahādhipa \|*  
*varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇadharmasya vā vibho \|\| 106 \|\|*

*duṣṭadaityavināśāya lokānāṃ pālanāya ca \|*  
*sṛṣṭo'haṃ bhavatā pūrvaṃ kalpādau ca kṛto'nagha \|\| 107 \|\|*

*yasya ruṣṭo bhavānsyādvai kathañcitpuruṣasya tu \|*  
*vyādhirduḥkhaṃ manorogaṃ dāridryaṃ santatikṣayaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*tasyaitāni bhavantīha ādhayo vividhāstathā \|*  
*tasmāttvaṃ ca tato deva saṃstavyaḥ satataṃ budhaiḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

*evaṃ tvāṃ gopate deva bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*ahamarcitumicchāmi tasmānmayi kṛpāṃ kuru \|\| 110 \|\|*

104-110. Let me be all powerful from all the god and invincible from Daityas, Danavas and Rakshasas. Increasing my own strength with your devotion, let my prowess be increased for performing great deeds at your command O lord of planets, I have to look after the people, the gods, varnas and ashramas. O sinless one, I have to attend to the destruction of Daityas, Danavas and the wicked people. You had created me for this very purpose at the start of the kalpa. When you get annoyed with a person, he attracts ailment, disease, miseries, poverty, loss of children besides several types of mental agonies. Therefore, the learned people should always remain devoted to you. Thus, O lord of the rays! I want to worship you with utmost faith and devotion. Kindly be graceful on me.”

## Chapter 154. Three types of Surya Images

## \|\| 1.154.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhānurviṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|*  
*uvāca kuruśārdūla ādityaḥ kṛpayānvitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O lion of Kuru race, listening to the words of Vishnu possessing his own lustre, the Sungod spoke with kindness.

## \|\| 1.154.2 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*yadarthaṃ prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Aditya said — “O Krishna, O long armed one, you listen to my words for which you have made a request to me. You will be successful in all the matters.

## \|\| 1.154.3 \|\|

*devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām \|*  
*ajeyastvaṃ mahābāho bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. For the Gods, Danavas, Yakshas, Gandharvas, Nagas and Rakshasas, you would be invincible.

## \|\| 1.154.4 \|\|

*jagatpālayituṃ sarvaṃ samarthaśca bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*acalā tava bhaktiśca bhaviṣyati mamopari \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. There is no doubt about it. You would be capable for looking after the universe, still I shall preserve my devotion for you.

## \|\| 1.154.5 \|\|

*brahmāpi satataṃ śakto jagatsraṣṭuṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*saṃhartuṃ śaṅkaraścāpi matprasādādbhaviṣyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. For my pleasure, Brahma would create the universe and Shiva would be engaged in its destruction.

## \|\| 1.154.6 \|\|

*bhavanto matprasādena jñānināmuttamaṃ padam \|*  
*gamiṣyanti na sandeho matpūjāprasādataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Because of the grace achieved for adoring me, all of you would achieve the best of positions among the learned people. There is \| no doubt about it.”

## \|\| 1.154.7-8 \|\|

*ravervacanamākarṇya gośrutābharaṇo vibho \|*  
*uvāca gopatirgogo gopatiṃ govṛṣadhvajaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tvāmārādhya bhaviṣyāmo vayaṃ sarve surottamāḥ \|*  
*kathamārādhayāmo hi bhavantaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ \|*  
*śreyase satataṃ deva brūhi nastattvamātmanaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. O competent one, thus listening to the words of the Sungod, Shiva, whose ears were adorned with kundalas, the lord of earth and having the figure of a cow or bull embossed over the flags, said to the Sungod who is the lord of rays — “With your devotion, we shall become the excellent gods, but getting devoted towards you, how could we be able to worship you? O Deva, for our welfare, be kind enough to reveal the method of worship of your image to us.

## \|\| 1.154.9 \|\|

*bhavato hi na paśyāmo mūrtiṃ paramapūjitām \|*  
*paśyāmaḥ kevalaṃ tejo hyabdhestoyamivojjhitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. We are unable to visualise your adorable form (or the body). Like the water discarded by the ocean, we can witness your lustre alone.

## \|\| 1.154.10-13 \|\|

*jvālāmālākulaṃ sarvamanekākṛti cādbhutam \|*  
*na cākāravihīnaṃ tu cetaso lambanaṃ bhavet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ālambanādṛte deva na cittaramaṇaṃ kvacit \|*  
*cetaso'ramaṇe bhaktirna puṃsāṃ jāyate kvacit \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhaktiṃ vinā pūjayituṃ na śakyante divaukasaḥ \|*  
*tvatpūjane hi prāpyante deva dharmādayo naraiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tasmāddarśaya tāṃ mūrtimātmano yā parā matā \|*  
*yena tvāṃ pūjayitvā tu vayaṃ siddhā bhavāmahe \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. It is surrounded with the garlands of flames. Your form is astonishing, but has no definite form. It therefore, does not appeal the mind. O Deva, unless there are some means to remove the worry, a person does not gets fully devoted and the people without any attachments, do not develop devotion in their minds. No one can worship the Sungod without devotion. O lord, the humans achieve dharma and artha by worshipping you. Therefore, you appear before us in your true form to enable us to achieve success by worshipping you.”

## \|\| 1.154.14 \|\|

*sūrya uvāca \|*  
*sādhu sādhu mahādeva sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvrata \|*  
*śṛṇu caikamanāḥ kṛtsnaṃ gadato mama mānada \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Surya said — “Well done, O Mahadeva! You have put me an excellent question. O Suvrata, you listen to the reply from me quite attentively. I am going to reveal everything to you.

## \|\| 1.154.15 \|\|

*caturmūrtirahaṃ deva jagadvyāpya vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*śreyase sarvalokānāmādimadhyāntakṛtsadā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. O Deva, taking to the four forms, for the benefit and for the sake of the creation, maintenance and absorption, I remain in the universe pervading the same.

## \|\| 1.154.16 \|\|

*ekā me rājasī mūrtirbrahmeti parikīrtitā \|*  
*sṛṣṭiṃ karoti sā nityaṃ kalpādau jagatāṃ vibho \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O excellent one! One of my form is royal or invaluable and is known by the name of Brahma. The same form, at the start of kalpa, performs the job of creating the entire universe.

## \|\| 1.154.17 \|\|

*dvitīyā sāttvikī proktā yā parā parikīrtitā \|*  
*jagatsā pālayennityaṃ duṣṭadaityavināśinī \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. My other form is known as Sattvika or endowed with goodness and is the best of all, which has earned enormous praise. This form is the destroyer of wicked, the daityas and lokas, after the well beings of the world.

## \|\| 1.154.18 \|\|

*tṛtīyā tāmasī jñeyā īśeti ṣarikīrtitā \|*  
*trailokyaṃ saṃharetsā tu kalpānte śūlapāṇinī \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The third form is that of Tomas or darkness. It is known by the name of Isa. The same form, at the end of the kalpa, destroys all the three worlds.

## \|\| 1.154.19 \|\|

*caturthī tu guṇairhīnā satyādibhiranuttamā \|*  
*sā cāśakyā kvaciddraṣṭuṃ sthitā sā cābhavatsadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The fourth form is devoid of sattva and all other virtues. It is truthful and always remains or everlasting. But no one is able to have an audience with it.

## \|\| 1.154.20 \|\|

*tayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ yaccodgīthaṃ tu me gatiḥ \|*  
*niṣkalā sakalā sā tu surūpā rūpavarjitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The same was the cause for the spread of this universe. My personality has been defined by the Samaveda. The said form is with and without competence and is beautiful as well as ugly.

## \|\| 1.154.21-22 \|\|

*antargatā ca lokānāṃ na ca karmaphalaṃ gatā \|*  
*tiṣṭhamānāpyaliptā sā padmapatramivāmbhasā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*anaṣṭā ca sadā ṣaḍbhiḥ saptātītya vyavasthitā \|*  
*catustanā ca sā ṣaḍbhyasturīyākhyā supūjitā \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The said form resides in the heart of the lokas t but it does not contribute towards the result of the deeds (good or bad), performed by a person. This form resides in the locas like a lotus flower in a pond, which is unmindful of the water as well as the mud beneath. Thus, it is untouched with all the six shortcomings like desire etc. It pervades all the seven lokas. The four Vedas are its address. It is adored well by all the Shastras. It is well known by the name of Turiya.

## \|\| 1.154.23 \|\|

*na sā spraṣṭuṃ tvayā śakyā hariṇā brahmaṇā na ca \|*  
*māmanārādhya bhūteśa vyomarūpaṃ kadācana \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Neither Brahma or Vishnu would be able to touch it unless O lord of the Bhutas, they adore me in the form of Vyoma.

## \|\| 1.154.24-27 \|\|

*yadetadbhavatāṃ deva prabodhārthamupasthitam \|*  
*ahaṃkāravimūḍhānāṃ tamasā ca trilocana \|\| 24 \|\|*

*prakāśāya ca lokānāṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam \|*  
*karṇikeva sthitaṃ deva bhūpadmasyākhilasya ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*yasya saṃdarśanādeva yūyaṃ sarve prabodhitāḥ \|*  
*prakāśamabhavadvāpi jagatsarvamathārcibhiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tasmādārādhayasvainamaspṛṣṭaṃ gamanopamam \|*  
*manmūrtiṃ yena tāṃ divyāṃ drakṣyasi tvaṃ trilocana \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. Becoming immovable because of the darkness as well as the pride, it stands before for recognition and is surrounded with the garland of flames, it resembles the pericarp of the locus flowers and stands for the illumination of the worlds. You could gain the knowledge with the mere sight of the same. Because of the rays of the same, the world has gained light. The same is resplendent like the solar rays. It is as vast as the sky, but is resplendent and has to be worshipped by you. O Shiva with three eyes, so that you could be able to have an audience with the same figure.

## \|\| 1.154.28 \|\|

*yattvādyamīśvaraṃ jajñe tadvyoma parikīrtitam \|*  
*kalpānte hyatra vai vyomni līyante sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The one who has been born as Ishvvara is known by the name of vyoma, in which the Devas get absorbed.

## \|\| 1.154.29 \|\|

*dakṣiṇe līyate brahmā vāme tasya janārdanaḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ sadā kacadeśe tu līyase tripurāntaka \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Brahma is lodged to his right, Janardana to his left and O Tripurantaka, you always get absorbed in the locks of hair.

## \|\| 1.154.30-31 \|\|

*gāyatrī līyate tasya hṛdaye lokamātaraḥ \|*  
*līyante mūrddhni vai vedaḥ saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*jaṭhare līyate sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam \|*  
*punarutpadyate hyasmādbrahmādyaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. The goddess Gayatri and other mothers of the universe are lodged in his heart All the Vedas with six angas remain lodged in his head. The mobile and immobile world gets lodged in his belly. Brahma and other mobile and immobile creatures get created similarly.

## \|\| 1.154.32 \|\|

*ākāśaṃ vyoma ityāhuḥ pṛthivī nikṣubhā matā \|*  
*bhūtaśreyoha'mākāśo nikṣubhā dayitā mama \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Vyoma, Ether and Nikshubha are the form of earth. I am the sky for the welfare of the people, while Nikshubha is my beloved.

## \|\| 1.154.33 \|\|

*mayā nikṣubhayā sarvaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ trilocana \|*  
*tasmādārādhaya vyoma tvaṃ brahmā keśavastathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O three-eyed one, together with Nikshubha, I pervade in this world. Therefore, you yourself, Narayana and Brahma meditate upon vyoma.

## \|\| 1.154.34 \|\|

*tanme rūpaṃ mahadvyoma pūjayitvā trilocana \|*  
*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi girau tvaṃ gandhamādane \|*  
*tato yāsyasi saṃsiddhiṃ ṣaḍaṅgāṃ paramāṃ śubhām \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O three-eyed one, performing my worship over the Gandhamadana mountain in the form of vyoma, for a thousand years, you would be able to achieve six fold success.

## \|\| 1.154.35 \|\|

*kalāpagrāmamāśritya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*ārādhayatu māṃ bhaktyā vyomarūpaṃ janārdanaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Janardana — the carrier of Shankha, cakra and gada, staying in the city of Kalapa, should worship me in the form of vyoma.

## \|\| 1.154.36-38 \|\|

*antarikṣagataṃ tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ lokapāvanam \|*  
*tatra gatvā viriñco me vyomarūpaṃ sadārcatu \|\| 36 \|\|*

*evaṃ māṃ satataṃ yūyaṃ samārādhya jagatpatim \|*  
*samānāṃ ca sudivyānāṃ sahasratrayamādarāt \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tato drakṣyatha me mūrtiṃ paramāṃ yāṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*kadambagolakākārāṃ raśmimālākulāṃ parām \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. Similarly, remaining in the space and achieving auspicious holy place, Brahma should also adore my vyoma form. Thus, after worshipping me as the lord of the universe, for three thousand divine years and getting decorated with the circular garland of kadamba flowers, you shall then have an audience with my image.”

## \|\| 1.154.39 \|\|

*atha nārāyaṇo devaḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim \|*  
*kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Thereafter, Vishnu offered his salutation, lowering his head, and spoke to the Sungod with folded hands.

## \|\| 1.154.40-42 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*yadi te paramaṃ rūpaṃ mataṃ vyoma hyanaupamam \|*  
*tamārādhya vayaṃ sarve yāsyāmaḥ siddhimuttamām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kīdṛgvyoma tvahaṃ brahmā haraśca tripurāntakaḥ \|*  
*ārādhayāmahe deva bhaktyā śreyo'rthamātmanaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*yena siddhiṃ gamiṣyāmastamārādhya divākaram \|*  
*tasmānno lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi vyomnaḥ paramapūjita \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. Vishnu said — “In case, your vyoma form is the best and the most beautiful and adoring form, we shall achieve the best success, then what is the other figure known, which is going to be adored by Shiva and Brahma, for their own welfare? O immensely adorable one, you kindly speak out the symptoms of vyoma, adoring which we are bound to achieve success.”

## Chapter 155. Exposition of Solar Dharma

## \|\| 1.155.1 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*sādhusādhu suraśreṣṭha sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhūdhara \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ kṛṣṇa gadato nikhilaṃ mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Aditya said — “O excellent god, well done, O king, you have put me an excellent question. O Krishna! I am revealing all the details. You please listen with apt attention.

## \|\| 1.155.2 \|\|

*ārādhayatvayaṃ devo mama rūmanaupamam \|*  
*catuṣkoṇaṃ paraṃ vyoma adbhutaṃ gairikojjvalam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O Deva, you better worship me with devotion in the form of a square, excellent, astonishing and shining like the silver. You better adore my divine form.

## \|\| 1.155.3 \|\|

*tvāmārādhya ca cakrāṃkaṃ śaṃkaro vṛttamādarāt \|*  
*śabdādau satataṃ brahma sagarādau trilocanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. O Deva! You worship me during the moon days with devotion. All the gods should also worship me as per their desire.

## \|\| 1.155.4-7 \|\|

*madhyāhne tvaṃ sadā deva bhaktyā māmarcayasva vai \|*  
*yatheṣṭamṛbhavaḥ sarve bhaktyā māṃ pūjayaṃtu vai \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tato brahmādayo devāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ vibhāvasoḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā sarvaṃ idaṃ vacanamabruvan \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dhanyā deva vayaṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyāstathaiva ca \|*  
*asmābhirbhagavānpṛṣṭa stejasā prajvalaṃti ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saṃbhūtā jñāninaḥ sarve bhavato darśanādvayam \|*  
*tamomohāttathā taṃdrā sarvamekapade gatam \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Thereafter, all the gods including Brahma, listening to the words of Surya, offered their salutation to him, lowering their heads. By performing your circular worship with great devotion, lord Shiva, who could consume everything even the poison, besides who meditated on Shabda-Brahma, enjoyed the exalted position. Graceful are we people and we feel beholden, because we had put a question to you, as a result of which we had an audience with you. Inspite of our being so learned and resplendent, all the lethargy and other leaknesses got disappeared in a moment.

## \|\| 1.155.8-9 \|\|

*vayaṃ tvanmūrtayaḥ sarve tejasā tava saṃvṛtāḥ \|*  
*utpattisthitināśāya lokānāṃ tava śāsanāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sthitāḥ sarve surajyeṣṭha lokapālāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*adhunā sādha yāmeha vyomnaḥ pūjāṃ vrajāmahe \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. We became resplendent like your own body. O best of all the god, during your rule, following the responsibilities of creatures, their maintenance and the destruction, we have been well established over the positions of Lokapalas. Now, we are departing in order to perform the worship of vyoma.

## \|\| 1.155.10 \|\|

*itthaṃ teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca brahmaviṣṇvīśānsāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Listening their words, Bhaskara, who sucks the water, peacefully spoke to Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

## \|\| 1.155.11-12 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*evametanna saṃdeho yadā vadatha suvratāḥ \|*  
*yūyaṃ manmūrtayaḥ sarve yuṣmākamahameva hi \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yadetaddarśanaṃ devāḥ pramāṇa ca yaduttamam \|*  
*jvālāmālākulaṃ śubhraṃ śāṃḍileyamivojjhitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Aditya said — O Suvratas, whatever has been spoken by you is correct. There is no doubt about it. You are actually my forms and I also belong to you. You have witnessed my form, which is adorned with the garland of flames. It resembles the spotless fire, kept separately. All of you are the only witness for the same. How were you able to have a look at such a form of Agni, you please listen to the reason for the same.

## \|\| 1.155.13-14 \|\|

*yuṣmākaṃ devaśārdūlāstannibodhata kāraṇam \|*  
*ahaṃkāravimūḍhānāṃ mithaḥ kalahināṃ tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*prabodhārthaṃ hi yuṣmākaṃ tamaso nāśanāya ca \|*  
*pravartanāya sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca pradarśitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Because of arrogance or loss of wisdom, you quarreled amongst yourselves. In order to remove the cause of your controversy and for the removal of darkness in the people, to enlighten you over the reality and for the noble result of all your deeds, you have been able me to witness me in this form.

## \|\| 1.155.15-18 \|\|

*tasmādevaṃ viditvā tu nāhaṃkāraḥ kadācana \|*  
*kartavyo bhūtimicchadbhiḥ satataṃ devasattamāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mānaṃ darpamahaṃkāraṃ pūrvaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ \|*  
*ārādhayata māṃ bhaktyā satataṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tato drakṣyatha me rūpaṃ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ ca yat \|*  
*yasya saṃdarśanādeva sarve siddhimavāpsyatha \|\| 17 \|\|*

*evamuktvā mahārāja sahasrakiraṇo vibhuḥ \|*  
*jagāmādarśanaṃ teṣāṃ paśyatāmeva bhārata \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. Therefore, O best of the gods, all of you must being desirous of your fortunes, should never become arrogant. First of all, the pride and arrogance should be discarded from a distance and then adore me with faith and devotion. This would enable you to be face to face with my form which is both sakala as well as nishkala. By your having an audience with that, you would be able to attain success. O Bharata, after thus speaking, the thousand rayed Sun disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 1.155.19 \|\|

*atha te vismitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupinākinaḥ \|*  
*tejasā tasya devasya bhāskarasya mahaujasaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thereafter, all Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva besides the other gods, were immensely surprised at that form of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.155.20-21 \|\|

*parasparamathocuste vismayena tadā nṛpa \|*  
*aho mahātmā'yaṃ devo'ditiputro divaspatiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*bṛhadbhānurmahātejā lokadīpo vibhāvasuḥ \|*  
*yena sarve vayaṃ trātā nighnatā vipulaṃ tamaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. O king! Feeling surprised, all of them started saying — “The great soul, son of Aditi, lord of the day, having long rays, immensely illustrious, the lamp of light, the Sungod is the only one which removes total darkness and has also protected us from the same.

## \|\| 1.155.22-23 \|\|

*ārādhayāmastaṃ sarve gatvā sthānāni kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*yena sarve vayaṃ tasya prasādātsiddhimāpnumaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tadvyoma pūjayitvā tu parayā śraddhayā vibhoḥ \|*  
*āmaṃtrya te mithaḥ sarve gatāḥ pūjārthamādarāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Let all of us reach our desired place and worship him to enable us to achieve the success.” The vyoma form of Surya then was desired to be worshipped and for so doing, all the gods went to their respective places.

## \|\| 1.155.24-25 \|\|

*jagāma puṣkaraṃ brahmā śālagrāmaṃ janārdanaḥ \|*  
*vṛṣabhadhvajo gato vīra parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tyaktvā mānamahaṃkāraṃ kurvaṃtastapa uttamam \|*  
*ārādhayaṃti taṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. While Brahma went to Pushkara, Janardana went to Shalagrama and Shiva retired to the Gandhamadana mountain. Reaching there, discarding their pride and arrogance, they started worshipping the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.155.26-27 \|\|

*vyomni kṛtvā catuṣkoṇaṃ brahmā nityamapūjayat \|*  
*cakrāṃkitaṃ harirnityaṃ samyagvyomaṃ tvapūjayat \|\| 26 \|\|*

*haro'pi satataṃ vīra tejasā vahnisannibham \|*  
*apūjayatsadā vṛttaṃ vyomaṃ bhaktyā samanvitaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. A square vyoma was made, Vishnu decorated it with cakra and started adoring it Shiva, on the other hand, made a circle resplendent like the fire and worshipped the same.

## \|\| 1.155.28-32 \|\|

*divyavarṣasahasrāṃte pūjayaṃto divākaram \|*  
*gaṃdhamālyopahāraistu nṛtyagītapravāditaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*atoṣayanmahātmānaṃ kurvāṇāstapa uttamam \|*  
*bhaktyācalena manasā vivasvaṃtamanuttamam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*atha teṣāṃ mahārāja prasanno bhuvanādhipaḥ \|*  
*darśayāmāsa lokātmā yugapadvai vibhāvasuḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇātmā ca mahātejāścaturdhā yogatonagha \|*  
*gatvaikena suraśreṣṭhaṃ sobravītparamaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*anyena śaṃkaraṃ manye anyena garuḍadhvajam \|*  
*sa tatāpa tathānyena rathārūḍho divaṃ sadā \|\| 32 \|\|*

28-32. They worshipped Divakara for a thousand years, offering fragrant garlands and other presents. The singing and dancing was also arranged. The stories of Divakara were listened to, besides worshipping him with devotion and firm mind. The excellent tapas too were performed, pleasing the great Sungod. The Sungod, who is the lord of the universe, besides being the soul of the world, appeared before them at the same time. O sinless one» the immensely illustrious soul of Krishna, the Sungod, taking to four forms with his yogic powers, spoke to Brahma in one of the forms, with sweet words. Similarly, he appeared before Vishnu having the Garuda-banner, besides Shiva in different forms. In his fourth form, riding over the chariot, he roams about in the sky always.

## \|\| 1.155.33-35 \|\|

*evaṃ yogabalādbhānuḥ kṛtavānmahadadbhutam \|*  
*ugre tapasi vartaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ caturmukham \|\| 33 \|\|*

*pūjayantaṃ mahadvyoma bhūgatairmukhapaṅkajaiḥ \|*  
*uvāca taṃ mahārāja bhāskaraścaturānanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*paśyapaśya suraśreṣṭha varadaṃ māmupāgatam \|*  
*śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ bhānorviriṃcastamathaikṣata \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Thus exercising the strength of his yoga, he took to the most surprising forms. He Found Brahma performing hard tapas for vyoma touching the earth with his lotus like face. The four-faced Brahma was then addressed by Surya, thus — “O senior god, look here, I have arrived here to bestow a boon on you.” “Listening to the words of the Sungod, Brahma looked at him and said.

## \|\| 1.155.36 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā jagāma praṇato hyavaniṃ mukhapaṃkajaiḥ \|*  
*harṣādutphullanayanaḥ punarutthāya bhāskaram \|*  
*uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. At the very sight of the Sungod, Brahma started touching the earth with his lotus like face, offering salutation to the Sungod. Then, with blossoming eyes, he delightfully said to Surya, with excellent words.

## \|\| 1.155.37-38 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*namaste devadeveśa namaste timirāpaha \|*  
*namaste bhūta bhavyeśa bhūtāde bhūtabhāvana \|\| 37 \|\|*

*prasādaṃ kuru me deva prasanno'tha divākaraḥ \|*  
*gatiranyā na me deva vidyate tvadṛte vibho \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Brahma said — O lord of gods, salutation to you, salutation to the destroyer of darkness. You are the great lord of the living beings, creator of the bhutas, salutation to you. O lord, be graceful on us. Let Divakara be pleased. You are all pervading Deva, I have no source except you.

## \|\| 1.155.39-40 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*evameva yathāttha tvaṃ nāsti tatra vicāraṇā \|*  
*tvaṃ me prathamajaḥ putraḥ saṃbhūtaḥ kāraṇātpurā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varadosmi tavāgrataḥ \|*  
*yamicchasi surajyeṣṭha mā tvaṃ śaṃkāṃ kuru prabho \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Aditya said — Whatever you say is correct There is nothing to be thought about it You happen to be my first son. You were born first due to some reason. I am present before you to bestow the boon. You speak out whatever you desire. There is no cause of any doubt here.

## \|\| 1.155.41 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*yadi me bhagavāṃstuṣṭo dadāti varamuttamam \|*  
*kartuṃ śaknomi sṛṣṭiṃ ca prasādāttava gopate \|*  
*kṛtākṛtā hi me deva sṛṣṭirneha prasidhyati \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Brahma said — In case, the lord is desirous to bestow an excellent boon on me, then by your grace, let me be able to start creation. Whatever creation is made by you, it is not well known.

## \|\| 1.155.42 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*na putratvamahaṃ prāptastava deva caturmukha \|*  
*tavānvaye gamiṣyāmi putratvaṃ hi marīcaye \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Aditya said — O four-faced one, I have understood whatever is meant by you. But I cannot be your son. Of course, I shall be born as son of Marichi in your race.

## \|\| 1.155.43 \|\|

*tato yāsyati te siddhiṃ kṛtsnā sṛṣṭiścaturmukha \|*  
*bhavitaivaṃ na sandeho matprasādā jjagatpate \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O four-faced one, at that point of time, your creation will have sufficient publicity. It shall happen like this because of my grace. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.155.44-45 \|\|

*evamukto viriṃcistu raviṇā pṛthivīpate \|*  
*taṃ vai vyoḍhaṃ vivastraṃtaṃ lokanāthaṃ jagatpatim \|\| 44 \|\|*

*punarāha surajyeṣṭhaḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim \|*  
*kva me vāso jagannātha bhaviṣyati divaspate \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. At these words of the Sungod, Brahma offered his salutation to Vivasvan — the lord of the earth, lowering his head and asked him — “O lord of the universe, where shall be my living place?”

## \|\| 1.155.46-57 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*yanme rūpaṃ mahadvyoma pṛṣṭhaśṛṃgamanuttamam \|*  
*tatra devakadaṃbaistu bhavānnityaṃ nivatsyati \|\| 46 \|\|*

*indraḥ pūrvadiśo bhāge āgneyyāṃ śāṃḍilīsutaḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamo nityaṃ nairṛtyāmatha nirṛtiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*paścimāyāṃ tu varuṇo vāyavyāṃ tu sadāgatiḥ \|*  
*uttare tu diśo bhāge nivaseddhanadastataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*aiśānyāṃ śaṃkaro devo madhye tvaṃ viṣṇunā saha \|*  
*śrutvaitvaṃ vacanaṃ bhānorvedhāḥ prītyā tamabravīt \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kṛtakṛtyaṃ tathātmānaṃ manyate ca narādhipa \|*  
*cakāra ca tathā sarvaṃ bhāska roktamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sa ca siddhiṃ gato vīra prasādādbhāskarasya tu \|*  
*ādityopi varaṃ dattvā brahmaṇyo brahmaṇe'nagha \|\| 51 \|\|*

*jagāma saha devena parvataṃ gandhamādanam \|*  
*dadarśa tatra bhūteśaṃ tapastīvraṃ samāśritam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kapardinaṃ śūladharaṃ candrārkakṛtaśekharam \|*  
*pūjayaṃtaṃ paraṃ vyoma suvrataṃ teja sānvitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*gandhamālyopahāraiśca nṛtyagītapravāditaiḥ \|*  
*mukhavādyaiśca bahubhiḥ praṇavastotragītibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjyaiva mahadvyoma jagāma śirasā mahīm \|\| 54 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pūjayantaṃ ca bhāskarastripurāṃtakam \|*  
*tuṣṭovocanmahātejā gośrutābharaṇaṃ haram \|\| 55 \|\|*

*bhīma tuṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ matto vṛṇuṣva vai \|*  
*tavāṃtikamahaṃ prāpto varado bhūbhṛdālaya \|\| 56 \|\|*

*śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ bhānormahādevo mahīpate \|*  
*dadarśa lokanāthaṃ taṃ prajvalaṃtamanuttamam \|*  
*uvāca praṇato bhūtvā aṣṭāṃgairbhūtalaṃ gataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

46-57. Aditya said — “O four-faced one, at the peak of my great vyoma you can live there with all your attendants; Indra is lodged to the east; Shandilya (Agni) in the south-east; Yama in the south; Nirriti in the south-west; Varuna on the west; Vayu in the north-west; Kubera in the north; Shiva in the north-east; Vishnu in the centre, and you will reside besides Vishnu.” On hearing the words of Surya, Brahma spoke lovingly — “O lord of humans, I feel myself to be beholden at the moment.” Thus, Brahma performed his task as per the command of Sungod. Because of the pleasure of the Sungod, he met with total success. O sinless one, after bestowing Brahma with the desired boon, Aditya moved on to the Gandhamadana mountain, where he found lord Shiva — the lord of the bhutas having matted locks of hair over his head, holder of a trident, decorating his head with the crescent moon, who had been engaged in the worship of vyoma offering the fragment garland accompanied with dancing, singing and listening of the recitation from the scriptures, uttering of stotras, playing of mouth organs, with which he was adoring the great vyoma. Surya then witnessed the illustrious Shiva and he expressed great pleasure for the same. Then lord Shiva, with his ears decorated with earrings, was addressed by Surya thus — “O great personality, I am extremely happy with you. You ask for a desired boon from me. O dweller of mountains, I have arrived here to bestow a boon on you.” O lord of earth, listening to the words of Surya, lord Shiva had a look at Surya possessing enormous resplendence. Then he prostrated before the Sungod with reverence.

## \|\| 1.155.58-60 \|\|

*namonamaste deveśa prabhākara divākara \|*  
*śubhālaya śubhādhāra vikartana śubhānana \|\| 58 \|\|*

*prasādaṃ kuru deveśa prasannastvaṃ vikartana \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavamagnasya bhava poto jagatpate \|\| 59 \|\|*

*tavāṃgasaṃbhavo deva putrohaṃ vallabhastava \|*  
*yatkaroti mahādeva pitā putrasya tatkuru \|\| 60 \|\|*

58-60. He said — “Salutation to Deva, Ka, the resplendence, the leader of the day, the auspicious one, having the auspicious face. O lord of Devas, you kindly be merciful on me. Be pleased with me, O lord of the universe, you help me like a boat in the ocean of the universe. O Deva, I was born of your limbs and your loving sons. You do something whatever a father does for his son.”

## \|\| 1.155.61-62 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*evametanna sandeho yathā vadasi śaṃkara \|*  
*lalāṭāttvaṃ samutpannaḥ putraḥ putravatāṃ vara \|\| 61 \|\|*

*varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mananā tvaṃ yamicchasi \|*  
*durdeyaṃ cāpi te dāsye tripurāntaka sundara \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Aditya said — “O Shiva, whatever you say will be done accordingly. You are the best of my sons you had been born out of my forehead. Let you meet with welfare. You ask for a boon us you desire. You are the killer of Tripura and quite handsome. I shall bestow the most difficult thing you desire.”

## \|\| 1.155.63 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca \|*  
*yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva anugrāhyosmi te yadi \|*  
*prayaccha me varaṃ bhāno dehi bhaktiṃ mamācalām \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Mahadeva said — “O Deva, in case you are pleased with me besides being graceful on me, then you kindly bestow on me your unshaking devotion.

## \|\| 1.155.64 \|\|

*devadānavagaṃdharvayakṣarakṣogaṇāṃstathā \|*  
*nirjityāhaṃ yathā deva yugānte saṃhare prajām \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Let me be victorious over Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yakshas and Rakshasas. I should be able to end the world at the end of the yuga.

## \|\| 1.155.65 \|\|

*tathā prayaccha me deva sthānaṃ ca paramaṃ vibho \|*  
*yenāhaṃ hetisarvaṃ ca jaye deva jagatprabho \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. O lord, you grant me the best of position, to enable me to overpower all the weapons.”

## \|\| 1.155.66-67 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagān \|*  
*hariṣyasi jagaccāpi yugānte tripurāntaka \|\| 66 \|\|*

*yadetatpūjitaṃ nityaṃ madrūpaṃ vyoma cotta mam \|*  
*etattriśūlaṃ paramaṃ tava śastraṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*īśāne ca tathā bhāge vyomno vāso bhaviṣyati \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Aditya said — “O Tripurantaka, at the end of yuga, you would be able to destroy the gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas and others, because you have worshipped vyoma which is the best of my forms. Because of this, the trident would be the best of your weapon. You would be lodged in the northwest of Ishana.”

## \|\| 1.155.68 \|\|

*mahādeva uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ bhavatu me deva yaḥ prasādastvayā kṛtaḥ \|*  
*kṛtakṛtyo'smi deveśa yanme devo varapradaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Mahadeva said — “O Deva, whatever has been bestowed by you on me as a boon, let it materialize. I now feel beholden, because a god like you has blessed me with the boons.

## Chapter 156. The story of the gods

## \|\| 1.156.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*itthaṃ dattvā varaṃ bhānurīśvarāya viśāṃ pate \|*  
*śālagrāmaṃ jagāmāśu varaṃ dātuṃ harernṛpa \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O lord of the poison, by thus bestowing the boon to lord Shiva, Surya intended also to bestow a boon over Vishnu, proceeded on to Shalagrama, the place of Vishnu.

## \|\| 1.156.2 \|\|

*dadarśa sa hariṃ tatra tapantaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāntaṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. He found Vishnu performing severe tapas there. He was clad in skin of black buck. He was peaceful and was resplendent with his own lustre.

## \|\| 1.156.3-5 \|\|

*pūjayantaṃ mahadvyoma cakrākāramanaupamam \|*  
*gandhamālyopahāraiśca nṛtyagītapravāditaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃpūjya tadvyoma bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*jagāma śirasā bhūmiṃ hṛdi dhyāyandivākaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

*viṣṇuṃ taṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭo devo vibhāvasuḥ \|*  
*uvāca viṣṇumāmaṃtrya paśya māmāgataṃ hare \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. He was worshipping the circular vyoma, regularly offering it the fragrant flower garlands and other presents. He was engaged in song, dance and music. He was worshipping the great vyoma with devotion and faith. He meditated upon the Sungod in his mind and offered his salutation to him, prostrating on earth. Observing the performance of Vishnu, Surya said to him — “O Krishna, O valorous one, look here, I have arrived.”

## \|\| 1.156.6-8 \|\|

*tadvākyaṃ keśavaḥ śrutvā śirasā ca mahīṃ gataḥ \|*  
*namaste sarvadeveśa namaste gaganecara \|\| 6 \|\|*

*jagatpate namaste'stu grahāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ \|*  
*dāridryavyādhiduḥkhaghna namaste bhavanāśana \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ādityārka rave bhāno bhaga pūrṇa divākara \|*  
*namaste sarvatattvajña sarvapāpavitarjita \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Listening to his words, Keshava offered his salutation to him, prostrating on earth. He said — “O lord of all the gods, salutation to you. Salutation to the Deva who moves in the sky Salutation to the lord of the universe. Salutation the one who removes poverty, ailments and the miseries. Salutation to the one, who relieves one from the pain of death and rebirth. Salutation to the one known by the names of Aditya, Arka, Ravi, Bhanu, Bhaga, Puma and Divakara, and the one who is aware of all the tattvas.

## \|\| 1.156.9 \|\|

*prasīda me jagannātha haṃsānagha divaspate \|*  
*saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ trāhi deva vṛṣadhvaja \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O lord Jagannatha, you are also known as Hamsa, Anagha (sinless) besides the lord of the day. You kindly be pleased with me. O lord with a bull banner, you better save me from drowning in the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.156.10 \|\|

*putro'haṃ tava deveśa dvitīyo brāhmaṇo'nagha \|*  
*piteva putrasya rave dehi kāmāñjagatpate \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O lord of gods, O sinless one, I happen to be your second Brahmana son. O Ravi, O lord of the world, you bestow success to me like a father.”

## \|\| 1.156.11-12 \|\|

*viṣṇorvacanamākarṇya harṣaṃ prāpya divākaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca kuruśārdūla harṣagadgadayā girā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sādhu kṛṣṇa mahābāho tuṣṭohaṃ tava keśava \|*  
*niśamya te parāṃ bhaktiṃ śraddhāṃ ca puruṣottama \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. O lion of the Kuru race, thus listening to the words of Vishnu, the Sungod was extremely pleased and he spoke with a choked voice — “O valorous Krishna, your words are correct. O Keshava, I am extremely pleased with you. I have observed and appreciated your utmost devotion.

## \|\| 1.156.13 \|\|

*varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ vatsa yaṃ manasecchasi \|*  
*varado' hamanuprāpto bhaktyākrāṃtastavānagha \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. You ask for a boon of your desire. O sinless one, I am impressed with your devotion and therefore I have arrived here to bestow a boon on you.”

## \|\| 1.156.14-15 \|\|

*niśamya vacanaṃ bhānorviṣṇurbhaktyā samanvitaḥ \|*  
*kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kṛtakṛtyo'smi deveśa nāsti dhanyataro mama \|*  
*yasya me bhagavaṃstuṣṭo varadastvaṃ gataḥ svayam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Listening to the words of the Sungod, lord Vishnu folded his hands in devotion and said — “O Deva, I feel beholden to you. None else is more graceful than myself, because you have personally arrived here all the way in order to shower a boon on me.

## \|\| 1.156.16 \|\|

*yadi tuṣṭo mama vibhurbhaktyā krīto mayā yadi \|*  
*prayaccha tvacalāṃ bhaktiṃ yathā śatruṃ parājaye \|*  
*tathā mama varaṃ dehi sarvārāti vināśanam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O lord, in case you are pleased with me, then (by bestowing boon) it amounts to purchasing my devotion. Then you bestow the everlasting devotion to me, by which I should be able to be victorious over my enemies. You are the destroyer of all the enemies I have only this much to tell you.

## \|\| 1.156.17 \|\|

*mama sthānaṃ ca paramaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam \|*  
*lokānāṃ pālane yuktiṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ yaśaḥ sukham \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Let me be adorable by all, achieving the best of position. Besides for the maintenance and upkeep of the people, I may be bestowed with wisdom, strength, prowess, glory and the comforts.”

## \|\| 1.156.18-20 \|\|

*evamukto ravirbhaktyā viṣṇunā vākyamuttamam \|*  
*uvāca kuruśārdūla gajatsannādayanniva \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sādhu sādhu mahābāho brahmaṇastvaṃ jaghanyajaḥ \|*  
*harasya agrajaścāpi sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhaktaścāpi mamātyaṃtaṃ brahmaṇyaśca sadānagha \|*  
*tasmāttavācalā bhaktirbhaviṣyati mamopari \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. O lion of Kuru’s race, at these words of Vishnu, the Sungod spoke with thundering voice, which echoed in the world. He said — “O valorous one, well done. You are junior to Brahma but senior from Shiva, you will be adorable by all the gods.

## \|\| 1.156.21 \|\|

*etadeva mahadvyoma cakraṃ te prabhaviṣyati \|*  
*sarvāyudhavaraṃ vīra sarvārātivināśanam \|*  
*tathā sthānaṃ ca paramaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The vyoma in the form of cakra would be your powerful weapon, which with destroy all your enemies. You will achieve the adorable position with this weapon alone.”

## \|\| 1.156.22-23 \|\|

*itthaṃ bhānorvaraṃ prāpya harirdevo jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*mahāprasādamityuktvā jagāma śirasā mahīm \|\| 22 \|\|*

*bhāskaro'pi varaṃ dattvā keśavāyāmitaujase \|*  
*jagāmāśu mahārāja svapuraṃ vibudhādhipaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. After receiving such a great boon by Narayana from the Sungod as a blessing, He accepted it from the Sungod and offered his salutation with humility. He offered his salutation to him with all humility and then he departed for his place. The Sungod also, after bestowing the boon to Vishnu, departed for his place.

## \|\| 1.156.24-30 \|\|

*lokānāṃ pālane śaktiṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ yaśaḥ sukham \|*  
*dattvā kṛṣṇāya deveśastathānyadapi kāṃkṣitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*evaṃ brahmādayo devāḥ pūjayitvā divākaram \|*  
*śaktimaṃto babhūvuste sargādīnāṃ pravartane \|\| 25 \|\|*

*iti te kathitaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*tridaivatyamupākhyānaṃ traisuraṃ lokapūjitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*stotratrayasamāyuktaṃ dharmakāmārthasādhanam \|*  
*dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ tathā puṇyamārogyadhanadhānyadam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhetstotratrayaṃ ca yaḥ \|*  
*so'gneyaṃ yānamārūḍho yāti bhānoḥ para padam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamaśnute \|*  
*vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ prasādādbhāskarasya tu \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ prabhayā pṛśnisannibhaḥ \|*  
*modate suciraṃ kālaṃ jñānināmuttamo bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

24-30. He endowed Shri Krishna with the power to maintain the world, besides strength, prowess, glory and comfort. His desire was also fulfilled. Thus, all the gods including Brahma and others, adored the Sungod and received their respective strength for the purpose. Thus, I have narrated to you the auspicious story, which removes the sins besides the stories relating to the three gods as well as dharma, artha and kama relating to the heaven. These stories increase riches and cereals. Anyone, who listens to the same or recites them, he emplaning the resplendent plans, achieves the excellent loka. By the grace of the Sungod, a childless person gets a son, the pauper gets riches, the student gets education and they become illustrious like the Sun. He, becoming the foremost of the learned people, enjoys bliss for long.

## Chapter 157. Incarnation of Surya

## \|\| 1.157.1-2 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*etanme kautukaṃ brahmanyadvaraṃ brahmaṇe raviḥ \|*  
*dattavāṃstava putratvamanvaye kaśyapasya tu \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yāsyāmi dvijaśārdūla prapannatimirāpahaḥ \|*  
*etanme mahadāścaryaṃ śaṃsa bhūmiṃ kathaṃ vrajet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Shatanika said — O Brahman, Surya bestowed a boon on Brahma that he would be born in the race of Kashyapa as his son. I feel surprised on hearing this, because the Sungod is the destroyer of total darkness, then how could he be born on earth?

## \|\| 1.157.3 \|\|

*devādīnāṃ praṇetā yo yo bhuvi prasavo vibhuḥ \|*  
*sa kathaṃ bhūtale vyoma janmabhāvaṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The one who is the creator of gods on earth, besides the humans and others, how could the same vyoma take birth on earth?

## \|\| 1.157.4-5 \|\|

*kimarthaṃ divyamātmānaṃ janmane sa niyokṣyati \|*  
*yaścakraṃ vartayatyeko brahmādīnāṃ manoramam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sa janmani kathaṃ puṇyāṃ buddhiṃ cakre vidāṃvara \|*  
*gopāyanaṃ yatkurute jagataḥ sarvalaukikam \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. He always remains present as a pleasant cakra for Brahma and other gods. Then how could he inspire his auspicious soul to incarnate on earth? O best of the learned people, he is the one who protects the entire universe with the three lokas, how could he think of incarnating on earth?

## \|\| 1.157.6-14 \|\|

*gobhiḥ pālayate kṛtsnamātmano yaḥ svayaṃ raviḥ \|*  
*mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā yaścakāra dadhāra ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*agarbhaḥ sa kathaṃ garbhamudare yācate vibhuḥ \|*  
*yena gobhiḥ samākrāṃtā vipra lokāścaturdaśa \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sthāpitā jagato mārgāstrivargapravarāstrayaḥ \|*  
*yo'ntakāle jagatpītvā kṛtvā vajramayaṃ vapuḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*lokamekārṇavaṃ cakre dṛśyate svena karmaṇā \|*  
*yaḥ purāṇe purāṇātmā tejasāṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*api sṛṣṭvā dvijaśreṣṭha yaḥ sasarja vasuṃdharām \|*  
*cakāra ca purā yaśca trailokyamidamavyayaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dadau kṛtvā vasumatīṃ surāṇāṃ surasattamaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ sthito hyanalaṃ pītvā saṃvatsaramayaśca yaḥ \|*  
*pātālasthorṇavarasaṃ madhyatoyamayaṃ haviḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*sahasracaraṇaṃ brahmanyamāhurvai yuge yuge \|\| 12 \|\|*

*mukhādyasya samutpanno vedhā lokapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*hariśca vakṣaso yasya lalāṭādyasya śaṃkaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yena te nihatā daityā maṃdehā nāma nāmataḥ \|*  
*brahmādīnāṃ durādharṣo yaḥ sadā vighnanāśanaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

6-14. The Sungod himself looks after all the lokas with his rays and is also known as the creator of the bhutas, besides being the cause of the creation of the bhutas. He is the one who has spread his rays in all the fourteen lokas, he getting deprived of the water, how could be desirous of entering a womb? He is the one who has created in this world, three paths as well as the three pravaras or special gotras and with his vajra like body, consumes the entire world. Then, he turning the entire world as water, keeps on observing it. He takes to the ancient form in the Puranas which is quite illustrious. O best of Brahmanas, he creates the earth and the imperishable one created the three worlds. Making the same earth as Vasumati (quite rich), gave it away to the gods. He is the one who inhaled the fire. He is juice of the ocean of the nether world, besides being the form of Samvatsara (year). In the middle region, he is havi which is consumed. In every yuga, he has been known as a god having a thousand eyes, thousand forms and virtues. From whose face, Brahma — the grandsire emerged, Vishnu emerged from the chest, while Shiva emerged out of the head, who killed the demons known as Mandehas. He is the terrific one for the enemies of the Devas and remover of all their obstructions.

## \|\| 1.157.15-22 \|\|

*sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvāyudhadharaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*ekacakrarathārūḍho garuḍāgrajasārathiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*karāṃte yo jagatsarvaṃ saha dānavarākṣasam \|*  
*prakāśatamamaspṛṣṭaṃ vapuryasya sadā dvija \|\| 16 \|\|*

*pūrvā diśaṃ gato nityamudayācalamakramam \|*  
*nāśayedyastu satataṃ tamo lokasya śāṃtaye \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nāśayitvā tamo yastu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartayet \|*  
*yoktrāṇi dakṣiṇādīkṣya musalolūkhalāni ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*gārhapatyena vidhinā tadvaddhāryeṇa karmaṇā \|*  
*agnimāhavanīṃ caiva vediṃ caiva kuśaṃ srucam \|*  
*prokṣaṇīyavrataṃ caiva avabhṛthaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sarvānimāṃśca yaścakre havyabhāgapradānmukhe \|*  
*havyādāṃśca surānyajñe kavyādāṃśca pitṝnapi \|\| 20 \|\|*

*bhāgārthe madhudhānāya cakre yo yajñakarmaṇi \|*  
*pūṣaṇaṃ ca sutaṃ somaṃ pavitrāmaraṇīmapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yajñāni ca dravyāṇi yajñāṃścāpi saṛtvijaḥ \|*  
*sadasyānyajamānāṃśca medhāvinastathottamān \|\| 22 \|\|*

15-22. He is the one who taking to the form of all the gods, holds all the weapons. He rides the single wheel chariot, makes Aruna the elder brother of Garuda as his charioteer. During the evenings, his body being resplendent, cannot be touched by the demons and the Rakshasas. He rises from the Udayachala mountain from the east and keeps on removing the darkness for peace in the world. After the removal of darkness, he initiates all the holy rites. The rope used in the yajna besides morter and pestle, the fire altar used for invoking fire in the yajna besides the kusha grass, Sruva (ladle) the vratas and baths are essential for yajna, which are arranged all by him. Then creating all the padarthas for homa and havya part is consumed by him. The havyas of the yajna are consumed by the gods, the kavyas are consumed by the pitris with their respective share, Pusha was created in the yajna for consuming Madhu, besides Suta, Soma, Pavitra, Arani, materials for yajna. All of them together with Ritvijas, the illustrious yajamanas were also created.

## \|\| 1.157.23-25 \|\|

*vibabhāja purā sarvaṃ pārameṣṭhayena karmaṇā \|*
