*yaḥ sugandhairmuktapuṣpaiḥ samyagbhānuṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*māghāsite'pi sumanāḥ so'naṃtaphalamaśnute \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. In the dark fortnight of the month of Magha, the one who getting delightful, worships the Sungod with self-grown fragrant flowers, he earns enormous merits.

## \|\| 1.163.74 \|\|

*karavīrairmahārāja saṃyato bhānumarcayet \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Controlling all the sense organs, a person when worships the Sungod offering the oleander flowers, he getting relieved of all the sins, is honoured in the abode of Surya.

## \|\| 1.163.75 \|\|

*agastyakusumairbhaktyā yaḥ sakṛdbhānumarcayet \|*  
*gavāṃ prayutadānasya phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ vrajet \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. A person who with utmost devotion, worships the Sungod once with Agastya flowers, he receives the merit of giving away in charity ten thousand cows.

## \|\| 1.163.76-81 \|\|

*mallikotpalapadmaiśca jātīpunnāgacaṃpakaiḥ \|*  
*aśokaśvetamaṃdārakarṇikārāṃdhukaistathā \|\| 76 \|\|*

*karavīrārkakahlāraśamītagarakeśaraiḥ \|*  
*agastibakapuṣpaistu śatapatrairnarādhipa \|\| 77 \|\|*

*puṣpairetairyathālābhaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayedravim \|*  
*sa tatphalamavāpnoti tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 78 \|\|*

*sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sarvakāmibhiḥ \|*  
*puṣpamālāparikṣiptairgītavāditranāditaiḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*taṃtrīmadhuravādyaiśca svacchaṃdagamanairnṛpa \|*  
*sūryakanyāsamākīrṇairdevānāṃ ca sudurlabhaiḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*dodhūyamānaścamaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*gacchedarkapurīṃ divyāṃ tatra saṃpūjito bhavet \|\| 81 \|\|*

76-81. A person who worships the Sungod offering the flowers like jasmine (Mallika), lotus, Cornell, white lotus or netmug, Champaka, Ashoka, white mandara, oleander, Karnikara, Andhuka, Arkakahlara, Sami, Agara, saffron, Agastya, Baka and the lotus flower, he achieves all the success in the world, which you please listen from me. He becomes resplendent like the crores of suns and all his desires on earth get fulfilled. He roams about in the world, boarding the plane decorated with the garland of flowers, with musical sound emerging from the same. He is surrounded with the divine Surya girls holding the flywhisks. He is praised by the prayers of Devas and Asuras. Reaching the Suryaloka, he is honoured intimately.

## \|\| 1.163.82 \|\|

*yaistaiśca vāpikusumairjalajaiḥ sthalajairnṛpa \|*  
*saṃpūjya śraddhayā bhānumarkaloke mahīyate \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. When a person worships the Sungod with devotion offering the flowers grown on earth or in water, he is honoured in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.163.83-87 \|\|

*sūryasyopari yaḥ kuryācchobhanaṃ puṣpamaṃḍalam \|*  
*śobhitaṃ puṣpasragdāmairāpīṭhāṃtaṃ pralaṃbitaiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*atyāścaryamahāyānairdivyapuṣpopaśobhitaḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāmupariṣṭācca vasedarkapure sukhī \|\| 84 \|\|*

*anekarāgavinyastaiḥ sugandhaiḥ kusumairgṛham \|*  
*yaḥ kuryātparvakāle tu vicitrakusumojjvalam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*sa puṣpakavimānena puṣpamālākulena tu \|*  
*puṣpetarapuraṃ divyaṃ śrayate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*akṣayaṃ modate kālamatiraskṛtaśāsanaḥ \|*  
*saurādisarvalokeṣu yatreṣṭaṃ tatra yāti saḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

83-87. A person who arranges the entire outer surface of the Sun temple with flower decorations, which hang upto the Pithasana, he getting decorated with the divine flowers, mounting over a wonderful plane, reaches Suryaloka where he lives with comfort. A person, who at the time of a function, decorates the temple with flowers, beautifying it, he having been adorned with flowers, is lodged over the Pushpaka plane, and is lodged in the divine city of Pushpapura. There is no doubt about it Then he, in a commanding position, feels blissful and moves in all the lokas with delight.

## Chapter 164. Description of Surya Shashthi-vrata

## \|\| 1.164.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*punastvaṃ devadevasya bhāskarasya mahaujasaḥ \|*  
*pūjane yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tanme brūhi dvijottama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O best of the Brahmanas, by worshipping the immensely resplendent Sungod, one earns the merits which have already been spoken by you. Could you kindly repeat them?

## \|\| 1.164.2 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu tvaṃ hi mahārāja sarvadaṃ lokapūjitam \|*  
*brahmeśopeṃdradevānāṃ trayāṇāmapi bhārata \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sumantu said — O great king, the story which bestows everything and is adored by Brahma, Vishnu besides everyone else, is going to be narrated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.164.3-4 \|\|

*sukhāsīnaṃ surajyeṣṭhaṃ manovatyāṃ caturmukham \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā bhūmau viṣṇvīśau vākyamūcatuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ya eṣa bhagavāndevaḥ sahasrakiraṇo raviḥ \|*  
*asya yatpūjane puṇyaṃ prāpyate tadvadasva nau \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. O Bharata, once seated at the bank of Manovati, over the ground, he was addressed by Vishnu and Maheshvara — “The Sungod of a thousand rays is visible, what merit does a man earn by worshipping him?”

## \|\| 1.164.5 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sādhu sādhu jagannātha sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi vāmiha \|*  
*tasmācchṛṇutamekāgrau gadato nikhilaṃ mama \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma said — Well done, O lord of the universe, you have put me an excellent question. I am speaking all about the same, therefore, you listen to me with attention.

## \|\| 1.164.6-8 \|\|

*svayamutpādya puṣṇāṇi yaḥ sūryaṃ pūjayetsvayam \|*  
*tāni sākṣātpragṛhṇāti tadbhaktyā satataṃ raviḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yastvārāmaṃ raveḥ kuryādāmrabilvādiśobhitam \|*  
*jātīvijayarājārkakaravīraiḥ sakuṃkumaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*punnāganāgabakulairaśokatilacaṃpakaiḥ \|*  
*agastikadalīkhaṃḍaistasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. A person who worships the Sungod with the self grown flowers, the Sungod is attracted towards his devotion and accepts the same, appearing before him. A person who creates a garden for the Sungod, planting the trees like mango, wood apple etc., and decorating it with Cornell (jasmine), Vijayaraja, Arka, oleander, saffron, Punnaga, Naga, Bakula, Asoka, sesamum, Champa, Agastya and the banana trees beautifying it at the same time, you listen to the merit which is earned by such a person.

## \|\| 1.164.9 \|\|

*yāvaddhi patraṃ kusumaṃ bījaṃ sūtaphalāni ca \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Till such time the trees keep on growing leaves, besides seeds, flowers and fruits, the said person is honoured for the period equivalent to the number of years multiplied by thousand.

## \|\| 1.164.10-12 \|\|

*saghṛtaṃ guggulaṃ dadyādrājanvā kaṃduruṃ tathā \|*  
*caturvedigṛhe janma prāpnoti satataṃ sukhī \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇāguruṃ ca karpūradhūpaṃ dadyāddivākare \|*  
*nairaṃtaryeṇa yastasya rājanpuṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca \|*  
*bhuktvā sūryapure bhogāṃstasyāṃte kṣmādhipo bhavet \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. A person who offers the Sungod, ghi with guggula and kunduru, he is reborn in the house of a Chaturvedi and always remains comfortable there. A person who daily offers the black Agaru, camphor and incense to the Sungod, listen to the merits earned by him. He enjoys all the comforts in the Suryaloka for a hundred crores of kalpas. Ultimately, he is born as a king on earth.

## \|\| 1.164.13 \|\|

*gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyu्ktaṃ yakṣo gṛhṇāti śabdakṛt \|*  
*yakṣāhvayasya dānena tasya loke mahīyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. With the offering of the guggula mixed with ghi y the Yakshas accept him creating musical sound with the charities extended by him, and he is honoured in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.14 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāṃśau kṛṣṇa saptamyāṃ yaḥ sājyaṃ gugguluṃ dahet \|*  
*sa cāsau sauramāsādya varṣāṇāṃ ca daśārbudam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. On the dark seventh moon day, one who offers to the Sungod ghi with guggula, he reaching in the Suryaloka, stays there for a period of ten hundred million years.

## \|\| 1.164.15 \|\|

*devadāruṃ nameruṃ ca śrīvāsaṃ kuṃduruṃ tathā \|*  
*śrīphalaṃ cājyasaṃyuktaṃ dagdhvāśrayamavāpnuyāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. By burning Devadaru (Cedar), Nameru, Shrivasa, Kunduru and Shriphala should be fried in ghi and then used as incense and by so doing, one achieves the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.16 \|\|

*evaṃ saugadhikaṃ rūpaṃ ṣaṭsahasraguṇottaram \|*  
*aguruṃ daśasāhasraṃ saghṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thus, by offering the ordinary fragrance, one achieves a thousand merits, when offered with the combination of ghi the merit multiplies to ten thousand, and when it is mixed with ghi, the merit is doubled.

## \|\| 1.164.17-18 \|\|

*anaṃtaphaladaṃ devaṃ sadā kuṃdurukāmukam \|*  
*dvisahasrapalānāṃ tu mahiṣākṣasya gugguloḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dagdhvārdhamavimiśrasya sūryatulyaḥ prajāyate \|*  
*śodhayetpāpasaṃyuktaṃ puruṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The kundaru fruit is the favourite of the Sungod and by presenting the same to him along with guggula, the performer looks graceful like the Sun himself. By this way, the sinners are corrected. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.164.19-22 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāgurubhavaṃ dhūpaṃ tuṣāgniriva kāṃcanam \|*  
*yoṃtaḥpuragṛhaṃ gandhaiḥ sugandhaiḥ pravilepayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kapāṭadvārakuḍyāditiryagūrdhvaṃ savedikam \|*  
*vāsayetpuṣpamālābhirdhūpaiścāpi sugaṃdhibhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tasya puṇyaṃ yathāvattu yuvayorvacmi kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*āpūrayandiśaḥ sarvā nānāgaṃdha samanvitaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kalpakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ tejasā vahnisannibhaḥ \|*  
*śakravatprajvalandevaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. A person who fills the interior with smoke of agaru like the smoke of the husk, including the gates, shutters, doors, besides the latches and spreads fragrance from the flowers in all the parts of the temple, I am speaking out the details of the related merits earned by him. By spreading fragrance of various types in all the directions, then earning enormous resplendence, he earns the Indra like beauty and is honoured in the Suryaloka for a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 1.164.23-24 \|\|

*tasyāṃte dharmaśeṣeṇa trailokyā dhipatirbhavet \|*  
*śatāvṛtaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādevaṃ gandhairbhagālayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sa sarvaśarmasaṃyuktaḥ sūryatulyaparākramaḥ \|*  
*sūryaloke vaseddevo yuvābhyāṃ saṃprapū jitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Thereafter, on the decline of dharma, he becomes the leader of all the three worlds. In this way, if a person perfumes the Sun temple a thousand times, he becoming valorous like the Sungod himself, lives in the Suryaloka and is worshipped by Shiva and Vishnu.

## \|\| 1.164.25 \|\|

*tadvacchuklaiśca saṃvītaṃ paṭṭasūtrairvinirmitam \|*  
*dattvopavītaṃ sūryāya bhavedvedāṃgapāragaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. One who offers the white yajnopavita for the Sungod, he becomes learned in the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.164.26-27 \|\|

*vāsāṃsi suvicitrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate \|*  
*truṭimātraṃ tu yo dadyādūrṇāvastraṃ sapaṃkajam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*bhāskarasyottamāṃgeṣu tasya puṇyaṃ bravīmyaham \|*  
*indrasyārdhāsane tiṣṭhedyāvadrindrāścaturdaśa \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. With the offering of various coloured costumes, the donor earns respect in the Suryaloka. But a person who offers him with the lotus flowers, the merit he achieves is being related by me. Till such time the fourteen Indras would live, he becomes entitled to half a seat of Indra.

## \|\| 1.164.28-29 \|\|

*evaṃ vittānusāreṇa sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ samāsataḥ \|*  
*sarveṣāṃ hemapātrāṇāṃ mukuṭānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*arkapatrapuṭaṃ cūrṇaṃ madhuparṇasamanvitam \|*  
*yo nivedayate'rkāya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thus, one should give away a crown and the golden vase for the Sun. In the cups made of the leaves of swallow wort, the powder and honey should be placed and one who offers the same to the Sungod, he earns the merit of performing the Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.164.30-32 \|\|

*śālitaṃḍulaprasthasya kuryādannaṃ susaṃskatam \|*  
*sūryāya ca caruṃ dattvā saptamyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*saṃyāvaṃ kṛśaraṃ pūpaṃ pāyasaṃ yāvakaṃ tathā \|*  
*dadhyodanarasālānnamodakānguḍapūpakān \|\| 31 \|\|*

*yāvaṃtastaṇḍulāstasminnaivedye parisaṃkhyayā \|*  
*tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. Preparing payasam with good rice which should be quite tasteful, it should be offered to the Sungod. It should be particularly offered on the seventh moon day, this has been prescribed. Besides the jelly, a mixture of rice and pulses, the fried cakes and the barley payasam, curd, boiled rice, mango, sweet balls, fried cakes made of sugarcane balls, should also be offered similarly and by so doing, the number of rice seeds that remain in the payasam, he lives for the same number of years in Suryaloka multiplied with thousand.

## \|\| 1.164.33 \|\|

*guḍakhaṃḍakṛtānāṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ vinivedane \|*  
*ghṛtena plāvitānāṃ ca phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The eatables made of sugar and ghi, which are well prepared, when offered to the Sungod, one earns a hundred times more the merit.

## \|\| 1.164.35 \|\|

*yathākālopalabdhāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca \|*  
*nivedyārkāya paramaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti pūjanāt \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By offering the mango fruit, one earns merit equal to the offering of eatables. With the offering of the fragrant waters, one earns half of the merit.

## \|\| 1.164.36 \|\|

*prajvālya ghṛtadīpaṃ tu bhāskarasyālaye śubham \|*  
*āgneyaṃ yānamāruhya gacchetsaumanasaṃ puram \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. By offering various types of food items for the Sungod and also by worshipping him, one achieves the best of the merit.

## \|\| 1.164.37 \|\|

*yaḥ kuryātkārtike māsi śobhanāṃ dīpamālikām \|*  
*saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāmāvāsyāyāmathāpi vā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. By burning the lamps of pure ghi in the Sun temple, a person mounting over the Agneya plane, reaches Devaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.38-40 \|\|

*bhāskarāyutasaṃkāśastejasā bhāsayandiśaḥ \|*  
*divyābharaṇasaṃpannaḥ kulamuddhṛtya sarvaśaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*yāvatpradīpasaṃkhyānaṃ ghṛtenāpūrya bodhitam \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

*dīpavṛkṣamathodbodhya parvasvāyataneṣu vai \|*  
*pūrvasmāddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. On the seventh and sixth moon day of the month of Karttika as also on the moonless night of the month of Karttika, one who provides the garland of lamps, he earning the lustre of the sun, illuminating the directions like him, adorned with the divine ornaments, redeems his race and stays in the Suryaloka for the same number of years, as the number of lamps burnt. On festive occasions, one who lights the tree of lamps in the temples, he earns double the merit. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.164.41 \|\|

*dīpavṛkṣaṃ samudbodhya bhāskarāyataneṣu bhoḥ \|*  
*sarvalohamayaṃ vīra raviloke mahīyate \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. A person who erects an iron tree with leaves, branches, boughs etc. placing the lamps over each one of the available space and lights these lamps, he also is adored in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.42-43 \|\|

*śirasā dhārayeddīpaṃ bhāskarasyāgrato niśi \|*  
*lalāṭe caiva hastābhyāṃ samudyuktastatho rasi \|\| 42 \|\|*

*bhāskarāyutasaṃkāśo vimānairarkasannibhaiḥ \|*  
*kalpāyutaśataṃ caiva sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. By placing the lamps over the tip, the head, the hands and the heart of the tree, such a person, gaining the lustre of ten thousand Suryas and riding over the resplendent planes, is honoured in Suryaloka for a hundred thousand kalpas in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.44-45 \|\|

*annadātā tu yo vīra vīraloke mahī yate \|*  
*bhāskarasyāgrato dattvā darpaṇaṃ nirmalaṃ śubham \|\| 44 \|\|*

*paryaṃke śobhitaṃ kṛtvā śvetamālyaiḥ sacandanaiḥ \|*  
*vṛkārkanirmalaḥ śrīmāndivyābharaṇa rūpadhṛk \|*  
*kalpāyutasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. A person who donates food for the Sungod is established in the Suryaloka. Placing an auspicious bed decorated with a looking glass, garlands of white colour, as well as the sandal wood, when donated to the Sungod, the concerned person becomes spotless like the tree (or Agni) or the Sungod, and is endowed with all the grace, divine ornaments, and is respected in the Suryaloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.46 \|\|

*kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā śraddadhāno ravernaraḥ \|*  
*aśvamedhasahasrasya sukhena labhate phalam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A person who goes round the image of the Sungod with devotion, he comfortably achieves the merit of performing a thousand Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.164.47 \|\|

*kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yastu namaskāraṃ prayojayet \|*  
*rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ sakalaṃ vindate phalam \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. One who offers his salutation to the Sungod after circumambulating him, he achieves the total merits of Rajasuya as well as Ashvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.164.48 \|\|

*namaskāraḥ smṛto yajñaḥ sarvayajño ttamottamaḥ \|*  
*namaskṛtvā sahasrāṃśumaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. This is because, of all the sacrifices, salutation is said to be the best of sacrifice Therefore, with the offering of a salutation to the Sungod, one is said to achieve the merit of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.164.49 \|\|

*praṇamya daṃḍavadbhūmau namaskāreṇa yo'rcayet \|*  
*sa yāṃ gatimavāpnoti na tāṃ kratu śatairapi \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. One who worships the Sungod by prostrating over the ground, he achieves the position, which is beyond the reach of a person who performs a hundred sacrifices.

## \|\| 1.164.50 \|\|

*sarvayajñopavāsepu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam \|*  
*abhijñāpyopahāreṇa pūjayā phalamaśnute \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The extent of merit one achieves with the performing of all the yajnas, fasting or visiting to all the holy places, the same merit is achieved by a person by appropriately performing the puja of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.164.51-52 \|\|

*śvetaṃ mahādhvajaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā cāpaṃ ca raṃgakam \|*  
*kiṃkiṇījālanirghoṣaṃ mayūracchatrabhūṣitam \|*  
*yastvaryamṇe naro dadyācchraddhayā parayānvitaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sa śatena vimānānāṃ sarvadeva namaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*manvantaraśataṃ deva modate divi devavat \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Developing immense devotion in his mind, when a person offers a white flag and red bow decorated with the small bells, creating sweet sound and decorated with peacock feathers, he becomes adorable by all the gods in the heaven, with hundreds of planes. Then he lives in the heaven for as many years equivalent to a hundred Manvantaras and enjoys bliss like gods there.

## \|\| 1.164.53-54 \|\|

*dhvajamālākulaṃ kuryādyaḥ prāṃteṣu bhagālayam \|*  
*mahādhvajāṣṭakaṃ cāpi digvidikṣu nivedayet \|\| 53 \|\|*

*sa vimānasahasreṇa dhvajamālākulena tu \|*  
*kalpāyutaśataṃ divyaṃ modete divi sūravat \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. A person, who decorates the comers of the Sun temple with flags and garlands, and also places eight big flags in all the directions, he, putting in his control a thousand planes, enjoys all the bliss in the Suryaloka for a hundred thousand kalpas.

## \|\| 1.164.55-59 \|\|

*śatacandrāṃśuvimalaṃ muktādāmopaśobhitam \|*  
*maṇidaṃḍamayaṃ chatraṃ dadyādvā kāṃcanādikam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*sa dhāryamāṇacchatreṇa hemadaṃḍopaśobhinā \|*  
*modate sūryaloke tu vimānavaramā sthitaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tatastasmāccyuto lokānnisargādbhuvamāgataḥ \|*  
*bhuṅkte samudraparyaṃtāmekacchatrāṃ vasundharām \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yaḥ śṛṃkhalāsamāyuktāṃ mahāghaṇṭāṃ mahāsvanām \|*  
*kāṃsyalohamayīṃ vāpi nibadhnīyādbhagālaye \|\| 58 \|\|*

*śobhanaḥ syānnaraḥ śrīmānbhagasyātīva vallabhaḥ \|*  
*sūryatulyabalo bhūtvā sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 59 \|\|*

55-59. A person, who donates a spotless chhatra or umbrella decorated with the strings of beads and a staff of gems or puts the danda of gold, then he, holding the chhatra with a golden danda, boards an excellent plane and reaches the Suryaloka where he always lives comfortably there. Then after falling from that place, he is reborn on earth in due course of time and becomes an exclusive monarch and rules the earth surrounded by the oceans. A person who hangs a huge bronze bell with a chain in the Surya temple creating loud sound, «tub a prison attains enormous grace and becomes as valorous as the Sungod himself, and is honoured in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.60-61 \|\|

*bherīmṛdaṃgapaṭahajharjharīmardalādikam \|*  
*daśakāṃsyādivāditraṃ yo bhagāya nivedayet \|\| 60 \|\|*

*sa vimānairmahābhāgervaṃśavīṇāyutasvanaiḥ \|*  
*yugāntakaśataṃ divyaṃ bhagaloke mahīyate \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. A person who donates for the Sungod a kettle drum, cymbals, big kettle drum, a tambourine, besides the bronze musical instruments, he achieves a fortunate plane, which produces the sweet sound of flute, and stays there in the Suryaloka for a hundred yugas.

## \|\| 1.164.62 \|\|

*susaṃgītakadānena savādyena viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yatheṣṭaṃ bhāskare loke modate kālamakṣayam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Especially arranging for a musical consort with related instruments, a person stays in the abode of Surya for everlasting time and enjoys all the desired comforts there.

## \|\| 1.164.63 \|\|

*mahāmahāsvanaṃ dattvā śaṃkhayugmaṃ bhagālaye \|*  
*yugakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ bhagaloke mahīyate \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. When a person donates two conches in the Sun temple which produce divine sound, he gets established there for a hundred crores of yugas, enjoying all the honours there.

## \|\| 1.164.64-67 \|\|

*vimānaṃ bahuvarṇābhaṃ madhye paṃkajabhūṣitam \|*  
*vicitramekavarṇaṃ vāsanavastropakalpitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kiṃkiṇījālasaṃpannaṃ varṇakaiścopaśobhitam \|*  
*puṣpamālāprabhaṃ vāpi ghaṃṭācāmarabhūṣitam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*bhagasyopari yo dadyātsarvaratnopaśobhitam \|*  
*dukūlapaṭṭadevāṃgairvastrairvā varṇakānvitaiḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*paṭṭādivastrataṃtūnāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yā bhavet \|*  
*tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate \|\| 67 \|\|*

64-67. A person who presents a plane to the Sungod with several types of colours and coloured costumes decorated with a lotus in the middle of it, besides asanas decorated with clothes of different colours, small twinkling hells like a net in different colours, adorned with several types of flower garlands, a gong and fly whisks beautified with several types of flower petals, with the paintings of goddesses clad in various types of costumes and scarfs of different colours, he is adored in the Suryaloka for the number of years equivalent to the number of threads used in the costumes.

## \|\| 1.164.68 \|\|

*bhagāhutyā jagatsarvaṃ sṛṣṭidvāreṇa dhāryate \|*  
*agnivartmā vacasyukto hyagnirasyātmajaḥ sadā \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. The world is lost in Surya like Ahuti which is recreated in the same, the process is also called as Agni-vartma because the fire is always close to him.

## \|\| 1.164.69 \|\|

*yastvagnikāryaṃ vidhivatkuryānnityaṃ bhagālaye \|*  
*bhagamuddiśya rājeṃdra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. A person who daily consecrates the fire in a Sun temple, he achieves the best of position.

## \|\| 1.164.70-71 \|\|

*sarvānnaṃ yāvakopetaṃ yastu nityavidhiṃ haret \|*  
*puṣpadhūpajalopetaṃ kālekāle viśeṣataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*mahāśvetādimātṝṇāṃ trikalpānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ kṛtvā sakṛdapyevaṃ sarvadikṣu baliṃ haret \|*  
*sa naraśca sahasrāṇi śāṃḍileyapure vaset \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. One who appropriately offers seven cereals with porridge, with all types of foods, besides flowers and incense with water in due time to the mothers including Mahashveta even once, besides making offerings in all the directions, he earns his stay in Agniloka for a thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.72 \|\|

*saurasaṃdhyābaliṃ kṛtvā dināṃte satataṃ raveḥ \|*  
*varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ bhagaloke mahīyate \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. At the close of the day, with the offerings of Saura-Sandhya besides bali, he earns great respect in the Suryaloka for a thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.73-76 \|\|

*dadhyodanapayobhiryaḥ pūritaṃ pātramāvṛtam \|*  
*puṣpadhūpārcitaṃ caiva vitānopari śobhitam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*śirasā dhārayetpātraṃ śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇam \|*  
*ravyāyatanaparyaṃte śaṃkhavīṇādinisvanaiḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*darpaṇairdhūpamālābhirgeyanṛtyādiśobhitam \|*  
*bhānorhi smṛtiśīlaśca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 75 \|\|*

*divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ tathā \|*  
*tapastaptaṃ mahattena bhavedevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

73-76. Preparing the vases containing curd, boiled rice and milk, then they should be adored with flowers and incense. Then they should be placed over the canopy. Thereafter, carrying the vases over his head one by one, he should proceed towards the Sun temple as if circumambulating it accompanied with the sound of flute, conchs and other musical instruments. Besides the giving of mirror, incense and garlands should also be offered. The singing and dancing should also be performed. The performer should always devote his mind towards the Sungod. In case he so performs, he will earn the merits which are going to be spoken by me. According to the merits earned by him, he is as good as having performed tapas for a divine thousand years or he performed great divine tapas for a hundred years. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.164.77 \|\|

*bhagabhaktiprasannātmā yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt \|*  
*bhagaloke vasennityaṃ bhagānucaratāṃ gataḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Even if one is a great sinner, but with the adoration of the Sungod he gains enormous pleasure. Such an attendant of Surya also stays in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.164.78 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhīṃ naktena yaśca kṛṣṇāṃ ca saptamīm \|*  
*iha bhogānavāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. One who performs fasting on the dark sixth moon day of the month and worships the Sungod on the seventh moon day of a month, then enjoying several types of pleasures on earth, he attains auspicious merits in the other world.

## \|\| 1.164.79-82 \|\|

*yobdamekaṃ tu kurvīta naktaṃ bhagadine naraḥ \|*  
*brahmacārī jitakrodho bhagārcanaparo naraḥ \|*  
*ayācitātparaṃ naktaṃ tasmannāktena vartayet \|\| 79 \|\|*

*devaistu bhuktaṃ madhyāhne pūrvāhṇe ṛṣibhistathā \|*  
*aparāhṇe tu pitṛbhiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

*sarvā velā hyatikramya saurāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ param \|*  
*bhuṃjāno naktakāle tu sūryabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*bhagalokamavāpnoti sumanāḥ sumanovrataḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā saumanasāṃllokānrā jā bhavati bhūtale \|\| 82 \|\|*

79-82. Therefore, throughout the year, on solar days, discarding anger, a Brahmachari should perform the fasting at night. The fasting at night is considered to be the best when consuming food is not sought after. Therefore, the fasting at night must be done. The Devas at noon, the Rishis in the forenoon and the manes in the evening take their food. Therefore, taking of the food should be resorted to by the devotees of Surya except during the times prescribed above. A person who performs the devotion of the Sungod, takes his food at night, then becoming a Devavrati like the gods, he reaches the solar region. Thereafter, when the sporting of the gods is completed, he becomes a monarch on earth.

## \|\| 1.164.83 \|\|

*haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānamāhārasya ca lāghavam \|*  
*agnikāryamadhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhojī samācaret \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Consuming of havishya food, daily bath, taking of little food, consecration of the fire and sleeping over the earth are the essential parts of the performing of the vrata by a person who performs vrata at night.

## \|\| 1.164.84 \|\|

*kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ prayatnena kṛtvā naktaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*naro mārgaśire māsi aṃśumāniti pūjayeta \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. On the black sixth moon day of the month of Margashirsha, one should complete the process of night fasting and should worship Amshuman form of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.164.85-86 \|\|

*vidhivatprāśya gomūtramanāhāro niśi svapet \|*  
*atirātrasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

*puṣyepyevaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ bhānumaṃtamuśaṃti ca \|*  
*vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya ghṛtaṃ prāśya labhennaraḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

85-86. By appropriately using the cow’s urine for breaking of the fast, one should sleep at night. A person who does so, earns the merit of performing the Atiratri yajna. Similarly, one should worship Sahasramshu form of Surya and finalize it with the sipping of the ghi. One who does so, earns the merit of performing the Vajapeya sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.164.87 \|\|

*māghe divākaraṃ nāma kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ narottama \|*  
*niśi pītvā tu gokṣīraṃ gomedhaphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. O best of humans, on the dark sixth moon day of the month of Magha, Surya should be adored in the form of Divakara and the devotee should consume cow’s milk. One who does so, earns the merit of performing Gomedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.164.88 \|\|

*mārtaṃḍaṃ phālgune māsi pūjayitvā gavāṃ payaḥ \|*  
*pibettataḥ sūryaloke modate so'yutāyutam \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. During the month of Phalguna, one should adore the Martanda form of Surya and break his fast with the drinking of milk. One who does so, he earns comforts in the Suryaloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.89 \|\|

*caitre māsi vivasvaṃtaṃ pūjayitvā subhaktimān \|*  
*haviṣyāśī sūryaloke'psarobhiḥ saha modate \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. A devoted person should adore the Vivasvan form of the Sungod in the month of Chaitra, and should conclude the fast by consuming havishya. By doing so, he sports in the heaven with the Apsaras.

## \|\| 1.164.90 \|\|

*vaiśākhe caṇḍakiraṇaṃ pūjayecca payovrataḥ \|*  
*varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate sūryasaṃnidhau \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. One who worships the Chandakirana form of Surya and breaks his fast by consuming milk, he enjoys all the pleasures with the Sungod for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.91 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe divaspatiṃ pūjya gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ pibet \|*  
*gavāṃ koṭipradānasya nikhilaṃ phalamā pnuyāt \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. During the month of Jyeshtha, one who adores the Divaspati form of Surya, offering water with a horn, he earns the merit comparable with the donating of a crores of cows.

## \|\| 1.164.92 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe tvarkanāmānamiṣṭvā prāśya ca gomayam \|*  
*prayātyarkasalokaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃśatam \|\| 92 \|\|*

92\. During the month of Ashadha one who worships the Arka form of the Sungod, and breaks the fasts with the tasting of the cowdung, he comfortably lives in the Suryaloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.93 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe'ryamanāmānaṃ pūjayitvā payaḥ pibet \|*  
*varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ modate bhāskarālaye \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. During the month of Shravana, one who worships the Aryama form of the Sungod, and breaks the fast consuming water or milk, he enjoys all the comforts in the Suryaloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 1.164.94 \|\|

*māsi bhādrapade ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhāskaraṃ nāma pūjayet \|*  
*bhāskaraṃ paṃcagavyasya sarvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. A person who adores Bhaskara during the month of Bhadrapada and concludes the fast with the consuming of the panchagavya, he earns the merit of performing of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.164.95 \|\|

*māsi cāśvayuje ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhagākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet \|*  
*palagomūtrabhukcaiva aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. In case, Bhaga form of Surya is worshipped by a person during the month of Ashvina and in case he breaks the fast with the consuming of cow’s urine, he achieves the merit comparable with the performing of the Ashvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 1.164.96 \|\|

*māse tu kārtike ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śakrākhyaṃ nāma pūjayet \|*  
*dūrvāṃkuraṃ sakṛtprāśya rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. During the month of Karttika, on the sixth moon day, if a person adores Shakra form of Surya and breaks his fast by consuming the durva grass shoots, he earns the merit of performing the Rajasuya yajna.

## \|\| 1.164.97-99 \|\|

*varṣāṃte bhojayedviprānsūryabhaktiparāyaṇān \|*  
*pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ vajreṇa ca pariplutam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*śaktyā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi bhaktyā tebhyo nivedayet \|*  
*nivedayecca sūryāya kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm \|\| 98 \|\|*

*varṣamekaṃ ca deve vai nairaṃtaryeṇa yo nayet \|*  
*kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 99 \|\|*

97-99. At the end of the year, a devotee of Surya should feed the Brahmanas with payasam and honey besides giving gold, costumes and a black milking cow for the Sungod. Thus, with the completion of the year, one who performs the shashthi vrata for the Sungod, listen the merit he earns from the same.

## \|\| 1.164.100 \|\|

*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*modate sūryaloke tu sa naraḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. He getting relieved of all the sins, gets all his desires fulfilled. He ultimately achieves Suryaloka, where he enjoys all the comforts for many years.

## \|\| 1.164.101 \|\|

*puṇyeṣvahaḥsu sarveṣu viṣuvadgrahaṇādiṣu \|*  
*dānopavāsahomādyairakṣayaṃ khaga jāyate \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. O mover of the sky, on all the auspicious days including the days of eclipse, one should give away the charities, keep fast and perform homa, with which one achieves the eternal place.

## \|\| 1.164.102-103 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ityuktavānpurā bhānuraruṇāya viśāṃpate \|*  
*kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham \|\| 102 \|\|*

*kṛtvedaṃ puruṣo bhaktyā bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

102-103. Sumantu said — This is how the Sungod had spoken to Arupa in the earlier times. With the performing of the vrata on the dark sixth moon day appropriately, the devotee becomes invincible, possessing the lustre of the Sun and finally achieves the place of the Sungod.

## Chapter 165. Ubhaya Saptami described

## \|\| 1.165.1 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ te saṃpravakṣyāmi sūryasyavrattamuttamam \|*  
*dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ pratipādanamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — I am now going to place before you the method of performing the last vrata of Surya. In this vrata, dharma, artha, kama and moksha have been well defined.

## \|\| 1.165.2-11 \|\|

*pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*jiteṃdriyaḥ satyavādī śāligodhūmagorasaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pakṣayoḥ saptamīṃ yatnādupavāsena yāpayet \|*  
*trisaṃdhyamarcayedbhānuṃ śāṃḍileyaṃ ca suvrata \|\| 3 \|\|*

*adhaḥśāyī bhavennityaṃ sarvabhogaviva rjitaḥ \|*  
*māsi pūrṇe tu saptamyāṃ ghṛtādibhirariṃdama \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kṛtvā snānaṃ mahāpūjāṃ sūryadevasya bhāsta \|*  
*naivedyaṃ modakaprasthaṃ kṣīraṃ siddhaṃ nivedayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhojayecca dvijānaṣṭau bhagārcā śubhalakṣaṇām \|*  
*gāṃ ca dattvā mahārāja kapilāṃ bhāskarāya tu \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ya evaṃ kurute puṇyaṃ sūryasya vratamuttamam \|*  
*tasya puṇya phalaṃ vacmi sarvakāmasamanvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sūryakoṭipratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|*  
*apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇairmahāvibhavasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saṃgītanṛtyavādyādyairgaṃdharvagaṇaśobhitaiḥ \|*  
*dodhūyamānaścamaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sahasrakiraṇābhāsaḥ sauraiḥ sūryasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatrāste raviraṃśumān \|\| 10 \|\|*

*romasaṃkhyā tu yā tasyāstatprasūtiḥ kuleṣu ca \|*  
*tāvadyugasahasrāṇi sūraloke mahīyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

2-11. In the month of Pausha, a person who has controlled all his senses and is truthful, should consume the Shall rice, wheat and butter milk on the seventh moon days of both the fortnights, observing fast, should adore Surya and Agni in the morning, noon and evening, and should sleep on the floor, discarding all the pleasures. Then at the end of the month, on the seventh moon day, he should take his bath, should perform the great puja of the Sungod and offers as naivedya 950 grams of sweet balls, besides the well boiled milk to the Sungod. After feeding eight Brahmanas and giving the auspicious milk of the white cow to them, in case he does so appropriately, he earns enormous merit from the same. This vrata bestows all the desires, and the merits such a person earns, are being spoken by me. You please listen. He is surrounded by crores of Apsaras shining like the Sungod. He is seated over the plane with enormous fortunes, enjoying the dance and music, adding grandeur with the presence of the Gandharvas, who wear the beautiful flywhisks, he is praised by the Rakshasas as well as the Asuras, he shines like the lord of a thousand rays, and he is accompanied with the devotees of the Sungod. Then, he achieves the place of Amshuman form of the Sungod. The numbers of hair as are there over the body of a cow, his generations enjoy the progress for the same number of years. For an equivalent number of years (as those of the hair on the body of a cow), he is well established in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.165.12 \|\|

*triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān \|*  
*jñānayogaṃ samāsādya punareva pramucyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Enjoying all the pleasures as per his desires, with his twenty one generations and attaining high learnings, he is redeemed again.

## \|\| 1.165.13-14 \|\|

*yogādduḥkhāṃtamāpnoti jñānayogaṃ pravartate \|*  
*sauradharmādbhavejjñānaṃ sauradharmo bhagārcanāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ te samākhyātaṃ bhavārṇavavyapohanam \|*  
*sauramokṣakramopāyaṃ sūrāśrayaniṣevaṇam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. In this way are the miseries removed in the first yoga. Thereafter, there is the rise of jnana-yoga and with the worship of the Sungod, one achieves the solar dharma. Thus, I have completed the description of the said vrata, which destroys the travel of the ocean of the universe. The reason for the redemption from solar region always depends on the same and is said to serve the same.

## \|\| 1.165.15-17 \|\|

*māghamāse tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*piṇyākaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhuṃjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sopavāsaśca saptamyāṃ bhavedubhayapakṣayoḥ \|*  
*ghṛtābhiṣekamaṣṭamyāṃ kuryādbhānornarādhipa \|*  
*gāṃ ca dayāddineśāya taruṇīṃ nīlasaṃnibhām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*indranīlapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ śikhisaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ bhogānbhuṃkte yathepsitān \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. O lord of the people, a person who during the seventh moon day of the month of Magha, takes food during the night and breaks the fast with ghi mixed with saffron, controlling all his senses, observing fast on both the moon days of the month, and performs abhisheka of the Sungod on the eighth moon day and gives a blue cow for the Sungod, he reaches the Suryaloka mounting over the plane made of sapphire and is protected by the peacocks. He reaches the Suryaloka, where he enjoys all the comforts of his liking.

## \|\| 1.165.18-21 \|\|

*rājeṃdra phālgune māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*śyāmākakṣīranīvārairjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vāpyatha saptamyāmupavāsaparo naraḥ \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ tu mahāsnānaṃ pañcagavyaghṛtādibhiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*valmīkajādimṛdbhiśca gomūtraśakṛdādibhiḥ \|*  
*tvagbhiśca kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ snāpayitvā pramārjayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*saurabheyīṃ tato dadyādraktābhāṃ raktamāline \|*  
*padmarāgapratīkāśairvimānairhastisaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. During the month of Phalguna, one should consume food during the night with the milk of black cow mixed with wild rice, shedding anger and controlling all the senses, and then fast on the sixth and seventh moon days. Then, he should take bath appropriately on the sixth and seventh moon days. On the eighth moon I day, he should bathe the image of Surya with water mixed with ghi and besides sand, cow’s urine, the skin of trees issuing milk (like fruit). The sprinkling of the water should also be done with the same water. Thereafter, a cow with red colour should also be given for the Sungod. In case he does so, then mounting over a plane made of ruby and having elephants in it, he reaches the excellent abode of the Sungod and enjoys bliss there for enormous number of years.

## \|\| 1.165.22-23 \|\|

*māsi caitre tu saṃprāpte yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*śālyannaṃ pāyasairyuktaṃ bhuñjānaśca jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*bhānave pāṭalāṃ dadyādvaiṣṇavīṃ taruṇīṃ nṛpa \|\| 22 \|\|*

*puṣparāga prabhairyānairnānāhaṃsādiyāyibhiḥ \|*  
*gacchetsūryapuraṃ ramyaṃ modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. One who takes food in the month of Chaitra during the night, controlling all his sense organs and gives away a young Vaishnavi cow, then he, mounting over the plane of ruby gems, driven by the peacocks or swans, reaches the solar region and stays there for innumerable number of years.

## \|\| 1.165.24-26 \|\|

*vaiśākhe vīramāse tu yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*sūrye khaṃḍājya saṃmiśraṃ sakṛddadyānnivedanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*gāṃ ca dadyānmahārāja bhāskarāya śubhānana \|*  
*sāmānyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryātprayukto yo mayā tava \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśairyānairbarhiṇavāhanaiḥ \|*  
*aṇimādiguṇairyuktaḥ sūryavadvicareddivi \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. One, who during the month of Vaishakha, taking his food during the night and gives for the Sungod the preparation made of ghi and sugar, he is mounted over the plane driven by the peacocks, attaining the virtues like anima and others reaches the Suryaloka and then he roams about in the heaven like the Sungod himself. In this case, the ordinary process should be followed as has been spoken by me.

## \|\| 1.165.27-29 \|\|

*saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*kṣīraṣaṣṭikabhaktena sarvasattvahite rataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*pītavarṇāṃ ca gāṃ dadyādbhāskarāya mahātmane \|*  
*sāmānyamakhilaṃ kuryādvidhānaṃ yatprakīrtitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sa vicitrairmahāyānairhaṃsasārasagāmibhiḥ \|*  
*gatvādityapuraṃ śrīmānpūrvoktaṃ labhate phalam \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. In the mouth of Shravana, one who takes food at night consuming the rich food of payasam and gives away a cow of yellow colour for the welfare of all the people, following the ordinary course, then mounting over the wonderful planes driven by cranes, he reaches the abode of the Sungod, where all his desires get fulfilled and he gets all the merits.

## \|\| 1.165.30-32 \|\|

*vīra bhādrapade māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*hutaśeṣahaviṣyāśī vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*svapyādāyatane rātrau sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ \|*  
*dadyādgāṃ rohiṇīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ bhāskarāya mahātmane \|\| 31 \|\|*

*niśākarakaraprakhyairvajravaidūryasannibhaiḥ \|*  
*cakravākasamāyuktairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. During the month of Bhadrapada, one should take food during the night and break his fast by consuming havi (collected from homa), He should spend a day at the roots of a tree and sleep in the temple at night. Then being compassionate on all the living beings, he should give away a cow of red colour for the Sungod By doing so, he boards over a plane of white and brilliant complexion, resembling the moonlight or the gem lapis lazuli. It fulfills all the desires, which is being driven by the partridge birds, and ultimately reaches Suryaloka where he is honoured by the Devas as well as the Rakshasas, and enjoys all the comforts there.

## \|\| 1.165.33-38 \|\|

*gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ surāsurasuvanditam \|*  
*modate sa mahābhāgo yāvadā bhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*śrīmānāśvayuje māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*mitāśanaṃ prabhuñjāno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*dadyādgāṃ padmavarṇābhāṃ bhānave'mitatejase \|*  
*divyābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ taruṇīṃ ca payasvinīm \|\| 35 \|\|*

*svastimauktikasaṃkāśairiṃdranīlopaśobhitaiḥ \|*  
*jīvo jīvakasaṃyuktavimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|*  
*gacchedbhānusalokatvaṃ bhuñjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*divākarāya gāṃ dadyājvalanārkasamaprabhām \|*  
*pūrvoktaṃ ca vidhiṃ kuryātsūrya tulyo bhavennaraḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kālānalaśikhaprakhyairmahāyānairnagopamaiḥ \|*  
*mahāsiṃhakṛtāropaiḥ sūryavanmodate sukhī \|\| 38 \|\|*

33-38. A person who takes very little food at night in the month of Ashvina, restricting his anger and sense organs and gives away in charity a young cow resembling the lotus flower adorned with all the ornaments and yielding the milk always, then he, boarding a plane decorated with beads and gems, enjoys pleasures of his mind’s liking. Ultimately, he reaches the Suryaloka. A person who takes food at night during the month of Karttika completing all the formalities and also gives away a cow for the Sungod according to the aforesaid process, then he becomes resplendent like the Sun himself. He reaches before the Sungod in a plane driven by the lion’s and enjoy all the comforts reaching close to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.165.39-41 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi yaḥ kuryānnaktabhojanam \|*  
*yaccānnaṃ payasā yuktaṃ bhuñjānaḥ sa jitendriyaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*prayacchedgāṃ tathā raktāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām \|*  
*sūryāya kuruśārdūla vidhiṃ cāpi samācaret \|\| 40 \|\|*

*sitapadmanibhairyānaiḥ śvetāśvarathasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*gatvā tatra pure ramye prabhayā parayānvitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. A person who takes little food at night during the month of Marghahirsha, controlling all his senses, and gives away payasam as well as a red cow decorated with all the ornaments for the sake of the Sungod in an appropriate manner, then he too boards a plane as white as the lotus flower which is driven by white steed, and reaches the abode of Surya, earning enormous lustre.

## \|\| 1.165.42-45 \|\|

*ahiṃsāsatyavacanamasteyaṃ kṣāṃtirārjavam \|*  
*triṣavaṇāgnihavanaṃ bhūśayyā naktabhojanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pakṣayorubhayormārge saptamyāṃ kurunaṃdana \|*  
*etānguṇānsamāśritya kurvāṇo vratamutta mam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*saptamyobhayavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham \|*  
*sarvarogapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ityevamādīnniyamāṃścaretsūryavratī sadā \|*  
*ya icchedvipulaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. The practicing of non-violence, speaking of truth, not to Steel riches of others, forgiveness, simplicity, bathing thrice a day, performing of homa, sleeping over the floor and eating food at night are essential for a person. Similarly, during both the seven moon days of a month, the auspicious vratas should be performed. Both the seventh moon days are remover of all the sins, remover of all the ailments and bestow all the wishes. Both of them have been defined by me. The person desirous of the illustrious place of the Sungod, should also perform the vrata, observing all the rules.

## Chapter 166. Nikshubha vrata

## \|\| 1.166.1 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*sūryabhaktā tu yā nārī dhruvaṃ sā puruṣo bhavet \|*  
*strī putramuttamaṃ sā cetkāṃkṣate śṛṇu tadvratam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — A woman who is devoted to the Sungod, is surely born as a male in the next birth. In case, she is desirous of an excellent son, then she also gets successful in that desire as well. I am speaking about the same. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.166.2 \|\|

*nikṣubhārkākhyamākhyātaṃ sadā prītivivardhanam \|*  
*aviyogakaraṃ vīra dharmakāmārthasādhakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The relevant vrata is known as Nikshurbhakhya, which always increases love, remover of separation and bestows success in dharma and kama.

## \|\| 1.166.3-7 \|\|

*saptamyāmatha ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā saṃkrāṃtau ca raverdine \|*  
*haviṣā havirhomaṃ tu sopavāsaḥ samācaret \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nikṣubhāṃ kāṃsyaniṣpannāṃ kṛtvā svarṇamayīṃ śubhām \|*  
*rājatīṃ vātha vā varṣaṃ snāpayecca ghṛtādibhiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya vastrayu gmaiśca śobhanaiḥ \|*  
*bhakṣyabhojyairaśeṣaiśca vitānadhvajacāmaraiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhojayetsūryabhaktāṃśca śuklavastrāvaguṇṭhitān \|*  
*kṛtvāyatanamadhye tu pratimāmupakalpayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ vitānacchatraśobhitam \|*  
*dhvajaśaṃkhādivibhavairbhagasyāyatanaṃ nayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. On the first day of the Sun, besides the days of sixth and seventh moon, one should observe fast and should perform homa of ghi. The image of Nikshubha should be made in bronze, gold or the silver. Then bathing it with ghi, two pieces of cloth should be bound to it. It should then be decorated with fragrant flowers. It should then be lodged in a canopy and flywhisks. Various food items should then be offered to the image. The devotees of Surya should then be served with food. Then, the image clad in white garments should be consecrated in the centre of the temple. It should then be decorated with chhatra and a canopy. Putting the vase over the head of the image together with flag and conch etc., it should be called to the sun temple.

## \|\| 1.166.8-10 \|\|

*nikṣubhārkadineśasya vratametannivedayet \|*  
*tatpiṃḍyāṃ sthāpayetpātramupaśobhāsamanvitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pradakṣiṇīkṛtya raviṃ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|*  
*samāpya tadvrataṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuyātpha lamaśnute \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dvādaśādityasaṃkāśairmahāyānairnagopamaiḥ \|*  
*yatheṣṭaṃ bhānave loke sauraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. It is known by the name of Nikshubharka, which had been described. Then, the vase filled with the material has to be placed over the pedestal. Then, the circumambulation of the image of the Sungod should be done. Thereafter, he should get himself redeemed of the sins by offering salutation to the deity with the concluding of the vrata. In this way, the merit a person attains, is being spoken by me. The concerned person, seated over the plane having the lustre of all the twelve Suryas, reaches the Suryaloka and enjoys all the pleasures with the followers of Surya. All his desires are fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.166.11 \|\|

*varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni ca \|*  
*naṃdate'sau mahābhāga viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O great one, such a person is worshipped in the Vishnuloka for a thousand crores or a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 1.166.12 \|\|

*tataḥ karmaviśeṣeṇa sarvakāmasamanvitam \|*  
*brahmalokaṃ samāsādya paraṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Subsequently, because of his performing the noble deeds, getting all his desires fulfilled, he reaches Brahmaloka and enjoys all the comforts.

## \|\| 1.166.13-14 \|\|

*brahmalokātparibhraṣṭaḥ śrīmāntsurasupūjitaḥ \|*  
*prajāpatimavāpnoti surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*lokāniha ciraṃ bhuktvā somaloke mahīyate \|*  
*somādeṃdraṃ punarlokamāsādyeṃdrapatirbhavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. After falling from Brahmaloka, again he becomes Prajapati and is worshipped even by the gods. He is offered salutation by the Devas and the Asuras. He lives there with comfort for a long time, after which he reaches the abode of Moon. From there, he goes to Indraloka where he conducts himself as a lord of Indra.

## \|\| 1.166.15 \|\|

*iṃdralokācca gaṃdharvalokaṃ prāpya sa modate \|*  
*tatastaddharmaśeṣeṇa bhavatyādityabhāvitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. From Indraloka he reaches Gandharvaloka and enjoys all the bliss there. Thereafter, since he still has dharma to his credit, he finally attains the Sayujya moksha of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.166.16 \|\|

*svakarmabhāvanodyogātpunaḥ prārabhate śubham \|*  
*śubhācca punaretyeha sa yātyatisahasraśaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Because of his devotion towards the performing of the noble deeds, the process of his auspicious deeds starts again. Because of his noble deeds, again he is reborn on earth several times.

## \|\| 1.166.17-18 \|\|

*yāvannāpnoti maraṇaṃ tāvadbhramati karmaṇā \|*  
*sunirvedātsavairāgyaṃ vairāgyājjñānasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*jñānātpravartate yogo yogādduḥkhāṃtamāpnuyāt \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. In this way, till such time he does not face the final death, he has to face the cycle of karmas. Thus, after facing extreme miseries, he develops detachment. From detachment, he achieves knowledge and from knowledge, he achieves yoga. It is with the practice of yoga alone, that end of miseries is ordained.

## Chapter 167. Nikshubha vrata

## \|\| 1.167.1-2 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ cāpyatha saptamyāṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī \|*  
*varṣamekaṃ na bhuṃkte yā mahābhāgajigīṣayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*varṣāṃti pratimāṃ kṛtvā nikṣubhāṃketi viśrutām \|*  
*\| snānādyaṃ ca vidhiṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktaṃ labhate guṇam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — A woman observing celibacy during the sixth and seventh days of moon, if does not take food for a complete one year with the desire to travel to the Suryaloka and at the end of the year, getting a beautiful image of Nikshubha made having it bathed properly, while concluding the ceremony, then she achieves all the aforesaid virtues.

## \|\| 1.167.3 \|\|

*jāṃbūnadamayairyānaiścaturdvārairalaṃkṛte \|*  
*gatvādityapure ramye aśeṣaṃ viṃdate phalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. She is seated in a plane of gold with four entrance gates. Then, reaching the Suryaloka, she enjoys all the merit.

## \|\| 1.167.4 \|\|

*saurādisarvalokeṣu bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. She enjoys all the pleasures in all the lokas of the Sungod and ultimately, becomes the queen there of the king.

## \|\| 1.167.5 \|\|

*yā nāryupavasedevaṃ kṛṣṇāmekāṃ tu saptamīm \|*  
*sā gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ bhānoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thus, a woman, who on the dark seventh moon day, observes fast appropriately, she attains the place of invincible Sungod.

## \|\| 1.167.6-7 \|\|

*varṣāṃte pratimāṃ kṛtvā śālipiṣṭamayīṃ śubhām \|*  
*pītānulepanairmālyaiḥ pītavastraiśca pūjayet \|*  
*pūrvoktamakhilaṃ kṛtvā bhāskarāya nivedayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saptabhīmairmahāyānairdaṃticāmīkaraprabhaiḥ \|*  
*varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. At the end of the year, she should make a beautiful image of the powder of shall rice and it should be painted with a white paint. The image should be decorated with garland and yellow garments. Performing all the aforesaid rites, she achieves seven planes of huge size and enjoys all the comforts in Suryaloka for a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 1.167.8 \|\|

*sauralokādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānnarādhipa \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminya theṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. After enjoying all the pleasures in Surya and other lokas, in due course of time, she is reborn in this world where she has the fortunes, wealth and a husband of her liking.

## \|\| 1.167.9-12 \|\|

*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yā nārī tu dṛḍhavratā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*varṣāṃte sarvagaṃdhāḍhyaṃ nikṣubhārkaṃ nivedayet \|suvarṇamaṇimuktābhyāṃ bhojayitvā magāṃganām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*suvicitrairmahāyānairdivyagaṃdharvaśobhitaiḥ \|*  
*sā vai yugasahasrāṇi sūraloke narādhipa \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yatheṣṭaṃ bhānave loke bhogānbhuktvā tu kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*kramādāgatya lokesminrājantaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. A woman, who performing vrata on the dark seventh moon day, with fairness, discarding all the pleasures, keeps on fasting for a year and at the end of the year, decorating the image of Nikshubha with gold, gems and jewels, and feeds the Maga women and then dedicates the image to the Sungod, then she boarding the plane, having on board several types of wonderful Gandharvas, reaches the place of Surya and enjoys all the pleasures there for a thousand yugas. Then in due course of time, she is reborn on earth as a queen.

## \|\| 1.167.13 \|\|

*evaṃ yā kurute rājanvrataṃ pāpabhayāpaham \|*  
*nikṣubhārkamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sā yāti paramaṃ padam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus, a woman, who performs vrata for Nikshubha appropriately, she achieves the supreme position.

## \|\| 1.167.14-16 \|\|

*varṣamekaṃ mahābāho śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ \|*  
*varṣāṃte vai bhojayedvīra dāṃpatyaṃ bhojakeṣu vai \|\| 14 \|\|*

*bhojayitvā tu dāṃpatyaṃ bhogakānāṃ mahābalaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedgaṃdhamālyaistu vāsobhiḥ kurunaṃdana \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kṛtvā tāmramaye pātre vajrapūrṇairalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*nikṣubhārkaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ dattvā tābhyāṃ tu śaktitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. O valorous one, a woman, getting devoted, should follow the vrata of Nikshubha goddess. After a year, the couple should feed a Bhojaka couple. Thereafter, collecting fragrance, flower garlands and costumes, the image of Nikshubha should be decorated. The image of the goddess should then be placed in a copper vase with the above stuff. Then, gold should be offered to the goddess according to one’s means.

## \|\| 1.167.17 \|\|

*nikṣubhā bhojikā jñeyā bhojako'rkaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*tasmāttau pūjayetsaurīśvaravacchraddhayānvitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Nikshubha is said to be a Bhojaka and the Sun is Bhojaka, therefore, both of them should be worshipped with devotion, like a deity.

## Chapter 168. Kamada Saptami vrata

## \|\| 1.168.1-5 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ekabhaktena yā nārī kārttikaṃ kṣapayennṛpa \|*  
*kṣamāhiṃsādiniyamaiḥ saṃyatā brahmacāriṇī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*guḍājyamiśraṃ śālyannaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet \|*  
*pakṣayorubhayostāta śradayā parayānvitā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇāṃ guggulaṃ sājyamādiśet \|*  
*saptamyāṃ tāta ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai upavāsaratirbhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*iṃdranīlapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|*  
*varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūraloke mahīyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tathā ca sarvalokeṣu bhogamāsādya yatnataḥ \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminyatheṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Sumantu said — O monarch, during the month of Karttika, a woman, observing forgiveness, non-violence and other disciplines and observing celibacy, should spend time by taking food once a day. Besides she should give away sugarcane balls and Sail rice mixed with ghi, oleander flowers and guggalu soaked in ghi for the Sungod, with dedication during both the fortnights. She should also observe fast on the sixth and seventh. By doing so, boarding the plane of sapphire which bestows all the desires, she proceeds on to the abode of Surya. She is honoured in that place for a hundred thousand years. Thereafter, enjoying all the comforts of all the lokas there, in due course of time, she is reborn on earth and attains a husband of her liking.

## \|\| 1.168.6 \|\|

*ityevaṃ sarvayajñeṣu vidhistulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*ekabhaktopavāsasya phalaṃ ca sadṛśaṃ bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Similar type of the performance of the yajnas has been prescribed. In case, she takes food once a day and also observes fast, the merit accrued thereof would be equal.

## \|\| 1.168.7-8 \|\|

*kṣamā satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ śaucamiṃdriyanigrahaḥ \|*  
*sūryapūjāgnihavanaṃ saṃtoṣaḥ steyavarjanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sarvavrateṣvayaṃ dharmaḥ sāmānyo daśadhā smṛtaḥ \|*  
*niḥśeṣamahaṃ vakṣyāmi māsānmāsavrataṃ prati \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. It has already been stated that forgiveness, mercy, charities, celibacy or devotion to the husband, purity, control of sense organs, Sun worship, performing homa in fire, contentment and not to steal, are the ten types of ordinary dharma which have been prescribed for all the people, I am also speaking the exclusive dharmas for all the months.

## \|\| 1.168.9-10 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi vyomapṛṣṭhe vinirmitam \|*  
*gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya śubhānanamanaupamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tāmrapātrādikaiścaivāpyapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ \|*  
*sumerau daśasāhasre sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The month of Margashirsha is quite auspicious. During this month, the auspicious vyoma should be drawn over a pedestal and should be decorated with fragrant flower garland, and placed in a copper vase. One who does so, she enjoys all the bliss in the Suryaloka for ten thousand years.

## \|\| 1.168.11-12 \|\|

*sarvadevakadaṃbeṣu saṃprāpya vimalāṃ śriyam \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt \|*  
*puṣpairamumalaṃkṛtya bhānave vinivedayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya śubhānanamanaupa mam \|*  
*tāmrapātrādikāṃsyaṃ vā kṛtvā tatra nivedayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Then, becoming the best of gods and possessing enormous fortunes, she is reborn in the world, where she becomes the chief queen. In the month of Pausha, a woman should decorate the figure with flowers and then offer it to the Sungod. Then, the image with a beautiful face should be decorated with beautiful garlands, and should be consecrated in a vase and the same should be offered to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.168.13-17 \|\|

*mahāpuṣpakayānena divyagaṃdhapravāhinā \|*  
*sumerau daśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣu bhārata \|*  
*saṃprāpyaitaṃ kramāllokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vidate patim \|\| 14 \|\|*

*māghe rathamaśvayujaṃ dīpamālyavibhūṣitam \|*  
*piṣṭasānusamā yuktaṃ kṛtvāyatanamānayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mahārathopamairyānaiḥ śvetāśvavarasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sarvāmarāṇāṃ lokeṣu prāpya bhogānyathepsitān \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminyatheṣṭaṃ patimāpnuyāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

13-17. The performer with the divine fragrance is carried by the great Pushpaka plane over the peak of the beautiful mountain of Suryaloka, where she earns respect for ten thousand years. Thereafter, she enjoys all the pleasures of all the lokas, and after arriving in due course of time on earth, she gets the husband of her choice. A woman who creates a chariot with a white horse and decorate it with a garland of lamps in the month of Magha, and takes away it in the Sun temple with peaks of powder, then she achieves the great chariot driven by white horse. Enjoying all the desired divinely pleasures, in due course of time, she arrives in this world, where she get a husband of her own choice.

## \|\| 1.168.18-20 \|\|

*pratimāṃ phālgune māsi kṛtvā piṣṭamayī raveḥ \|*  
*gaṃdhamālyairalaṃkṛtya sthāpayedbhāskarā laye \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yānairapratimairdivyairgītanādasamākulaiḥ \|*  
*sumerau daśasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sarvābhimataloke'sminprāpya bhogānyathepsitān \|*  
*punaretya imaṃ lokaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Preparing an image of the Sungod in wheat flour, when decorated with fragrant flower garlands and is consecrated in a sun temple, then she is carried in a beautiful plane, with the playing of the musical instruments and reaches the Suryaloka with excellent peaks, and is respected there for ten thousand years, enjoying all the divine pleasures. After her rebirth in this world, she is united with a husband of her own choice.

## \|\| 1.168.21-23 \|\|

*kṛtvāruṇaṃ tathā caitre gaṃdhamālyopaśobhitam \|*  
*sthāpya pātre yathokte tu bhāskarāya nivedayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śaradiṃdupratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|*  
*varṣāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

*karmakṣayādihāgatya putrapautrasamanvitam \|*  
*abhīṣṭaṃ patimāsādya labhedbhogāntsudurlabhān \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. During the month of Chaitra, an image of red colour, decorating it with fragrant flower garlands, should then be consecrated in a vase and should be offered to the Sungod. Then she, boarding a resplendent plane as shining as the moon itself and which fulfills all the desires, reaches the Suryaloka and is lodged in an excellent place there, where enjoying all the comforts, she returns on earth at the decline of her good deeds. Here, she gets the husband of her choice, besides noble sons and the grandsons. Here also, she enjoys with her husband and sons besides the grandsons, all the great pleasures (which are beyond the reach of the ordinary people).

## \|\| 1.168.24-25 \|\|

*taṃḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā vai meruparvatam \|*  
*nikṣubhārkasamāyuktaṃ sarvadhātuvibhūṣitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*nānālaṃkārasaṃpannaṃ nānāmālyavibhūṣitam \|*  
*sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayedbhāskarālaye \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. During the month of Vaishakha, a figure of Nikshubha should be made with 2¾ pishtas (a pishta is equal in weight to 950 grams) of flour and should be decorated with all the metals. It should be adorned with all the ornaments, garlands and all the diamonds. It should then be consecrated in a Sun temple.

## \|\| 1.168.26-27 \|\|

*mahadvyomavrataṃ hyetadvaiśākhe yaḥ samācaret \|*  
*nānāvidhaiśca yānaistu sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

*saurādisarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ patimāpnuyāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Thus, with the conclusion of the vrata of Maha-vyoma in an appropriate manner, in which various vehicles should be used, one who does so, she enjoys all the pleasures in the Suryaloka. In due course of time, she falls on the earth, where she gets the husband of her own choice.

## \|\| 1.168.28-30 \|\|

*dvitīyaṃ ca tathā padmamāṣāḍhe piṣṭamuttamam \|*  
*sarvabījarasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā tu śubhralakṣaṇam \|*  
*nānākeśaragaṃdhāḍhayaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*etairvā haimabhiryānaiḥ sarvabhogānvitairnṛpa \|*  
*varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

*bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣvanukramāt \|*  
*prāptā tu sarvabhogāḍhayaṃ taruṇaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. During the month of Ashadha, the images of Nikshubha as well as Surya should be made in flour together with all the seeds and the juices, the saffron and the gems. It should be well decorated. A woman who does so, then mounted over a golden plane, she proceeds to the solar region, in which there are enough of eatables. Reaching there, she is honoured and she lives there for a hundred crores of years. Further, enjoying all the comforts in all the lokas, she arrives in this world, where she has a husband of her own choice.

## \|\| 1.168.31-33 \|\|

*sarvadhātusamākīrṇaṃ vicitradhvajaśobhitam \|*  
*nivedayeta sūryāya śrāvaṇe tilaparvatam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*svacchaṃdagāmibhiryānairnānā varṇavibhūṣitaiḥ \|*  
*varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

*saṃprāpya vividhānbhogānbahvāścaryasamanvitān \|*  
*kramāllokamimaṃ prāpya rājānaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. During the month of Shravana, a hill of sesamum seeds should be prepared, decorated with all the metals, which should be dedicated to the Sungod. By so doing, the performer, mounting over the plane decorated with various types of banners of various colours, resembling the clothes of a damsel, reaches the place of the Sungod, where she is immensely honoured at an auspicious place for a hundred crores of years. She also enjoys several wonderful pleasures. In due course of time, she returns to the earth, where she becomes a chief queen.

## \|\| 1.168.34-35 \|\|

*kṛtvā bhādrapade māsi vyoma śālimayaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*vitānadhvajacchatrāḍhyaṃ nānāmālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*taruṇārkakaraprakhyairmahā yānaiḥ suśobhanai \|*  
*varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. In the month of Bhadrapada, vyoma of the Sail rice flour should be made and kept in a canopy. It should be decorated with flags, flower petals and, several types of flower garlands. In case she does so, then boarding a plane having the shine of a rising Sun in which all the luxurious comforts are available, she reaches the abode of the Sungod. There she enjoys all the comforts for a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 1.168.36 \|\|

*saṃprāpya vividhānbhogāntsarvānnimiṣasaṃbhavān \|*  
*kramādāgatya loke'sminrājānaṃ viṃdate patim \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. After enjoying all the pleasures there, at every moment of her stay there, in due course of time, she returns to earth.

## \|\| 1.168.37-40 \|\|

*kṛtvā cāśvayuje māsi vipulaṃ dhānyaparvatam \|*  
*suvarṇavastragaṃdhāḍhyaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sāvitraiśca mahāyānairvarabhogasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sūryalokādilokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān \|*  
*asmiṃlloke cā saṃprāptā rājānaṃ viṃdate patim \|*  
*candrāgnibhāskarāṇāṃ tu kāṃtitejaḥprabhānvitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yaṃyaṃ kāmaṃ samuddiśya naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ \|*  
*pūjayaṃti raviṃ bhaktyā tatsarvaṃ prāpnuvaṃti hi \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. During the month of Ashvina, a hill should be made of enormous heap of paddy. It should then be decorated with gold, costumes, fragrance and it should be offered to the Sungod. By so doing, enjoying all the comforts in the great plane of the Sungod, she reaches in Suryaloka and enjoys all the comforts there for a thousand crores of years. Thereafter, enjoying all the pleasures in other lokas, she in due course of time is reborn on earth, where she becomes the queen of a king, having the shine of the moon. In this way, the men, women or eunuchs who worship the Sungod with utmost devotion and whichever desire in mind, they surely get their desires fulfilled.

## Chapter 169. Description of Surya vrata

## \|\| 1.169.1-2 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*mṛnmayaṃ dārujaṃ śailaṃ pakveṣṭakamathāpi vā \|*  
*kṛtvā maṭhaṃ gṛhaṃ vāpi yathā vibha vasaṃbhavāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ sarvadhānyasamanvitam \|*  
*sūryāyetthaṃ gṛhaṃ dadyātsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — One should construct a Sun temple in day, wood, stone or the baked bricks according to one’s means. He should then provide it with enough of wealth, cereals, and resources and then dedicate it to the Sungod. One who does so, all his desires get fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.169.3-7 \|\|

*kṛtvaikabhaktaṃ hemaṃte māghamāsamataṃ dritaḥ \|*  
*māsāṃtena rathaṃ kuryāccitravastropaśobhitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śvetaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ turagaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*śvetadhvajapatākābhiśchatracāmaradarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*taṃḍulāḍhakapiṣṭena kṛtvā bhānuṃ narādhipa \|*  
*vinyasya taṃ rathopasthe saṃjñayā saha bhūpate \|\| 5 \|\|*

*taṃ rātrau rājamārgeṇa śaṃkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ \|*  
*bhramayitvā śanaiḥ paścātsūryāyatanamāviśet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tatra jāgarapūjābhiḥ pradīpāvaliśobhitaiḥ \|*  
*prekṣaṇīyaiḥ pradānaiśca kṣapayitvā śanaiḥ kṣapām \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. During the season of Hemanta besides the month of Magha, shedding lethargy, consuming food once a day, at the end of the month, a person should build a wonderful chariot with various types of costumes and which is driven by a white horses. It should be decorated with white flags and banners, leaves, flywhisks, besides the mirrors. The chariot should be consecrated with 2¾ pishtas of rice. Then during the night, the image should be placed in the Sun temple, moving a procession through the royal path which is moving slowly, with the sound of conches, kettle drums, etc. The night should be spent giving away beautiful presents.

## \|\| 1.169.8-11 \|\|

*prabhāte snapanaṃ kṛtvā madhukṣīraghṛtena ca \|*  
*dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyo'nnaṃ yathāśaktyā ca dakṣiṇām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*rathaṃ saṃvāhanopetaṃ bhāskarāya nivedayet \|*  
*bhuktvā ca bāṃdhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ praṇamyārkagṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sarvavratānāṃ pravaraṃ maṃtradharmānvitaḥ sadā \|*  
*vrataṃ sūryavrataṃ nāmasarvakāmārthasiddhaye \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sarvavrateṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam \|*  
*sarvaṃ sūryaratheneha tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nṛpa \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Again in the morning, the image should be bathed with honey, milk, ghi etc. Thereafter, the poor and blind should be given food with dakshina. Thereafter, the chariot should be donated to the Sungod with the horses. Then, he should take food with relatives and offer salutation to the Sungod and retire to his home. This is the best of the vratas, is endowed with mantra-dharma is known as Surya-vrata. It fulfills all the desires. The merits one earns with the performing of all the yajnas, all those merits can be achieved with the performing of this vrata alone.

## \|\| 1.169.12-13 \|\|

*sūryāyutapratīkāśairvimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|*  
*trisaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānsarvalokeṣvanukramāt \|*  
*kalpāyutaśataṃ sāgraṃ tato rājā bhavetkṣitau \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The concerned person, then boarding the plane having the lustre of ten thousand suns, which bestows all the desires, together with his family and twenty one generations, is established in the Suryaloka. Then, enjoying all the comforts for a hundred thousand kalpas, he ultimately becomes the king on earth.

## \|\| 1.169.14-17 \|\|

*paṃcabalisamāyuktaṃ mṛdu ṣaḍvāstukalpitam \|*  
*sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ sūryaṃ saṃjñāṃ prakalpayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*saṃjñādevīsamāyuktaṃ paiṣṭāśāḍhyaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*saurajñānārthatattvajñamācāryamudayānvitam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpādyairvastrālaṃkāracāmaraiḥ \|*  
*bhakṣya bhojyairaśeṣaiśca tataḥ śayyāṃ nivedayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tadūrṇātūlavastrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyā tu yāvatī \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. Preparing the figures of both Surya and Samjna, then a person, according to his means should offer them five balis and six grihas, which should possess all the resources. The image of Samjna should be made of the white flour and presented to Surya. Then, in order to know about the tattva of the Sungod, one should worship the Acharya presenting him fragrance, flowers, costumes, flywhisks, ornaments and a bed with other eatables. In case, the devotee does so, ho remains In Suryaloka for the number of years equivalent to the number of the threads of cotton In the costume multiplied by a thousand.

## \|\| 1.169.18-20 \|\|

*surādisarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*kāmādāgatya loke'sminrājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*daśa gobhiḥ saha vṛṣaṃ tā vṛṣaikādaśāḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*sūryāya vinivedyeha yatphalaṃ labhate śṛṇu \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dvādaśādityatulyātmā aṇimādiguṇairyutaḥ \|*  
*sarvatra modate rājansūryasyānucaro bhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. After enjoying all the pleasures of the heaven, in due course of time, he is reborn on earth as a king. When a bull is given in charily with eleven cows, such a charity is known as Vrishaikadasha. By offering the same to the Sungod, the merit the donor earns, is going to be spoken by me, which you please listen. O king, such a person, attaining all the riddhis (success) like anima and others, besides becoming the attendant of Surya, attaining all the enjoyments, lives in the Suryaloka.

## Chapter 170. Donation of a Cow

## \|\| 1.170.1-4 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*savṛṣaṃ gośataṃ dattvā bhāskarāya narādhipa \|*  
*triḥsaptakulajaiḥ sārdhaṃ śṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*varakoṭipratīkāśaiḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*mahāyānairasaṃkhyeyairamarāsurapūjitaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dvādaśādityasaṃkāśo divākara ivāparaḥ \|*  
*gatvādityapuraṃ ramyaṃ krīḍate sūryamaṃḍape \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhuktvā tu vipulānbhogānpralaye sarvadehinām \|*  
*mohakaṃcukamutsṛjya viśatyādityamaṃḍale \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sumantu said — O lord of the people, by giving away In charity a hundred cows with a bull for Sungod, the donor achieves merits fur his twenty one generations, details of which are being spoken by me, which you please listen. Hoarding a plane which is having the shine resembling a crore of suns, which bestows all the wishes, which is adored by all the gods and the asuras, he himself earns the shine of all the twelve Suns, appears like a second Sun and reaches the Suryaloka. He then sports In the Sun temple. After enjoying enormous pleasures, at the time of dissolution, discarding the curtain of illusion, enters into the solar disc.

## \|\| 1.170.5-6 \|\|

*sarvajñaḥ sūraparamaḥ śuddhaḥ svātmanyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*sarvagaḥ paripūrṇatvātsūryavaddīptimānbhavet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yo dadyādubhayamukhīṃ saurabheyīṃ divākare \|*  
*saptadvīpāṃ mahīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt \|*  
*pādadvayaṃ śiro'rdhaṃ ca saśailavanakānanā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Then resembling the omniscient Sungod, he becomes auspicious and gains the power to move anywhere, and becoming apt in all respects, becomes resplendent. A person, who gives away for the Sungod a Surabhi cow, he earns the merit of donating seven continents, two feet, half the head, the earth with mountain as well as mandalas.

## Chapter 171. Serving food to Bhojakas

## \|\| 1.171.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*magānāṃ brūhi me dharmaṃ samāsavyāsayogataḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ ca kiṃ bhavedbrahmanmagadharmaniṣevaṇāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O Brahman, you kindly speak out in detail about the dharma of the Magas and also the merit one earns by the following of the dharma of Magas.

## \|\| 1.171.2 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ya eṣa dharmaḥ sūryeti tavākhyāto mayānagha \|*  
*magadharmaḥ sa evoktaḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sumantu said: — O sinless one, the Surya dharma as has been told by me, is the destroyer of all the sins. The same is also called the dharma of Magas.

## \|\| 1.171.3 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ magadharmaniṣevaṇam \|*  
*magadharmaśca saṃprokta eteṣāṃ bhavamuktaye \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Therefore, the people of all the castes should follow the Maga dharma.

## \|\| 1.171.4 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ strī śūdro vā magāśramī \|*  
*yaḥ pūjayati mārtaṃḍaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Therefore, any one of the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, women and shudras, should embrace the dharma of Magas. One who does so, he achieves the highest position.

## \|\| 1.171.5 \|\|

*trisaṃdhyamarcayedbhānumagnikāryaṃ ca śaktitaḥ \|*  
*kuryānmago mahābāho mukhamāvṛtya yatnataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O valorous one, covering his face, a Maga should worship the Sungod thrice a day, as per his means, observing the fire rites at the same time.

## \|\| 1.171.6 \|\|

*trisaṃdhyamekakālaṃ vā pūjayecchaddhayā ravim \|*  
*asaṃpūjya raviṃ mohānna bhuṃjīta kadācana \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. In case, it is not possible to perform the Sun worship thrice a day, then one should do so with devotion only once a day. He should not take food without worshipping the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.171.7 \|\|

*eṣa dharmaḥ paro jñeyaḥ śeṣo bhavati mānavaḥ \|*  
*apūjayitvā bhuṃjāno viṣṭhāṃ bhuṅkte ca vai magaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. This should be treated as the best of dharma, because Maga who follows the dharma, if takes food without worshipping the Sungod, it amounts to eating refuse.

## \|\| 1.171.8 \|\|

*devaṃ samāśritaiḥ pūjā kartavyeyaṃ tribhiḥ sadā \|*  
*manasā pūjayedyogī puṣpaiścāraṇyasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Therefore, the Sungod must be worshipped atleast thrice a day. A yogi must worship the Sungod with a devoted mind offering flowers.

## \|\| 1.171.9 \|\|

*devārthapuṣpahiṃsāyāṃ na bhavettasya hiṃsakaḥ \|*  
*yadyalpamapi cātmārthaṃ nihanyāddhiṃsakastadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In case, some insects are killed while collecting the flowers, he will not earn any sin for the same. This is certain.

## \|\| 1.171.10-11 \|\|

*magaścāgniparo nityaṃ tadbhakto'tithipūjakaḥ \|*  
*magī maithunavarjyaḥ syācchrīmāngṛhamagāśramī \|\| 10 \|\|*

*devāgnisvatithau bhaktaṃ pacate cātmakāraṇāt \|*  
*ātmārthe yaḥ pacenmohātsa mago narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. A Maga must worship the Agni in a fire altar daily and his devotee should perform the worship of guests. The sex act has been forbidden for the followers of Maga dharma. The Magas prepare food only for the gods, fire and the guests. A Maga, who prepares food for himself, he has to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.171.12 \|\|

*devārthe pacanaṃ yeṣāṃ saṃtānārthaṃ tu maithunam \|*  
*artho dānārthaṃ uddiṣṭo narakaṃ hi viparyayāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. A person who earns money for preparing food for the god, sex act for progeny and the earning of money for giving it in charity, his activities are said to be praiseworthy. The one who act to the contrary, he surely falls in the hell.

## \|\| 1.171.13 \|\|

*jīvatṛtīyabhāgepi na prakurvīta vārcanam \|*  
*vittārjane tadardhena yato nityaṃ hi jīvitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. One should keep up his living with a third of his income and it should not be used for the worship of the god. In case, half of the income is used for leading of daily life, it would not be improper, because the life has to continue.

## \|\| 1.171.14 \|\|

*nyāyopārjitavittaḥ syādanyāyaṃ pari varjayet \|*  
*anyāyārjitavittaistu kurvannarakamāpnuyāt \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The money should be earned by fair means and the illegal means for the purpose should be discarded. By earning riches with unfair means, one has to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.171.15-16 \|\|

*vācorthe brahmacārī yaḥ sūryapūjāgnitatparaḥ \|*  
*bhavejjiteṃdriyaḥ śāṃto naiṣṭhiko bhauti ko'pi vā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sarvagaṃdhavinirmuktaḥ kaṃdamūlaphalāśanaḥ \|*  
*mama vaikhānaso jñeyaḥ sūryapūjāgnitatparaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. For learning of the religious process, one who observes celibacy, worships the Sungod, besides performing the fire rites, controls all the senses, becomes peaceful, religious minded, discards all the fragrance inspite of his being a worldly person and consumes wild roots and fruits, then he should be treated as a Rishi like me.

## \|\| 1.171.17 \|\|

*nivṛttaḥ saṃgamebhyastu sūryadhyāna rataḥ sadā \|*  
*jñeyaḥ saurayatīṃdrāya pūjāniṣṭho jiteṃdriyaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person who is always devoted to Surya should be treated as devoted to the Sungod having controlled al his sense organs.

## \|\| 1.171.18 \|\|

*muṃḍopanayano vyaṃgī śuklavāsaḥ samanvitaḥ \|*  
*jñeyaṃ tadarcanasthānametatkāryaṃ prayatnataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. A person who wears yajnopavita, girdle, is clad in white clothes, he is considered to be capable of performing worship. Therefore, such a person should conduct himself appropriately.

## \|\| 1.171.19-20 \|\|
