*athāvyaṃgo mahārāja dhārayedyastu bhojakaḥ \|*  
*agamyaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dhvaṃsanaṃ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ sarvapāpa bhayāpaham \|*  
*bhāvaśuddhena satatamarcanīyo divākaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. After that, when a Bhojaka wears the girdle, he achieves the Sungod for all others, of course, Surya is the destroyer of the wicked people. Therefore, the Sungod should be worshipped with an auspicious mind.

## \|\| 1.171.21-23 \|\|

*gaṃdhalepavihīno'pi bhāvaśuddho na duṣyati \|*  
*bhāveṣu ca carecchaucaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ satyapūtaṃ vaco vadet \|*  
*sauradhyānaratāḥ śāṃtāḥ sauradharmaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sarva evāśramā jñeyā bhāskarāṃgasamudbhavāḥ \|*  
*bhojakāṣṭavrataṃ dhāryaṃ raviṇoktamanaupamam \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. In the absence of fragrance and the paste, no puja could be considered as blemished because it is said that the purity of thought, taking of water filtered with cloth, the pure vision, to walk carefully and speaking truthful words are essential and important. Concentrating one’s mind in Surya, one should be peaceful and dedicated towards the solar religion, because all the ashramas have emerged out of the Sungod. This is certain that Bhojakas should patronize the Ashta-vrata, about which the Sungod has himself prescribed.

## \|\| 1.171.24-25 \|\|

*sarvavratānāṃ paramaṃ dharmālayamanuttamam \|*  
*saurabhakte sadā kṣāṃtirahiṃsā sarvadā śamaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*saṃtoṣaḥ satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tathāṣṭamam \|*  
*yathāsaṃbhavapūjābhiḥ karmaṇā manasā girā \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. This is best of all the vratas and is the abode of dharma. A devotee of the Sungod should always practice forgiveness, nonviolence, peace, contentment, truthfulness, not to steal and Brahmacharya. Then, he should perform the worship of the Sungod by action, thought and behaviour.

## \|\| 1.171.26 \|\|

*saurabhaktiḥ sadā kāryā bhojakeṣu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*svadehānnirviśeṣaṃ hi bhojakānpālayedbudhaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. They should always be devoted to Surya. The people of wisdom should particularly maintain the Bhojakas as well as their own bodies.

## \|\| 1.171.27 \|\|

*bhayadāridryarogebhyasteṣāṃ kuryātpriyāṇi vai \|*  
*sūryasya paripūrṇasya kiṃ nāma kriyate naraiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Inspite of their being poor, frightened and ailing, their favourite tasks should be performed. It is because the Sungod is complete in itself and what more can be done for him by the people?

## \|\| 1.171.28 \|\|

*yatkṛtaṃ bhojakānāṃ vai tatkṛtaṃ syādravernṛpa \|*  
*sudūramapi gaṃtavyaṃ magānāṃ yatra vai gaṇaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Infact, whatever is done for a Bhojaka, it is done for the Sungod. In case, a gana of Magas lives at a distance, still a person should go and meet him.

## \|\| 1.171.29-30 \|\|

*sa ca prayatnāddraṣṭavyastatra saṃnihito raviḥ \|*  
*bhojakasya tu bhaktasya sūryapūjāratasya ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ājñāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*devāśramagato bhaktyā devārcāṃ pūjayennṛpa \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. One should meet him making all the efforts, because the Sungod is always lodged there. This has been ordained. One should obey the command of Bhojaka and by so doing, one earns the merit of performing an Ashvamedha sacrifice. Therefore, a person, after visiting the abode of a god, should adore the deity with devotion.

## \|\| 1.171.31 \|\|

*svāgatāsanapādyārghyamadhuparkādyanukramāt \|*  
*bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. When a Bhojaka is invited for taking food, the householder should welcome him, offer a seat, padya and arghya, besides Madhuparka, which should be offered in due course before the food. A person who does so, is well established in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.171.32-33 \|\|

*pratiśrayapradānena rājā bhavati bhārata \|*  
*dattvā sthānaṃ tathā śaucaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śvetabiṃduparītāṃgaṃ dhyānaśramavikarśitam \|*  
*saṃvījya tālavṛṃttena vāyuloke mahīyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. One who provides shelter to a Bhojaka, becomes a ruler. Similarly, by providing him an auspicious place, one earns the place of Varuna. By doing tapas with all the efforts, the man starts perspiration. At that point of time, by moving the fans of palm tree, one achieves honour in the Vayuloka.

## \|\| 1.171.34-35 \|\|

*kṣutpipāsāturaṃ śrāṃtaṃ malinaṃ rogiṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*pālayitvā yathā śaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 34 \|\|*

*patitāśastasaṃkīrṇacaṃḍālādīnāṃ pakṣiṇām \|*  
*kāruṇyātsarvabhūtānāṃ deyamannaṃ svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. By serving a person who is hungry or thirsty, degraded, deprived and ailing, as per one’s means, all the desires are fulfilled. The fallen, degraded, poor and Chandala or even the birds, whosoever may be in trouble or pain, al flic living beings should be offered the food as per one’s means.

## \|\| 1.171.36 \|\|

*atyalpamapi kāruṇyāddattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam \|*  
*tasmātsarveṣu bhūteṣu devakāruṇyamucyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The giving of a small quantity of food etc. to a miserly person, becomes eternal. Therefore, O Deva, one should shower his compassion on all the people fids is essential.

## \|\| 1.171.37 \|\|

*abhāve tṛṇabhūmyannaṃ patraṃ dhanaphalāni ca \|*  
*dattvā'gatāya praṇataḥ svargaṃ yāti priyeṇa vā \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. In the absence of the same, the strand, land, food, leaves, wealth and the fruits should be given. Because by giving these things to the helpless people with humility and by speaking of sweet words to them, one achieves heaven.

## \|\| 1.171.38 \|\|

*na hīdṛksvargayānāya yathā loke priyaṃ vacaḥ \|*  
*ihāmutra sukhaṃ teṣāṃ vāgyeṣāṃ madhurā bhavet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. There is no other conveyance in the world to reach the heaven, which could be comparable to sweet words. Because the more the sweet is the tongue or speech of a person, he achieves more and more comforts in the heaven.

## \|\| 1.171.39 \|\|

*amṛtasyaṃdinī vācaṃ caṃdanasparśaśītalām \|*  
*dharmāvirodhinīmuktvā sukhamakṣayyamāpnuyāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The speech which drops nectar like words cools down a person like the sandal paste. By speaking such words which are conducive to the dharma one achieves everlasting comforts.

## \|\| 1.171.40-44 \|\|

*alaṃ dānena rājeṃdra pūjayādhyāpanena vā \|*  
*idaṃ svargasya sopānamacalaṃ yatpriyaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*pūjābhibhāṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ pratyekaṃ svargahetavaḥ \|*  
*saṃpṛcchedā gataṃ bhaktyā kuśalaṃ praśnamādarāt \|\| 41 \|\|*

*gamane tasya vaktavyaṃ paṃthānaḥ saṃtu te śivāḥ \|*  
*sukhaṃ bhavatu te nityaṃ sarvakāryakaraṃ bhṛśam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*āśīrvādamidaṃ vākyaṃ sarvakāleṣu sarvadā \|*  
*namaskārādivākyeṣu svasti maṃgalavādane \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śivaṃ bhavatu te nityaṃ taṃ brūyātsarvakarmasu \|*  
*evamādi ca vācāramanuṣṭhāya sadāśramī \|\| 44 \|\|*

40-44. O Rajendra, the giving away of charities, performing of puja and its conclusion, are of no use, because for proceeding to the heaven, sweet tongue is surely the first step. To speak sweet words in the performing of the puja and to sec whatever is pleasant for the mind, are tho causes for the heaven. When a guest arrived at one’s place, one should enquire about his welfare and when he departs, then one should wish him a safe and comfortable journey besides success in all the matters. This practice should always be followed. Similarly, when a person offers salutation to you, you should always bless him. During the welfare ceremonies, svasti should be uttered and further a person be blessed for achieving success in all the matters in future. These are the words which should always be used by the performers of the religious rites and by the dwellers of the ashramas.

## \|\| 1.171.45 \|\|

*aśeṣapāpa nirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|*  
*sūryabhakte tu yā bhaktiḥ sadbhaktaiḥ kriyate naraiḥ \|*  
*sūrye bhaktisamā nityaṃ bhakte bhaktiranuṣṭhitā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. By so doing, getting relieved of all the sins, he is honoured in the Suryaloka. The noble devotees should get devoted to the devotees of the Sungod, because by devoting oneself to a devotee of Surya, it is comparable with the devotion of Surya himself.

## \|\| 1.171.46 \|\|

*ākruṣṭe tāḍite vāpi yo nākrośenna tāḍayet \|*  
*vākyādadhikṛtaḥ svasthaḥ sa duḥkhātparimucyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A person who does not react on being denounced and does not strike back when struck by others, but expresses his fearlessness in soft words, he never has to suffer from any pain.

## \|\| 1.171.47-50 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ kṣāṃtiḥ paramapūjitā \|*  
*tasmātpūrva prayatnena kṣāṃtiḥ kāryā kriyāsu vai \|\| 47 \|\|*

*jñānayogatapo yasya yajñadānāni satkriyā \|*  
*krodhanasya vṛthā yasmāttasmātkrodhaṃ vivarjayet \|\| 48 \|\|*

*marmāsthiprāṇahṛdayaṃ nirdahedapriyaṃvacaḥ \|*  
*na vaco hyapriyaṃ tasmādbhojakeṣu viśeṣataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kṣamā dānaṃ tviṣaḥ satyaṃ kṣamāhiṃsārkasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*na śakyā vistarādvaktumapi varṣaśatairapi \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. All the holy places are respectable, therefore, in all the activities, one should always practice forgiveness. The tapas has the form of jnana-yoga, and the performing of yajna is a noble deed. If a person while so doing is angered, then all his efforts become useless. Therefore, the shedding away of anger is necessary. The harsh words when spoken cause pain in sensitive spots, bones, breath and the heart. Therefore, one should avoid the speaking of harsh words, particularly in relation to a Bhojaka. The forgiveness, charity, lustre, truth and non-violence were all generated from Suryaloka. I have explained the subject according to my capacity and this cannot be explained in details in hundreds of years.

## Chapter 172. The Solar dharma

## \|\| 1.172.1-2 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*punaḥ śṛṇu mahārāja dharmamādityasaṃmatam \|*  
*saurapriyaṃ sadā sauraṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kvacidgacchanyadā paśyetsūryārcāsaṃprapūjanam \|*  
*yatra pūjā tato gacchantsa sūryo nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — O great king, you listen to the Surya-dharma as propounded by the Sungod himself, whose devotees are his favorites, is auspicious and the destroyer of sins. You please listen to the same. During the journey, when one finds a Sun temple, he should surely go there, because it is taken to be the form of Surya. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.172.3-6 \|\|

*snānanaivedyavastraiśca nānālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*yathāvibhavamāśritya namaskārādisaṃstavaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvāyatanamākramya namaskṛtya raviṃ vrajet \|*  
*kvacitpathi nadīṃ śailaṃ gacchamānaṃ ca bhojakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*upaśrutyāvaniṃ gatvā bhojakaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*rathāśvagajayānebhyo hyavatīrya magānnṛpa \|*  
*magānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhaktyā śaktyā dānaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*daśapūrvāndaśa parānātmanā saha bhārata \|*  
*samādāya vrajetsthānaṃ raveramitatejasaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Entering the Sun temple, a devotee should offer bath, naivedya, costumes, different types of beautiful ornaments, according to his means and worship the Sungod. Then, he should offer his salutation to the deity and eulogized the image. Thereafter, he can go elsewhere. On the way or while crossing a river, when one comes across a Bhojaka, an intelligent person should go and prostrate before him and should worship him. Mounting over a chariot, a horse or an elephant, one should go to the Maga country, and should give away the charities as per one’s means. By so doing, the ten last and the ten future generations achieve the excellent place of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.172.7-8 \|\|

*daivaparvotsave śrāddhe puṇyeṣu divaseṣu ca \|*  
*bhānuṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadbhojakānbhojayettataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pitaraḥ sarvadevānāṃ sūryamāśritya saṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*prīte sūrye tu te sarve prītāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. On the function of a god, festivities, Shraddha or any other auspicious day, the Sungod should be worshipped, the food should be offered to the Bhojakas, because all the gods and the manes are dependent on the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.172.9-10 \|\|

*yadā ca śraddhayā yuktaṃ prasaktaṃ ravipūjanam \|*  
*bhojayedbhojakaṃ bhaktyā śrāddheṣu vidhivannṛpa \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhojakasya mahārāja divasenāpi yatphalam \|*  
*na tacchakyamidaṃ tena prāptuṃ varṣaśatairapi \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Becoming faithful, getting devoted to the worship of the Sungod, a Bhojaka should be served with food by a person with devotion. With the taking of the food by a Bhojaka, the merit which is earned by a devotee, the same cannot be achieved by him in the future hundreds of years.

## \|\| 1.172.11-12 \|\|

*yaḥ paśyati prasannātmā yo na dveṣṭi na kāṃkṣati \|*  
*śabdādīnāṃ tu saṃbhogaṃ sa vijñeyo jiteṃdriyaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*jñānavijñānasampannaḥ sūryabhaktyā samanvitaḥ \|*  
*pāṣaṃḍayogamuktaśca sa vai bhojaka ucyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. A person who gladly observes and listens without any envy, besides being uninterested in the worldly pleasures, he should be taken to be the one having controlled all his sense organs. Learning all the knowledge, one who worships the Sungod, unless he is a cheat, can be called as a Bhojaka.

## \|\| 1.172.13-14 \|\|

*sūryadharmādbhavejjñānaṃ jñānādvairāgyasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*jñānavairāgyayuktasya sūryayogaḥ pravartate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sūryayogācca sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaḥ sunirvṛtaḥ \|*  
*ātmanyavasthitaḥ śuddhaḥ sūryavaddi vi modate \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. With the adoration of the Sungod, one achieves knowledge. From knowledge, one develops detachment. With the gaining of detachment, he is united with the Sungod. With the combination with the Sungod, he becomes omniscient and complete in all respects. Then, he becomes free form self interest and established in the soul, he becomes auspicious like the Sun and enjoys bliss in the heaven.

## \|\| 1.172.15-17 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāmuttamaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*puruṣebhyo dvijaḥ śreṣṭho dvijebhyo graṃthapāragaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*granthibhyo vedavidvāṃsastebhyasta ttvārthaciṃtakāḥ \|*  
*arthavidbhyaśca jñānārthapratibuddho viśiṣyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*jñānārthakoṭikoṭibhyo variṣṭhā yogino matāḥ \|*  
*yogināṃ koṭikoṭibhyo bhojakaścottamo bhavet \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. Humans are said to be the best of all the living beings. Of the men, the Brahmanas are considered to be the best. The best among the Brahmanas are those who are well-versed in the Vedic literature. The thinkers of tattvas are better than them. Those who are well awakened, are better than them. From a crores of learned people, a yogi is born and after crores of yogis, a Bhojaka is born. This has been ordained.

## \|\| 1.172.18 \|\|

*yogajñā yoganiṣṭhāśca pitaro yogasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*bhojite bhojake sarve prītāḥ syuste na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The manes well-versed in yoga, emerged out of yoga alone and they feel happy when the Bhojakas are served with food. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.172.19 \|\|

*sarvajñānatapodānaiḥ kṛtairdattaiśca yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ vidhivadbhojyabhojakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. All the merits and knowledge are achieved by serving food to a Bhojaka.

## \|\| 1.172.20-21 \|\|

*yaśca dravyakalāpātmā dakṣiṇā havirṛtvijaḥ \|*  
*ṛgyajuḥsāma yogaiśca devayajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*brahmacaryaṃ tapo maunaṃ kṣāṃtirāhāralāghavam \|*  
*ityetattapasāṃ rūpaṃ sudhīraṃ paṃcalakṣaṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. The sacrifice in which, by several means, wealth, expenses, dakshina, havi, Ritvik, Rig, Yajuh and Sama’s contact is established, it is known as Deva-yajna. The five symptoms of tapas are known as observing of Brahmacharya (celibacy), meditation, silences, peace and consuming little of food etc. They are considered to be five main principles of tapas.

## \|\| 1.172.22-23 \|\|

*yacca diṣṭaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca nyāyaprāptaṃ ca yadbhaveta \|*  
*tattadguṇavate deyamityetaddānalakṣaṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vivardhanīṃ sahasrāṇāṃ sarvasasyaprarohiṇīm \|*  
*dadyādbhūmiṃ jalopetāṃ bhūmidānaṃ taducyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. For whom a specific time is prescribed, one who has specialized in a subject, one who gets timely justice, the same thing should be offered to the same learned person at the same time. This is the salient feature of the giving of charity. The earth which produces food for thousands of people, which produces grains for all, besides being filled with water and when it is donated to a person, it is called the giving away of the land.

## \|\| 1.172.24-27 \|\|

*ekacchatrāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā dvijebhyaḥ pratipādayet \|*  
*saṃpūrṇāṃ parvatāraṇyairbhūmidānaṃ taducyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kanyāmalaṃkṛtāṃ dadyādadhanāya narādhipā \|*  
*dvijāya vedaviduṣe kanyādānaṃ taducyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarvadoṣavinirmuktāṃ kulayogyāmalaṃkṛtām \|*  
*madhyamottamavastrāṇāṃ yo dadyādahatāni ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*etatsamāsato jñeyaṃ vastradānasya lakṣaṇam \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇusamādhikyakāṃtiśīlaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*ahorātraṃ na bhuñjīta hyupavāsasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. When all the mountains, forests and the entire land are linked together and then donating the same to the Brahmanas, it is known as donation of land. O king, a girl decorated with ornaments and costumes, should be given to a poor Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, because it is known as real Kanyadana. The girl should also be free from all the blemishes, suitable for the family and adorned with ornaments. The cloth of medium or high quality is considered for giving away in charity. This is called donation of cloth. The symptom of fasting is that inspite of not taking any food for long, the concerned person retains the lustre resembling Brahma and Vishnu.

## \|\| 1.172.28-29 \|\|

*catvāriṃśatsamāyuktaṃ piṃḍānāṃ hi śatadvayam \|*  
*māse hyadyāyathākāmamidaṃ cādrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaśāstrajñaistaponiṣṭhairjiteṃdriyaiḥ \|*  
*devaiśca sevitaṃ toyaṃ kṣitau tattīrthamu cyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. When a person offers two hundred and forty pindas in a month, it is called Chandrayana. The water of the earth which is used by the Rishis learned in scriptures for performing of tapas, is known to be a tirtha.

## \|\| 1.172.30 \|\|

*sūryāvāṃtarasthānāni puṇyakṣetrāṇi nirdiśet \|*  
*mṛtānāṃ teṣu sūryatvaṃ saurakṣetreṣu dehinām \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The intermediate place of Surya is known as the auspicious region. When a person dies in that very region, he achieves the Sayujya devotion of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.172.31 \|\|

*dānānyāvasathaṃ kuryādudyānaṃ deva tāgṛham āvasatha \|*  
*tīrtheṣvetāni yaḥ kuryātso'kṣayaṃ labhate phalam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. By building a temple with a garden at a holy place and giving it in charity, he achieves the everlasting reward.

## \|\| 1.172.32-33 \|\|

*kṣāntiḥ spṛhā tathā satyaṃ dānaṃ śīlaṃ tapaḥ śrutam \|*  
*etadaṣṭāṃgamuddiṣṭaṃ paraṃ pātrasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yajñopavāsadānāni tapastīrtharphalāni ca \|*  
*saṃpūrṇaṃ labhate bhaktyā bhojayitvā tu bhojakān \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. A person who is peaceful, neat and clean, truthful, giver of charities, performer of tapas, engaged in studies, these are the eight qualities of a noble person. These qualities are achieved with the performing of yajna, charity, visiting of the holy places, besides serving food with devotion to the Bhojakas.

## \|\| 1.172.34-35 \|\|

*sūre bhaktiḥ kṣamā satyaṃ daśeṃdriyavinigrahaḥ \|*  
*sukhiteṣu ca maitrī ca sūryadharmasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sūryabhaktaṃ dvijaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ śrāddheṣu ca bhojayet \|*  
*kulasaptakamuddhṛtya sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. The symptoms of the solar religion comprise of forgiveness, devotion towards Surya, truthfulness, control of the ten sense organs and friendship with comfortable people. A person, who during the time of Shraddhas, serves food with devotion to the Bhojakas, he gets honoured in the Suryaloka with his seven generations.

## \|\| 1.172.36 \|\|

*bahunātra kimuktena sūryabhaktaṃ tu bhojayet \|*  
*sūryabhaktena yadbhuktaṃ bhānunāmāśrayaṃ nṛpa \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. What more can be said, whatever food is eaten by a devotee of Surya, it actually becomes the support of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.172.37 \|\|

*na vedaviduṣāṃ koṭyā labhyate ceha tatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ labhate rājanbhojaṃ bhājya vidhānataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. One cannot achieve the same merit by feeding crores of learned people, as compared to the food served to a Bhojaka once, in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 1.172.38 \|\|

*tasmācchrāddhe viśeṣeṇa puṇyeṣu divaseṣu ca \|*  
*sūryamuddiśya vipreṃdra bhojaṃ saṃbhojayennṛpa \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. O great Brahmanas, therefore, during the Shraddhas and other auspicious occasions, the Bhojakas should be served with food for the sake of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.172.39 \|\|

*asaṃyataḥ saṃyato vā sarvāvasthāṃ gatopi vā \|*  
*yaścāsau ravibhaktaḥ syātsūryavatpūjya eva hi \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. In respect of him being disciplined or indisciplined, he has equation with the Sungod, because of his being the devotee of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.172.40-44 \|\|

*saṃsargādvāpi vā lobhādbhojakaṃ yastu bhojayet \|*  
*so'pi yāṃ gatimāpnoti na tāṃ yajñaśatairapi \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tasmānmānyaśca pūjyaśca rakṣaṇīyaśca sarvadā \|*  
*bhojakaḥ kuruśārdūla saureṇa gatimicchatā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*nāmamātraprayatno'pi yadi syādbhojako raveḥ \|*  
*sūryavatsa hi draṣṭavyaḥ pūjanīyaśca bhārata \|\| 42 \|\|*

*gṛhe śrāddhasya yatpuṇyamaraṇye tacchatādhikam \|*  
*saurāśrameṣu vijñeyaṃ tatpuṇyamayutādhikam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*dattvā tu bhojake saumyaṃ hyāsanaṃ saparicchadam \|*  
*dhātudaṃtamayaṃ cāpi rājā bhavati bhūtale \|\| 44 \|\|*

40-44. Out of proximity or out of greed, in case a person feeds a Bhojaka, the merit he so earns cannot be earned by him with the performing of hundreds of yajnas. O lion of the Kuru race, therefore, for him a Bhojaka is adorable, respectful and is to be protected always, because he is desirous of achieving the highest place with Surya. Even when a Bhojaka is by name only, even then he is as adorable as the Sungod. The merit one gets with the performing of a Shraddha in a house, a person gets more than that by doing so in the forest and with the performing of worship in the ashrama of a Surya saint, the same merit multiplies to ten thousand times. A person who gives the bed made of ivory or metal with all the related requirements to a Bhojaka, he becomes the ruler on earth.

## \|\| 1.172.45 \|\|

*vimale vāsasī dattvā bhojakāya mahīpate \|*  
*uddhṛtya śatasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. O king, by giving a pair of excellent costumes to a Bhojaka, the donor, redeeming a hundred thousands of the people of his race, achieves respect in the solar region.

## \|\| 1.172.46 \|\|

*dattvā tu lomaśāṃ rājanbhojakāya śubhāṃ bṛhat \|*  
*romṇiromṇi suvarṇasya dattasya phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. By donating a big woolen blanket to a Bhojaka, he earns the merit of donating the gold from each one of his hair-pit.

## \|\| 1.172.47 \|\|

*śaṃkhaṃ dadāti yo bhaktyā tathā divye ca pāduke \|*  
*sūryalokamavāpnoti tejasā ravisannibhaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. A person, who with devotion, donates the sandals and a conch, he getting adored like the sunshine, ultimately reaches the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.172.48 \|\|

*likhāpayati yo bhaktyā purāṇena tu pustakam \|*  
*yugakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. A person, who with utmost devotion, has the Purana written (by experts), he is respected in the Suryaloka for a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 1.172.49-50 \|\|

*bhavedihāgataḥ śrīmānsukhāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ karoti gṛhaṃ bhānostatsthānaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tatsūryo bhojakaḥ sotra bhojakaḥ sūrya eva hi \|*  
*tena bhojakavipreṣu dānamakṣayyamityapi \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. One who makes an excellent abode for the Sungod, he after reaching there, enjoys all the comforts and becomes immensely learned. Infact, Bhojaka is Surya and Surya is Bhojaka. Therefore, the charities given to a Bhojaka Brahmana, is everlasting by nature.

## \|\| 1.172.51-52 \|\|

*yadyadyasyopayujyeta deyaṃ tattasya yatnataḥ \|*  
*upayogaparo nityaṃ sūryastadubhayorapi \|\| 51 \|\|*

*vyākhyāne sauradharmasya kṛtvā āmalakaṃ mahat \|*  
*śobhitaṃ puṣpapatrādyairnyasettatrāsane surāḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Whatever is needed by a person, it must be provided to him, because the Sungod helps on both the sides. When the discussion on the solar religion takes place, a mirror decorated with flower garland and tender shoots should also be placed there over the pedestal.

## \|\| 1.172.53 \|\|

*śobhitaṃ mālyagandhaistu sūryasya sādhanaṃ mahat \|*  
*purastāttasya saṃsthāpya ācāryaṃ pūjayetsadā \|*  
*sūryavatsauradharme ca tulyametaddvayaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. An Acharya is considered to be the great source for Surya, who should be made to take his seat in front of the image of the Sungod. He should be offered the fragrant flower garlands and should always be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.172.54-55 \|\|

*ya evaṃ nyāyato vakti sauradharmaṃ śṛṇoti ca \|*  
*āyurvidyāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtimupalabhya raviṃ japet \|*  
*vadaṃtyanye pibaṃtyanye sarve te phalabhāginaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tasmādevaṃvidho dharmo vācakaiśca vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*tasyānte pūjayedbhaktyā ya icchedvipulaṃ yaśaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Thus a person, who conducting himself in a judicious manner, listens to the solar dharma, he enjoys long life, gets education, glory and fame. He also has an audience with the Sungod. Those who follow the truth alone, or drink the nectar of solar dharma, all of them earn due merits. Therefore, the reciters should enlighten the learned persons accordingly, which is necessary. Those who are desirous of achieving enormous glory, then after the worship of the Sungod, the Acharya or the reciter should also be worshipped.

## Chapter 173. Description of Solar dharma

## \|\| 1.173.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*punarme brūhi viprendra sauraṃ dharmamanuttamam \|*  
*samāsātkathitaṃ brahmanvistareṇa prakīrtaya \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O Indra among the Brahmanas, you kindly repeat the solar dharma, because you have described it in brief. Therefore, I would like to hear it in an exhaustive manner.

## \|\| 1.173.2 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhārata \|*  
*tvatsamo nāsti loke'sminsauraḥ pārthivasattama \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sumantu said — O valorous one, well done, You have put up an excellent question. There is no devotee of the Sungod on earth better than you.

## \|\| 1.173.3-5 \|\|

*kīrtayāmyatha taṃ puṇyaṃ saṃvādaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*garuḍāruṇayo rājanpurāvṛttaṃ narādhipa \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sukhāsīnaṃ purā rājannaruṇaṃ sūryasārathim \|*  
*upagamya mahābāho garuḍo vākyamavravīt \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dharmāṇāmuttamaṃ dharmaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*sauradharmaṃ khagaśreṣṭha brūhi me kṛtsnaśonagha \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Now, I am going to repeat the auspicious conversation between Arupa and Garuda. O monarch! In earlier times, once Arana, the charioteer of the Sun’s chariot, was seated comfortably, when Garuda arrived there and asked — “O sinless one, O best of birds, you explain to me the Saura-dharma which is best of all the dharmas and is the remover of sins.” Aruna said — “Well done, O son, you are great soul and graceful as well. You are free from sins because you are desirous to listen about the solar dharma.

## \|\| 1.173.6-8 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*sādhu vatsa mahātmāsi dhanyastvaṃ pāpavarjitaḥ \|*  
*śrotukāmo'si yatputra sauradharmamanuttamam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śṛṇu tvaṃ kīrtayāmyeṣa sukhopāyaṃ mahatphalam \|*  
*paramaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sauradharmamanuttamam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ajñānārṇavamagnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmayam \|*  
*sauradharmo hyayaṃ śrīmānparatīraprado yataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. This Saura-dharma can be followed with comfort and is immensely rewarding. Ibis is therefore, best of all the dharmas. I am going to reveal the facts about it. You please listen. All the living beings who are drowning in the ocean of ignorance are to be rescued and be made to float over the other side of the ocean, by means of the solar dharma alone.

## \|\| 1.173.9 \|\|

*ye smaraṃti raviṃ bhaktyā kīrtayaṃti ca ye khaga \|*  
*pūjayanti ca ye nityaṃ te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O bird, those who meditate upon the Sungod daily, worship him and sing kirtana for him, they achieve the absolute position.

## \|\| 1.173.10 \|\|

*ātmadrohaḥ kṛtastena jāteneha khagādhipa \|*  
*nārcito yena deveśaḥ sahasrakiraṇo raviḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. O bird king, one who has not adored the Sungod with a thousand rays, he having his birth in the world, has actually killed his own soul.

## \|\| 1.173.11-12 \|\|

*suciraṃ saṃbhramatyasminduḥkhade ca bhavārṇave \|*  
*jarābhūtamahāgrāhe tṛṣṇāvelākulāpare \|\| 11 \|\|*

*mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya ye'rcayaṃti divākaram \|*  
*teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ janma kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The old age is a great crocodile. Desire and anxiety are the shores of the painful ocean of the universe in which people are drowning. Those, who after being born as humans, worship the Sungod, their birth on earth is successful, because such of the excellent people are successful.

## \|\| 1.173.13 \|\|

*sūryabhaktiparā ye ca ye ca tadgatamānasāḥ \|*  
*ye smaraṃti sadā sūryaṃ na te duḥkhasya bhāginaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Getting absorbed in the devotion of the Sungod, those who meditate upon Surya and worship him, they do not have to face misery.

## \|\| 1.173.14 \|\|

*vividhāni manojñāni vividhābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ vā dṛṣṭaparyaṃtaṃ sūryapūjāvidheḥ phalam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The beautiful damsels, adorned with various types of ornaments and enormous treasure of wealth, can be found on earth, which are the good effects of the properly performed puja of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.173.15-16 \|\|

*ye vāṃchanti mahābhogānrājyaṃ vā tridaśā laye \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ kāṃtimatulāṃ bhogaṃ tyāgaṃ yaśaḥ śriyam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*saundaryaṃ jagataḥ khyātiḥ kīrtirdharmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*phalānyetāni vai putra sūrya bhaktividherbudha \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. They enjoy all the great pleasures of the heaven, besides kingdom, fortunes, extraordinary grace, pleasures, renunciation, glory, fortune, world fame and are further desirous of dharma. These are the results of the worship done by them in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 1.173.17 \|\|

*tasmātsaṃpūjayetsūryaṃ sarvadevagaṇārcitam \|*  
*durlabhā bhāskare bhaktirdurlabhaṃ ca tadarcanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Therefore, the Sungod, who is the lord of all the Devas, must be worshipped which is difficult to achieve.

## \|\| 1.173.18 \|\|

*dānaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tasmai taddhomaśca sudurlabhaḥ \|*  
*durlabhaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ tadabhyāso'pi durlabhaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. It is difficult for them to give away the charities. Their knowledge and practice is also beyond the reach.

## \|\| 1.173.19 \|\|

*sudurlabhataraṃ jñeyaṃ tadārādhanamuttamam \|*  
*lobhasteṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ye raviṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The excellent worship of the Sungod is extremely difficult to achieve. Those of the people, who have gained the worship of the Sungod, the same is a great asset or gain for them.

## \|\| 1.173.20-24 \|\|

*yeṣāmiheśvare bhānau nityaṃ sūrye gataṃ manaḥ \|*  
*namaskārādisaṃyuktaṃ ravirityakṣaradvayam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*jihvāgre vartate yasya sakalaṃ tasya jīvitam \|*  
*ya evaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ \|*  
*mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ḍākinyo vividhākārā rākṣasāḥ sapiśācakāḥ \|*  
*na tasya pīḍāṃ kurvaṃti tathānyāśca vibhīṣaṇāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śatravo nāśamāyāṃti saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt \|*  
*na rogaiḥ pīḍyate vīra āpado na spṛśaṃti tam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dhanamāyuryaśo vidyā prabhāvo hyatulaṃ tathā \|*  
*śubhenopacayaṃ yāṃti nityaṃ pūrṇamanorathāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. Such of the persons, who are devoted to offering salutation to the Sungod and on the tips of whose tongues the world Ravi always remains lodged, their lives alone are successful. Thus, a person, who getting immensely devoted worship the Sungod, he is surely relieved of all the sins. There is no doubt that Dakinis, and the Rakshasas of different types as well as the Pishachas cannot cause any pain to him. Besides those with other terrific bodies are unable to cause any harm to them. In the battle, they get victorious, defeating the enemies. The pain of the diseases and other obstructions cannot touch them. Because of the performing of the noble deeds, the wealth, long life, glory, education, extraordinary influence are all possessed by them. All their desires also get fulfilled always.”

## Chapter 174. Prayer to Sungod

## \|\| 1.174.1 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*pūjayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā brahmā bahmatvamāgataḥ \|*  
*viṣṇutvaṃ cāpi deveśo viṣṣurāpa tadarcanāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Arana said — By worshiping the Sungod, Brahma achieved Brahmanhood and Vishnu — the leader of the gods, has achieved Vaishnavism.

## \|\| 1.174.2 \|\|

*śaṃkaro'pi jagannāthaḥ pūjayitvā divākaram \|*  
*mahādevatvamagamattatprasādātkhagādhipa \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O best of the birds, Shiva also, after adoring the Sungod, by his grace has attained the position of Mahadeva.

## \|\| 1.174.3-4 \|\|

*sahasrākṣopi deveśa indro bhānuṃ tamopaham \|*  
*indratvamagamaddevaṃ pūjayitvā divākaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*mātaro devagaṃdharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ \|*  
*pūjayaṃti sadā bhānumīśānaṃ suranāyakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Then Indra, with a thousand eyes, worshipped Surya — the remover of darkness, and thereby attained the position of Indra. Similarly, the mothers, the gods, Gandharvas, Pishachas, Nagas and the Rakshasas also worship the Sungod, who is the leader of all the gods.

## \|\| 1.174.5 \|\|

*sarvametajjagannityaṃ bhānau deve pratiṣṭhitam \|*  
*tasmātsaṃpūjayedbhānuṃ ya icchetsvargamakṣayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The entire universe stands absorbed in the Sungod, therefore, a person desirous of achieving the heaven, should worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.174.6 \|\|

*yo na pūjayate sūryaṃ bhāskaraṃ tamasūdanam \|*  
*dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ na naro bhājanaṃ bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. If Bhaskara — the remover of darkness, is not worshipped by a person, he does not get entitled to dharma, artha, kama and even moksha.

## \|\| 1.174.7 \|\|

*tasmātkāryaṃ hi taddhyānaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā \|*  
*arcayeta sadā bhānumāpanno'pi sadā khaga \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Therefore, with a firm resolve in one’s mind, he should worship the Sungod. During the time of misery also, he should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.174.8 \|\|

*yastu saṃtiṣṭhate nityaṃ vinā sūryasya pūjanāt \|*  
*varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ śiraso vātha cchedanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. A person who spends time without adoring the Sungod, it would be better for him to end his life by cutting off his head.

## \|\| 1.174.9 \|\|

*sūryaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīta tridaśeśaṃ divākaram \|*  
*itthaṃ nirvahate yasya yāvajjīvaṃ tadarcanam \|*  
*manuṣyacarmaṇā naddhaḥ sa ravirnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A person who takes food after worshipping the Sungod, and spend the entire life in worshipping him, he should not be considered as a human, but the Sungod in the garb of a human. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.174.10-11 \|\|

*na hi arkārcanādanyatpuṇyamapyadhikaṃ bhavet \|*  
*iti vijñāya yatnena pūjayasva divākaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sūryabhaktāgamāścaiva sūryārcanaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*saṃyatā dharmasaṃpannā dharmādīnsādhayanti te \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. No one can get the merit greater than the one bestowed by the Sungod. Realizing this, the Sungod should be worshipped. On the arrival of a devotee of Surya, who worships him daily controlling all his sense organs, the dharma is established, because one achieves success in dharma alone.

## \|\| 1.174.12-17 \|\|

*sarvadvandvasahā vīrā nītividhyuktacetasaḥ \|*  
*paropakāraniratā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*amānino buddhimanto'vyaktaspardhā gataspṛhāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtā svāṃtagatā bhadrā nityaṃ svāgatavādinaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*svalpavācaḥ sumanasaḥ śūrāḥ śāstraviśāradāḥ \|*  
*śaucācārasusaṃpannā dayādākṣiṇyagocarāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*daṃbhamatsaranirmuktāstṛṣṇālobhavivarjitāḥ \|*  
*saṃvibhāgaparāḥ proktā na śaṭhāścāpyakutsitāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*viṣayeṣvapi nirlepāḥ padmapatramivāṃbhasā \|*  
*na dīnā māninaścaiva na ca rogavaśānugāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bhavaṃti bhāvitātmānaḥ susnigdhāḥ sādhusevitāḥ \|*  
*na pāṇipādavākcakṣuḥśrotraśiśnodare ratāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

12-17. The valorous people bear the miseries of all types, who follow the procedure prescribed in the scriptures, who do good to others, serving the preceptors, devoid of arrogance, intelligent, who do not enter into useless controversies, they don’t have competition with others except in business, who are peaceful and move in with pure soul, who are the form of welfare, who always welcome others, truthful, having a spotless heart, well — versed in archery, possessing purity, talk little about fail of wisdom deprived of cheating and fraud, who have discarded desire and greed, and who are deprived of wickedness, such people are not to be denounced. They are not at all involved in the worldly pleasures, like the lotus in the mud, they are deprived of inferiority and arrogance. They are free from ailments and remain in contact with the people of mobility and preserve a soft heart and broad nature. They do not get attracted towards the activities of hands, feet, speech, ears, linga and the belly.

## \|\| 1.174.18 \|\|

*capalāni na kurvaṃti sarvavyāsaṃgavarjitāḥ \|*  
*sūryāsanaratāḥ śāṃtāḥ ṣaḍakṣaramanogatāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. They remain away from coming in contact with the undesirable people and preserve no instability. But getting attracted towards the Sungod, they remain peaceful and recite the six-lettered mantra.

## \|\| 1.174.19 \|\|

*ityācārasamāyuktā bhavaṃti bhuvi mānavāḥ \|*  
*ekāṃtabhaktimāsthāya dharmakāmārthasiddhaye \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. For the success of dharma, artha and kama, people should worship the Sungod at a secluded spot and observe this type of conduct.

## \|\| 1.174.20-22 \|\|

*pūjanīyo ravirnityaṃ guṇeṣveteṣu vartate \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva pātrāṇāmatipātraṃ divākaraḥ \|*  
*patantaṃ trāyate yasmādatīva narakārṇavāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tasya pātrātipātrasya māhātmyaṃ dānamaṇvapi \|*  
*anena phalamādiṣṭamihaloke paratra ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dravyeṇāpi hi yaḥ kuryānnaraḥ karma tadālaye \|*  
*so'pi dehakṣaye jñānaṃ prāpya śāṃtimavāpnuyāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. All these qualities remain enshrined always in the Sungod, because Surya is considered to be the best of all the Devas. The one who could rescue a person having fallen in the ocean of hell, he is considered to be the best of the actors. Even when a petty amount of charity is given for the sake of the Sungod, then also, the related merits are achieved by a person in this world as well as the heaven. A person who spends money for the Sun temple, he attains knowledge and peace after his death.

## \|\| 1.174.23 \|\|

*sarvadvijakadaṃbeṣu kaścijjñānamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*kaścidetattu me divyaṃ labdhvā jñānaṃ vimuñcati \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Out of the groups of the Brahmanas, only a few attain full knowledge, while others achieving the divine knowledge, depart from this world.

## \|\| 1.174.24 \|\|

*tāvadbhramaṃti saṃsāre duḥkhaśokapariplutāḥ \|*  
*na bhavaṃti raverbhaktā yāvatsarvepi dehinaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Unless all the living beings get devoted to the Sungod, they get involved in the miseries of the world and keep on wandering.

## \|\| 1.174.25 \|\|

*sūryasyālepanaṃ puṇyaṃ dviguṇaṃ candanasya tu \|*  
*candanādagurau jñeyaṃ puṇyamaṣṭaguṇottaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The plaster offering to the Sungod is quite meritorious, but when the sandalpaste is offered, it is double rewarding. The offering of agaru paste is eight times more rewarding than that of the sandalpaste.

## \|\| 1.174.26 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāgurau viśeṣeṇa dviguṇaṃ phalamiṣyate \|*  
*tasmācchataguṇa puṇyaṃ kuṃkumasya vidhīyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The black agaru especially yields double the reward. But when the paste of kunkum offered, it yields a hundred times more reward.

## \|\| 1.174.27 \|\|

*sūryayajñopakaraṇaṃ kṛtvālpaṃ yadi vā bahu \|*  
*bhāvādvittānusāreṇa sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. For the performing of yajna for Surya, one should act according to his devotion and resources. Even when it is organized in an ordinary way, one achieves the Suryaloka where he is well respected.

## \|\| 1.174.28 \|\|

*yadapīṣṭamaniṣṭaṃ ca nyāyenobhayamāgatam \|*  
*tatsūryāya nivedyaṃ sadbhaktyānantaphalārthinā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O judicious Kshatriya, otherwise whatever is available, be it big or small, he should offer the same with devotion to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.174.29 \|\|

*karmaśāṭhyena yaḥ kuryādduḥkhenāpi tadarcanam \|*  
*so'pi dvijo divaṃ yāti karmaṇā pāpavarjitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Because of unfavourable time, in case a person is placed in a miserable condition, but he continue to worship the Sungod with his meagre means, the said Brahmana, with the same performance, gets relieved of all the sins and attains the heaven.

## \|\| 1.174.30 \|\|

*sarvamanyatparityajya sūrye caikamanā sadā \|*  
*sūryapūjāvidhiṃ kuryādya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. A person who is desirous of his own welfare, then discarding everything, he should worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.174.31 \|\|

*tvaritaṃ jīvitaṃ yāti tvaritaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā \|*  
*tvaritaṃ vyādhirapyeti tasmānnityaṃ raviṃ vrajet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The human body is short lived. Similarly, the youthful age has a short span of life. The human body attracts ailments quickly. Therefore, one should always be ready for the Sun worship.

## \|\| 1.174.32 \|\|

*yāvannābhyeti maraṇaṃ yāvannākramate jarā \|*  
*yāvanneṃdriya vaikalyaṃ tāvadarceddivākaram \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Before one’s body attracts old age, the stage of death and the sense organs become inactive, the worship of the Sungod should be continued.

## \|\| 1.174.33 \|\|

*na sūryārcanatulyopi na dharmonyo jagattraye \|*  
*itthaṃ vijñāya deveśaṃ pūjayasva divākaram \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. There is no other dharma in the three worlds which could be compared with the Sun worship. Well understanding this, one should worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.174.34 \|\|

*ye bhaktyā devadeveśaṃ sūryaṃ śāṃtamajaṃ prabhum \|*  
*iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. One who worships the Sungod who is beyond birth, baseless being the lord of gods, peaceful, he enjoys all the pleasures in the world, besides achieving the highest position.

## \|\| 1.174.35 \|\|

*gopatiṃ pūjayitvā tu prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā \|*  
*kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā purā brahmābravīdidam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. In earlier times, after completing the worship of Surya with delight, Brahma had ultimately eulogized him.

## \|\| 1.174.36-37 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*bhagavantaṃ bhagakaraṃ śāṃtacittamanuttamam \|*  
*devamārgapraṇetāraṃ praṇato'smi raviṃ sadā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*śāśvataṃ śobhanaṃ śuddhaṃ citrabhānuṃ divaspatim \|*  
*devadeveśamīśeśaṃ praṇato'smi divākaram \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Brahma said — O Bhaga, with a peaceful mind and leader of the divine path, salutation the Sungod always. You are always beautiful, pure and are known as Chitrabhanu Divaspati, lord of gods, Isa of the Ishvara besides being Divakara. Salutation to you.

## \|\| 1.174.38-40 \|\|

*sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ devaṃ sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ ravim \|*  
*varānanaṃ varāṃgaṃ ca varasthānaṃ varapradam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ nityaṃ praṇato'smi vibhāvasum \|*  
*arkamaryamaṇaṃ cendraṃ viṣṇumīśaṃ divākaram \|\| 39 \|\|*

*deveśvaraṃ devarataṃ praṇato'smi vibhāvasum \|*  
*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ brahmaṇoktaṃ stavaṃ param \|*  
*sa hi kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya punaḥ sūryapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. You are the remover of all the miseries, Deva, remover of all the sufferings. O Surya, you have a beautiful face, excellent limbs and excellent abode, you are the bestower of boons, adorable, besides being Vibhavasu, salutation to you. You are also known as Arka, Aryama, Vishnu, Isa, Divakara, Deveshvara, favourite of the gods, salutation to you. A person who daily recites eulogy by Brahma, or listens to it, he surely earns the excellent glory and fame, besides achieving the solar region.

## Chapter 175. Fire rites of Surya

## \|\| 1.175.1-2 \|\|

*garuḍa uvāca \|*  
*sarvarogahatā ye tu ādhivyādhisamanvitāḥ \|*  
*grahopaghātairvividhairarditā ye ca mānavāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*aribhiḥ pīḍitā ye ca vināyakahatāśca ye \|*  
*kartavyaṃ kiṃ bhavetteṣāmātmanaḥ śreyase'nagha \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Garuda said — O sinless one! A person, who is suffering from body as well as the mental ailment getting shattered, besides suffering from the evil effect of the planets, facing several discomforts, surrounded by the enemies who torture him, besides face death from the remover of the obstructions, then what should be done by him for the sake of his welfare?

## \|\| 1.175.3 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*nānārogahatānāṃ tu arditānāṃ tathāribhiḥ \|*  
*ādityārādhanaṃ muktvā nānyacchreyaskaraṃ param \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Aruna said — For a person, who is suffering from various types of diseases as well as the enemies, there is no other remedy more beneficial than the worship of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.175.4 \|\|

*tasmādārādhayennityaṃ sarvarogavināśanam \|*  
*grahopaghātahaṃtāraṃ rājopadravanāśanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The Sungod should always be adored for the cure from ailments, evil effect of the harsh planets or the sufferings caused by the king. This should be regularly done.

## \|\| 1.175.5-7 \|\|

*garuḍa uvāca \|*  
*sarvapatravihīnaṃ me sarvarogavivarjitam \|*  
*śāpena brahmavādinyāḥ paśyāṃgaṃ dvijasattama \|\| 5 \|\|*

*evaṃ mattasya me tāta kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate \|*  
*yenāhaṃ karmaṇā kalpo bhaveyaṃ patravānpunaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tanme brūhi khagaśreṣṭha prapannasya khagādhipa \|*  
*yatkṛtvā kalpatāṃ prāpya pūjayāmi divākaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Garuda said — O best of Brahmanas, you look at my wings, all of which have been burnt out because of the curse from a female ascetic well-versed in the Vedas. I am unable to reach the heaven. Can a remedy be possible for a person like me? O best of the birds, you kindly tell me a way out, by which, I could have my wings re-grown afresh, getting restored my earlier beauty. O lord of birds, I take refuge in you.

## \|\| 1.175.8-9 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*pūjayasva jagannāthaṃ bhāskaraṃ timirāpaham \|*  
*sūryāgnikāryaṃ satataṃ śuddhacittaḥ samācara \|\| 8 \|\|*

*mahāśāṃtikaraṃ khyātaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam \|*  
*grahopaghātahaṃtāraṃ śubhakāryaṃkaraṃ param \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Aruna said — O lord of the world, you better worship Bhaskara — the destroyer of the darkness of the world, with a purified mind, worship the Sungod by consecrating the fire, and it should be done regularly which bestows great peace. He is well known, remover of all the turmoils, remover of the evil effects of the planets and is the performer of the noble deeds.

## \|\| 1.175.10-11 \|\|

*garuḍa uvāca \|*  
*nāhaṃ śaktosmi vai kartuṃ pūjāṃ dinakarasya ca \|*  
*na cāgnikāryaṃ śaknomi kartuṃ vikalatāṃ gataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tasmānme kuru śāṃtyarthamagnikāryaṃ khagādhipa \|*  
*mahāśāṃtiriti khyātaṃ śāṃtaye mama suvrata \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Garuda said — I am unable to worship the Sungod and because of my deformity, I also cannot perform the fire rites. Therefore, for my sake, you yourself perform the religious as well as the fire rites for me.

## \|\| 1.175.12 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*evameva yadāttha tvaṃ vainateya khagādhipa \|*  
*akalpastvaṃ na śaknoṣi mahāvyādhiprapīḍitaḥ \|\| 12\|\|*

12\. Aruna said — O foremost of the birds, the words spoken by you are absolutely appropriate because in view of your debility, it is impossible for you to do the needful.

## \|\| 1.175.13-17 \|\|

*ahaṃ karomi te putra śāṃtaye pāvakārcanam \|*  
*yatkṛtaṃ mama cārkeṇa purā śāṃtidamādarāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāvipravināśanam \|*  
*mahodayaṃ śātikaraṃ lakṣahomavidhi smṛtam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*apamṛtyuharaṃ vīra sarvavyādhiharaṃ param \|*  
*paracakrapramathanaṃ sadāvijayavardhanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tṛptidaṃ sarvadevānāṃ bhāskarapriyamuttam \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ diśi lipyātha sthaḍilaṃ gomayena tu \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devālayasya vidhivatkuryādagniprabodhanam \|*  
*mahāvyāhṛtibhirvīra lakṣahomaṃ samācaret \|\| 17 \|\|*

13-17. Therefore, O son, for your satisfaction, I am going to perform the fire rites for your sake. The related process was spoken out to me in earlier times, by the Sungod himself. The same process bestows peace, removes all the sins, auspicious, remover of grave obstructions, results in great rising up for self and is peaceful. For that purpose, a lakh of offerings have to be made. It averts the untimely death and all the ailments. It destroys the cakra of the enemy, always makes a man to be victorious and is the favourite of the Sungod. A raised pedestal in a temple should be plastered with the cowdung and the fire should be consecrated over there. The performers should then drop a lakh of offerings in the same.

## \|\| 1.175.18-32 \|\|

*bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti svāhā praṇavena samanvitam \|*  
*āraktadeharūpāya raktākṣāya mahātmane \|\| 18 \|\|*

*dharādharāya śāntāya sahasrākṣiśirāya ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*adhomukhāya śvetāya svāhā pūrvāhutiṃ sṛjet \|*  
*caturmukhāya śāṃtāya padmāsanagatāya ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

*padmavarṇāya vedhāya kamaṇḍaludharāya ca \|*  
*dvitīyordhvamukhāyeha svāhākārāhutiṃ sṛjet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*hemavarṇāya dehāya airāvatagatāya ca \|*  
*sahasrākṣaśarīrāya pūrvadiśyunmukhāya ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*devādhipāya cendrāya vihastāya śubhāya ca \|*  
*svāhākāraṃ cotsṛjedeva tṛtīyavadanāya ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dīptāya vyaktadehāya jvālāmālākulāya ca \|*  
*indranīlābhadehāya sarvārogyakarāya ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

*yamāya dharmarājāya dakṣiṇāśāmukhāya ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṃbaradharāyeha svāhāhutimanutsṛjet \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nīlajīmūtavarṇāya raktāṃbaradharāya ca \|*  
*muktāphalaśarīrāya piṃgākṣāya mahātmane \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śuklavastrāya pītāya divyapāśadharāya ca \|*  
*svāhākārāya ca tathā paścimābhimukhāya ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇapiṃgalanetrāya vāyavyābhimukhāya ca \|*  
*nīladhvajāya vīrāya tathā cendrāya vedhase \|\| 28 \|\|*

*svāheti pavanāyeha āhutiṃ cotsṛjedbudhaḥ \|*  
*gadāhastāya sūryāya citrasragbhūṣaṇāya ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

*mahodarāya śāṃtāya svāhādhipataye tathā \|*  
*uttarābhimukhāyeha mahādevapriyāya ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

*śvetāya śvetavarṇāya citrākṣāya mahātmane \|*  
*śāṃtāya śāṃtarūpāya pinākavaradhāriṇe \|\| 31 \|\|*

*īśānābhimukhāyeha dadyādīśāya cāhutim \|*  
*visṛjetkhagaśārdūla vidhivacchreyasenagha \|\| 32 \|\|*

18-32. Then facing east, reciting the hymn — “Om Bhur Bhuvah Svaha” an offering should be poured in the fire dedicating it to the lord with red limbs, red eyes, red complexion, the great soul, serpent 3esha, peaceful, having a thousand eyes and heads, with lowered head and with the one having white complexion, the offering is meant This second offering is meant for Brahma with four faces, who is peaceful, seated in padmasana, having the complexion of lotus, holding a kamandalu whose second face is raised. The third offering is meant for Indra with gold like complexion of the body, mounted over elephant, possessing a thousand eyes, facing towards the east. The rest offerings are meant for Dharmaraja and Yama, the god of death with flames issuing from his body, having the complexion of sapphire, the one who provides cure from all the ailments, having his face turned towards the south, clad in black garments. Next offering is for the Wind-god, having the complexion of a blue cloud, clad in red garments, with the body resembling a jewel, with pinkish eyes. Then, there is for Varna with white costumes, holding a noose of yellow colour, having turned his face to the west, for whom this offering is being made. Then there is the offering for the god whose eyes are black as well as pink, his flag is blue, who faces the north-east. The offering is meant for Vedha and the Wind-god. Then Surya, holding a club in his hand, decorated with the flower garlands, pleasant, peaceful to look at, the lord of Svaha, facing the north, beloved of Mahadeva, white complexioned, holder of an excellent bow, facing the north-east, for him (Siva) this offering is meant. Thus, after the uttering of each name, the word Svaha should be uttered, before dropping the offering. With the pouring of these offerings in an appropriate manner, the welfare of the concerned person is certain to happen.

## \|\| 1.175.33-34 \|\|

*evaṃ devaṃ mahātmānaṃ pāvakaṃ vidhivatkhaga \|*  
*arhediti tu yatkāryaṃ tatsauraṃ khagasattama \|\| 33 \|\|*

*lakṣahomaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtvā śāṃtikamācaret \|*  
*bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti svā hā lakṣahomavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. O sinless bird! Thus, the adoration of the fire god done in an appropriate manner, is known as a hundred rites performed. O best of the birds, after performing fire sacrifice with a lakh of offerings, the homa may be completed, and after which the shanti mantra should be recited for peace. There is a provision for the performing of a homa by making offerings reciting the mantra — Bhurbhuvah Svariti Svaha, a lakh of times.

## \|\| 1.175.35-39 \|\|

*mahāhome ca vai saura eṣa eva vidhiḥ paraḥ \|*  
*kṛtvaivamagnikāryaṃ tu bhojako bhāskarāya vai \|\| 35 \|\|*

*śāṃtyarthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ tataḥ śāṃtikamācaret \|*  
*sindūrāsanaraktābhaḥ raktapadmābhalocanaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sahasrakiraṇo devaḥ saptāśvarathavāhanaḥ \|*  
*gabhastimālī bhagavānsarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ grahapīḍānivāriṇīm \|*  
*tricakrarathamārūḍha apāṃ sāramayaṃ tu yaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*daśāśvavāhano deva ātreya ścāmṛtasravaḥ \|*  
*śītāṃśuramṛtātmā ca kṣayavṛddhisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*somaḥ saumyena bhāvena grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu \|\| 39 \|\|*

35-39. This process has been said to be the best in the forest of the solar region. A Bhojaka, after performing the fire rites, thereafter the Shantikarma should be started for the welfare of all. Having the seat of vermilion, Surya should have red complexion, the eyes should be red like red lotus flowers, having a thousand rays, seated over a chariot driven by seven horses, wearing the garland of rays and adored by all the gods. Such type of the Sungod shall always relieve you of the domestic pain and bestow on you immense peace. The Moon with three wheeled chariot should be used by him, he is the sattvika form of the water. The chariot is driven by ten horses. The son of Atri — Moon, is nectar like and gradually increases and decreases. Let such a Moon god remove all your domestic sufferings.

## \|\| 1.175.40 \|\|

*padmarāganibho bhaumo madhupiṃgala locanaḥ \|*  
*aṃgārako'gnisadṛśo grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Bhauma (Mars) is having the complexion of ruby, with pink eyes resembling the honey, and flaming like the fire. Let such a planet Mars, relieve you of the domestic pain.

## \|\| 1.175.41 \|\|

*puṣparāganibheneha dehena paripiṃgalaḥ \|*  
*pītamālyāṃbaradharo budhaḥ pīḍāṃ vyapohatu \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Let Mercury, having the complexion of pollen (flower dust), wearing the yellow garments and garland of the same colour, subside your suffering.

## \|\| 1.175.42-44 \|\|

*taptagairikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*sarvadevagururvipro hyatharvaṇavaro muniḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatiriti khyāta arthaśāstraparaśca yaḥ \|*  
*śāṃtena cetasā sopi pareṇa susamāhitaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*grahapīḍāṃ vinirjitya karotu tava śāṃtikam \|*  
*sūryārcanaparo nityaṃ prasādādbhāskarasya tu \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Let Brihaspati (Jupiter) — the preceptor of the gods, having the complexion of the molten gold, well-versed in all the scriptures, Brahmana by birth, belonging to the Atharvan gotra, well-versed in the Arthashastra, such a preceptor of the gods daily worship the Sungod. Therefore, for the pleasure of lord Bhaskara, let your pain be removed.

## \|\| 1.175.45-49 \|\|

*himakuṃdeṃduvarṇābho daityadānavapūjitaḥ \|*  
*maheśvarastato dhīmānmahāsauro mahāmatiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sūryārcanaparo nityaṃ śukraḥ śuklanibhastadā \|*  
*nītiśāstraparo nityaṃ grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu \|\| 46 \|\|*

*nānārūpadharovyakta avijñātagatiśca yaḥ \|*  
*notpattirjāyate yasya nodayapīḍitairapi \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ekacūlo dvicūlaśca triśikhaḥ paṃcacūlakaḥ \|*  
*sahasraśirarūpastu candraketuriva sthitaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*sūryaputrogniputrastu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ \|*  
*anekaśikharaḥ ketuḥ sa te pīḍāṃ vyapohatu \|\| 49 \|\|*

45-49. Let the planet Shukra (Venus) having the complexion of snow or the white lotus flowers, or the moon, who is adored by the Danavas as well as the Daityas, intelligent, a great devotee of Surya, possessing enormous intelligence, remove your domestic misery. Let Ketu, who takes to many forms, whose movements are unknown, who because of the suffering of the pains of birth, remained unborn, having a single, two, three and five locks of hair on the head, having a thousand heads,, who is said to be the son of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva having many peaks, remove your sufferings.

## \|\| 1.175.50 \|\|

*ete grahā mahātmānaḥ sūryārcanaparāḥ sadā \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te hṛṣṭāḥ sadā kālaṃ hitekṣaṇāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Thus planets, who are the great souls, always keep on worshipping the Sungod. Let the planets who always adore the Sungod, caste a compassionate look at you and getting pleased for your total welfare, bestow peace on you.

## Chapter 176. The Solar dharma described

## \|\| 1.176.1-5 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*padmāsanaḥ padmavarṇaḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śrīmāndevagaṃdharvapūjitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*caturmukho devapatiḥ sūryārcanaparaḥ sadā \|*  
*surajyeṣṭho mahātejāḥ sarva lokaprajāpatiḥ \|*  
*brahmaśabdena divyena brahmā śāṃtiṃ karotu te \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pītāṃbaradharo deva ātreyīdayitaḥ sadā \|*  
*śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śyāmavarṇaścaturbhujaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yajñadehaḥ kramo deva ātreyīdayitaḥ sadā \|*  
*śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirmādhavo madhusūdanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sūryabhaktānvito nityaṃ vigatirvigatatrayaḥ \|*  
*sūryadhyānaparo nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ śāṃtiṃ karotu te \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Sumantu said — The one having a seat resembling a lotus flower, having the lotus complexion, the eyes resembling the lotus petals, possessing all the fortunes, adored by the gods and the Gandharvas, four-faced, leader of the Devas, always the devotee of Surya, the senior most of the gods, extremely resplendent, Prajapati of all the lokas, popular with the divine word of Brahman, let such a lord Brahma bestow comforts and peace on you. Vishnu, who is clad in a Pitambara (or yellow lower garment), son of Atreya, holder of conch, disc, club, having the dark complexion, four-armed, having the body in the form of yajna, also known as Madhava, Madhusudana, devotee of Surya, deprived of movement, such a god Vishnu — the devotee of Surya, should bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.176.6-8 \|\|

*śaśikuṃdeṃdusaṃkāśo viśrutābharaṇairiha \|*  
*caturbhujo mahātejāḥ puṣpārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*caturmukho bhasmadharaḥ smaśānanilayaḥ sadā \|*  
*gotrārirviśvanilayastathā ca kratudūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*varo vareṇyo varado devadevo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*ādityadehasaṃbhūtaḥ sa te śāṃtiṃ karotu vai \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Like the moon, lotus or camphor, whose ears are adorned with kundalas, who has four arms, resplendent, who decorates half of his head with flowers, having four heads, having applied ashes over the body, who is the dweller of the cremation ground, enemy of mountains, the abode of the universe, Kratudushana, excellent, respectable, bestower of the sons and who was born of Aditya, let such a lord Maheshvara bestow peace and comfort on you.

## Chapter 177. The fire rites

## \|\| 1.177.1-2 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*padmarāgaprabhā devī caturvadanapaṃkajā \|*  
*akṣamālārpitakarā kamaṃḍaludharā śubhā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*brahmāṇī saumyavadanā ādityārādhane ratā \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu suprītā āśīrvādaparā khaga \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Aruna said — O bird, let the goddess Brahmani, having the lustre of a ruby, having four lotus like faces, holding a rosary, kamandalu, the form of auspiciousness, getting pleased, who always remains devoted to the Sungod, an image of delight, bestower of blessings, render you peaceful.

## \|\| 1.177.3-4 \|\|

*mahāśveteti vikhyātā ādi tyadayitā sadā \|*  
*himakuṃdeṃdusadṛśā mahāvṛṣabhavāhinī \|\| 3 \|\|*

*triśūlahastāvaraṇā viśrutābharaṇā satī \|*  
*caturbhujā caturvaktrā trinetrā pāpanāśinī \|*  
*vṛṣadhvajārcanaratā rudrāṇī śāṃtidā bhavet \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The spouse of the Sungod known by the name of Mahashveta is beloved of the Sungod, having the complexion of snow, lotus and moon. Having a great bull as her vehicle, carrying a trident in her hand, with her ears adorned with the earrings, having four arms, four faces and three eyes (on each face), destroyer of the sins and having a banner of bull, such a Rudrani should make you peaceful.

## \|\| 1.177.5-6 \|\|

*mayūravāhanā devī siṃdūrāruṇavigrahā \|*  
*śaktihastā mahākāyā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sūryabhaktā mahāvīryā sūryārcanaratā sadā \|*  
*kaumārī varadā devī śāṃtimāśu karotu te \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The goddess, having a peacock as her vehicle, has the complexion of vermilion. She holds a Shakti, has a vast body and is adorned with all the ornaments. She is devoted to the Sungod and is immensely valorous. She is Kaumari and bestower of boons. Let her bestow all the peace to you.

## \|\| 1.177.7-8 \|\|

*gadācakradharā śyāmā pītāṃbaradharā khaga \|*  
*caturbhujā hi sā devī vaiṣṇavī surapūjitā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sūryārcanaparā nityaṃ sūryaikagatamānasā \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityaṃ sarvāsuravimardinī \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. O bird, the goddess Vaishnavi has four arms, having dark complexion, clad in yellow lower garment and having four arms. She worships the Sungod in her mind. She is the destroyer of all the Asuras. Let her always bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.177.9-10 \|\|

*airāvatagajārūḍhā vajrahastā mahā balā \|*  
*sarvatralocanā devī varṇataḥ karburāruṇā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*siddhagaṃdharvanamitā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā \|*  
*iṃdrāṇī te sadā devī śāṃtimāśu karotu vai \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Indrani is mounted over an elephant, she is extremely strong, has four eyes, her complexion is red and is worshipped by the Gandharvas. She is adorned with all the ornaments, let the same Indrani bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.177.11-12 \|\|

*varāhaghoṇā vikaṭā varāhavaravāhinī \|*  
*śyāmāvadātā yā devī śaṃkhacakragadādharā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tejayaṃtīti nimiṣānpūjayaṃtī sadā ravim \|*  
*vārāhī varadā devī tava śāṃtiṃ karotu vai \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Varahi has the snout like a boar, having a boar as her vehicle. She is of black complexion and holds in her hands conch, disc and a club. She illuminates the moments, and always remains devoted with Sungod. Let such a Varahi bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.177.13-15 \|\|

*ardhakośā kaṭīkṣāmā nirmāṃsā snāyubaṃdhanāt \|*  
*karālavanā ghorā khaḍgaghaṃṭodgatā satī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kapālamālinī krūrā khaṭvāṃgavaradhāriṇī \|*  
*āraktā piṃganayanā gajacarmāvaguṃṭhitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*gośrutābharaṇā devī pretasthānanivāsinī \|*  
*śivārūpeṇa ghoreṇa śivarūpabhayaṃkarī \|*  
*cāmuṃḍā caṃḍarūpeṇa sadā śāṃtiṃ karotu te \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Chamunda is the goddess with half the sheath and slender waist. Her body with no flesh is bound with entrails, horrible to look at, holding a sword, bell, wearing the garland of skulls, holding a terrible khatvanga, having red complexion, pink eyes, clad in the elephant skin, with the ears adorned with the earrings, dweller of the cremation ground, terrific form of Shiva (Parvati), such a goddess Chamunda, taking to a horrible form, should bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.177.16-19 \|\|

*caṃḍamuṃḍakarā devī muṃḍadehagatā satī \|*  
*kapālamālinī krūrā khadvāṃgavaradhā riṇī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ākāśamātaro devyastathānyā lokamātaraḥ \|*  
*bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvāstathānyāḥ pitṛmātaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vṛddhiśrāddheṣu pūjyaṃte yāstu devyo manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*mātre pramātre tanmātre iti mātṛmukhāstathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pitāmahī tu tanmātā vṛddhā yā ca pitāmahī \|*  
*ityetāstu pitāmahyaḥ śāṃtiṃ te pitṛmātaraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. She is the one who holds Chanda and Munda in her hands, and pervades in the body of Munda. The mother of the sky, mother of the lokas, bhutas mother, parental mother, those mothers who are worshipped by the intelligent people, besides other mothers, grandmothers and the great grandmothers, bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.177.20 \|\|

*sarvā mātṛmahādevyaḥ svāyudhāvyagrapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*jagadvyāpya pratiṣṭhaṃtyo balikāmā mahodayāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. All the great goddesses who are Mahadevis, holding the sharp weapons in their hands, reached there in order to receive offerings and for the upliftment of the people as a whole, got pervading and then got established.

## \|\| 1.177.21 \|\|

*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu tā nityamādityārādhane ratāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtena cetasā śāṃtyaḥ śāṃtaye tava śāṃtidā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. All these mothers who remain devoted to the Sungod, having the form of peace, let them shower peace on you.

## \|\| 1.177.22-25 \|\|

*sarvāvayavamukhyena gātreṇa ca sumadhyamā \|*  
*pītaśyāmāti saumyena snigdhavarṇena śobhanā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*lalāṭatilakopetā caṃdrarekhārdhadhāriṇī \|*  
*citrāṃbaradharā devī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*varā strīmayarūpāṇāṃ śobhā guṇasusampadā \|*  
*bhāvanāmātrasaṃtuṣṭā umā devī varapradā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sākṣādāgatya rūpeṇa śāṃtenāmitatejasā \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te prītā ādityā rādhane ratā \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. These mothers have beautiful limbs and the waists, having the complexions of yellow colour, dark and extremely beautiful, which attract the mind. They had tilakam over their foreheads, besides a crescent moon. They were adorned with wonderful types of costumes and ornaments, and were the most beautiful among the ladies of the time, who could be satisfied with the virtuous feelings. They were all devoted to the Sungod. Such a goddess Uma who is the bestower of the boon, delightfully bestow peace on you.

## Chapter 178. The Solar dharma

## \|\| 1.178.1-2 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*abalo bālarūpeṇa khaṭvāṃgaśikhivāhanaḥ \|*  
*pūrveṇa vadanaḥ śrīmāṃstriśikhaḥ śaktisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kṛttikāyāśca rudrasya cāṃgodbhūtaḥ surārcitaḥ \|*  
*kārtikeyo mahātejā ādityavaradarpitaḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityaṃ balaṃ saukhyaṃ ca tejasā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Aruna said — Let lord Kartikeya, who was without prowess being a child, was holder of the weapon khatvanga, with a peacock serving him as a vehicle, facing east, Intelligent, possessing the three tufts and enormous strength, who was born of Rudra and Krittikas, had divine performance, and who was glorified due to the boon of Aditya, bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.178.3-9 \|\|

*ātreyībalavāndeva ārogyaṃ ca khagādhipa \|*  
*śvetavastraparīdhānastryakṣaḥ kanakasuprabhaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śūlahasto mahāprājño nadīśo ravibhāvitaḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te śānto dharme ca matimuttamām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dharmetarāvubhau nityamacalaḥ saṃprayacchatu \|*  
*mahodaro mahākāyaḥ snigdhāṃjanasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ekadaṃṣṭrotkaṭo devo gajavaktro mahābalaḥ \|*  
*nāgayajñopavītena nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sarvārthasaṃpadoddhāro gaṇādhyakṣo varapradaḥ \|*  
*bhīmasya tanayo devo nāyakotha vināyakaḥ \|*  
*karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ bhāskarārcanatatparaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*iṃdranīlanibhastryakṣo dīptaśūlāyudhodyataḥ \|*  
*raktāṃbaradharaḥ śrīmānkṛṣṇāṃgo nāgabhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pāpāpanodamatulamalakṣyo malanāśanaḥ \|*  
*karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ prītaḥ prītena cetasā \|\| 9 \|\|*

3-9. O king of birds and son of the sage Atri, lord Shiva as Trayambaka, clad in white clothes, having the lustre of the molten gold, carrying a trident in his hand, immensely intelligent, lord of Nandi and favourite of Nandi, bestow on you the excellent wisdom, good health as well as the peace. Besides dharma, he should always bestow good health and eternal peace. Let the lord Ganapati with the elephant head, protruding belly, having the lustre of charming collyrium, having a single tusk, having the face of an elephant, valorous, wearing a yajnopavita of a serpent, adorned with all the ornaments, redeemer of all the financial fortunes, Vinayaka — the lord of the gartas, bestower of boons, son of Shiva, engaging himself in the worship of the Sungod, bestow on you the great prowess. Let the .lord having resplendence, three eyes, shining trident with black complexioned body, using snakes as ornaments, destroyer of enormous sins, the invisible one, bestow great prowess on you.

## \|\| 1.178.10-11 \|\|

*varāṃbaradharā kanyā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā \|*  
*tridaśānāṃ ca jananī puṇyā lokanamaskṛtā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sarvasiddhikarā devī prasādaparamāspadā \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te mātā bhuvanasya khagādhipa \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The beautiful girl clad in beautiful garments, adorned with all the ornaments, who produced the gods, adored by the worlds, bestower of all the success, who is the mother of the universe, form of delight, lodged at an auspicious place, let the same bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.178.12-13 \|\|

*snigdhaśyāmena varṇena mahāmahiṣamardanī \|*  
*dhanuścakrapraharaṇā khaṅgapaṭṭiśadhāriṇī \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ātarjanyāyatakarā sarvopadravanāśinī \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te durgā bhavānī ca śivā tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Let the goddess Shiva with charming dark complexion, destroyer of Mahishasura, holder of a bow, disc, sword and pattisha, spreading her hands upto the little finger, destroy all the disturbances and make you peaceful.

## \|\| 1.178.14 \|\|

*atisūkṣmo hyatikrodhastryakṣo bhṛṃgiriṭirmahān \|*  
*sūryātmako mahāvīraḥ sūryaikagatamānasaḥ \|*  
*sūryabhaktikaro nityaṃ śivaṃ te saṃprayacchatu \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Let Nandishvara who is immensely enraged, having three eyes, resembling the Sungod, the valorous one, engaged in the worship of Surya getting devoted to him, being immensely great, such a Nandikeshvara bestow welfare on you.

## \|\| 1.178.15-16 \|\|

*pracaṃḍagaṇasainyeśo mahāghaṃṭākṣadhārakaḥ \|*  
*akṣamālārpitakaraścākṣacaṃḍeśvaro varaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*caṃḍapāpaharo nityaṃ brahmahatyā vināśanaḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityamādityārādhane rataḥ \|*  
*karoti ca mahāyogī kalyāṇānāṃ paraṃparām \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Let Chandeshvara — the leader of the terrific ganas, adorned with a large bell and a rosary besides holding an akshamala, remove all the grave sins including that of Brahmahatya and always bestow peace on you, while adoring the Sungod, besides the eternal traditions of the yogis.

## \|\| 1.178.17 \|\|

*ākāśamātaro divyāstathānyā devamātaraḥ \|*  
*sūryāyaṇaparā devyo jagadvyāpya vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu me nityaṃ mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The arid mothers, divine mothers and the solar mothers, while pervading in the universe, are worshipped by the gods, let them bestow peace on you, becoming compassionate.

## \|\| 1.178.18-19 \|\|

*ye rudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudra sthānanivāsinaḥ \|*  
*mātaro rudrarūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāśca ye \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vighnabhūtāstathā cānye digvidikṣu samāśritāḥ \|*  
*sarve te prītamanasaḥ pratigṛhṇaṃtu me balim \|*  
*siddhiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ bhayebhyaḥ pāṃtu sarvataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. The Rudras, performers of the terrific deeds, besides the mothers, leader of the ganas taking to the form of obstruction and lodged in all the directions, let them all getting pleased accept my offering and bestow success on me.

## \|\| 1.178.20-24 \|\|

*aiṃdrādayo gaṇā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*himakundeṃdusadṛśā nīlakṛṣṇāṃgalohitāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*divyāṃtarikṣā bhaumāśca pātālatalavāsinaḥ \|*  
*aiṃdrāḥ śāṃtiṃ prakurvaṃtu bhadrāṇi ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*āgneyyāṃ ye bhṛtāḥ sarve dhruvahatyānuṣaṃgiṇaḥ \|*  
*sūryānuraktā raktābhā japāsumanibhāstathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*viraktalohitā divyā āgneyyāṃ bhāskarādayaḥ \|*  
*ādityārādhanaparā ādityagatamānasāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ prayacchaṃtu baliṃ mama \|*  
*bhayā'dityasamā ye tu satataṃ daṇḍapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*ādityārādhanaparāḥ kaṃ prayacchaṃtu te sadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. The ganas of Indra, holding great vajras, should always save me from danger, bestowing success on me. The gartas of Indra carrying vajra in their hands, having the complexion of snow, lotus, blue and black besides the red, dwelling in the space, earth and patala, let them all shower peace and welfare on me. All the gods of south-east direction, who suddenly tried to kill Dhruva, devoted to the Sungod, possessing lustre, having the red complexion, getting absorbed in the Sun, worship him. Let all these gods make the offerings to you. Let these gods, holding staff in hand and always getting engaged in the adoration of the Sungod, always provide comforts to you.

## \|\| 1.178.25-27 \|\|

*aiśānyāṃ saṃsthitā ye tu praśāṃtāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*bhasmoddhūlitadehāśca nīlakaṇṭhā vilohitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*divyāṃtarikṣā bhaumāśca pātālatalavāsinaḥ \|*  
*sūryapūjākarā nityaṃ pūjayitvāṃśumālinam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tataḥ suprītamanaso lokapālaiḥ sama nvitāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu me nityaṃ kaṃ prayacchaṃtu pūjitāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Staying in the north-east direction, being extremely peaceful, holding a trident in the hands, having the bodies plastered with ashes, with blue throats, red complexion, the dwellers of the sky, earth and patala who are the worshippers of the Sungod together with the lokapalas, these gods getting adored, should bestow peace on me.

## \|\| 1.178.28-31 \|\|

*amarāvatī purī nāma pūrvabhāge vyavasthitā \|*  
*vidyādharagaṇākīrṇā siddhagandharvase vitā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ratnaprākārarucirā mahāratnopaśobhitā \|*  
*tatra devapatiḥ śrīmānvajrapāṇirmahābalaḥ \|*  
*gopatirgosahasreṇa śobhamānena śobhate \|\| 29 \|\|*

*airāvatagajārūḍho gairikābho mahādyutiḥ \|*  
*deveṃdraḥ satataṃ hṛṣṭa ādityārādhane rataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*sūryajñānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*sūryapraṇāmaḥ paramāṃ śāṃtiṃ te'dya prayacchatu \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. There is a city named Amaravati in which the ganas of Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Gandharvas live. Their boundary walls are decorated with gems. Holding vajra in his hands, the lord Sungod together with a thousand rays, appears graceful there. Mounting over the elephant Airavata, having the lustre of the gold, showing enormous resplendence and with a delightful heart, Indra meditated upon the Sungod. The knowledge of Surya possessed by him is supreme. Getting devoted to the Sungod and offering salutation to the Sungod, he should bestow peace on you today.

## \|\| 1.178.32-34 \|\|

*āgneyadigvibhāge tu purī tejasvatī śubhā \|*  
*nānādevagaṇākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tatra jvālā samākīrṇo dīptāṃgārasamadyutiḥ \|*  
*purago dahano devo jvalanaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ādityārādhanarata ādityagatamānasaḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu te devastathā pāpaparikṣayam \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Tejasvati is a city lodged in the south-east direction, which is inhabited by the various types of gods. The said city is decorated by various types of gems. The fire god with high flames, reside there. He has the quality of burning in flames, and he worships the Sungod. Let the fire god, remaining engaged in the Sun worship, removes all your sins.

## \|\| 1.178.35-37 \|\|

*vaivasvatī purī ramyā dakṣiṇena mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*surāsuraśatākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tatra kundeṃdusaṃkāśo haripiṃgalalocanaḥ \|*  
*mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*antako'tha mahātejāḥ sūryadharmaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*ādityārādhanaparaḥ kṣemārogye dadātu te \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. In the southern direction, there is a city known as Vaivasvati, which belongs to Yama. Hundreds of Gods and Rakshasas live there. All of them are adorned with the gems and they have the complexion of lotus and the moon and having pink eyes resembling the monkeys. Yama has a great buffalo bull for his use, he is clad in black garments and rosaries. He is immensely illustrious and follows the Surya — dharma. Yamaraja is devoted to the worship of the Sungod, let him bestow welfare on you.

## \|\| 1.178.38-40 \|\|

*nairṛte digvibhāge tu purī kṛṣṇeti viśrutā \|*  
*moharakṣogaṇāśaucapiśācapretasaṃkulā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tatra kundanibho devo raktasragvastra bhūṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*khaḍgapāṇirmahātejāḥ karālavadanojjvalaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*rakṣeṃdro vasate nityamādityārādhane rataḥ \|*  
*karotu me sadā śāṃtiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ praya cchatu \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. There is a city named Krishna which is lodged in south-west. The confused Rakshasas live therein. There are huge crowds of impure Pishachas who are ruled by Rakshendra. They have the complexion of the lotus. They wear red rosaries and clothes and hold swords in their hands. They are of red complexion and red costumes. They have terrific feces and bright complexion. They always meditate upon the Sungod. Let them bestow on me peace, riches and cereals always.

## \|\| 1.178.41-42 \|\|

*paścime tu diśo bhāge purī śuddhavatī sadā \|*  
*nānābhogisamākīrṇā nānākinnarasevitā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tatra kundedusaṃkāśo haripiṃgala locanaḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ karotu me prītaḥ śāṃtaḥ śāṃtena cetasā \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. In the western direction, there is a city named Suddhavati, which is always inhabited by the various types of the servants, besides the kinnaras. Their leader has the complexion of lotus or the moon, while the eyes are pink like those of the monkeys. Let them feeling delighted and peaceful at heart, bestow the peace on me.

## \|\| 1.178.43-44 \|\|

*yaśovatī purī ramyā aiśānīṃ diśamāśritā \|*  
*nānāgaṇasamākīrṇā nānākṛta śubhālayā \|*  
*tejaḥprākāraparyaṃtā anaupamyā sadojvalā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tatra kuṃdeṃdusaṃkāśaścāṃbujākṣo vibhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*trinetraḥ śāṃtarūpātmā akṣamālā dharādharaḥ \|*  
*īśānaḥ paramo devaḥ sadā śāṃtiṃ prayacchatu \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. In the north-east direction, there is a city known as Yashovati. Several types of ganas have the auspicious homes there, which are quite resplendent and bright. Ishanadeva, having the complexion of lotus and moon, lives there. He has the lotus like eyes, beautiful body, peaceful appearance and wears rosary of beads. Let him bestow peace on us always.

## \|\| 1.178.45 \|\|

*bhūloke tu bhuvarloke nivasaṃti ca ye sadā \|*  
*devādevāḥ śubhāyuktāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. In the Bhuloka and Bhuvarloka are the dwelling places of the gods. Let all of them bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.178.46 \|\|

*maharloke janoloke paraloke gatāśca ye \|*  
*te sarve muditā devāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Maharloka, Janaloka and Paraloka are the dwelling places of the gods, who should bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.178.47-48 \|\|

*sarasvatī sūryabhaktā śāṃtidā vidadhātu me \|*  
*cārucāmīkarasthā yā sarojakarapallavā \|*  
*sūryabhaktyāśritā devī vibhūtiṃ te prayacchatu \|\| 47 \|\|*

*hareṇa suvicitreṇa bhāsvatkanakamekhalā \|*  
*aparājitā sūryabhaktā karotu vijayaṃ tava \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. The goddess Sarasvati is the devotee of Surya and bestower of peace. Let her bestow peace and riches on me. She is seated over a golden throne. She has the tender hands like lotus leaves. She is depending over the devotion of the Sungod. Aparajita is adorned with various types of garlands and waistband of gold. Let her bestow victory on you.

## Chapter 179. Solar dharma

## \|\| 1.179.1-5 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛttikā paramā devī rohiṇī ca varānanā \|*  
*śrīmanmṛgaśiro bhadrā ārdrā cāpyaparojjvalā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*punarvasustathā puṣya āśleṣā ca tathādhipa \|*  
*sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ sūryabhāvānubhāvitāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*arcayaṃti sadā devamādityaṃ surate sadā \|*  
*nakṣatramātaro hyetāḥ prabhāmālāvibhūṣitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*maghā sarvaguṇopetā pūrvā caiva tu phālgunī \|*  
*svātī viśākhā varadā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*arcayaṃti sadā devamādityaṃ surapūjitam \|*  
*tavāpi śāṃtikaṃ dyotaṃ kurvaṃtu gaganoditāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Aruna said — The excellent goddess Krittika, Rohini with a beautiful face, Mrigashira, Ardra with beautiful bright figure, Punarvasu, Pushya and Ashlesha are always devoted to the Sungod and worship him. The constellation mothers as well are adorned with the garlands of lustre.
