Then, Magha, Purva, Phalguni, Svati and beneficial Vishakha, staying in the southern direction, always worship the Sungod, who is adored by all the gods. Let all the constellations who rise in the sky, bestow welfare on you.

## \|\| 1.179.6-8 \|\|

*anurādhā tathā jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ sūryapuraḥsarā \|*  
*pūrvāṣāḍhā mahāvīryā āṣāḍhā cottarā tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ ca bahuśrutam \|*  
*etāḥ paścimato dīptā rājaṃte cānu mūrtayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*bhāskaraṃ pūjayaṃtyetāḥ sarvakālaṃ subhāvitāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. The constellations like Anuradha, Jyeshtha, Mula, Purvashadha, the extremely valorous Uttarashadha, Abhijit as well as Shravana shine on the western side and preserve the high feeling and also worship the Sungod always. Therefore, let them all bestow the fortunes on you for all times to come.

## \|\| 1.179.9-11 \|\|

*dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā tu pūrvabhādrapadā tathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*uttarā bhādrarevatyau cāśvinī ca mahāmate \|*  
*bharaṇī ca mahādevī nityamuttarataḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sūryārcanaratā nityamādityagatamā nasāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvatu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Those of the constellations who are lodged to the north and are devoted in the worship of the Sungod, are known as — Dhanishtha, Shatabhisha, Purva-Bhadrapada, Uttara-Bhadrapada, Ashvini and Bharani — the great goddess. They always adore the Sungod Let them all bestow on you peace as well the fortunes.

## \|\| 1.179.12-13 \|\|

*meṣo mṛgādhipaḥ siṃho dhanurdīptimatāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*pūrveṇa bhāsayaṃtyete sūryayogaparāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ bhaktyā sūryapadāṃbuje \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vṛṣaḥ kanyā ca paramā makaraścāpi buddhimān \|*  
*ete dakṣiṇabhāge tu pūjayaṃti raviṃ sadā \|*  
*bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Mesha, Simha — the leader of Mrigas, and the illustrious Dhanu are always anxious to unite with the Sungod. All of them shine to the east, remaining devoted at the lotus like feet of the Sungod. Let all of them shower peace on you. The excellent Kanya Vrisha and the intelligent Makara are all lodged to the south and render excellent worship to the Sungod Let all of them extent peace to you.

## \|\| 1.179.14-15 \|\|

*mithunaṃ ca tulā kuṃbhaḥ paścime ca vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*japaṃtyete sadākālamādityaṃ grahanāya kam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ khakholkājñānatatparāḥ \|*  
*satapodattapuṣpābhyāṃ ye smṛtā satataṃ budhaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Mithuna, Tula and Kumbha are all lodged to the west. They all worship the Sungod. Let them bestow peace on you. The people with wisdom always remember them for achieving the global knowledge.

## \|\| 1.179.16-19 \|\|

*ṛṣayaḥ sapta vikhyātā dhruvāṃtāḥ praramojjvalāḥ \|*  
*bhānuprasādātsaṃpannāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kaśyapo gālavo gārgyo viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*munirdakṣo vaśiṣṭhaśca mārkaṇḍaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*nārado bhṛgurātreyo bhāradvājaśca vai muniḥ \|*  
*vālmīkiḥ kauśiko vātsyaḥ śākalyo'tha punarvasuḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śālaṃkāyana ityete ṛṣayo'tha mahātapāḥ \|*  
*sūryadhyānaikaparamāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. The well-known seven Rishis who always shine around Dhruva and have earned the grace of the Sungod, let them all bestow peace to you. Let the great sages, like Kashyapa, Galava, Gargya, the great sage Vishvamitra, Daksha, Markandeya, Vasishtha, Pulaha, Kratu, Narada, Bhrigu, Atreya, Bharadvaja, Valmiki, Kaushika, Vatsya, Sakalya, Punarvasu, Salankayana, who happen to be the best of Rishis, meditate upon the Sungod, and always bestow peace to you.

## \|\| 1.179.20 \|\|

*munikanyā mahābhāgā ṛṣikanyāḥ kumārikāḥ \|*  
*sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The daughters of the auspicious Rishis, the maidens who always get engaged in the worship of the Sungod, should bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.179.21-22 \|\|

*siddhāḥ samṛddhatapaso ye cānye vai mahātapāḥ \|*  
*vidyādharā mahātmāno garuḍaśca tvayā saha \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ādityaparamā hyete ādityārādhane ratāḥ \|*  
*siddhiṃ te saṃprayacchaṃtu āśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Besides the sages who have developed their personalities with the performing of the tapas, other great ascetics, besides Garuda who likes the serpents, who always remain devoted to the Sungod, should bestow their blessings on you, besides the success.

## \|\| 1.179.23-26 \|\|

*namucirdaityarājedraḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahābalaḥ \|*  
*mahānātho'tha vikhyāto daityaḥ paramavīryavān \|\| 23 \|\|*

*grahādhipasya devasya nityaṃ pūjāparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*balaṃ vīryaṃ ca te ṛddhimārogyaṃ ca bruvaṃtu te \|\| 24 \|\|*

*mahāḍhyo yo hayagrīvaḥ prahlādaḥ prabhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*tānaikāgnimukho daityaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ete daityā mahātmānaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭiṃ balaṃ tathā'rogyaṃ prayacchaṃtu surārayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. The great ruler of the daityas known as Namuchi, valorous daityas Shankukarna and Mahanatha possess the great prowess as well as the fame. All of them adore the Sungod. Let them all bless you for achieving the great prowess, success and good health. Hayagriva, Prahlada, daitya Agnimukha and the valorous Kalanemi, all are the devotees of the Sungod. Let them all shower satisfaction, strength and good health.

## \|\| 1.179.27-28 \|\|

*vairocano hiraṇyākṣasturvasuśca sulocanaḥ \|*  
*mucakuṃdo mukuṃdaśca daityo raivatakastathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhāvena parameṇemaṃ yajaṃte satataṃ ravim \|*  
*satataṃ ca śubhātmānaḥ puṣṭiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The demons like Vairochana, Hiranyaksha, Turvasu, Sulochana, Muchukunda, Mukunda, Raivataka worship the Sungod lovingly. Besides all of them are the images of welfare themselves, let all of them support you always.

## \|\| 1.179.29 \|\|

*daityapatayo mahābhāgā daityānāṃ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*kumārā ye ca daityānāṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The auspicious wives of the daityas and their charming girls, the princes, should also bless you for peace.

## \|\| 1.179.30-31 \|\|

*āraktena śarīraṇa raktāṃtāyatalocanāḥ \|*  
*mahābhāgāḥ kṛtāṭopāḥ śaṃkhādyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*anaṃto nāgarājeṃdra ādityārādhane rataḥ \|*  
*mahāpāpaviṣaṃ hatvā śāṃtimāśu karotu te \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. The serpent Ananta having a red body, red eyes, besides Shankha and other serpents, always remain devoted to the Sungod. Let all of them discarding venom, bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.179.32-33 \|\|

*atipītena dehena visphuradbhogasaṃpadā \|*  
*tejasā cātidīptena kṛtasvastikalāṃchanaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*nāgarāṭ takṣakaḥ śrīmānnāmakoṭyā samanvitaḥ \|*  
*karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ sarvadoṣaviṣāpahām \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. Then Takshaka the lord of serpents, with a yellow body from which the elements of pleasure emerge, who is endowed with the marks of welfare, making his name purposeful, should bestow great peace on you by which you could be able to remove the entire venom.

## \|\| 1.179.34-35 \|\|

*atikṛṣṇena varṇena sphuṭādhikaṭamastakaḥ \|*  
*kaṃṭharekhātrayopeto ghoradaṃṣṭrāyudhodyataḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*karkoṭako mahānāgo viṣadarpabalānvitaḥ \|*  
*viṣaśastrāgnisaṃtāpaṃ hatvā śāṃtiṃ karotu te \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Because of his being of extremely black colour, whose waist and head are not clearly visible, who has three lines in the neck, has terrific fangs, resembling the weapons, such a great serpent is known as Karkotaka, who disowning the fire of venom, bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.179.36-42 \|\|

*padmavarṇaḥ padmakāntiḥ phullapadmāyatekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*khyātaḥ padmo mahānāgo nityaṃ bhāskarapūjakaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sa te śāṃti śubhaṃ śīghramacalaṃ saṃprayacchatu \|*  
*śyāmena dehabhāreṇa śrīmatkamalalocanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*viṣadarpabalonmatto grīvāyāṃ rekhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*śaṃkhapālaśriyā dīptaḥ sūryapādābjapūjakaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*mahāviṣaṃ garaśreṣṭhaṃ hatvā śāṃtiṃ karotu te \|*  
*atigaureṇa dehena caṃdrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*dīpabhāge kṛtāṭopaśubhalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ \|*  
*kuliko nāma nāgendro nityaṃ sūryaparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*apahṛtya viṣaṃ ghoraṃ karotu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*aṃtarikṣe ca ye nāgā ye nāgāḥ svargasaṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*girikaṃdaradurgeṣu ye nāgā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*pātāle ye sthitā nāgāḥ sarve yatra samāhitāḥ \|*  
*sūryapādā rcanāsaktāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 42 \|\|*

36-42. The Padma who is known as the Mahanaga, having the complexion of a lotus, who has the broad eyes like the blossomed lotus flower, he is devoted to the Sungod. Let him bestow welfare on you, besides the eternal music. Then Shankhapala, having the body with dark complexion, having the lotus like eyes, an intoxicated line over the neck, worshipper of the lotus like feet of the Sungod, he is the destroyer of the terrific venom. Let him bestow peace on you. Then the serpent Kulika, who is of bright complexion, whose forehead is decorated with a crescent, who is intoxicated of the possessing of the venom, having all the auspicious cymbals, besides being devoted to the Sungod, let the same Naga king shedding away his venom, bless you. Let all the Nagas, who reside in space, heaven, the mountain caves, besides earth and patala, worship the Sungod with devotion. Let them all shower peace on you.

## \|\| 1.179.43-44 \|\|

*nāginyo nāgakanyāśca tathā nāgakumārakāḥ \|*  
*sūryabhaktāḥ sumanasaḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ya idaṃ nāmasaṃsthānaṃ kīrtayecchṛṇuyāttathā \|*  
*na taṃ sarpā vihiṃsati na viṣaṃ kramate sadā \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. The females of the Nagas, daughters of the Nagas and their young ones, worship the Sungod with utmost devotion. Whosoever listens to the story of the Sungod, the serpents never harm them and their venom also does not harm such people.

## Chapter 180. The peace

## \|\| 1.180.1-2 \|\|

*gaṃgā puṇyā mahādevī yamunā narmadā nadī \|*  
*gautamī cāpi kāverī varuṇā devikā tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarvagrahapatiṃ devaṃ lokeśaṃ lokanāyakam \|*  
*pūjayaṃti sadā nadyaḥ sūryasadbhāvabhāvitāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ sūryadhyānaikamānasāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. The rivers like auspicious Ganga, Mahadevi, Yamuna, Narmada, Gautami, Kaveri, Varuna, Devika, besides the lord of all the planets, the Devas, Lokapati, leader of the lokas, lovingly adore the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.180.3-4 \|\|

*niraṃjanā nāma nadī śoṇaścāpi mahānadaḥ \|*  
*maṃdākinī ca paramā tathā sannihitā śubhā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*etāścānyāśca bahavo bhuvi divyaṃtarikṣake \|*  
*sūryārcanaratā nadyaḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The river Niranjana, Shona, the great and excellent river Mandakini, besides several other rivers moving through the heaven and space, meditate upon the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.180.5-8 \|\|

*mahāvaiśravaṇo devo yakṣarājo maharṣikaḥ \|*  
*yakṣakoṭiparīvāro yakṣasaṃkhyeyasaṃyutaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mahāvibhavasaṃpannaḥ sūryapādārcane rataḥ \|*  
*sūryadhyānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*śāṃtiṃ karotu te prītaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*māṇibhadro mahāyakṣo maṇiratnavibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*manohareṇa hāreṇa kaṃṭhalagnena rājate \|*  
*yakṣiṇīyakṣakanyābhiḥ parivāritavigrahaḥ \|*  
*sūryārcanasamāsaktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. Yaksharaja Kubera also known as Mahavaishravana — the son of a Maharishi, the crores of families of Yakshas who possess enormous fortunes, are devoted to the lotus like feet of the Sungod, let them all getting pleased in bestow peace on you. The great yaksha Manibhadra, decorated with gems, whose neck is adorned with the garland of gems, besides his wife and the entire family with his daughters, is engaged in the worship of the Sungod. Let them all bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.9-10 \|\|

*suciro nāma yakṣeṃdro maṇikuḍala bhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*lalāṭe hemapaṭalaprabaddhena virājate \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bahuyakṣasamākīrṇo yakṣairnamitavigrahaḥ \|*  
*sūryapūjāparo yuktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Let the lord of Yaksha known as Suchira, who is adorned with the kundalas of gems, with his forehead decorated with a lotus leaf, surrounded by many Yakshas, but still firmly devoted to the worship of the Sungod, he too bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.11-12 \|\|

*pāṃciko nāma yakṣeṃdraḥ kaṃṭhābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*kukkuṭena vicitreṇa bahuratnānvitena tu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yakṣavṛndasamākīrṇo yakṣakoṭisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*sūryārcanakaraḥ śrīmānkarotu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Let Panchika — the chief of Yakshas, whose neck is adorned with a necklace decorated with the figures of cocks, besides himself wearing many types of gems and surrounded by the crores of Yakshas, bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.13-14 \|\|

*dhṛtarāṣṭro mahātejā nānāyakṣādhipaḥ khaga \|*  
*divyapaṭṭaḥ śuklacchatro maṇikāṃcanabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sūryabhaktaḥ sūryarataḥ sūryapūjāparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*sūryaprasādasaṃpannaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. O bird, Dhritarashtra — the Yaksha, having enormous lustre, clad in divine costumes and adorned with the divine ornaments, having a white umbrella over his head with a golden rod, is the devotee of Surya and enjoys the grace of Surya. Let such a Yaksha bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.15-16 \|\|

*virūpākṣaśca yakṣeṃdraḥ śvetavāsā mahādyutiḥ \|*  
*nānākāṃcanamālābhirupaśobhitakaṃdharaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sūryapūjāparo bhaktaḥ kaṃjākṣaḥ kaṃjasannibhaḥ \|*  
*tejasādityasaṃkāśaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. There is another Yaksha chief known as Virupaksha. He is clad in white garments and is adorned with the garland of glass beards and devoted to the Sungod. He has lotus like eyes. He is quite beautiful like the Sungod himself. Let him bestow the peace to you.

## \|\| 1.180.17-18 \|\|

*aṃtīrakṣagatā yakṣā ye yakṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ \|*  
*nānārūpadharā yakṣāḥ sūryabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tadbhaktāstadgamanasaḥ sūryapūjāsamutsukāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te hṛṣṭāḥ śāṃtāḥ śāṃtiparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. All the Yakshas are lodged in the space. They move even in the heaven. They can change to any forms, but are devoted to the Sungod. They perform the vratas firmly. They concentrate their minds in the Sun worship. They always remain anxious to worship the Sun. They are devoted to the Sun. All these Yaks as are delightful and peaceful. Therefore, let them bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.19-20 \|\|

*yakṣiṇyo vividhākārāstathā yakṣakumārakāḥ \|*  
*yakṣakanyā mahābhāgāḥ sūryārādhanatatparāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śāṃtiṃ svastyayanaṃ kṣemaṃ balaṃ kalyāṇamuttamam \|*  
*siddhiṃ cāśu prayacchaṃtu nityaṃ ca susamāhitāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Their spouses are of different types, their young one’s besides their auspicious girls who always remain engaged in the worship of the Sungod, becoming attentive, calm, should recite welfare songs and bestow forgiveness, strength, excellent redemption and quick success.

## \|\| 1.180.21-22 \|\|

*parvatāḥ sarvataḥ sarve vṛkṣāścaiva maharddhikāḥ \|*  
*sūryabhaktāḥ sadā sarve śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sāgarāḥ sarvataḥ sarve gṛhāraṇyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*sūryasyārādhanaparāḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. All the mountains as a whole and the trees flowering in abundance should bestow peace, because of their being devoted to the Sun. All the oceans, all habitation and the forest, because of their having been devoted to the Sungod, should bestow peace.

## \|\| 1.180.23-24 \|\|

*rākṣasāḥ sarvataḥ sarve ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ \|*  
*sthalajā rākṣasā ye tu aṃtarikṣagatāśca ye \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pātāle rākṣasā ye tu nityaṃ sūryārcane ratāḥ \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sarve tejasā nityadīpitāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The Rakshasas with terrific strength, who are spread in the space, earth and the netherworld, because of their being devoted to the Sungod and because of the lustre emanating from the Sungod, bestow peace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.25-27 \|\|

*pretāḥ pretagaṇāḥ sarve ye pretāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ \|*  
*atidīptāśca ye pretā ye pretā rudhirāśanāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*aṃtarikṣe ca ye pretāstathā ye svargavāsinaḥ \|*  
*pātāle bhūtale vāpi ye pretāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ekacakro ratho yasya yastu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. All the goblins having hues on oil the sides are highly Inflammable, suckers of blood, dwellers of space, heaven, earth and the netherworld, take to any form at will. They too worship the Sungod who moves over a single wheeled chariot, Let them bestow pence on you, because of the grace of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.180.28-30 \|\|

*ye piśācā mahāvīryā vṛddhimaṃto mahābalāḥ \|*  
*nānārūpadharāḥ sarve sarve ca guṇavattarāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*aṃtarikṣe piśācā ye svarge ye ca mahābalāḥ \|*  
*pātāle bhūtale ye ca bahurūpā manojavāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yasyāhaṃ sārathirvīra yasya tvaṃ turagaḥ sadā \|*  
*tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te'ñjasā \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. The Pishachas are quite valorous, strong, intelligent and they take to many forma at will besides being virtuous. These strong Pishachas move at will in the space, and the heaven (and earth) taking too many forma, while I happen to be the charioteer, you are the hone. All of them should bestow peace by the grace of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.180.31-33 \|\|

*apasmāragrahāḥ sarve sarve cāpi jvaragrahāḥ \|*  
*ye ca svargasthitāḥ sarve bhūmigā ye grahottamāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*pātāle tu grahā ye ca ye grahāḥ sarvato gatāḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇe kiraṇe yasya sūryasya ca sthito hariḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*haro yasya sadā vāme lalāṭe kaṃjajaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. The Apasmara planets, the planet of fever, the excellent planets living on earth as well as the heaven, the planets dwelling in patala, besides the planets which are found everywhere, all these planets have the lustre of Surya, in whose right ray resides Hari, Hara in the left ray and Brahma in the forehead. They all should bestow grace on you.

## \|\| 1.180.34 \|\|

*iti devādayaḥ sarve sūryayajñavidhāyinaḥ \|*  
*kurvaṃtu jagataḥ śāṃtiṃ sūryabhakteṣu sarvadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Such of the people, who start the Surya yajna in an appropriate manner, including the gods and their ganas, besides the world as well as the devotees of Sungod, should bestow peace.

## \|\| 1.180.35 \|\|

*jayaḥ sūryāya devāya tamohaṃtre vivasvate \|*  
*jayapradāya sūryāya bhāskarāya namostu te \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Vivasvan — the remover of the darkness, be victorious. Bhaskara — the bestower of victory, salutation to him.

## \|\| 1.180.36-37 \|\|

*grahottamāya devāya jayaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇe \|*  
*jayaḥ padmavikāśāya budharūpāya te namaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*jayaḥ dīptividhānāya jayaḥ śāṃtividhāyine \|*  
*tamoghnāya jayāyaiva ajitāya namonamaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Victory to the Sungod who bestows the best of welfare in the household, victory to the one who makes the lotus to blossom. Victory to the one who provides light, victory to the one who bestow peace. Salutation to the remover of the darkness, the form of victory and who is invincible.

## \|\| 1.180.38 \|\|

*jayārka jayadīptīśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala \|*  
*jaya nirmitalokastvamajitāya namonamaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Salutation to Arka, lord of light, who illuminates with his thousand rays. Salutation to the builder of the world. Salutation again and again to the invincible one.

## \|\| 1.180.39 \|\|

*gāyatrīdeharūpāya sāvitrīdayitāya ca \|*  
*dharādharāya sūryāya mārtaṃḍāya namonamaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The one who is the body of Gayatri, beloved of Savitri, carries the earth, salutation to such a Martanda again and again.

## \|\| 1.180.40-41 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śāṃtimaruṇasya mahīpate \|*  
*śreyase vainateyasya garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*etasminneva kāle tu suparṇaḥ patravānabhūt \|*  
*tejasā budhasaṃkāśo valena hariṇā samaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Sumantu said — Thus, for the welfare of Garuda, the Shanti anushthana was carried out by Arana, as a result of which the wings of Garuda were re-grown afresh. At the same time, he achieved the lustre like Budha (Mercury) and the strength of lord Vishnu.

## \|\| 1.180.42-44 \|\|

*saṃpūrṇāvayavo rājanyathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat \|*  
*prasādāddevadevasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*evamanye'pi rājeṃdra mānavā ye ca rogiṇaḥ \|*  
*asmitkṛte'gnikārye tu virujāste bhavaṃti hi \|*  
*tasmādyatnena kartavyamagnikāryaṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*karaṇīyaṃ ca rājeṃdra mānavaiśca prarogibhiḥ \|*  
*asminkṛte agnikāye virujāste bhavaṃti hi \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Thus, all the limbs of Garuda, by the grace of the Sungod, were restored. O Rajendra, a blind also recovers the eyesight with the performing of the fire rights. O king! Therefore, the fire rights should be performed by all those who wish to get rid of their ailments. I myself got enormous benefits by performing of the fire rights.

## \|\| 1.180.45 \|\|

*graho paghāte durbhikṣa utpāteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*avarṣamāṇe parjanye lakṣahomasamanvitaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. At the time of creating, the disturbance by the evil planets, or at the time of draught, at the time of disturbances or having no rainfall, there is a provision of making a lakh of offerings in the fire, which should be started.

## \|\| 1.180.46-48 \|\|

*pūjayitvā prasūktaṃ tu dhyātvā vīraṃ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*vāruṇaiśca tathā sūktairhomaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*cetasā suprasannena sarpiṣā madhunā saha \|*  
*tilairyavaiśca sahitaiḥ pāyasaṃ madhunā tathā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*idaṃ ca śāṃtikaṃ kuryādbaliṃ dayātprayatnataḥ \|*  
*evaṃ kṛte śriyaṃ devā varṣaṃte kāmanā nṛṇām \|\| 48 \|\|*

46-48. Making all the efforts, the Sungod should be worshipped with the reciting of the mantras from the Varuna Shaktas and the Homa should be performed. Feeling delightful, the homa should be performed making use of honey, ghi, sesamum seeds, barley and the payasam mixed with honey. Thus, starting the shanti rites, the offerings should be made with all the efforts. With the concluding of these rites, one is bestowed with all the riches, the fall of rain from the clouds. The desires of all the people also get fulfilled with the same performance.

## \|\| 1.180.49-51 \|\|

*ityevaṃ śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi \|*  
*vidhinā sarvalokastu dhyāyamāno divākaram \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sa vijitya raṇe śatruṃ mānaṃ ca paramaṃ labhet \|*  
*akṣayaṃ modate kālamatiraskṛtaśāsanaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vyādhibhirnābhibhūyeta putrapautraiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|*  
*bhavedādityasadṛśastejasā prabhayā tathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. A person, who recites or listens to the chapter on Shanti-patha or meditates on Divakara, he becomes victorious over his enemies in the battle field, besides earning great glory. He earns an undisturbed kingdom and enjoys all the pleasures till eternity. Getting freed from ailments, he earns the glory with his sons and the grandsons, like that of the Sungod. Thereafter, he is established.

## \|\| 1.180.52-54 \|\|

*yānuddiśya paṭhedvīra vācako mānavo bhuvi \|*  
*na pīḍyate ca tai rogairvātapittakaphātmakaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya na sarpaiścāpi daśyate \|*  
*na viṣaṃ kramate dehe na jaḍāṃdhyaṃ na mūkatā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*na cotpatti bhayaṃ tasya nābhicārakajaṃ bhavet \|*  
*ye rogā ye mahotpātā ye'hayaśca mahāviṣāḥ \|*  
*te sarve praśamaṃ yāṃti śravaṇādasya bhārata \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. A person, who recites this stotra with whatever purpose, he surely gets successful (without any obstruction). Besides, he does not suffer from the ailments of vata, pitta and cough or any other disease. He does not meet with untimely death, He is not bitten by a snake, the poison does not spread in his body. He is also not overpowered by darkness of ignorance. He also does not become dumb. O Bharata, with him listening of this chapter, he gets free from the dangers of births and death, injury from weapon, or death dining the religious performance. All his ailments, great disturbance (attack from the) immensely poisonous snakes and serpents, get subsided.

## \|\| 1.180.55 \|\|

*yatpuṇyaṃ sarva tīrthānāṃ gaṃgādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnoti śravaṇādibhiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. The merit a person earns by visiting all the pilgrimages including those located at the banks of the Gangs, a crores of times more merit is earned with the hearing of this chapter.

## \|\| 1.180.56-58 \|\|

*daśānāṃ rājasūyānāmanyeṣāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ \|*  
*śaraṇāgatadīnārtamitraviśrabhaghātakaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*duṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāraḥ pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā \|*  
*śravaṇādasya pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. (A person who does so), getting from all the ailments, he lives for an age of a hundred years. The killer, the ungrateful person, one who unites with the wife of the preceptor, one who betrays a person taking refuge with him, one who betrays the faith of a friend, wicked one, sinner, killer of the parents, all get relieved of their sins with the listening or reading of this chapter. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.180.59-62 \|\|

*itihāsamimaṃ puṇyamagnikāryamanuttamam \|*  
*na dadyātkasyacidvīra mūrkhasya kaluṣātmanaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sūryabhakte sadā deyaṃ sūryeṇa kathitaṃ purā \|*  
*aruṇasya mahābāho garuḍasyāruṇena ca \|\| 60 \|\|*

*garuḍena purā proktaṃ bhojakānāṃ mahātmanām \|*  
*sūryaśarmasukhādīnāṃ śākadvīpe mahīpate \|\| 61 \|\|*

*taiścāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ munervyāsasya dhīmataḥ \|*  
*tenāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham \|\| 62 \|\|*

59-62. One should not advice an ignorant or foolish person to read or listen to this chapter. This chapter should be given only to the devotee of the Sungod. This type of advice was rendered by the Sungod, earlier to Aruna. The same was repeated by Aruna to Garuda and Garuda repeated the same to Bhojakas in Shakadvipa. Those who enjoy the welfare of Surya being the noble souls, had also heard it from Vyasadeva. This auspicious story had been narrated by the sage Vyasa himself as well.

## Chapter 181. Jurisprudence or Smarta Dharma

## \|\| 1.181.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*paṃcaprakāraṃ dharmaṃ me vada smārtaṃ yathākramam \|*  
*kautukaṃ pṛccha te brahmansamāsavyāsayogataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O Brahman, you kindly describe to me the details of Smarta-dharma, which has been interpreted in five ways, briefly as well as exhaustively, because I am quite anxious to learn about it.

## \|\| 1.181.3-5 \|\|

*sahasrakiraṇaṃ bhānumudayasthaṃ divākaram \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā devamuvāca garuḍāgrajaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhagavandevadeveśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala \|*  
*smṛtidharmānyathātattvaṃ vaktumarhasi pṛcchataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*evaṃ pṛṣṭastu bhagavānaruṇena khagādhipaḥ \|*  
*uvāca parayā prītyā pūjayitvā mahīpate \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Sumantu said — The five types of Smarta — dharma had been described for the noble soul Aruna by the Sungod himself. The way he did so, is going to be explained by me in detail. You please listen. Once Aruna questioned the Sungod with a thousand rays, and asked him at the time of the sunrise, offering his salutation to him — “O lord, O lord of gods, possessing a thousand rays, I am desirous of knowing about the Smarta-dharma. You kindly reveal the tattva of the same in an appropriate manner.” O lord of earth, the extremely delighted Aruna when asked this question, Surya — the leader of those moving in the sky, replied to him.

## \|\| 1.181.6-8 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca \|*  
*smṛtidharmaṃ vedamūlaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ garuḍāgraja \|*  
*pūrvānubhūtaṃ yaddhyānamatha tatsmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dharmaḥ kriyātmā nirdiṣṭaḥ śreyobhyudayalakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*sa ca pañcavidhaḥ prokto vedamūlaḥ sanātanaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*asya śabdasyānuṣṭhānātsvargo mokṣaśca jāyate \|*  
*iha loke sukhaiśvaryamalaṃ yacca khagādhipa \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Bhaskara said — “O elder brother of Garuda, I am going to reveal the Smarta-dharma which is based on the Vedas. You please listen. Getting absorbed in meditation, the experience that comes in mind, and then recalling the same is called Smriti. The form of this dharma is creative. The credit and the upliflment are its symptoms and has been described to be of five types. It is based on the Vedas, besides being eternal and everlasting. O foremost of the birds, by following this dharma, one achieves the heaven, moksha besides achieving of all the worldly pleasures.

## \|\| 1.181.9 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ paṃcavidho hyeṣa prokto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*kasya bhedāstu te paṃca brūhi me devasattama \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Aruna said — How was this eternal dharma divided into five forms? What are these five types, you kindly tell me?

## \|\| 1.181.10-13 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca \|*  
*vedadharmaḥ smṛtastveka āśramāṇāṃ sa tatparaḥ \|*  
*varṇāśramastṛtīyastu guṇanaimittiko yathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*varṇatvamekamāśritya adhikāre pravartate \|*  
*savarṇāśramadaṃḍastu bhikṣā daṃḍādiko yathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*varṇāśramāśramatvaṃ ca yodhikṛtya pravartate \|*  
*sa varṇāśramadharmastu daṃḍādyā mekhalā yathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yo guṇena pravarteta sa guṇo dharma ucyate \|*  
*yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ pālanaṃ param \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. Bhaskara said — Vedic dharma is one, which has been remembered. The duties of all the four ashramas are enshrined therein. As for example, the entry of the casual dharma is the Varnashrama-dharma. By conceiving the caste in it, the exercising of the right has been explained. Therefore, keeping in view the Brahmanas as well as the other varnas or castes like Vaishyas and others, at the time of the performing of the yajnopavita ceremony, the rites for begging as well as the holding of a danda, the same process is followed. This is called varnashrama-dharma, The process of holding a danda and wearing of a girdle is said to be similar for a Brahmachari as well as a Sanyasi, Because of the supremacy of guna or quality when the type of dharma is put in use, it is known as guna-dharma. As for example, for the kings who put on their heads tilakam for them, the well upkeep of the people is said to be the best dharma.

## \|\| 1.181.14-16 \|\|

*nimittamekamāśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate \|*  
*naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyo jātidravyaguṇāśrayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*eṣa tu dvividhaḥ proktaḥ samāsādaviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sa caturdhā nirūpyastu svarūpaphalasādhanaiḥ \|*  
*pramāṇatastu pratyekasamastaiśca yathākramam \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. When a dharma is put into practice patronizing on particular cause, it should be known as a casual dharma. This type of dharma is made keeping in view the caste, matter or virtue as the cause. The same has been explained also as two types of the basic dharma. But inspite of their being two separate entities, there exist no conspicuous variations in both of them. As for example, the performance of the rites of repentance are considered to be the casual dharma. It is said to be of four types, based on the form, reward, besides the resources. Each one of the aforesaid dharmas have been separately explained.

## \|\| 1.181.17-23 \|\|

*śrutyā saha virodhe tu bādhyate viṣayaṃ vinā \|*  
*vyavasthayā virodhena kāryo yatnaḥ parīkṣyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*smṛtyā saha virodhena cārthaśāstrasya sādhanam \|*  
*parasparavirodhe tu arthaśāstrasya sādhanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*adṛṣṭārthe vikalpastu vyavasthāsaṃbhave sati \|*  
*smṛtiśāstravikalpastu ākāṃkṣāpūraṇe sati \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vedamūle sthitaṃ tvetadanuṣṭhānaṃ kriyā satī \|*  
*evaṃ śakyavidhānaṃ tu nyāyo hyevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*niṣedhavidhirūpaṃ tu dvidhā śāstraṃ khagādhipa \|*  
*ekarūpaṃ vadaṃtyanye bahurūpamathā pare \|\| 21 \|\|*

*paṃcaprakārāḥ smṛtaya evaṃ śiṣyavyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*tridhā caturdhā dvedhā vā ekadhā bahudhā khaga \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭārthā tu smṛtiḥ kācidadṛṣṭārthā tathāparā \|*  
*anuvādasmṛtistvanyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu paṃcamī \|*  
*sarvā etā vedamūlāḥ smṛtā vai ṛṣibhiḥ svayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

17-23. When opposed to the Shrutis, it is obstructed without any cause. With the setting up and opposition thereof, the task to be performed is tested. When opposed to Smriti, the dharma becomes the cause of Arthashastra. At the stage of mutual conflict, it becomes the source of Arthashastra. At the possibility of organization, the interpretation of the imaginary meaning has an alternative. The alternative of the Smriti Rostra can be established at the fulfilling of the desire. The creativity of this process is enshrined in the Vedas. Similarly, all the prescribed procedures and justice are well organized. O lord of birds, there are two types of Shastras, viz., the prohibited and those in vogue. Some people interpret them as of one form, while others conceive them to be of various forms. Thus, Smritis have a single form, two forms, three forms, four forms and of many forms. These are meant to be used by five types of students. A Smriti sometimes has clear interpretation, while at time it has hidden meaning. Sometimes, there is a translated Smriti, while at times it contains visible and invisible meanings. All these Smritis are said by the Rishis to have been based on the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.181.24-26 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*yā etā bhavatā proktāḥ smṛtayaḥ parvagopane \|*  
*etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi samāsādeva sattama \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭārthā kā matā deva adṛṣṭārthā ca kā bhavet \|*  
*dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpā kā nyāyamūlā ca kā bhavet \|*  
*anuvādasmṛtiḥ kā syādṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu kā bhavet \|\| 25 \|\|*

*evamukto mahātejā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ \|*  
*uvāca taṃ khagaṃ vīraṃ praṇataṃ vinayānvitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Aruna said — O excellent one, you have explained the Smritis for the protection of the tithis (moon days). You kindly speak out their symptoms individually. I would like to know about them. O Deva, those known as Drishtartha (conveying the right significance of meanings of the word), Adrishtartha (unclear meanings), Drishtadrishta (cases in which some meaning is clear and unclear as well) and finally which only project the translation done. You kindly enlighten me on all such Smritis.” When Aruna so asked from the Sungod, the resplendent Bhaskara as thief of the water, spoke to the bird Aruna, who had been humbly seated there lowering his head.

## \|\| 1.181.27 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*ṣaḍguṇasya svarūpaṃ tu prayogā tkāryagauravāt \|*  
*samayānāmupāyānāṃ yogo vyāsasamāsataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Aditya said — The form of Smarta-dharma, its usages, related glory, the period and the methods are being discussed by me in brief as well as in detail, which have been said to be of six types as per the yoga.

## \|\| 1.181.28 \|\|

*adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca nikṣepaḥ karaṇānāṃ nirūpaṇam \|*  
*dṛṣṭārtheyaṃ smṛtiḥ proktā ṛṣibhirgaruḍāgraja \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. O elder brother of Garuda, the Smriti dealing with the wiping out of the superiors, and determination of the causes of actions is known to be Drishtartha Smriti.

## \|\| 1.181.29-30 \|\|

*saṃdhyopāstistathā kāryā śuno māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet \|*  
*adṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ proktā manunā vinatātmaja \|\| 29 \|\|*

*pālāśaṃ dhārayeddaṃḍamubhayārthā vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*virodhe tu vikalpaḥ syādyāgo homastato yathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. O son of Vinata, the performing of Sandhya thrice a day as revealed in the Smriti is known as Adrishtartha Smriti. The dog’s meat should not be consumed and the Smriti which highlights this subject is known a Drishtadrishta Smriti. This is what has been spoken by the people of learnings. In case, a controversy is possible with a Smriti, then one should think of an alternative, like the discarding of homa of a yajna.

## \|\| 1.181.31-32 \|\|

*śrutau dṛṣṭaṃ yathā kāryaṃ smṛto tattādṛśaṃ yadi \|*  
*uktānuvādinī sā tu pārivrājyaṃ tathā gṛhāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ukto dharmaśca saṃkṣepātparibhāṣā ca tadgatā \|*  
*tatsādhanaṃ ca deśādi itthamityabravīdraviḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. In case, whatever is mentioned in the Shruti is also mentioned in the Smriti serially, then to mention that Shruti as a visible subject is known as the translation. The Smriti which speaks out like that could be treated as the one, which is only a translation (of the original one). This is compared to the activity of embracing Sanyasa renouncing the household. This is how dharma has been defined in brief. Its other interpretation has also been discussed. The country and the time are their resources, has been spoken by the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.181.33 \|\|

*brahmāvartaḥ paro deśa ṛṣiśastastvanaṃtaraḥ \|*  
*madhyadeśastato'pyanya āryāvartastvanaṃtaraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The excellent Brahmavarta is the land of Rishis. Madhyadesa falls under it, which houses Aryavrata country.

## \|\| 1.181.34 \|\|

*kṛṣṇasārastu vicarenmṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ \|*  
*yajñiyaḥ sa tu deśaḥ syānmlecchadeśastataḥ paraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The country in which the black bucks roam about here and there, then that country is said to be praiseworthy for the performing of the yajna. The country that follows it, is known as the country of Mlecchas.

## \|\| 1.181.35-37 \|\|

*brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ brāhmaṇādestathaiva ca \|*  
*bhūtagrāmasya kṛtsnasya trayaṃ kṛtsnasya khecara \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sādhanatvaṃ manuḥ prāha vedamūlaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*prakāśayajñasaṃsiddhyai yadaśabdasya eva tu \|\| 36 \|\|*

*upalabhya yathātattvaṃ sa ca darśitavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*samyaksaṃsādhanaṃ dharmaḥ kartavyastvadhikāriṇā \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. O flier of the sky, the gods like Brahma and other varnas, besides all the living beings, have all dharmas as the resource, which has been described as eternal and based on the Vedas. It is an integral part of the Vedic speech of Brahma, the light in the yajnas and their success. Realizing the truth about it, by dhyanayoga or meditation, the Rishis revealed it (to the people) for their welfare. Therefore, the people with confidence should follow the same, making all the efforts.

## \|\| 1.181.38 \|\|

*niṣkāmena sadā vīra kāmyaṃ rūpānvitena ca \|*  
*ācārayuktaḥ śraddhālurvedajño'dhyātmaciṃtakaḥ \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti nyāyārjitadhanaśca yaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. The dharma is said to be of two forms, viz. with desire or without desire. Such of the people with wisdom who are faithful and well — versed in the Vedas, meditate upon spiritual aspects, they surely attain reward of their deeds. A person who earns riches by lawful means, also achieves the same.

## \|\| 1.181.39 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmāvartādideśānāṃ samastānāṃ vibhāvaso \|*  
*vibhāgaṃ brūhi deveṃdra saṃmānaya grahādhipa \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Aruna said — O Vibhavasu (Sungod), the divisions of all the countries of Brahmavarta and others may kindly be revealed to me. O Devendra and the lord of the planets, you kindly accept this prayer of mine.

## \|\| 1.181.40 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyordevanadyoryadaṃtaram \|*  
*taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmāvartaṃ pracakṣate \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Aditya said — The country in between the rivers of Sarasvati and Drishadvati, which was created by the gods, is known as Brahmavarta.

## \|\| 1.181.41-43 \|\|

*himavadviṃdhyadharayoryadaṃtaramudāhṛtam \|*  
*pratyageva prayāgācca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*āsamudrāttu vai pūrvādāsamudrāttu paścimāt \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tayorevāṃtaraṃ giryorāryāvartaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*āryāvarta \|*  
*etānvijñāya saddeśāntsaṃśrayeta prayatnataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*śūdrastu yasmiṃstasminvā nivasedvṛttikarśitaḥ \|*  
*eṣā dharmasya vai jyotiḥ samāsātkathitā tava \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. The land between the Himalaya as well as Vindhya mountain which is lodged to the rest of Prayaga is known as Madhyadesa. The area between the eastern seashore to the western seashore has been described as Aryavrata by the learned people. Realizing this, one should make this place as his living abode. As a Shudra can live in any country for the earning of his livelihood, thus the entire glory of dharma has been shown to you.

## Chapter 182. The performing of marriage

## \|\| 1.182.1 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*uktaṃ dharmasya rūpaṃ tu sādhikāraṃ sanātanam \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmamāśramiṇāṃ khaga \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Aditya said — You have been apprised of the true form of dharma. Now I am speaking about the dharmas of different ashramas.

## \|\| 1.182.2 \|\|

*brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vanastho bhikṣureva ca \|*  
*catvāra āśramāḥ proktā eka eva caturvidhaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The Brahmachari, the householder, the Vanaprasthin (or the forest dweller) as well as the ascetics or sanyasis are the four ashramas.

## \|\| 1.182.3-8 \|\|

*gāyatro brahmacārī tu prājāpatyo dvitīyakaḥ \|*  
*devavratastṛtīyastu naiṣṭhikastu caturthakaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*catvāra āśramāḥ proktāḥ savedāḥ samadharmakāḥ \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃskāraṃ dharmasiddhaye \|\| 4 \|\|*

*garbhādhānamṛtau kāryaṃ hṛṣṭayostu samantrakam \|*  
*kāryaṃ puṃsavanaṃ mātustṛtīye māsi saṃyutaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sīmantaḥ saptame garbhe ṣaṣṭhe vā saptame'pi vā \|*  
*pātrasaṃskārakā iṣṭā garbhādhānādayastrayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*jātakarmādayaḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ puruṣasya tu \|*  
*jātasya prāśanaṃ yatra svarṇā dīnāṃ samantrakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*jātakarmeti tatproktaṃ guhyaṃ nāma tadaiva tu \|*  
*prakāśo nāma kartavyaṃ dine tvekādaśerthavat \|\| 8 \|\|*

3-8. The one who worships is known as a Brahmachari. The householder who performs the prajapatya yajna is known as running in the ashrama of a householder. A person who performs adoration of gods is the third one, and the one who performs the religious rites regularly with faith, represents the fourth ashrama. The Vedas also describe the four ashramas. Now, I shall speak about the Samskaras to be performed by all of them for the achieving of success in all the four ashramas. You please listen. Both the husband and wife with delighted hearts, during the period of menstruation, should conceive reciting the mantras. During the third month of the pregnancy, the Pumsavana rite of the mother should be performed. During the sixth or the seventh month, the Simanta ceremony should be performed for the mother. With the performing of the rites, the parents of the child are purified. Therefore, these must be performed by all the castes. The name giving and other ceremonies are performed only for the male child. Then reciting the mantras, the ceremony of tasting should be performed using the gold (spoon). Then the name is given. This ceremony is also known as Guhya as well, the name should be given on the eleventh day.

## \|\| 1.182.9-11 \|\|

*dharmaśāstrādisaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ khaga \|*  
*prathame'bde tṛtīye vā cūḍākarma vidhīyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aṣṭame daśame vāpi brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam \|*  
*puruṣasya tathā cānyajātīyānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ekādaśe dvādaśe vā kārya kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ \|*  
*vedasaṃskārakaṃ vacmi manyante tvaupanāyanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. According to the religious scriptures, the ceremony for the tasting of food of a child should be performed during the sixth month. The Chudakarma or the removal of the hair should be performed during the first or the third year of the child. The yajnopavita ceremony of a Brahmana boy should be performed during the eighth or the tenth year, which is a must even for the other castes as well. The Vedic form of the performing of the yajnopavita ceremony of Kshatriya and Vaishya boys should be performed during the eleventh or the, twelfth year. This is the opinion of the learned people.

## \|\| 1.182.12-13 \|\|

*puruṣasya tathā cānya ubhayośca bravīmyaham \|*  
*sāvitraṃ vaidikaṃ caiva mahānāmnīmahāvratam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tathaupaniṣadaṃ cābdaṃ godānaṃ ca suvarṇakam \|*  
*vratāni grahaṇārthāni vedasyeti manormatam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The Brahmanas and the people of other castes have to perform the which are well known and are being repeated by me. You please listen. The annual process as per the Upanishads is the giving of a cow in charity by the high caste people. This vrata should be performed as per the Vedic dharma as per the opinion of Manu.

## \|\| 1.182.14-17 \|\|

*vedaikadeśapāṭhasya uktaṃ gṛhye prapañcakam \|*  
*uktā gurostu śuśrūṣā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthasādhanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ubhayorvā tathā cānyā yathānyāyaṃ yathāśrutam \|*  
*gurorapyeva taṃ vidyāttaddhyānaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*toṣaḥ parasparasyeti etāvāndharmasaṃgrahaḥ \|*  
*kṛtsno vedo'dhigaṃtavyaḥ svadharmamanutiṣṭhatā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*jñātvā vedaṃ brahmacārī graṃthārthānyānyathāvidhi \|*  
*naiṣṭhikaśca vidhānaṃ tu yāvatklībaṃ vidhīyate \|*  
*vidyānte'bhīṣṭadānaṃ ca anujñāto gṛhī bhavet \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. The part of the Vedas, which has been explained exhaustively n the Grihyasutras should be recited. Besides, service rendered to the preceptors have been described as the means to Drishtadrishta. The judicious words spoken by the preceptor should be recited serial wise. This recitation is essential. Its meditation is of three types. To maintain cordiality among (the preceptor as well as the disciples) is essential. But this is the only reward for conducting religiously by a person. Following one’s dharma appropriately, one should study the Vedas. It is desirable of a Brahmachari that why carrying on the studies of the Vedas, he should also try to understand the tattvas of the other scriptures, pretty well. The true religious knowledge is gained with the decline (of the force) of the sense organs. After the compilation of the studies, the preceptor should be offered the appropriate presents, a Brahmachari should embrace the position of a householder with the permission of the preceptor.

## \|\| 1.182.18 \|\|

*niṣkāsanaṃ gurugṛhādgṛhasthasya yathābhavet \|*  
*naiṣṭhikaśca tathā snānaṃ kuryātsamyagyathāvidhi \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. As a person departs from the abode of the preceptor to become a householder, similarly, the bath for naifthikas has been prescribed in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 1.182.19-22 \|\|

*udvahedvai tato bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām \|*  
*aviplutabrahmacaryaścādhikārī khagottama \|\| 19 \|\|*

*svatantramanye cecchanti hyadhikāraṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*saptamīṃ pañcamīṃ caiva kanyakāṃ pitṛmātṛtaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*udvaheta dvijo bhāryāmasamānārṣagotrajām \|*  
*saṃkhyāvidhivivāheṣu gotrārthaṃ vidhivarjitam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vikalpenaiva mantavyamṛṣīṇāṃ vividhā śrutiḥ \|*  
*aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ saṃskārākhyā iti śrutiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. O foremost of the birds, the perfect Brahmachari on his return to his home, should try to get a beautiful girl with auspicious symptoms as his wife. The other excellent Brahmanas should also try to exert their rights. A girl from fifth or seventh generation whose Rishi and gotras are not similar, should be accepted by him as his wife. In the appropriate marriages, the relationship in the same gotra is not acceptable. There are several types of Shrutis. It has been ordained in the Shruti that eight types of marriages are solemnized in all the four varnas.

## \|\| 1.182.23-24 \|\|

*yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāmanākhyāya praya cchati \|*  
*tasya kuryānnṛpo daṃḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān \|\| 23 \|\|*

*piturgṛhe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā \|*  
*pataṃti pitarastasya kanyā ca vṛṣalī bhavet \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. In case, the marriage of a blemished girl is solemnized without revealing the blemish of the girl, then the king should punish the donor of the girl with ninety six papas (gold coins). In case, a girl starts menstruation in parent’s home, the name of that father fall in the hell. Besides the girl is termed as a Shudra girl.

## \|\| 1.182.25 \|\|

*yastu tāṃ varayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ \|*  
*aśrāddheyamapāṅkteyaṃ taṃ vidyādvṛṣalīpatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. A Brahmana who with little knowledge accepts such a girl as his wife, he should be ousted from Shraddha rites, discarded from the line and is treated as the husband of a Shudra.

## \|\| 1.182.26-27 \|\|

*sarvadoṣānhi vikhyāpya striyā vā puruṣasya vā \|*  
*ubhayorapi vikhyāpya tataḥ saṃbandhamācaret \|\| 26 \|\|*

*gaurī kanyā pradhānā vai madhyamā kanyakā smṛtā \|*  
*rohiṇī tatsamā jñeyā adhamā tu rajasvalā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Irrespective of their being the boy or the girl, the related blemishes must be revealed before the marriage is performed. The one with fair complexion (Gauri) is considered to be the foremost one. The girl with other complexion is considered to be of mediocre type. Rohini is like that and the girl with menstruation is considered to be of the lowest grade.

## \|\| 1.182.28 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*gaurī tu kā matā kanyā rohiṇī ca jagatpate \|*  
*rajasvalā nagnikā ca devakanyā ca kā bhavet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Aruna said — What are the features of Gauri, Rohini and a girl in period, Nagnika as well as a Devakanya.

## \|\| 1.182.29-30 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca \|*  
*asaṃprāptarajā gaurī prāpte rajasi rohiṇī \|*  
*avyañjanayutā kanyā kucahīnā ca nagnikā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*saptavarṣā bhavedgaurī daśavarṣā tu nagnikā \|*  
*dvādaśe tu bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Bhaskara said — A girl without menstruation is known as Gauri. The one whose menstruation has started is known as Rohini, and the one without symptoms is known as a Kanya, while the one having no race is known a Nagnika. Further the girl having seven years of age is known as Gauri; the one who is ten years old is known as Nagnika; the one of the age of twelve years is known as a Kanya and the one with the age higher than this is known as Rajasvala.

## \|\| 1.182.31 \|\|

*payodhareṣu gaṃdharvā rajasyagniḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. A girl with auspicious symptoms is enjoyed by Soma. The breasts are enjoyed by Gandharvas and the fire is said to be lodged in the menstrual fluid from women.

## \|\| 1.182.32 \|\|

*hinasti vyañjanaiḥ putrānkulaṃ hanyātpayodharaiḥ \|*  
*gatimiṣṭāṃ tathā lokānhanyāttu rajasā pituḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The symptoms of the unwed girl (when not disclosed), the father is likely to lose his son; and with the breasts the loss of race, and when a girl do not menstruates, he does not achieves the excellent position as well as the best of the lokas.

## \|\| 1.182.33-34 \|\|

*tasmādavyañjanopetāmarajaskapayodharām \|*  
*nānyopabhuktāṃ somādyairdadyādduhitaraṃ pitā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*annaṃ tasya na bhoktavyaṃ vṛthā pāko hi sa smṛtaḥ \|*  
*vṛthā pākasya bhuktvānnaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Therefore, when the symptoms of menstruation and breasts appear, the girl should be married. A person whose daughter does not fall in the above categories, his food should not be eaten, because the food cooked in the house of such a person is considered to be of no use. By taking the useless food, one has to perform repentance.

## \|\| 1.182.35 \|\|

*prāṇāyāmaṃ trirabhyasya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati \|*  
*vivāhayedekagotrāṃ samānapravarāṃ khaga \|*  
*kṛtvā tasyāṃ samutsargamatikṛcchro viśodhanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. After taking food with such a person, one should thrice perform pranayama and sip ghi as a repentance. When a person cohabits with the girl of same gotra and pravara, for him performing of the kricchra vrata has been prescribed.

## \|\| 1.182.36 \|\|

*udvāhayetsagotrāṃ ca tanayāṃ mātulasya ca \|*  
*ṛṣibhiścaiva tulyo yo dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. In case, a Brahmana is married to a girl of the same gotra or with the daughter of a maternal uncle having the similar Rishi such a Brahmana has to perform the Chandrayana vrata.

## \|\| 1.182.37 \|\|

*asapiṇḍā tu yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ \|*  
*sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The girls who are separate from the gotra of the mother and are distinct from the gotra of the father as well, are considered to be praiseworthy for marriage by the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.182.38 \|\|

*aruṇa uvāca \|*  
*dārakarma kimuktaṃ vai yaduktaṃ bhavatā idam \|*  
*sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Arana said — You have stated a girl to be praiseworthy for dara-karma as well as the physical union. But what is the dara-karma.

## \|\| 1.182.39 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*agnihotrādi yatkarma vaidikaṃ vinatātmaja \|*  
*taduktaṃ dārakarmeti dvābhyāṃ yogāttu maithune \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Aditya said — O son of Vinata, the performing of Vedic rites of sacrifice are known as dara-karma which is essential for the marriage, besides the sex act.

## \|\| 1.182.40-42 \|\|

*nodvahetkapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṃgīṃ na rogiṇīm \|*  
*nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ na cākūṭāṃ na piṅgalām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ṛkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīṃ nānyaparvatanāmikām \|*  
*na yakṣāhipreṣyanāmnīṃ cātibhīṣaṇanāmikām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*yasyāstu na bhavedbhrātā na vijñāyeta vai pitā \|*  
*nopagaccheddhi tāṃ prājñaḥ putrikādharmaśaṃkayā \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. A woman or a girl with reddish brown complexion, the one with an additional limb, the ailing one, having no hair or excessive hair, the deceitful one, the one with yellow complexion or the one having the name similar to the one of a constellation, tree, a river, a mountain, Yaksha, Naga, messenger and the one having a terrific name, should not be married. The one having no brother, or whose father is unknown, a person with wisdom should not marry such a girl, because there could be a possibility of her belonging to his own race, which could result in the loss of dharma.

## \|\| 1.182.43 \|\|

*haṃsasvarāmekavarṇāṃ madhupiṃgalalocanām \|*  
*tādṛśīṃ varayetkanyāṃ gṛhārthī khagasattama \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. O foremost of the birds, for becoming a householder, one should have the voice of a swan, similar beauty and complexion, the eyes of yellow colour of honey. Such girls should be married.

## \|\| 1.182.44-45 \|\|

*dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo'graje sthite \|*  
*parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*parivittiḥ parivettā ca yayā sa parividyate \|*  
*sarve te narakaṃ yāṃti dātṛyājakapaṃcamāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. A person who do the performance of marriage or the homa in fire, he is called Parivetta. The wife of such a person, the girl’s father and the one who performs the marriage, all of them have to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.182.46-48 \|\|

*klībe deśāṃtarasthe vā patite vrajite tathā \|*  
*yogaśāstrābhiyukte ca na doṣaḥ parivedane \|\| 46 \|\|*

*khaṃjavāmanakubjeṣu gadgadeṣu jaḍeṣu ca \|*  
*jātyaṃdhe badhire mūke na doṣaḥ parivedane \|\| 47 \|\|*

*na śrāddhaṃ tu kaniṣṭhasya vikulāya ca kanyakā \|*  
*varaśca kulaśīlābhyāṃ na śuddhyeta kadācana \|*  
*na maṃtrāḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra na ca kanyā vṛtā bhavet \|\| 48 \|\|*

46-48. In case, the elder is suffering from a disease, is a eunuch, dwells in a forest land, is a fallen person or an ascetic or a yogi, then he does not earn any blemish with his wife. In case, the elder brother is lame, dwarf, hunch back, with slumbering speed, insane, blind by birth, deaf and dumb, then the younger brother will have no objection to live with his wife. As the Shraddha of a younger person cannot be performed, similarly, the girl should not be given to a person whose family is unknown. Because a groom whose family or race is unknown, cannot be purified. The mantras are not effective in such a case, nor can the girl be married.

## \|\| 1.182.49 \|\|

*udvāhitā tu yākanyā na ca prāptā tu maithunam \|*  
*punarabhyeti bhartāraṃ yathā kanyā tathaiva sā \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A girl who has already been married but has not enjoyed the union with her husband, she can remarry, because she remains a virgin like a maid girl.

## \|\| 1.182.50 \|\|

*samākṣipya matāṃ kanyāṃ pitā tvakṣatayonikām \|*  
*kulaśīlavate dadyānna syāddoṣaḥ khagādhipa \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The father (in case of need) should decorate the untouched girl and give her away to a groom of a high family and by so doing, he does not earn any blemish.

## \|\| 1.182.51 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*ete'ṣṭau prabhavāḥ proktā vivāhā ye jagatpate \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi caiteṣāṃ samāsāttimirāpaha \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Aruna said — O lord of the universe, you have spoken about the eight types of marriages which are common on earth. O remover of the darkness, you kindly enlighten me on the comprehensive symptoms.

## \|\| 1.182.52 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*śubhāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kulaśīlaguṇānvitām \|*  
*alaṃkṛtyārhate dānaṃ vivāho brāhma ucyate \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Aditya said — A girl with auspicious symptoms, belonging to a high family and excellent virtues, should be decorated with ornaments, and when given to a capable person in marriage, it is known as Brahma marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.53 \|\|

*saha dharmakriyāhetordānaṃ samayabaṃdhanāt \|*  
*alaṃkṛtyaiva kanyāyāḥ prājāpatyaḥ sa ucyate \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. For the performing of the religious rites and giving of charities as per one’s resolve and then marry the girl to a suitable person is called the Prajapatya type of marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.54-55 \|\|

*pradānaṃ yatra kanyāyāḥ sahagomithunena tu \|*  
*savarṇāyāḥ sagotrāyāstamārṣamṛṣayo viduḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*aṃtarvedyāṃ samānīya kanyāṃ kanakamaṃḍitām \|*  
*ṛtvije caiva yaddānaṃ vivāho daivasaṃjñakaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. In a marriage, in which a girl is given in marriage with two cows to the groom of the same caste and gotra, such a marriage is called Arsha type of marriage by the Rishis. When a girl, decorated with ornaments, is brought in the mandapa and is given to the sacrificial priest, it is known as Daiva type of marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.56 \|\|

*ete vivāhāścatvāro dharmakāmārthadāyakāḥ \|*  
*aśulkā brahmaṇā proktāstārayaṃti kuladvayam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. With the performing of these four types of marriages, both the families are redeemed. There is no provision for the exchange of wealth. This has been told by Brahma.

## \|\| 1.182.57 \|\|

*caturṣveteṣu dattāyāmutpanno yaḥ sutaḥ striyām \|*  
*dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca punātyāsaptamānpitṝn \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. The children produced from the woman under these types of marriages redeem the donor, receiver and their seven generations.

## \|\| 1.182.58 \|\|

*vivikte svayamanyo'nyaṃ strīpuṃsoryaḥ samāgamaḥ \|*  
*prītihetuḥ sa gāṃdharvo vivāhaḥ paṃcamo mataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. When a man and a woman, both after investigating the truth about each other, out of love, establish the relationship of a husband and wife, such a marriage which is of fifth type is known as the Gandharva marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.59 \|\|

*hatvā cchittvā ca bhittvā ca krośaṃtīṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt \|*  
*prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ rākṣasodvāha ucyate \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. After creating disturbance and violence, when a girl is kidnapped while crying and lamenting, it is the sixth type of marriage called the Rakshasas marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.60 \|\|

*śulkaṃ pradāya kanyāyā haraṇaṃ vyasanādapi \|*  
*prasāda heturuktoyamāsuraḥ saptamastathā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Because of a person being a debauch and when the required fee is paid, and when a girl is taken away, it is called the seventh Asura type of marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.61 \|\|

*suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vā raho yatropagacchati \|*  
*sa pāpiṣṭho vivāhānāṃ paiśācaścāṣṭamodhamaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. When a girl is fast asleep, then to forcibly enjoy such a girl in seclusion is a sinful union, which is the eighth type of marriage known as Paishachi marriage.

## \|\| 1.182.62-63 \|\|

*etānsaśulkānsāmānyānvivāhāṃścaturo viduḥ \|*  
*kevalaṃ kṣatriyasyaiva vīryaṃ chittvā hi rākṣasaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*prāpte pūrvavivāhe tu vidhirvaivāhikaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*kartavyastu tribhirvarṇaiḥ samayenāgnisākṣikaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. The first four types of marriages when arranged with a payment are said to be ordinary marriages. In the Rakshasa marriage, the kidnapping of a girl has been said to be the destruction of the prowess of the Kshatriyas. The first four types of marriages bestow welfare. Therefore, making the fire as a witness, all the three varnas should perform the marriage appropriately.

## \|\| 1.182.64-66 \|\|

*doṣavatyāḥ pradāne tu dātuḥ ṣaṇṇavatirdamaḥ \|*  
*syāttu śulkapradāne ca kanyāyāścāpavarjane \|\| 64 \|\|*

*mokṣopavartanaṃ dveṣaḥ strīdhanasya nivartanam \|*  
*ākāṃkṣā tīrthasaṃrodhastyāgahetuśca vakṣyate \|\| 65 \|\|*

*parasparasya saṃbaṃdhānmokṣaḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*na syādanyataraḥ prīto roṣātsāṃpratikādapi \|\| 66 \|\|*

64-66. A person who gives away a blemished girl in marriage has to pay a danda of ninety six panas (gold coins). The same amount of punishment has to be awarded who prevents the marriage to be solemnized. To himself only aspire for moksha, jealousy, spending of wealth meant for the woman, aspirations besides living at a place of pilgrimage, are the means, which have been described for the renouncing of one another. I am going to speak about in a serial order. When the mutual conjugal relations are established between a man and a woman, the achievement of moksha is said to be certain and that is desirable as well, instead of discarding the same out of pleasure or the instantaneous rage, and then try to achieve moksha.

## \|\| 1.182.67-73 \|\|

*bādhate cetpatirbhāryāṃ sa tu dveṣa iti smṛtaḥ \|*  
*vṛttirābharaṇaṃ śulkaṃ lābhaśca strīdhanaṃ bhavet \|\| 67 \|\|*

*bhoktṛstu svayamevedaṃ pratijñāhananaṃ bhavet \|*  
*vṛthā mokṣeṇa bhogena striyai dadyātsavṛddhikam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*āpattisamaye jāte strīdhanaṃ bhoktumarhati \|*  
*ākāṃkṣetāṣṭavarṣāṇi bhartāpi prasavaṃ striyāḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*jāyante yadi no putrāstasyāṃ yatne mahatyapi \|*  
*tato viṃdeta putrārthī dharmataḥ kulajāṃ striyam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*putralābhātparaṃ loke nāsti hi prasavārthinaḥ \|*  
*etāṃ śulkasya tāṃ bhuktvā anyāṃ labdhuṃ yadīcchati \|*  
*samastāstoṣayitvārthaiḥ sūryoḍhāṃ paramāṃ varet \|\| 71 \|\|*

*ekā śūdrasya vaiśyasya dve tisraḥ kṣatriyasya tu \|*  
*catasro brāhmaṇasya syurbhāryā rājño yatheṣṭataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

*atīrthagamanātpuṃsastīrthe saṃgāhanātstriyāḥ \|*  
*ubhayordharmalopaḥ syātsveṣveva tu viśeṣataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

67-73. When the husband causes pain to the wife, it happens due to jealousy (tor riches). The gaining of riches is the prerogative of a woman. Therefore, the person should himself desist from using such wealth for himself. The desire tor the achieving of alone is useless, besides enjoyment of the same (alone) is of no consequence. Therefore, for the self development, it would be better to spare it for one’s wife. It would not be improper to make use of the wealth of the wife in emergency. It would be desirable for a husband to wait for eight years to enable his wife to conceive. In case, during the period of eight years, the wife does not conceive inspite of foe best efforts, thereafter, he should many another girl of high family according to foe religious rites. In this world, for those who intend to conceive, there is another more important thing than getting a son. In case a person, after paying foe adequate fee, intends to keep another woman for the purpose, then spending foe riches, he should select a woman who is (suryodha) or the one who arrives at sunset This is because, it has been allowed for a Shudra to have a single wife, two for Vaishya, three for a Kshatriya and four for a Brahmana. This is a rule. In case, the man does not go on a pilgrimage but the wife goes there, in that case the dharma of both of them vanishes, particularly for the rich people.

## \|\| 1.182.74-78 \|\|

*yaugapadye tu tīrthānāṃ vivāhakramaśo vrajet \|*  
*tatsāmyaṃ jīvaputrā vā grahaṇakramaśopi vā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*brāhmādibhirvivāhaistu saṃskṛtau tau khagādhipa \|*  
*aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ vainateya uśaṃti vai \|\| 75 \|\|*

*brāhmo daivastathārṣaśca prājāpatyaḥ khagā dhipa \|*  
*gāṃdharvaścāsuro rakṣaḥ paiśācastvaṣṭamo'dhamaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*praśastāḥ kṣatriyādīnāṃ viprādīnāṃ tu mānataḥ \|*  
*pratigrahādayo baddhā vivāhā brāhmaṇasya tu \|\| 77 \|\|*

*kṣatriyasyāpi deyā tu pratigrahavivarjitā \|*  
*pravṛttiṃ kecidicchaṃti dānamityapare striyāḥ \|*  
*pāvanaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vivāhaṃ paricakṣate \|\| 78 \|\|*

74-78. In case, both the husband and wife intend to go on pilgrimage, then the sequence of marriage should be adopted. In other words, when foe first married wife is available, then the second one should not accompany the husband. In case the first wife has a son, in that case, foe second one could accompany her husband, disregarding the sequence. It is because with foe performing of the marriage by Brtlhma style, foe couple becomes well civilized. Therefore, O son of Vinata, eight types of marriages have been prescribed by the people of foe upper castes, viz., Brahma, Daiva Arsha, Prajapatya, Gandharva, Asura, Rakshasa and Paishacha. A Kshatriya can marry the Vaishya, Kshatriya and even shudra girls. A Brahmana can marry a Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaishya and Shudra girls, quite gracefully. The marriage of Brahmanas should be performed with donations (kanyadana). Some people prefer marriage due to inclination of mind, while others prefer getting a girl as a dana or foe charity. Thus, I have defined the mode of marriage for the men.

## Chapter 183. Performing of Shraddha

## \|\| 1.183.1 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca \|*  
*kuryātpaṃcamahāyajñānadhikāro dvijasya saḥ \|*  
*bhūtapitramarabrahmamanuṣyāṇāṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bhaskara said — According to the scriptures, the five Mahayajnas for bhutas, pitris, gods, Brahma and the humans is essential for the Brahmanas, because it happens to be his prerogative.

## \|\| 1.183.2 \|\|

*sadā sadāna kṛtyānāṃ phalārthamapare sthitāḥ \|*  
*nityānitya miti prāhuranuṣaṃgātphalaṃ pare \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Someone is of the opinion that these rites should be performed with a reward in view. Some call this performance as eternal, while the other call it as incidental, for seeking a reward.

## \|\| 1.183.3 \|\|

*atitheḥ paritoṣāya paricaryā vidhīyate \|*  
*adṛṣṭaniyamādṛṣṭamārogyāntaṃ ca varjanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. For the proper satisfaction of a guest, it is essential to serve him. The invisible rules can be followed when a person is healthy. Therefore, it would not be improper to discard it when a person is ailing.

## \|\| 1.183.4-5 \|\|

*tisroṣṭakāstu kartavyā madhyāvartī caturthikā \|*  
*śākapāyasapūpaistu māṃsena tu caturthikā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pratipadi kriyate yattu catuṣpārvaṇamucyate \|*  
*svagṛhyoktavidhānena tattu pakṣādi kīrtyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The three invisible rites — serving vegetables, payasam and fried cakes should be performed. The middle type of rites should be performed with meat. On the first moon day of a fortnight when a rite is performed, it is called Chatushparvana. According to one’s own Grihyasutra, when the rites are performed, then they are known as Pakshadi.

## \|\| 1.183.6 \|\|

*nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ sapiṃḍanam \|*  
*pārvaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ goṣṭhaśuddhyarthamuttamam \|*  
*karmāṃgaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ vaidikaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The everlasting, the casual, desirable, Shraddha for increase, Sapindan, Parvana, Vijnenyam, the cow’s pen’s purification ceremonies, Karmagam, and the tenth Vedic — karma, are the rites which are to be performed surely by the families who are quite well off.

## \|\| 1.183.7 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śrāddhaṃ dvādaśadhā vibho \|*  
*tasya sarvasya mā brūhi lakṣaṇaṃ vai pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Aruna said — You have described the performance of the twelve types of the Shraddha which are essential. But how could the same be done without knowing about there details, which may kindly be spoken individually.

## \|\| 1.183.8 \|\|

*nityaṃ kimucyate śrāddhaṃ kiṃ vā naimittikaṃ bhavet \|*  
*kāmyādi devadeveśa eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vada \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O god of gods, what are the descriptions of regular, casual, kamya and other Shraddhas. You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 1.183.9 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*ahanyahani yacchrāddhaṃ tannityaṃ khaga kīrtitam \|*  
*vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu aśaktāvudakena tu \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Aditya said — O bird, a Shraddha which is performed daily is known as nitya or regular Shraddha. In case, one is unable to perform the rite of bali of Vaishvadeva by giving away the food, then it could be done with the offering of the water alone.

## \|\| 1.183.10 \|\|

*ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tannaimittikamucyate \|*  
*tatsadaiva prakartavyamayugmānbhojayeddvijān \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Ekodishta Shraddha is known as a casual Shraddha, which should be continuously performed. During a Shraddha, the odd number of Brahmanas should be served the food.

## \|\| 1.183.11 \|\|

*kāmayuktaṃ hi tatkāmyamabhipretārthasiddhaye \|*  
*pārvaṇena vidhānena tadapyuktaṃ khagādhipa \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A Shraddha which is performed for the sake of one’s desire, is known as Kamya Shraddha. O best of birds, it should be completed with the Parvana rite.

## \|\| 1.183.12 \|\|

*vṛddhau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ taducyate \|*  
*sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvāhṇe tūpavītinā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The Shraddha which is performed with a desire in view is known as Kamya Shraddha. A person who wears a yajnopavita must perform the aforesaid Shraddha in the forenoon appropriately.

## \|\| 1.183.13-16 \|\|

*gaṃdhodakatilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātracatuṣṭayam \|*  
*arghārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ pramocayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ye samānā iti dvābhyāmetajjñeyaṃ sapiṃḍanam \|*  
*nityena tulyaṃ śeṣaṃ syādekoddiṣṭaṃ striyā api \|\| 14 \|\|*

*darśe vai kriyate yattu tatpārvaṇamudāhṛtam \|*  
*parvaṇi kriyate yacca tatpārvaṇamiti sthitiḥ \|*  
*gobhyaśca kriyate śrāddhaṃ tadgoṣṭhaśrāddhamucyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

*bahūnāṃ viduṣāṃ saṃpatsukhārthaṃ pitṛtṛptaye \|*  
*kriyate śuddhaye yadvai brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam \|*  
*śudyarthamiti tatproktaṃ vainateya manīṣibhiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. The sandalpaste water mixed with sesamum seeds, should be kept in four vases for offering arghya. It should then be mixed with the vases of the pitris. The water of oblation should be mixed with the same, reciting the mantra-ye samana. This is known as Sapinda rite. The rest of the process is accordingly as detailed earlier. The Ekodishta Shraddha is also performed for the sake of the women. The Shraddha which is completed on the moonless day is known as Parvana. Besides those, performed on the day of festivities, are also called Parvana Shraddhas. For the satisfaction of the pitris, some service is rendered to the Brahmanas by these means. With these thoughts in view, the Shraddha is also termed as Sampatsukhartha. O son of Vinata, when a Brahmana is served with food for the purification of wisdom, it is called Shuddhyartha by the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.183.17 \|\|

*niṣekakāle some ca sīmatonnayane tathā \|*  
*jñeyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ śrāddhaṃ tacca karmāṃgameva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The Shraddha performed during the pregnancy of a woman, the one performed for the purification of the moon, Simantonnayana and Pumsavana rites are known as Karmanga Shraddhas.

## \|\| 1.183.18 \|\|

*kriyate devamuddiśya saptamyādiṣu yatnataḥ \|*  
*gaccheddeśāṃtare yastu śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu sarpiṣā \|*  
*tadyatnārthamiti proktaṃ pradiśecca na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The Shraddhas performed for the sake of the gods, at the time of proceeding on to a journey on the Saptami and other moon days, with the use of ghi, are called Yatnartha Shraddha. By performing this, the concerned person becomes successful in his journey. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.183.19 \|\|

*śarīropacaye śrāddhamaśvavṛddhyarthameva ca \|*  
*puṣṭyarthametadvijñeyamaupacārikamucyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A Shraddha when performed for upkeep of the limbs of the body, increase in the number of steed besides overall development, is known as this formal or Aupacharika Shraddha.

## \|\| 1.183.20 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva śrāddhānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ matam \|*  
*kiyate yatkhagaśreṣṭha mṛtehani budhaiḥ saha \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O best of birds, the annual Shraddha is said to be the best of all the Shraddhas, which is performed at the end of the year, for the sake of the dead on the months and dates of their actual death.

## \|\| 1.183.21-23 \|\|

*mṛte'hani punaryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt \|*  
*mātuśca khagaśārdūla vatsarāṃte mṛte'hani \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nāhaṃ tasya khagaśreṣṭha pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ \|*  
*na brahmā na ca vai rudro na cānye devatāgaṇāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte'hani \|*  
*nareṇa khagaśārdūla bhojakena viśeṣataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. O lion among the birds, on the annual day of death of a poison or on the death day of the mother, one who does not perform the Shraddha, the worship performed by him for Vishnu, Rudra and other gods are not accepted Therefore, it is proper for a person that on the death anniversary of the person, the Shraddha should be performed for him and particularly for the Bhojakas.

## \|\| 1.183.24-25 \|\|

*bhojako yastu vai śrāddhaṃ na karoti khagādhipa \|*  
*mātāpitṛbhyāṃ satataṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte'hani \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tāmisraṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|*  
*tato bhavati duṣṭātmā nagare sūkaraḥ khaga \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. A Bhojaka, who does not perform Shraddha on the death anniversary of his parents, he achieves the terrific hell known as Tamisra. Thereafter, the wicked soul becomes a pig.

## \|\| 1.183.26 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*na jānāti dinaṃ yastu na māsaṃ vibudhādhipa \|*  
*mṛtau yatra mahāprājña pitarau sa kathaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*śrāddhaṃ karotu vai tābhyāṃ vidhivadvatsarātmakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Aruna said — A person who does not know about the date of the death anniversary of his parents, how could he perform the annual Shraddha for them?

## \|\| 1.183.27-31 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*na jānāti naro yastu mṛtānāṃ vinatātmaja \|*  
*māsaṃ dinaṃ mṛtānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ khagasattama \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yathā kuryātkhagaśreṣṭha śṛṇu kṛtsnaṃ samāsataḥ \|*  
*mṛtāhaṃ yo na jānāti mānavo vinatātmaja \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tena kāryamamāyāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ khaga \|*  
*māse mārgaśire vīra māghe vā vidhivatkhaga \|\| 29 \|\|*

*viśeṣato bhojanena yo māṃ pūjyate sadā \|*  
*prītaye mama vai tena saṃpūjyāḥ pitaraḥ sadā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*mameṣṭāḥ pitaro nityaṃ gāvo viprāśca suvrata \|*  
*tasmācca te sadā pūjyā madbhaktena viśeṣataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

27-31. Aditya said — O son of Vinata, one who is not aware of the month or day of the death of his parents, I am going to speak out the way, by which he should perform the Shraddha for them. In case a person is unaware of the exact day, then he should perform the Shraddha on the moonless day of the same month, for the departed soul. Such of the people, who during the month of Margashirsha or Magha, worship me offering the food, the manes also get adored by the same. O Suvrata, the manes, the cows and the Brahmanas have always been my favourite. Therefore, my devotees should always continue to worship them, because they are all adorable for them.

## Chapter 184. The Brahmana Dharma

## \|\| 1.184.1 \|\|

*prakhyāte pratyayenaiva praśnapūrvaṃ pratigrahaḥ \|*  
*yajane'dhyāpane vāde ṣaḍvidho vedavikrayaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. The Vedas are said to be sold by the (popularizing self, to gain the confidence of others, not to insist on a point with the known people, accepting donations, performance of yajnas, besides the delivering of the discourse. These are the six means by which the Vedas are said to be sold.

## \|\| 1.184.2 \|\|

*veda vikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ striyā cāvarjitaṃ dhanam \|*  
*na deyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yacca klībātkhagādhipa \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. O foremost of the birds, the wealth earned with the reciting of the Vedas for sake of the gods as well as the pitris, or the wealth of the women should not be spent, because the person who does so, is called a eunuch.

## \|\| 1.184.3 \|\|

*anuyogena yo dadyādbrāhmaṇāya pratigraham \|*  
*sa pūrvaṃ narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇāstadanaṃtaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A person who gives a Brahmana any donation of any kind, then initially, the donor falls in the hell and thereafter, the Brahmana who receives the same, follows him.

## \|\| 1.184.4 \|\|

*vedākṣarāṇi yāvaṃti niyujyanterthakāraṇāt \|*  
*tāvatyo bhrūṇahatyā vai vedavikrayamāpnuyāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. For the earning of the riches when the words of the Vedas are collected and on selling the same, he earns the sin of abortion.

## \|\| 1.184.5 \|\|

*vaiśvadevena yo hīna ādityasya ca karmaṇaḥ \|*  
*sarve te vṛṣalā jñeyāḥ prāptavedāśca brāhmaṇāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. When a Brahmana, who is well-versed in the Vedas, gets deprived of the worship of the Sungod, he is called a Shudra.

## \|\| 1.184.6-7 \|\|

*yeṣāmadhyayanaṃ nāsti ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ \|*  
*kulaṃ vā'śrotriyaṃ yeṣāṃ sarve te śūdradharmiṇaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*akṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu yo bhuṅkte so'budhaḥ khaga \|*  
*vṛthā tenānnapākena yamayoniṃ vrajettu saḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. (A Brahmana) in whose house the performing of Homa, reciting of the Vedas, besides their study is not carried out, he should the treated as a shudra. Performing the bali-Vaishvadeva when a person takes food, he becomes ignorant, therefore, preparing of the food by him is useless, because he shall have to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.184.8 \|\|

*priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkhaḥ paṃḍita eva ca \|*  
*vaiśvadeve tu saṃprāpte so'tithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. When the bali-Vaishvadeva is being performed and a learned guest arrives and a person who serves him, for him the achieving of the heaven is a great possibility.

## \|\| 1.184.9 \|\|

*naikagrāmīṇamatithiṃ viprasāṃgatikaṃ tathā \|*  
*aciṃtyobhyāgato yasmāttasmādatithirucyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A person who does not live in a particular village, there is no certainty for the arrival of a guest. A noble person like a Brahmana and about the arrival of whom no one is sure, such a person when arrives, he is known as a guest.

## \|\| 1.184.10 \|\|

*aciṃtyaḥ sa tu vai nāmnā vaiśvadeva upāgataḥ \|*  
*atithiṃ taṃ vijānīyānna punaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. On the arrival of such an imaginary person, one should think that with the same name and form, Vaishvadeva has arrived. He should be treated as a guest and another one who is already present.

## \|\| 1.184.11 \|\|

*yāvacca prāpnuyādannaṃ kṛtāśīḥ snātako dvijaḥ \|*  
*tasyānnasya caturbhāgaṃ haṃtakāraṃ viduḥ khaga \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O bird, the food which is meant for an initiated Brahmana, one fourth of it should be given to a guest.

## \|\| 1.184.12 \|\|

*grāsamātrā bhavedbhikṣā catuṣkālaṃ caturguṇam \|*  
*puṣkalāni ca catvāri haṃtakāro vidhīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The morsel of four types in bhiksha or the charity should be given four times a day. And flowers of four types, are also to be given.

## \|\| 1.184.13 \|\|

*ārūḍho naiṣṭhikaṃ dharmaṃ yastu pracyavate punaḥ \|*  
*cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsamiti viddhi khagādhipa \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. O foremost of the birds, with the following of the eternal dharma, in case a person falters, then he should perform the Chandrayana vrata for a month.

## \|\| 1.184.14 \|\|

*ārūḍhapatitāpatyā brāhmaṇo vṛṣalena ca \|*  
*dvāvetau viddhi cāṃḍālau veditrādyaśca jāyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. The progeny of a Brahmana who falls from the performing of the religious rites and the vrishala Brahmana, both should be treated as Chandalas.

## \|\| 1.184.15-16 \|\|

*brāhmaṇī kulaṭā nityaṃ svakaṃ tyaktvā patiṃ khaga \|*  
*anyasya viśate gehe brāhmaṇasya khagādhipa \|\| 15 \|\|*

*utpadyate tu yastasyā brāhmaṇena mahāmate \|*  
*sa cāṃḍālo mahānprokto mahācāṃḍāla ityuta \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. O bird, in case a wicked woman, daily deserting her own husband when goes to another Brahmana’s house, then the children produced by her from (the fake Brahmana), are known as Chandalas or Maha Chandalas.

## \|\| 1.184.17 \|\|

*yastu pravrajito bhūtvā punaḥ sevati maithunam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥ \|*  
*paṃcagavyena śuddhiḥ syādityāha mama dehakṛt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person who after becoming a recluse, again indulges in sex act, he is reborn as an insect in the refuse. He can be purified only with the use of Panchagavya. This is what has been ordained by Vishvakarma.

## \|\| 1.184.18-19 \|\|

*abhojyaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ vṛṣalena nimaṃtritam \|*  
*tathaiva vṛṣalasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇena nimaṃtritam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānnaṃ dadacchūdraḥ śūdrānnaṃ brāhmaṇo dadat \|*  
*ubhāvetāvabhojyānnau bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 19 \|\|*
