18-19. The food of a Shudra Brahmana should not be consumed by a Brahmana. Similarly, the food of a Vrishala (Shudra) should not be taken by a Brahmana, even when he is invited for the purpose. At whichever place, when the food is served by a Chandala in the house of a Brahmana or when the food is served by a Brahmana in the house of a Shudra, in both the cases, such food should be discarded.

## \|\| 1.184.20 \|\|

*upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ ca paceddvijaḥ \|*  
*abhojyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ sa ca vipraḥ purohitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. In case, in the house of a Shudra, the food is prepared by a Brahmana and also supervised and protected by a Brahmana, but still such a food is unfit to be consumed. Such a Brahmana would be termed as the priest of the Shudra.

## \|\| 1.184.21 \|\|

*śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaṃ śūdreṇa saha vāsanam \|*  
*śūdrājjñānāgamaḥ kaścijvalaṃtamapi pātayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The food of Shudra, the contact with him, living with him and gaining of the knowledge by a Shudra, result in the fire flames which surely destroys the Brahmana and results into his total fall.

## \|\| 1.184.22 \|\|

*śūdrānnopahatā viprā vihvalā ratilālasāḥ \|*  
*kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. By consuming the food of a Shudra, the glory is lost and by enjoying sex with a female Shudra, one goes in flames. When enraged, the Brahmana conducts himself like a serpent without venom. In fact, such a Brahmana is incapable of doing anything.

## \|\| 1.184.23 \|\|

*hastadattāstu ye snehāllavaṇavyaṃjanādayaḥ \|*  
*dātāraṃ nādhitiṣṭhaṃti bhoktā bhuṃkte tu kilbiṣam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In case, a Shudra, out of affection, hands over salt or other stuff in the hand of a Brahmana, then the giver achieves no removal at all. To the contrary, it becomes sinful for the receiver,

## \|\| 1.184.24 \|\|

*āyasena tu pātreṇa yadannamupadīyate \|*  
*bhoktā viṣṭhāśanaṃ bhuṃkte dātā tu narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. When the food is given in an iron vase, then in that case, the food turns like refuse for the receiver. The giver also falls in hell for giving the same.

## \|\| 1.184.25 \|\|

*aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ yatpratyakṣalavaṇaṃ ca yat \|*  
*mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. To brush the teeth with the finger, eating food with salt, besides consuming of the dust, are the acts comparable with the consuming of the flesh of the cow.

## \|\| 1.184.26 \|\|

*mukhe paryuṣite nityaṃ bhavatyaprayato dvijaḥ \|*  
*tasmācchuṣkamathārdraṃ vā bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The mouth daily becomes stale and with that a Brahmana is unable to do anything. Therefore, in the early morning, it is necessary to brush the teeth with a dry or fresh tooth stick.

## \|\| 1.184.27 \|\|

*puṣpālaṃkāravastrāṇi gaṃdha mālyānulepanam \|*  
*upavāse na duṣyaṃti daṃtadhāvanamaṃjanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. With the use of flowers, ornaments, costumes, fragrances, flower garlands, paste, tooth stick and collyrium, one does not attract impurity.

## \|\| 1.184.28-30 \|\|

*gṛhāṃte vasate mūrkho dūre cāsya guṇānvitaḥ \|*  
*guṇanvite ca dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhavya tikramaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti vipre vedavivarjite \|*  
*jvalaṃtamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sannikṛṣṭamadhīyānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo vyatikramet \|*  
*bhojanenaiva dānena dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. A fool can remain in the house and a virtuous person at a far off place. Therefore, whatever is to be given, should be given to the virtuous person and not to a fool. A Brahmana who is deprived of the study of the Vedas, should not be disowned, because the offering is made in the flames of fire and not in the heap of ashes. A person who does not serve a Brahmana by offering him the food, but prefers those who live at far off places, he actually bums his future seven generations.

## \|\| 1.184.31-34 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*evameva jagannātha devadeva jagatpate \|*  
*kiṃ tu yatte purā deva śrutaṃ vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*gadato nāradasyaiva śṛṇu tvaṃ vibudhādhipa \|*  
*gadato me suraśreṣṭha dharmyamarthaṃ sukhāvaham \|\| 32 \|\|*

*satyaniṣṭhaṃ dvijaṃ yastu śuklajātiṃ priyaṃvadam \|*  
*mūrkhaṃ pākhaṃḍinaṃ vāpi vṛttihīnamathāpi vā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*atikramya naro ghoraṃ narakaṃ pātayetkhaga \|*  
*sapta parānsapta pūrvānpuruṣānātmanā saha \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. Aruna said — O lord of the universe, whatever you have spoken is true. But in earlier times, whatever had been heard by me from the sage Narada, the religious stories which provide comfort, are being repeated by me. You also please listen. A person, neglecting a Brahmana who lives close by but is fair complexioned, soft spoken, foolish, wicked and is without resources but honours a Brahmana of a far off place with the giving of the charities, he drives his earlier and seven future generations towards the hell.

## \|\| 1.184.35-36 \|\|

*tasmānnātikramedrājā brāhmaṇaṃ prātiveśikam \|*  
*saṃbandhatastathāsannaṃ dauhitraṃ vidyate tathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā baṃdhuṃ grahādhipa \|*  
*nātikramennarastvetānsumūrkhānapi gopate \|*  
*atikramya mahadraudraṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The king should not discard the Brahmanas, living close by. In case, the neighbor Brahmanas are related as the sons of the daughter, sister’s sons or close relatives but even when they are highly foolish, they should never be discarded. O lord of rays, by discarding those Brahmanas, one falls in the Maharaurava hell.

## \|\| 1.184.37 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*evametanna saṃdeho yathā vadasi khecara \|*  
*mamāpyavagataṃ vīra brāhmaṇaṃ na parīkṣayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Aditya said — O flier in the sky, whatever has been spoken by you is correct. There is no doubt about it. I have also decided that a Brahmana should never be put to test.

## \|\| 1.184.38 \|\|

*sarvadevamayaṃ vipraṃ sarvalokamayaṃ tathā \|*  
*tasmātsaṃpūjayedenaṃ na guṇāṃstasya ciṃtayet \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. A Brahmana is the form of all the gods as well as the universe. Therefore, he should be worshipped without putting him to test.

## \|\| 1.184.39 \|\|

*kevalaṃ ciṃtayejjātiṃ na guṇānvinatātmaja \|*  
*tasmādāmaṃtrayetpūrvamāsannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O son of Vinata, one should know about his caste and not about the virtues. Therefore, the people with intelligence say that the Brahmanas living nearby should be respected.

## \|\| 1.184.40 \|\|

*yastvāsannamatikramya brāhmaṇaṃ patitādṛte \|*  
*dūrasthānpūjayenmūḍho guṇāḍhyānnarakaṃ vrajet \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Except a degraded person, one who discarding the neighboring Brahmana, houses a Brahmana from a far off place, he surely falls in the hell.

## \|\| 1.184.41-42 \|\|

*devakarmavināśena brahmasvaharaṇena ca \|*  
*devadravyaṃ dvijānnaṃ ca brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇārjitam \|*  
*viyonyāṃ kṣipate yastu viyonimadhigacchati \|\| 41 \|\|*

*mā dadasveti yo brūyādgavāgnibrāhmaṇeṣu vai \|*  
*tiryagyoniśataṃ gatvā cāṃḍā leṣvabhijāyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The destruction of the activities carried out for the purpose of the gods, the stealing of the riches of the Brahmanas, the wealth of the gods, usurping the cereals of a Brahmana which were earned by the Brahmana himself, implanting of semen in the womb of a barren woman, and the one who enjoys sex with her, those who prevent the giving away of the charities for a cow, fire to a Brahmana, are all reborn as birds a hundred times, and are then reborn in the house of a Candela.

## \|\| 1.184.43 \|\|

*yattu vācā pratijñātaṃ karmaṇā nopapāditam \|*  
*tadṛṇaṃ dharmasaṃyuktamiha loke paratra ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. A person who does not put into practice the words spoken by him, he shall have to be responsible for that debt in the present as well as the future life.

## \|\| 1.184.44 \|\|

*vedavidyāvratasnāte śrotriye gṛhamāgate \|*  
*krīḍaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. The gaining of the Vedic knowledge, performing of the vratas, the initiation in an order, besides with the arrival of a Shrotriya Brahmana, one feels that he is bound to achieve the excellent position.

## \|\| 1.184.45 \|\|

*madhu māṃsaṃ surāṃ somaṃ lākṣādyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*vikrīyānyatamaṃ teṣāṃ dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. A Brahmana who is engaged in the sale of anyone of the things like honey, meat, wine, Soma juice, wax etc., besides the salt, he could be purified with the performing of Chandrayana vrata.

## \|\| 1.184.46 \|\|

*guḍaṃ tilaṃ tathā nīlaṃ keśāngodhūmakānyavān \|*  
*vikrīya brāhmaṇo gāṃ ca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A Brahmana who is engaged in the sale of anyone of the things like sugarcane balls, sesamum, sapphire, hair, or the wheat or barley flour, can gain purity with the performing of the Santapana vrata.

## \|\| 1.184.47 \|\|

*auṣṭramāvikadugdhaṃ ca annaṃ mṛtakasūtake \|*  
*caurasyānnaṃ mṛtaśrāddhe bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. A Brahmana who consumes the milk of a camel, sheep, the food of the dead person, stolen food and taking of the food at the thirteenth day Shraddha of a dead person, should perform the Chandrayana vrata.

## \|\| 1.184.48 \|\|

*gavāṃ śṛṃgodake snāto mahānadyāśca saṃgame \|*  
*samudradarśanādvāpi śunā daṣṭaḥ śucirbhavet \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. In case of getting a dog bite, one can be purified by having a bath with the water purified with the horns of the cows or at the confluence of two great rivers or at the sight of the water of the ocean.

## \|\| 1.184.49 \|\|

*vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ śunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga \|*  
*hiraṇyodakamiśraṃ tu ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. O bird, when a Brahmana, well-versed in the Vedas is bitten by a dog, he is purified with the taking of water mixed with ghi in a golden vase.

## \|\| 1.184.50 \|\|

*tiṣṭhanvāpyatha vā gacchañchunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga \|*  
*vajraṃ prāśya śuciḥ syādvai yathāha bhagavānmanuḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. When a person is bitten by a dog while seated or walking, he gets purified with the touch of vajra. This has been ordained by lord Manu.

## \|\| 1.184.51 \|\|

*vratinaścāpi daṣṭasya trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*saghṛtaṃ ca tato bhuktvā vrataśeṣaṃ samācaret \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. When a person performing the vrata, is bitten by a dog, he should consume ghi alone for three nights and the vrata should be concluded thereafter.

## \|\| 1.184.52-55 \|\|

*brāhmaṇī tu śunā daṣṭā some dṛṣṭaṃ samācaret \|*  
*yadā na dṛśyate somaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet \|\| 52 \|\|*

*yāṃ diśaṃ vrajate somastāṃ diśaṃ cāvalokayet \|*  
*somamārgeṇa sā pūrvā pañcapūtena śudhyati \|\| 53 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇasya brahmadvāre pūya śoṇitasaṃbhave \|*  
*krimibhirdaśyate yaśca niṣkṛtiṃ tasya vacmi te \|\| 54 \|\|*

*gavāṃ tatra purīṣeṇa trikālaṃ snānamācaret \|*  
*dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā kṛmidaṣṭo viśudhyati \|\| 55 \|\|*

52-55. When a Brahmana woman is bitten by a dog, she gets purified at the sight of the moon. In case, the sight of the moon is not possible, then she should have a look into the direction in which the moon moves. This surely purifies her. In case, the worms emerging out of the blood and puss of a Brahmana bite another Brahmana, then the way by which the Brahmana (bitten by the worms) gets relieved from the same, is going to be spoken by me. He should take a bath with water mixed with the cowdung. Besides this, he should consume milk, curd and ghi. All these combined purify him.

## \|\| 1.184.56 \|\|

*atha nābhyāḥ pradaṣṭasya āpādādvinatātmaja \|*  
*etadvinirdiśetprājñaḥ prāyaścittaṃ khagādhipa \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O son of Vinata, when a person is bitten in the portion from feet to the navel by an insect, the learned people have spoken the above remedy for the same.

## \|\| 1.184.57 \|\|

*nābhikaṇṭhāṃtare vīra yadā cotpadyate kṛmiḥ \|*  
*ṣaḍrātraṃ tu tadā proktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. In case, the worms develop an infection in the human body from navel to the neck, the learned people have prescribed repentance for the same for six nights.

## \|\| 1.184.58-59 \|\|

*yadā daśaṃti śirasi kṛmayo vinatātmaja \|*  
*kṛcchraṃ tadā caretprājñaḥ śuddhaye kaśyapātmaja \|\| 58 \|\|*

*mṛtānnaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca yastu bhuñjīta brāhmaṇaḥ \|*  
*sa trīṇyahānyupavasedekāhaṃ codake vaset \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. In case, the worms develop infection in the head, then O son of Kashyapa, the Kricchra vrata is said to be the remedy for the same. He should fast without food for three days and he should consume water for a day during the said vrata.

## Chapter 185. Performing of Shraddha of a mother

## \|\| 1.185.1 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kurvīta rākṣasī kīrtitā hi sā \|*  
*sandhyayorubhayorvīra sūrye caiva tirohite \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Aditya said — The Shraddha should not be performed during the night, which has been described to be the Rakshasi one. The Shraddha should also not be performed during the Sandhyas in the morning as well as in the evening.

## \|\| 1.185.2 \|\|

*akṛtvā mātṛyajñaṃ tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet \|*  
*tātasya krodhasaṃyuktāṃ hiṃsāmicchaṃti dāruṇām \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. One who performs the Shraddha of the father without performing the Shraddha of the mother, he actually perform a terrific murder.

## \|\| 1.185.3 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*mātṛśrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ kāśca tā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*nāṃdīmukhāśca pitaraḥ kathaṃ pūjāmavāpnuyuḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Aruna said — How is the mother Shraddha performed? Who are the mothers? How do the Nandimukha manes receive the related worship?

## \|\| 1.185.4 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*hanta te sampravakṣyāmi mātṛśrāddhavidhiṃ khaga \|*  
*śṛṇu tvaṃ khagaśārdūla gadato mama kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Aditya said — I am going to speak out the process of performing of the Matri-shraddha in considerable details. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.185.5-9 \|\|

*pūrvāhṇe bhojayedviprānaṣṭau sarvānpradakṣiṇān \|*  
*tathānyaṃ navamaṃ vipraṃ caturaśca khagādhipa \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ṛjūnvai kṛtapāndattvā satyena vidhivatkhaga \|*  
*kṛtvā yavaistilārthaṃ tu dadhimiśraṃ krameṇa ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryādviprapradakṣiṇam \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyastato dadyānmadhuraṃ bhojanaṃ khaga \|\| 7 \|\|*

*guḍamiśraṃ khagaśreṣṭha savastramodanaṃ param \|*  
*rasānāṃ modakāṃścaiva na ca tānkaṭukāṃstathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*evaṃ bhukteṣu vipreṣu dadyātpiṃḍā nsamāhitaḥ \|*  
*dadhyakṣatavimiśrāṃstu badaraiśca khagādhipa \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. A person should serve food to eight Brahmanas in the forenoon, together with a ninth Brahmana. Then placing the kusha grass, he should invoke each one of them offering barley, sesamum mixed with curd, fragrance besides flowers etc. They should be worshipped and the Brahmanas should then be served with sweet and delicious food. The food should include the boiled rice mixed with sugarcane cakes, the delicious sweet balls and other items, which should have the least bitterness. Thus, after serving food to the Brahmanas, the rite of pinda-dana comprising of curd, unbroken rice and jujube besides other fruits, should be performed.

## \|\| 1.185.10-15 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu maṃḍapaṃ vīra caturasraṃ pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*pūrvāgrāṃśca kuśāndattvā puṣpāṇāṃ prakaraṃ tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*savyena pāṇinā vīra vidhivatkhagasattama \|*  
*mātre pramātre tanmātre nirvapetpūrvatomukhaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*piturmātre tu tanmātre nirvapedvidhiva tkhaga \|*  
*vṛddhāyai prapitāmahyai tathānyaṃ nirvapedbudhaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*evamuddiśya vai mātṝḥ ṣaṭ piṃḍānnirvapetkhaga \|*  
*aṣṭāśayeddvijānvīra mātṛśrāddhe khagā dhipa \|*  
*navamaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhojayedvidhivatkhaga \|\| 13 \|\|*

*nāṃdīmukhāṃstānuddiśya pitṝnpaṃca dvijottamān \|*  
*bhojayedvidhicchrāddhe vṛddhiśrāddhe pradakṣiṇam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*itthaṃ śrāddhadvayaṃ kuyādvṛddhau kaśyapanaṃdana \|*  
*tathānyamapi te vacmi paraṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ tava \|\| 15 \|\|*

10-15. Firstly, a square mandapa should be prepared and then kusha grass should be placed over a pedestal in the centre of it. It should be decorated with the flowers. All the rites should be performed appropriately placing the sacred thread over the right shoulder and the right hand. Thereafter, O bird, the pinda-dana should be offered in favour of the mother, grandmother, grandfather, great grandmother, great grandfather, mother’s great grandfather, and mother’s great great grandfather. Thus, six pindas should be offered for the mother’s side. In the matri-Shraddha eight Brahmanas should be served with food. Then, five Brahmanas should be served food for the Nandi-mukha Shraddha according to the provision of the Vriddhi-Shraddha. O son of Kashyapa, the Vriddhi-Shraddha is of two types. The process of performing of other Shraddhas is also being spelt out by me.

## \|\| 1.185.16 \|\|

*athaivaṃ bhojayecchrāddhe tatpūrvaṃ tu pravartayet \|*  
*anyathā tatra luṃpaṃti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Similarly, serving of food to the Brahmanas is also in the performing of other Shraddhas as well, because the Shraddha starts only after serving of the food to the Brahmanas. In case it is not done, then all the activities relating to the gods, asuras as well as the humans are faded out.

## \|\| 1.185.17-18 \|\|

*agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāvevopapādayet \|*  
*yo hyagniḥ sa dvijo vīnda maṃtradarśibhirucyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pūrva pātre yadannaṃ ca yaccānnamupakalpitam \|*  
*tenaiva saha bhoktavyaṃ pṛthagbhāvo na vidyate \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. In the absence of the fire, the offerings should be made in the hand of a Brahmana. This has been ordained by the people well — versed in the mantras. According to them, there is hardly any difference in fire and a Brahmana. The food which is initially placed in a vase, or whatever is received, one should consume the same and not separately.

## \|\| 1.185.19-20 \|\|

*dvau daive'tharvaṇau viprau prāṅmukhāvupaveśayet \|*  
*pitrye trīnudagāsyāṃśca vṛddhau cādhvaryusaṃgamān \|\| 19 \|\|*

*trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutupāstilāḥ \|*  
*trīṇi cātra praśaṃsaṃti śaucamakrodhamatvaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. In the Deva karmas, two Vedic Brahmanas should be served the food, making them face east. In the Pitris-karyas, three Brahmanas should be served the food, who should face north. In the Vriddhi-Shraddha, the Brahmanas who recite the Vedas, should be made to sit During the Shraddhas, the son of a daughter should take food in the eight muhurta of the day, besides the sesamum seeds are all considered to be auspicious. The purity, not to be angry and not to hurry are the three aspects, which have been considered to be praiseworthy.

## \|\| 1.185.21-24 \|\|

*dauhitraṃ khaṃḍamityuktaṃ lalāṭāya prajāpate \|*  
*tatra śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ taddauhitramiti smṛtam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*savyādaṃsātparibhraṣṭaṃ nābhideśe vyavasthitam \|*  
*ekavastraṃ tu taṃ vidyāddaive pitrye ca varjayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā \|*  
*nottarīyaṃ vinā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ syānniṣphalaṃ yataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*paridhānakṛte skaṃdhe gṛhastho yo'rcayetpitṝn \|*  
*na sa tatphalamāpnoti yathā yogapaṭāvṛtaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. O Prajapati, the son of a daughter has been considered to be the head of ornaments, besides the vase of Shringa. To be clad in a single cloth in the Deva or Pitri rites is prohibited. By wearing clothes and keeping half of the same over the shoulder, then it should fall at the waist. However, while performing the Deva and Pity rites as well as the human rites, as well as during consuming of the food, a single cloth is essential for puja, because in the absence of it, the performance of the rites becomes useless. By placing somehow the other part of the costume over the shoulder, when a person performs the pitri rites, he cannot enjoy the reward of the said deed, as the yogins do by binding a patta.

## \|\| 1.185.25 \|\|

*vanasthānāṃ khagaśreṣṭha yatīnāṃ ca mahāmate \|*  
*siddhaye karmaṇāṃ vīra yogapaṭṭakamucyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O best of the birds, all the Siddhas and Yogis dwelling in the forests, perform all Vedic rites by binding a patta only.

## \|\| 1.185.26 \|\|

*hastau prakṣālya gaṃḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibedavicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*sa tu daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca ātmānaṃ copaghā tayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A person who washing his hands, does not rinses the mouth with water in hand and drink it, all his karmas relating to the Devas, Pitris or the casual ones, get destroyed.

## \|\| 1.185.27 \|\|

*bhojaneṣveva tiṣṭhaṃti svasti kurvaṃti ye dvijāḥ \|*  
*āsuraṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. If a Brahmana, while taking food, utters the word Svasti, the reward of that particular Shraddha does not go to his Pitris, but is enjoyed by the Asuras getting diverted.

## \|\| 1.185.28 \|\|

*dātāro nobhivardhaṃtā vedāḥ saṃta tireva ca \|*  
*śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no'stviti \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. To the contrary, he should say let there be upliftment in my race of the donors, let there be increase in the study of the Vedas and the performing of the Vedic rites, let there be increase in the progeny, there should be no decline in your devotion and the riches in my house should go on increasing for the giving away of the charities.

## Chapter 186. The purification rites

## \|\| 1.186.1 \|\|

*bhāskara uvāca \|*  
*śrāvaṇyāṃ tu baliḥ kāryaḥ sarpāṇāṃ maṃtrapūrvakaḥ \|*  
*śayanārohaṇe caiva kārye sukhamabhīpsatā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bhaskara said — On the full moon day of Shravana, offering is made to the serpents, reciting the mantras, besides climbing with comfort as well as the sleeping. Both the tasks should be accomplished.

## \|\| 1.186.2-8 \|\|

*kāryaḥ pratyavarohastu mārgaśīrṣyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ vinā tvanuṣṭhānaṃ nityānāmiṣyate sphuṭam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kāmyānāṃ saphalārthaṃ tu doṣaprāptyarthameva ca \|*  
*naimittikānāṃ karaṇaṃ trividhaṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*phalaṃ kecidupāttasya duritasya pracakṣate \|*  
*anutpattiṃ tathā cānye pratyetyābhyupamaṃtrya ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*nityakriyaṃ tathā cānye anuṣaṃgātphalaṃ śrutiḥ \|*  
*agnyādheyaṃ tathā darśaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ dvitīyakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*cāturmāsyamagnihotraṃ paśubaṃdho nirūḍhakāḥ \|*  
*sautrāmaṇī saṃsthāḥ syurhaviṣaḥ śrutinoditāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*agniṣṭomo'tyagniṣṭoma ukthyaḥ saṃṣoḍaśī tathā \|*  
*vājapeyātirātraśca āpyoryāmaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dayā syātsarvabhūteṣu anasūyātha maṃgalam \|*  
*kṣāṃtirdayā tvanāyāsaḥ śaucamaspṛhatā vratam \|\| 8 \|\|*

2-8. Similarly, on the hill moon days of Margashirsha, the renascent task has to be accomplished. In the performing of the daily practices, one should not be seeking for the reward and for the successful achievement of one’s desires and for the removal of the blemish, the kamya-karma is started. For the performing of the casual deeds, three types of rewards are envisaged. Some people are of the opinion that the erasing of the rewards of sinful deeds has been interpreted as the reward gained. While others feel that the arrival of obstructions and their disappearing have to be achieved as the separate rewards. Some others, on the basis of the Shrutis feel that the receiving of the sudden reward is similar in the same way. Some people interpret the consecrating of the fire with the reciting of the Vedic mantras, performing of yajnas on the days of full moon and the moonless days, performing of Chaturmasa vrata, the homa in fire, the yajnas like Sautramani as well as Pashubandha yajna, performing of homa have been ordained by the Shrutis. Accordingly, the yajnas like Agnistoma, Ukthya, Shodashi Vajpeya, Atiratra, Apta and Yama are required to be performed according to the Shrutis. While performing these yajnas, the people have to be merciful on all, praise all and seek welfare for all. Peace, compassion and detachment are essential features for performing of a vrata.

## \|\| 1.186.9-12 \|\|

*samyaguktāstu saṃskārā brahmaprāptinimittakāḥ \|*  
*anaṃtaraṃ pravakṣyāmi viprāṇāṃ vṛttayaḥ śubhāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ṛtāmṛte ca viprāṇāmṛtaṃ pramṛtameva ca \|*  
*pratigrahavaṇijyādi śreyasī nottarottarā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ājīvikāvṛttayastu ityādyāḥ saṃpravartitāḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ kayāpi jīvettu anutiṣṭhedyathāvidhi \|\| 11 \|\|*

*nityaṃ śuciḥ sugaṃdhaśca snānaśīlaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ \|*  
*pūjyaśca pūjayeddevānkāryāṇi svayamācaret \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. With the intention of achieving of Brahman, all these Samskaras have been well defined. Thereafter, I am speaking about the auspicious livelihoods for the Brahmanas — though the Brahmanas are required to earn their livelihood by collecting each particle of gram from the fields (Rita), amrita (sought for charity), donation, or the business. These are the means prescribed for the livelihood of a Brahmana. Of the above means, the first one is praiseworthy, while the others are said to be unpraiseworthy. But in a given situation, he can earn his livelihood by any valid means, performing all the religious rites. A person performing the religious rites has to maintain purity, taking of bath with fragrant water, speaking soft words, getting adored by others and then himself worship the lord. He should perform puja himself.

## \|\| 1.186.13-14 \|\|

*nekṣetārkaṃ na nagnāṃ strīṃ na ca saṃspṛṣṭa maithunam \|*  
*nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā nāśucī rātritārakāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śāstroktā yaṃtraṇā yā tu nānuktāni vratāni ca \|*  
*svargārthaṃ sādhayettaiśca śaktimānmanasā tathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. He should not look at the naked woman, should not engage himself in the sex act, urinating in water or dropping refuse in it, impurity, not to look at the falling stars from the sky at night. The powerful person should firmly follow all the rules of scriptures and should with a firm resolve, perform all the vratas and should aspire to achieve the heaven.

## \|\| 1.186.15 \|\|

*nityāni kecidicchaṃti kāmyāni ca tathāpare \|*  
*kāmyāpravṛttau saṃge ca prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Some people perform the daily rites of routine nature regularly, while others do so with particular desires. Some repentances have been prescribed for not doing the kamya karmas or for getting attracted towards the same.

## \|\| 1.186.16 \|\|

*vratāni manasā tviṣṭasaṃkalpa iti mānasaḥ \|*  
*aṃtarānuphalaṃ yattadṛṣivādāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The mental resolve for the performing of the religious rites is known as the manasika samkalpa and while the karma is being done when a person suddenly takes another resolve, it is known as Rishi-vada (resolve of the ascetics).

## \|\| 1.186.17-19 \|\|

*anadhyāyaṃ svayaṃ samyagvarjayetphalasādhanam \|*  
*ātmā śuddhastathā deśo hyasuhāraḥ prajāpadaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*aśubhāni nimittāni utpāto vikṛtaṃ tathā \|*  
*parvāṇi manaso'śuddhiranadhyāya iti smṛtaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*anadhyāyāśca dṛṣṭārthā adṛṣṭārthāstathāpare \|*  
*vedādhyayanameveti tridhā maddhyānadarśanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. All types of vacation or interruptions should be discarded when a person himself is impure and even the entire country is impure. The death of the king or the inauspicious causes, disturbances, blemishes, days of festivities and when the mind is impure, are fee causes for interruptions. The visible and invisible obstructions and the study of the Vedas are said to be three types of dhyana — darshanas.

## \|\| 1.186.20 \|\|

*abhakṣyaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ śāvāśaucaṃ khagādhipa \|*  
*dravyaśuddhistathaiva syādanyathā tvasamaṃjasam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O foremost of the birds, it is essential to keep in mind the impurities caused by the death of a person in the family, because it envisages the purity of the padarthas and not otherwise.

## \|\| 1.186.21-22 \|\|

*jātiduṣṭaṃ kriyāduṣṭaṃ kāladuṣṭaṃ vibhūṣitam \|*  
*saṃsargāśrayaduṣṭaṃ ca sahṛllekhaṃ svabhāvataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*laśunaṃ gṛṃjanaṃ caiva palāṃḍuṃ kavakāni ca \|*  
*vārtākaṃ nālikeraṃ tu mūlakaṃ jātiduṣṭakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. The caste performance, time, connection, dependence and natural Sahrillekha should be particularly kept in mind. The garlic, onion, carrot, mushroom, egg-plant and radish, belong to the blemished species and therefore, should be discarded.

## \|\| 1.186.23-27 \|\|

*no bhuñjīta kriyāduṣṭaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca patitaiḥ pṛthak \|*  
*kāladuṣṭaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ hānidaṃ cirasaṃsthitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dadhibhakṣyavikārāśca madhuvarjyāstadiṣyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

*surālaśunasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ peyūṣādisamanvitam \|*  
*saṃsargaduṣṭametaddhi śunocchiṣṭaṃ khageśvara \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śūdrasaktaṃ khaṃḍasaktaṃ jñeyamāśrayadūṣitam \|*  
*vicikitsā tu hṛdaye bhakṣye yasmintsujāyate \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sahṛllekhaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ purīṣaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ \|*  
*rasaduṣṭe vikāro'pi rasasyeti pradarśitaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

23-27. Similarly, the things which are defiled by actions or blemished by the fallen people, are unfit for consumption. Besides the things which become stale due to keeping them for long, are also said to be unfit for consumption. By eating them, some special harms have been pointed out. As for example, the stuff made of curd (when kept for long) has to be discarded since its becomes defective. Even honey has to be discarded when it becomes defective. The mixture of wine and garlic has to be discarded as beverage. O lord of birds, similarly, the things tasted by the dogs have to be discarded. Such of the things which are divided and when touched by the Shudras, has also to be discarded. Such of the eatables about which a person develops a special feeling in his mind, to know fee facts about fee same, it is called Sahrillekha or doubtful. As for example, the Purisha-mantra or the refuse like mantra is never accepted. Because when it gets blemished, all fee stuff made out of it is also considered to be blemished.

## \|\| 1.186.28 \|\|

*pāyasaṃ kṣīrapākādi tasminneva dine tathā \|*  
*yathāśāstraṃ khagaśreṣṭha bhakṣyābhakṣye nirūpayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. As the payasam is good for the day on which it is made, thus I have defined the stuff which has been described as eatable and otherwise by fee scriptures.

## \|\| 1.186.29 \|\|

*prāṇātyaye prokṣitaṃ ca śrāddhe ca dvijakāmyayā \|*  
*pitṝndevāṃścārpayitvā bhuṃjanmāṃsaṃ na doṣabhāk \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. When a person is upset with hunger, when the life is going to depart or for the sake of yajna besides in Shraddha or after the oblation for the gods and the pitris, the consuming of the meat has not been prohibited.

## \|\| 1.186.30-32 \|\|

*pretāśuddhiḥ sapiṃḍānāṃ tasminneva mṛte sati \|*  
*daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā pakṣaṃ māsaṃ tvaśuddhatā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*daśāhāditrike bhāge varṇaśo na bhavaṃti hi \|*  
*daśāhena tu bhojyāḥ syuḥ sūtakāśaucayostathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ūrdhvaṃ daśāhādekāhaśravaṇe sati jāyate \|*  
*saṃvatsare vyatīte tu snānādeva viśudhyati \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. At the death of someone, the people of his family attract impurity of the death, which lasts for ten, twelve, a fortnight and a month respectively (for Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras). In the case of Dashaha’s (ten days after the death of a person), impurity does not attract people after ten days. Therefore, after the tenth day of the death or the birth of a child, the impurity in both the cases is removed. Therefore, the food could be served to the Brahmanas thereafter. When a person knows about the death of a person after the tenth day of the death, he still attracts the impurity for a day. However, in case one learns of the death of a person after a year, he if relieved of the impurity simply with the taking of a bath.

## \|\| 1.186.33-35 \|\|

*samānodakatā proktā janmanāmnoraparyaye \|*  
*sapiṃḍāḥ saptapuruṣāḥ śrutāvetannidarśanam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ā daṃtajanmanaḥ sadya ācūḍānnaiṣṭhikī smṛtā \|*  
*trirātramāvratādeśātsapiṃḍeṣu mṛteṣu ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*teṣāmapi tadekaṃ syādvayovasthāpyapekṣyate \|*  
*samānodakāttrirātreṇa śudhyedvai mṛtyujanmanoḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. In a family, the similarity of water and the name is believed. The pindas are offered upto the seventh generation. This has been ordained in the Vedas (Shrrutis). In Sapinda (or the same gotra), before the initiation and in the impurity of death, one gets purified by taking a bath. During the first year after the tonsure ceremony and before the thread ceremony, the impurity for three nights lasts. In case of collateral birth and death, the impurity lasts for the period of three nights.

## \|\| 1.186.36 \|\|

*garbhasrāve trirātreṇa udakyā śudhyate tathā \|*  
*anaṃtajanma maraṇe taccheṣeṇa viśudhyati \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. During abortion, the woman attracts impurity for three nights. The lady then is purified with water. In case of the birth and death of several people, the earlier impurity also gets purified.

## \|\| 1.186.37-38 \|\|

*dvijānāṃ tvevameva syātpitrarthaṃ mātureva vā \|*  
*agnihotrārthaṃ vijñeyaṃ sadyaḥ śaucamiti sthitiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*asapiṃḍe tu nirhārāttrirātramapi mānavaḥ \|*  
*tasyaivānugatau jñeyaṃ sadyaḥ śaucaṃ khagādhipa \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Thus, impurity has been prescribed for the Brahmanas relating to their parents. A person who performs homa, is purified with the taking of a bath at the same time. When a death occurs in the same gotra, one gets immediately purified after a lapse of three nights.

## \|\| 1.186.39 \|\|

*śudhyeddvijo daśāhena janmahānau dviyoniṣu \|*  
*ṣaṅbhistribhirahai kena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. In the birth as well as the death impurities, a Brahman a gets purified on the tenth day. A Kshatriya is purified on the twelfth day, a Vaishya on the fifteenth day and a Shudra gets purified after a month.

## \|\| 1.186.40-53 \|\|

*uktaśaucaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śārīraṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ \|*  
*dravyaśuddhividhānaṃ tu yathāvadabhidhīyate \|\| 40 \|\|*

*taijasī mārtikī vīra vāriśuddhiḥ smṛtā tathā \|*  
*nirlepakṣālanenaiva sparśe tu prokṣaṇena vai \|\| 41 \|\|*

*aśuddhaṃ naiva kiṃciddhi dravyamastīti khecara \|*  
*vacanācchuddhyaśuddhī tu dravyāṇāmiha khecara \|\| 42 \|\|*

*snānaṃ śaucaṃ ca kartavyaṃ dravyaśaucādanaṃtaram \|*  
*prātaḥsnānaṃ tu nityaṃ syādgrahaṇe kāmyameva ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*naimittikaṃ kṣurāśaucaṃ tena pāpādviśudhyati \|*  
*uktaṃ tu śaucaṃ vijñeyaṃ doṣakṣayakaraṃ khaga \|\| 44 \|\|*

*karmāṃgaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ ṣaṭprakārā samāsataḥ \|*  
*evamācamanaṃ vidyādviśiṣṭaṃ tu dvijanmanām \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tadā mṛtānāṃ tadvatsyādanyeṣāṃ tu yathāsukham \|*  
*kanyānivṛttiṃ putraistu yathānyāyaṃ samācaret \|\| 46 \|\|*

*kalāśilpānisarvāṇi gṛhrīyātparituṣṭaye \|\| 47 \|\|*

*śuśrūṣeta patiṃ bhāryā paritoṣaṃ yathā vrajet \|*  
*gurūṇāṃ paritoṣaśca dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ sanātanaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*vṛddhā'putrā yadi mṛtā tadabhāve nṛpasya tu \|*  
*mṛtāpatyāpyagarbhā ca vṛddhāpatyā pativratā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kuryādanirvṛtaṃ bharturgate sannihitepi vā \|*  
*etāṃ dharma samāṃ niṣṭhāṃ bhartṛlokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 50 \|\|*

*strī dharmacāriṇī sādhvī mṛtā dāhyā tathāgnibhiḥ \|*  
*viparītādadāhyā tu punardārakriyā tathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*strīṇāṃ niyogo vihito maraṇādbrahmacārakam \|*  
*prāptavyaśca yathādharmo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tasmāddharmaṃ sadā kuryātkurvatī svargamāpnuyāt \|\| 53 \|\|*

40-53. Therefore, the people who are well-versed in the tattvas, their process of purity has been defined O valorous person, a figure made of clay is purified with water, though it should not be washed in water. Rather the water should be sprinkled over it with the kusha grass. O flier of the sky, ordinarily, no stuff is impure. The things are purified or unpurified by words alone. Even with the purification of a substance, the bath and purity are essential. In the kamya and other rites, there should be daily bath. In the casual rite, the purity is done with a knife. O bird! Thus, I have explained unblemished purities. The karmangas are of six types. Similarly, the sipping of the water has also been explained and particularly for the Brahmanas. Similar process has to be adopted during the death. For other rites, there are distinct rules. The sons should judiciously marry the girls. The women should be learned in all the fields of arts, industry and all other professions. It is also desirable for the women to serve their husbands as per their desires. This is the eternal dharma. In case, a childless woman meets with the death of her husband, it would be better otherwise that she should serve the king. Similarly, one who produces dead children or the one who is barren, such a chaste woman should try to remove the blemish irrespective of whether the husband stays with her or not. Because of her religious inclinations, she achieves the abode of the husband. The body of the chaste woman after her death, should be consigned to flames. But in case it is otherwise, the burning of the body is not necessary. For a woman, instead of putting an end to her life or maintaining celibacy, it would be better to perform niyoga (sexual intercourse with the younger brother of her husband), because by so doing, the visible as well as the invisible rewards are achieved. Therefore, a woman should always follow dharma, to enable herself to achieve the heaven.

## Chapter 187. The Solar Dharma

## \|\| 1.187.1-7 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*kāni puṇyāni kṛtveha svargaṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ \|*  
*manuṣyaloke saṃbhūtāḥ svarloke gāminaḥ param \|\| 1 \|\|*

*karmayajñastapoyajñaḥ svādhyāyo dhyānanirmitaḥ \|*  
*jñānayajñaśca paṃcaite mahāyajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*eteṣāmeva yajñānāmuttamaḥ katamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*etadyajñaphalānāṃ ca kiṃ phalaṃ kā gatirbhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dharmādharmaprabhedāśca kiyantaḥ parikīrtitāḥ \|*  
*tatsādhanāni katidhā gatayaśca yathā vada \|\| 4 \|\|*

*khaga nārakiṇāṃ puṃsāmāgatānāṃ punaḥ kṣitau \|*  
*kāni cihnāni jāyante muktaśeṣeṇa karmaṇā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mahābhavārṇavādghorāddharmādharmābhisaṃkulāt \|*  
*garbhādiduḥkhaphenāḍhyānmucyaṃte dehinaḥ katham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ samāsavyāsayogataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Aruna said — In the world of humans, those humans who are reborn after proceeding on to the heaven, by what auspicious deeds do they achieve the heaven? The fire Mahayajnas viz., karma-yajna, tapo-yajna, dhyana-yajna and jnana-yajna are quite well known, which one of these yajnas is treated to be the best and by performing the same, what type of position is achieved by a person? What are the divisions of dharma and adharma? What is the number of their means? By performing them, what type of reward is achieved? O bird, the sinful persons, after facing the painful situations in the hell, are reborn on earth. What types of births and which types of symptoms are achieved by them due to their remaining deeds? How do they get themselves freed from the terrific ocean of the universe where there are miseries, dharma and adharma, besides those birth forms which resemble the confused form? How does such a person is relieved? When he thus asked with all humility, the immensely resplendent lord Bhaskara, speaking broadly as well in brief, started speaking in order to answer all the questions.

## \|\| 1.187.8 \|\|

*āditya uvāca \|*  
*svargāpavargaphaladaṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam \|*  
*dharmaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu śūra prabhāṣataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Aditya said — O valorous one, I am going to talk about the dharma by following which one achieves the heaven as well moksha, redemption from the ocean of hell, destruction of sins and the virtues are achieved.

## \|\| 1.187.9 \|\|

*śraddhāpūrvaḥ sadā dharmaḥ śraddhāmadhyāṃtasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*śraddhāniṣṭhapratiṣṭhaśca dharmaḥ śraddhā prakīrtitā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the beginning, middle and the end of dharma, the faith and devotion are lodged, because the faith is the alternative name of dharma.

## \|\| 1.187.10 \|\|

*śrutimaṃtrarasāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ \|*  
*śraddhāmātreṇa gṛhyaṃte na pareṇa ca cakṣuṣā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The mantra-rasa of the subtle Shrutis and the supreme Purusheshvara can be achieved only by the faith and not by the subtle eyes.

## \|\| 1.187.11 \|\|

*kāyakleśairna bahubhirna caivārthasya rāśibhiḥ \|*  
*dharmaḥ saṃprāpyate sūkṣmaḥ śraddhāhīnaiḥ surairapi \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The gods too without faith, cannot achieve the subtle dharma even by spending enormous wealth, facing enormous physical pain.

## \|\| 1.187.12-13 \|\|

*śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā yajñāhutaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*śraddhā mokṣaśca svargaśca śraddhā sarvamidaṃ jagat \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sarvasvaṃ jīvitaṃ vāpi dadyādaśraddhayā ca yaḥ \|*  
*nāpnuyātsa phalaṃ kiṃcittasmācchraddhāparo bhavet \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The faith infact is subtle and the best of all dharmas, including the offering of the yajna, tapas, moksha as well as the heaven. Therefore, the world has the form of faith. Even when a person without faith sacrifices his life, but even by so doing he is not to achieve any good result. Therefore, one should always try to be faithful or develop faith.

## \|\| 1.187.14 \|\|

*evaṃ śraddhāmayāḥ sarve mama dharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*pūjyastu śraddhayā puṃsā dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca śraddhayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. All my dharmas are inclined towards faith. Therefore, a person, developing faith in his mind, should worship dharma (or myself) besides performing meditation.

## \|\| 1.187.15 \|\|

*adhikārasya prāptyarthaṃ mahāsāravimuktidam \|*  
*ajñāduktaṃ sasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametanmamādbhutam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The words of mine, which appear to you to have been spoken by an ignorant person besides being doubtful, but they are meant to procure the right for you besides redeeming you from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.187.16 \|\|

*nānāsiddhikaraṃ divyaṃ lokacittānuraṃjanam \|*  
*suniścitārthagaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ mama manoramam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. This is the medicine for the ailing person, and bestows moksha who are desirous for the same. It is siddha in itself and fulfills all the desires.

## \|\| 1.187.17 \|\|

*manmānasasamudro hi dvipadoyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*sa khaṣolketi vikhyātaḥ saśivaṃ maṃḍalaṃ khaga \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. These words, which bestow various types of success, attract the mind of the divine place. They carry the deep meaning and are the decent sentences which have been spoken by me.

## \|\| 1.187.18 \|\|

*devatrayaguṇātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvavitprabhuḥ \|*  
*omityekākṣare maṃtre sthitaḥ sa paramo mama \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. My welfare masala known as khasholka is the form of my ocean like mind. This is what the people with wisdom say.

## \|\| 1.187.19 \|\|

*yathānādipravṛttoyaṃ ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ \|*  
*khaṣolkopi tathānādiḥ saṃsārārṇavaśodhanaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He happens to be my most excellent Deva, who is devoid of trigunas, omniscient, all knowledgeable besides being form of the lord. It always resides in the mantra with Om.

## \|\| 1.187.20 \|\|

*vyādhīnāṃ bheṣajaṃ yadvatpra tipakṣasvabhāvataḥ \|*  
*mokṣiṇāṃ muktihetuśca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. This khasholka relieves one from the ocean of the universe in which a person remains involved from the time immemorial.

## \|\| 1.187.21 \|\|

*mamābhidhānamantroyamabhidheyaḥ sadā smṛtaḥ \|*  
*abhidhānābhidheyohaṃ mantrasiddho'smi khecara \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O mover in the sky, this is the mantra of my name and is fit to be recited for all the people for all the times to come. I happen to be the name, the mantra and the deity to be adored.

## \|\| 1.187.22 \|\|

*vedo manogame cātra ṣaḍakṣaramaṃtrasthitaḥ \|*  
*yadvā mukto'kṣaraikena loke pañcākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. This six lettered mantra is to be recited by mind and is found in the Vedas. A person is freed from the worldly bondages with the reciting of a single letter of this mantra. On the other hand, the mantra has five letters, viz. Om Khasholka.

## \|\| 1.187.23 \|\|

*kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ śāstrairvā bahuvistaraiḥ \|*  
*yasyoṃ namaḥ khaṣolketi mantro'yaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A person in whose mind the mantra — om Namah Khasholkaya is firmly planted, for him there is no need for other mantras and huge scriptures.

## \|\| 1.187.24 \|\|

*tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam \|*  
*yenoṃ namaḥ khaṣolketi mama vākyaṃ ṣaḍakṣaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A person who has patronized the mantra — Namah Khasholka comprising of six letters, he has completed all the studies and has also performed the excellent rites.

## \|\| 1.187.25 \|\|

*vidhivākyamidaṃ sarvaṃ nārthavādaṃ vaco mama \|*  
*etatte vakṣyate'śeṣaṃ mama vākyārthamuttamam \|*  
*pṛcchasvemaṃ praṇamyāśu vainateya mahāmate \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O son of Vinata, O intelligent one, these words spoken by me are eternal and for the sake of the praise. You ask them, who would narrate everything to you about me.

## \|\| 1.187.26 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhānorvainateyo mahābalaḥ \|*  
*saptāśvatilakaṃ bhaktyā praṇamyovāca bhārata \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Sumantu said — O Bharata, on hearing the words of the Sungod, the valorous Aruna offered his salutation to Saptashvatilaka with devotion and asked him.

## \|\| 1.187.27 \|\|

*anūruruvāca \|*  
*brūhi māṃ devaśārdūla yatpṛcchāmi mahāmate \|*  
*kīdṛgvākyamidaṃ bhānorvākyārthaṃ brūhi ca prabho \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Aruna said — O lion among the gods, whatever is asked by me, you kindly clarify the same. You also please reveal the meanings of the words of Surya.

## \|\| 1.187.28 \|\|

*saptāśvatilaka uvāca \|*  
*vimuktāśeṣadoṣeṇa sarvajñena bhagena yat \|*  
*praṇītamamalaṃ vākyaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Saptashvatilaka said — The (words that the) extremely unblemished Sungod who is the omniscient one, has used, they are pure and authentic. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.187.29 \|\|

*yasmānmārtaṃḍa nāmāsau kathyate ca manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*yathārthaṃ puṇyamāpnoti patatyaśraddhayā tvadhaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The people with wisdom, developing faith in him, adore him by the name of Martanda. It is they alone, who earn the merits in reality. Similarly, the people having no faith have to fall.

## \|\| 1.187.30 \|\|

*sauravākyapravaktāraṃ sūravatpūjayedgurum \|*  
*saṃsārārṇava nirmagnaṃ yaḥ samuddharate janam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The preceptor who repeats the words of the Sungod should be worshipped like the Sungod himself. Because it is he, by whom the redemption of a person plunging in the ocean of the universe, has been ordained.

## \|\| 1.187.31 \|\|

*sauradharmāmbuhastena kastena sadṛśo guruḥ \|*  
*ajñānavahnisaṃtaptaṃ nirvāpayati yaḥ śanaiḥ \|*  
*jñānāmṛtena vai bhaktā kastaṃ na pratipūjayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. When the water of the solar dharma is held in a palm, there could be no other preceptor comparable with him, who slowly extinguishes the fire flames of ignorance with the use of the nectar like knowledge. Therefore, who would not honour him?

## \|\| 1.187.32 \|\|

*naiva rājyena mahatā na caivārthasya rāśibhiḥ \|*  
*prāptamajñānaśamanaṃ paraloke sukhāvaham \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Therefore, with the huge empire at one’s disposal together with enormous treasure, the knowledge in the other world besides the comforts cannot be achieved.

## \|\| 1.187.33 \|\|

*svargāpavarga siddhyarthaṃ bhāṣitaṃ yattu śobhanam \|*  
*vākyaṃ te devadevena tadvijñeyaṃ subhāṣitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The beautiful words with which the Sungod has addressed, they are extremely beautiful and the bestower of salvation.

## \|\| 1.187.34 \|\|

*rāgadveṣākṣamākrodhakāmatṛṣṇānusāriṇām \|*  
*vākyaṃ niraya hetutvāttaddurbhāṣitamucyate \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The people with attraction, envy, not to forgive, anger, desire and greed, drive them towards the hell. Therefore, they are termed speakers of foul words.

## \|\| 1.187.35 \|\|

*saṃskṛtenāpi kiṃ tena mṛdulālāpasaṃginā \|*  
*avidyārāmavākyena saṃsārakleśahetunā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The use of the polished words which are full of softness, would be of no use for the people wandering in the garden of ignorance which causes pain and sufferings to the people. Of what use would they be?

## \|\| 1.187.36 \|\|

*yacchrutvā jāyate puṇyaṃ rāgādīnāṃ ca saṃkṣayaḥ \|*  
*virūpamapi tadvākyaṃ vijñeyamatiśobhanam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The words with the hearing of which one earns merits and the blemishes like lust and envy disappear, such a speech should be treated as beautiful.

## \|\| 1.187.37 \|\|

*smṛtayo bhārataṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi sumahāṃti ca \|*  
*svāyuṣaḥ kṣapaṇāyaiva dhamo'rthasamagranthitaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Therefore, the Smritis, the Mahabharata, the Vedas and the other difficult scriptures getting complicated with the knots of interpretations, are apparently meant for the reducing of the age for the sake of dharma.

## \|\| 1.187.38-39 \|\|

*putradārādisaṃsāre narāṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām \|*  
*saṃsāraviduṣāṃ śāstramanādi mukhanirgatam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*idaṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ jñātumicchasi \|*  
*api varṣasahasrāyuḥ śāstrāntaṃ nādhigacchati \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The people with ignorant minds, accompanied with their sons and wives who are considered as wise in the world, the Shastras emerging from their mouths are claimed to be eternal, being excellent. This is quite essential for you to know. By so doing, the age of thousands of years vanishes, still a person does not become well-versed in the scriptures.

## \|\| 1.187.40-41 \|\|

*vijñāyākṣaratanmātraṃ jīvitaṃ cātivaṃcanam \|*  
*vihāya sarvaśāstrāṇi paralokaṃ samācaret \|\| 40 \|\|*

*paṇḍitenāpi kiṃ tena samarthena ca dehinām \|*  
*yaḥ puṇyabhāramudvoḍhumaśaktaḥ pāralaukikam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. By the study of a letter of the Shastras amounts to the waste of life. Thus thinking, discarding it, some other means of the merits for Paraloka should be adopted. A learned Brahmana, who ins pile of being quite capable, is unable to make the cam merits for the next world, would be of no consequence.

## \|\| 1.187.42 \|\|

*paṇḍito'pi sa mūrkhaḥ syācchaktiyukto'pyaśaktikaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ saurajñānamāhātmyamuccārayitumakṣamaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Such a person should be treated as a fool inspite of his being a learned one, displays his weakness in such a way that “I am unable to highlight the glory of the solar dharma.”

## \|\| 1.187.43 \|\|

*tasmātsa paṃḍitaḥ śaktaḥ sa tapasvī jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ saurajñānasadbhāvamālocayitumudyataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Therefore, only that learned Brahmana is the capable one besides being a tapasvi who having controlled his sense organs, is always ready to reveal the secrets of the solar dharma.

## \|\| 1.187.44-45 \|\|

*yaḥ pradadyānnṛpaḥ kṛtsnāṃ kṣmāṃ dhanaṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā \|*  
*sarvamanyāyataḥ pṛchenna tasyopadiśedguruḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*yaḥ śṛṇoti raverdharmaṃ nyāyataḥ sa ca vakti ca \|*  
*tato gacchati susthānaṃ narakaṃ tadviparyaye \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. The preceptor should also advise the king who should distribute his land, gold and riches in an unfair manner. Those who listen to the solar dharma and use judicious words, they achieve a nice place (heaven). Those who act to the contrary, head for the hell.

## \|\| 1.187.46 \|\|

*dattagodohasaṃbhūtaḥ ṣaḍakṣaravidhānataḥ \|*  
*raviḥ saṃpūjitaḥ śīghraṃ narāṇāṃ tulyatā bhṛśam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. With the worship of the Sungod appropriately and reciting the six-lettered mantra, the performer shines like the Sun.

## \|\| 1.187.47 \|\|

*surāsurairmathyamānātkṣīrodātsāgarātpurā \|*  
*pañca gāvaḥ samutpannāḥ sarvalo kasya mātaraḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. In earlier times, the demons and gods churned the ocean of milk collectively. From there emerged the five cows, which are treated to be the mother of the universe.

## \|\| 1.187.48 \|\|

*naṃdā subhadrā surabhī sumanā śobhanāvatī \|*  
*gāvaḥ sūryasamā bhāsā utpannāḥ kṛtimāgatāḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. They were known by the names of Nanda, Surabhi, Sumana, Subhadra and Shobhanavati. The cows with these five names gained the lustre of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.187.49 \|\|

*sarvalokopakārārthaṃ devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca \|*  
*māmāśritya sthitā gāvaḥ snānārthaṃ bhāskarasya tu \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. For doing good to all the lokas and for the satisfaction of the gods, besides for the bathing of Bhaskara, these cows were kept by me.

## \|\| 1.187.50 \|\|

*tāsāmaṃgāni puṇyāni ṣaḍrasāḥ khagasattama \|*  
*khagādiṣu ca sarveṣu sthirāṇītyupadhāraya \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The six rasas of their limbs are present in all the living beings, including the birds.

## \|\| 1.187.51 \|\|

*gomayaṃ rocanaṃ mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ gavām \|*  
*ṣaḍaṃgāni pavitrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The cowdung, gorochana, cow’s urine, milk, curd and ghi are the six limbs of the cows which bestow all the success.

## \|\| 1.187.52 \|\|

*gomayādutthitaḥ śrīmānbilvavṛkṣo'rkavallabhaḥ \|*  
*tatrāste padmahastā śrīrvṛkṣastena ca sa smṛtaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. The wood apple tree has emerged out of gomaya which has all the wealth and is dear to the Sungod. The lotus carrying Lakshmi resides in the same tree. Because of the same, the tree is always remembered.

## \|\| 1.187.53 \|\|

*paṃkānyutpalapadmāni punarjātāni gomayāt \|*  
*gorocanaṃ ca maṃgalya pavitraṃ sarvakāmadam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Again, with the same cowdung, the blue and red lotus flowers emerged out of it. Then there is gorochana (yellow pigment vomited by a cow) which also is quite auspicious and fulfills all the desires.

## \|\| 1.187.54 \|\|

*gomūtrādguggulurjātaḥ sugaṃdhiḥ priyadarśanaḥ \|*  
*āhāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhāskarasya viśeṣataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The guggulu gum emerged out of the cow’s urine which is fragrant and charming and is consumed by Bhaskara and all other gods.

## \|\| 1.187.55 \|\|

*yadbījaṃ jagataḥ kiṃcittajjñeyaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam \|*  
*dadhnaḥ sarvāṇi jātāni māṃgalyānyarthasiddhaye \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Whatever is there in the form of a seed on earth, is the product of the milk. For the success in finances, all the welfare things have emerged out of the curd.

## \|\| 1.187.56-57 \|\|

*ghṛtādamṛtamutpannamamarāṇāmatipriyam \|*  
*tasmāddhṛtena payasā dadhnā yaḥ snāpayedravim \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tadaṃte coṣṇatoyena kaṣāyaiśca nirūpayet \|*  
*snāpya śītāṃbunā paścādbhānuṃ rocanayālabhet \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The nectar emerged out of the ghi which is the favourite of the gods. Therefore, the image of the Sungod should first be washed with ghi; milk and curd and then with the hot water. Thereafter, it should be washed with cold water and then it should be plastered with gorochana (yellow pigment).

## \|\| 1.187.58-59 \|\|

*pūjayedbilvapatraiśca padmairnīlotpalaistathā \|*  
*arghyaṃ dadyāttataḥ paścātsavajraṃ guggulaṃ khaga \|\| 58 \|\|*

*pāyasaṃ dadhibhaktaṃ ca vajraṃ ca madhunā saha \|*  
*nivedayecca sadbhaktyā bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Besides that, the wood apple leaves and blue lotus should be used in offering arghya to him. Thereafter, guggulu should be offered. In this way, the best of the eatables with milk and curd mixed with honey, together with honey should be offered to the Sungod with devotion.

## \|\| 1.187.60-62 \|\|

*kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paścātpraṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā bhānuṃ ṣaḍaṃgena divaspatim \|\| 60 \|\|*

*iha loke pare caiva sarvānkāmānsa gacchati \|*  
*ṣaḍaṃgavidhinā taṃ cāpūjyaivaṃ sumanā ravim \|\| 61 \|\|*

*svargaṃ nayetsadhīmāṃstu kulānāmekaviṃśatim \|*  
*svarge sthāpya svayaṃ gacchejjyautiṣaṃ nāma tatpadam \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Thereafter, salutation should be offered by going round the image. Thereafter, one should ask for forgiveness with the six angas. A person who does so, all his worldly desires as well as those of the other world, become successful By worshipping the Sungod with six angas with a delightful mind, the intelligent person places his twenty one generations in the heaven and he himself achieves the place known as Jyotish.

## \|\| 1.187.63 \|\|

*aṃśena bhojakā vīra devakārye niyojitāḥ \|*  
*prayāṃti svāminā sārdhaṃ śrīmadbhānuṃ paraṃ mahaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Bhojakas are also said to have been born out of the amsha of the Sungod and were entrusted with the tasks of the gods. All of them roam about with their lord in the adorable lokas.

## \|\| 1.187.64 \|\|

*bhuktvā bhogāṃstu vipulānbhojako bhogasaṃmitaḥ \|*  
*kālātpunarihāyātaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. The Bhojakas after enjoying several types of pleasures, according to the wheel of the time, are reborn again becoming powerful kings on earth.

## \|\| 1.187.65 \|\|

*puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yadgataṃ bhāskarārcane \|*  
*saurā gāvaśca gacchaṃti sūryalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The flowers, leaves, fruits, water, the cows, besides whatever has been produced for the use in worship, are surely the cause for the achieving of the solar region.

## \|\| 1.187.66 \|\|

*yaḥ pibedbhojane dhenoradattā bhānave payaḥ \|*  
*sa gacchennarakaṃ ghoramakurvaṃstarpaṇaṃ raveḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. A person who drinks milk without offering food to the Sungod, he falls in the terrific hell, because he failed to satisfy the Sun.

## \|\| 1.187.67 \|\|

*ekakālaṃ pibetkṣīraṃ dhenūnāṃ bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*anena snāpayeddevaṃ kṣīreṇa khagasattama \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. O best of birds, the cow’s milk should be consumed once a day. Besides the image of the Sungod should also be washed with the same milk.

## \|\| 1.187.68 \|\|

*pratyūṣe yadbhavetkṣīraṃ dhenūnāṃ bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*snāpayettena vai bhānuṃ kṛtsnena garuḍāgraja \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. O older brother of Garuda, in the early morning, the image of the Sungod should be washed with the milk of the solar cones and it should then be consumed.

## \|\| 1.187.69-70 \|\|

*yastu loko bhajetsarva na devāya nivedayet \|*  
*yāvanto romakūpāśca gavāṃ dehe khagādhipa \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi narake pacyate khaga \|\| 69 \|\|*

*pūjitaṃ pūjyamānaṃ vā yaḥ kaścicchṛṇuyādravim \|*  
*śrutvānumodate yastu sa yajñaphalamaśnute \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. A person who drinks the milk without offering it to the Sungod, he has to remain in the hell for a number of years equivalent to the number of hair on the body of the cow, multiplied by a thousand. The worship performed by the Sungod or the worship to be performed for the Sungod, when a person supports the same, he earns merit for the performing of a yajna.

## \|\| 1.187.71 \|\|

*bhāskaraṃ pṛjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*harṣātpraṇamya vai bhānuṃ tasya loke mahīyate \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. After the performing of the pa\]a and by having a look at the Sungod, one is relieved of the sins. When a person delightfully offers his salutation to him, he is honoured in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.187.72 \|\|

*pūjyamānaṃ raviṃ bhaktyā yaḥ paśyenmānavaḥ khaga \|*  
*so'pi yajñaphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. By having a look at the Sungod with devotion, one achieves the merit of performing of all the yajnas. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.187.73 \|\|

*śrutvānumodate yastu pūjyamānaṃ divākaram \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ phalamāpnoti prasādādbhāskarasya tu \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. O Brahmana, even half part of the sesame seed is given with devotion, it fulfills all the desires of the giver.

## \|\| 1.187.74 \|\|

*ekajanmānugaṃ dānaṃ bhaktyā yacca niveditam \|*  
*japayajñādviyuktebhyaḥ sahasrabhavikaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*ābhūtasaṃplava sthāyi pradānaṃ japajīvinām \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. One who supports, after hearing the name of the Sungod, he also achieves all the rewards with the grace of Bhaskara.

## \|\| 1.187.75 \|\|

*atyalpamapi yaddattaṃ vācakāya khagādhipa \|*  
*tanmahāpralayaṃ yāvaddāturbhogāya kalpate \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. By offering him donations with devotion, one achieves the reward in an entire birth. A person without resorting to these, perform yajna and does some job for the Sungod (in his temple), he earns merit of performing upto the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 1.187.76 \|\|

*na dānamalpaṃ bahudhā kiṃcidasti vijānatām \|*  
*deśakālavidhiśraddhāpātrayuktaṃ tadakṣayam \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Even a small charity given to the reciter bestow the great reward upto the time of the dissolution.

## \|\| 1.187.77 \|\|

*pātre deśe ca kāle ca vidhinā śraddhayā ca yat \|*  
*dattaṃ hutaṃ kṛtaṃ caiva tadanaṃtaphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. No specific charities have been prescribed for the wise people. At the same time, the small charities given according to the country, time, procedure, faith and the receiver, becomes everlasting in some cases.

## \|\| 1.187.78 \|\|

*tilārdhamapi yadvīra dīyate śraddhayā dvija \|*  
*satpātre vidhivadbhaktyā tadbhavetsarvakāmikam \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. When the charities are given according to the country, time and procedure to him, the receiver bestows unlimited reward to the donor.

## \|\| 1.187.79 \|\|

*yatsnātaṃ jñānasalilaiḥ śīlabhasmapramārjitam snāna \|*  
*tatpātraṃ sarvapātrebhya uttamaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. With the washing of the Surya image by the water of knowledge, sprinkling of the ashes in the vases has been said to be the best in all respects.

## \|\| 1.187.80 \|\|

*japo damo yamaḥ puṃsāṃ trātā saṃsāgsāgarāt \|*  
*ajñānāṃ pāpanetrāṇāṃ tatpātraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The japam, controlling of the sense organs and self control are the three aspects which guard a person in the ocean of the universe. Therefore, for an ignorant and sinful person, (the aforesaid follower) of the riches has been described to be the excellent one.

## \|\| 1.187.81 \|\|

*jñānaplavena copetaṃ śāstraṃ pāpamahārṇavāt \|*  
*ajñānsaṃtārayennūnaṃ kiṃ śilā tārayecchilām \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The boat of knowledge with the scriptures save the ignorant sinners from the ocean of the universe, otherwise could it be possible to chisel the stone slab with a stone?

## \|\| 1.187.82 \|\|

*dvijānāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ kaṭisaṃbhogi yatphalam \|*  
*haṃtakārapradānena tatphalaṃ japajīvine \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. The merit one achieves when a costume is offered to Vedic scholar is far greater than the one earned by the performer of a yajna.

## \|\| 1.187.83 \|\|

*jīvo yasyaitya gṛhe ca bhuṅkte satkṛtisatkṛtaḥ \|*  
*kulamuttārayettasya narakārṇavasaṃsthitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. When a stranger consumes the food with respect on reaching the abode of a household, he redeems his entire household from falling into the ocean of hell.

## \|\| 1.187.84 \|\|

*yajñāgnihomatīrtheṣu yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*japināmannadānena tatsamagraṃ phala labhet \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. The merits one get with the performing of yajnas, Homa in fire and visiting the places of pilgrimage, all such merits are achieved by a person, who performs the yajna with japam.

## \|\| 1.187.85 \|\|

*bhojine śāṃtacittāya paridhyānaratāya ca \|*  
*śraddhayānnaṃ sakṛddattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. In case, the food with devotion is offered to Bhojaka with a peaceful mind and engaged in meditation, then the donor is relieved of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.187.86 \|\|

*japakāñchāṃtisaṃyuktānādityārpitacetasaḥ \|*  
*bhojayitvā sakṛdbhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. A Bhojaka who is peaceful and with his mind devoted to the Sungod when given the food, all the desires of the donor are fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.187.87 \|\|

*dhyāyamāno raveḥ sūktaṃ bhojayetsatataṃ ca yaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sākṣādanenaiva tadbhuktamaśana bhavet \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. A person who gives food to a person who remains devoted to the worship of the Sungod, he actually serves the food to the Sungod himself.

## \|\| 1.187.88 \|\|

*pitṝnudiśya yaḥ śrāddhe bhojayedbhojakaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sa sthānaṃ samavāpnoti bhānavīyamasaṃśayaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. The one who in order to please the manes, serves food to the Bhojakas, he undoubtedly achieves the place of Surya.

## Chapter 188. Welcome of Bhojakas

## \|\| 1.188.1 \|\|

*saptāśva uvāca \|*  
*sūryāya sarvapākānnaṃ nivedyāgnau ca homayet \|*  
*hutvāgnau prakṣipedvīra baliṃ dikṣu samaṃtataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Saptashva said — All the types of food items prepared by a person should first be offered to the Sungod and then the Homa should be performed in the fire. Then they should be kept in all the directions, as offerings.

## \|\| 1.188.2 \|\|

*sūryāgniguruviprāṇāṃ sarvapākānnamanvaham \|*  
*yo'nivedyātmanā bhuṃkte sa bhuṃkte kilbiṣaṃ naraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Without offering them to Surya, Agni and the Brahmanas, one who eats the delicious dishes, such a person actually consumes the sins, instead of the food.

## \|\| 1.188.3 \|\|

*kṛṣipālye ca vāṇijye krodhasatyakṣayādibhiḥ \|*  
*puṃsāṃ pāpāni vardhaṃte sūnādoṣaiśca paṃcabhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. There is an increase in the sins because of farming, trade, anger, falsehood and five types of violence.

## \|\| 1.188.4 \|\|

*kaṃḍanī peṣaṇī cullī udakuṃbhaḥ pramārjanī \|*  
*paṃca sūnā gṛhasthasya tena svargaṃ na gacchati \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The five types of blemishes of violence emerge from the husking of the paddy, the grinding stone mill, plastering of the oven, placing of the pitcher of water as well as the brooming of the house. Because of the same, a householder is unable to achieve the heaven.

## \|\| 1.188.5 \|\|

*sūryāgnigurupūjābhiḥ pāpairetairna lipyate \|*  
*anyaiśca pātakaighoraistasmātsaṃpūjayetsadā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. By worshipping the Sun, Agni and the preceptor, one is relieved of all the five blemishes, besides other grave sins. Therefore, they should always be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.188.6 \|\|

*sūryāgnigurunaivedyaṃ yāvatsyādannasaṃkhyayā \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi dātā sūryapure vaset \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The quantity of food which is offered to Sungod, preceptor as well as the fire, the donor resides in the heaven for the number of years multiplied with a thousand.

## \|\| 1.188.7-8 \|\|

*ghṛtapūpayutaiḥ siktaiḥ puṇyaṃ daśaguṇottaram \|*  
*avadaṃśaguṇairyuktaṃ puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ khaga \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭikaudananaivedyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam \|*  
*sugaṃdhaśālinaivedyaṃ vijñeyamayutottaram \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. When the food given is fried in ghi, the merit is increased ten times. When some intoxicating food is offered, the related merit is increased to a hundred times. When the boiled rice of Shali type is given, the merit increases to a thousand times. When the fragrant food is given, the related merit is increased to several times more.

## \|\| 1.188.9 \|\|

*bhakṣyānnapānadānāni tatphalāni tathātathā \|*  
*yadvā tadvā sadā deyaṃ sūryāgnigurusādhuṣu \|*  
*bhakṣyaṃ nivedya pūrvoktamakṣayaṃ labhate phalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The eatables and other food items should be offered to the Sungod, Agni, the preceptor and the saints, for achieving of the relevant boons. Because by so doing, one gets the everlasting merit as stated above.

## \|\| 1.188.10 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktiṃ deva deve divākare \|*  
*sa pitṝnsarvapāpebhyaḥ samuddhṛtya divaṃ nayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A person who thus adores the Sungod, he is relieved of all the sins and his manes achieve the heaven.

## \|\| 1.188.11 \|\|

*gaṃgāsnānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanātprāpnuyādraveḥ \|*  
*sarvatīrthābhiṣekaṃ ca praṇāmādviṃdate khaga \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. O bird, one achieves the merit comparable with a bath in the Ganga when a salutation is offered to him, and he gains the merit for the taking of bath in all the holy places.

## \|\| 1.188.12 \|\|

*mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ praṇamya śirasā ravim \|*  
*śuśrūṣeta ca saṃdhyāyāṃ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. By offering a salutation to the Sungod by lowering the head, one achieves the honour in Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.188.13 \|\|

*yugapatpūjitāstena brahmaviṣṇu maheśvarāḥ \|*  
*pitaraḥ sarvadevāśca bhaveyuḥ pūjitā ravau \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. By offering the prayer to the Sungod, all the gods besides Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and manes get worshipped.

## \|\| 1.188.14-15 \|\|

*tuṣyaṃti pitarastasya sukṛṣṭeneva karṣukāḥ \|*  
*yaḥ śrāddhe bhojayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ japajīvinam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*api naḥ sa kule kaṃciduddharetkiṃ khageśvara \|*  
*yaḥ saṃpūjya raviṃ śrāddhe bhojayejjapajīvinam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. When a person during the Shraddha serves food to a reciter Brahmana, his manes get pleased like the land which is ploughed well O lord of birds, after the worship of the Sungod, one who serves food to a reciter Brahmana, he redeems his entire race.

## \|\| 1.188.16 \|\|

*tṛpyaṃti pitarastasya gāyaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ \|*  
*adya naḥ sa kule prājño vācakaṃ bhojayiṣyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. All his manes are well pleased and grandparents sing that the intelligent reciter born in our race has served food to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.188.17 \|\|

*purāṇavidamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva saha saṃsthitāḥ \|*  
*krīḍaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ svargamakṣayam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. When a learned Brahmana well-versed in the Purana arrives in the house of a householder, then all the herbs delightfully start dancing, saying — “Now we shall achieve the everlasting heaven.”

## \|\| 1.188.18 \|\|

*anugrahāya lokānāṃ śraddhāyāśca parīkṣaṇe \|*  
*caraṃtyatithirūpeṇa pitaro devatāstathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The manes and the gods wander on earth to test the devotion of the householder in the form of guests.

## \|\| 1.188.19 \|\|

*tasmādatithimāyāṃtamagre gacchetkṛtāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*svāgatāsanapādyārghyasnānānnaśayanādibhiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Therefore, on finding the approaching of a guest, the householder should atonce meet him with folded hands and receive him. Then, he should offer him the seat, padya and water for arghya. And finally, he should arrange for his sleeping.

## \|\| 1.188.20 \|\|

*rūpānvitaṃ virūpaṃ vā malinaṃ malināṃbaram \|*  
*velāyāmatithiṃ prāptaṃ paṃḍito na vicārayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The guest arriving at the house even when he is dirty or beautiful, deprived, with shattered clothes, then the learned people should not think about his dirty condition.

## \|\| 1.188.21 \|\|

*bhojakānāṃ śarīreṣu nityaṃ sannihito raviḥ \|*  
*ye bhojakāstyajaṃtyanye sarvapāpeṣvavasthitāḥ \|*  
*adhomukhorddhvapādāste pataṃti narakāgniṣu \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The Sungod always pervades in the body of the Bhojakas. Therefore, the person who disowns the Bhojakas, he earning all the sins, fall in the fire of hell with head on and feet raised upwards.

## \|\| 1.188.22 \|\|

*kṛmibhirbhinnavadanāstapyamānāśca vahninā \|*  
*pīḍyaṃte cāyudhai rghoṃrairyāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The insects tear out his body. And, he suffer in that fire for the duration of the rule of fourteen Indras.

## \|\| 1.188.23 \|\|

*ye cāpavādaṃ śṛṇvaṃti vimūḍhā brāhmaṇeṣu vai \|*  
*te viśeṣeṇa pacyaṃte narakeṣu madicchayā \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Such of the fools who listen to the denouncement of the Brahmanas, they keep on boiling in the altars of the hell at my command.

## \|\| 1.188.24 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva pātrāṇāṃ satpātraṃ jāpakaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayetsusamāhitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Of all the people, the reciters are considered to be the best. Therefore, one should always make efforts to worship them.

## Chapter 189. The talk of Saptashva

## \|\| 1.189.1 \|\|

*saptāśvatilaka uvāca \|*  
*āmapātrarasā yadvannaśyaṃte naśyabhājane \|*  
*japopekṣe tathā dānaṃ saha pātreṇa naśyati \|*  
*sadbījamūṣare yadvatsamuptaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Saptashva said — By keeping beverages in the pitcher of clay, it gets destroyed. Similarly, the charities given to someone other than the Bhojakas, get destroyed like the vase of day and becomes infructuous like the seed sown in the barren land.

## \|\| 1.189.2 \|\|

*bhasmanīva hutaṃ havyaṃ yathā hotuśca niṣphalam \|*  
*japena rahite vipre tathā dānaṃ nirarthakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The giving away of charities to a Brahmana who is devoid of japam is like the performing of homa over the heap of ashes.

## \|\| 1.189.3 \|\|

*yathā ṣaṇḍho'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā \|*  
*brāhmaṇasya tathā janma japahīnasya niṣphalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. As a eunuch is useless for woman, the impotent bull among the cows, similarly, the Brahmana without japam is useless by birth.

## \|\| 1.189.4 \|\|

*lohoḍupena pratarannimajjatyudake yathā \|*  
*dātā dātā grahītā ca patatyaṃdhe tamasyatha \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A person who tries to cross the river with an iron boat or makes other to do so, both are bound to drown. Similarly, by giving charity to a Brahmana who does not perform japam both the giver and the taker are bound to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.189.5 \|\|

*kāruṇyātsarvabhūteṣu śraddhayā yatpradīyate \|*  
*dānaṃ tadvai khaga jñeyaṃ sārvakāmikamuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O bird, being a devotee, when the charities are given to the people out of compassion, it is said to be the best and fulfills all the desires.

## \|\| 1.189.6 \|\|

*dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca bālavṛddhātureṣu ca \|*  
*yaddīyate khagaśreṣṭha tasyānantaphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O best of the birds, those who are miserable, blind, of young age, or of old age, diseased or sick, and when the charities are given to them, the giver achieves the endless merits.

## \|\| 1.189.7 \|\|

*na hi svārthaṃ samuddiśya pratigṛhṇaṃti sādhavaḥ \|*  
*dāturevopakārāya jagṛhuḥ śravaṇādayaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The saints do not accept the riches given to them with the selfish motive. On the contrary, for the welfare of the donor, they accept the same.

## \|\| 1.189.8 \|\|

*dāturevopakārāya vadatyarthī dadasva me \|*  
*yasmāddātā prayātyūrdhvamadhastiṣṭhetpratigrahī \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. For the welfare of the donor, they reach the house of the donor and say — “Give me.” By so saying, the donor achieves the heaven, but the receiver falls from the heaven.

## \|\| 1.189.9 \|\|

*dehīti suvadannarthī dhanaṃ bodhayatīva saḥ \|*  
*yanmayā kṛtamarthitvaṃ prage'dānaphalaṃ hi tat \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. The beggar reaching at the door of the donor, never seeks something with the speaking of the sweet voice. To the contrary, he remind the donor about the riches, saying — “I had not given charities in the earlier births as a result of which, I had to resort to this practice of begging.”

## \|\| 1.189.10 \|\|

*bodhayaṃti na yācante dehīti kṛpaṇā janāḥ \|*  
*avastheyamadānasya yadyācāmo gṛhegṛhe \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The miserly people do not beg by saying — “Give me.” Rather, they remind (the giver) saying that this condition that I am begging from house to house, has been achieved by me because of my failure of giving away the charities in the past births.

## \|\| 1.189.11 \|\|

*āyātyarthī gṛhaṃ yastu kastaṃ na pratipūjayet \|*  
*koyamarthī na pūjyaḥ syādyācamāno dinedine \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Who does not adore a beggar who reaches the home, because those who beg daily are adored by all?

## \|\| 1.189.12 \|\|

*yadbalādapyanicchaṃtaṃ yojayaṃti narāśrayān \|*  
*ahanyahani yācaṃte dātuste darśayaṃti hi \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Such of the beggars seek something or the other from a donor against his wishes, then with the begging of the day, they display the difference between the donor and the receiver.

## \|\| 1.189.13 \|\|

*ekastiṣṭhati cādhastādanyaścopari tiṣṭhati \|*  
*dātṛyācakayorbhedaḥ karābhyāmeva sūcitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. It is because, the hand of one person remains down, while that of the other remains above. By this, the difference between the receiver and the giver becomes apparent.

## \|\| 1.189.14 \|\|

*yaḥ prāptāyārthine dānaṃ tyaktvā pātra mudīkṣate \|*  
*sarvakarmasu yuktatvānna dātā pāramārthikaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Such of the people get engrossed about the suitability of the receiver or otherwise on the arrival of a guest and in such a case, the donor inspite of his performing all the activities appropriately, is deprived of the merit of the best end.

## \|\| 1.189.15 \|\|

*yadyarthino narā na syurdānadharmaḥ kathaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tadarthiṣu bhaveddānaṃ svāgataṃ svāgataṃ priyam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Without the beggar, how could the dharma of charity be performed? Because by the donation given to a beggar, one welcomes the guest in one form or the other.

## \|\| 1.189.16 \|\|

*pādodakamanuvrajyātsvargasopānasaptakam \|*  
*ciṃtāciṃtānurūpeṇa kadā kasya vinaṣyati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The water with which the feet of the beggar is washed, should be held with respect because it serves as a stair to reach the heaven. Otherwise, a person is always engrossed in the worldly worries and no one is ever free from them.

## \|\| 1.189.17 \|\|

*grāsādardhamapi grāsaṃ yuktaṃ dātuṃ sadārthinām \|*  
*dānaṃ priyavinirmuktaṃ naṣṭamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. It would be proper for a donor even to give half of his morsel to the beggar. Otherwise, discarding such a loving beggar, and to give donation to others, has been turned to be of no consequence by the people with wisdom.

## \|\| 1.189.18 \|\|

*tasmātsatkṛtya dātavyamanaṃtaphalamicchatā \|*  
*pretyākhyānamapi śreyaḥ priyānunayapeśa lam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Therefore, a person who is desirous of endless merit, should give them the donation with respect. They should sit near him, and talk to him. This would be beneficial. Because the talk with the near and dear ones is always good in all respects.

## \|\| 1.189.19 \|\|

*na taddānamasatkārapāruṣyamalinīkṛtam \|*  
*varaṃ na dattamarthibhyaḥ saṃkruddhenāṃtarātmanā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The charities given with arrogance and getting enraged is not considered to be praiseworthy. It would be better not to give charity to a beggar in anger.

## \|\| 1.189.20 \|\|

*na taddhanaṃ na ca prītirna dharmaḥ priyavarjitaḥ \|*  
*dānapradānaniyamayajñadhyānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ \|*  
*yatnenāpi kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ krodho'sya niṣphalaṃ khaga \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The wealth, love and dharma are of no consequence which is useless for the loving beggar. O bird, the donation or reward, observing of rules, yajna, meditation, homa besides the tapas, even when are concluded in an appropriate manner, became fruitless with the use of anger.

## \|\| 1.189.21 \|\|

*yaḥ śraddhayārcitaṃ dadyātprati gṛhṇāti cārcitam \|*  
*tāvubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ naraka tadviparyayāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. A person who donates the best of things, both the giver and the receiver achieve the heaven. Those who act contrary to the same, have to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 1.189.22 \|\|

*audāryaṃ svāgataṃ maitrī hyanukaṃpā ca matsaraḥ \|*  
*paṃcabhistu gurau dānaṃ dāturdāne mahāphalam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. The display of generosity, welcoming the guests, friendship, mercifulness and lack of jealousy are the five virtues. A person who gives the donation with these five virtues to a beggar, he receives the great merit for his donation.

## \|\| 1.189.23-25 \|\|

*vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca \|*  
*gātaṭaṃ samudraśca naimiṣāraṇyameva ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

*mūlasthānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṃḍīrasvāmikaṃ tathā \|*  
*kālapriyaṃ khagaśreṣṭha kṣīrikāvāsa eva ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ityete kīrtitā deśāḥ surasiddhaniṣevitāḥ \|*  
*sarve sūryāśramāḥ puṇyāḥ sarvā nadyaḥ saparvatāḥ \|*  
*gosiddhamuni vāsāśca deśāḥ puṇyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. O best of the birds, the Gods and the Siddhas reside in the sacred places like Varanasi, Kurukshetra, Pushkara, Kalapriya and Kshirasagara. All the ashramas of the Sungod, all the rivers with mountains, the cows, the abodes of Siddhas and the Munis are all said to be the auspicious places.

## \|\| 1.189.26-28 \|\|

*sūryāyatanasaṃsthānāṃ yadyadalpaṃ tu dīyate \|*  
*tadanaṃtaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ vacaḥ kṣetrānubhāvataḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*grahaṇaṃ caṃdrasūryābhyāmuttarāyaṇamuttamam \|*  
*viṣuvaṃ savyatīpātaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dinacchidrāṇi saṃkrāṃtiḥ puṇyaṃ viṣupadaṃ khaga \|*  
*iti kālaḥ samā khyātaḥ puṃsāṃ puṇyavivardhanaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. In case, a small quantity of (eatables) is given to those who live in the Sun temple, then the donor receives the endless merit. This has been ordained by the Siddhas. O bird, during the solar or the lunar eclipses, or when the sun is in Uttarayana or on the Libra, Scorpion, or Dhanu — the ninth zodiac sign or the first day of longest and smallest days, are said to be the days when the merits of the humans are increased.

## \|\| 1.189.29 \|\|

*bhaktibhāvaḥ parā prītirdharmo dharmaikabhāvanaḥ \|*  
*pratipattiriti jñeyaṃ śraddhāparyāyapaṃcakam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The highest stage of love, Dharma, devotion for religion, becoming conscious soul, and one’s duty are the five synonyms of devotion.

## \|\| 1.189.30 \|\|

*śraddhayā vidhivatpātre pratipāditamuttamam \|*  
*tasmācchraddhāṃ samāsthāya deyamakṣayamicchatā \|\| 30 \|\|*
