*ādityadevatāḥ sarve tathānye devadānavāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mukhādbhūto viriṃcistu rudro vakṣasthalāttataḥ \|*  
*upeṃdro dakṣiṇāddhastāddhātā vāmakarāttathā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vāmapādatalāddakṣo dakṣiṇātkaśyapastathā \|*  
*ityutpannāstathā cānye devāsuranarāḥ khagāḥ \|*  
*tenāsau deva ādityaḥ sarvadeveṣu pūjitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. Therefore, it is Aditya who created this world, which includes the Devas, Asuras, Rakshasas, Gandharvas and Yakshas, besides Rudras, Upendra, Indra, Brahma, Daksha, Kashyapa, the gods besides other Devas and Danavas. Brahma was born out of his face, Rudra from chest, Upendra (Vishnu) from right arm, Dhata from the left hand, from the left sole of the foot was born Daksha; from sole of the right foot Kashyapa was born. Besides these, other gods, humans, birds, etc. were created. Because of this, Aditya is adorable by all the gods.

## \|\| 1.198.21-22 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*yadītthaṃ gīyate vīra digvidikṣu sa bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*yadi tasya prabhāvoyaṃ pārāśarya jagatpateḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sa kimarthaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ paribhūyate \|*  
*dvijaiḥ saṃrakṣyate bhūyaścakravadbhramate punaḥ \|*  
*rāhuṇā gṛhyate'grāhyastatkimarthaṃ dvijottama \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Bhishma said — In case, the glory of Bhaskara is thus being sung in all the directions, then O son of Parashara, if it is because of the influence of the same universal lord, then why is he facing defeat from the Rakshasas in the three Sandhyas occasionally, in which the Brahmanas come to his rescue? He moves like a cakra or a wheel. Then why does Rahu causes eclipse to him?

## \|\| 1.198.23-25 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*piśācoragarakṣāṃsi ḍākinīdānavāṃstathā \|*  
*dakṣiṇāgnirdahetkrodhāttamākrāmati bhāskaraḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*trisaṃdhyaṃ tu trayo devāḥ sānnidhyaṃ ravimaṃḍale \|*  
*muhūrtasya prabhāvoyamasādhye dṛṣṭake tathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tamekamevamuddiśya loke dharmaḥ pravartate \|*  
*namaskṛte stute tasminsarve devā namaskṛtāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Vyasa said — The Pishachas, Nagas, Dakinis and the Danavas are destroyed by the fire of the south. Getting enraged, Bhaskara attacks them. During all the three Sandhyas, all the gods remain in attention with the solar disc. This is due to the influence of the muhurta and is quite unavoidable. The people follow the religion because of the command of the Sungod. By adoring and offering prayers to him, all the gods get adored.

## \|\| 1.198.26-27 \|\|

*trisandhyaṃ vasudhādevairbhāskarastriḥ praṇamyate \|*  
*rāhurādityabiṃbasya sthitodhastānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*amṛtārthī vimānastho yāvatsaṃsravate'mṛtam \|*  
*vimānāṃtaritaṃ biṃbamādiśedgrahaṇaṃ tataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. During all the three Sandhyas, all the Bhu — devas in a group, offer their salutation to the Sungod thrice. Of course, for the sake of the nectar, Rahu also remains within his shadow. There is no doubt about it, that he remains seated in the plane till such time the nectar oozes. He becomes support of his own shadow constantly, which is known as eclipse.

## \|\| 1.198.28 \|\|

*na kaściddharṣituṃ śakta ādityo dahate dhruvam \|*  
*divārātrimuhūrtānāṃ jñānāyākramate raviḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. It is definitely with the force of the Sungod that vehicle is moved. No one is competent enough to attack him. In order to gain knowledge of days, nights, muhurta, it is the Sungod who attacks in the form of rising.

## \|\| 1.198.29-30 \|\|

*nādityena vinā rātrirna dinaṃ na ca tarpaṇam \|*  
*nādharmmo nātha vā dharmmastena dṛṣṭaṃ carācaram \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ādityaḥ pāti vai sarvamādityaḥ sṛjate sadā \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mama \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Without Bhaskara, no activity is possible during the days, nights, oblation, dharma and even adharma, mobiles and immobiles. The sustenance and creation of the entire universe is done by the Sungod himself. Thus, I have explained whatever had been asked by you.

## Chapter 199. Talk of Bhishma

## \|\| 1.199.1 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*sa ādityo bhavedyena acirāttu varapradaḥ \|*  
*tadahaṃśrotumicchāmi vipra māṃ brūhi tattvataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bhishma said — O Brahmana, I am desirous to know the way by which Aditya, expeditiously bestows boon. I am desirous of knowing the relevant process. Kindly explain the same to me in a detailed manner.

## \|\| 1.199.2-3 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*pūjayā japahomena dhyānadhāraṇayā saha \|*  
*sakalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā taddīkṣā samayaṃ tathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*labdhvā rādhayate yastu bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ \|*  
*tasya bhānurbhavedvīra acirāttu varapradaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Vyasa said — O valorous one, creating the entire mandala, one should embrace initiation and observing all the rules whosoever, concentrating his mind adores the Sungod, for him the Sungod bestows the reward atonce.

## \|\| 1.199.4-7 \|\|

*balasiddhiṃ mahadvīryaṃ pratāpaṃ ca svakāyanam \|*  
*dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rūpaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpadam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ārogyamāyuḥ kīrtiṃ ca yaśaḥ putrāṃśca mānada \|*  
*dadate nātra saṃdeho yasya tuṣṭo divākaraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dharmamarthaṃ tathā kāmaṃ vidyāṃ mokṣaśriyaṃ tathā \|*  
*dadate bhāskarastuṣṭo narāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saureṇa vidhinā tāta pūjayitvā divākaram \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tathādityālayaṃ nṛpa \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. All the desires for strength, great prowess, popularity, wealth in one’s own home, cereals, beauty, fortunes and wealth, healthy body, grace and the sons are bestowed on the person, over whom the Sungod showers his grace. There is no doubt about it. When pleased, the Sungod also bestows on the humans dharma, artha, kama, knowledge and moksha. There is no doubt about it. By adoring the Sungod appropriately, one achieves success in all the desires, besides arrival in the place of Surya.

## \|\| 1.199.8 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*saurasnānavidhiṃ brūhi sarahasyaṃ mahāmate \|*  
*yena snāto'malo yāti naraḥ pūja yituṃ ravim \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Bhishma said — O Intelligent one, you kindly reveal the sacred solar bath, taking which a person gets completed, purified and is entitled to worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.199.9-10 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi snānaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*śucau manorame sthāne saṃgṛhyāstreṇa mṛttikām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*saṃdhisaṃgho hakārastu ṭarephophasamanvite \|*  
*anenāstreṇa saṃgṛhya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Vyasa said — I am now speaking about the solar bath, which is the destroyer of the sins. You please listen. One should pick up the clay of an auspicious place after reciting a mantra. The letters of the mantra are — ha, ta, ra, pha. The earth should be dug with the weapon and then carrying it, the same should be used for the bath.

## \|\| 1.199.11-16 \|\|

*malasnānaṃ tataḥ paścāccheṣārdhena tu kārayet \|*  
*bhāgatrayaṃ tu sārdhaṃ tu tṛṇapāṣāṇavarjitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ekamastreṇa cālabhya tathānyaṃ bhāskareṇa tu \|*  
*aṃgaṃ caiva tṛtīyena abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt \|\| 12 \|\|*

*japtvāstreṇa kṣipeddikṣu nirvighnaṃ tu jalaṃ bhavet \|*  
*sūryatīrthe dvitīyena abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gu ṇḍayitvā tataḥ snāyāditi tīrtheṣu mānavaḥ \|*  
*tūryaśaṃkhaninādena dhyātvā devaṃ divākaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

*snātvā rājopacāreṇa punarācamya yatnataḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ kṛtvā tato bhīṣma maṃtrarājena saṃyutam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*harephau biṃduyuktaśca tathānyo dīrghayā saha \|*  
*mātrayā rephasaṃyukto hakāro biṃdunā saha \|\| 16 \|\|*

11-16. Thereafter, of the remaining half portion mala-snana should be performed. The rest of the earth should be divided in three parts in which there should be no straw or pebbles. One part of it should be accepted lifted with a weapon, the second part should be lifted reciting the name of Bhaskara. The third part should be thrown in all the directions after touching it with all the limbs of the body reciting the mantras, so that the process of taking bath should be completed without obstruction. The second part should be sanctified by the mantras and dropped around the Sun temple. Thereafter, one should take bath at the same holy place. At the time of taking bath, thinking about Divakara, the trumpet should be sounded and the conch should be blown. O Bhishma, after thus taking bath in an appropriate manner, one should sip the water, recite the great mantra and then take the bath. The mantra repha has been described to be having re and pha, then sah adding hram sah.

## \|\| 1.199.17-19 \|\|

*sakāraḥ savisargastu maṃtrarājo'yamucyate \|*  
*tatastu tarpayenmaṃtrānsarvāṃstāṃstu karāgrajaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*parvaṇāmūrdhvato devāḥ savyena munayastathā \|*  
*pitaraścāpasavyena tadbījena pratarpayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yadgītaṃ pravaraṃ loke akṣarāṇāṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|*  
*tadbiṃdusahitaṃ proktaṃ hṛdbījaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Thereafter, oblation should be performed reciting the mantras. It is desirable that the yajnopavita placing on Savya (as opposite to the right) with foreparts of the fingers and oblation should be offered to the gods and the Rishis. The oblation to the manes should be performed in apasavya condition. This has been prescribed. The Bija letter has been described as the best of the letters by the people of wisdom.

## \|\| 1.199.20 \|\|

*kṛtvā vāmakare hastāddhyātvā prājño vidhānavit \|*  
*evaṃ snātvā vidhānena saṃdhyāṃ vandedvidhānataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The learned person, well-versed in the religious procedures, should place it from the right to the left hand and perform the Sandhya-vandana appropriately.

## \|\| 1.199.21-26 \|\|

*tato vidvānkṣipetpaścādbhāskarāyodakāṃjalim \|*  
*japecca tryakṣaraṃ maṃtraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ vā yadicchayā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*maṃtrarājeti yaḥ pūrvaṃ tavākhyāto mayā nṛpa \|*  
*paścāttīrthe tu maṃtrāṃstu saṃhṛtya hṛdayaṃ nyaset \|\| 22 \|\|*

*maṃtrairātmānamekatra kṛtvā hyarghyaṃ pradāpayet \|*  
*raktacandanagaṃdhaistu śucisnāto mahītale \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kṛtvā maṇḍalakaṃ vittamekacitto vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā karavīrāṇi saṃsthāpya tāmrabhājane \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tilataṃḍulasayuktaṃ kuśagandhodakena tu \|*  
*raktacandanadhūpena yuktamarghyaṃ prasādhya tat \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ \|*  
*pūrvamaṃtreṇa saṃyuktamarghyaṃ dadyāttu bhānave \|\| 26 \|\|*

21-26. Thereafter, the oblation of water should be offered to the Sungod. Akshara and Shadakshara oblation of water should be made to the Sungod, as has been told by me to you. Thereafter, while uttering mantras in his heart, the arghya should be offered. The red sandal has been said to be auspicious in the world. One should take bath with its fragrance (or paste) and getting purified, make a mandate quite carefully and place the oleander flowers in a copper vase. The sesamum seeds, unbroken rice, kusha, fragrance and the red sandal paste should be placed in the copper vase. Then he should kneel over his knees, he should touch the copper vase with his head and offer arghya to the Sungod, reciting the aforesaid mantra.

## \|\| 1.199.27-28 \|\|

*mucyate sarvapāpaistu yo hyevaṃ vinivedayet \|*  
*yadyugādisahasreṇa vyatīpātaśatena ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*ayanānāṃ sahasreṇa candrasya grahaṇe tathā \|*  
*gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare \|*  
*datte kurukulaśreṣṭha tadarghyeṇa phalaṃ labhet \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. By offering arghya in this way, one is relieved of all the sins. Giving of a hundred thousand cows in charity at the Pushkara — the best of places of pilgrimage, on the Kritayuga, on a hundred Vyatipatas (astronomical yogas), on a thousand ayanas and on due lunar eclipse, the merit one achieves, the same merit is achieved by offering oblation.

## \|\| 1.199.29 \|\|

*dīkṣāmantravihīno'pi bhaktyā saṃvatsareṇa tu \|*  
*phalamarghyeṇa vai vīra labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. When one is without initiation or mantras but offers oblation to the Sungod in this way, for a year, he earns all the merits. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.199.30-32 \|\|

*yaḥ punardīkṣito vidvānvidhinārghyaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*nāsāvutpadyate bhūmau sa layaṃ yāti bhāskare \|\| 30 \|\|*

*iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurāgegyasaṃpadām \|*  
*acirādbhavate vīra sa bhāryāsukhabhājanam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*eṣa snānavidhiḥ prokto mayā saṃkṣepatastava \|*  
*hitāya mānaveṃdrāṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. But when a learned person getting initiated, offers the oblation in a proper manner, he does not have to consume water on earth and he attains the Sayujya devotion of the Sungod. He cams all the fortunes in this world, long life, good health, quite rapidly. He has enormous and unique love of his wife. I have spoken to you in brief about the solar bath, which removes all the sins of all the people. The welfare of all the people resists in the same.

## Chapter 200. The Solar Dharma

## \|\| 1.200.1 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*kathitaste snānavidhirbrahmanvai pāpahārakaḥ \|*  
*samyagbrahmarcanavidhiṃ pūjayiṣyāmi yena vai \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bhishma said — O Brahman, you have explained the process of taking bath which removes the sins. But I would like to know the method of his adoration, because I am desirous of worshipping him. Therefore, you please speak out about the same.

## \|\| 1.200.2-3 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi vidhimādityapūjane \|*  
*vivikte vijaya sthāne suprasanne suśobhane \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pūjayedbhāskaraṃ mantrī saralīkṛtavigrahaḥ \|*  
*bhadrāsanasamārūḍhaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sādhakottamaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Vyasa said — I shall tell you the mode of Sun worship. One should sanctity or purify himself at a beautiful and delightful place and being seated in Bhadrasana facing east, a devotee should then worship the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.200.4-6 \|\|

*astrabījena maṃtreṇa naraḥ svāṃgāni vinyaset \|*  
*aṃguṣṭhamāditaḥ kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāntaṃ suvinyaset \|\| 4 \|\|*

*hṛdayādīnphaḍantāṃstānvinyasetkramataḥ sadā \|*  
*netrapāṇitale vīra nyasya arghyādi maṃtravit \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yavarge yacaturthaṃ tu karṇabiṃdusamanvitam \|*  
*netrabījamiti proktaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Using the ashtrabija-mantra, a person should perform the anganyasa initially, in which starting from the big toes of the feet, one should touch the little fingers of the hands. This is called karanyasa. Similarly, starting from the heart, upto ashtrayaphat vinyasa is to be performed. A person who is well-versed in mantra, should perform nyasa in the palm of the hand. The letters of yavarga when added with a bindu, it is known as the form of flame or the netra-bija.

## \|\| 1.200.7 \|\|

*paścāttu tryakṣaraṃ sūryaṃ kavacaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ \|*  
*kathitaṃ tanmayā vīra maṃtrarājeti pṛcchataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then nyasa should be performed with the three letters of Surya. This happens to be the secret of the mantra, which has already been told by me.

## \|\| 1.200.8-12 \|\|

*prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryātprathamaṃ bījamudgiran \|*  
*śeṣakrameṇa hutvāyaṃ viraje bhīṣmaśaktitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tribhireva tato ghorairātmaśuddhiḥ kṛtā bhavet \|*  
*iti saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ sūryaṃ sarvāṃtikaṃ nyaset \|\| 9 \|\|*

*hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset \|*  
*ekaviṃśatimātṛkāyā akṣaraṃ yatprakīrtitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*hṛdbījamiti vikhyātaṃ brahmasthānamanaupamam \|*  
*śirasārkasya pūjā tu lokerkaḥ pratikathyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*śikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasyeccharīre kavacaṃ nyaset \|*  
*netrayorvinyasennetraṃ karayorastrameva ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. Then starting with the first seed, the salutation should be made, after which homa should be performed. O Bhishma, thus by repeating the process thrice, the self-purification is achieved. Thus getting purified, one should offer himself to the Sungod. Performing nyasa with head to head and heart to heart, the use of hridaya bija should be made. In this, the letters of twenty one Matrikas have been termed as the Hridaya-bija, which happens to be a beautiful Brahma-sthana or the place of Brahman. The Shirah worship in the world has been prescribed for the Sungod. The process of eyes in eyes, Shikha in Shikha (tuft), a kavacha over the body and a weapon in hands forms the process of the ashtra-nyasa.

## \|\| 1.200.13-16 \|\|

*mahāvyāhṛtayo rājaṃstathārajvālinī śikhā \|*  
*hakāraśca rakāraśca kukāro biṃdunā saha \|\| 13 \|\|*

*eteṣāṃ samayāścaiva kavacaṃ parikathyate \|*  
*netrayorvinyasennetraṃ karayora strameva ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*evamaṃgāni vinyasya nāsau kenāpi bāddhyate \|*  
*śatravo mitratāṃ yāṃti alābhe lābhamāpnuyāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

*ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ jñātvā yathoktaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ \|*  
*tatastu pūjayedbhānuṃ sthaṃḍile vidhivatpunaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. O king, ra stands for a Shikhd with flame. Therefore, hakara, rakara and kukara with a bindu are known as the three upper regions (bhu, bhuva, svah). Their time is known as kavacha. By putting on the kavacha the nyasa of eyes in eyes and astra in hand is performed. By performing the nyasa with the limbs, no obstructions are envisaged. Because the enemies become friend, and profit emerges out of loss. According to the people well-versed in the tattvas, one should perform the worship of the Sungod on earth treating himself to be the Sun, in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 1.200.17-19 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu dakṣiṇe pārśve divyapuṣpakaraṃḍakam \|*  
*kṛtvā suśobhite vāme tāmrapūrṇena vāriṇā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*astreṇa kṣālitāṃ pūrṇāṃ śeṣaṃ maṃtrairjalaistathā \|*  
*abhimaṃtrya tataḥ sthāpya kavacenāvaguṃṭhitām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sthaṃḍile caiva dravyāṇi pūjārthaṃ kalpitāni tu \|*  
*sarvāṇi prokṣayedvidvānarghyapātraṃ jalena tu \|*  
*tato maṃtraṃ japetpaścādekacittena maṃtravit \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. On the right side, there should be the vase of flowers and water vase on the left, made of bamboo, besides a copper vase filled with water. Then, reciting the astra mantra, the ground should be purified. Then reciting mantras, the ground should be sanctified sprinkling water. Thus lines should be drawn with kavacha and a circle should be formed. All the materials for worship kept there, should be washed with arghya vase and purifying the same. Then, the devotee well-versed in mantras, should start attentively the performing of japam.

## \|\| 1.200.20-22 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*purāṇasahitairmaṃtrairyo vidhiḥ kathito budhaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sa mayā viditaḥ kṛtsnaḥ kathito naikaśo dvijaiḥ \|*  
*vedoktairvividhairmaṃtrairyathā saṃpūjyate raviḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tathā me brūhi sakalaṃ vaidikaṃ vidhisattamam \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Bhishma said — This is the mode of worship which has been revealed by the three learned persons. I have heard the same from many other Brahmanas. Now, you please speak out the way in which the Sungod is worshipped by Vedic mantras.

## Chapter 201. The Gods of the Solar Region

## \|\| 1.201.1-2 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*atha tvāṃ kathayiṣyehaṃ saṃvādaṃ dharmavarddhanam \|*  
*surajyeṣṭhasya devasya keśavasya ca bhārata \|\| 1 \|\|*

*manovatyāṃ surajyeṣṭhaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ caturmukham \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuridaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Vyasa said — O Bharata, in this connection, I shall speak to you about a religious discussion between Keshava and Brahma. Once at Manovati, Vishnu asked Brahma — the best of the gods, offering him the salutation, lowering his head.

## \|\| 1.201.3 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*bhagavandevadeveśa surajyeṣṭha caturmukha \|*  
*ārādhanavidhiṃ brūhi bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Vishnu said — O lord, god of gods, foremost of the gods and four-faced lord, you kindly tell me the mode of worship of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.201.4 \|\|

*kathamārādhayedbhānuṃ maṃḍalasthaṃ divaspatim \|*  
*brūhi me'tra gaṇaṃ devaṃ yenāhaṃ pūjaye vibhum \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. How could the lord of the day also known as Bhaskara be worshipped? You also please describe about Ganadeva, because I intend to worship him.

## \|\| 1.201.5 \|\|

*sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo' smi bhūdhara \|*  
*śṛṇu caikamanā deva bhāskarārādhane vidhim \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Brahma said — Well done, O valorous one, you have put an excellent question before me. I am now narrating the mode of worship of the Sungod. You please listen carefully.

## \|\| 1.201.6-7 \|\|

*khaṣolkaṃ nirmalaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vibhāvasum \|*  
*pūrve madhye tathāgneyyāṃ virūpākṣe prabhaṃ jane \|\| 6 \|\|*

*krameṇa yāvadīśānīṃ hṛdi bījena vinyaset \|*  
*khaṣolkāsanametattu vinyastaṃ mānavottamaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. After worshipping the spotless Bhaskara, one should perform anga-nyasa in the east, middle, south-east, west, north-west and northeast directions, reciting the bija mantra. The anga-nyasa performed by the excellent people are said to be the asanas of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.201.8-18 \|\|

*tatastasyopariṣṭāttu hṛdayena tu kaṃcu kam \|*  
*saptāvaraṇasaṃyuktamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kesarālaṃbadevatvaṃ paṃcavarṇaṃ mahādbhutam \|*  
*parīkṣābhūmividhivacchāstroktavidhinā kṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dīptādi pūrvādārabhya yāvadīśānagocaram \|*  
*nyasecchaktyaṣṭakaṃ maṃtrī madhyataḥ sarvatomukhīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā \|*  
*amoghā vidyutā caiva navamī sarvatomukhī \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tata āvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari \|*  
*upasthānaṃ tu vai kṛtvā maṃtreṇānena suvrata \|\| 12 \|\|*

*udutyaṃ jātavedasamiti maṃtraḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*agniṃ dūtena maṃtreṇa anena viśvasuvrata \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ākṛṣṇena rajasā maṃtreṇānena cārcayet \|*  
*haṃsaḥśuciṣaditi ca maṃtreṇārkaṃ prapūjayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*apaptetārakaṃ devīdīptānena prapūjayet \|*  
*adṛśramasyaketavaḥ sūkṣmāṃ devīṃ samarcayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*taraṇirviśvadarśeti anena satataṃ jayam \|*  
*pratyaṅdevānāṃ viśeti bhadrāṃ devīṃ samarcayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vibhūtimarcayennityaṃ yenāpāvakacakṣasā \|*  
*vidyāmeṣīti maṃtreṇa hyanena vimalāṃ sadā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*amoghāṃ pūjayennityaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrata \|*  
*navamīṃ pūjayeddevīṃ satataṃ sarvatomukhīm \|\| 18 \|\|*

8-18. Thereafter, seven coverings should be placed over the asana with eight petalled lotus in which the pericarp should be beautifully made. It should be made over the land examined according to the provision of the holy scriptures. The ashtadala lotus should be made in five colours and should be established over the wonderful ground. Then in its saffron part, the place for the god should be earmarked. Starting from the eastern direction Ishana mountain should be lodged, which should be resplendent with the shakti of Surya. Its replica should also be established in Ashtadala. Then Sarvatomukhi should be placed by the reciter of the mantra. Then, Diksha, Sukshma, Jaya, Bhadra, Vibhuti, Vimala, Amogha, Vidyuta and Sarvatomukhi should be invoked. Thereafter, the Sungod should be invoked over the pericarp and should be adored. Thereafter, the mantra — Udutyam Jatavedam should be recited. The mantras — Agni dutena and Akrishnena Rajasa should be used for adoration, besides Hamsa Shuchishaditi should be invoked with the mantra Atapte tarakam devi, Sukshma Devi with Adrishramasya ketavah, Jaya Devi with mantra Tarinirvishvadarsheti, Bhadradevi with Pratyanga devanam vised, Vibhuti goddess with Yena pavaka Vimala with Vidyameshiti. The same mantra should be used in invoking Amogha and Sarvatomukhi.

## \|\| 1.201.19-23 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena kṛṣṇasya udvayaṃtamitīha ca \|*  
*udyannadyamitrahomaṃ prathamamakṣaraṃ vrajet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dvitīyaṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ śukleṣu harimāhave \|*  
*udagādayamādityo anenāpi tṛtīyakam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tatsaviturvareṇyeti caturthaṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*mahitomahitoyeti paṃcarcaṃ parikīrtayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatā ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam \|*  
*savitā paścātātpurastātsaptamaṃ devasattama \|\| 22 \|\|*

*evaṃ bījāni vinyasya ādityaṃ sthāpayeddvijaḥ \|*  
*ādityaṃ sthāpayeddhyāne sarveṣāṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

19-23. Thereafter, all the seven coverings of the god should be adored with different mantras as stated above in the Sanskrit text. Then making use of the bija mantra and performing nyasa, the Sungod should be consecrated. The learned Brahmanas must consecrate Aditya while consecrating all the gods.

## \|\| 1.201.24-27 \|\|

*bāhyato devaśārdūla indrādīnāṃ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*raktavarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ sitapadmopari sthitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*dvibhujaṃ caikacakraṃ ca saumyaṃ padmadhanuṣkaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

*vartulaṃ tena biṃbena madhyasthamatitejasam \|*  
*ādityasya tvidaṃ rūpaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*dhyātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ maṃḍalāśritam \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. In the outer portions, the gods like Indra and other gods should be invoked and consecrated. The Sungod should have red complexion, resplendent, lodged over a white lotus, possessing all the auspicious marks and adorned with all the ornaments. The Sungod should have two arms carrying a cakra, pleasant face, holding a lotus and a bow. The image should be roundish in shape. He should be worshipped drawing a mandala over the ground. It is this form of Surya which is worshipped in the universe.

## Chapter 202. Mode of Sun worship

## \|\| 1.202.1 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*maṇḍalasthaṃ suraśreṣṭha vidhinā yena bhāskaram \|*  
*pūjayenmānavo bhaktyā sa vidhiḥ kathyatāṃ mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vishnu said — O best of the gods, the mode with which the people worship the Sungod in a masala, may kindly be told to me.

## \|\| 1.202.2 \|\|

*pūjayedvidhinā yena bhāskaraṃ padmasaṃbhavam \|*  
*mūrtisthaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ pūjitaṃ sasurāsuraiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Besides the manner in which Bhaskara emerges out of the lotus in the form of a figure, being the all-pervading god, is adored by the gods and the asuras, the same may kindly be explained to me.

## \|\| 1.202.3-5 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*sādhu kṛṣṇa mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvrata \|*  
*śṛṇu caikamanāḥ pūrvaṃ mūrtisthaṃ yena pūjayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*iṣe tveti ca mantreṇa uttamāṃgaṃ sadārcayet \|*  
*agnimīḷeti mantreṇa pūjayeddakṣiṇe kare \|\| 4 \|\|*

*agna āyāhi mantreṇa pādau devasya pūjayet \|*  
*ājighreti ca maṃtreṇa pūjayetpuṣpamālayā \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Brahma said — O valorous Krishna, well done, O noble one, you have put me an excellent question. The mode by with the Sungod is worshipped in the form of an image is going to be related by me. You listen to me carefully. Using the mantra Ishe tve, the excellent form of the Sungod should be worshipped. Similarly, by reciting the hymn Agni mile, the right hand should be worshipped. Then, using the mantra agna ayahi, the feet of the Sungod should be worshipped. Then with the mantra ajighreta the flower garland should be offered.

## \|\| 1.202.6-9 \|\|

*yogayogati maṃtreṇa muktapuṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet \|*  
*samudraṃ gaccha yatproktamanena snāpayedravim \|\| 6 \|\|*

*imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhūdhara \|*  
*samudrajyeti mantreṇa kaṣāyaiḥ parirūpayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*snāpayetpayasā kṛṣṇa āpyāyasveti mantrataḥ \|*  
*dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhnā snāpayeddadhivadravim \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tejo'si śukramiti ca ghṛtena snapanaṃ param \|*  
*yā auṣadhīti maṃtreṇa snānamoṣadhibhiḥ smṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. Reciting the mantra yoga yogeti the flowers filled in both the hand cups should be offered. But before that the image of the Sungod should be bathed uttering the mantra samudram gaccha yatproktamanena. In the meantime, the mantra imam me gangeti should be muttered. With samudrajyeti mantra, the fragrant paste should be applied. Then, using the mantra dpydyasveti, the bathing with milk should be carried out. Reciting the mantra dadhikravneti, the curd should be offered. Then, ghi should be offered reciting the mantra tejosi sukramiti. Then with the mantra ya aushadhi, the Sungod should be bathed with herbs water.

## \|\| 1.202.10-11 \|\|

*udvartayettato dvipadābhiḥ surādhipa \|*  
*mānastoketi mantreṇa yugapatsnānamācaret \|\| 10 \|\|*

*viṣṇorarāṭamantreṇa snāpayedgandhavāriṇā \|*  
*sauvarṇena tu maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ pādyaṃ nivedayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. With the uttering of the mantra dvipadabhi the limbs of the Sungod should be plastered. With the mantra manastoketi, the all mixed bath should be offered. Thereafter, reciting the mantra Vishnorarata the fragrant water should be poured ‘over the image. The arghya should then be offered with the mantra Sauvarnena tu.

## \|\| 1.202.12-15 \|\|

*idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame maṃtreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet \|*  
*vedo'sīti hi maṃtreṇa upavītaṃ pradāpayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bṛhaspateti mantreṇa dadyādvastrāṇi bhānave \|*  
*yena śriyaṃ prakurvāṇāṃ puṣpamālāṃ prayojayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dhūrasīti ca mantreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsaguggulam \|*  
*samiddhoṃ'janamaṃtreṇa aṃjanaṃ tu prayacchati \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yuñjānīti ca maṃtreṇa bhānuṃ rocanayārcayet \|*  
*āraktakaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyuṣṭvāya vai budhaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. With the mantra idam vishnurvichakrame, the arghya should be offered. Then with the mantra Vedo’siti, a yajnopavita should be offered. Then with, Brihaspateti mantra the cloth should be presented to him. With the mantra yen shriyam prakurvanam, the flowers should be offered. With the mantra dhurasiti the incense of guggulu should be offered. With the reciting of the mantra samiddhonjana the collyrium should be offered. Uttering yunjaniti mantra the tilakam should be offered. A learned person should try that the image should be made to appear as red from the head to feet, because by so doing, one achieves long life.

## \|\| 1.202.16-17 \|\|

*sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo raviṃ sarasi pūjayet \|*  
*saṃbhāvayeti maṃtreṇa padmanetre parāmṛśet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*viśvataścakṣurityevaṃ bhānordehaṃ samālabhet \|*  
*śrīśca te lakṣmīśceti maṃtreṇānena pūjayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. With the reciting of the mantra sahasrashirsha purusho, the head of the image should be touched. Then with the mantra-sambhavayeti his eyes should be touched with lotus. Thereafter, reciting mantras the devotee should touch his body and then worship it.

## Chapter 203. Mode of adoration of Surya

## \|\| 1.203.1 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*vyomapūjāvidhiṃ brūhi samāsāccaturānana \|*  
*aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ kathaṃ vyoma pūjayedbhāskarasya tu \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vishnu said — O four faced one, how is the vyoma of eight peaks of Bhaskara, worshipped? You kindly explain it me quite exhaustively.

## \|\| 1.203.2 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*vyomapūjāvidhiṃ kṛṣṇa nibodha gadato mama \|*  
*aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ yathā vyoma pūjayaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Brahma said — I am narrating to you the mode of worship of Ashta-shringa vyoma by the learned people. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.203.3-7 \|\|

*sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kṛtvā cāśmamayaṃ tathā \|*  
*aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ mahābāho anena vidhinārcayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*prathamaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ madhye maṃtreṇa suvrata \|*  
*mahiṣā vo mahāyeti nānāpuṣpakadaṃbakaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*trātāramiṃdraṃ maṃtreṇa sarvaśṛṃgaṃ sadārcayet \|*  
*udīratāmavara ityatha vānena pūjayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*āyaṃ gauriti mantreṇa nairṛ taṃ śṛṃgamarcayet \|*  
*rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ vā pūjayedasurāṃtakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*indrasomāṃtapataye hyatha vānena pūjayet \|*  
*abhitvā śūra no numa aiśānaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. O valorous one, the vyoma is made of the metals like gold, silver, copper or stone, with eight peaks. The Sungod is worshipped in the centre of it. Thereafter, uttering the mantra mahisha vo, sahaya and trataramindra all the peaks should always be adored or otherwise the mantra udiratamavara should be recited. Again with the use of mantra dyam gaurt, the peak of the south-west direction should be adored. Then Asurantaka should be adored using the mantra rakshohana vajinam or Indrasomanta pataye. Then reciting the mantra abhitva shura no numa, the peak of north-east should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.203.8-9 \|\|

*evaṃ bhānuṃ ca paritaḥ pūjayaṃti sadācyuta \|*  
*yenedaṃ bhūtamiti vai atha vānena pūjayeta \|\| 8 \|\|*

*namo'stu sarvapāpebhyo vyomapīṭhaṃ sadārcayet \|*  
*te narāḥ satataṃ kāmānprāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Uttering the mantra yenedam bhutamiti, after worshipping the Sungod, reciting the mantra namo ’stu sarvapdpebhyo, the pedestal of vyoma should always be worshipped, because by so doing, all the desires of a person always get fulfilled. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.203.10 \|\|

*tvameko rudrāṇāṃ vasūnāṃ pūrvāhṇe tena pūjayet \|*  
*tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi vai aparāhne sadārcayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. The Sungod should be worshipped in the forenoon uttering the mantra tvameko rudranam vasunam and with the reciting of mantra tadvishnoh paramampadam the same god should be worshipped in the afternoon.

## \|\| 1.203.11 \|\|

*evaṃ bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjayaṃti sadaspate \|*  
*te sarvānvividhānkāmānprāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thus, a person who worships the Sungod with all other planets, all his desires get fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.203.12-13 \|\|

*vimale vāsasī dattvā gurave sapavitrake \|*  
*upānahau tathā kṛṣṇa sauvarṇamaṃgulīyakam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpāṇi citrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyānyanekaśaḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu sopavāsorcayedravim \|*  
*bahuputro bahudhanaḥ sa naro bhavyavānbhavet \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. O Krishna, the spotless and auspicious costumes should be offered to the Sungod with shores, gold ring, perfumes, flowers and several types of eatables to the Sungod. By this process, a person who observing the fast, worships the Sungod, he achieves enough of sons and enough of riches and fortunes.

## \|\| 1.203.14 \|\|

*uttare cāyane yastu sopavāsorcayedravim \|*  
*sośvamedhaphalaṃ viṃdyādbahuputraśca jāyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A person who observing fast during Uttarayana, worships the Sungod appropriately, he besides earning the merit of performing the ashvamedha sacrifice, also gets several sons.

## \|\| 1.203.15 \|\|

*kṛtvopavāsaṃ viṣuve yastu pūjayate ravim \|*  
*bahuputro bahudhano kīrtimāṃścāpi jāyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. During the equinox time, a person, who while fasting worships the Sungod, he achieves many sons, many riches, fame and glory.

## \|\| 1.203.16 \|\|

*kṛtvopavāsaṃ grahaṇe vidhivaccaṃdrasūryayoḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbhāskaraṃ bhaktyā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. By fasting from the time of solar or lunar eclipse, a person who performs puja with elevation or in a proper way, he achieves Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 1.203.17-18 \|\|

*iti te kathito viṣṇo bhāskarārādhane vidhiḥ \|*  
*yaṃ śrutvā puruṣo bhaktyā mama loke mahīyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*punaretya mahīṃ kṛṣṇa rājā bhavati bhūtale \|*  
*bahu putro bahudhanaḥ samareṣvaparājitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. O Krishna, in this way, I have spoken out the mode of worship of Bhaskara in the form of Vishnu, with the listening of which with devotion, a person achieves my abode when reborn on earth. He becomes a king who is invincible.

## Chapter 204. Mode of Sky or Vyoma Worship

## \|\| 1.204.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ paramapūjitam \|*  
*ratnavyomapratiṣṭhāyāṃ yathā bhānuṃ prapūjayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — Thereafter, I shall speak to you about the establishment of vyoma by the mode of which the Sungod is worshipped. The sacred mode is revealed by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.204.2 \|\|

*arcayitvā tu prakṛtiṃ gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairvibho \|*  
*sahodakenāṃjalinā sahapuṣpākṣatena vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Adoring the image with scent, flowers and unbroken rice, the image should be worshipped. Then, with the hand cup filled with rice and flowers, the oblation of water should be made.

## \|\| 1.204.3 \|\|

*āvāhayenmahādevaṃ khaṣolkaṃ bhāskaraṃ vibhum \|*  
*mantreṇa kuruśārdūla pratyakṣakiraṇāya vai \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Then using the mantras which make him appear, Bhaskara — the great god should be invoked.

## \|\| 1.204.4 \|\|

*oṃ khaṣolkamāvāhayāmi oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaroṃ ādityārādhane mantraḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The mantra Om khasholkamavahayami om bhurbhuvah svaro is used for the invoking as well as the worship of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.204.5 \|\|

*abhimantrya bhuve mātraṃ sāvitryā ca ṛcā vibho \|*  
*āpo hiṣṭheti yā proktā vṛthā sūryasya sarvadā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. With Savitri richa Bhu should be invoked and with Apo histheti mantra, the Sungod should always be invoked and worshipped

## \|\| 1.204.6 \|\|

*yathānyāyaṃ tu saṃkṣālya pūrayeccānyato yataḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatetyanayā kṣālayedbudhaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. By purifying and completing the same, the mantra hiranyagarbhah samavartatetyanaya, the water should be sprinkled.

## \|\| 1.204.7 \|\|

*savitā paścātātsavitā hyanayā pūrayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*ityevaṃ pūrayitvā tu vāri puṣpākṣatairbudhaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. By reciting the mantra Savita prashchatatsavita water should be filled in the cup of fig tree and should be shower before the Sun.

## \|\| 1.204.8-9 \|\|

*pātramaudumbaraṃ gṛhya kṛtsnaṃ sūryasya darśayet \|*  
*udutyaṃ jātavedasamanayā vyomni nikṣipet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi pādyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*nirvāpayecca payasā khaṣolkaṃ snāpayettataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Reciting the mantra udutyam jatavedasamanaya, the water should be poured over vyoma. By uttering the mantra Hamsah shuchishaditi, the water should be offered for the washing of the feet. Thereafter, the image of the Sun should be washed with milk and then with water.

## \|\| 1.204.10-11 \|\|

*agnistu saptabhirvīra kīrtitāstāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*āpo hiṣṭheti ca kramāttisṛbhiḥ kurunaṃdana \|\| 10 \|\|*

*hiraṇyavarṇeti kramāccaturbhiśca narādhipa \|*  
*abhimaṃtryodakamṛgbhistisṛbhi rnikṣipennṛpa \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Reciting the mantras agnishtu saptabhirvira and apo histheti, hiranya varneti, etc. are the four mantras and three richas with which the water should be sanctified and poured over the vyoma.

## \|\| 1.204.12-13 \|\|

*bhānoḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṇuṣvapāja ityapi \|*  
*tya mūṣu vājinaṃ giraḥ prathamā parikīrtitā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*patimiṃdrastavācāma dvitīyā parikīrtitā \|*  
*patimiṃdrastu śuddho na āgahi tṛtīyā parikīrtitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. By reciting the mantras as — krinushvapaja ityamshu vajinam girah then first going round, by uttering patimindrastavachama the second one, and by uttering patimindrastu shuddho na agahi, the third pradikshina should be completed.

## \|\| 1.204.14-15 \|\|

*sidhye vṛtrāṇi jighne śagaṃdhairbhānuṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*asya vāmasyetyanayā akṣataiḥ pūjayedravim \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sapta yuṃjaṃti rathamanayā pūjayedravim \|*  
*puṣpairbharataśārdūla satataṃ tamanāśanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Reciting siddhye vritrani, the fragrance should be offered. By uttering asya vamasye, the unbroken rice should be offered to Surya. His worship has been prescribed with the uttering of sapta yunjani ratham. The Sungod who removes the darkness, should be worshipped offering flowers.

## \|\| 1.204.16-22 \|\|

*ko dadarśa prathama manayā dhūpamādiśet \|*  
*pākaḥ pṛcchāmyanayā caṃdanaṃ pratipādayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*uddīpyasyetyanayā dīpaṃ dadyādvibhāvasoḥ \|*  
*arcitvā kuṃkumaṃ caiva śīrṣaṃ kṣīraṃ tu maṃḍalam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yuktā mātāsītyanayā naivedyaṃ pratipādayet \|*  
*gaurīrmimāyeti dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ samudretyanayā upavītaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*iti saṃpūjya deveśaṃ tataḥ kuryātparāṃ stutim \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ṛgbhirvai paṃcabhistāta śṛṇu caikamanādṛtaḥ \|*  
*ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśniriti ca prathamā parikīrtitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*catvāri vāgiti bhaveddvitīyā parikīrtitā \|*  
*iṃdraṃ mitraṃ tṛtīyā tu varādhikye prakīrtitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ hi tathā caturthī parikīrtitā \|*  
*yo ratnavāhītyanayā kirīṭaṃ yojayedravau \|\| 22 \|\|*

16-22. The sandalpaste should be offered uttering pakah pricchamya; by ko dadarsha the incense; the lamp saying uddipyasya; the saffron mixed in payasam should be offered over his head on the mandala. Again with the reciting of yukta matasitya mantra the eatables should be offered. With the mantra two bright costumes and by saying tasya samudra, the yajnopavita should be offered. Thereafter, the excellent prayer should be offered to him. The said prayer is offered with five reds. The first one is ukshanam, the second is chatvari vagiti; the third one is indram mitram; the fourth one is krishnam niyanam, and the fifth one is yo-ratnavahi. After the offering of fifth red, the kirita crown should be placed over his head.

## \|\| 1.204.23-29 \|\|

*gatehanāmityanayā avyaṃgaṃ bhāskaraṃ nyaset \|*  
*iyamadadādrabhasamṛṇacyutamiti ṛgāditaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kṛtvā pūjāṃ tataścargbhiraṣṭābhiriti cācyuta \|*  
*devasya śaktayo'ṣṭau ca pūjayedvidhivatkramāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ityeṣa te mayākhyātaḥ pratimāpūjane vidhiḥ \|*  
*yaḥ purokto mahābāho brahmaṇā viṣṇave tathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu satataṃ pūjayedravim \|*  
*sa prāpnotyakhilānkāmāniha loke paratra ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam \|*  
*kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ vedārthī vedavidbhavet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*niṣkāmaḥ pūjayedyastu sa mokṣaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā pūjya gataḥ siddhiṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*brahmādayastathā devaṃ pūjayitvā vibhāvasum \|*  
*anena vidhinā pūjya saṃtaḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

23-29. Uttering the mantra gate hanami, Surya should be offered the girdle. Uttering iyamadadadrabhasamrinachyutimi etc. are the eight reds by which all the eight shaktis of Surya should be worshipped in an appropriate manner. O long armed one, the mode of worship of the images, which had been narrated by Brahma for Vishnu has been revealed to you. A person who regularly worships the Sungod, all his desires of the present and future world are made successful. A person desirous of son gets a son, the one desiring riches gets riches, one who desires a daughter gets a daughter and the one who is desirous of knowledge achieves the knowledge of the Vedas. Such of the people who worship the Sungod without any desire, they achieve moksha. By worshipping the Sungod in this manner, Vaishnavas had achieved success. Brahma and the other gods, by adoring the Sun in this way, achieved the excellent success.

## Chapter 205. Worship of Mahadeva

## \|\| 1.205.1 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*punarnibodha me bhīṣma gadataḥ paramaṃ vidhim \|*  
*yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevaṃ divā karam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vyasa said — O Bhishma, the best mode by which lord Bhaskara is worshipped, is being spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.205.2-3 \|\|

*prabhūtaṃ nirmalaṃ teja ārādhya paramaṃ sukham \|*  
*pūrvamaṃtastathāgneyyāṃ nairṛtyāṃ pavanālaye \|\| 2 \|\|*

*krameṇa yāvadīśānaṃ hṛdi bījaṃ ca vinyaset \|*  
*bhāskarāsanametattu nyastavyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. The resplendent and spotless ball of lustre, when adored, bestows enormous comforts. The hridaya-nyasa should be performed from east, south-west, south-east, north-west, northeast respectively, uttering the bija-mantra. It is because the people well-versed in the tattvas have described it as the seat of Bhaskara.

## \|\| 1.205.4-6 \|\|

*upariṣṭāttatastasya hṛdayena tu paṃkajam \|*  
*aṣṭapatraṃ keśarālaṃ paṃcavarṇasakeśaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dīptādi pūrvamārabhya āmahādevagocaram \|*  
*śaktyaṣṭakaṃ nyasenmaṃtrairāditaḥ sarvatomukhīm \|\| 5 \|\|*

*abījaiḥ kesarāgreṣu krameṇaiva ca pūjayet \|*  
*tatastvāvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. The eight petalled lotus is above it with pericarp. It should be decorated with five types of lines in different colours. From east, the start should be made with flash light and thereafter, all the shaktis of the Sungod should be worshipped after invoking them out of them, the goddess Sarvatomukhi should be adored with flowers in the middle. With a mantra other than the bija-mantra, after their invoking and worship, the Sungod should be established over the pericarp.

## \|\| 1.205.7-9 \|\|

*tasyopahṛtya taṃ cānyaṃ veditavyaṃ khapuṣkaram \|*  
*tenaivāvāhanaṃ cārcya sthāpanaṃ cārdhameva ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pādyamācamanaṃ sthānaṃ vastragaṃdhādibhūṣaṇam \|*  
*vidhinā vīrapuṣpāṇi naivedyaṃ dhūpameva ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kartavyaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā evaṃ tuṣyati bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*mahāpātakino'pyāśu labhaṃte ciṃtitaṃ phalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. All of them should be invoked and worshipped offering arghya to them. Similarly, the water for washing of the feet should also be offered with devotion, reciting the Khasholaka mantra. Similarly, water for washing feet, arghya, sipping, bathing, costumes, flowers, eatables, incense, should also be offered with devotion, which please the Sungod. By thus worshipping, the desires of the grave sinners are also fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.205.10 \|\|

*ādityaṃ pūjayitvā tu paścādaṃgāni pūjayet \|*  
*dīptāyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya bhavānyā śiraso nyaset \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Worshipping the Sungod first, his limbs should also be worshipped in which for the sake of dipta (flame), Hridaya nyasa and for Bhavani, Shiraso nyasa should be performed.

## \|\| 1.205.11 \|\|

*digvidikṣu nyasedastramiṃdrādi diśottarāṃtikam \|*  
*karṇikāyāṃ nyasennetraṃ svabījena tu vārcayeta \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Astra should be in the north direction, while Indra and other gods should be established. The eyes should be worshipped in the pericarp reciting the bija-mantra.

## \|\| 1.205.12-16 \|\|

*puṣpairgaṃdhaiśca dhūpaiśca hṛdayāni krameṇa tu \|*  
*pūjayitvā tu vidhivadgarbhaṃ paścāttu maṃtravit \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bāhyataḥ pūrvato maṃdaṃ dakṣiṇena budhaṃ tathā \|*  
*viṣāṇaṃ paścime pūjya uttareṇa tu bhārgavam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*āgneyyāṃ ca kujaṃ pūjya nairṛtyāṃ bhānudehajam \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ pūjayetkṛṣṇamaiśānyāṃ vikacaṃ nṛpa \|\| 14 \|\|*

*indrādilokapālāṃśca tato'ṣṭau pūjayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*sugaṃdhairvividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaiścaiva manoramaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*krameṇa pūjayedbhānuṃ lokapālairgrahaiḥ saha \|*  
*maṃtraiḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

12-16. Thereafter, using flowers, perfume and incense, the heart should be worshipped. In this way, the priest well-versed in the mantras, should worship the gods lodged in the womb. Thereafter, the gods who are lodged outside should be worshipped. Saturn is lodged in the east, Budha in south, Ganesha in the west, Shukra in the north, eight Indras in south-east, besides the other Lokapalas. With several types of fragrant flowers and pleasant incense, Surya with lokapalas should be worshipped for one’s own welfare.

## \|\| 1.205.17-18 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yatra devaḥ saṃpūjyate raviḥ \|*  
*na caurāgnibhayaṃ tatra na cāpi narakādbhayam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*varṣopalaviṣādibhyo bhayaṃ tatra na vidyate \|*  
*sukhamārogyamānaṃdaṃ subhikṣamacalāṃ śriyam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The region in which the Sungod is worshipped appropriately, there is no danger of theft, fire and hell. Similarly, the dangers from rain, snow, stones and poison also vanish from there. To the contrary, good health, comforts, bliss, plenty of food and unfading riches are available to the people there.

## \|\| 1.205.19 \|\|

*tejobiṃbāṃtamadhyastha ādityaḥ paramārthataḥ \|*  
*yaṣṭavyaḥ sādhakairnityaṃ na ratho na ca vājinaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A devotee should always worship a resplendent image for the sake of others always and not of the chariot or the horses.

## \|\| 1.205.20-21 \|\|

*ityeṣa vidhirākhyāto mayā bhīṣma tavākhilaḥ \|*  
*yena pūjayate nityaṃ mahādevo divākaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

*itthaṃ pūjya vivasvantaṃ hṛdbījena visarjayet \|*  
*ya evaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. O Bhishma, I have explained to you the entire procedure by which the Sungod should be daily worshipped. After the worship of the Sungod, the deity should be sent off using hridvija. Those who worship thus the Sungod, attain the highest position.

## Chapter 206. Glory of the Sun Worship

## \|\| 1.206.1 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*maṃtroddhāraṃ paraṃ brūhi mudrāśaktisamanvitam \|*  
*rūpavarṇa samaṃ caiva paurāṇikamanuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bhishma said — You please tell me the basis on which mantras of the Puranas, his complexions with shaktis and mudras of Surya have been prescribed?

## \|\| 1.206.2 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu bhīṣma mahābāho yathā vakṣyāmi tenagha \|*  
*paurāṇikānāṃ maṃtrāṇāmuddhāraṃ vaidikādṛte \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Vyasa said — O immensely valorous Bhishma, I am speaking to you the reformation of the Sungod on the basic of the Puranas, in which the Vedic literature has nothing to say. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.206.3-5 \|\|

*varṇarephasamāyuktaṃ vidrumenaiva bhūṣitam \|*  
*aṃtasthānāṃ hi aṃtyaṃ vai brahmadaivatyamucyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*biṃdurephasamāyuktaṃ dīrghayā mātrayā tathā \|*  
*dīkṣākṣaraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ dvitīyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tṛtīyaṃ tu tathā proktaṃ savisargaṃ janādhipa \|*  
*sa tṛtīyo budhaiḥ prokto rudradaivata eva hi \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. The letter Ra is the Brahmadeva. This has been revealed. With the bindu and the N vowel, the letter Ram is formed. The second one is said to be the prominent letter for diksha of lord Vishnu. Then Ra with colon, Ra which Rudradeva is prominent, has been described as such by the people of wisdom.

## \|\| 1.206.6 \|\|

*bhāskaroyaṃ mahānsākṣānmaṃtramūrtistrirakṣaraḥ \|*  
*durlabhaḥ paramo guhyastridevo devapūjitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. With these three letters (ra, ram and rah) the lord Bhaskara is conceived, who a difficult to be achieved, extremely secret. They represent the three gods and are adored by the gods. He represents the form of mantra himself.

## \|\| 1.206.7 \|\|

*yastvidaṃ japate bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|*  
*tataśca mudrāṃ vakṣyāmi sānnidhya kāraṇaṃ param \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A person who recites the same with devotion, he achieves the excellent position or salvation. Now, I am revealing before you the postures by which one can achieve the vicinity of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.206.8 \|\|

*padmākārau karau kṛtvā madhye śliṣṭe tu madhyame \|*  
*aṃguliṃ kṣārayettasminvimudreti ca socyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The fingers of both the hands should be held together like a lotus. Both the little fingers should be joined, bent in the middle and then separated. This is called the special posture.

## \|\| 1.206.9 \|\|

*anayā baddhayā rājanbhāskarasya priyo bhavet \|*  
*mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu mātṛvatparirakṣati \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Having been bound with this mudra or posture, a person becomes the favourite of the Sungod, who protects him like a mother, when he is facing a grave danger.

## \|\| 1.206.10-12 \|\|

*hṛdayaṃ tasya vijñeyaṃ yadakṣaravaraṃ smṛtam \|*  
*vidrumopari saṃchannaṃ hṛdgataṃ tadgataṃ sadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śirasyarkamiti proktaṃ devadevasya bhārata \|*  
*mahāvyāhṛtayastisrastathārajvālinī śikhā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*aṣṭākṣarā tu vidyeyamādityasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ smaretsādhakastvenaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. The said excellent letter should be treated as his heart. Having been cut off from the coral tree, it has been said to be the headgear of the Sungod. His flame in the form of a tuft is in the form of ra, the three mystic words like Jvalini with tuft besides the letter ra. The Mahavyahritis (three in number) are believed to be the eight lettered Vidyas of the Sungod. With the mere recalling of them, the devotee does not have to face any type of danger.

## \|\| 1.206.13 \|\|

*akāreṇa samāyuktaṃ biṃdurephasamanvitam \|*  
*hakāramagnidaivatyaṃ kavacaṃ bhāskarapriyam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Akara with a bindu, with repha (the letter ra placed over the following consonant) and the prominent god of hakara is the fire. The mantra sum hum is known as the kavacha of protection of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.206.14 \|\|

*ekākṣaramidaṃ proktamabhedyaṃ yaḥ smaredidam \|*  
*duṣṭānāṃ caiva vighnānāṃ nāśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. This Ekakshara is the favourite kavacha of Surya, which is impregnable. With its mere recall, all the obstructions and wicked people get destroyed. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.206.15 \|\|

*savisargo repha iti astramekākṣaraṃ smṛtam \|*  
*nāśayedduṣṭakarmāṇi sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Then ra with visarga (colon) is ekakshara astra and it destroys the end greeds of the devotee. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.206.16-18 \|\|

*saṃmukhau tau karau kṛtvā śliṣṭau tu grathitāṃgulī \|*  
*kaniṣṭhenāmike yojye tarjanyau madhyame tathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*hṛcchiraḥ saśikhā carmā mudreyaṃ vyomasaṃjñitā \|*  
*muṣṭivakrocchritaṃ kuryātsavyahastasya tarjanīm \|\| 17 \|\|*

*mālaśabdakṛtādistu mudrā hyastrasya kīrtitā \|*  
*trāsanī nāma vikhyātā sarvaviprabhayaṃkarī \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Both the hands should be held before a I person, joining the fingers. The little finger, ring finger and the middle one should be joined and should be held together. In this way, the tuft without head has been conceived as vyoma. Tightening the first in a curved manner, the forefinger should be kept raised and has been described as the Mala posture of astra. Because it removes all the hurdles, it is also called Trasani (the horrible one).

## \|\| 1.206.19 \|\|

*karṇabiṃdusamāyuktaṃ yaṃ caturthaṃ mahāmate \|*  
*bhāskarasya tvidaṃ netramagridaivatamucyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O intelligent one, with karna-bindu, it has been described as the fourth eye of the Sun, of which the fire god is the prominent deity.

## \|\| 1.206.20-21 \|\|

*smaraḥ syātsādhakeṃdrāṇāṃ duraṃto nāśane dhruvam \|*  
*madhyamā tarjanī caiva savyahastasya cocchritam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kaniṣṭhānāmike kuṃcya aṃguṣṭhena tataḥ kramet \|*  
*netrābhyāṃ sparśayedenāṃ netramudrā prakīrtitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. The posture in which the middle and tarjani remain raised, it removes the dangers of the devotees being out of his reach for them. The ring finger and little finger collectively with the thumb should be joined and the eyes should be touched with the same. This is called the netra mudra.

## \|\| 1.206.22-23 \|\|

*govṛṣā nāma vikhyātā darśayeddivyagocaram \|*  
*rāṃ dīptāriṃ tataḥ sūkṣmārīṃ jayā bhīṣma ucyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ubhāhvārūṃ vibhūtiśca vimalā reṃ prakīrtitā \|*  
*aghahā ca mahābāho vidyutā rauṃ prakīrtitā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Ram is also known as Govrisha by means of which an audience with god is possible. O Bhishma, Rām is known as Diksha (initiation), Rim is known as Sukshma (subtle), Rīm is Jaya (victory), Rum is Vibhuti (majesty), Raim is Vimala (spotless) and Raum is Aghaha (unfailing) and is Vidyuta (lightning).

## \|\| 1.206.24 \|\|

*govṛṣā nāma raṃ sarvaṃ vīrabhadrakarī tathā \|*  
*ityetā bījarūpāstu kathitāścaiva śaktayaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Govrisha is also named as Ram who is all pervading all powerful. Thus the Shaktis of the seed form have been highlighted.

## \|\| 1.206.25-27 \|\|

*uttānau tu karau kṛtvā savyākuṃcya tatoṃgulīḥ \|*  
*kuryādupari cāṃguṣṭhau cālayeta punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarvāsāṃ caiva śaktīnāmetā mudrāḥ pradarśayet \|*  
*nāmnā ca vidyutā caiva navamī sarvatomukhī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*nāmānyetāni śaktīnāṃ samāsātkathitāni tu \|*  
*sabījāni mahābāho mayā snehena bhārata \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Both the hands should be made to lay on back, the fingers of the right hand should be contracted. The thumbs should then be raised and moved repeatedly. This particular posture should be displayed for all the shaktis. O Bharata, O Mahabaho, in this way, I have revealed the facts above all the Shaktis with their seeds.

## \|\| 1.206.28-30 \|\|

*grahāṇāṃ śṛṇu bījāni rūpaṃ ca gadato mama \|*  
*sarvatra bhaṃ tathā khaṃ ca kaṃjakūtuhalodvaha \|\| 28 \|\|*

*oṃkārā dīpitāḥ sarve namaskārāṃtayojitāḥ \|*  
*pūjākāle prayoktavyā japakāle tathaiva ca \|\| 29 \|\|*

*homakāle tu svāhāṃtaṃ maṃtraṃ ṣaṭkārasaṃyutam \|*  
*sarve biṃduyutā bhīṣma śikhā biṃduvibhūṣitāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Now, I am relating the seeds of the planets. You please listen. O born of the anxiety of Brahman, in the seeds of the planets, bham and kham are to be uttered ahead of Omkara and the word namah should be added at the end irrespective of its being the time of adoration or japam. While performing homa, the word svaha should always be added at the end of the mantra. O Bhishma, in this way, all the planets from the Moon to Ketu are all decorated with a bindu tuft.

## \|\| 1.206.31-32 \|\|

*somādyāḥ ketuparyaṃtā grahā hyevaṃ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*etā mudrāḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhipradāyikāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sumukhau tu karau kṛtvā śliṣṭau caiva prasāritau \|*  
*iyaṃ mudrā namaskāre grahasānnidhyakārikā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. After describing these, I am going to deal with the different postures, which bestow all the success on a person. First of all, the Sumukha mudra (the pleasant one) should be made with the fingers of both the hands, then the joined fingers should be spread. With the use of this posture, one achieves the vicinity of the planets. The same process is repeated in the namaskara mudra.

## \|\| 1.206.33-37 \|\|

*maṃtroddhārastavākhyāto rahasyo durlabho nṛpa \|*  
*śṛṇuṣva rūpaṃ devānāṃ dhyānakāle hyupasthite \|\| 33 \|\|*

*japāvarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ śvetapadmopari sthitam \|*  
*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tathaikavaktraṃ dvibhujaṃ somapaṃkajakaṃdharam \|*  
*maṃḍalena ca rūpaṃ tu madhyasthaṃ raktavāsasam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*mārtaṃḍasya idaṃ rūpaṃ śuciḥ snāto jiteṃdriyaḥ \|*  
*trikālaṃ yaḥ smaredbhīma ekacitto vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*so'cirādbhavate loke vittena dhanadopamaḥ \|*  
*mucyate sarvabhogaistu tejasvī balavānbhavet \|\| 37 \|\|*

33-37. Thus, the mantroddhara which is difficult to be achieved, has been spoken to you. Now, you listen to the forms of the gods who are present at the time of dhyanam (meditation). The lord Martanda should be conceived as having the complexion of white rose, resplendent, standing over the white lotus, possessing all the auspicious symbols, having a single face, two arms, having a neck resembling the moon or a lotus, lodged in a mandala and clad in red costumes. A person, who getting disciplined, takes a bath and getting fully purified, meditates on this form of Surya, he gets enriched soon in this world like Kubera is relieved of all the sufferings and becomes strong and resplendent.

## \|\| 1.206.38-39 \|\|

*hṛdayaṃ cottamāṃgaṃ ca śikhā vai vaktrameva ca \|*  
*raktavarṇā ime śyāmāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*varadā'bhayahastāśca dhyātavyā sādhakena tu \|*  
*taḍitpuṃjanibhaṃ śastraṃ raudraṃ caṃdrakarālinam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The devotee should meditate upon his heart, head, tuft, face, red complexion and the body adorned with all the ornaments, projecting Varada and Abhaya hand postures. Similarly, he is ferocious like the lightning and heap of lustre, holding a sword as a weapon.

## \|\| 1.206.40 \|\|

*viśeṣaḥ kathito hyeṣa kāmarūpaḥ svabhāvataḥ \|*  
*dīptā dīptaśikhākārā dhyātavyā mama śaktayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Thus, his form which changes at will, has also been described. My Shaktis which have the form of shining tuft, including Dipta and others should also be meditated upon always.

## \|\| 1.206.41-47 \|\|

*śvetavarṇaṃ smaretsomaṃ raktavarṇaṃ kujaṃ smaret \|*  
*saumyamaṣṭāpadābhaṃ ca guruṃ ca pītavarṇakam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śaṃkhakṣīranibhaṃ śvetaṃ kāṇaṃ cāṃjanasaṃnibham \|*  
*rajāvartanibhaṃ rāhuṃ dhūmraṃ ca vikacaṃ smaret \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vāmahastau kaṭinyastau dakṣiṇau cābhayapradau \|*  
*raktabhrūraktanetrāsya ardhakāyakṛtāṃjaliḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*iti bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ ye dhyāyaṃti nṛpottama \|*  
*labhaṃte te mahāsiddhimacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tavākhyātamidaṃ vaktraṃ grahāṇāṃ bhīṣma kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyaṃte bhuvi mānavāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā bhīṣma sadā devaṃ divākaram \|*  
*trikālaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā vīra śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*itthaṃ pūjayamānastu sarvadevaṃ divākaram \|*  
*brahmahatyāvinirmukto mahādevatvamāpnuyāt \|\| 47 \|\|*

41-47. The moon is of white complexion, while Mars is of red complexion. Budha is of green complexion. Jupiter is of yellow colour. Venus (Shukra) is of white colour like conch, while Saturn is of collyrium like black colour. Rahu is of smoky colour, while Ketu has the smoke like complexion. A person whose both the left hands are held at the waist, both the right hands display Abhaya mudra, and who worships the Sungod whose eyes and eyebrows are red, half the body is like anjali, along with planets, he soon achieves the great success. There is no doubt about it. O Bhishma, I have described about the faces of all the planets, listening to which, a person a relieved of all the sins. Thus, the Sungod should be worshipped at all the three times, with devotion. The persons who worship the Sungod in such a manner, they getting relieved of the sins like Brahmahatya, achieve the position of Mahadeva.

## Chapter 207. Mode of Aditya worship

## \|\| 1.207.1 \|\|

*bhīṣma uvāca \|*  
*aho devasya māhātmyaṃ bhāskarasya tvayoditam \|*  
*pūjayaṃti sadā hyenaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Bhishma said — You have already spoken about the glory of the Sungod with its mode. It is quite surprising that even Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva also adore him.

## \|\| 1.207.2 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*evametanna saṃdeho yathā vadasi bhārata \|*  
*nāsti sūryasamo devo nāsti sūryasamā gatiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Vyasa said — Whatever you have said is correct. There is no about it. There is no god comparable with the Sungod, nor is there any salvation found comparable with the one bestowed by him.

## \|\| 1.207.3 \|\|

*nāsti sūryasamaṃ brahma nāsti sūryasamaṃ hutam \|*  
*nāsti sūryasamo dharmo nāsti sūryasamaṃ dhanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. The gods like Brahma, Agni, Dharma and even riches are of no significance before him.

## \|\| 1.207.4 \|\|

*nāsti sūryādṛte kāmo nāsti sūryādṛte padam \|*  
*nāsti sūryasamo baṃdhurnāsti sūryasamaḥ suhṛt \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. There is no position without the Sungod. There is no relative better than the Sungod. There is no friend better than the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.207.5 \|\|

*nāsti sūryasamā mātā nāsti sūryasamo guruḥ \|*  
*nāsti sūryasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na pavitraṃ tataḥ param \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The mother, the preceptor and the auspicious place of pilgrimage are of no consequence before him.

## \|\| 1.207.6 \|\|

*tamekaṃ daivataṃ vidyānnaivāpyarkaparāyaṇam \|*  
*lokānāṃ devatānāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ cāpi bhārata \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The Sungod is the only prominent god of gods and manes. There is no completion better than the Surya parayana.

## \|\| 1.207.7 \|\|

*tamarcaṃtaḥ stuvaṃtaśca prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ gatim \|*  
*te prapannāstu ye bhaktyā muktāste bhavasāgarāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A person who adores him, achieves the highest position (salvation). A person who takes refuge in him with devotion, is freed from the ocean of the universe.

## \|\| 1.207.8 \|\|

*rājā corā grahāḥ sarpā dāridryaṃ duḥkhasaṃpadaḥ \|*  
*naite pīḍayituṃ śaktāḥ prasanne bhāskare sati \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. When the Sungod is pleased, the kings, thieves, planets, serpents, poverty, means of suffering, never trouble a person.

## \|\| 1.207.9-10 \|\|

*vyāsa uvāca \|*  
*evaṃ tāta mahābāho devo bhāskaratatparaḥ \|*  
*sa pūjyaḥ sa namaskāryaḥ sa hi dhyātavya eva ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pratyakṣadevatā hyeṣā devadevoyamādarāt \|*  
*atha kiṃ bahunoktena yadvakṣyāmi nibodha me \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Vyasa said — O valorous one, a person who has resolved to perform worship of the Sungod, should adore and offer salutation to him besides meditating on him. He is the visible god and is respectable god of gods. What more can be said? You listen to whatever is happening.

## \|\| 1.207.11 \|\|

*pūjayettanayaḥ pāpī tathādityadinairapi \|*  
*pūjayanti narā ye vai te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The worship of the Sungod is a must on Sundays for all. Irrespective of the worshipper being a grave sinner, whosoever worships him he achieves salvation.

## \|\| 1.207.12 \|\|

*prāpte sūryadine bhaktyā bhānuṃ saṃpūjya śraddhayā \|*  
*naktaṃ karoti puruṣaḥ sa yātyamaraloktām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On the arrival of a Sunday, performing the worship of the Sungod with faith and devotion when a person observes the night fast, he surely achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 1.207.13 \|\|

*yastu pūrvaṃ raverbhaktyā pañcaratnasamanvitam \|*  
*nivedayati maṃtreṇa sa yātyamaralokatām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A person, who with utmost devotion, offers him pancharatna reciting the mantra, he surely achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 1.207.14 \|\|

*mārtaṃḍaprītaye yastu kuryācchrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*saṃkrāntāvayane vīra sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. On the first day of the month or on the day of ayana, one who perform Shraddha to please him, he achieves the place of Surya.

## \|\| 1.207.15 \|\|

*kṛtvopavāsaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu saptamyāṃ yastu mānavaḥ \|*  
*karoti vidhivacchrāddhaṃ bhāskaraḥ prīyatāmiti \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Observing fast on the day of Shashthi, when a person performs Shraddha on the day of Saptami, Bhaskara gets pleased with the same.

## \|\| 1.207.16-17 \|\|

*sarvadoṣavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|*  
*mānavo yastu saptamyāṃ yoṣidvāpi divākaram \|\| 16 \|\|*

*prapūjya vidhivadbhānuṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|*  
*viśeṣatastasya dine grahaṇe ca narādhipa \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. He getting relieved of all the blemishes, gains honour in the Suryaloka. When a man or a woman worships the Sungod particularly on the day of the solar eclipse, all his or her desires gets fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.207.18 \|\|

*iti bhīṣma vijānīhi na devo bhāskarātpriyaḥ \|*  
*ādityamekaṃ paramaṃ devadeveṣu pūjitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. One should know only this much, there is no other god clearer than the Sungod, because even the leaders of the gods worship him.

## \|\| 1.207.19-23 \|\|

*ratnaparvatamāruhya yathā bhuvi narādhipāḥ \|*  
*sattvānurūpaṃ gacchanti ratnabhāgānaśeṣataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tathā bhānuṃ samārādhya prāpnuvaṃti narāḥ phalam \|*  
*dhanārthī prāpnuyādarthaṃ putrārthī prāpnuyātsutam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*mokṣārthī mokṣamāpnoti cātha vā'maratāṃ vrajet \|*  
*atha kiṃ bahunoktena śṛṇu tvaṃ vacanaṃ mama \|\| 21 \|\|*

*brahmādayo devagaṇā bhānumārādhya bhārata \|*  
*manoharāṇi divyāni divi sthānānyavāpnuvan \|\| 22 \|\|*

*acalāni mahābhāgāḥ sarvapāpaharāṇi ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

19-23. As the rulers of the earth collect the gems reaching the peak of the mountain of gems as per their strength, similarly, the people by adoring Bhaskara, achieve all the merits. Those desirous of riches get the riches, those desirous of son get the son and those desirous of moksha achieve moksha and become eternal as well. What more should I speak about it? You should know only this much that Brahma and other gods have achieved the divine places in the heaven after worshipping of the Sungod. He is the one who removes all the sins and is himself endowed with enormous fortunes.

## \|\| 1.207.24 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ityuktvā bhagavānvyāsastatraivāṃtaradhīyata \|*  
*bhīṣmo'pi pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā bhānuṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Sumantu said — Thus speaking, lord Vyasa suddenly disappeared from that place. Thereafter, Bhishma also performed the worship of the Sungod in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 1.207.25-26 \|\|

*tathā tvamapi rājendra pūjayemaṃ divākaram \|*  
*pūjayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā sthānaṃ yāsyasi śāśvatam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*yathā gataḥ sa bhagavānvyāso bhīṣmaśca mānada \|*  
*sakṛtprapūjya saptamyāṃ bhaktyā devaṃ divākaram \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. O Rajendra, similarly, you also worship Divakara with devotion and by so doing, you shall also achieve the eternal place. O praiseworthy one, Vyasa and Bhishma by once adoring the Sungod on saptami day, achieved the same place (you also do the same).

## Chapter 208. Mode of Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 1.208.1 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*punarme brūhi saptamyāṃ prītaye bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*upoṣito bhavatīha naro yastu dvijottama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Shatanika said — O intelligent one, best of Brahmanas, in order to please Bhaskara, the people have to observe fasting. You kindly tell me the same.

## \|\| 1.208.2-3 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*kathitāḥ sapta saptamyaḥ punarasminmahāmate \|*  
*bahavaḥ kuruśārdūla bhūyastvetāḥ śṛṇuṣva me \|\| 2 \|\|*

*svayaṃ yāḥ kathitāḥ pūrvamādityena khagādhipa \|*  
*aruṇasya mahābāho saptamyaḥ sapta pūjitāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Sumantu said — O intelligent one, though have already spelt out the mode of performing all the saptami vratas but still, O lion of Kuru race, I am repeating details of the same. O valorous lord of birds, you listen to the mode of observing vratas of the seven Saptamis, which had been earlier explained by the Sungod to Aruna and is being repeated by me.

## \|\| 1.208.4-7 \|\|

*arkasaṃpuṭakairekā dvitīyā maricaistathā \|*  
*tṛtīyā niṃbapatraiśca caturthī phalasaptamī \|\| 4 \|\|*

*anodanā pañcamī syātṣaṣṭhī vijayasaptamī \|*  
*saptamī kāmikā jñeyā vidhiṃ tāsāṃ nibodha me \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śuklapakṣe ravidine dakṣiṇe cottarāyaṇe \|*  
*grahaṇe sūryanakṣatre gṛhṇīyātsapta saptamī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sa tāṃ su brahmacārī syācchaucayukto jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*sūryārcanarato dāṃto japahomaparastathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. In the first Saptami vrata, the mode of Arka-samputa has been prescribed. Similarly, in the second Saptami, the parana of black pepper has been prescribed. In third Saptami, myrobalan has been prescribed. In the fourth one, some fruit is to be used; in the fifth something else besides the boiled rice is to be used; the sixth one is known Vijaya Saptami and the seventh one is known as the Kamika Saptami. I am going to narrate the modes of their observation. On the bright Sunday, when Sun is moving to the Narayana or Dakshinayana, on the day of solar eclipse, or the first day of the month, the process of all the seven Saptamis should be started. Getting disciplined, observing purity, observing chastity (Brahmacharya), the worship of the Sun should be performed together with japam and homa.

## \|\| 1.208.8-10 \|\|

*pañcamyāmeva puruṣaḥ kuryānnitya manātmakam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ na maithunaṃ gacchenmadhumāṃsaṃ ca varjayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*arkasaṃpuṭakairekāṃ tathānyāṃ maricairnayet \|*  
*tathāparāṃ niṃbapatraiḥ phalākhyāyāṃ phalaṃ caret \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anodanāmannarahita upāsīta yathāvidhi \|*  
*ahorātraṃ vāyubhakṣaḥ kuryādvijayasaptamīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. A person should free himself from ignorance on the fifth moon day and on the sixth moon day, should discard sex activities and the eating of non-vegetarian food besides wine. Thereafter, on the first Saptami day, Arka samputa should be performed; on the second the black pepper and nima leaves; on the third, with fruit; on the fourth and on the fifth Saptamis he should not consume the boiled rice, such that it is known as the one without cereals. He should inhale only the air during the night. The sixth one is Vijaya — saptami and it should be properly observed.

## \|\| 1.208.11 \|\|

*tathaikāṃ saptamīṃ kṛtvā pratimāsaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*kuryādyathāvidhi mudā tataḥ kurvīta kāmikām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thus, an intelligent person should perform the Saptami vrata appropriately. Thereafter, the vrata of each Saptami should be observed in an appropriate manner. Then, he should perform the process of the Kamika Saptami which happens to be the seventh one.

## \|\| 1.208.12 \|\|

*āsāṃ likhitvā nāmāni patrakeṣu pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*tāni sarvāṇi patrāṇi kṣipedabhinave ghaṭe \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. By writing their names one each on each one of the pages, each one of them should be separately kept in individual vases.

## \|\| 1.208.13 \|\|

*tadarthaṃ yo na jānāti lokavāhyopi vā naraḥ \|*  
*tena hyuddhārayedekaṃ na kuryācca vicāraṇām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. A person, who is unable to know its meaning, irrespective of his being a Charvaka (a non-believer), he is redeemed. There is nothing to be thought about it in this connection.

## \|\| 1.208.14-15 \|\|

*tenaiva vidhinā yastu pratimāsaṃ ca tattapaḥ \|*  
*saptaiva yāvatsaptamyo vijñeyā sā tu kāmikā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ityetāḥ sapta saptamyaḥ svayaṃ proktā vivasvatā \|*  
*kurvīta yo naro bhaktyā sa yātyarkasado nṛpa \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Similarly, at the completion of the Saptami vrata of each month, the conclusion of the seventh Saptami known as Kamika Saptami should be made. In this way, the process of all the Saptami vratas should be concluded, as has been ordained by the Sungod himself. The people who complete the process with devotion, they achieve the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.208.16-17 \|\|

*arkasaṃpuṭakairvittamacalaṃ saptapauruṣam \|*  
*maricaiḥ saṃgamaḥ syādvai priyaiḥ putrādibhiḥ sadā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sarvarogāḥ praṇaśyaṃti niṃbapatrairna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*phalaistu putrapautrāśca dauhitraścāpi puṣkalaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The vrata of Saptami with Arka samputa is when performed by a person, he surely attains riches and all the seven powers. With the observing of the Saptami of black pepper one gets dear sons. By observing the Saptami of leaves of myrobalan, the ailments disappear. There is no doubt about it. Similarly, with the observing of Phala — saptami one gets sons, grandsons, and the grandsons from daughter’s side as well.

## \|\| 1.208.18 \|\|

*ato dhanaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā \|*  
*tathā paśurhiraṇyaṃ ca ārogyaṃ satataṃ nṛpa \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Besides that, one gets riches, cereals, gold, silver, animals and good health for all times to come.

## \|\| 1.208.19 \|\|

*upoṣya vijayāṃ śatrūnrājañjayati nityaśaḥ \|*  
*sādhayetkāmadā kāmānvidhivatsamupāsitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O king, in the same way, by observing the sixth Vijaya-saptami, one becomes victorious over his enemies and when Kamika Saptami is observed in a proper manner, all the desires of the performer get fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.208.20 \|\|

*putrakāmo labhetputramarthakāmorthamakṣayam \|*  
*vidyākāmo labhedvidyāṃ rājyārthī rājyamāpnuyāt \|*  
*kṛtsnānkāmāndadātyeṣā kāmadā kurunandana \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. A person desirous of a son gets the son; one desirous of riches gets the riches; a student gets education; and the one desirous of the kingdom gets the same. O son of Kuru race, with the observing of Kamada Saptami, all the desires of the performer get fulfilled.

## \|\| 1.208.21 \|\|

*naro vā yadi vā nārī yathoktaṃ saptamīvratam \|*  
*karoti niyatātmā vai sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Whenever a man or a woman concludes the Saptami vrata in an appropriate manner, he or she achieves the supreme position or the salvation.

## \|\| 1.208.22 \|\|

*na teṣāṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcidastīti durlabham \|*  
*ye bhaktyā lokanāthasya vratinaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. With the performing of the vratas of Surya the leader of the world regularly in an appropriate manner, nothing remains beyond the reach of the performer.

## \|\| 1.208.23-24 \|\|

*vrataistu vividhairvīra tapobhirvā suduṣkaraiḥ \|*  
*na tatphalamavāpnoti yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tīrthābhiṣecanairvāpi dānahomārcanaistathā \|*  
*yatphalaṃ ca pūjayituṃ saptamyāṃ prāpya mokṣadam \|*  
*mokṣārthī pārthivaśreṣṭha yathāha bhagavānraviḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. The extent of merits one achieves with the performing of several vratas, hard tapas, the yajnas with enormous dakshina, going to pilgrimages, charities, homa and meditation, are not so enormous as one gets with the performing of the moksha Saptami vrata. This has been revealed by the Sungod himself.

## \|\| 1.208.25 \|\|

*kṛtvādityadine naktaṃ bhaktyā saṃpūjayedravim \|*  
*acalaṃ sthānamāpnoti mānavaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*sūryaloke ca niyataṃ tasya vāso na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. After performing the night vrata with faith and devotion, one who worships the Sungod on Sunday, he achieves the unshakable place and stays in the Suryaloka forever. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.208.26 \|\|

*yastu pūjayate bhaktyā saptamyāṃ bhāskaraṃ naraḥ \|*  
*brahmeṃdrarudralokeṣu tasyāpratihatā gatiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. A person who with devotion, worships the Sungod on the day of Saptami, he reaches the abode of Brahma, Indra and Rudra, with unrestricted speed.

## \|\| 1.208.27 \|\|

*nāṃdho na kuṣṭhī na klībo na vyaṃgo na ca nirdhanaḥ \|*  
*kule tasya bhavedvīra yaścaretsaptamīvratam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. A person who regularly performs the process of Saptami vrata in his race, none becomes blind, leper, eunuch, deformed or pauper in his race.

## \|\| 1.208.28 \|\|

*vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt \|*  
*bhāryārthī rūpasaṃpannāṃ striyaṃ putrāṃśca bhārata \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The students (by observing Surya vratas) get educated, the person desirous of riches gets riches, one desirous of a wife gets a beautiful woman and sons.

## \|\| 1.208.29-30 \|\|

*lobhātpramādānmohācca vratabhaṃgo yadā bhavet \|*  
*tadā trirātraṃ nāśnīyātkuryādvā keśamuṃḍanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*prāyaścittamidaṃ kṛtvā punareva vratī bhavet \|*  
*saptaiva yāvatsaptamyo bhavaṃti ca khageśvara \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. In case, the vratas are obstructed because of greed, confusion or arrogance, then the concerned person should fast for three nights or should have his head shaved as a repentance and restart the vratas. O lord of the birds, by so doing, he achieves the competence to perform all the seven vratas of Saptami.

## \|\| 1.208.31 \|\|

*abhyarcya sūryasaptamyāṃ mālyadhūpādibhirnaraḥ \|*  
*bhojayitvā dvijāñchaktyā prāpnuyātsvargamakṣayam \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On the day of Saptami a person should worship the Sungod offering the flower garlands and serve food to the Brahmanas. By so doing, he achieves the eternal heaven.

## \|\| 1.208.32 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ vipramukhyebhyo hiraṇyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|*  
*sa tadakṣayyamāpnoti sūryalokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A person who offers gold to the Brahmanas, he achieves the eternal Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.208.33 \|\|

*itīdaṃ kīrtitaṃ vīra saptamīvratamuttamam \|*  
*bhūya evābhidhāsyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Thus, I have narrated to you the process of performing of Saptami vratas. I am repeating the same subject and you please listen carefully.

## Chapter 209. Saptami vrata

## \|\| 1.209.1-6 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*yaḥ kṣipedgomayāhāraḥ śuklā dvādaśa saptamīḥ \|*  
*athavā yāvakāhāraḥ śīrṇaparṇāśano'pi vā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kṣīrāśī caikabhakto vā bhikṣāhārotha vā punaḥ \|*  
*jalāhāropi vā vidvānpūjayitvā divākaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

*puṣpopahārairvividhaiḥ padmasaugandhikotpalaiḥ \|*  
*nānāprakārairgaṃdhaiśca dhūpairguggulucaṃdanaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇagaṃdhapāyasādyairvicitraiḥ suvibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*arcayitvā dvijāñcchreṣṭhānhiraṇyānnādibhirnaraḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sa tatphalamavāpnoti kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ \|*  
*yadeha tapyate vīra prāpyate kevalaṃ raveḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|*  
*tataḥ puṇyakṣayādrājankule mahati jāyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Sumantu said — All the twelve Saptamis of the twelve (months and their vratas etc.) have already been brought out. Thereafter, cowdung, barley, shattered leaves, taking of little food and intake of water has been prescribed for the breaking of the fast. A person with wisdom should collect several types of presents like flower garland, lotus, blue lotus, various perfumes, incense, guggulu, sandal paste, black perfume, payasam, besides the ornaments which should be offered to the Sungod, while concluding the worship of the Sungod. Thereafter, the Brahmanas should be served with food. In case, a person does so, he achieves the merits, which can be achieved after performing of the huge yajnas with high amount of dakshina paid to the Brahmanas. A person who performs tapas simply to please the Sungod, he reaching the Suryaloka in a plane, is respected there. After the decline of his merits, he is reborn in a high race.

## \|\| 1.209.7-11 \|\|

*evaṃ bhaktyā vivasvaṃtaṃ pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā nāmāni parikīrtayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*caitrike māsi viṣṇuśca mādhave hyaryameti vai \|*  
*śukre vivasvā nmāse tu śucau māse divākaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*parjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi nabhasye varuṇastathā \|*  
*mārtaṃḍeti ca vijñeyaḥ kārtike bhārgavaḥ punaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mārgaśīrṣepi mitrastu kīrtitaḥ satataṃ budhaiḥ \|*  
*pūṣā pauṣe tu vai māse pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*māghe bhageti vijñeyastvaṣṭā caivātha phālgune \|*  
*evaṃ krameṇa nāmāni kīrtayetprītaye raveḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. Thus, the Sungod should be worshipped with devotion every month, besides uttering his names.
