In the month of Chaitra, he is adored as Vishnu; Aryama in Vaishakha, Vivasvan in Jyeshtha; Divakara in Ashadha; Parjanya in the month of Shravana; Varuna in Bhadrapada; Martanda in Ashvina; Bhargava in the month of Karttika; Mitra in the month of Pausha; Bhaga in Magha and Tvashta in Phalguna. These are the twelve names of Surya, which should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.209.12 \|\|

*dhūpārcanavidhimimaṃ saptamyāṃ susamāhitaḥ \|*  
*yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus, a person with devotion, who offers the incense and worship to the Sungod, he achieves the best of position (or saltation).

## \|\| 1.209.13 \|\|

*tataste sarvamākhyātaṃ yathāguhyatamaṃ vibhoḥ \|*  
*naiva deyamaśiṣyāya nābhaktāya kadācana \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In this way, I have spoken the secret tales of the Sungod, which can never be given to a non-disciple or to person with no faith.

## \|\| 1.209.14 \|\|

*na ca pāpakṛte deyaṃ na deyaṃ nāstikāya vā \|*  
*kṛtaghne nāstike vīra na deyaṃ krūrakarmaṇi \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. It should also not be given to a sinner, an atheist, an ungrateful person or a cruel person.

## \|\| 1.209.15-16 \|\|

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ saptamīvratamuttamam \|*  
*paṭhedyaścāpi niyataḥ śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya sūryaloke mahīyate \|*  
*puṇyakṣayādihāgatya rājā bhavati bhūtale \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. A person who practices the Saptami vrata with devotion or listens to it with reverence, he achieves all the comforts of the world, besides respect in the abode of Surya. After the decline of his merits, when he is reborn on earth, he becomes a monarch.

## Chapter 210. Surya worship

## \|\| 1.210.1 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*ityeṣa saptamīkalpaḥ samāsātkathitastava \|*  
*vistarātte punarvacmi śṛṇu caikamanā vibho \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O omnipresent one, I have explained the Saptami kalpa to you quite thoroughly. But now, I am speaking on the same quite exhaustively. You better listen with apt attention.

## \|\| 1.210.2 \|\|

*phālgunāmalapakṣasya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca samupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbhāskaraṃ snātvā gaṃdhapuṣpavilepanaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. On the sixth bright moon day of the month of Phalguna, one should keep fast and then he should take his bath. Then offering bath, fragrance, incense and flowers besides the pastes, the Sungod should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.210.3-4 \|\|

*arkapuṣpairmahābāho guggulena sugaṃdhinā \|*  
*śvetena karavīreṇa caṃdanena divākaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*guḍodakena naivedyaṃ nivedyaṃ prītaye raveḥ \|*  
*evaṃ pūjya divā bhānuṃ rātrau tasyāgrataḥ svapet \|*  
*japanbhaumaṃ paraṃ jāpyaṃ vinidraḥ satataṃ budhaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The flowers of the coral tree, scented incense, flowers of white oleander and the sandal paste should be offered to the Sungod who should be worshipped accordingly. Thereafter, the eatables made of sugarcane balls and water should be offered. Thus completing his worship during the day, the devotee should sleep before the image. The learned person should recite his mantra till he is overpowered by sleep.

## \|\| 1.210.5-6 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ tatparaṃ bhagavataḥ priyaṃ jāpyamanuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*japtavyo yatparairbhaktyā bhānustasyāgrato naraiḥ \|*  
*tanme brūhi tathā mantrāndhūpadīpānviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yenāhaṃ taṃ japañjapyaṃ pūjayāmi divākaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Shatanika said — Which one of the excellent mantra is liked by lord Bhaskara, which a person should keep on muttering with devotion, even at the time of sleep. You kindly enlighten us on the use of incense or lamp, because I intend to worship the Sungod and to mutter his mantra.

## \|\| 1.210.7-8 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*vacmi te bharataśreṣṭha samāsānna tu vistarāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa kuryātsarvaṃ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*japaṃ homaṃ tathā pūjāṃ śatajaptena sarvadā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Sumantu said — O excellent Bharata, I am speaking to you in brief. You please listen, because, there is no time to discuss the matter in detail. The six lettered mantra of the Sungod should be recited attentively. During the time of japam, homa or worship, the said mantra should be recited atleast a hundred times on each occasion.

## \|\| 1.210.9 \|\|

*sāvitryā ca japaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtvā śatasahasraśaḥ \|*  
*paścātsarvaṃ prakurvīta japādikamanākulam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Initially, the Savitri mantra should be uttered a hundred thousand times.

## \|\| 1.210.10-11 \|\|

*oṃ bhoḥ sāvitri bhāskarāya sahasraraśmi dhīmahi \|*  
*tena sūryaḥ pracodayāt \|\| 10 \|\|*

*japa eva paraḥ proktaḥ saptamyāṃ bhānunā svayam \|*  
*japtvā sakṛdbhavetpūto mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. On the day of Saptami, the recitation of the mantra — “Om bhoh Savitri Sahasrasmim dhimahi, tena Suryah prachodayat”, should be completed appropriately, because the said mantra has been revealed by the Sungod himself. With merely reciting this mantra once, a person is surely purified. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.210.12-13 \|\|

*prabhāte tvatha saptamyāṃ japanniyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbhānkaraṃ bhaktyā pūrvoktavidhinā nṛpa \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śraddhayā bhojayeccāpi brāhmaṇāñchaktito nṛpa \|*  
*divyānbhogāṃśca vidhivadbhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. O ruler, on the day of Saptami, a person should purify himself in the early morning and should perform japam of the mantra and should worship the Sungod with utmost devotion. Besides, the Brahmanas should also be served the excellent food with sever dishes.

## \|\| 1.210.14 \|\|

*vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta bhojakāṃśca prabhojayet \|*  
*na bhojayettathā'saurānsaurānyatnena bhojayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. While doing so, one should not be miserly about spending his money. The Bhojakas should be served with food, discarding those who are not devoted to Surya. He should serve food to the Brahmanas who are devoted to the Sungod, taking good care of them.

## \|\| 1.210.15 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*ke bhojyā ke na vā bhojyā brāhmaṇā brahmavittama \|*  
*keṣu citteṣu saptamyāṃ devadevo divākaraḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Shatanika said — O excellent Brahmana, which one of the Brahmana should be served with food and who should be excluded from the same? In which one of the Brahmanas, the Sungod remains lodged in their hearts?

## \|\| 1.210.16-19 \|\|

*ghaṭībhojyo bhavedvipraḥ saptamīṃ kurute ca yaḥ \|*  
*saurabhinneṣvabhojyo yo yaśca bhukto divākare \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ete bhojyā dvijā rājannādityena samāsataḥ \|*  
*proktāḥ kurukulaśreṣṭha tathā'bhojyāñchṛṇuṣva vai \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sabhāryaḥ sapatiryastu kuṣṭharogairhataśca yaḥ \|*  
*yaścānyadevatābhaktastathā nakṣatrasūcakaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*parāpavādanirato yaśca devalakastathā \|*  
*ete'bhojyāḥ savitrā tu svayaṃ devena cintitāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. Sumantu said — A Brahmana who performs the Saptami vrata is fit to be served with food repeatedly. But he should not be the one, who while worshipping the Sungod, is taking food with a person who does not believe in the Sungod. He should be the one who takes food with a devotee of a Surya. Such a person would be fit enough to be served with the food again and again. Such a Brahmana had been created by the Sungod himself for taking of food. O best of the race of Kurus, the Brahmanas who are unfit to be served with food, are going to be highlighted by me. You please listen. One who lives with a woman; one who performs the duty of a servant; a leper; who is ailing; who worships other gods; an astrologer; one who denounces others and a temple priest, such Brahmanas have been termed as unfit for serving food.

## \|\| 1.210.20 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*ye bhojyā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā ye cābhojyā dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi sarveṣāṃ vai samāhitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Shatanika said — Kindly speak out the symptoms of the Brahmanas who are to be served with food and those who are prohibited for the purpose?

## \|\| 1.210.21-22 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭho'smi rājendra kīrtayāmyeva kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*paṭhatāṃ tu trayī vidyāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kadambakaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ghaṭetyuktā tu sā rājansvayaṃ devena bhānunā \|*  
*sā ghaṭā vidyate yasya sa ghaṭītyucyate dvijaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Sumantu said — You have put up an excellent question. I am going to narrate all the symptoms, you please listen. The Brahmanas who are well-versed in the three Vedas are known as Ghatas. This has been revealed by the Sungod himself and such a Brahmana is known as a Ghata-Brahmana.

## \|\| 1.210.23-24 \|\|

*brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vīra śūdrāṇāṃ ca kadambakaḥ \|*  
*śṛṇvatāṃ vidhivatpuṇyaṃ bhaktyā pustakavācanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*iti māse nibaddhasya homasyeti ca bhānunā \|*  
*kathitaṃ kuruśārdūla svayamākāśagāminā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. A group of a Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaishya and Shudra, listening to the parayana of the sacred book, earns the merit. On the day of Masa-saptami, they should be made to conduct the homa and then food should be served to them. This has been revealed by the Sungod — the dweller of sky, himself.

## \|\| 1.210.25-28 \|\|

*yasyāḥ kartā bhavedyastu mama syātkarako mataḥ \|*  
*sa vipro rājaśārdūla sadeṣṭo bhāskarasya tu \|\| 25 \|\|*

*jayopajīvī vyāsaśca samaḥ syājjīvakastathā \|*  
*yānyetāni purāṇāni setihāsāni bhārata \|*  
*jayeti kathitānīha svayaṃ devena bhāsvatā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*ekaṃ nivāsayanyastu brāhmaṇaṃ tūpajīvati \|*  
*jayopajīvī sa jñeyo vācakaśca tathā nṛpa \|\| 27 \|\|*

*āruṇeyādiśāstrāṇi saptāśvatilakaṃ tathā \|*  
*yaśca jānāti saurāṇi vipraḥ saurassa tattvavit \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. A Brahmana who completes the process of the Saptami vrata, he is known as Karaka according to my opinion. Such a Brahmana is always dear to the Sungod. Similarly, he is also called as Jayopajivi, Vyasa and Jivaka as well. All the Puranas including the Mahabharata are known as Jaya. This has also been revealed by the Sungod himself A special Brahmana well-versed in these scriptures, should be kept by a person in his abode and he should be brought up carefully. Such a Brahmana is known as Jayopajivi and Vachaka. A Brahmana, who is well-versed in all the Shastras besides the Saptashva tilaka and is also aware of the solar scriptures, such a Brahmana is known as Tattvavit.

## \|\| 1.210.29-31 \|\|

*pūjayetsatataṃ yastu bhāskaraṃ nṛpasattama \|*  
*bhojakāṃśca tathā rājanyathā devaṃ divākaram \|\| 29 \|\|*

*sa jñeyo bhāskare bhakto bhojanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*bhojyānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ hyetadabhojyānāṃ śṛṇuṣva me \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vṛṣalī yasya vai bhāryā brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*parabhāryāpatirasau brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇādhamaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. O excellent king, those who always worship the Sungod, should adore the Bhojaka Brahmanas like the Sungod, offering food to them and make efforts in this regard. I had spoken out the symptoms of the Bhojya Brahmana or those who should be served food. Now, I shall speak about the Brahmanas, who should not be served the food. You please listen. A Brahmana who has a Shudra wife or the one who enjoys other women, he is said to be a degraded one.

## \|\| 1.210.32 \|\|

*daivena nihataḥ kuṣṭhī brāhmaṇo brahmaghātakaḥ \|*  
*bhojako viṃdate yastu na ca taṃ pūjaye ttathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. A Brahmana having the disease of leprosy, or the one who had killed a Brahmana or even a Bhojaka, should not be invited for food.

## \|\| 1.210.33 \|\|

*jñeyonyadevabhaktosau sa vipraḥ kurunaṃdana \|*  
*ādityaṃ bhojakaṃ vidyādbhānordehasamudbhavam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O son of Kuru race, the Brahmanas who worship other gods, should not be entertained for food. The Bhojaka Brahmanas are the form of the Sungod himself, having emerged out of his body.

## \|\| 1.210.34 \|\|

*nādityaṃ pūjayedyastu sa bhojyo na kadācana \|*  
*muṇḍo vyaṃgadharo gauraḥ śaṃkhapuṣpadharastathā \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. Therefore, the one who is not devoted to the Sungod, the one with shaven head, the joker, having fair complexion, carrying conch and flowers, such a Brahmana should not at all be entertained for serving of food.

## \|\| 1.210.35 \|\|

*yasya yāti gṛhe rājanbhojako mānavasya tu \|*  
*tasya yāṃti gṛhe devāḥ pitaro bhāraka rasya tu \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. When a Bhojaka arrives in a house of a person, all the solar deities, the manes and all deities related to the Sungod, reach there.

## \|\| 1.210.36 \|\|

*rakṣobhūtapiśācāśca yoginyopi palāyitāḥ \|*  
*sakṛdbhuṅkte gṛhe yasya bhojako gṛhadharmiṇaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The householder in whose house the Bhojakas arrive, and when the food is served to them once, the Rakshasas, goblins, Pishachas and Yoginis flee from that place.

## \|\| 1.210.37 \|\|

*saptasaṃvatsaraṃ yāvatṛpto bhavati bhāskaraḥ \|*  
*tasmāttānbhojayeddivyānbhojakānsatataṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*yastu tānniṃdate vipraḥ sa na bhojyaḥ kadācana \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. By serving the food even once to a Bhojaka, the Sungod remains pleased and satisfied for a period of seven years. Therefore, a learned person should always serve food to the Bhojakas. A Brahmana who denounces a Bhojaka, should not be served the food.

## \|\| 1.210.38 \|\|

*nijaṃ bhartāramutsṛjya svairaṃ yānyatra gacchati \|*  
*svairiṇī sā tu vai proktā pāpiṣṭhā kuladūṣiṇī \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. A woman who discarding her husband wanders freely or indulge herself in evil ways, such a sinful woman is known as adulteress, who blemishes the race.

## \|\| 1.210.39 \|\|

*pracchannaṃ rocate rājanyā nārī bhavadoṣataḥ \|*  
*jñeyā sā svairiṇī rājankule bhavati nāśinī \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. A woman who because of the blemished birth and who wanders freely, also comes under the same category. She also destroys the race.

## \|\| 1.210.40-43 \|\|

*yo'syāṃ rato bhavedvipraḥ sa jñeyaḥ svairiṇīrataḥ \|*  
*raṃgopajīvī kathako yaśca prākṛtanartakaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*raṃgopajīvī rājeṃdra tathā ca bahuyācakaḥ \|*  
*dve ete nāmanī rājankathakasya prakīrtite \|*  
*kṛtenānena yādṛkca udvṛttaḥ kurunaṃdana \|\| 41 \|\|*

*yaḥ stutiṃ gāyate vipraḥ proccaistu janasaṃsadi \|*  
*raṃgopajīvī proktoyaṃ dvitīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sūcanaṃ kathanaṃ proktaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu bhārata \|*  
*sūcayedyastu ṛkṣāṇi sa vai nakṣatrasūcakaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

40-43. The Brahmanas who unite with such a woman, those who live on dancing or those who are dancers by nature, are not fit to be served with food. The Kuthaka are of two types, viz., Rangopajivi and Bahuyachakas. A Brahmana who sings in a gathering in loud voice, he is known as Rangopajivi. Similarly, those who inform about the constellation or are astrologers, should also not be served with food.

## \|\| 1.210.44 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ bhavato yaddvijānprati \|*  
*vedāṃgaṃ jyotiḥśāstraṃ tu ṣaṣṭhaṃ proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Rangopajivi and Bahuyachakas. A Brahmana who sings in a gathering in loud voice, he is known as Rangopajivi. Similarly, those who inform about the constellation or are astrologers, should also not be served with food.

## \|\| 1.210.45-46 \|\|

*ṣaḍaṃgo na bhavettena rahitena dvijena ca \|*  
*abhojye paṭhanāttasya yadvatsyādbrāhmaṇo dvija \|\| 45 \|\|*

*bhojyo'khaṇḍaṃ yayau vipro'narthakena tvanarthakam \|*  
*vimṛśya kathyatāṃ vipra atra me saṃśayo mahān \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Shatanika said — I feel extremely painful by learning such things about the Brahmanas, because the learned people believe that astrology happens to be the sixth part of the Vedas.

## \|\| 1.210.47-48 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭosmi bhavatā śrūyatāmatra nirṇayaḥ \|*  
*yasya jīvyamidaṃ jñeyamaṃgaṃ viprasya vai bhavet \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sāṃvatsareṇa jyotiṣā jñānanakṣatrasūcakaḥ \|*  
*na sa bhojyo bhavedrājanyasyeyaṃ jīvikā bhavet \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Therefore, without its study, Brahmanas cannot be termed as the reciter of the six angas of the Vedas. But those who get mastery of that subject, cannot be served with food. (This is quite painful). O Brahmana, I have developed a great doubt in this connection. Let Bhojakas be everlasting, but the Brahmanas should not earn misfortune. Therefore, you kindly explain this subject again.

## \|\| 1.210.49-51 \|\|

*niṣkāraṇaṃ parāṇāṃ ca parokṣaṃ doṣakīrtanam \|*  
*guṇānāṃ ca yathā guptiḥ parivādaparastu saḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇo yastu rājeṃdra vṛttyā karma karoti vai \|*  
*devatāyatane ceha devānāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*ādhipatyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ ca naivedyasya paraṃtapa \|*  
*sa jñeyo devalo rājanbrāhmaṇo brāhmaṇādhamaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. Sumantu said — You have put me an excellent question. I am now talking decisively in this connection. You please listen. A Brahmana who earns his livelihood by practicing astrology, this prohibition applies to him alone. An astrologer, who after the study of the science of astrology, makes the people aware about the constellations, he is said to be excluded from the serving of the food.

## \|\| 1.210.52 \|\|

*nādhikārastu viprāṇāṃ bhaumānāṃ devapūjane \|*  
*vṛttyā bharataśārdūla ādhipatye viśeṣataḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Those who claim destinely, speak of a person’s short comings at his back, concealing the virtues, they are known as the denouncers. The Brahmanas, who in order to earn their living, perform the worship of the deities in temples and exerting their authority, also accept the naivedyas offered to the deities, such Brahmanas are unfit for serving food. Such Brahmanas are known as the degraded Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.210.53 \|\|

*yastu pūjayate devīṃ brāhmaṇo dravyalobhataḥ \|*  
*vṛttyai kurukulaśreṣṭha sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The Brahmanas of this earth are suitable to worship the images of the Sungod, particularly for those who earn authority in the temples.

## \|\| 1.210.54 \|\|

*devālayeṣu sarveṣu agnikāryaṃ ca suvrata \|*  
*yaḥ kuryāddravyalobhena adhogatimavāpnuyāt \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. O best of the race of Kuru, a Brahmana, who out of the greed, worships the goddess, he surely falls in the hell.

## \|\| 1.210.55 \|\|

*devālayeṣu sarveṣu varjayitvā śivālayam \|*  
*devānāṃ pūjanaṃ rājannagnikāryeṣu vā vibho \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. A Brahmana, who out of greed, performs homa in a temple, he has to face misfortune.

## \|\| 1.210.56 \|\|

*adhikāraḥ smṛto rājanbhojakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*pūjayaṃtastu te devānprāpnuvaṃti parāṃ gatim \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Except in a Shiva temple, the right of worship of deities in other temples has been assigned to the Bhojakas. There is no doubt about it. They alone achieve the best position or salvation, while adoring the deities in temples.

## \|\| 1.210.57-58 \|\|

*naivedyaṃ bhuñjate yasmādbhojayaṃti ca bhāskaram \|*  
*pūjayaṃti ca devānāṃ divyatantreṇa te gatāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā tu vai devānnaivedyaṃ bhakṣya ca prabhoḥ \|*  
*yāṃti te paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. By serving food to the Sungod and consuming his naivedya and with the worship of the gods, they achieve the best of the lokas. By worshipping the Sungod and the naivedya offered by them, they achieve the highest position.

## \|\| 1.210.59-62 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaścāpi taṃ brūyā ttīkṣṇe sati mahāmate \|*  
*evaṃ kariṣye śreyorthaṃ nātmanastava vā vibho \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ityāmaṃtrya tato gacchetsvagṛhaṃ kurunandana \|*  
*tathā pare'hni saṃpūjya devaṃ bhaktyā divākaram \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kṛtvā ca pāvakaṃ rājanbrāhmaṇānbhojayettataḥ \|*  
*śālyodanaṃ tathā mudgaṃ sugandhaṃ mudgameva hi \|\| 61 \|\|*

*apūpānguḍapūpāṃśca payo dadhi tathā nṛpa \|*  
*etaistu tṛptimāyāti bhāskaro narasattama \|\| 62 \|\|*

59-62. When the Bhojaka becomes enraged, the Brahmana should tell him with humility — “I do not perform for yourself, but always have been performing for the welfare of all. Therefore, I shall act accordingly.” Thus inviting him, he should proceed on to his place. On the next day, adoring the Sungod with devotion, should perform homa and then serve food to the Brahmanas. The boiled Shali rice, perfume, green gram, fried cakes and the same with sugarcane balls and the milk should be offered to the Sungod, which pleases the lord.

## \|\| 1.210.63-65 \|\|

*varjyāni bharataśreṣṭha śṛṇu tvaṃ gadato mama \|*  
*kulatthakānmasūrāṃśca niṣpāvādīṃstathaiva ca \|\| 63 \|\|*

*sisrukaṃ ca tathānyacca rājamāṣāṃstathaiva ca \|*  
*naitāni bhāskare dadyādya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*durgadhaṃ yacca kaṭukamatyalpaṃ bhāskarasya tu \|*  
*vimiśrāṃstaḍulāṃścāpi na dadyādbhāskarāya vai \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. O excellent Bharata, the articles which have to be discarded are being spoken by me. You please listen. The black wheat, lentil, nishpava, sisruka and kidney beans should not be offered to the Sungod by a person desirous of his own welfare. Similarly, a thing issuing bed smell, a bitter thing though with the slightest bitterness and the boiled rice mixed with pulses should never be offered to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.210.66-67 \|\|

*itthaṃ bhojya dvijaṃ rājanprāśayedarkasaṃpuṭam \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā devamudakena samanvitam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā ketanaṃ yastu bhajate'nyatra lokataḥ \|*  
*nāśnaṃti pitarastasya na devā na ca mānavāḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Thus, after serving food to the Brahmanas, the conclusion should be made with Arka-samputa. Initially, salutation should be made to the Sungod lowering the head. Such of the people who getting separated worship the flag of the Sungod, the manes, the gods and the humans do not take food in their houses.

## \|\| 1.210.68-70 \|\|

*niṣkramya nagarādrājangatvā pūrvottarāṃ diśam \|*  
*nātyucce nātinīce ca śucau deśe'rkamuttamam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*jātaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāho pūjayitvā khagottama \|*  
*pūrvottaragatāścaiva tasya śākhā diśannṛpa \|\| 69 \|\|*

*śākhāyā agrataḥ pātre susūkṣme pallavāśrite \|*  
*suśliṣṭe na pṛthagbhūte saṃpūjya gṛhamāvrajet \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. O king, coming out of the town or a village, one should move towards the east and a tree which is not grown over uneven surface should be worshipped. Then, he should worship its branch extending towards north and east besides its tender shoots and leaves and then return home.

## \|\| 1.210.71-72 \|\|

*snātaḥ pūjya vivasvaṃtamarkapuṣpaiḥ khagottama \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu arko me prīyatāmiti \|\| 71 \|\|*

*prāśya maṃtreṇārkapuṭaṃ tato bhuṃjīta \|*  
*vāgyataḥ devasya purato vīra tvaspṛśandaśanaiḥ puṭam \|\| 72 \|\|*

71-72. O best of birds, then he should take bath himself and worship Surya offering the flowers. Thereafter, food should be served to the Brahmanas, praying that — “Let the Sungod be pleased with me.” In this way, sanctifying the same with flowers of swallow wart, keeping silence, he should stand before the Sun, and should eat without touching it with the teeth.

## \|\| 1.210.73-75 \|\|

*oṃ arkasaṃpuṭa bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te'rkaṃ sadāstu vai \|*  
*mamāpi kuru bhadraṃ ca prāyaścittaprado bhava \|\| 73 \|\|*

*imaṃ maṃtraṃ japanrājansmarannarkaṃ mahāmate \|*  
*sthitvā pūrvamukho brahma vāriṇā sahitaṃ nṛpa \|\| 74 \|\|*

*prāśya bhuṃkte ca yo rājansa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|*  
*daṃtairaspṛśya he vīra tatpuṭaṃ cārkasaṃjñitam \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. O intelligent king, one should perform japam with Arka-samputa, stand facing east and consume it with water, and the said Arka samputa should not touch the teeth. In case he does so, he achieves the excellent position or salvation.

## \|\| 1.210.76-77 \|\|

*anena vidhinā bhaktyā kartavyā saptamī sadā \|*  
*yāvadvarṣe mahābāho prītaye'rkasya śraddhayā \|\| 76 \|\|*

*yaścemāṃ saptamīṃ kuryādbhāskaraṃ prīṇayannaraḥ \|*  
*tasyākṣayaṃ bhavedvittamacalaṃ sāptapauruṣam \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. O valorous one, vratas of each one of the Saptami in a year, when performed by a person appropriately, completing them all, the Sungod gets pleased with the same. Such of the people who perform the Saptami vratas to please the Sungod, his seven future generations enjoy enormous riches for all times to come.

## \|\| 1.210.78 \|\|

*suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tathā kṣayam \|*  
*kṛtvemāṃ siddhimāyātaḥ kauthumiḥ sahasā gataḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Besides, they also achieve the undestructible treasures of gold, silver and copper. With the performing of the Saptami — vrata, sage Kauthumi had achieved quick success.

## \|\| 1.210.79-80 \|\|

*kuṣṭharogācca vai mukto jayastomo mahīpatiḥ \|*  
*bṛhadbaladhvajaḥ kopī yājñavalkyo 'tha kṛṣṇajaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*arkaṃ caiva samārādhya tato'guste'rkasāmyatām \|*  
*iyaṃ dhanyatamā puṇyā saptamī pāpanāśinī \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. With the conducting of the same, the sage Kauthumi was relieved of leprosy. Similarly, the king Jayastoma, Brihadvala, Kopi, Yajnavalkya and the son of Krishna were freed (from leprosy) with the observing of the vratas of the same Saptami. They all, worshipping the Sungod, were formed like him. Therefore, this Saptami vrata is quite graceful, auspicious and is the remover of all the sins.

## \|\| 1.210.81 \|\|

*paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājankurvatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*tasmādeṣā sadā kāryā vidhivacchreyase'nagha \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. O king, with the reading, hearing or performing of its anusthana, all the sins get destroyed. Therefore, O sinless one, (for your own) welfare, its anusthana should be performed in an appropriate manner during all the times.

## \|\| 1.210.82-84 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*janakādayo yathā siddhiṃ gatā bhānuṃ prapūjya ca \|*  
*śrutaṃ mayā tu bahuśo na śrutaṃ kauthumiryathā \|\| 82 \|\|*

*siddhiṃ gato'rkamārādhya kuṣṭhānmuktaśca suvrata \|*  
*kaścāsau kauthumirvipraḥ kathaṃ kuṣṭha mavāptavān \|\| 83 \|\|*

*kathamārādhayāmāsa bhānuṃ devapatiṃ dvija \|*  
*etanme vipra nikhilaṃ kīrtayasva samāsataḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

82-84. Shatanika said — I have several times heard about the way, Janaka achieved success by worshipping the Sungod. But how did the Brahmana Kauthumi achieved success by worshipping the Sungod and got himself relieved of the disease of leprosy? I have not heard about the same. Who is this Kauthumi Brahmana? How could he attract leprosy? How did he worship the Sungod? O Brahmana, you kindly speak out the same to me.

## Chapter 211. Description of Arka Samputa

## \|\| 1.211.1-2 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭo 'smi rājeṃdra śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|*  
*āsītpurā mahāvidvānbrāhmaṇaḥ sthānagottamaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sa gataḥ putrasahito janakasyāśramaṃ dvijaḥ \|*  
*tatra vādo' bhavatteṣāṃ viprairanyairnṛpottama \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — O Rajendra, you have put up an excellent question. I am giving you the reply. You please listen. There was an excellent Brahmana in earlier times, he proceeded to the king Janaka with his son. Reaching there, they arose a controversy of his son with the Brahmanas there.

## \|\| 1.211.3-11 \|\|

*krodhāviṣṭena vai tatra hataḥ kauthuminā dvijaḥ \|*  
*tena dṛṣṭvā hataṃ vipraṃ tyaktaḥ pitrā sa kauthumiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhrātṛbhiśca mahābāho tathā śiṣṭaiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*pratyuktaḥ sa ca sarvaistu śokaduḥkhasamanvitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tīrthāni sa jagāmātha divyānyāyatanāni ca \|*  
*na ca muktastvasau vipraḥ sahasā brahmahatyayā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*amukte'tha tayā vipre paro vyādhirajāyata \|*  
*karṇanāsāvihīnastu pūyaśoṇitavisravaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pṛthivīṃ paryaṭansarvāṃ punarāgātpiturgṛham \|*  
*duḥkhopahatacittastu pitaraṃ vākyamabravīt \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pitargatastu tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca \|*  
*mukto'smi nānayā tāta krūrayā brahmahatyayā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kṛte'pi hi pare tāta prāyaścitte tu me'nagha \|*  
*kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi tātātīva rujo mama \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kṛtena karmaṇā yena alpāyāsena me vibho \|*  
*naśyettu brahmahatyeyaṃ vyādhiścāyaṃ paraṃtapa \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kathyatāṃ mā ciraṃ tāta kuru niḥśreyasaṃ mama \|*  
*hiraṇyanābho viprastu śrutvā vākyaṃ sutasya tu \|*  
*śokaduḥkhābhibhūtastu vākyaṃ putramuvāca ha \|\| 11 \|\|*

3-11. O best of humans, in the control of anger, his son named Kauthumi killed one of the Brahmana. Finding his son having been involved in Brahmahatya, the saintly Brahmana disowned his son. Similarly, the son, having been disowned by his brothers, relatives and other educated people, feeling painful at heart, he was worried and went to pilgrimage, visiting the divine temples to have an audience with the deities. Still, he could not be relieved from Brahmahatya. At the same time, he also attracted another ailment of leprosy. As a result of this, his nose, ears were matted and fallen. The pus and blood started oozing out of his limbs. He went round the entire earth, but had no respite from his sufferings. Ultimately, he returned home and with a pathetic voice, he spoke to his father in a pathetic voice — “I have visited all the auspicious places of pilgrimage as well as the temples of the deities, but I could not freed from the sin of the cruel Brahmahatya O father, I have performed the best of repentances for the purpose, but have not with no success. O sinless one, this ferocious disease is causing great pain to me. What should I do? Where should I go? O excellent one, you kindly suggest to me a small remedy by which, with a little effort, I get relieved of the Brahmahatya as well as the cruel disease. O great tapasvi, you kindly speak out quickly to me. My welfare rests with you.” The Brahmana named Hiranyanabha, on hearing the painful words of his son, felt concerned and with a painful heart said.

## \|\| 1.211.12-14 \|\|

*hiraṇyanābha uvāca \|*  
*jñātaḥ putra tava kleśaḥ prāpto yastvayāṭatā mahīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tīrthāni ca tvayā vatsa prāyaścittāni kurvatā \|*  
*na cāpi brahmahatyā tvāṃ muṃcate matkulodvaha \|\| 13 \|\|*

*upāyamekaṃ vakṣyāmi yena tvaṃ mokṣamāpsyasi \|*  
*alpāyāsena vai putra śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Hiranyanabha said — O son, I am well aware of the miseries faced by you, while travelling on earth. O son, (I am aware) that you went on pilgrimage and performed repentances too, but you could not be relieved of the sin of Brahmahatya. O lotus of my race, thou is a remedy by which you could be relieved of this misery. This is quite an insignificant one, which is going to be repeated by me.

## \|\| 1.211.15 \|\|

*kauthumiruvāca \|*  
*ārādhayāmi kaṃ devaṃ brahmādīnāṃ kathaṃ vibho \|*  
*śarīreṇa vihīno'smi hetunā sarvakarmaṇām \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Kauthumi said — Who is the god to be adored by me? How could Brahma and other gods be adored with this (deformed) body? Because of the ailments, I find my body to be unfit for the purpose and all the activities are performed with the body alone.

## \|\| 1.211.16-18 \|\|

*hiraṇyanābha uvāca \|*  
*siddhisaṃtatiyuktena karmaṇā tuṣṭimāpnuyuḥ \|*  
*devairapi supūjyoyamupalepanamārjanaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bhānureko dvijaśreṣṭha ūcurevaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*brahmā viṣṇurmahādevo jaleśo dhanadastathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhānumāśritya sarve te modaṃte divi putraka \|*  
*tasmādbhānoḥ samaṃ devaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi kaṃcana \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Hiranyanabha said — When the Sungod gets pleased, he bestows success at every step. The worship of the Sungod alone by smearing the body or with the sprinkling of the water is the best one, because the Sungod is adorable them. The learned people had declared that the Sungod alone is adorable. Brahma, Vishnu, Mahadeva, Varuna and Kubera are all dependant on the Sungod and they enjoy all the pleasures in the heaven. Therefore, O son, no other god, except the Sungod, is visible before me.

## \|\| 1.211.19 \|\|

*evaṃ bhānuṃ sarvamānyamadhunā khilakāmadam \|*  
*pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tāta narāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The Sungod grants the desires of the people of the universe and he represents the parents. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.211.20 \|\|

*tamārādhaya vai bhaktyā japanmaṃtramanuttamam \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni śṛṣu śraddhā samanvitaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Therefore, you recite his mantra wit devotion, listening to the ancient Pumas at the same time.

## \|\| 1.211.21 \|\|

*ārādhayanraviṃ bhaktyā japansāma mahāmate \|*  
*purāṇāni tato loke mokṣaṃ prāpsyasi putraka \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. O excellent one, the worship of the Sungod with devotion and listening to the reciting of Samaveda as well as the Puranas, you shall achieve redemption in this world itself.

## \|\| 1.211.22-23 \|\|

*kauthumiruvāca \|*  
*diśa sāmāni vai tāta pravarāṇi mahāmate \|*  
*oṃkārapravarodgīthaṃ prasthānaṃ ca catuṣṭayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*paṃcamaḥ parihārotra ṣaṣṭhamāhustamadbhutam \|*  
*nidhanaṃ saptamaṃ sāmnāṃ sāptavidhyamiti smṛtam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Kauthumi said — O father, O intelligent one, the Samaveda and Omkara Pravarodgitha are said to possess four Pratiharas, while Parihara is the fifth, Adbhut is the sixth and Nidhan is the seventh one. Thus, Samaveda is said to be divided into seven parts.

## \|\| 1.211.24-25 \|\|

*sāptavidhyamiti proktaṃ hiṃkārapraṇaveṣu ca \|*  
*aṣṭamaṃ ca tava śāṭhyaṃ navamaṃ vāmadevikam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhaṃ tu daśamaṃ sāma vedhase priyamuttayam \|*  
*eteṣāṃ tāta sāmnāṃ vai kaṃṭhe jāpyaṃ paraṃ matam \|*  
*japitvā tu ahaṃ śaktyā gacchāmi paramaṃ padam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Thus, Soma with seven parts and further seven parts of Himkara Pranava, the eighth one is Sathya; ninth is Vamadevika and the tenth is Jyestha-Sama which happens to be the favourite of Brahma. Remembering all these Samos by heart, you should recite them. Their recitation is said to be the best. By doing so, I would be able to achieve the supreme position or salvation.

## \|\| 1.211.26-28 \|\|

*hiraṇyanābha uvāca \|*  
*sādhu putra kulaṃ pūtaṃ tvatputreṇa samena ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*evaṃ gatasyāpi hi te jātā putra vidheḥ smṛtiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ tāta na saṃdehaḥ sāmānyetāni putraka \|\| 27 \|\|*

*pravarāṇi hi sāmnā vai brahmaṇā kathitāni ha \|*  
*eṣāmapi paraṃ proktaṃ sāmadvayamanuttamam \|*  
*tasmādekaṃ paraṃ jāpyaṃ sarva pāpabhayāpaham \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. Hiranyanabha said — O son, you have spoken well. My race gets purified by having a son like you, because even in this distressed condition, you are aware of the process. O son, the ordinary Pravaras (eminent passages) has been spoken by Brahma himself. There is no doubt about it. Two of them are said to be the best Samas and the recitation of one of them is extremely essential, because it happens to be the best and is destroyer of the sins.

## \|\| 1.211.29 \|\|

*kauthumiruvāca \|*  
*kathyatāṃ tāta tacchīghraṃ yattu sāmadvayaṃ param \|*  
*eteṣāṃ tāta sāmnāṃ tu nānyajjāpyaṃ ca yadbhavet \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Kauthumi said — You tell me rapidly, the names of the gods, who are the best, because in their presence, no other god’s worship would be necessary.

## \|\| 1.211.30 \|\|

*hiraṇyanābha uvāca \|*  
*jyeṣṭhasāmaparaṃ pūrvaṃ dvitīyaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Hiranyanabha said — First of all, Jyestha — Sama is said to be the best. Now I am speaking about the second one, which is Gadata. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.211.31-32 \|\|

*tataḥ śrāvyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu japtavyaṃ muktimicchatā \|*  
*tataśca paramaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*svayaṃ daivatamādiṣṭaṃ chaṃdasāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*priyaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasya priyaṃ sūryasya sarvadā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Now, I shall tell you about the third one which is Shravya and is quite suitable to be recited by those desirous of salvation, the existence of which was revealed by none else than the Sungod himself and which is the favourite of Brahma born of golden egg besides the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.211.33 \|\|

*japaśca viniyogopi lakṣaṇaṃ ca nibodha me \|*  
*satyena svaralīnastu śūkarādi smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. I am highlighting the related japam, viniyoga as well as the symptoms. You please listen, With the absorption of its sound, the reader is turned like a wild boar.

## \|\| 1.211.34-35 \|\|

*ṛturbhāvastathā dharmo vidharmaḥ satyakṛttathā \|*  
*dharmādharmau tathā kāryau dharmavedaname va ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yadebhirgīyate śabde ruciraṃ samayairdvijaiḥ \|*  
*jāpyaṃ tatparamaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. The Brahmanas should create with pleasant sound, Ritu, Bhava, Dharma, Vidharma, Satyakrit, Dharmadharma as well as Dharmavedana, by singing. The performance of the excellent japam has been revealed by the Sungod himself.

## \|\| 1.211.36 \|\|

*etadvai japamānastu punarāvartate na tu \|*  
*sarvarogavinirmukto mucyate brahmahatyayā \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. A person who performs japam for this, is freed from rebirth. Not only that, he is freed from all the sins, he is relieved of the sin of Brahmahatya as well.

## \|\| 1.211.37-39 \|\|

*etajjāpyaṃ tu saṃjapya ārādhaya divākaram \|*  
*gāyansāma tava proktaṃ śṛṇu paurāṇikaṃ suta \|\| 37 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhasāmno'pi te putra lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmi hi \|*  
*ādyāyādājyadoheti jyeṣṭhasāmopi lakṣaṇam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tava śrāvyaṃ japaṃ putrajyeṣṭhagāyai raviḥ sadā \|*  
*samārādhaya śṛṇvanvai putrāṇāmiva putraka \|*  
*evamārādhya deveśaṃ tato duḥkhaṃ prahāsyasi \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. Therefore, you should worship the Sungod with this mode. You have been enlightened of the singing of Samaveda. O Son, I am also speaking of the symptoms of earlier Pauranika, which you please listen. O son, I am revealing before you the symptoms of the elder Sama, Adyayadajya doheti is the symptom of the elder Sama. This is to be heard by you and you should worship the Sungod reciting the same. O son, by thus adoring the Sungod, all your sufferings would be subsided.

## \|\| 1.211.40-44 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*tataḥ śrutvā piturvākyaṃ sāmagaḥ kauthumistathā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ārādhayāmāsa raviṃ bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ śrāvyaṃ japanrājaṃtrikāle purato raveḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śṛṇvatastu purāṇāni bahmahatyā gatā tadā \|*  
*vyādhiśca kuruśārdūla phalametacchrutasyavai ' \|\| 42 \|\|*

*japatā yatphalaṃ tena devaṃ pūjayatā nṛpa \|*  
*sopi prāpto raviṃ rājañchṛṇuṣvaika manā nṛpa \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sa gato mūrtimānvipraḥ prasādādbhāskarasya tu \|*  
*praviśya maṃḍalaṃ bhānoḥ padaṃ yatparamaṃ vibhoḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

40-44. Sumantu said — Thereafter, Kauthumi — the reciter of Sama, on hearing the words of his father, started the worship of the Sungod with devotion and faith. He recited the said mantra thrice before the Sungod at the time of all the three Sandhyas. With the worship of the Sungod and listening to the Puranas, you listen to me attentively, the details of the merits he earned by worshipping the Sungod. I am speaking out the same. By the grace of the Sungod, the Brahmana, achieving an excellent body, entered the mandala of the Sungod and achieved the best position.

## \|\| 1.211.45-48 \|\|

*āvartate na cādyāpi gatosau paramaṃ padam \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ rājangataḥ siddhiṃ mahādvijaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*upoṣyemāṃ bhavedvīra saptamīṃ yāti bhāskaram \|*  
*kauthumirnaraśārdūla prasā dādbhāskarasya tu \|\| 46 \|\|*

*japamānastu vai sopi purāṇaśravaṇastathā \|*  
*ityeṣā kathitā rājanprathamā saptamī tathā \|\| 47 \|\|*

*arkasya puṭikā puṇyā vittadā yā priyā raveḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. He achieved such a high place as a result of which even today he does not have to face the rebirth. O king! Thus, I have related to you the story of success of an excellent Brahmana. By fasting on the day of Saptami, performing the vrata, Kauthuma achieved the Sayujya moksha of the Sungod. This happened by the grace of Bhaskara. In this way, the first Saptami or the Saptami with Arkaputa bestows the merit and the fortunes and is the favourite of the Sungod as has been explained to you.

## Chapter 212. Mode of the Sun worship

## \|\| 1.212.1 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ityeṣā kathitā vīra arkasaṃpuṭikā tava \|*  
*dvitīyā maricairyā tu śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — I have revealed the details of Arka-samputa Saptami. Now, I am talking you about the Mari (black pepper) Saptami, which you please listen.

## \|\| 1.212.2 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe tu caitrasya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ samyagupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbhāskaraṃ bhaktyā sauradharmavidhānataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. On the bright sixth day of the month of Chaitra, one should observe fast and the Sungod should be worshipped as per the solar scriptures.

## \|\| 1.212.3 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*brūhi sarvānmama brahmanmaṃtrānpuṇyānviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sūryādihṛdayaṃ cāpi śironyāsayutāṃstathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Shatanika said — O Brahmana, you enlighten me on all the Vedic mantras including Aditya hridaya, one in which Shironyasa has been mentioned.

## \|\| 1.212.4 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ vibho \|*  
*yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ bhaktyā bhānormahātmanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Sumantu said — O all pervasive one, you listen to the best of process with its secrets, which had been revealed by Brahma, being his special devotee. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.212.5-7 \|\|

*sarvapāpakṣayārthāya tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate \|*  
*sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamādityaṃ lokapūji tam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śikhādāmasamāyuktaṃ vakārāmṛtamuttamam \|*  
*oṃ vaṃ phaṭ \|*  
*oṃ eṣa sūryaḥ svayaṃ tāta maṃtramūrtirmahābalaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*asyānusmaraṇānmaṃtrī nityaṃ madhurabhojanaḥ \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa deveśaṃ sākṣādbhānuṃ prapaśyati \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Because of the worship done appropriately, whatever Brahma had said, you please listen. By performing the worship appropriately, all the sins vanish. The auspicious form of the Sungod, adored by the world, the excellent Vakara with a tuft with the mantra — Om vam phat. With Om this mantra is the form of a figure of the Sungod himself. The person who performs the same, he with its mere recall, achieves the delicious food. By performing this vrata for a year, one has an audience with the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.212.8-10 \|\|

*vyādhimṛtyośca nirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*satataṃ japamānastu rājanmaṃtravidāṃ varaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*manasā karmaṇā vācā śāpānugrahatopi vā \|*  
*kṣīrāśī maunamāśritya vivikte niyatendriyaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*japitvā dvādaśalakṣaṃ saśarīro divaṃ vrajet \|*  
*trailokyaṃ carate rājaṃściṃtāmaṇirivecchayā \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. By reciting this mantra for a year regularly, the performer getting relieved of the disease and death, achieves the Suryaloka. By performing the anusthana by mind, speech and the body, the performer, keeping silent and observing purity, if recites the mantra twelve lakhs of times, he achieves the heaven with the same body, inspite of his having been cursed earlier. He also roams about in the three worlds at will.

## \|\| 1.212.11-12 \|\|

*athedaṃ paramaṃ vāmaṃ sūryasya hṛdayaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*smartavyaṃ śucinā nityaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpa ham \|\| 11 \|\|*

*viyuktaṃ caṃdrasaṃyuktamṛkāreṇa ca bhārata \|*  
*oṃkāradīpitaṃ caiva hṛdayaṃ parikīrtitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. After this, I am going to speak about the heart of Surya, which is to be remembered in an auspicious manner and is the destroyer of all the sins. You please listen. O Bharata, together with Chandrakara, Rikara as well as Omkara when combined, are known as his heart.

## \|\| 1.212.13-15 \|\|

*yakārabiṃdusaṃyuktaṃ vaiśākhaḥ kathito budhaiḥ \|*  
*yakāraśca vakāraśca mātrā biṃdustathā nṛpa \|\| 13 \|\|*

*iṣṭaṃ kavacamādiṣṭamastraṃ vakṣye nibodha me \|*  
*praṇavādiṃ dukāraṃ ca sānusvāraṃ kaṭastathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*idamastraṃ smṛtaṃ rājannamṛtaṃ ca nibodha me \|*  
*biṃducaṃdrasamāyuktaṃ vakāramamṛtaṃ smṛtam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Yakara together with the bindu has been taken by the people as Yakara. Then, Yakara together with a vowel and bindu besides Vakara is known as the Ishta-kavacha. Thereafter, I am speaking about the Astra. You please listen. Together with Pranava (Om), Dukara besides Kata with the nasal sight (anusvara), has been termed as Astra. O king, now I speak about Amritastra. You please listen. Vakara with Chandrabindu (nasal sound) has been stated to be Amritastra.

## \|\| 1.212.16-20 \|\|

*oṃ brahmannastramamṛtaṃ gāyatrīṃ cāpi te rogaṃ dhenurvai parikīrtitam \|*  
*yakāraśca vakāraśca rirovetramādiśet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vyanetra etānyaṃgāni sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ \|*  
*ādityaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyaset \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sāvitrīṃ kaṃṭhadeśe tu aśeṣaṃ mūrdhni ciṃtayet \|*  
*arkanyāso mayākhyāto vidvānnyāsaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*ekākṣarasya sūryasya śṛṇvarcanavidhiṃ param \|*  
*prathamaṃ kiṃkiṇīmudrāṃ baddhvā tu hṛdaye nṛpa \|\| 19 \|\|*

*prāṇāyāme ca tathā parivīrasamanvitam \|*  
*ekākṣaraṃ samāvetti ātmaśuddhyarthamādarāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

16-20. O Brahmana, the Amritastra with Om, with Gayatri, Yakara, Vakara etc, are the limbs of the Sungod. The nyasa of the Sungod should start from the head and carried to the heart Gayatri is lodged in throat, while the rest of the nyasas should be aimed at the head. These are the nyasas of Surya which have been prescribed by the learned people and have been heard by you. Now you listen to the mode of excellent adoration of the Sungod. Initially, the hand should be held in the kimkini posture. Then, for the self purification, reciting Ekakshara mantra, pranayama should be performed, which is necessary.

## \|\| 1.212.21-23 \|\|

*punastvāmeva vadhyaṃ tu vakāreṇātmanā labhet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*etatkṛtvādityasamo bhavatīti na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā ca mudrāṃ prāsāde astraṃ yojya mahīpate \|\| 22 \|\|*

*prāsādaśobhanaṃ syādvai kṛtvā tadbharatarṣabha \|*  
*kavacenārkavāñchatruṃ kṣālayedvardhanakriyām \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Again the same Vakara should be used as support. Thus, a mudra should be created over the prasada which should be completed with astra. By so doing, the performer becomes like the Sungod himself. By so doing, the prasada gets glorified. With the putting on of the kavacha, he resembling the Sungod, with the process of advancement, makes the enemy to vanish.

## \|\| 1.212.24 \|\|

*tatorghyapātraṃ puṣpaiśca pūjayedvidhivanṛpa \|*  
*hṛdinā snāpayeddevaṃ tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Thereafter, the arghya vase with flowers and with meditating upon the Sungod in his heart, the performer should take a bath.

## \|\| 1.212.25 \|\|

*padmamudrā puṣpagarbhā devaṃ śirasi vinyaset \|*  
*āvāhito bhavedevaṃ devadevo divākaraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The nyasa of lotus mudra with flowers held in hands, should be performed at the head of the Sungod. The Sungod has to be invoked in a similar way.

## \|\| 1.212.26 \|\|

*hṛdayenārghyasaṃyuktāṃ pūjāṃ badhnīta bhārata \|*  
*hṛdayena ca naivedyaṃ dātavyaṃ śaktito vibhoḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. O Bharata, completing the worship of the Sungod with arghya, touching the heart, and then the eatable as per one’s means, should be offered to the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.212.27 \|\|

*yathāśakti japaṃ kuryātsuvratī vāgyatendriyaḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā rājansarvakā ryāṇi sādhayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. For the performing of the vrata, the mind and the speech should be well controlled. By completing the vrata with the same process, all the tasks of the performer get established.

## \|\| 1.212.28-29 \|\|

*na kvacitpratighātaḥ syānna cāpi duritaṃ bhavet \|*  
*vyomamudrāṃ parāṃ baddhvā kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*devaṃ visarjayetpaścāddhṛdayena mahīpate \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. The sinful acts or violent attacks or other miseries do not affect him. With the excellent posture and with the performing of circumambulation, the Sungod should be send off by heart.

## Chapter 213. Adoration of Surya

## \|\| 1.213.1-4 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tu pāvakaṃ devaṃ pāvakasthaṃ divākaram \|*  
*avyāttu saparīvāraṃ ghukāraṃ parikīrtayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛte śodhanaṃ syātpāvakasya na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*padmagarbhe tato vātha hṛdayāgnau samākṣipet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*āvāhito bhaveddevadevaḥ sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*oṃkāreṇāhutiśataṃ netrāṃjanasamādhinā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pañcāhutīstato dadyādaṃgānāṃ prītaye nṛpa \|*  
*visarjanaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhṛdayena vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sumantu said — Observing the form of Divakara like the fire resting in fire, his Ghukara form should be adored with his major and minor members, who always exists in the form of a member. By so doing, the fire gets purified. There is no doubt about it. With the fire in the lotus like heart, it should be struck accordingly. The Sungod is also invoked in the same manner. There is no doubt about it. Sitting in meditation, the offerings should be made uttering Omkara. Thereafter, meditating the Sungod in his heart, the devotee should also send him off.

## Chapter 214. Vrata of Maricha Saptami

## \|\| 1.214.1-2 \|\|

*sumantu ruvāca \|*  
*padminī ca tathānyā tu madhyamānāmanī tathā \|*  
*arkiṇī jvālinī caiva tejanī ca gabhastinī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śaṃkhamudrā ca daśamī sūrya vaktrā tathāparā \|*  
*sahasrakiraṇā caiva mudrā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sumantu said — There are twelve mudras (postures) known as — Pannini, Vyoma, (Udayashraya), Madhyama, Arkini, Jvalini, Tejani, Gabhastini, Shankha, Suryavakra, Para, Sahasrakirana, etc.

## \|\| 1.214.3 \|\|

*dadyādarghyaṃ tu padminyā vyoma baddhā japedbudhaḥ \|*  
*udayāśrayaḥ samākarṣe madhyamā vyādhināśinī \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. With Pannini mudra, arghya is offered to the Sungod. With Vyoma mudra, japam is performed as prescribed by the learned people. For attracting others, Udayashraya mudra is used. To get released from the disease, Madhyama mudra is used.

## \|\| 1.214.4 \|\|

*arkiṇyā paśyate sūryaṃ vidhisthastu bhavedyadi \|*  
*jvālinīmupasaṃgaṃtuṃ baddhvā sūryamukho japet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In case the Arkini mudra is used appropriately, the Sungod appears in person. Making use of the Jvalini mudra, japam should be performed.

## \|\| 1.214.5-6 \|\|

*saptāhādvīkṣate sūryaṃ sidhyate ca tataḥ svayam \|*  
*avatīrya padmakhaṃḍaṃ sūryādabhimukho naraḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*japañchatasahasraṃ hi akṣayaṃ labhate nidhim \|*  
*śaṃkhamudrādibhirimaṃ sūrya cakravidhiṃ śṛṇu \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. By performing japam in this way, the success is achieved besides having an audience with the Sungod. Reaching the middle of lotuses, in case the japam is made a hundred thousand times, a person achieves the imperishable treasure. Now, I am speaking about the process of Shankha mudra. You please listen.

## \|\| 1.214.7-10 \|\|

*ahorātroṣito bhūtvā baddhvā sūryamukho naraḥ \|*  
*sthitaḥ padmāsane rājañjapaṃścāpyayutaṃ manum \|\| 7 \|\|*

*paśyate tu tryahātsūryaṃ bhavetsiddhiśca mānasī \|*  
*sahasrakiraṇaṃ baddhvā nābhimātrajale sthitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*japedayutamātraṃ tu bhavettadgatamānasaḥ \|*  
*sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ paraṃ raśmibhirāvṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sa paśyati paraṃ dhāma bhavetsiddhiśca puṣkalā \|*  
*śāpānugrahakartāsau sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhavet \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Fasting for a day and a night, one should be seated in Padmasana facing the Sun and perform ten thousand japam. By so doing, the Sungod appears before the performer within three days and one achieves the desired success. Standing in water upto the navel, making use of the Sahasrakirana mudra, one who in meditation, performs japam of mantra for ten thousand times, he has an audience with the Sungod having a thousand rays, achieving success at the same time. Then, he becomes able to pronounce curse or bestow boons on people.

## \|\| 1.214.11 \|\|

*sarvataḥ kañcukaṃ muktvā bhavedvai vigata jvaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. By discarding bodies of all types, one feels peaceful.

## \|\| 1.214.12-13 \|\|

*parau gulphau karau kṛtvā saṃlagnau ca parasparam \|*  
*vāmānāmikayākramya dakṣiṇāṃ tu kanīyasīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vāmā dakṣiṇayā caiva dakṣiṇā vāmayā tathā \|*  
*mudraiṣā hi mahāpuṇyā vyomamudrā prakīrtitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Joining the hand and the ankle bone, the ring finger of left hand should be placed over the little finger of the right hand. Then the ring finger of the right hand should be placed over the little finger of the left hand, which is known as Vyoma mudra.

## \|\| 1.214.14 \|\|

*baddhayā cānayā sadyo hīyaṃte vyādhayo nṛṇām \|*  
*nānayā rahitaḥ kaścitsiddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. This auspicious mudra is known as Vyoma mudra. Making use of the same in an orderly manner, all the ailments of the people disappear. No performance can meet with success without this.

## \|\| 1.214.15 \|\|

*sarvatraivottamā hyeṣā maṃtramuṣṭiriti smṛtā \|*  
*sūryasya hṛdayaṃ seyamarkamudreti viśrutā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. This is known as the best mantra mushti, This is also the form of the heart of Surya and is also known as Arka mudra.

## \|\| 1.214.16 \|\|

*badhnīyātsatataṃ mantrairāyurārogyavṛddhaye \|*  
*sūryamaṃḍala abhyagre mantrī sūryodaye sthitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A person, who is well aware of this mantra, standing before his mandala in the morning, should perform this for the increase of his age and health. He should display this mudra always.

## \|\| 1.214.17-18 \|\|

*sa sūryābhimukho bhūtvā japenmaṃtraṃ tu sādhakaḥ \|*  
*dinatrayeṇa vīkṣeta dhyānī japaparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāśnute mṛtyuṃ duḥkhī na ca na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*prāpnoti ca paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The performer should stand facing the Sungod and recite the mantra, because a person who meditates on him can have an audience with the Sungod within three days, observing which he gets free from the jaws of death, nor does he suffer in anyway. There is no doubt about it. Thereafter, he achieves a place where the Sungod lives himself.

## \|\| 1.214.19-20 \|\|

*uttānau tu karau kṛtvā pṛṣṭhalagnau parasparam \|*  
*baddhvā tvaṃgulayaḥ sarvāḥ suprakīrṇā na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ākramya cāṃgulīmūlamaṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ yathākramam \|*  
*udayā nāma mudraiṣā badhnīyādudaye raveḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. By joining the reverse of both the hands and binding fingers with one another, both the thumbs should hold the end of the fingers. This is called Udaya mudra.

## \|\| 1.214.21 \|\|

*dvādaśādvīkṣate sūryaṃ dinātsa hi na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpaharā caiva sarvapāpavināśinī \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. This mudra, when used, enables the performer to have an audience with the Sungod within twelve days. There is no doubt about it. It also destroys all the sins.

## \|\| 1.214.22-33 \|\|

*udayā ca vinā vāmaṃ madhyataścaiva taṃ kṣipet \|*  
*madhyamā nāma vikhyātā madhyasū्rye tu cintayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*madhyamā vidhinā tena baddhvā mudrāṃ tu sādhakaḥ \|*  
*aṃgulyoḥ paramaṃguṣṭhau vidhinā tāvubhau grathet \|\| 23 \|\|*

*mudrā sāstamanī hyeṣā sarvatantreśvarī śubhā \|*  
*sūryasyāstamane mudrā baddhvā japtaṃ samārabhet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sahasraṃ hi śataṃ vāpi mudrāṃ baddhvā japedbudhaḥ \|*  
*sarvapātakasaṃyuktaḥ saptāhādanuśobhanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*karau parasparaṃ lagnāvaṃguṣṭhau cordhvasaṃsthitau \|*  
*ubhau cāṃguṣṭhakau cordhvau saṃlagnau mūrdhni saṃsthitau \|\| 26 \|\|*

*mudrā nu mālinī caiva nirdahetpāpapañjaram \|*  
*brahmahatyādi yatpāpaṃ yojitā sā tu mūrdhani \|\| 27 \|\|*

*vidarbhyāṃgulayaḥ sarvā īṣanmadhyastathāgrataḥ \|*  
*ūrdhvasthitau taṣāṃguṣṭhau mudreyaṃ tarjanī smṛtā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sarvavyādhiharā devī sarva śatruvināśinī \|*  
*etāṃ baddhvā mahāpuṇyāṃ sarvānstaṃmbhayate ripūn \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ubhau prasārya vai hastau madhye sārdhena saṃsthitau \|*  
*śeṣānāmyā tataścaiva aṃguṣṭhāgraṃ tathā kramāt \|\| 30 \|\|*

*mudrā gabhastinī nāma sūryasya hṛdayaṃ param \|*  
*mṛtyuṃ nāśayate hyeṣā baddhvā sūryodaye śubhā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*arghyakāle tu badhnīyādarcayāgniṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*japakāle ca badhnīyānmaṃtrāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vidakṣiṇakaniṣṭhikyāṃ tarjanībhyāṃ tathā bhavet \|*  
*tarjanībhyāṃ tathāṃguṣṭhau saṃlagnau tu parasparam \|*  
*japaṃ yaḥ kurute nityaṃ tribhirmāsairviśudyati \|\| 33 \|\|*

22-33. Udaya mudra is free from all the inferiority feelings. The mudra which is used at noon is called Madhyama. When the Sun reaches the mid-day, one should worship him. With the practice of Madhyama mudra in a proper way, the performer should knit both the thumbs with the fingers. Under tins circumstance, this is conceived to be the best of the mudras which bestows welfare and is called Ashtamani mudra. At the time of setting of the Sun, this mudra should be practiced, reciting the mantras at the same time. A person, who practicing this mudra, recites the Surya-mantra a lakh of times, such an intelligent person is freed from all the sins within a week’s time. Both the hands should be joined and when the thumbs are raised up teaching the head, it is called Malini mudra, which destroys all the sins, including Brahmahatya. The fingers should be spread a little in the centre and a little in the front when the thumbs air raised, it is called Tarjani mudra and relieves one of all the ailments besides the enemies. By practicing this mudra, all the enemies can be made inactive. In Gabhastini mudra, both the hands should be spread, then centre should be established in the front and the forepart of the thumb should be moved. This is called Gahistini mudra. At the time of the sunrise, when this mudra is practiced, it destroys even the death. This should be practiced while giving arghya. At the same time, the fire should also be worshipped. A person who performs with this mudra, surely captivizes (the enemies) with mantras. A person, who places the little finger of the right hand and links the ring fingers of both the hands and then makes the thumbs to join them and then performs the japam, he gets purified in three months.

## \|\| 1.214.34-35 \|\|

*karau tu saṃpuṭau kṛtvā tarjanyau dve ca kuñcayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sahasrakiraṇā hyeṣā sarvamudreśvareśvarī \|*  
*trisaṃdhyametāṃ badhnīyātsādhako maṃtramūrdhani \|*  
*nāśayetsarvapāpāni tamorāśimivāṃśumān \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Closing both the hands and then bending both the ting fingers, with curves, the Sahasrakirana mudra is formed, which is the foremost of all the mudras. In case, this particular mudra is used at the time of three Sandhyas, all the sins of the performer vanishes, like the darkness (vanishing with the rise of the Sun).

## \|\| 1.214.36 \|\|

*mudrā mudrakakuṃbheti baddhvā paścāttu maṃtrayet \|*  
*māsena nāśayetkuṣṭhaṃ tribhirmāsairna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*iti mudrāṃgasahitaṃ sūryaṃ pūjayate tu yaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The posture known as Mudra Kakumbha when practiced, the disease like leprosy vanishes in three months. There is no doubt about it. Thus, the Sun worship must be performed with the mudras.

## \|\| 1.214.37-40 \|\|

*anena vidhinā rājanbrahmā pūjayate ravim \|*  
*tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra pūjayānena bhāskaram \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tataḥ sūryamavāpyeha sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu pūjayetsata taṃ ravim \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ \|*  
*itthaṃ pūjya ca deveśamanena vidhinā nṛpa \|\| 39 \|\|*

*bhojayitvā yathāśakti brāhmaṇāṃśca vidhānataḥ \|*  
*saptamyāṃ prāśayedvāpi maricaṃ maṃtratastathā \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. O king, with the same process, Brahma worshipped the Sungod. Therefore, you also do the same to enable you to achieve the abode of the Sungod. Those who worship the Sungod following the same process, they achieve the best place, where they live with the Sungod O king, after worshipping the Sungod in this way, the Brahmanas should be served with food as per one’s own means and on the day of Saptami Maricha, they should also be invited and should break the fast with the same.

## \|\| 1.214.41 \|\|

*ekaṃ gṛhītvā maricamavraṇaṃ ca dṛḍhaṃ param \|*  
*sajalaṃ prāśayedrājanmantreṇānena vā smṛtam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. A hard black pepper without defect should be consumed reciting the mantra.

## \|\| 1.214.42 \|\|

*yathoktena vidhānena pūjayitvā divākaram \|*  
*iti saṃprāśya maricaṃ tato bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. After the worship of the image of Surya, the vrata should be concluded with the swallowing of black pepper, and then he should take food keeping silence.

## \|\| 1.214.43 \|\|

*priyasaṃgamavāpnoti tatkṣaṇādeva nānyathā \|*  
*itīyaṃ saptamī puṇyā priyasaṃgamadāyinī \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. By following this process, the devotee shall be united with his near and dear ones. Because of the same, this particular Saptami is also known as the one which unites the near and dear ones.

## \|\| 1.214.44 \|\|

*kuryādekena kāmāṃstu vatsareṇa sa gacchati \|*  
*putrādibhirnaraśreṣṭha punaḥ saṃgamamṛcchati \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. For the fulfilment of one’s own desires in case one worships the Sungod for a year, then he can again achieve sons and others.

## \|\| 1.214.45-47 \|\|

*kuru tasmānmahābāho tvameva priyadāyinīm \|*  
*upoṣya iṃdro vidhivatsurāmaricasaptamīm \|\| 45 \|\|*

*saṃyogaṃ kṛtavānvīra saha śacyā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*upoṣyaināṃ nalaścāpi damayantyā mahābalaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*rāmo'gātsītayā sārdhamupoṣyaināṃ narādhipa \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. O long armed one, therefore, you should also perform this vrata, because with the performing of the vrata of this Saptami, Indra was united with Shachi. The valorous Nala, after performing this vrata was united with Damayanti. Besides, Rama also was united with Sita, after performing this vrata.

## Chapter 215. Importance of Surya mantra

## \|\| 1.215.1 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*tṛtīyāṃ saptamī vīra śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|*  
*niṃbapatraiḥ smṛtā yā tu paramā roganāśinī \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sumantu said — O valorous one, I am speaking about the mode of the performing of third Saptami in which the leaves of nima tree are used for the breaking of the fast. You please listen. This Saptami with nima leaves, removes all the serious ailments, it is said.

## \|\| 1.215.2-3 \|\|

*yathārcanavidhirvānyo yena pūjayate ravim \|*  
*devadevaḥ śārṅgapāṇiḥ śaṃkha cakragadādharaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*athārcanavidhiṃ vacmi maṃtroddhāraṃ nibodha me \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. In this process of worship of the Sungod, holder of Shankha, Chakra, a bow known as Saranga, besides the Gada and is said to be the remover of all the ailments, is made by the process, which is going to be narrated by me.

## \|\| 1.215.4-6 \|\|

*oṃ khaṣolkāya namaḥ mūlamaṃtraḥ \|*  
*oṃ viṭi 2 śiraḥ \|*  
*oṃ sahasraraśma ye astram \|*  
*oṃ sahasrakiraṇāya 200 ūrdhvabaṃdhaḥ \|*  
*oṃ ghanāya bhūtabhāvine namaḥ iti bhūtabaṃdhaḥ \|*  
*oṃ jvala 2 prajvala 2 agniprakara \|\| 4 \|\|*

*oṃ ādityāya vidmahe viśvabhāgāya dhīmahi \|*  
*tannaḥ sūryaḥ pracodayāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*gāyatrīsaṃkalīkaraṇamidam \|*  
*oṃ dharmātmane namaḥ eśānyām \|*  
*oṃ dakṣiṇāya namaḥ āgneyyām \|*  
*oṃ vajrapāṇaye'naṃtāya namaḥ uttarataḥ \|*  
*oṃ śyāmapiṃgalāya namaḥ aiśānyām \|*  
*oṃ amṛtāya namaḥ āgneyyām \|*  
*oṃ budhāya somasutāya namo dakṣiṇataḥ \|*  
*oṃvāgīśvarāya sarvavidyādhipataye nairṛtyām \|*  
*oṃ śukrāya maharṣaye bhūtāya paścimataḥ \|*  
*oṃ īśvarāya sūryātmane namo vāyavyām \|*  
*oṃ kṛtavate namaḥ uttarataḥ \|*  
*oṃ rāhave namaḥ aiśānyām \|*  
*oṃ aṃtarāya sūryātmane namaḥ pūrvataḥ \|*  
*oṃ dhruvāya namaḥ aiśānyām \|*  
*oṃ bhagavate pūṣanmālinsakalajagatpate saptāśvavāhana bhūbhuja paramasiddhiśirasi gataṃ gṛhṇa tejorūpaṃ anaṃtajvāla 2 \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. The basic mantra is — Om khasholkaya namah. Then saying — Om viti, one should touch his head twice. Then reciting, Om Sahasra rashmaye, the astra should be touched. With Om Sahasrakiranaya the upper knot should be removed, then uttering Om ghanaya, the bhuta bandhana should be removed. Then Om jvala etc. combined with the Gayatri mantra should be uttered. Then, he should invoke Dharma in the north-east, Dakshina in the south-east, Indra — the holder of vajra in the north, Syama — Pingala in the north-east, the nectar in the south-east, Budha — the son of the Moon in the south, Vagishvara in the north, Shukra in the west, Ishvara in the north-west, Krita in the north, Rahu in north-east, Surya in the east and Dhruva in the north-east Then, lord Surya — the lord of the universe, should arrive at an excellent place and accept it He is lord of the entire universe, has innumerable flames and should arrive at the best place and accept it Salutation to the lord Aditya with a thousand rays, you arrive at your own convenience and be comfortable here. In this way, the Sungod should be invoked and salt off.

## Chapter 216. Mode of listening to the Purana

## \|\| 1.216.1-4 \|\|

*sumaṃturuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvarcāvidhiṃ rājanmaṃtrapūtena vāriṇā \|*  
*prokṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena kimarthaṃ susamāhitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*hadayādiṣvathāṃgeṣu maṃtraṃ vinyasya maṃtravit \|*  
*ātmānaṃ bhāskaraṃ dhyātvā paricārasamanvitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kuryātsaṃmārjanīṃ mudrāṃ diśāṃ ca pratibodhanam \|*  
*pātāle bhūśodhanaṃ caiva nabhasaśca tathā matam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*arcanasya prakāro'yaṃ sarveṣāmīpsitapradaḥ \|*  
*sarvairapi budhairvīra padmametatprakīrtitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sumantu said — O king, why in the mode of worship, the sanctified water is being used? Why is the sprinkling done, is going to be narrated by me. You please listen. The person well-versed in the mantras should first perform nyasa of the limbs of his body, reciting the mantras. Then, he should meditate the Sungod with all his associates and sprinkle water over all. Then, he should have knowledge of the directions, use the Sammarjani mudra, and recession of Patala and the sky, are the forms of making all the desires of a devotee successful. This is called Padma by the learned people.

## \|\| 1.216.5-6 \|\|

*aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ śucau deśe sakarṇikam \|*  
*āvāhanīṃ tato baddhvā mudrāmāvāhayedravim \|\| 5 \|\|*

*khaṣolkaṃ snāpayettatra svarūpaṃ lobhadāyakam \|*  
*sthāpayetsnāpayeccaiva maṃtrai maṃtraśarīriṇam \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Then, eight petalled lotus should be created at an auspicious place, in which the pericarp should be quite beautiful. Then, the posture should be used while invoking the Sungod. The Khasholka form of the Sun, in which excess of greed and profit is enshrined, (should be worshipped). Then, the image of Surya which is nicely built, should be consecrated reciting the mantras and the same should then be bathed.

## \|\| 1.216.7-8 \|\|

*āgneyyāṃ diśi devasya hṛdayaṃ sthāpayennaraḥ \|*  
*aiśānyāṃ tu śiraḥ sthāpya nairṛtyāṃ vinyasecchikhām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pauraṃdaryāṃ nyasennetre ekāmahṛdayastu saḥ \|*  
*āvāhya caikaṃ kavacaṃ vāruṇyāmastrameva ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Concentrating his mind, a person should worship the heart of Surya in the north-east direction, head in the north-east, the tuft in the south-east and the eyes in the east, should be imagined He should then be invoked, kavacha should be lodged in the west. Besides the Astras and Shastras should be imagined there.

## \|\| 1.216.9-10 \|\|

*aiśānyāṃ sthāpayetsomaṃ pauraṃdaryāṃ tu lohitaḥ \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ somatapanaṃ yāmyāṃ caiva bṛhaspatim \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nairṛtyāṃ dānavaṃ śukraṃ vāruṇyāṃ ca śanaiścaram \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ ca tathā ketuṃ kauberyāṃ rāhumeva ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Similarly, Soma should be lodged in the north-east, Mars in the east, Budha in the south-east, Brihaspati in the south, Danavas in the south-west, Saturn in the west, Ketu in the north-west and Rahu in the north should be lodged.

## \|\| 1.216.11-17 \|\|

*dvitīyāyāṃ tu kakṣāyāṃ devatejaḥsamudbhavān \|*  
*sthāpayeddvādaśādityānkāśyapeyānmahābalān \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhagaḥ sūryoryamaścaiva mitro varuṇa eva ca \|*  
*savitā caiva dhātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahābalaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tvaṣṭā pūṣā tathā rudro dvādaśo viṣṇurucyate \|*  
*pūrve cendrāya dakṣiṇe yamāya paścime varuṇāya uttare kuberāya aiśānyāmīśvarāya āgneyyāmagnidevatāyai nairṛtyāṃ pitṛdevebhyo vāyavyāṃ vāyave \|*  
*jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī cāparājitā \|*  
*śeṣaśca vāsukiścaiva revatī ca vināyakaḥ \|*  
*mahāśvetā mahādevī rājñī caiva suvarcalā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tathānyo vāpi devānāṃ samūhasta tra tatra ha \|*  
*tathānyo lokavikhyāto yogaḥ proktaśca dakṣiṇe \|\| 14 \|\|*

*purastādbhāsurasthāne sthāpanīyā vijānatā \|*  
*siddhirvṛddhiḥ smṛtirdevī śrīścaivotpalamālinī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sthāpyā svadakṣiṇe pārśve lokapūjyā samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*prājñāvatī kṣudhā vīra hārītā buddhireva ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sthāpya buddhimatī nityaṃ śrīkāmairvā vivasvataḥ \|*  
*ṛddhiścaiva visṛṣṭiśca paurṇamāsī vibhāvarī \|*  
*sthāpyāśca svottare pārśve ityetā devaśaktayaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

11-17. In the second compartment, the valorous twelve Adityas, emerging out of the lustre of the Sungod, should be consecrated. The names of these Adityas are said to be — Bhaga, Surya, Aryama, Mitra, Varuna, Savita, Dhata, Vivasvan, Tvasta, Pusha, Moon and Vishnu. India is lodged in the north; Yama in the south; Varuna in the west; Kubera in the north; Ishvara in the north-east; the fire god in southeast; Pitris in the north-east; Vayu in the northwest; the gods and the goddesses like Jaya and Vijaya, Jayanti, Aparajita, Shesha, Vasuki, Revati, Vinayaka, Mahashveta, Mahadevi, Rajni and the groups of other gods, besides the well-known yoga should be established in the southern direction. Siddhi should be placed in the best place before the Sungod, besides Vriddhi (advancement), Smriti (memory) while Shri Lakshmi should be established with lotus garlands decorating her. To the south-west of the same, the world renowned Prajnavati, Kshudha (hunger), Harita and Buddhi (intelligence) should also be consecrated. The devotees of Bhaskara should always worship the goddess Shri, Then, Riddhi, Visrishti, Paurnamasi, Vibhavari are the Shaktis, who should be lodged to the north-west.

## \|\| 1.216.18 \|\|

*dīpaścānnamalaṃkāro vāsaḥ puṣpāṇi mantrataḥ \|*  
*deyāni devadevāya sānugāya samūrtaye \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Reciting the mantras, the lamps, food, ornaments, clothes and the flowers should also be offered to the Sungod, who is the lord of the gods as well as his attendants.

## \|\| 1.216.19 \|\|

*vidhinānena satataṃ sadā yorcayati bhāskaram \|*  
*saṃprāpya paramānkāmāṃstato bhānusado vrajet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus, a person who worships Bhaskara in a proper way, all his desires get fulfilled and he ultimately achieves the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 1.216.20-23 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu bhojayedbhāskaraṃ nṛpa \|*  
*tvaṃ niṃba kaṭukātmāsi ādityanilayastathā \|*  
*sarvarogaharaḥ śānto bhava me prāśanaṃ sadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*itthaṃ prāśya japedbhūmau devasya purato nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu śaktyā dattvā tu dakṣiṇām \|\| 21 \|\|*

*bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ paścānmadhuraṃ kṣāravarjitam \|*  
*ityeṣā varṣaparyantaṃ kartavyā caiva saptamī \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kurvāṇaḥ saptamīmetāṃ sarvarogaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*sarvaroga vinirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. The food should be served to the Sungod in the same way, saying — “O nima, you are bitter, but gave the abode of the Sungod therefore, my prashana should be the remover of all the ailments and peaceful.” O king, in this way, the devotee should perform japam seated before the image of the Sungod. Then, serving food to the Brahmanas, he should pay them the dakshina as per his means. Then, he should silently discard the salt and should take sweet food. This process is required on all the Saptamis of the year and by so doing, all the ailments are subsided and the devotee earns the abode of Surya.

## \|\| 1.216.24 \|\|

*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*atha bhādrapade māsi site pakṣe mahīpate \|*  
*kṛtvopavāsaṃ saptamyāṃ vidhivatpūjayedravim \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O Intelligent one, in the bright fortnight of the month of Bhadrapada, one should observe fast and should worship the Sungod by the method of Maheshvara.

## \|\| 1.216.25-28 \|\|

*māheśvareṇa vidhinā pūjayedatra bhāskaram \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ tu punaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā divākaram \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dadyātphalāni viprebhyo mārtaṇḍaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*kharjūraṃ nālikeraṃ ca mātuliṅgaphalāni ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*devasya purato dattvā tathā cāmraphalāni ca \|*  
*iti te kathitaṃ rājansaptamīphalamāditaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*mahātapo mahāśreṣṭhaṃ bhāskarasya viśāmpate \|*  
*yacchrutvā mānavo rājanmucyate brahmahatyayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. Again, one should take a bath on the day of Ashtami. One should worship the Sungod and should think in his mind — “Let the Sungod be pleased.” Thereafter, the dates (palm), coconut and myrobalan should be given to the Brahmanas. First of all, the fruits with mango should be placed before the image of the Sungod and then, they should be given over to the Brahmanas. O king, thus, I have spoken to you about the importance of Phala-Saptami. This is the best of all the vratas of Bhaskara, with the mere listening to its name, a person is relieved of the sins of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 1.216.29-33 \|\|

*tathedaṃ paramaṃ parva kathitaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam \|*  
*yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyante mānavā nṛpa \|\| 29 \|\|*

*aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca \|*  
*sarvatīrthābhigamane vedābhyāse ca yatphalam \|*  
*yatphalaṃ pṛthivīdāne tatsarvaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*rājasūyasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca \|*  
*sahasraśatadānasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*lekhatvaṃ brāhmaṇo gacchetkṣatriyo vipratāṃ vrajet \|*  
*vaiśyo'pi kṣatratāṃ yāti śūdro vaiśyatvameva ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sūtamāgadha bandyādyā ye cānye saṃkarodbhavāḥ \|*  
*te'pi yāṃtyuttamaṃ sthānaṃ purāṇaśravaṇādvibho \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. All other similar types of sins simply vanish. A person attains merit equivalent to the performing of a thousand Ashvamedha sacrifices, a hundred Vajpeya sacrifices, pilgrimage of all the holy places, the study of the Vedas, donating of the land, performing of a thousand Rajasuya sacrifices, giving of a hundred thousand charities, can be achieved by simply listening to the Puranas. O excellent one, simply with listening of the Purana a Brahmana achieves godhood, a Kshatriya rises to the position of Brahmana, while Shudra rises to the position of a Vaishya. The Sutas (charioteers), Magadhas, Bandis (bards) and other people of mixed breed achieve the highest position.

## \|\| 1.216.34 \|\|

*itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ na tvanyatpāvanaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*yeṣāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. For humans, there is nothing else which could be more auspicious than the Puranas because, with the mere listening to the same, all the sins get destroyed.

## \|\| 1.216.35 \|\|

*vidhinā rājaśārdūla śṛṇvatāṃ yatphalaṃ kila \|*  
*yathoktaṃ nātra saṃdehaḥ paṭhatāṃ ca viśāṃpate \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O lion among the kings, with the reciting or listening of the Puranas, one gets the reward as has already been spelt out. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 1.216.36 \|\|

*śatānīka uvāca \|*  
*bhagavankena vidhinā śrotavyaṃ bhārataṃ naraiḥ \|*  
*caritaṃ rāmabhadrasya purāṇāni viśeṣataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Shatanika said — O lord, you please tell me the mode in which a person should listen to the epic of the Mahabharata? How should the epic of Ramayana, highlighting the story of lord Rama be listened?

## \|\| 1.216.37 \|\|

*kathaṃ tu vaiṣṇavā dharmāḥ śivadharmā aśeṣataḥ \|*  
*saurāṇāṃ cāpi viprendra ucyatāṃ śravaṇe vidhiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. O best of Brahmanas, you also please speak about the mode of listening to the details of Vaishnava dharma, Shaivism and solar dharma.

## \|\| 1.216.38-40 \|\|

*vācanīyaṃ kathaṃ cāpi vācako dvijasattama \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ cāsya me brūhi vācakasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*svarūpaṃ cāsya me brūhi khaṣolkasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ ca pūjite kiṃ syādvācake vidhivaddvija \|\| 39 \|\|*

*pāraṇepāraṇe pūjyo vācakaḥ śrāvakaiḥ katham \|*  
*samāpte bhagavankiṃkiṃ deyaṃ parvaṇi vācake \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. O best of Brahmanas, in which way, the reciting of the Puranas should be completed by the reciters? You also tell me the qualities of an orator and the form of Khasholka — mahatmya. O Brahmana, what type of a merit is earned by adoring the reciter or an orator and what should be given to an orator after the completion of the function or the recitation? You also please spell out the task that is established at the conclusion of each one of the parva.

## \|\| 1.216.41-43 \|\|

*na ca kiṃ kāryasiddhaṃ yatsiddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi \|*  
*sumanturuvāca \|*  
*samyakpṛṣṭo'smi rājendra itihāsapurāṇayoḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śravaṇe tu mahābāho śrūyatāṃ yanmayā purā \|*  
*pṛṣṭo vocanmahātejā viriṃco bhagavānguruḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*haṃta te kathayāmyeṣa purāṇaśravaṇe vidhim \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni śrutvā bhaktyā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmahatyādibhirvibho \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Sumantu said — O Rajendra, you have put up an excellent question. O long armed one, in earlier time, whatever lord Brahma had spoken about the merit of the history and Puranas, the same is going to be repeated by me. O excellent one, by listening to the history and Puranas with devotion, all the sins including the grave sin of Brahmahatya vanish.

## \|\| 1.216.44-45 \|\|

*sāyaṃ prātastathā rātrau śucirbhūtvā śṛṇoti yaḥ \|*  
*tasya viṣṇustathā brahmā tuṣyate śaṃkarastathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*pratyūṣe bhagavānbrahmā dināṃte tuṣyate hariḥ \|*  
*mahādevastathā rātrau śṛṇvatāṃ tuṣyate vibhuḥ \|*  
*pāraṇāni daśāheṣu eke kurvaṃti tāni bhoḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. When a person listens to the same in the morning, at noon or during the night, getting purified, the gods like Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva get pleased over him. By listening to the same in the morning, lord Brahma is pleased, by listening to the same in the evening, lord Vishnu is pleased and when one listens to the same during the night, lord Shiva gets pleased. The process of performing it for ten days has been prescribed.

## \|\| 1.216.46-48 \|\|

*bhavedvai rājaśārdūla śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam \|*  
*vidhānaṃ vācakasyeha śṛṇvatāṃ ca viśāṃpate \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śuddhavāsā gṛhādetya sthānaṃ yatsamayānvitam \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ tato gatvā yastasmindeva eva hi \|\| 47 \|\|*

*nātyuccaṃ nātinīcaṃ ca hyāsanaṃ bhajate tataḥ \|*  
*āsanaṃ tasya vai rājanbodhakasya sadā bhavet \|\| 48 \|\|*

46-48. O lion among the kings, the merits of its reciting or listening are being spelt out by me. One should put on the auspicious clothes, and leaving his house, he should reach the place where the recitation of the Puranas has been fixed. In the temple of Suryadeva, one should perform circumambulation, should arrange a seat for the reciter, which should be neither too high nor too low. The orator should always have such an asana.

## \|\| 1.216.49 \|\|

*vandanīyaṃ prapūjya ca śrotṛbhiḥ kurunandana \|*  
*vyāsapīṭhaṃ tu tatproktaṃ gurorāsanamādiśet \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. O son of Kuru race, the listeners should adore the orator properly, because he occupies the seat of Vyasa or a preceptor.

## \|\| 1.216.50 \|\|

*na stheyaṃ śrāvakaistasmādvācakasyāsane nṛpa \|*  
*rājāsane yathā bhṛtyairyathā putraiḥ piturnṛpa \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. No listener should occupy the seat of the orator. Similarly, the throne of the king should not be occupied by a servant and the seat of the father should not be occupied by the son.

## \|\| 1.216.51-53 \|\|

*yathā śiśurgurorvīra sa teṣāṃ hi gururmataḥ \|*  
*devārcāmagrataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇārcāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*upa viśya tataḥ paścācchrāvakaḥ śṛṇuyānnṛpa \|*  
*samastānāgatānkṛtvā tataḥ pustakamādadet \|\| 52 \|\|*

*praṇamya śirasā tasya pustakasya viśāṃpate \|*  
*graṃthiṃ ca śithilāṃ kuryādvācakaḥ kurunandana \|*  
*punarbadhnīta tatsūtraṃ tanmuktvā vācayetkvacit \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. The disciples should not occupy the seat of their preceptors, who has the great personality and happens to be his preceptor. Initially, the worship of the god should be done and then worshipping the Brahmana, the listener should be seated and listen. The orator should cast a delightful glance at the audience and he should accept the book. Before accepting the book, he should offer his salutation to the same, which has been prescribed. Thereafter, O son of Kuru race, he should remove the bondages of the book and should select the chapters which are required to be discussed on that particular day and get them released. The rest of the pages of the book should then be rearranged in bondage and placed properly, because the recitation from them are not going to be made on that particular day, but on some other day.

## \|\| 1.216.54-55 \|\|

*trividhaṃ pustakaṃ vidyātsūtraṃ vāsukirucyate \|*  
*patrāṇi bhagavānbrahmā akṣarāṇi janārdanaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*śaṃkaraśca tathā sūtraṃ paṃktayaḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|*  
*pāvakaśca tathā sūtre madhye bhānuḥ samāśritaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. The book is said to be of three forms. First is of Vasuki the leaves of which represent lord Brahma, the words represent lord Janardana, the lines represent Surya. Shankara and Pavaka in Sutras, while the Sungod is lodged in the middle.

## \|\| 1.216.56-57 \|\|

*agre sthitā grahāḥ sarve diśo vāpi tathā vibho \|*  
*smṛto meruḥ sadā śaṃkuśchidramākāśamucyate \|\| 56 \|\|*

*yaṃtradvayaṃ kāṣṭhamayamadhordhvaṃ yadudāhṛtam \|*  
*dyāvāpṛthivyośca śaṃkhastathā caṃdra udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*
