56-57. O excellent one, the planets are lodged in its foreparts, the directions, Sanku and Meru mountain, the wooden boards which are placed below the leaves and above them, represent the sky and the earth. They are also interpreted to mean the conch and cakra.

## \|\| 1.216.58 \|\|

*itthaṃ devamayaṃ hyetatpustakaṃ devapūjitam \|*  
*namasyaṃ pūjanīyañca gṛhe sthāpyaṃ vibhūtaye \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Therefore, the book represents the gods and adored by them. A person should offer his salutation to it which is worth adoration, and it should be lodged in his house for the increase of his wealth.

## \|\| 1.216.59 \|\|

*yo'sya sūtraṃ bṛhatkṛtvā prayacchati narottamaḥ \|*  
*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. A person who provides a long string for binding of the book, such an excellent person achieves the highest place where Divakara himself is lodged.

## \|\| 1.216.60-61 \|\|

*nirūpya pātraṃ rājendra karābhyāṃ gṛhya vācakaḥ \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā sarvānbrahmādīnvyāsameva ca \|*  
*vālmīkiṃ ca tathā rājanvidhiṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ ravim \|\| 60 \|\|*

*namaskāramathaiṣāṃ tu paṭhitvā kurunaṃdana \|*  
*tatosau vyāharedviprānvācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. O Rajendra, the orator should initially introduce the participants of the story, then he should carry the leaves of the book in his hand, offer his salutation to the gods like Brahma, then Vyasa, Valmiki, Vishnu, Shiva and the Sungod, and then start the recitation from the book. Thereafter, he should narrate the book with devotion to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.216.62-63 \|\|

*alaṃbitamatastabdhamadbhutaṃ vīramūrjitam \|*  
*asaṃsaktākṣarapadaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam \|\| 62 \|\|*

*saptasvarasamāyuktaṃ kālekāle viśāṃpate \|*  
*pradarśayanrasāntsarvānvācako vyāharennṛpa \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. Slowly, he should analyze the words and their meanings separately and should speak the words which should be without doubt, wonderful, firm and full of lustre. His words should be lucid, sweet, emotional and should be kept on flowing. At times, he should made use of the seven svaras (tunes). In this way, the orator should display all the rasas and should narrate the story of the parayana.

## \|\| 1.216.64-66 \|\|

*īdṛśādvācakādviprācchrutvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇāni rāmasya caritaṃ tathā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*niyamasthaḥ śuciḥ śrotā śṛṇuyātphalamaśnute \|*  
*brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāpi viśeṣataḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvānkāmānavāpnute \|*  
*rogaiśca mucyate sarvairmahatpuṇyaṃ ca viṃdati \|*  
*gacchedvāpi paraṃ sthānaṃ devasyādbhutamuttamam \|\| 66 \|\|*

64-66. By listening to the recitation from the Brahmana with devotion, of the history and the Puranas besides the story of Rama (Ramayana), the purified listener achieves the merit. The Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and shudras earn the merit of performing the Ashvamedha sacrifice. All their desires get fulfilled. They are also freed from the diseases and they earn great merit, besides achieving the wonderful place of the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.216.67-69 \|\|

*snātairgṛhaṃ samāgamya śrotṛbhirvācakasya tu \|*  
*praṇamya śirasā vipraṃ vācakaṃ śraddhayā nṛpa \|\| 67 \|\|*

*āsanaṃ ca samāśritya sthātavyaṃ vācakasya tu \|*  
*saṃmukhaṃ rājaśārdūla vāgyataiḥ susamāhitaiḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*vācakena namaskāre kṛte vyāsasya bhūpate \|*  
*na vaktavyaṃ mahābāho śrāvakaiḥ saṃśayādṛte \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. After taking bath in the house, the listener should then go to the listening place of the Purana and reaching there, he should be seated with devotion before the orator Brahmana, taking his seat. O valorous monarch, after the orator, while offering his salutation to vyasa becomes attentive, at that point of time, the listeners should only talk about their doubts and not on any other subject.

## \|\| 1.216.70 \|\|

*saṃśaye sati praṣṭavyo vācakaḥ saṃprasādya tu \|*  
*yataśca sa gurusteṣāṃ dharmato baṃdhurucyate \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. In case, a listener develops a doubt, then pleasing the orator, the question should be put to him, because the orator happens to be the preceptor of the audience present there and also kin as per dharma.

## \|\| 1.216.71 \|\|

*vācakenāpi vaktavyaṃ yatsyātteṣāṃ nibodhanam \|*  
*anugrahāya sarveṣāmaśeṣā guravo nṛpa \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. The orator should also be kind to the audience and should make use of such a simple language and speech, to enable them to understand things properly, because the orator happens to be their preceptor for all purposes.

## \|\| 1.216.72-74 \|\|

*namaskārādayaḥ śrāvyā śivamastviti vodyate \|*  
*vāgyatairnṛpaśārdla varṇaiḥ sarvairmahīpate \|\| 72 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ purato vaiśyā vaiśyānāṃ kṣatriṇastathā \|*  
*madhyasthito'tha sarveṣāṃ vācako vyāharennṛpa \|*  
*ye ca saṃkarajā rājannarāste śūdrapṛṣṭhataḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaṃ vācakaṃ vidyānnānyavarṇajamādaret \|*  
*śrutvānyavarṇajādvācaṃ vācakānnarakaṃ vrajet \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. O lion among the humans, while listening to the speech, the Vaishyas should be seated before the Shudras, Kshatriyas before the Vaishyas and the orator should be seated in the middle of all of them. The speech should then be listened by all of them. The people of mixed birth should be seated behind the Shudras. None else, but Brahmana should be made to serve as an orator or speaker, because by listening of the Puranas from the people of a caste other than the Brahmana, one fails in the hell.

## \|\| 1.216.75 \|\|

*itthaṃ hi śṛṇvatāṃ teṣāṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ \|*  
*māsimāsi bhavedrājanpāraṇaṃ kurunandana \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. O king, in this way, the listener should in each month, listening to the lines of the Purana and completing the process appropriately, perform the pāraṇa or conclusion.

## \|\| 1.216.76-78 \|\|

*śreyo'rthamātmano rājanpūjayedvācakaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*māsi pūrṇe dvija śreṣṭhe dātavyaṃ svarṇamāṣakam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇena mahābāho dve deye kṣatriyasya tu \|*  
*vācakāya dvijaśreṣṭha vaiśyenāpi trayaṃ tathā \|\| 77 \|\|*

*śūdreṇaiva ca catvāro dātavyāḥ svarṇamāṣakāḥ \|*  
*māsimāsi dvijaśreṣṭha śraddhayā vācakāya tu \|\| 78 \|\|*

76-78. A learned person should worship the orator for his own welfare. At the close of the month, the Brahmana should give one gram of gold, a Kshatriya should give two grams of gold, a Vaishya should give three grams and a Shudra should give away four grams of gold to the orator. O best of Brahmana, such a type of dakshina should be given by all the four varnas of the people with devotion.

## \|\| 1.216.79 \|\|

*prathame pāraṇe rājanvācakaṃ pūjya śaktitaḥ \|*  
*agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ viṃdati mānavaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. At the close of the first session, when a person performs adoration as per his means, he earns the merit of performing Agnishtoma yajna.

## \|\| 1.216.80-82 \|\|

*kārtikādīnsamārabhya yāvatkārttikamacyuta \|*  
*agniṣṭomaṃ gosavaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomaṃ tathā nṛpa \|\| 80 \|\|*

*sautrāmaṇiṃ vājapeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā vibho \|*  
*māheśvaraṃ tathā brāhmaṃ puṃḍarīkaṃ yajeta yaḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*ādityayajñasya tathā rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ \|*  
*phalaṃ prāpnoti rājeṃdra māsairdvādaśabhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*itthaṃ yajñaphalaṃ prāpya yāti lokāṃstathottamān \|\| 82 \|\|*

80-82. Starting from the month of Karttika, in case the performance of recitation is made every month, then a person achieves merits for each month for twelve months of the yajnas like Agnistoma, Gosava, Jyotishtoma, Sautramani, Vajapeya, Vaishnava, Maheshvara, Brahma, Pundarika, Aditya and Rajendra. The merits of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha yajnas could be achieved by performing vratas for Surya for twelve months continuously. Thus, a person gaining merits for all the yajnas, achieves the best of the lokas.

## \|\| 1.216.83 \|\|

*vajravedikasaṃpannaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam \|*  
*vimānamāsthito rājanmodate śakramaṃdire \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. O king, such a person, boarding a plane, with the pedestals of vajra and decorated with the gems, enjoys all the pleasures in the abode of Indra.

## \|\| 1.216.84-85 \|\|

*tataścaṃdrasya bhavane vāruṇe bhavane tataḥ \|*  
*śociṣkeśagṛhe gatvā gaccheccailavile gṛhe \|\| 84 \|\|*

*dhiṣaṇasya gṛhaṃ gatvā tataścitraśikhaṃḍinaḥ \|*  
*vṛddhaśravasamāsādya gacchetkaṃjajamaṃdire \|*  
*evameva nṛpaśreṣṭha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. Thereafter, he reaches the abode of the Moon, Varuna, Agni and Kubera, enjoying all the pleasures with the planets, and achieves the abode of Agni, Indra and Brahma. There is nothing to be thought about it.

## \|\| 1.216.86-87 \|\|

*phalametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satataṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*etatphalaṃ vatsareṇa śṛṇvato vidhito nṛpa \|\| 86 \|\|*

*etāni parimāṇāni vatsareṇa bhavaṃti vai \|*  
*śṛṇvatāṃ nṛpaśārdūla dadatāṃ vācakāya vai \|\| 87 \|\|*

86-87. The people who listen to the Puranas continuously for a year, they earn the due merits. This has been ordained. Listening to the recitation of the Puranas for a full one year and by offering dakshina to the orator, the listeners earn the due merit.

## \|\| 1.216.88 \|\|

*ekaṃ ca dve tathā trīṇi catvāri ca viśāṃpate \|*  
*deyāni vācakāyeha māsimāsi narādhipa \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. For the reciters of the Puranas of the Brahmana caste, dakshina of one, two, three or four grams of gold should be given to the orator (by each one of the varnas). This process has been prescribed for the listeners for each and every month.

## \|\| 1.216.89 \|\|

*brāhmaṇādyairnṛpa śreṣṭha sarvavarṇavibhāgaśaḥ \|*  
*samāpte parvaṇi tathā vācakaṃ pūjayetpunaḥ \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. The Brahmanas and the people of all other castes should adore the orator in the same way.

## \|\| 1.216.90 \|\|

*vācakaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva sarvakāmaiḥ prapūjayet \|*  
*gandhamālyādibhirdivyairvā sobhirvividhairapi \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. For the fulfilment of all the desires, the adoration of the Brahmana, offering fragrant flowers to him, has been prescribed.

## \|\| 1.216.91-92 \|\|

*vācakāya pradattvā tu tato viprānprapūjayet \|*  
*hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ rukmaṃ gāśca kāṃsyopadohanāḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

*dattvā ca vācakāyeha śrutasya prāpyate phalam \|*  
*yathā sadakṣiṇaṃ cānnaṃ śrāddhakāle prakīrtitam \|*  
*tathā śrutaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sadakṣiṇamudāhṛtam \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. After adoring the orator and offering dakshina etc. to him, the Brahmanas should be entertained, offering to them in charity gold, silver, bronze, milk, besides the decorated cows. When the orator is given such types of articles, he earns the merits prescribed above. At the time of performing of a Shraddha, the giving of the food has been prescribed, similarly, the process of giving id after listening to the Puranas is almost the same.

## \|\| 1.216.93 \|\|

*vācakaṃ pūjayedyasmā tpaścāllekhakapūjanam \|*  
*samāpte parvaṇi vibho viśeṣeṇaiva cārcayet \|\| 93 \|\|*

93\. After worshipping the orator, the worship of the book is also essential and particularly at the end of the parva or the festival.

## \|\| 1.216.94 \|\|

*vācakaḥ pūjito yena pūjitāstena devatāḥ \|*  
*vācake parituṣṭe ca mama prītiranuttamā \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. One who performs the worship of the orator, he is believed to have worshipped all the gods, because when the orator gets immensely pleased, he becomes my favourite.

## \|\| 1.216.95 \|\|

*iti vedhāḥ sadā prāha devānāṃ purataḥ purā \|*  
*tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagatsarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ bhavati nityaśaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

95\. This is what Brahma had spoken in presence of the gods in earlier times. When the orator is pleased, all the listeners of the world get pleased with him.

## \|\| 1.216.96 \|\|

*tasmātprapūjayedvipra vācakaṃ nṛpa sattama \|*  
*na tulyaṃ vācakeneha pātradānasya vidyate \|\| 96 \|\|*

96\. Therefore, a Brahmana orator should be immensely worshipped, because there is no better receiver of the charity as compared to the orator.

## \|\| 1.216.97 \|\|

*tiṣṭhaṃti yasya śāstrāṇi jihvāgre pṛthivīpate \|*  
*dṛṣṭaśca gocarastāta kastena sadṛśo dvijaḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

97\. O lord of earth, a Brahmana on whose tip of the tongue all the scriptures are lodged, then which other Brahmana could be compared with him?

## \|\| 1.216.98 \|\|

*na tulyaṃ vidyate tena bhuvi pātraṃ nareṣu vai \|*  
*tasmādannaṃ sadā pūrvaṃ tasmai deyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|*  
*śrāddhe yasya dvijo bhuṃkte vācakaḥ śradayānvitaḥ \|*  
*bhavaṃti pitarastasya tṛptā varṣaśataṃ nṛpa \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. Since there is no orator comparable with him on earth, the learned people have ordained to offer the food initially to him alone. A person with whom, on the eve of Shraddha an orator Brahmana takes food with devotion, his manes at the same time feel satisfied for a hundred years.

## \|\| 1.216.99-100 \|\|

*yatheha sarvadevānāṃ bhāskaraḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā \|*  
*kalasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam \|\| 99 \|\|*

*budhyamānaḥ sadātyarthaṃ graṃthāthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu graṃthārthaṃ vācayennṛpa \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. As lord Bhaskara has been termed to be the best of all the gods, similarly, the Brahmana orator, who is quite clear in speech, wonderful, calm, who well understands the meanings of the words in a book, is said to be the foremost of all. The Brahmanas and people of other castes should listen to the meaning of the words in the book with devotion.

## \|\| 1.216.101 \|\|

*ya evaṃ vācayedrājanya vipro vyāsa ucyate \|*  
*ato'nyathā kathayitā jñeyo'sau vaktṛnāmakaḥ \|\| 101 \|\|*

101\. A person who performs of the religious scriptures, he is known as a Vyasa and those who perform other are known as Vyasas.

## \|\| 1.216.102 \|\|

*itthaṃbhūto vasedyasminvācako vyāsasannibhaḥ \|*  
*deśe'tha pattane rājansa deśaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 102 \|\|*

102\. A country or a village in which anyone comparable with Vyasa lives, the said country and the village is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 1.216.103 \|\|

*te dhanyāste mahātmānaste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*vasaṃti yatnato yasminsa deśaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. Therefore, graceful is the orator besides being the great souls and successful. The country in which such Vyasas live, that country is said to be the best of all.

## \|\| 1.216.104 \|\|

*na śobhate puraṃ vīra vyāsahīnaṃ kadācana \|*  
*yathārkahīnaṃ hi dinaṃ caṃdrahīnā yathā niśā \|\| 104 \|\|*

104\. As a day without the Sun and a night without the Moon does not look graceful, similarly, a country can never be graceful without an excellent orator.

## \|\| 1.216.105 \|\|

*na rājate saro yadvatpadminī rahitaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*tathā vyāsavihīnaṃ tu rājate na puraṃ kvacit \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. As a tank without the lotus flowers does not look graceful, similarly, a village without a Vyasa does not look graceful.

## \|\| 1.216.106 \|\|

*praṇamya vācakaṃ bhaktyā yatphalaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ \|*  
*na tatkratusahasreṇa prāpyate kurunaṃdana \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. The merit one earns by offering salutation to an orator, the same cannot be achieved by performing of thousands of yajnas.

## \|\| 1.216.107 \|\|

*yathaikato grahāḥ sarve ekatastu divākaraḥ \|*  
*tathaikato dvijāḥ sarve ekatastu sa vācakaḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. As all the planets cannot be compared with the grace of the Sungod alone, similarly, an orator cannot be compared with a number of Brahmanas.

## \|\| 1.216.108-109 \|\|

*yathā vedasamo nāsti āgamo bhuvi kaścana \|*  
*tathā vyāsasamo nāsti brāhmaṇo bhuvi kaścana \|\| 108 \|\|*

*kurukṣetrasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na dvitīyaṃ pracakṣate \|*  
*na nadī gaṃgayā tulyā na devo bhāskarādvaraḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. As there is no Agama on earth which could be compared with the Vedas, similarly, there is no sacred place on earth comparable with Vyasa. As no river in the world is as sacred as the holy river of the Ganga, similarly, there is no other deity better than the Sungod.

## \|\| 1.216.110-114 \|\|

*nāśvamedhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ na pāpaṃ brahmahatyayā \|*  
*putrajanmasukhaistulyaṃ na sukhaṃ vidyate yathā \|\| 110 \|\|*

*tathā vyāsasamo vipro na kvacitprāpyate nṛpa \|*  
*daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pāvanaḥ paramo nṛṇām \|\| 111 \|\|*

*nāsti vyāsasamaḥ śreṣṭha itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ \|*  
*atha viprasahasrāṇāṃ vipro'yaṃ śreṣṭha īritaḥ \|*  
*upaviṣṭo yadā bhuṃkte vyāso vai vipramaṇḍale \|\| 112 \|\|*

*śrāddhe tāta pavitrāṇi kathitāni purā mama \|*  
*brahmaṇā rājaśārdūla śṛṇu tāni yathāvidhi \|\| 113 \|\|*

*madhu pāyasaṃ kālaśākastilāśca kutapastathā \|*  
*rājataṃ cāpi pātreṣu brāhmaṇeṣvatha vācakaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

110-114. As there is no merit bigger than the one earned with the performing of the Ashvamedha sacrifice, there is no sin worst than the Brahmahatya, no pleasure greater than the birth of a son, therefore, there is no other Brahmana better than Vyasa. There is no human better than him among the people or even the gods, because this is the well-known Vedic tradition that there is no one better than Vyasa. Such a Brahmana is considered to be the best among the thousands of Brahmanas. When a Vyasa takes food on the event of a Shraddha in the group of Brahmanas, everything is purified that time. O lion among the kings, this was revealed by none else than Brahma himself in earlier times. I am repeating the same process. You please listen. As honey, payasam, kala-shaka, sesamum seeds and deer skin are considered to be pure and in the vases, the vases of silver are considered to be the best, similarly, among the Brahmanas, the orator is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 1.216.115-120 \|\|

*daive karmaṇi pitrye ca sa jñeyaḥ paṃktipāvanaḥ \|*  
*vācakaśca yatiścaiva tathā yaśca ṣaḍaṃgavit \|\| 115 \|\|*

*ete sarve nṛpaśreṣṭha vijñeyāḥ paṃktipāvanāḥ \|*  
*nāmanī vācakasyaite śṛṅgavārthamathaitayoḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

*itihāsapurāṇāni jayeti viditāni vai \|*  
*upajīvati yasmādvai vācayāno dvijo nṛpa \|*  
*jayopajīvī tenāsau gataḥ khyātiṃ tu vācakaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣaramidaṃ tathā \|*  
*kalasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam \|\| 118 \|\|*

*yudhyamānotha vātyarthaṃ graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu graṃthārthaṃ cārpayettathā \|\| 119 \|\|*

*ya evaṃ vācayedrājanya vipro vyāsa ucyate \|*  
*ato'nyathā vācayitā na gacchedvyāsatāṃ kvacit \|\| 120 \|\|*

115-120. In the rites relating to the gods and the manes, Vyasa should be considered as the sacred one. O best of monarchs, the orator, husband, the Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas with six angas, are said to be of the excellent line. The orator is known as Vachaka as well as Vyasa, therefore, I am going to reveal the meaning of these words. You please listen. The Pauranika literature and history is known by the name of Jaya. A Brahmana who earns his living by performing the par ayanas, he is known as Jayopajivi vachaka (orator). He is extremely clear (in his experience), wonderful, calm and recites in sweet and emotional voice all the scriptures, gaining all the knowledge of the same. Then, he recites these scriptures in front of the Brahmanas, who listen to the same. Such a person is known as Vyasa.

## \|\| 1.216.121 \|\|

*trividhaṃ vācakaṃ vidyātsadā guṇavibhedataḥ \|*  
*śrāvakaṃ ca mahābāho trividhaṃ guṇabhedataḥ \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. Because of the difference in merits or talent, the Vachakas have been divided into three categories.

## \|\| 1.216.122-131 \|\|

*dvāvetau kathyamānau tu nibodha gadato mama \|*  
*abhidrutaṃ tathāspaṣṭaṃ vistaraṃ svaravarjitam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*padacchedavihīnaṃ ca tathā bhāvavivarjitam \|*  
*abudhyamāno graṃthārthamabhīṣṭotsāhavarjitaḥ \|\| 123 \|\|*

*īdṛśaṃ vācayedyastu vācakaḥ kṣmādhipeśvara \|*  
*krodhano'priyavādī ca ajñānādgraṃthadūṣakaḥ \|\| 124 \|\|*

*budhyate na ca kaṣṭācca sa jñeyo vācakādhamaḥ \|*  
*vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam \|\| 125 \|\|*

*abudhyamāno graṃthārthaṃ vācayedyastu vācakaḥ \|*  
*sa jñeyo rājaso rājannidānīṃ sāttvikaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 126 \|\|*

*vispaṣṭamadbhutaṃ śāṃtaṃ spaṣṭākṣarapadaṃ tathā \|*  
*kalasvarasamāyuktaṃ rasabhāvasamanvitam \|\| 127 \|\|*

*attyarthaṃ budhyamānastu graṃthārthaṃ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu ācāryo vidhivannṛpa \|\| 128 \|\|*

*ya evaṃ vācayedrājansa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ \|*  
*śraddhā bhaktivihīno yo lobhiṣṭhaḥ kaṭuko yathā \|\| 129 \|\|*

*hetuvādaparo rājaṃstathāsūyāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*nityāṃ naimittikāṃ kāmyāmādadaddakṣiṇāṃ nṛpa \|\| 130 \|\|*

*vācako yo mahābāho śṛṇuyādyastu mānavaḥ \|*  
*sa jñeyastāmaso rājañchrāvako mānavo'pi saḥ \|\| 131 \|\|*

122-131. I am now talking about the other two types of orators or Vachakas. You please listen. The one who clears quickly the interpretation (of subjects), expands it, is without rhythm, unrelated and lacks imagination and is unaware of the correct interpretation of the scriptures, he is known as a vachaka. Besides, being of angry nature, harsh speaker, polluter of the scripture because of his ignorance and ignorant of the true meaning of scriptures, inspite of his making best efforts to well understand the same, he is known as the degraded Vachaka. A person who has the clear speech, who is surprisingly calm, who recites the passages with a sweet lucid tone and who (unnecessarily) expand the interpretation of the subject due to ignorance, is known as Rajasa Vachaka. Now, I am explaining about the Sattvika orator, you please listen. The one who is extremely clear in his expression, wonderful, calm, clear and who speaks the word and the passages quite clearly, whose speech is quite sweet, lucid with correct expressions and explains the complex passages with ease, such a person has been said to be the Acharya of the Brahmanas. A person who performs the parayana of this type, is known as the Sattvika vachaka. O king, similarly, a vachaka who is devoid of faith and devotion, is greedy, bitter like the swallow wort, who gets himself involved into unnecessary controversy, who charges fees for the performing of the routine rites, is known as Tamasa vachaka. All the listeners of such a type of orators have also been described as Tamasa listeners.

## \|\| 1.216.133-136 \|\|

*rājankautukapātraṃ tu sa jñeyo rājaso bhavet \|*  
*saṃtyajya sarvakāryāṇi bhaktyā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 133 \|\|*

*satataṃ pūjayedyastu vācakaṃ śraddhayā mudā \|*  
*nitye naimittike kāmye gurūnvai devatāstathā \|\| 134 \|\|*

*ya evaṃ śṛṇuyādvīra sa jñeyaḥ sāttviko budhaiḥ \|*  
*vyāsaḥ pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ yathā vyāsavaco nṛpa \|\| 135 \|\|*

*tasmātpūjyatamo nānyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ nṛpottama \|*  
*yataḥ sa vai gurusteṣāṃ jñānadātā sadā nṛpa \|\| 136 \|\|*

133-136. A learned Brahmana should not perform parayana for the sake of such people. O king, in case, a person who is devoid of faith and devotion, for him it is an entertainment only and as such he is known as a Rajas listener. A person with faith and devotion, who leaving aside all his engagements, always adores the orator and also worships the gods and the preceptors on the festive occasions, such type of listeners are known as Sattvika listeners According to the words of a Vyasa, he is extremely adorable for the listeners. There is no other listener more adorable than such listeners, because such an orator happens to be his preceptor, because of his imparting knowledge to him.

## \|\| 1.216.137 \|\|

*caturṇāmiha varṇānāṃ nānyo bandhuḥ pracakṣyate \|*  
*vyāsādṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

137\. O best of rulers, the Vedas and the Shrutis ordain that for all the four varnas, there is no other kin better than Vyasa.

## \|\| 1.216.138 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayedvācakaṃ sadā \|*  
*sa guruḥ sa pitā mātā sa baṃdhuḥ sa suhṛttathā \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. Therefore, all the people, making all the efforts, should worship the orator, because, he happens to be the preceptor, the parents, the kin and the friend.

## \|\| 1.216.139 \|\|

*vācako nṛpaśārdūla viprādīnāmaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*itthaṃ vyāso gururjñeyaḥ pūjyo mānyo dvijātibhiḥ \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. O lion among the rulers, Vachaka (orator) is also adorable for all the Brahmanas in the same way. Such a type of Vyasa should be taken to be a preceptor. For Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, he is adorable and is honoured by them.

## \|\| 1.216.140 \|\|

*śṛṇvaṃti ye narā rājansa teṣāṃ gururucyate \|*  
*pūjārthaṃ tasya samayaḥ śrāvakāṇāmudāhṛtaḥ \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. O monarch, the people who listens to the recitation, for them he is the preceptor of all of them. The time has been prescribed for the listeners to worship him.

## \|\| 1.216.141-142 \|\|

*ye śṛṇvaṃti nṛpaśreṣṭha māsi māsi dadaṃti te \|*  
*svarṇamāṣakamekasmai vācakāya pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 141 \|\|*

*dvādaśyāṃ cāmāvāsyāyāmatha vā ravisaṃkrame \|*  
*sā nityā dakṣiṇā tasyāṃ yā ca śreyo'rthamātmanaḥ \|\| 142 \|\|*

141-142. Such of the people who listen to the recitation for a month, they should individually present him a gram of gold each. When the recitation is listened to on the day of Dvadashi, moonless night and on the first day of the month, the same amount of dakshina has been prescribed for the orator.

## \|\| 1.216.143 \|\|

*ayane viṣuve caiva caṃdrasūryagrahe tathā \|*  
*prāpte vāparapakṣe ca dānaṃ tasyai svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 143 \|\|*

143\. At the time of meeting of both the ayanas, meeting of the time of day and night, at the eclipses of the Sun and Moon, a person should give away dakshina as per his means.

## \|\| 1.216.144 \|\|

*deyaṃ syācchrāvakaistāta taṃ muktvā nānyato nṛpa \|*  
*prathamaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ śreyo'rthaṃ śrāvakaiḥ sadā \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. Besides the specified above, the listener should not present anything else to the orator. When something else has to be given, the listener should first give away the things stated above and then rest should be given.

## \|\| 1.216.145 \|\|

*adattvā tasya yenyasmai saṃprayacchaṃti śrāvakāḥ \|*  
*avamānaḥ kṛtastaistu vācakasya bhavennṛpa \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. Without first giving the aforesaid things if something else is given, it amount to the insulting of the orator by the listeners.

## \|\| 1.216.146 \|\|

*kṛtvāvamānamatha taiḥ prāpyate yatphalaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇādyaiḥ samastaiśca tacchṛṇuṣva varānana \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. Even after thus insulting the orator, the merits earned by the listeners are being spoken by me.

## \|\| 1.216.147 \|\|

*śūdratvaṃ brāhmaṇo yāti kṣatriyo yāti kākatām \|*  
*jāyate ca tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. A Brahmana becomes a Shudra. The Kshatriyas turn as crows. The Vaishya and the Shudras are born in the houses of Chandalas.

## \|\| 1.216.148 \|\|

*tasmātpūjyo nṛpaśreṣṭha prathamaṃ vācako budhaiḥ \|*  
*āpatkāle ca vṛddhau ca yataścāsau guruḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 148 \|\|*

148\. Therefore, O excellent monarch, the learned people should worship the orator first, because he is considered to be their preceptor even during the time of calamity.

## \|\| 1.216.149 \|\|

*vaiśākhyāmayane vīra tṛtīyāyāṃ ca suvrata \|*  
*kārttikyāmatha mārgyāṃ ca saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaṃ bhavet \|\| 149 \|\|*

149\. On the full moon day of the month of Vaishakha, at the time of ayana and third moon day, besides on the full moon days of the month of Margashirsha and Karttika, the orator should be worshipped.

## \|\| 1.216.150-152 \|\|

*parvasvanyeṣu ca vibho saṃpūjyo dharmataḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 150 \|\|*

*annaṃ cāpi tathā pakvaṃ māṃsaṃ ca kurunaṃdana \|*  
*dātavyaṃ prathamaṃ tasmai śrāvakairnṛpasattama \|\| 151 \|\|*

*vācakastu yathā nityaṃ sukhamāste narādhipa \|*  
*na pīḍyate yathā dvaṃdvaistathā kāryaṃ varānana \|\| 152 \|\|*

150-152. Similarly, on the days of other festivals, after performing the usual puja, the gold wealth, cereals and food should be given by the listeners (to the orators). The listeners should move in a way in which the orator is relieved of all the miseries and he becomes comfortable. The listeners should act accordingly.

## \|\| 1.216.153 \|\|

*hemaṃte lomaśā deyāśchatraṃ prāvṛṣi sattama \|*  
*upānahau kālayogye kāle caivānulomaśaḥ \|\| 153 \|\|*

153\. At the time of the cold season, the blanket should be given, while an umbrella should be given during the rainy season. During the winter and summer seasons, the shoes should be given.

## \|\| 1.216.154 \|\|

*itthaṃ dvaṃdvavinirmuktaḥ sa yeṣāṃ vācako nṛpa \|*  
*te dhanyāḥ śrāvakā loke te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 154 \|\|*

154\. With this, the orator when gets relieved of the misery with the help of the listeners, then such listeners are considered as graceful in the world and they achieve the supreme position.

## \|\| 1.216.155 \|\|

*ātmanā tu kathaṃ vīra sukhamicchedvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*viṣamasthe gurau rājanyataśca sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

155\. Finding the preceptor in a miserable condition, who will be the person with wisdom to desire for his own comfort? Because, the orator has been conceived as a preceptor.

## \|\| 1.216.156 \|\|

*vācakaśrāvakāṇāṃ ca tasmāddvaṃdvaṃ vighātayet \|*  
*yatnaḥ kāryaḥ śrāvakaiśca vācakasya janādhipa \|\| 156 \|\|*

156\. O foremost of the people, therefore, the listener should never tolerate the misery of the orator and should try to remove it, while the orator should do so for the listeners.

## \|\| 1.216.157-159 \|\|

*itthaṃ pūjyaḥ sadā vyāsaḥ śreyo'rthaṃ prathamaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*bhartā pūjyo yathā strīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ vai mahī pate \|\| 157 \|\|*

*śrāvakāṇāṃ tathā rājanvācakaḥ pūjya ucyate \|*  
*upādhyāyastu śiṣyāṇāṃ yathā bhāgavato hariḥ \|\| 158 \|\|*

*saurāṇāṃ ca yathā bhānuḥ śaivānāṃ śaṃkaro yathā \|*  
*vācakastu tathā pūjyaḥ śrāvakāṇāṃ narādhipa \|\| 159 \|\|*

157-159. Thus, Vyasa should always be worshipped first of all. As the husband is adorable for all the wives, the preceptor for the disciples and Vishnu is adorable for the Vaishnavas, similarly, the orator is respectable for the listeners. The Sungod is adorable for the devotees of the Sun, Shiva for the devotees of Shiva, similarly, the orator is adorable by the listeners.

## \|\| 1.216.160 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāṃ dadatā nityaṃ śrotavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|*  
*pūrvoktamāṣakaṃ tasmai vācakāya janādhipa \|\| 160 \|\|*

160\. With the desire for the increase in one’s own wealth, the dakshina of a gram of gold should be invariably be given to the orator, while listening to his discourse.

## \|\| 1.216.161 \|\|

*yadā dātuṃ na śaknoti māṣakaṃ kāṃcanasya tu \|*  
*rajatasya tadā deyaṃ māṣakaṃ śreyase nṛpa \|\| 161 \|\|*

161\. In case, a person is unable to give dakshina of a gram of gold to the orator, then for his own welfare, the silver of the same weight should be given as dakshina.

## \|\| 1.216.162 \|\|

*tadabhāve hiraṇyaṃ ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*mṛttikāpi hi dātavyā prāpnoti satphalaṃ śubham \|\| 162 \|\|*

162\. One should not be miserly in giving the wealth, but in its absence, an equivalent amount of copper or other metal can be given. In case, one is unable to give even that, he can give an earthen vase, by which he can also earn the best of merits.

## \|\| 1.216.163 \|\|

*ityeṣā dakṣiṇā nityā māsimāsi bhavennṛpa \|*  
*naimittikā bhavedrājangrahaṇādiṣu parvasu \|\| 163 \|\|*

163\. At the beginning of each month or the eclipse and other auspicious days, the prescribed amount of dakshina should always be given to the orator. This has been prescribed.

## \|\| 1.216.164-165 \|\|

*amale vāsasī rājangaṃdhamālyavibhūṣaṇe \|*  
*samāpte parvaṇi vibho dātavye bhūtimicchatā \|\| 164 \|\|*

*jñātvā sarvasamāptiṃ tu pūjayecchrāvako dhuvam \|*  
*ātmānamapi vikrīya ya icchetsaphalaṃ śrutam \|\| 165 \|\|*

164-165. O all-pervading one, at the time of the conclusion of the festival too, neat clothes, perfume, flower garland and the ornaments should be given. At the conclusion of the festival, in order to make the listening of the scripture a success, the listener should worship the orator.

## \|\| 1.216.166 \|\|

*naimittikāṃ ca nityāṃ ca dakṣi ṇāmapradāya ca \|*  
*śṛṇoti ca sadā yastu tasya tanniṣphalaṃ śrutam \|\| 166 \|\|*

166\. A person who listens to the recitation of casual or regular nature without offering the dakshina, his listening of the scriptures becomes fruitless.

## \|\| 1.216.167 \|\|

*yathā ca dakṣiṇāhīnādyajñānna phalamaśnute \|*  
*tathā śrutaṃ ca rājeṃdra dakṣi ṇārahitaṃ smṛtam \|\| 167 \|\|*

167\. As a person does not earn the merit for the yajnas without giving of the related dakshina, similarly, the listening of the scriptures is of no consequence, without giving of dakshina.

## \|\| 1.216.168 \|\|

*caturguṇā bhavedrājanyā nityā dakṣiṇā vibho \|*  
*samāpte parvaṇi vibho ityāha bhagavāñchivaḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

168\. O king, the dakshina which is given regularly, it gets multiplied at the end of the parva.

## \|\| 1.216.169 \|\|

*ityeṣa kathito rājanpurāṇaśravaṇe vidhiḥ \|*  
*yataśca vidhihīnaṃ tu na karmaphalamudyate \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. O king, I have thus revealed to you the process of listening to the Puranas. Therefore, nothing should be done without following the regular process.

## \|\| 1.216.170 \|\|

*snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam \|*  
*vidhipūrvaṃ smṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ yatheha kurunadana \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. O son of the race of Kurus, the taking of bath, giving of charities, performing of japam and Homa as well as worship of gods and the manes, should be done in a proper manner.

## \|\| 1.216.171 \|\|

*phaladaṃ nṛpaśārdūla purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*yathāyaṃ kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ vidhinā śravaṇaṃ mayā \|\| 171 \|\|*

171\. O lion among the rulers, I have explained to you the process of listening to the Puranas, which is fruitful.

## \|\| 1.216.172-173 \|\|

*yathoktaṃ tu yathā jīvaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmavādinā \|*  
*sa brāhmaṇo mahārāja sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

*yathāśrutaṃ mahābāho tathedaṃ kathitaṃ tava \|*  
*bhāskarasya tu māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ vācakasya tu \|\| 173 \|\|*

172-173. The Brahmavadins have thus defined the jiva. Therefore, such Brahmanas are adorable for all. Listening to Puranas from an orator has been recommended. Thus, I have spelt out the glory of Bhaskara as well as the orator.

## \|\| 1.216.174-178 \|\|

*tathā ca saptamīkalpaḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu pūjayetsatataṃ naraḥ \|\| 174 \|\|*

*bhagalokaṃ samāsādya triṣu lokeṣu gīyate \|*  
*tato'rkalokamāsādya gaccheccitraśikhaṃḍinaḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

*tasmādapi mahābāho gacchellokaṃ divākaram \|*  
*arkaloke tato yātastato golokamaśnute \|\| 176 \|\|*

*ṛtasya ca tato gacchetkaṃjajasya tataḥ param \|*  
*daśānāṃ rājasūyānāmagniṣṭomaśatasya ca \|\| 177 \|\|*

*śravaṇātphalamāpnoti pitāmahavaco yathā \|\| 178 \|\|*

174-178. Similarly, I have also explained Saptami-kalpa which removes all the sins. Such of the people who worship the Sungod following the mentioned process, they achieve the place of Surya, where they are praised. Thereafter, they achieve Arka (Surya), fire and thereafter, they reach Goloka. From there, they go to Satya and Brahmaloka. They also earn the merits for the performing of Agnishtoma yajna as well as the Rajasuya yajna, by listening to the Puranas, as per the words of Brahma.
